jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Salary:£90,000 - £100,000
Location: Remote, but within the UK
Please note:We are unable to sponsor international visas at this time.
About Nexus Mods
Established in 2001, Nexus Mods is the largest video game modding platform on the internet - a household name in the PC gaming ecosystem.
77M+ registered members
900K+ mods for 5,000+ games
24B+ mod downloads
We’re currently focused on product modernisation, driving growth and building infrastructure for the next 10 years of community-powered modding.
The Role:
We are looking for a seasoned Head of Product to join our team, in order to drive product delivery and execution.
You’ll be working with multiple product-led cross-functional teams, with the aim to improve execution speed and delivery of value to users. This is a senior role, with responsibility for managing the product team, including hiring, onboarding, performance management and career development.
This role needs a strong leader who can operate at and sustain high capacity, managing multiple priorities at any one time. Your goal is to optimise our delivery speed and processes, whilst taking the time to learn and understand our complex product.
Role Requirements
8-10 years of product experience, with at least 3+ years leading a product team at a product-led organisation.
Take a pragmatic approach to delivery, finding user-centric products that are valuable, usable and feasible.
Strong data fluency, using analytics, KPIs and user testing to validate opportunities and initiatives.
Excellent time management and prioritisation skills, be ruthless with what you can and can’t achieve.
Master communicator, able to influence without authority in order to get buy-in and align the business with the product strategy.
Self-learner who pushes themselves to continually improve, with a good level of technical and design knowledge.
Build trust through transparency and candour.
Bonus Skills:
Interest in PC gaming.
Experience modding PC games.
Working with passionate communities.
Hands-on experience driving product across marketplaces.
Role Responsibilities
Manage the timely delivery of our cross-functional teams, improving execution speed and reducing the time to deliver user value.
Develop strong working relationships with the Design and Engineering teams.
Actively contribute to the overall product vision, strategy and roadmap.
Ensure that projects remain aligned with our product vision, strategy and the wider business goals.
Own our user-centric business KPIs, driving growth and innovation.
Create quarterly roadmaps, giving the business and our community insight into what we’re working on now, next and later.
Improve product processes where necessary, solving problems without adding unnecessary red tape.
Conduct product research and discovery for new areas of business or novel problems.
Take responsibility for hiring, onboarding and performance management in our product team.
Support the product team pastorally and develop the careers of our Product Owners and Managers.
Benefits of Working at Nexus Mods
Benefits:
We work a 4-day week of 32 hours, with no reduction in pay.
An allowance of £25 each month to spend on video games.
Employee Assistance Programme.
Private BUPA healthcare for you and your family.
A very flexible training budget.
Regular social events throughout the year. Participation is optional!
Diversity and Inclusion
We celebrate diversity and want you to bring your whole self to work.
Supporting an incredible community of tens of millions of users, we thrive on engaging as many views as possible to improve our platform. We see no reason why our culture should be any different.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Head of AI & Data (m/w/d)
jobs.text:
Deine Aufgaben
Die Eberhardt Service Group steht für modernes, nachhaltiges Facility Management und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Leistungen. Digitalisierung, künstliche Intelligenz und die intelligente Nutzung von Daten eröffnen dabei enorme Chancen: Prozesse können einfacher werden, Mitarbeitende entlastet, Entscheidungen besser getroffen und unsere Leistungen für Kunden weiterentwickelt werden.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die AI & Data nicht nur strategisch denkt, sondern ins Unternehmen bringt und messbare Wirkung erzeugt.
Als Head of AI & Data (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von AI, Data und digitalen Lösungen innerhalb der Eberhardt Service Group. Du verbindest Unternehmensstrategie, operative Prozesse und Technologie und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren:
Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die AI- und Data-Strategie der Eberhardt Service Group und übersetzt sie in eine klare Roadmap und konkrete Maßnahmen.
Du analysierst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Potenziale für AI, Daten, Digitalisierung und Automatisierung.
Du bewertest, priorisierst und steuerst AI- und Data-Initiativen nach Nutzen, Aufwand, Risiko, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Skalierbarkeit – von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
Du verantwortest die Entwicklung und Implementierung von AI-Anwendungen, Automatisierungen, digitalen Tools und datenbasierten Lösungen und entscheidest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern, was wir selbst entwickeln, einkaufen oder integrieren.
Du baust die notwendigen Datenstrukturen, Governance und Standards für einen sicheren, verantwortungsvollen und skalierbaren Einsatz von AI und Daten auf und berücksichtigst dabei Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und regulatorische Anforderungen.
Du machst den Nutzen von AI und Data messbar, entwickelst Business Cases und KPIs und stellst sicher, dass erfolgreiche Lösungen einen konkreten Beitrag zu Effizienz, Qualität, Produktivität und Unternehmensentwicklung leisten.
Du führst und entwickelst das AI-&-Data-Team, baust die entsprechenden Kompetenzen im Unternehmen weiter aus und arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Führungskräften und Fachbereichen zusammen.
Dein Profil
Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science, AI oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – alternativ eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation.
Mehrjährige Erfahrung in AI, Data, Digitalisierung, Automatisierung oder Technologie.
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von AI-/Data-Strategien und konkreten Use Cases.
Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams und/oder größeren Projekten sowie in der Verantwortung für Budgets und Ressourcen.
Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, digitale, AI- oder Data-Lösungen aufzubauen, einzuführen und zu skalieren.
Verständnis für Claude, Python, Generative AI, LLMs, AI-Agenten und Automatisierung.
Gute Kenntnisse in Data Governance, Datenplattformen, Analytics und Datenqualität.
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Systemen wie SAP BO oder ELO.
Erfahrung mit Cloud- und AI-Plattformen, idealerweise im Microsoft-Umfeld
Verständnis für den gesamten AI-Lifecycle – von der Idee über Piloten bis zum produktiven Betrieb.
Erfahrung mit Business Cases, ROI-Betrachtungen und der wirtschaftlichen Bewertung von Technologie.
Grundlegendes Verständnis moderner IT- und Microsoft-Umgebungen.
Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst mit der Geschäftsführung über Strategie und Investitionen sprechen, mit operativen Führungskräften über Prozesse und mit technischen Spezialisten über Architektur, Daten und AI.
Erfahrung in Change-Management und im Aufbau von AI-/Data-Kompetenzen in Fachbereichen, die neu mit diesen Themen in Berührung kommen.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2)
Warum wir?
Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem modernen und nachhaltig ausgerichteten Unternehmen
Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Eberhardt Service Group
Viel Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs AI & Data
Ein kollegiales, familiäres Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Projekte im Facility Management
Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
Angebote rund um Gesundheit, Fitness und mentale Gesundheit
Eine faire und marktgerechte Vergütung, die sich an deiner Erfahrung und deinen Kompetenzen orientiert.

jobs.title: Product Director, Practice Management Software (PMS)
jobs.text:
About Docplanner
We are the world’s largest healthcare platform. Every month, 100 million patients visit our marketplaces — ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, Doktortakvimi, jameda — to find the right doctor and book a visit in real time. We process 20 million bookings a month, serve ~300,000 paying doctors and clinics across 13 countries (and we’re #1 in 12 of them), being profitable while growing ~25% a year.
And we’re just getting started. Our mission is to help people live longer, healthier lives — and our 10-year ambition is to support 1 billion patient visits a year by putting AI at the heart of every medical workflow. From Noa, our AI brand for doctors, to a frictionless, empathetic and AI-powered patient experience, we are transforming from a marketplace into the operating system of healthcare.
What you’re building
Practice Management Software — scheduling, electronic health records, billing, insurance — is how clinics actually function. Get it right, and Docplanner doesn't just help patients find doctors. We become indispensable to every clinic that uses us.
Your mandate is to build the best PMS in every market we operate in: one coherent vision, localized to win. As our engineering team drives the technical modularization of our core stack, you'll define the product strategy that turns that foundation into something doctors love and clinics can't imagine working without.
This is a rare kind of role. You're not inheriting a finished product — you're shaping what it becomes.
What you’ll own
Product strategy across all PMS — MyDr, Gipo, Clinic Cloud, Feegow, and our own light-version PMS. One north star, adapted for each country.
Making PMS AI-first — embedding Noa natively: AI scribe, AI booking, patient summaries, intelligent scheduling. Every clinic gets superpowers out of the box.
The unification journey — partnering closely with the Engineering Director so that modularity doesn't just simplify the stack; it unlocks new product possibilities.
A growth engine — designing a lightweight entry product for individuals and small clinics, with a clear, natural path to the full PMS, Noa, and marketplace.
The outcomes that matter — doctor and clinic retention, expansion revenue, integrated-doctor growth, new-market launches.
A team of product leaders across four countries, plus close collaboration with the PMS business owner, country managers, and the Noa team.
Who you are
We hire for attributes first. These five define how we work — and how you’ll lead:
Exceptional problem-solving mindset. Complexity is something you thrive on daily — five products, +12 countries, dozens of integrations — and turn it into a single, cohesive product vision adapted to each country.
AI-first approach. You believe the clinic of the future runs on AI — and you’ll make our PMS the place where doctors feel that smoothly. Always solving their problems and discovering what they could do, or what we could do for them and their patients.
Product impact focus. You focus on outcomes — retention, expansion, integrated bookings — and you prioritize effectively to ensure we focus on what truly moves them.
Builder leadership. You’ve built products and teams; you know a winning product isn't handed over by engineering — it's co-created, and you make the product–design–engineering partnership the strongest relationship in the building.
Founder-level ownership and drive. You take the complex, ambiguous, multi-year mission and own it with full accountability and collaborative focus.
What you bring
3+ years leading product at Lead / Director level (must-have) — you’ve owned multi-team product organizations, not just a single squad.
Proven track record in B2B SaaS.
Experience driving multi-product consolidation.
Comfort with regulated environments (healthcare data, GDPR, medical-device software) is a strong plus.
Fluent English; Spanish, Polish, Italian or Portuguese are a plus in our multi-local world.
What we offer
Remote-first within Europe — work from anywhere, with hubs in Warsaw, Barcelona and beyond, and regular team off-sites.
A seat at the table: you report directly to our CPTO and shape company strategy, not just a roadmap.
Competitive compensation package including a stock option plan — we want you to think and earn like an owner.
Real scale, real impact: your decisions reach 100 million patients and hundreds of thousands of doctors every month.
A profitable, founder-led company on a clear path from €250M to €1B ARR — the rare combination of rocket-ship growth and solid ground.
Ready to build the future of healthcare?
If you read this and thought “this is my job” we want to hear from you. Apply with your CV and a short note on the product impact you’re most proud of.
Full-time · Remote (PL, ES) · Reports to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO)

jobs.title: Product Director
jobs.text:
Product Director
👫 Team: Product
🌍 Location: Holborn, London
⭐ Office Policy: Hybrid – 3 days onsite
Who We Are
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.
Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £100 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.
And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.
🔑 About The Job
Having already gained serious traction and significant revenue with a lean team, there’s still a huge greenfield opportunity ahead. You’ll be joining an early-stage product organisation that’s expanding into new markets while also innovating and launching new products for millions of customers.
This is a high-impact leadership role where you’ll shape product strategy, scale teams and help define how product operates across the business. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to drive product-led growth, unlock innovation and create exceptional customer experiences at scale.
🤩 About You
You love building products, creating structure and leading through ambiguity. You’re energised by solving complex problems, scaling teams and delivering meaningful impact through technology and customer experience.
You’re equally comfortable setting strategic direction and rolling up your sleeves to help teams execute. You know how to inspire high-performing product teams, influence stakeholders across the business and bring clarity to fast-moving environments.
Most importantly, you’re excited by the opportunity to help grow a mission-driven business that has already raised over £100 million for incredible causes across the UK — and is just getting started.
🔧 What You’ll Be Doing
Lead day-to-day execution across several cross-functional squads.
Grow and coach a high-performing team of Product Managers, setting the bar for talent and product craft.
Drive company-level product strategy to support product-led growth.
Own area-level OKRs, roadmaps and delivery, ensuring squads stay aligned and operate efficiently.
Drive innovation across the product experience, from new games to app personalisation.
Scale and evolve the experimentation engine to support rapid learning and optimisation.
Support international expansion initiatives and help launch into new markets.
Shape how product squads collaborate with engineering, design, data and commercial teams.
Bring AI into the product team’s toolkit to automate workflows and improve efficiency.
Act as a bridge between Product and the wider business through compelling storytelling and communication.
🙌What’s In It For You
Generous stock options scheme
Private medical and dental insurance
9% employer pension contributions when you contribute at least 2%
A personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships
Personal equipment budget to support working from home
Enhanced family leave policies
Life assurance of 4x your salary
Diversity Statement
We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities and perspectives, and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

jobs.title: Vice President, Enterprise Technology Operations
jobs.text:
About The Role
The RealReal is looking for a Vice President of Enterprise Technical Operations to lead the teams and systems that keep our business running — from core networking and device management to the enterprise applications and AI platforms that power our people. This leader will own technical operations at scale across our corporate, retail, and authentication center locations, drive enterprise AI enablement, and build a high-performing organization that attracts and grows top talent.
What You Get To Do Every Day
Own and evolve TRR's technical operations strategy across core networking, endpoint/device management, and infrastructure supporting corporate, retail, and authentication center locations
In Partnership with the VP of AI, lead enterprise AI enablement across the organization, driving adoption and governance of enterprise AI platforms such as Google Gemini Enterprise for employee productivity and workflow automation
Direct enterprise application support and roadmap for NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Okta, and related systems, partnering closely with Finance, HR, and Sales/CX stakeholders
Build and mature enterprise incident and problem management practices — from real-time response and escalation to root-cause analysis and prevention — to minimize business disruption
Ensure reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure and connectivity for retail stores and authentication centers, where operational uptime directly impacts customer and consignor experience
Partner with Product & Technology leadership to align technical operations with broader enterprise architecture and AI platform strategy
Set and manage SLAs, operational metrics, and vendor relationships across managed services, telecom, and SaaS providers
Attract, hire, develop, and retain a high-performing technical operations team; build clear career paths and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement
Drive automation and self-service across IT operations to reduce manual toil and free the team to focus on higher-value, strategic work
Serve as an escalation point and trusted advisor to executive stakeholders on technology operations, risk, and resilience
What You Bring To The Role
Minimum Requirements:
10+ years of progressive technical operations leadership, including experience running enterprise IT/infrastructure at scale in a multi-site environment (retail, distribution, or similar physical footprint a plus)
Demonstrated success leading enterprise AI enablement initiatives — deploying and driving adoption of enterprise AI platforms such as Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, or similar across a workforce
Deep hands-on knowledge of core networking, endpoint/device management (MDM), and infrastructure supporting distributed retail or field locations
Strong track record managing enterprise applications (NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Google Workspace, Okta, or comparable systems) and the vendor/stakeholder relationships that come with them
Proven ability to build and run mature incident and problem management functions, including postmortem discipline and continuous improvement processes
A people-first leadership style with a demonstrated record of attracting, developing, and empowering top talent — you build teams people want to stay on
Experience partnering cross-functionally with Security, Product & Technology, Finance, and Retail Operations leaders
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment, balancing hands-on execution with strategic planning
Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing executive stakeholders
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Ability to travel up to 10%.
Preferred Requirements:
Experience with enterprise AI adoption and agentic workflows
Experience in e-commerce or marketplace technology
Experience managing vendor partnerships and budgets
Compensation, Benefits, + Perks
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
401K with Company Match
Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
Paid Parental Leave
9 Paid Company Holidays
Flexible Time Off (With Manager Approval)
Find out more about our Benefits here.
The expected salary range for this role is $-$. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Additionally, salary is just one component of TRR’s total rewards package. Depending on role, employees may also be eligible for a bonus program, incentive pay and benefits.
The RealReal is the world’s largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, with 40 million members. With a rigorous authentication process overseen by experts, The RealReal provides a safe and reliable platform for consumers to buy and sell their luxury items. We have hundreds of in-house gemologists, horologists, and brand authenticators who inspect thousands of items each day. As a sustainable company, we give new life to pieces by thousands of brands across numerous categories—including women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art, and home—in support of the circular economy. We make selling effortless with free virtual appointments, in-home pickup, drop-off, and direct shipping. We handle all of the work for consignors, including authenticating, using AI and machine learning to determine optimal pricing, photographing and listing their items, as well as shipping and customer service.
The RealReal is committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or Veteran status. We will consider qualified applicants for a position regardless of arrest or conviction records. At TRR, People Come First. That’s why diversity and inclusion are vital to our priorities as an equal opportunity employer. You can read about our Diversity Equity and Inclusion program here.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.
Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.
Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.
Help us see what's possible. Join us.
Your Role
You bring the ability to reliably ship industrial mass-scale products across multiple product lines and market segments. You will own the Product function, including Product Management, Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, and Quality Management & Compliance, accountable for delivering product end-to-end, at an industrial scale.
Your mandate is to create a systemic capability to scale breakthrough technologies to global products, with coherence, speed, and quality, shaping what Orbem builds and how it gets to market. You maximize the impact of our technology to make the world better from the inside out.
Your Day-to-Day
Deliver product coherence end-to-end. You own the product lifecycle end-to-end. You build the function that turns customer truth and company strategy into mass-scale products.
Set the standard for what is good. Work with our Product Management, Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, and Quality Management & Compliance teams at Orbem to define areas of accountability, processes, and tactics to deliver with speed and quality.
Build a product ecosystem. Bring product coherence, unifying experience, requirements, architecture, metrics, and compliance scaffolding.
Regulatory Navigation. Guide product compliance and certifications across our product lines. Ensure compliance is a business enabler, not a blocker.
Elevate the customer’s voice. Define the standard of customer evidence at Orbem to reach product viability and desirability.
Build Team Capabilities. Create an organizational structure and fill it with functional expertise. Make the team strong by developing its people, processes, and tools.
Translate science into a mass-scale product. Partner with Science to structure how application feasibility and AI/ML maturity flow through the development lifecycle. Partner with Operations to ensure that our products work on a global scale.
Your Responsibilities Include
Product success: Deliver viable, desirable, and feasible products on time, on quality, and within budget; maximizing company profit and impact.
Strategic leadership: Translating Orbem’s product and technology strategy into roadmaps, programs, architectures, and compliance plans that move our product metrics across industries.
Organization building: Hiring, mentoring, and leading a high-performing product function spanning from functional teams to cross-functional value creation structures that ship products.
Roadmap & program ownership: Owning prioritization tactically and strategically. Making the tough “not now” calls.
Quality & compliance posture: Building regulatory and quality strategy into product development from the start, not bolted on at the end.
Your Experience and Skills
Industrial product DNA. You have shipped physical products in industrial environments at mass scale. You have leveraged hardware as a moat while iterating on AI and software.
Scaleup operator. You have lived the 50→500 person scaling journey at a deep tech company, building the function that delivers globally successful products
End-to-end product breadth. You have an engineering background, and you have built or led at least two of Product Management, Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, and Product Quality functions, and you understand how the others work. You can run all four as one team accountable for product coherence at an industrial scale.
Customer-anchored. You can sit with a customer for a day, leave with a sharper problem statement than they had, and translate it into specs that can be shipped. Customer evidence is a discipline for you, not a slogan.
Extreme ownership. You hold yourself and your organization fully accountable for product outcomes, not just product process. You have strong product sense to inform making the right decisions to ensure the right outcomes. When something breaks between product, science, engineering, operations, and commercial, you fix it.
Architecture for Scale - You have led product architecture shifts from building individual products to building hardware platform products that enable scalable solutions across market segments.
Leadership. 15+ years of professional experience, including 7+ years building organizations and shipping products.
Communication. You can communicate product strategy across the company, define tactics, and strive for better yourself and your organization.
What Makes You Stand Out
Experience shipping embedded AI products (Physical AI)
Experience as a Senior Director or VP-level
Experience at a deep-tech scaleup that scaled from a few customers to global reach
Experience with industrial life science
Experience as an engineering leader
Track record of highly successful products in the market
Fit to Our Values
We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.
We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.
We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.
What We Offer
International Environment:
Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.
Comprehensive Benefits:
Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.
Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.
Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.
Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.
Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.
Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation.
Work-Life Integration:
Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.
WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!
30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.
Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.
Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.
Make a Difference:
Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.
Your Team:
You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/
At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

Set the standard for what is good. Work with our Product Management, Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, and Quality Management & Compliance teams at Orbem to define areas of accountability, processes, and tactics to deliver with speed and quality.
Build a product ecosystem. Bring product coherence, unifying experience, requirements, architecture, metrics, and compliance scaffolding.
Regulatory Navigation. Guide product compliance and certifications across our product lines. Ensure compliance is a business enabler, not a blocker.
Elevate the customer’s voice. Define the standard of customer evidence at Orbem to reach product viability and desirability.
Build Team Capabilities. Create an organizational structure and fill it with functional expertise. Make the team strong by developing its people, processes, and tools.

Translate science into a mass-scale product. Partner with Science to structure how application feasibility and AI/ML maturity flow through the development lifecycle. Partner with Operations to ensure that our products work on a global scale.
Your Responsibilities Include
Product success: Deliver viable, desirable, and feasible products on time, on quality, and within budget; maximizing company profit and impact.
Strategic leadership: Translating Orbem’s product and technology strategy into roadmaps, programs, architectures, and compliance plans that move our product metrics across industries.
Organization building: Hiring, mentoring, and leading a high-performing product function spanning from functional teams to cross-functional value creation structures that ship products.
Roadmap & program ownership: Owning prioritization tactically and strategically. Making the tough “not now” calls.
Quality & compliance posture: Building regulatory and quality strategy into product development from the start, not bolted on at the end.
Your Experience and Skills
Industrial product DNA. You have shipped physical products in industrial environments at mass scale. You have leveraged hardware as a moat while iterating on AI and software.
Scaleup operator. You have lived the 50→500 person scaling journey at a deep tech company, building the function that delivers globally successful products

End-to-end product breadth. You have an engineering background, and you have built or led at least two of Product Management, Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, and Product Quality functions, and you understand how the others work. You can run all four as one team accountable for product coherence at an industrial scale.

Customer-anchored. You can sit with a customer for a day, leave with a sharper problem statement than they had, and translate it into specs that can be shipped. Customer evidence is a discipline for you, not a slogan.

Extreme ownership. You hold yourself and your organization fully accountable for product outcomes, not just product process. You have strong product sense to inform making the right decisions to ensure the right outcomes. When something breaks between product, science, engineering, operations, and commercial, you fix it.
Architecture for Scale - You have led product architecture shifts from building individual products to building hardware platform products that enable scalable solutions across market segments.
Leadership. 15+ years of professional experience, including 7+ years building organizations and shipping products.
Communication. You can communicate product strategy across the company, define tactics, and strive for better yourself and your organization.
What Makes You Stand Out
Experience shipping embedded AI products (Physical AI)
Experience as a Senior Director or VP-level
Experience at a deep-tech scaleup that scaled from a few customers to global reach
Experience with industrial life science
Experience as an engineering leader
Track record of highly successful products in the market
Fit to Our Values
We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.
We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.
We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.
What We Offer
International Environment:
Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.
Comprehensive Benefits:
Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.
Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.
Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.
Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.
Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.
Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation.
Work-Life Integration:
Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.
WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!
30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.
Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.
Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.
Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.
Your Team:
You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

jobs.title: Head of Product - Clients (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.
We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.
About the role:
As Upvest continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional Head of Product - Clients. You will work closely with Florian Thiel, Christian Wöhlke, and the Product & Engineering teams of the tribe (3 domain teams in total). In addition you will need to build strong relations with the Operations, Banking and Commercial leadership teams, owning topics critical to Upvest's product and business success.
Lead the clients tribe's product vision and strategy:
As Head of Product, you start leading one of the Clients tribe teams directly, while guiding the overarching strategy and success of the Clients Tribe and you start scaling yourself. You will work very closely with the Director of Engineering and VP of Product to define the tribe's strategy, set OKRs, and shape the long-term roadmap. The goal: to power Upvest's asymmetric scaling by building the intelligent, seamless "AI-experience", internal and external, that makes flawless API experiences the foundation of Upvest's ecosystem.
Drive asymmetric scaling through intelligent, agentic operations:
Your challenge is to make our tools and workflows scale without lockstep headcount growth.. That means embedding intelligence and automation into every process, and exploring how agentic operations, AI agents handling operational workflows end to end, can take on work that today needs manual effort. You'll be the go-to voice for applied AI across our tooling, helping the business run efficiently and helping clients get to market faster, at lower cost and higher reliability.
Take tooling into its next stage:
You'll own the roadmap for Internal Tooling or Upfront, both key strategic product enablers for scaling the business, and drive it forward through OKRs, deciding where to push deeper automation, broaden coverage, or reimagine a workflow entirely. You'll work directly with the Engineering team, and stay close to the people the products serve, so every step forward is one that truly matters.
What you’ll do:
Significant impact and strategic influence, shaping the roadmap and scaling strategy with a seat at the table with engineering and product leadership.
Autonomy coupled with inspirational leadership. You fully own the product success of your team and function.
Product-centricity throughout the organisation, with no struggle for relevance that product people may encounter elsewhere.
Product Engineering culture, working closely with engineering counterparts guided by joint OKRs and a clear roadmap.
An exceptional team, combining impactful work with a relaxed, fun atmosphere and consistently high eNPS.
Continuous learning across investments, API products, and a state-of-the-art tech stack.
What you bring:
5+ years in Product Management, ideally with a focus on internal and/or external tooling. Financial services, compliance, or fintech experience is a big plus.
Proven people leadership of teams of 3+ people.
Firm grasp of UI/UX best practices; can ideate and prototype through lo-fi wireframes and collaborate closely with design.
Strong track record of taking initiative, owning outcomes, and bridging dependencies.
Be a sponge. You don't need to be a finance or investment expert, but you'll need to absorb complex topics quickly (subledger reconciliation, mutual fund trading flow) and apply strong product fundamentals.
Experience with agile software development, delivering features and outcomes consistently.
Comfortable with product toolkits such as Linear, Slite, Miro, and Figma.
Familiarity with API documentation standards and an interest in how AI agents consume APIs (MCP or similar) is a strong plus.
How we Upvest in you:
Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.
Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.
Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.
Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.
Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.
Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.
Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.
Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.
Our Values:
Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.
Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.
Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.
Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.
Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Python/Django (f/d/m): Path to CTO
jobs.text:
Berlin, 35-40 hours per week, starting immediatly
Do you want to work and help shape the world of work? Then join us and become part of a purpose-driven team working towards a fair and sustainable world of work.
We are INES Analytics – a passionate software start-up in the heart of Berlin. Our mission: to make social sustainability measurable and to support companies in creating fair working conditions.
To drive our mission forward, we’re looking for you: a committed individual to strengthen our team.
A growing team, a clear mission and the chance to help shape real social change through your work – data-driven, practical and forward-looking.
Tasks
You'll own the backend technically and be the go-to person for architecture and infrastructure. You'll write code yourself, help the team grow, and set the technical direction. Together with us, you'll grow into the CTO role.
In Detail:
Own the backend (Python/Django): architecture, code quality, scalability and maintainability
Design and evolve REST APIs and integrate external systems
Build authentication and SSO (e.g. OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML)
Design and run asynchronous processing and background jobs
Keep the system fast and scalable as we grow: profiling, query optimization, caching
Build a strong testing culture with automated unit, integration and end-to-end tests
Review code and pull requests, and set shared engineering standards
Mentor junior developers and support their growth
Shape and improve reliable deployment, release and CI/CD processes
Run and optimize our cloud infrastructure on AWS, containerized with Docker and managed as Infrastructure as Code
Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so issues are caught before customers notice them
Write and maintain clear technical documentation on architecture, APIs and runbooks
Build security and data protection (GDPR) into our architecture and code
Work closely with product, design and founders, and bring technical input to the roadmap
Requirements
The following qualifications and experiences are required
* Experience as a tech lead or in a first leadership role
* Several Years of backend development experience with Python and Django
Strong PostgreSQL skills (data modeling, performance tuning, migrations)
Experience designing and building REST APIs (e.g. Django REST Framework)
Hands-on experience with authentication/SSO and integrating external systems
Experience with asynchronous task processing
A proven track record of improving performance and scaling systems under growing load
Solid testing practice (e.g. pytest) and a belief that well-tested code ships faster
Confident with Linux, deployment and cloud infrastructure, especially AWS (incl. S3), nginx and Gunicorn
Experience with Docker and Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
Experience with monitoring and observability
A good understanding of SaaS architecture, security and data protection
You write clear documentation and value it as part of the work
Experience with code reviews and a genuine interest in mentoring others
Strong communication skills: you can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical people and make decisions together with them
A startup mindset: you're pragmatic, take ownership and handle ambiguity and changing priorities well
The drive to grow into a leadership role
Fluent English and / or German
Even if you don’t tick all the boxes perfectly, we’d love to hear from you!
Nice to have:
Previous startup experience
Experience with compliance frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2):
Benefits
Real ownership and a clear path to CTO
A small, motivated team where decisions happen quickly
A Job with Purpose: Together with our team, you’ll lay the foundation for a future free of discrimination for all employees in companies
Flexible work hours with a portion of mobile work
Direct access to the founding team instead of anonymous corporate structures
Real responsibility from day one—your work directly contributes to the product
Insights into building a startup in the field of pay equity and compliance tech
Deutschlandticket
Table tennis table
We don’t have a never-ending application process. Just send us your CV and a short cover letter so we can find out a bit more about you. If it looks like a good fit, we’ll have a little task for you and invite you to a relaxed online chat. And if we hit it off, we’ll take it further: welcome to our Berlin office – complete with coffee, a great team atmosphere and maybe even a quick game of table tennis to round things off.
We also embrace diversity within our organisation and are actively committed to equal opportunities. We’re therefore particularly keen to hear from people with different perspectives – regardless of gender, background, sexual orientation, age, disability or religious affiliation.

jobs.text:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
This is the senior product role on a small, high-leverage product team. You'll own key pieces of the product line — from how we position it, to how we price it, to how the field sells it. You'll work closely with engineering and be the person Marketing and Field teams looks to for the answer to "why us, why now”.
We need a product leader who lives close to customers and to revenue, who can hold a deeply technical conversation with multiple stakeholders - from technical buyers to executive, and who treats GTM as a first-class part of the product — not something that happens after the product is "done."
What You Will Do:
Growth strategy for our Data Intelligence products — where we play, who we sell to, how we win, and the sequencing of bets that gets us there
Partnerships — work closely with key partners to develop ground breaking products
The customer and buyer motion — being in front of inference platform teams, data platform leads, and the buyers who decide. Joining strategic deals. Running the win/loss loop and feeding it back into strategy.
Positioning and narrative — partnering with Marketing on how the AI stories land in market, what we publish, and how a first-time buyer encounters MinIO
Field partnership — building the assets sellers actually use, supporting the deals that matter, making sure the field can run an inference-buyer or lakehouse-buyer conversation confidently
Pricing and packaging — how Data Intelligence products are sold, how the AI and Analytics motions are priced differently if they should be, how we capture value as workloads grow
Competitive intelligence — knowing the AI training inference competitive landscape, and shaping how we differentiate
Partner GTM for AI — the AI ecosystem is partner-heavy, and unlocking it is part of the role
Influence on the product — through customer signal, pipeline data, and competitive insight you will be the most informed external voice in the room to influence direction.
Your Skills and Experience:
8+ years in product management, with at least 3 years on infrastructure, data, or AI/ML products sold to technical buyers
Demonstrated fluency in modern AI and analytics stacks — you don't need to have trained a foundation model, but you should be conversant in how training and inference pipelines actually consume storage, key tradeoffs and why it matters, and how data platform teams make build/buy decisions
A track record of working closely with field teams on real revenue — you've sat in on deals, you've built enablement that sellers actually used, you've changed a deal's outcome with a well-timed product conversation
Partnership with marketing on crafting compelling narratives, presented at external conferences, webinars
Strong analytical instincts — you reach for data to test your hypotheses, not to confirm them
The ability to write clearly and think rigorously in writing. Most of the work that compounds in this role is written
Excellent partnership with engineering — you've earned engineers' trust before by being technically credible and by making prioritization defensible
Real comfort with pricing and packaging decisions — if you've owned or co-owned them, not just commented on them, that's a big plus

We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.text:
About Deep Origin
Deep Origin is a biotech startup building an operating system for science that transforms how life science research is conducted. Led by Michael Antonov, co-founder of Oculus, and backed by Formic Ventures, we are redefining the infrastructure behind modern drug discovery. Our AI-driven platform enables scientists to accelerate discovery, reduce cost, and bring breakthrough innovations to life faster. As we scale, engineering excellence is a critical lever in advancing our mission to dramatically reduce disease and extend human healthspan.
Role Description
We are looking for an experienced Director of Product Management to lead product execution and help build and scale the product organization at Deep Origin.
This role is for a product leader who has built and scaled B2B SaaS products in a startup environment, taken products from 0 → 1 through product-market fit and meaningful commercial scale, and knows how to deeply understand customer problems before deciding what to build.
You will work closely with executive leadership, Product, Engineering, AI/ML, Science, Sales, Marketing, and Business Development to translate customer and market needs into clear product strategy, priorities, roadmaps, and execution.
This is not a role focused only on maintaining an existing roadmap. We are looking for someone who can challenge assumptions, identify the right customer problems to solve, bring structure to the product organization, and help turn strong technology into scalable products customers value and are willing to pay for.
Experience in biotech, life sciences, biology, chemistry, or drug discovery will be helpful. The most important requirement is a demonstrated record of building and scaling successful software products.
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

jobs.title: SVP, Technology (Product & Engineering)
jobs.text:
Who We Are
SWTCH is pioneering EV charging solutions for multifamily and commercial properties across North America. Since 2016, our team of entrepreneurs, energy professionals, and technologists has been focused on unlocking the social, economic, and environmental benefits of widespread EV adoption. Today, our solutions are deployed in tens of thousands of locations —many of which are low-to-moderate income housing—helping to make clean mobility accessible for all.
With an expanding footprint across Canada and the U.S., we’re scaling quickly and looking for mission-driven talent to help accelerate our growth.
Job Opportunity
SWTCH is looking for a senior technology leader to lead our Product, Software Engineering and Hardware organizations as we enter our next stage of growth.
Reporting to the CEO and as a member of the executive team, the SVP, Technology will own SWTCH’s technology strategy and execution — connecting our product vision, software platform and hardware ecosystem into a clear and scalable roadmap.
This is a role for a leader who combines strong technical depth with product and commercial thinking and can move comfortably between long-term strategy and hands-on execution.
What You’ll Do
Lead Product, Software Engineering and Hardware, creating a unified technology organization with clear priorities, ownership and accountability.
Own SWTCH’s technology and product strategy, translating the company’s growth plans into a clear roadmap across product, software, hardware and infrastructure.
Shape the product roadmap by balancing customer needs, market opportunities, commercial priorities and longer-term platform investments.
Drive technical architecture and scalability, ensuring our platform and systems can support a growing customer base, charging network and evolving product ecosystem.
Raise the bar on reliability, safety, quality and security, embedding strong standards for testing, validation, releases and production performance.
Ensure seamless integration across hardware, firmware, software and cloud systems, with clear ownership across the full product lifecycle.
Strengthen engineering and product execution, creating greater predictability, discipline and accountability around priorities, commitments and delivery.
Build and develop a high-performing technology leadership team, ensuring we have the right structure, capabilities and talent to support our next stage of growth.
Partner closely with the CEO and executive team on company strategy, technology investments, business priorities and key technical decisions and trade-offs.
Bring the voice of the customer into technology decisions, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success and Operations to understand customer needs and translate them into scalable solutions.
Create a culture of technical excellence and ownership, where teams move with speed while maintaining a high bar for quality, collaboration and execution.
What We’re Looking For
15+ years of technology experience with significant senior leadership experience.
Experience leading large or complex Engineering and Product organizations.
Strong technical foundation with the credibility to engage deeply with engineers and architects.
Experience with hardware-enabled technology, connected devices, IoT or complex distributed systems.
Proven experience scaling technology organizations and platforms.
Strong track record in reliability, quality and operational excellence.
Commercial and customer-oriented approach to product and technology decisions.
Strong executive communication and leadership skills.
Experience in EV charging, energy, infrastructure, telecommunications or another hardware/software environment is an asset.
The Leader We’re Looking For
You are a builder and operator. You bring technical credibility, strong judgment and a high bar for execution. You know how to build great teams, create clarity in complex environments and balance speed with quality.
Most importantly, you understand how to turn technology into a competitive advantage — building products and platforms that customers trust and that can scale with the business.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (Financial Platforms)
jobs.text:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
About the Product team
The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.
About the role
Our Financial Platform sits at the heart of every loan Affirm makes and every dollar we move. We're looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead and scale the teams behind two of our most critical and complex domains: Loans Lifecycle and Money Movement. This is a role for a seasoned product leader who thrives in the intersection of financial systems, platform engineering, and organizational scale.
What you’ll do
Lead and grow a high-performing PM team. Build, mentor, and manage a team of 6–10 product managers, including people managers. You'll set the bar for craft, create development paths, and cultivate a culture of ownership, rigor, and candor.
Own the vision and strategy for Loans Lifecycle and Money Movement. Define the multi-year product strategy for Affirm's foundational loan systems and global money movement infrastructure — ensuring they are scalable, compliant, and capable of supporting rapid product innovation. Translate that vision into clear roadmaps and decisions that teams can execute against.
Be the domain authority. Serve as the executive-level subject matter expert on loan lifecycle mechanics, payment rails, settlement flows, and institutional transfers — guiding product, engineering, and business partners on tradeoffs, best practices, and platform decisions.
Drive cross-functional alignment at scale. Partner closely with Engineering, Accounting, Treasury, Capital Markets, Legal, Compliance, and Client Success teams. Navigate complexity, balance competing stakeholder needs, and build trust through clear communication and a strong delivery track record.
Enable platform scalability and international expansion. Architect platform strategies that simplify domain boundaries, standardize loan behaviors across products and markets, and unlock faster time-to-market for new geographies and product lines.
Measure and improve platform health. Define success metrics — including settlement success rates, reconciliation coverage, exception volumes, and time-to-resolution — and hold teams accountable to the reliability and accuracy standards these critical systems demand.
Influence up and across the organization. Regularly present strategy, tradeoffs, and priorities to senior leadership. Shape organizational thinking on where to invest and what to deprioritize.
What we look for
15+ years of product management experience, with at least 3–5 years managing and developing PM teams including people managers
Deep experience in loans or lending systems — you understand loan lifecycle mechanics, platform architecture for loan servicing, and the compliance and operational requirements that come with it
Meaningful experience in money movement, payments infrastructure, or financial operations — you're fluent in payment rails, settlement flows, cross-border transfers, and the reliability and accuracy standards these systems demand
Experience in fintech, financial services, or banking; familiarity with BNPL, platform products, or backend infrastructure is strongly preferred; capital markets background is a plus
Demonstrated ability to set and execute long-term platform strategy in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
Strong technical fluency — you're comfortable diving into data models and API discussions with engineers and holding informed opinions

About the Product team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.
About the role

Our Financial Platform sits at the heart of every loan Affirm makes and every dollar we move. We're looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead and scale the teams behind two of our most critical and complex domains: Loans Lifecycle and Money Movement. This is a role for a seasoned product leader who thrives in the intersection of financial systems, platform engineering, and organizational scale.

Define the multi-year product strategy for Affirm's foundational loan systems and global money movement infrastructure — ensuring they are scalable, compliant, and capable of supporting rapid product innovation. Be the domain authority. Serve as the executive-level subject matter expert on loan lifecycle mechanics, payment rails, settlement flows, and institutional transfers — guiding product, engineering, and business partners on tradeoffs, best practices, and platform decisions.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering & Platform
jobs.text:
Job Description Summary
‎
The Director, Data Engineering & Platform provides M4-level organizational leadership for the execution of the enterprise data engineering and platform vision and strategy established by the VP, Enterprise Data Platforms. The Director contributes to the evolution of the platform strategy in partnership with the VP, Director of Data Architecture, and peer leaders, but is primarily accountable for translating that strategy into an executable operating model, multi-year modernization roadmap, engineering governance, delivery priorities, and measurable enterprise outcomes.
This role owns the way enterprise data engineering and platform work is executed across the organization. The Director leads multiple engineering managers and cross-functional engineering organizations responsible for enterprise data engineering, platform engineering, data integration, data operations, and platform services. The role ensures that enterprise data capabilities are secure, scalable, resilient, cost-effective, and aligned to strategic growth initiatives, digital transformation, AI enablement, interoperability, enterprise reporting, and data-driven decision-making.
The Director balances organizational leadership, technology execution, financial stewardship, vendor strategy, operating discipline, and business partnership while developing a high-performing engineering organization capable of delivering enterprise-scale data products and platform services.
‎
How will you make an impact & Requirements
‎
Enterprise Strategy Execution & Platform Capability Leadership
Own execution of the enterprise data engineering and platform strategy established by the VP, Enterprise Data Platforms, translating strategic direction into an operating model, multi-year execution roadmap, delivery priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Contribute to enterprise platform vision, strategy, and technology direction in partnership with the VP, Director of Data Architecture, and peer technology leaders.
Establish the enterprise data engineering operating model, engineering governance, standards, and operating principles adopted across the organization.
Establish and maintain the platform evolution roadmap aligned with enterprise data strategy, modernization priorities, architectural direction, security requirements, and business objectives.
Accountable for implementing enterprise data platform capabilities that support strategic growth initiatives, digital transformation, AI enablement, interoperability, enterprise reporting, and data product delivery.
Evaluate emerging technologies, platform capabilities, and engineering practices to recommend pragmatic adoption approaches that improve enterprise outcomes.
Enterprise Platform Ownership & Modernization Execution
Own enterprise data engineering operations and the way work is executed across platform engineering, data engineering, data integration, and data operations.
Own execution of the enterprise platform strategy, including platform modernization, cloud transformation, lifecycle management, automation, and operational maturity.
Own the modernization roadmap for enterprise data engineering and platform capabilities, ensuring roadmap execution remains aligned with VP strategy, enterprise architecture, and business priorities.
Accountable for enterprise engineering service performance, technology resilience, organizational capability, and strategic platform evolution.
Ensure enterprise platforms meet organizational expectations for availability, scalability, security, resiliency, regulatory compliance, observability, cost effectiveness, and operational supportability.
Establish enterprise service-level objectives, operational performance standards, recovery expectations, and continuous improvement practices across platform and engineering services.
Engineering Organization Leadership & Span of Control
Direct multiple engineering managers and cross-functional engineering teams responsible for enterprise data engineering, platform engineering, data integration, and platform operations.
Direct Engineering Managers responsible for Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Operations, and Data Integration.
Develop workforce strategies including workforce planning, organizational design, staffing plans, succession planning, leadership development, recruiting strategy, and vendor strategy.
Establish organizational goals, performance expectations, accountability measures, and execution disciplines aligned with enterprise priorities.
Develop engineering and platform organizational leadership capability through succession planning, leadership coaching, management development, and clear accountability for delivery outcomes.
Build an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, operational excellence, customer service, and reliable enterprise delivery.
Enterprise Architecture Partnership & Engineering Governance
Define enterprise data engineering strategy in partnership with the Director of Data Architecture and the VP, Enterprise Data Platforms.
Establish enterprise engineering standards, the platform evolution roadmap aligned with strategy, and operating principles governing data engineering across the organization.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Compliance, Infrastructure, Data Governance, Analytics, and Product leaders to maintain enterprise technology standards and practical delivery guardrails.
Ensure engineering practices comply with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity standards, privacy expectations, audit requirements, and healthcare data protection obligations.
Govern data engineering patterns, automation practices, reliability standards, deployment approaches, observability expectations, and operational controls across platform and engineering services.
Portfolio, Investment & Decision Influence
Govern investment priorities across multiple portfolios and engineering organizations based on business value, operational risk, strategic alignment, cost profile, and organizational capacity.
Contribute a strong Director-level voice with peers and the VP in portfolio prioritization, organization structure, capital investment, vendor selection, strategic technology direction, operating model design, and sourcing decisions.
Develop business cases supporting modernization initiatives, enterprise data platform capabilities, automation investments, and emerging technology adoption.
Partner with the VP and peer leaders to translate technology investment decisions into execution roadmaps, resource plans, delivery commitments, and outcome measures.
Monitor portfolio performance using executive dashboards, key performance indicators, delivery health metrics, cost trends, and organizational outcome measures.
Financial & Vendor Management
Own annual operating and capital budget planning and management for enterprise data engineering and platform services in partnership with the VP, Enterprise Data Platforms.
Actively engage with the VP in annual planning, operating budget development, capital planning, technology investment portfolio management, ROI analysis, vendor management, and contract negotiations.
Govern cloud spend, software licensing strategy, technology procurement, vendor contracts, managed service relationships, and vendor performance for enterprise data engineering and platform services.
Lead investment prioritization, vendor negotiations, software licensing analysis, cloud spend governance, and business case development for platform and engineering capabilities.
Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value while maintaining financial stewardship, cost transparency, and accountability for platform economics.
Present budget performance, investment recommendations, vendor considerations, and financial tradeoffs to the VP and executive stakeholders as appropriate.
Business Accountability & Executive Partnership
Accountable for implementing enterprise data platform capabilities supporting strategic growth initiatives, digital transformation, AI enablement, interoperability, enterprise reporting, and data-driven decision-making.
Translate business priorities into enterprise data engineering capabilities that improve operational performance, customer outcomes, clinical and business insight, and trusted data product delivery.
Represent Data Engineering & Platform in executive planning, governance, prioritization, and strategic investment forums as delegated by or in partnership with the VP.
Serve as a trusted technology execution partner to business leaders, analytics leaders, product leaders, clinical operations, finance, governance committees, and technology peers.
Ensure enterprise data engineering capabilities support organizational growth, platform adoption, enterprise reporting, interoperability, AI enablement, and long-term technology modernization.
Operational Excellence
Establish organizational metrics measuring platform adoption, engineering productivity, reliability, service quality, operational maturity, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and business value realization.
Drive continuous improvement across engineering delivery, operational processes, automation, release management, platform performance, incident management, and organizational effectiveness.
Ensure platform and engineering services are observable, supportable, cost transparent, well governed, and resilient enough to support enterprise-scale data products.
Create durable management routines that improve delivery predictability, production reliability, engineering quality, and cross-functional alignment.
Leadership Responsibilities
Direct multiple engineering managers and technical leaders across Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Operations, and Data Integration.
Establish execution roadmaps, organizational priorities, operating cadences, and accountability measures aligned with VP strategy and enterprise priorities.
Build leadership capability through coaching, management development, succession planning, and talent development.
Lead workforce planning, organizational design, recruiting strategy, vendor strategy, and capacity planning for the enterprise data engineering and platform organization.
Foster collaboration across technology, business, clinical, analytics, governance, security, infrastructure, and operational organizations.
Drive organizational accountability for delivery, quality, operational resilience, innovation, financial stewardship, and customer outcomes.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
9–12 years of progressive experience in technology leadership, data engineering, platform engineering, enterprise data platforms, cloud data platforms, or related disciplines.
5+ years leading managers and highly technical resources in enterprise engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, integration, or data operations environments.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise transformation, platform modernization, cloud transformation, or large-scale data engineering initiatives.
Experience directing multiple engineering teams and leading through managers, technical leaders, delivery partners, and vendors.
Experience managing or materially influencing multi-million-dollar operating and capital budgets, technology investment portfolios, ROI analysis, vendor management, and contract negotiations.
Executive communication experience, including the ability to present technology strategy, investment tradeoffs, delivery risks, and business outcomes to senior leadership.
Demonstrated success partnering with enterprise architecture, information security, compliance, analytics, product, finance, clinical, and business leadership stakeholders.
Strong working knowledge of modern cloud data platforms, data engineering practices, platform operations, automation, reliability engineering, data governance, cybersecurity, and operational excellence frameworks.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience within healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
Experience supporting enterprise AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, interoperability, enterprise reporting, and digital transformation initiatives.
Experience governing enterprise cloud platforms, modern data architectures, data engineering operating models, and large-scale engineering organizations.
Experience leading enterprise modernization and organizational transformation initiatives while balancing strategy, execution, cost, risk, and delivery capacity.
Experience with Databricks or comparable enterprise lakehouse, cloud data platform, data engineering, or analytics platform capabilities.
Strong knowledge of cloud-native engineering, enterprise data governance, cybersecurity, data protection, observability, automation, and operational excellence frameworks.
‎
Compensation Range:
$158,804.00
to
$238,207.00
The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.
