jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland, CA
Role Type: Full-time
Compensation: $201,250
Reports to: Chief Impact Officer
Visa sponsorship: Not available
Hires remotely in: United States
Experience: 8+ years
-
Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring a Director of Product and Design to join our team! We're a growing, fast-moving group building technology that helps government leaders safely reduce incarceration and improve outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. That's where you come in. We're looking for a product leader who is equally energized by people and strategy — someone who can set the direction, build the systems, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and product designers to do the most important work of their careers.
About us
Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.
Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we've been able to safely reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.
People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.
About the role
This role sits at the center of Recidiviz's ability to scale. As Director of Product and Design, you’ll lead and develop a team of experienced product managers and designers—people with years of domain expertise and a deep commitment to the mission. Your job is to make each of them sharper, more supported, and more impactful: setting strategic context, building the people systems that help them grow, and creating the conditions for them to build products that actually get used on a daily and weekly basis. You'll report to the Chief Impact Officer and serve as a key partner on product direction, team health, operational standards, and organizational strategy as Recidiviz scales nationally. Some travel to our state partners, internal team gatherings, and offsites is expected.
Core responsibilities
Own the outcomes: Drive positive correctional outcomes by expanding product-market-impact fit, building long-term organizational sustainability, and scaling what works to more states—ensuring tools deliver immediate usability and sustained weekly active engagement.
Lead and develop a high-performing team: Manage and mentor PMs, designers, and emerging leaders. Build cohesive cross-functional rituals, streamline team operations, and drive adoption of shared UI standards to increase execution speed and state-by-state consistency.
Build cross-functional trust: Partner closely with engineering, data science, state engagement, and marketing, coaching your team to do the same. Keep teams close to frontline staff, government leadership, and justice-impacted individuals through grounded, trauma-informed discovery practices.
Set strategic context: Define a clear direction so every PM and designer understands where their area fits, what to prioritize, and why it matters. Partner with and coach team members as they navigate complex policy and administrative constraints, helping them land on clear roadmaps and intuitive user workflows.
Modernize workflows and execution: Help the team stay ahead of shifts in technology by modeling AI-assisted workflows across discovery, scoping, and prototyping—accelerating delivery speed without sacrificing rigor or user empathy.
Wild success
Here are a few things you might accomplish in your first year that would demonstrate wild success in this role. Some of these will be the direct result of your work. Others will be because of the conditions you've set for a great team to do great things.
Active adoption & impact: Recidiviz’s product portfolio achieves deeper impact—measured by high weekly active tool usage, stronger client executive support, and steady launch momentum.
People growth: Multiple team members have grown into meaningfully new scope—a first-time manager, a senior IC owning a harder problem, or someone who was stuck and is now thriving.
Operational velocity: User feedback loops and reusable components are cleanly integrated into product cycles, eliminating redundant work and accelerating state deployments.
Minimum qualifications
Deep care for the growth and wellbeing of the people you manage—you measure your success by theirs.
8+ years in product management or design, with at least 3 years managing a team of PMs and/or designers; you've led both senior ICs and emerging leaders and know how to get the best from each.
Exceptional communication and relationship skills—you earn trust quickly, especially with people who have strong opinions and high standards.
Experience coaching PMs and designers toward management readiness—you've developed future managers, not just individual contributors.
Comfort operating in ambiguity, with the ability to help teams create clarity and momentum where little exists.
Strong strategic instincts: you can zoom out to see the system, identify what's misaligned, and help teams make better decisions with less friction.
A builder's mindset paired with strategic rigor—you see gaps, you close them, and you leave things better than you found them.
Ability and willingness to travel, about one trip per quarter.
Preferred qualifications
Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder environments where end users, administrative buyers, and institutional partners each have distinct needs—and where building trust with all of them is part of the job.
Experience working in or closely with mission-driven, nonprofit, or public sector organizations.
Personal or professional experience working with the criminal justice system.
Experience in a high-growth startup where the playbook was still being written.
Exposure to AI-assisted product development and the unique team dynamics it creates.
A track record of elevating strong PM and design ICs into more strategic, senior thinkers—not just promoting people, but genuinely shaping their craft.
Compensation
Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.
The compensation for this role is: $201,250.
What we offer
Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters
90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays per year
401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Complimentary One Medical membership (availability based on location)
Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits
Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness
Free mental health support via Talkspace
Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose
An annual company offsite and other ad-hoc gatherings
All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit
More about Recidiviz
Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we've built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator's 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.
Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 20 state partners — big and small, red and blue — and touches over 46% of the country's incarcerated population. We have helped to get hundreds of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably.
To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our 2025 Year in Review, read some press coverage, or watch our TED Talk.
An important note
Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look — you might be great for another role or another time!

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!
Your Team and Role
Working on the Site Reliability Team, you'll help build and maintain world-class infrastructure to meet the needs of millions of users protecting their privacy online. You'll utilize high-level languages like Perl, Go, TypeScript, or Python and work on related projects. Recent projects include:
Ensuring our Duck.ai product meets our reliability standards and minimizing user friction on failures
Scaling up our own index infrastructure to handle billions of documents
Create anti fraud verifications that respect users privacy
As Director, Site Reliability Engineering, you'll dive deep into complex operational challenges, including software, systems, automation, and process analysis. We are looking for candidates who can read, write, troubleshoot, and deploy all types of software to help us tackle the reliability challenges of large-scale deployments.
About You
10+ years relevant professional experience in reliability, platform, infrastructure, or software engineering, including 4+ years leading SRE teams.
Experience participating in a 24x7 on-call rotation for a large-scale deployment.
Ability to lead and collaborate on high-impact and complex projects from proposal through postmortem.
Proficient in AI-driven development, including designing and implementing agentic workflows
Skills to wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a strong focus on metrics.
Experience developing effective tools, services, alerts, and responses to identify and address reliability risks.
Investigative ability to root-cause sources of instability in high-traffic, distributed systems.
Deep experience administering and troubleshooting Linux and web technologies.
Ability to implement automation around infrastructure provisioning and configuration management to prioritize efficiency, scalability, and reliability.
Foresight to help identify the future technical direction of our deployment with the goal of improving reliability and performance.
Advanced programming skills enabling close partnership with software engineers to triage production issues and identify appropriate remediation, including code changes and performance considerations.
Ability to leverage cloud-native services and architectures to enhance reliability and scalability, with hands-on experience packaging and deploying applications using Docker and Docker Compose.
Compensation
$243,800 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.
Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.
Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.
Hiring Process
Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.
We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to
Please note that:
You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing
Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.
While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.
A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.
By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.
Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process
As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.
Key Principles:
Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.
Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.
Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.
By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
FLiiP is a fast-growing fitness technology company building a SaaS platform that helps gyms and fitness businesses run and grow their operations. Working at the intersection of software and the fitness industry, the team is focused on delivering technology that supports day-to-day business management while creating a strong experience for customers and end users.
We're backed by two venture capital firms that have invested CAD 4.4M in FLiiP, and we're part of the Google for Startups Accelerator. And we're just getting started.
As Director of Engineering, you will shape how engineering operates and scales as the company grows. This is a high-impact leadership role with broad reach across our web, mobile, and data engineering teams. You will be a key driver of technical excellence, team performance, and the integration of AI into our engineering DNA.
You'll report directly to the COO/CTO and work closely with Product, Design, and Customer-facing teams to ensure we ship fast, ship right, and continuously raise the bar.
Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Development
Lead, coach, and grow a team of engineers and data scientists across web, mobile, and data disciplines
Support individual growth through regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development plans
Drive a culture of ownership, accountability, performance and continuous improvement
Manage hiring to scale the team as FLiiP grows
Engineering Excellence
Define and enforce engineering best practices, quality standards, and deployment processes
Manage on-call rotations and ensure system reliability
Own our SOC 2 and GDPR compliance posture from an engineering security perspective
Champion technical debt reduction and proactive platform reliability
Support your team during incident or when it is required
AI & Innovation
Lead the design and continuous improvement of our AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (AI SDLC)
Embed AI tooling and practices across the engineering team to increase velocity and quality
Collaborate with the data science team on AI/ML product initiatives to drive innovation with product
Cross-functional Collaboration
Work closely with Product and Design peers to align engineering execution with product strategy
Partner with Customer Success and Support to resolve escalations requiring technical depth
Report on engineering performance with clear, data-driven metrics

jobs.title: Head of Employee Tech & Experience (ETX)
jobs.text:
About the Team
Employee Tech & Experience (ETX) helps people at OpenAI do their most ambitious work. Across Helpdesk, Executive Support, Systems Operations, Logistics and AV, we make technology simple, reliable and secure. Employee needs guide what we build, improve and choose to eliminate.
About the Role
Reporting to the Head of Global IT, you’ll lead ETX globally, building on the team’s capabilities and customer-zero work to continually advance the employee experience. You’ll shape ETX’s strategy, investment priorities and operating model in partnership with leadership across the company, turning new capabilities into measurable amplification. You’ll develop leaders and strengthen teams where people feel valued, own meaningful work and enjoy working together.
This role is based at our San Francisco headquarters and requires an in-office presence.
In this role, you will:
Lead the next stage of ETX’s global growth across Helpdesk, SysOps, Logistics and AV, with a shared strategy and accountability for employee outcomes.
Continually elevate the employee experience through research and design, directing investment to simplify entire user journeys, remove unnecessary effort and amplify what employees can accomplish.
Accelerate ETX’s agent-led and customer-zero work as capabilities advance: continually challenge which workflows need to exist, extend what agents can own end to end and evolve the operating model to deliver measurable amplification.
Develop leaders who earn trust, grow others and sustain an environment where people feel valued, take pride in their work and enjoy working together. Give people meaningful ownership and opportunities to stretch and grow, with clear priorities and sustainable workloads.
Scale global services to support company growth, with clear commitments to reliability, security, responsiveness, and effective controls. Measure performance through employee effort, service quality, and time to resolution.
Shape priorities and investment with leadership across the company, accelerating execution across functions with accountability for adoption and measurable improvements in how employees work.
Translate employee friction into lasting improvements in policy, service design, and ownership. Hold ETX accountable for restoring productivity, communicating with empathy, and addressing the underlying causes of recurring failures.
You might thrive in this role if you:
Have led global organizations through growth and transformation, with measurable improvements in employee experience and reliability.
Start with what employees need. Use research and design to challenge assumptions and remove unnecessary work.
Rethink how the organization works as AI advances, expanding what agents can own and delivering measurable amplification.
Build leadership teams that help people grow, own meaningful work and enjoy working together.
Set direction and investment priorities with leadership across the company. Own execution, adoption and lasting results.
The impact you’ll have
You’ll help people at OpenAI do their most ambitious work. You’ll compound the impact of ETX’s agent-led work, turning advances in AI into measurable amplification, giving people back time and making technology simpler and more reliable as we grow. You’ll develop leaders who grow others, sustaining a culture where people feel valued, own meaningful work and enjoy achieving together what once felt out of reach.
About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.
OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Head of People Operations & Tech
jobs.text:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.
n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.
We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
Head of People Ops & Tech
🎯 You'll own and rebuild the operating system behind n8n's People function: hygiene, analytics, systems, and automation. This isn't a maintenance job. You'll have a real mandate to design it your way, and since n8n builds workflow automation for a living, you'll get to use our own product to do it. If you've ever wanted to turn your own function into your best case study, this is that job.
You're inheriting a People Ops team that's kept things moving through real growth, and you'll get a proper audit period before anyone asks you to change anything. That's real trust, and it means you get to diagnose before you prescribe.
Here's what you'll own:
Own the hygiene factors of employment
Own employment contracts, payroll coordination, visas, and employee policies end to end.
Keep n8n's SOC 2-related compliance processes accurate and audit-ready.
Bring clear, centralized ownership to freelancer and contractor engagement approvals, an area with no consistent oversight today.
Personally step in on hands-on hygiene work whenever it's the highest-impact use of your time.
Build people analytics in-house
Stand up n8n's own people analytics capability rather than relying on the central data team, given the sensitivity of the data.
Turn People data into decisions leadership can act on, from attrition trends to org health.
Report on the health of the People function to the VP People and wider leadership.
Own people systems and drive automation
Own and evolve People systems like HiBob and Mahana, keeping data clean and workflows scalable.
Automate repetitive People Ops work, partnering with workflow automation engineers on the most complex builds. You'll be doing it with n8n's own product, so you get to dogfood the exact tool your company sells, on your own function.
Get the underlying process and data right before you automate it. Solid documentation and a consistent process come first here, not as an afterthought.
Reduce manual load so the function scales without headcount growing in lockstep.
Welcome new hires and grow the team
Act as the onboarding liaison, making sure new hires feel welcomed and set up to succeed from day one.
Build out a small, high-trust team, hiring 2–3 specialists in analytics, automation, and systems over the next 12–24 months.
Partner closely with the VP People, Talent Acquisition, People Partners, and Finance/Legal to keep People Operations reliable as we scale.
REQUIREMENTS
Must-haves
📈 Proven scaling experience: You've scaled or matured an existing People Operations function, not necessarily built one from zero, through a comparable growth range such as 500 to 1,000 employees.
📝 Hands-on hygiene ownership: You've personally owned contracts, payroll coordination, visas, employee policies, and SOC 2-adjacent compliance, not just directed others who do.
⚖️ Strategic and hands-on: You're comfortable setting vision and prioritizing, and just as comfortable rolling up your sleeves on execution.
📊 People analytics fluency: You have real experience with people analytics and data, and you're willing to build that capability in-house.
⚙️ Systems and automation: You've worked hands-on with HRIS platforms like HiBob and have driven process automation in a People function.
🌍 Europe-based: You're based in Europe.
🔁 Track record: You've run or built this kind of function at least once before; twice is a plus.
🧭 Sequencing judgment: You know automation is only as good as the process and data behind it, and you don't force AI onto a process that isn't documented or consistent yet.
Nice-to-haves
🔄 Hybrid background: You've come up through analytics into people ops, or the other way around.
🤖 Automation partnership: You've partnered with or managed workflow-automation or AI tooling specialists.
💰 Comp benchmarking exposure: You've worked with compensation benchmarking or market-data analysis before.
🌐 Remote-first scaling: You've scaled a People function specifically inside a remote-first, distributed organization.
Why join us?
You'll take real ownership of the systems that let n8n's People function scale. This is a genuine mandate to design them, not inherit someone else's finished blueprint, and you'll get a built-in audit period so you can diagnose before anyone asks you to prescribe. You'll report directly to our VP People, with real visibility and sponsorship, and you'll shape the next 2 to 3 hires on your own team as it grows.
Since n8n builds workflow automation for a living, you'll get to use our own product to automate your own function. That's a genuinely rare setup, and honestly, the best advertisement for what we build. You're joining at around 400 people, heading past 500 by year-end, which is exactly the stage where the calls you make on hygiene, analytics, systems, and automation define how the company scales, rather than just keeping the lights on.
n8n is remote-first, fair-code, and riding the AI and automation wave as one of the most starred projects on GitHub. You'll work with the same autonomy and talent density that defines how we build our own product. Apply now, and help us build the People operating system that gets n8n to its next 1,000 people.
n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.
Our company language is English.
You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).
Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.
Benefits
Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.
Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:
Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.
US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
Health & wellness 🩺 –
Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*
US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
Future planning 💰 –
Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*
US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
Financial security 🛡️ –
Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*
US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.
Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.
Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.
* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

jobs.title: Fractional Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Catch Creation
Catch Creation is a global eCommerce company built for the digital age. We create, grow, and manage online brands that inspire customers and deliver real value through exceptional products and experiences. Our team thrives in a fully remote environment, combining creativity, data-driven strategy, and innovation to build scalable eCommerce solutions that perform.
From concept to conversion, we specialize in developing brands that stand out in competitive markets—driven by a passion for design, storytelling, and customer satisfaction. Every product we launch reflects our commitment to quality, authenticity, and growth.
At Catch Creation, we believe great ideas can come from anywhere—and our remote-first culture allows talented people from around the world to collaborate, innovate, and bring those ideas to life.
TYPE
Fractional / Contract
DURATION
6–12 Months
LOCATION
Remote — USA/Canada
HOURS/WEEK
10–20 hrs (flexible)
About Catch Creation & Muddy Mat
Catch Creation is a global e-commerce company that creates, grows, and manages online brands. Our flagship brand, Muddy Mat, is a 9-figure revenue, bootstrapped, profitable DTC pet products company the #1 selling indoor mat for cleaning dog paws, loved by millions of pet owners across America.
We operate across TV, DTC e-commerce, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and expanding retail partnerships with Home Depot, Costco, and Walmart. Our portfolio also includes Cloud K9 (anti-anxiety dog beds) and Wizz (pet stain remover). We are remote-first, lean, and move fast.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a hands-on, entrepreneurial Fractional CTO to provide senior technology leadership during a critical growth phase. You will work directly with the Founder/CEO and leadership team to own our technology strategy, lead our engineering team, and ensure our platforms can scale with the business.
This is not a consulting role where you write recommendations and disappear. We need someone who will embed with the team, make decisions, and drive execution.
What You’ll Do
Technology Strategy & Architecture
Own and execute our overall technology roadmap and platform architecture
Evaluate and recommend technology solutions that support multi-channel e-commerce growth
Ensure scalability, security, and reliability across all tech systems
Represent technology in leadership and strategic planning meetings
Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and manage our existing engineering team day-to-day
Set clear priorities, KPIs, and delivery expectations for the tech team
Identify gaps and make hiring recommendations where needed
Foster a culture of ownership, speed, and quality
Platform & Systems
Oversee and optimize our Shopify multi-store setup, including integrations, apps, and checkout flows
Manage integrations with order tracking tools, upsell/downsell sequences, and third-party platforms
Audit existing tech infrastructure and implement improvements for performance and reliability
Ensure our systems support Amazon, TikTok Shop, DRTV, and retail channel operations
What We’re Looking For
Required
Proven experience as CTO, VP Engineering, or equivalent senior tech leadership role
Deep hands-on experience with Shopify and e-commerce tech stacks at scale
Track record of building, leading, and scaling engineering teams
Experience with multi-channel e-commerce: DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop, or retail integrations
Strong communicator who can translate between technical and business teams
Based in the USA or Canada
Preferred
Prior fractional or advisory CTO experience
Familiarity with DRTV (direct response television) tech and operations
Experience at a high-growth DTC brand ($50M–$500M revenue range)
Exposure to 3PL/fulfillment tech and supply chain systems
Who You Are
You’ve done this before you know how to step into a fast-moving company, get up to speed quickly, and lead without needing hand-holding. You think like an operator, not just an architect. You’re equally comfortable reviewing a pull request and presenting a 12-month technology roadmap to the CEO.
You don’t hide behind process. You ship. You own outcomes. And you know that in a lean company, your impact is visible and immediate.
How to Apply
Please apply with your resume and a brief note covering:
Your relevant e-commerce / Shopify experience
Examples of engineering teams you’ve led
Your availability and preferred engagement structure (hours/week, start date)
Your rate or compensation expectations
We move quickly. Strong candidates will be contacted within a few business days.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Digital & Technology Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.
BeOne is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the discovery and development of innovative drug therapies for the treatment of cancer. At BeOne we believe that access to life-changing medicine sees no borders.
General Description:
The Senior Director, Global Digital & Technology Systems Engineering operates primarily as the primary point of contact and strategic bridge to the Global Technology Solutions (Enterprise IT function), ensuring all business-specific systems align with Enterprise infrastructure, security, identity management, and cloud platform standards.
The role owns the end-to-end remit for systems engineering for externally developed platforms & solutions, integration engineering, and technical application lifecycles across the organization. This includes designing, configuring, and deploying high-performance computing (HPC) clusters and containerized environments, alongside implementing modern system observability frameworks and robust data pipeline integration architectures. Additionally, this leader acts as a deep technical subject matter expert who advises on and engineers foundational AI architecture and systems engineering patterns, including advanced RAG pipelines, agentic AI frameworks & multi-modal integration patterns.
As a member of the GRDTS Leadership Team, the Senior Director is an active contributor to developing and executing BeOne’s R&D systems engineering strategy, defining necessary technology investments, and driving transparency in prioritization and planning. The Senior Director and their team are responsible for ensuring the strategy is fully aligned with business needs, positioning GRDTS to deliver and realize compelling business value.
A successful candidate is a dynamic leader who brings deep end-to-end pharma / biotech domain knowledge with technical expertise related to digital & technology systems, systems engineering, processes, data science, analytics, AI, & genAI. Ability to manage multiple projects across different sub-functions in a global, geographically diverse environment, and building and sustaining teams in times of ambiguity are all critical success factors for this role. An ideal candidate will adapt communication cadences and problem-solving skills to accommodate stakeholders, partners, and team members, exercise diplomacy and effective influence to reach consensus, and build strong relationships.
Essential Functions of the job:
Enterprise IT Alignment & Collaboration
Serve as the single point of contact and strategic bridge to Global Technology Solutions (Enterprise IT function), ensuring R&D systems align with global infrastructure, corporate cybersecurity, identity management, and cloud platform standards while advocating for specialized technical requirements.
Platforms & Systems Engineering
Oversee the engineering, architecting, and deployment strategies for platforms & systems, balancing on-prem, hybrid cloud, and multi-tenant SaaS environments based on business needs.
Architect robust, low-latency API layers and data buses to bridge disparate third-party applications, ensuring seamless data interoperability across the end-to-end organizational pipeline.
Implement modern observability frameworks, distributed tracing, and real-time telemetry across infrastructure and applications to proactively manage system health, identify bottlenecks, and resolve failures.
Lead the design, configuration, and deployment of High-Performance Computing (HPC) clusters and containerized environments optimized for compute-heavy, complex processing systems.
Provide oversight for the engineering and maintenance of the underlying storage fabric, data lakes, and pipelines that manage the full ingest, storage, and processing lifecycle of datasets for the Research function.
Manage the systems engineering and product development lifecycle, codebase evolution, patch management, and automated deployments of customized platforms and applications, ensuring long-term technical sustainability for the Research function.
Foundational AI Architectures & Workflow Patterns
Act as the technical SME & oversee the design, on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture, engineering vector storage integrations, advanced chunking strategies, and semantic retrieval layers.
Design and implement agentic AI system patterns, orchestrating multi-agent frameworks that can securely handle complex, multi-step autonomous workflows and tasks.
Engineer pipelines capable of handling multi-modal AI inputs and outputs, allowing core systems to ingest, process, and reason across diverse data types simultaneously.
Change Management & Digital Adoption
Manage the technical change strategy for foundational infrastructure overhauls and cloud migrations in collaboration with GTS.
Drive organizational alignment around unified integration standards, guiding systems engineering, development, and vendor teams toward optimized technical architectures.
Governance & Risk Mitigation
Collaborate with Global Technology Solutions (Enterprise IT) in the technical implementation of secure, enterprise-grade AI proxy layers and gateways, ensuring that proprietary data, information & systems, and intellectual property are strictly sandboxed.
GRDTS Leadership:
Team Leadership & Talent Development:
Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing GRDTS team focused on Systems Engineering.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability and drive professional development.
Operational Excellence, Compliance & Governance:
Ensure all systems and platforms adhere to relevant pharmaceutical industry regulations and internal security policies.
Liaise with vendors, Enterprise IT partners, audit, and compliance to coordinate system implementation and change activities
Ensure the team is trained in and embeds CSV, compliance, and health authority requirements into operational activities.
Collaboration & Partnership:
Collaborate with R&D functions and teams on standards and best practices to attain business goals
Engage with peers to define, sponsor, and execute continuous improvements.
Supervisory Responsibilities:
Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing GRDTS team dedicated to Systems Engineering.
Key Capabilities :
Enterprise-to-R&D Infrastructure Bridging: Acting as the primary liaison to global Enterprise IT, aligning R&D platforms with Enterprise cybersecurity, identity management, and cloud standards while successfully advocating for specialized Research needs.
External Platform Technical Assessment: Technically evaluating and stress-testing externally developed platforms, vendor solutions, and SaaS architectures to verify their scalability, security, integration readiness, and alignment with Enterprise engineering standards.
Internal & Vendor Platform Integration: Engineering secure, unified integration layers that connect internal applications seamlessly with externally developed third-party platforms.
Full-Ecosystem Observability & Reliability: Implementing real-time telemetry and monitoring across all internal and vendor-hosted applications to maximize platform uptime and performance.
Advanced Computer & AI Architecture Scaling: Scalability planning for cloud environments, high-performance computing, and emerging AI frameworks (e.g., enterprise RAG, secure AI gateways).
Technical Governance & Talent Upskilling: Driving adherence to unified architectural standards across internal teams and vendors while managing the reskilling roadmap for technical staff.
Key Competencies :
Objective Technical Due-Diligence: A highly analytical approach to reviewing vendor codebases, architecture diagrams, APIs, and SLAs to separate marketing claims from true engineering readiness.
Enterprise & Domain Diplomatic Mindset: The ability to navigate global Enterprise IT processes, translate core infrastructure constraints to the R&D team, and effectively negotiate exceptions for specialized scientific technical stacks.
Ecosystem-Level System Thinking: Viewing internal applications, cloud infrastructure, and external vendor platforms as a singular, cohesive, and scalable system.
Enterprise Risk & IP Stewardship: A security-first mindset committed to protecting Enterprise data and intellectual property across all internal and vendor-hosted environments.
Transformational Change Leadership: The ability to coach, upskill staff, and drive unified technical standards across groups.
Resilient Crisis Management: Providing decisive technical leadership during major platform upgrades, infrastructure overhauls, or critical system outages.
Key Deliverables :
R&D Systems Blueprint: Technical reference documentation detailing R&D systems and external vendor platforms.
Vendor Technical Assessment & Feasibility Reports: Formal architectural scorecards and technical risk assessments reviewing the scalability, code health, integration viability, and security posture of proposed third-party software.
Scalable AI/ML Architecture Patterns & Blueprints: Reusable infrastructure configurations, standardized RAG pipeline templates, and multi-agent workflow frameworks engineered to rapidly accelerate and scale projects.
Ecosystem Observability & Telemetry Views: A centralized, live monitoring infrastructure providing end-to-end health tracking and alert routing across all external systems and platforms.
Cross-Functional Governance & Technical Alignment Agreements: Formally negotiated architecture and compliance agreements co-authored with global Enterprise IT to approve R&D systems.
Other Qualifications:
12+ years of professional experience in data, digital & information technology with direct oversight and experience in the Systems Engineering area in the Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, and/or Medical Device industries
7+ years of proven leadership experience at a senior level, directing a team of multi-skilled direct reports and associate-level team members.
Strong experience in ML/AI/genAI methods and technologies from a Systems Engineering angle.
Business relationship management acumen and demonstrable success as a change agent leading or contributing to significant transformational initiatives in organizations.
Strong experience with software lifecycle methodologies, 21CFR Part 11 compliance, and GxP computer systems validation (CSV), ICH guidelines.
Accomplished in building and development of people and teams, comfortable working with a broad cross section of people in direct and matrixed relationships
Proficient in various project management disciplines (i.e., Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Lean etc.)
Education Required:
Bachelor or above
Travel:
Some travel expected as part of assigned duties
BeOne Global Competencies:
When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Collaborative Spirit, Bold Ingenuity and Driving Excellence, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

Salary Range: $207,800.00 - $277,800.00 annually
BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, and any other applicable federal, state or local laws, applicants who require reasonable accommodation in the job application process may contact .

jobs.title: Director, Product Design - AI & Context
jobs.text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
We're looking for an experienced Design Leader to oversee our Context Platform Pillar, which homes several critical company initiatives including Design Systems, Code, MCP, CMS, Community, and more. Think of it as the team that drives the most important context for AI agents to help you design better products.
In this role, you'll tackle strategic challenges from building new products to evolving and scaling existing ones - all while empowering your teams to deliver ambitious, high-quality work. If you're a leader who is especially deep in understanding modern AI + Design Systems workflows, and very passionate about empowering Designers through platform-wide investments in Figma's ecosystem, this role is for you.
As a Design leader at Figma, you'll guide and grow a team of world-class designers, with the opportunity to expand this group as the scope and impact of our work evolves. In this deeply cross-functional role, you'll work in close collaboration with product management, engineering, research, marketing, and other teams to shape both product and business strategy in our next chapter.
This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.
What you'll do at Figma:
Hire, manage, and develop a multi-team design group spanning Design Systems, Code, MCP, CMS, and Community
Partner with Product and Engineering leads in this area to improve team processes and execution and coach individual teams through setting roadmap and strategy
Develop a perspective on your team's product areas and successfully advocate for it across the organization
Lead critique, sprint, and design review practices across the pillar
Advance your own skills at people management in a supportive and growth-oriented environment
Operate hands-on across both people management and strategy and execution
We'd love to hear from you if you have:
5+ years of design management experience, ideally including experience managing managers and leading teams through ambiguity and change
Deep understanding of the latest AI developments, modern tooling, and component-driven design practices
Strong hands-on expertise with Figma's tools, with the ability to mentor and guide design teams effectively
Proven track record of partnering cross-functionally to solve complex design challenges and drive meaningful outcomes
Strong strategic thinking and communication skills, demonstrated through influencing teams, adapting quickly, and taking a proactive, solution-oriented approach
While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:
Background contributing to open-source or developer-facing design tools
Experience partnering with Research and Marketing on platform-wide initiatives
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Pay Transparency Disclosure
Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.
Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off. Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.
Annual Base Salary Range:
$290,000—$376,000 USD
At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.
Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Assure Health:
Assure Health is a fast-growing remote patient monitoring and virtual care provider that has proven to improve outcomes for patients and lower the cost of care. They are a 50-state provider network and have built a best -in-class technology platform to deliver excellent, relationship-driven care for patients with chronic conditions in collaboration with health systems and health plans.
The Role:
This is an exciting opportunity to work with a well-funded healthcare startup and build out the Engineering function. As a high-impact member of the leadership team, the VP of Engineering will be responsible for creating a world-class development organization, scaling, and leading the engineering team. The VP of Engineering will help drive the success of the overall business by collaborating with stakeholders internally and externally to set technical direction. The VP of Engineering will have been brought through the ranks as a hands-on Engineer and also have some leadership experience. This role will be both hands on and strategic. The ideal candidate will be based in South Florida, but we are open to it being remote for the right candidate.
Responsibilities:
Establish engineering processes and define our engineering standards
Identify and implement core technologies, while removing technical hurdles
Lead architecture discussions during feature development with both internal and external stakeholders (specifically clients) to ensure that projects are built in a sound, reliable, performant way.
Work cross-functionally, supporting the successful implementation of core features
Build solutions for appropriate scalability at speed
Hire, develop, and lead an A+ engineering team
Have a perfectionist-like mind, naturally monitoring and fine-tuning systems for performance
Engage in troubleshooting, testing, and maintaining core product software; optimize, scale, and improve existing code
Guiding incident response and vulnerability remediation efforts
Establish a culture of high productivity, collaboration, and big impact, and empowering each team to bring their vision to life
Provide software and technology research, analysis, and recommendations internally and to our clients
Skills and Qualifications:
7+ years of hands-on engineering experience, writing and shipping high-quality production code, especially highly reliable and scalable distributed system
Ideally 2+ years of experience recruiting, leading, and mentoring an engineering team
Engineering experience in a healthcare startup that has grown from under 50 employees to a few hundred employees is ideal
Experience building healthcare compliant systems
Experience with implementations at healthcare organizations
Experience obtaining HiTRUST certification is a plus
Worked with JavaScript, Node.js, ElectronJS, and React Native
Previous involvement with Salesforce development
Experience working with AWS and have some DevOps experience
Experience implementing core business strategies with technology by creating processes that scale, advancing architecture, and developing roadmaps
Possess a continuous improvement mindset to develop a scalable MVP and iterate in a data-driven approach
Able to execute on ideas and influence decision making in a clear and effective manner
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Director of Product - RPG
jobs.text:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.
With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.
This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.
What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.
Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.
At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.
Mission
As a Director of Product on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with that game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
Own LiveOps end-to-end. You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
Lead your team. You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
Oversee the monetization model. Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
Drive growth, in partnership with UA. You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
Cross-functional excellence. You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
Set the bar. Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
Stay hands-on when it counts. This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.
This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy,, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

jobs.title: Head of Technology Operations
jobs.text:
FP Markets Group of Companies is a well-established multi-regulated broker, founded in Australia, offering traders access to CFD trading on Forex, Indices, Commodities, Stocks and Cryptocurrencies. We are growing and looking to recruit a Full-time Head of Technology Operation in our Cyprus office - a certified Great Place to Work®.
You will lead the teams that run and support the company's technology services, ensuring reliable service, effective support, safe changes, tested recovery and clear operational ownership.
Reporting to: CTO
Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the Technology Operations function, including Infrastructure & Cloud, IT Operations, Application Support, Business Systems & CRM, Trading Platform Operations and regional technology operations
Ensure the reliable day-to-day operation, availability and support of business-critical technology services
Establish clear service ownership, support coverage, operational procedures and escalation processes across the technology environment
Lead the response to major technology incidents, coordinating service restoration, stakeholder communication, root-cause reviews and corrective actions
Drive continuous improvements in incident management, service reliability, recovery and operational resilience
Ensure robust backup, recovery and business continuity procedures are established and regularly tested
Oversee operational changes and release readiness, ensuring that environments, monitoring, support, rollback procedures and handovers are in place before releases
Oversee application support activities, including issue triage, diagnosis, authorised workarounds and escalation to Engineering and Product teams where required
Support and deliver authorised technology and security-related operational initiatives, working closely with Information Security and Technology Risk
Ensure operational security actions are properly assigned, tracked and completed with appropriate evidence
Work closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Risk, Dealing and other business stakeholders to ensure effective technology service delivery
Manage technology suppliers and service providers, including performance, costs, renewals and service quality
Manage delegated technology budgets and maintain visibility over operational expenditure
Lead, develop and mentor Technology Operations managers and specialists, including workforce planning, recruitment, succession planning and knowledge transfer

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer - US-Based
jobs.text:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Position Description:
As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.
You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.
You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.
You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.
Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.
You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.
This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.
This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.
AI and agentic engineering
Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.
Team, resourcing, and accountability
Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.
Platform and execution
Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.
In the first week, expect to:
Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.
In the first month, expect to:
Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.
In the first three months, expect to:
Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.
In the first six months, expect to:
Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.
In the first year, expect to:
Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Essential Job Functions
Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt
Compensation
Additional Information
