jobs.title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
jobs.text:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.
As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.
Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)
Language requirement: fluency in German or Spanish
Location: Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA
Employment: 18-month FTC with view to extend
About the role:
We're hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You'll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You'll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren't there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you'll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.
Key Responsibilities:
New Business and Client Engagement
Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren't present, and know when and how to bring them in.
Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.
Requirement Gathering and Analysis
Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.
Operating Model and Solution Design
Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.
Commercial Modelling
Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.
Stakeholder Communication
Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.
Data, Measurement and Reporting
Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.
About You:
Essential
10-15 years' experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren't in the room.
Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.
Desirable
Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.
What Success Looks Like:
Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

Be Ambitious to succeed
Be Imaginative to push the boundaries of what's possible

Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren't present, and know when and how to bring them in.
Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

items: Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

blocks.text: Operating Model and Solution Design

items: Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

blocks.text: Commercial Modelling

items: Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.

items: Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Enterprise Product
jobs.text:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.
Reporting to the VP of Engineering, the Director of Engineering will lead the engineering organization responsible for the systems at the core of how teams, venues, and promoters manage tickets and operate their businesses. Hundreds of major live event venues around the globe rely on the SeatGeek platform, including those home to the Dallas Cowboys, Cleveland Cavaliers, Florida Panthers, and Manchester United F.C.
You will set technical direction for this complex, mature platform while helping lead its evolution toward SeatGeek’s next generation of products and architecture. At the same time, you will help change how we build software as we move toward an AI-native engineering organization.
This role requires someone who can move comfortably between technology, product, and the ticketing domain. You will partner closely with Product and Design leadership, Engineering Managers, Senior Engineers, and our clients to turn complicated business problems into clear technical and product direction.
What you'll do
Set technical direction across US Ticketing, working with Engineering Managers and Staff+ engineers on architecture, system ownership, modernization, and platform boundaries
Lead the evolution of a mature, business-critical platform, balancing client commitments and near-term delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, and modernization
Stay close to the technology and contribute directly when useful, whether through code, prototypes, debugging, architecture reviews, technical designs, or documentation
Pioneering AI-native engineering by evolving how teams design, build, test, operate, and understand software, and by turning successful experiments into repeatable improvements
Partner as a peer with Product and Design leadership to shape strategy, not simply execute a roadmap
Develop a deep understanding of our clients and business, distinguish client-specific needs from durable platform opportunities, and participate directly in important client, sales, and implementation conversations when engineering context matters
Lead and develop Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders, creating clear ownership and strong leverage through others
Build a strong engineering organization by developing leaders, growing Staff+ talent, and evolving team structure as the business changes
Create an engineering culture that combines high ownership, healthy technical debate, strong execution, and sustainable performance
What you have
Experience leading multiple engineering teams and Engineering Managers in a complex software organization
Strong technical judgment and enough architectural depth to work credibly with senior engineers on difficult system and platform decisions
A willingness and ability to contribute technically when it is the highest-leverage way to help, including architecture, technical writing, prototyping, debugging, and code
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software development and a strong point of view on how AI changes engineering practices and the software development lifecycle
Experience evolving mature, business-critical systems while continuing to deliver customer value
A track record of creating technical strategy from ambiguous product and business problems
Experience partnering closely with senior Product and Design leaders and learning complex customer domains quickly
Experience developing Engineering Managers and Staff+ engineers and creating leverage through other leaders
Strong cross-functional leadership, communication, ownership, and comfort making consequential decisions with incomplete information
Experience with ticketing, live events, commerce, payments, reservations, inventory, or similarly complex transactional systems is a plus
Our stack
US Ticketing includes mature systems that have powered some of the world’s largest live events for years alongside newer services and applications. We care much more about your ability to understand complex systems, make sound architectural decisions, lead modernization, and use new tools effectively than experience with any particular language or framework.
This is a deeply technical leadership role. We do not expect the Director to be the primary implementer, but we do expect them to be willing and able to contribute technically when it helps move the team forward. AI is becoming a core part of our engineering process, and this leader will help us rethink how teams build and evolve software in an AI-native development environment.
Perks
Equity stake
Discretionary annual bonus
Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely
A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
Unlimited PTO
Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave
401(k) matching
Student loan matching program
Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care
$500 per year for wellness expenses
Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
$360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music
The salary range for this role is $236,000-$341,000 USD. This role is equity eligible. In addition, you may receive a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation packages within that range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location.
SeatGeek is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, creed, age, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. As an equal opportunities employer, we recognize that diversity is a positive attribute and we welcome the differences and benefits that a diverse culture brings.

jobs.title: Director of Technology Operations (Fully Remote)
jobs.text:
The Role We Need
We’re hiring a Director of Technology Operations to lead the three functions that keep PadSplit’s technology and business operations healthy: Quality Assurance, IT & internal tooling, and Security. You’ll inherit existing teams across each area and be responsible for modernizing how they work: moving QA toward automation, IT toward proactive enablement, and Security toward a structured, risk-based program.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set strategy and own outcomes across all three areas, while staying close enough to the work to evaluate a test architecture, challenge a vendor renewal, or lead an incident review yourself.
The Person We Are Looking For
We’re looking for a technology leader who has led multiple technology operations functions and knows how to turn reactive, manual processes into scalable systems. You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution, developing teams while also getting into the details when the situation calls for it.
You’ll need strong technical judgment, particularly across QA, IT operations, and Security, and the ability to translate technical risks and tradeoffs into clear business decisions. Most importantly, you’re a player-coach who can modernize these functions without losing sight of the people and teams responsible for delivering the work.
Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day
Set QA strategy: Define what quality means at PadSplit, how it’s measured, and how quality is built into the development lifecycle rather than addressed at the end.
Modernize testing: Increase test automation, improve CI/CD quality gates, and move the team from manual regression toward automation engineering.
Scale with AI: Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted testing tools for test generation, maintenance, and triage so QA can keep pace with product demand without relying solely on headcount growth.
Develop teams: Coach existing QA, IT, and Security team members, create career paths, and hire where additional expertise is needed.
Improve IT: Modernize internal tools and workflows, automate repetitive processes, manage the SaaS portfolio, and identify opportunities to consolidate vendors and reduce costs.
Build service standards: Establish IT SLAs, self-service resources, and documentation so employees receive fast, predictable support as the company scales.
Lead security: Own the security roadmap across application, infrastructure, corporate/endpoint security, and vendor risk while establishing policies, training, vulnerability management, and incident response processes.
Lead incidents: Serve as the escalation point for security incidents, leading response and communication and facilitating blameless postmortems that turn incidents into improvements.
Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful
Leadership experience: 10+ years in technology roles and 5+ years leading teams, including direct leadership experience in at least two of the three areas: QA, IT, or Security, and strong working knowledge of the third.
Modernization track record: Experience transforming a manual QA organization, ad hoc Security function, or reactive IT organization into a more automated, structured, and proactive operation.
QA expertise: Strong knowledge of test automation, CI/CD integration, quality metrics, agile product development, and modern approaches to AI-assisted testing.
AWS experience: Hands-on experience with AWS and enough infrastructure knowledge to make informed QA, IT, and Security decisions.
IT operations: Strong grounding in IAM/SSO, MDM, SaaS administration, network security tooling, and IT budget management.
Automation knowledge: Familiarity with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, with enough technical depth to evaluate architecture and coach the team.
Business judgment: Strong judgment around build-vs-buy decisions, vendor selection, and how to prioritize limited resources across competing technology needs.
Executive communication: Able to communicate clearly and directly and translate technical risks, tradeoffs, and decisions into language executives and non-technical stakeholders can understand.
The Interview Process:
Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.
If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our CTO for one (1) hour.
If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our key stakeholders for one (1) hour.
If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for two (2) hours.
The panel interview will require a candidate to work on a technical assessment where you will showcase your technology experise to the panel for discussion.
If warranted, then we move to offer!
Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:
Fully remote position - we swear!
Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity
National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
Company provided life insurance policy
Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
401(k) plan
Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents
The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis
Compensation
Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.
Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Atlanta, Georgia, this is a fully remote position. This is a result of our Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn.
Additional Information
Notice to Applicants:
PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.
PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Director - Technology
jobs.text:
Role in One Breath
You'll join the Simple Machines UK leadership team as a senior technology and people leader with deep roots in software engineering. You'll help ensure the success and growth of our existing enterprise clients while opening new relationships, shaping propositions and solutions, and helping us win significant new work.
You'll provide senior technology leadership to our clients, lead major pursuits and develop our technology people, with genuine influence over what we build, what we take to market and where Simple Machines goes next in the UK and Europe.
Help lead the UK business. Grow our strategic accounts. Win new clients. Build an exceptional technology team.
What This Role Actually Involves
This is a hands-on technology leadership role. You'll be deep in the work, helping our teams and clients successfully deliver complex software engineering programmes, while leading across architecture, clients, growth and people. You'll influence as much as direct: selling ideas, building alignment and bringing clients, teams and other business units on the journey.
Engineering and delivery leadership
• Get close to our most complex software engineering engagements and help ensure they succeed
• Lead the engineering of modern software solutions, increasingly including AI-native and agentic applications and systems
• Work directly with engineers, technical leads and architects to solve difficult technical and delivery problems
• Review architecture and engineering approaches, challenge decisions and step in where senior technical leadership is needed
• Drive strong engineering practices and ensure emerging AI and agentic solutions are engineered with enterprise-grade rigour
• Own the technical quality of our work and ensure what we deliver is something we are proud to stand behind
Architecture and technical leadership
• Shape software, solution and enterprise architecture across major client programmes
• Make pragmatic architecture decisions balancing engineering quality, enterprise constraints and delivery
• Provide technical assurance across our portfolio while remaining close to the engineering
• Stay technically current and credible with our most senior engineers and architects
Clients, influence and strategic accounts
• Help ensure the continued success and growth of our strategic enterprise accounts
• Act as a trusted technology adviser to senior client stakeholders
• Sell ideas and approaches to clients and internal stakeholders, building alignment and bringing people with you
• Work across consulting, delivery, data and AI to shape joined-up solutions and propositions
• Lead difficult technology, architecture and stakeholder conversations when senior intervention is required
Go-to-market and growth
• Open new client relationships and lead early-stage technology conversations
• Turn client problems into compelling propositions, architectures and delivery approaches
• Personally shape proposals, pitches, RFPs and major pursuits
• Ensure what we sell is technically credible, commercially compelling and deliverable
• Work across Simple Machines to assemble the capabilities and support required to win and grow work
People leadership
• Lead, mentor and develop our UK technology team
• Develop senior engineers, technical leads, principal engineers and architects through real client work
• Set a high bar for engineering craft, architecture and technical leadership
• Help attract exceptional technical talent and build a high-performance, low-ego engineering culture

jobs.title: Head of Business Technology Engineering
jobs.text:
About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic's Business Technology Engineering team builds the systems the company runs on. We own the internal platforms every employee uses and our collaboration tooling, and we embed engineers directly with Legal, Security, Communications, Product Operations and other business functions to rebuild how their work gets done with Claude at the center. Our mandate is to make Anthropic the best-run company in the world at using its own models internally, and to be the example our customers point to.
We are hiring an engineering leader to run this org. You will lead a growing engineering organization across two tracks: Platforms, which builds and operates the shared systems the company depends on, and Forward Deployed, which drops into a business function, proves Claude wins on a real workflow, hands off, and moves on. You will partner on defining the roadmap, build relationships with functional leaders, grow the team, and shape what forward deployed engineering looks like inside a frontier AI lab.

jobs.title: Head of Analytics
jobs.text:
Lighthouse Games is a new AAA studio in Leamington Spa. We are defined by our pedigree of talent, and serious ambition to build a new best-in-class game. When you join us at Lighthouse, you will be able to create the best work of your career, in an environment that feels truly collaborative. You will learn from the best, and work along side the future greats of the gaming industry.
Reporting to the Director of Live Service, you will own analytics for a new AAA IP end to end including the strategy and team. You’ll lead the team, define how we measure and understand player behaviour, and be the analytics voice in the room.
Key Duties Include
Decide what needs to be built: define the analytics strategy, event taxonomies, and instrumentation roadmap
Lead the team day to day: setting priorities, reviewing work, and unblocking delivery
Deliver actionable insight by turning data and analysis into clear recommendations
Manage partnerships across the studio, particularly with design, to get analytics requirements built and prioritised
Deliver forecasting, build outlooks and scenarios, and pressure test assumptions
Lead data governance and privacy by driving compliance across analytics and data pipelines, monitoring data quality, managing access, and keeping documentation current
Act as the primary analytics counterpart to our publisher’s analytics team, aligning on data definitions and reporting

jobs.title: Director Product Management - Identity & Activation
jobs.text:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.
The role
We are looking for a Director Product Manager to advance our identity resolution capabilities and build future-proof identity and activation solutions. You will own product strategy and roadmap across both identity and activation, bring a clear point of view on where the market is heading, and turn that into products customers want to buy.
This is a senior role for someone who can operate at two altitudes. You set direction and vision, and you are also hands-on: close to customers, close to engineering, and comfortable making the calls on what gets built and in what order. You will play a meaningful part in expanding our client base, which means you understand the market, the buyers, and what it takes to win them.

jobs.title: VP Engineering and R&D - AI Startup
jobs.text:
Are you a technology leader who is not only passionate about AI but is also excited to be at the forefront of solving one of the most challenging problems that have plagued IT for years and could result in organizations becoming highly challenged or possibly extinct as digital transformation sweeps every sector?
Are you looking for a role with the opportunity to:
Execute core research in AI knowledge management that leads to patentable technologies?
Take an idea from research to a commercially successful cloud-based enterprise software product?
Build a solution that will have a meaningful impact on one-third of the US economy - both for-profit and not-for-profit organizations?
Are you seeking the potential to:
Be the first to bring a unique combination of AI and data management to the market?
Work with experienced, successful Silicon Valley entrepreneurs with 4X startup experience leading to IPO and acquisition exits?
Be mentored by a team of research advisors known in the industry as thought leaders?
Participate in a Silicon Valley-style equity opportunity within a venture with the potential for significant value creation?
Work with a company built around a remote model before COVID-19 made it a requirement?
Give back to your community through a 1-1-1 philanthropic model as pioneered by Marc Benioff’s Salesforce?
The Essentials:
Master or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Operation Research or other equivalent quantitative fields
Experience in AI with a demonstrated understanding of expert systems, knowledge management, and digital assistants
Experience managing a team of data scientists and AI researchers and engineers using Agile methodologies and tools
Previous startup experience with a proven track record of leading teams that drive innovation and deliver products in a fast-paced, high-energy environment
Excited to work with new technologies and approaches
Experience working within an SBIR NSF (Small Business Innovation Research - National Science Foundation) Program grant award model
Responsibilities:
Get to know our customer (or know them already) and use that empathy to inform shaping the product’s vision and requirements and building an exceptional product
Serve as a thought leader and technology strategy driver along with the CEO and Co-Founders to make decisions on the product technology architecture including building block components - with a preference for open source technologies
Build, build, build - especially in the early days, you will be rolling up your sleeves and writing code, from core platform to fixing bugs
Help form a top-performing team of talented and responsible software engineers, data scientists and product designers, and provide them the freedom to be creative and innovative
Lead product engineering including research and development of unique proprietary and patentable intellectual property that yields competitive advantages
Embody the company’s culture and mission by fostering a culture that is passionate about building awesome products that deliver measurable value and a customer experience that delights
Evangelize the company’s technology vision, roadmap and capabilities with customers, investors, employees, and other stakeholders
Stay current on technology advances in the field of AI - especially digital assistants, knowledge engineering, data-driven reasoning, expert systems - and in the field of data management - including column databases and other advanced decision analytics technologies
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
C-PLan.IT is an early stage startup on a mission to enable mid-market organizations to measure and maximize value from IT investments. We are building an AI Digital Assistant delivered as-a service in real time to support IT investment decision making and value optimization.
Unlike competitive solutions that focus on cost or asset management only C-Plan.IT specializes in IT investment management with a particular focus on digital transformation objectives.
The benefits of using C-Plan.IT increase as the platform’s membership grows toward the bold goal of becoming the world’s largest IT investment platform with $100B annual IT investments under management across 2000 organizations in the next 10 years.
Privately funded, we are a fully remote company with a 100% distributed team allowing us to hire the best people regardless of where they are located.

jobs.title: Director AI Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
Our client is building a new AI Engineering & Platform team in Germany to support the next generation of AI-powered media, localization, automation, and workflow capabilities. The Director, AI Engineering & Platform will lead this team and will be responsible for building, operating, and evolving the technical foundation for production AI services across our client.
This is a senior hands-on leadership role for someone who can build and run a high-performing engineering team, deliver complex AI platform and integration projects, and provide technical direction across cloud infrastructure, model deployment, AI services, agentic workflows, and production operations. The role will lead a hybrid engineering team based primarily in Germany while also managing and collaborating with engineers in other our client locations, including the United States.
In addition to leading delivery and operations, this person will continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, model providers, open-source frameworks, agentic workflow patterns, and industry capabilities. They will be expected to make clear recommendations on where our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate in order to improve speed, quality, cost, automation, and product differentiation.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build, lead, mentor, and develop a distributed AI engineering team across Germany and other our client locations. Experience recruiting, hiring, and standing up the full AI/ML engineering organization from scratch: applied ML engineers, MLOps/platform engineers, data engineers, integration engineers, etc.
Lead development, hosting and ongoing improvement of our client’s cloud-native training and inference platform (compute, storage, orchestration, model serving, monitoring, cost management) for our client’s NLP technology for MT, ASR, and TTS in production.
Own technical delivery for our client’s AI platform, model-serving, workflow automation, and applied AI engineering initiatives.
Lead architecture,execution, deployment and SLA performance for scalable AI services, including inference platforms, training environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and operational support.
Own infrastructure cost efficiency (GPU utilization, training vs. inference cost trade-offs, autoscaling) as a first-class, ongoing responsibility rather than a one-time setup task.
Evaluate internal and external AI technologies on an ongoing basis, including commercial models, open-source models, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and vendor platforms.
Recommend when our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate with third-party AI capabilities.
Guide teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, DevOps, AI platform operations, applied AI engineering, and model integration.
Establish engineering standards, operating rhythms, delivery practices, documentation expectations, and technical review processes.
Establish and drive MLOps practices: continuous improvement across AI engineering practices, reproducible training pipelines, model versioning and registry, automation, CI/CD, monitoring, automated quality evaluation, testing, and release management.
Support adoption of AI capabilities across our client applications and workflows through reusable platforms, services, APIs, and technical patterns.
Create clarity around priorities, risks, technical tradeoffs, delivery timelines, and resourcing needs.
Ensure the team can operate production AI systems independently through strong documentation, runbooks, monitoring, incident response, and knowledge sharing.
Partner with U.S. and European stakeholders across engineering, product, operations, localization, media workflows, and business leadership. Partner closely with the leaders of our client’s localization business lines to understand where current MT/ASR/TTS quality falls short and translate that into a prioritized technical roadmap.
Ensure AI systems are reliable, secure, maintainable, cost-conscious, and aligned with production business needs.
Represent AI/ML technology capability and constraints to executive leadership; contribute to the company's overall technology and product strategy.
QUALIFICATIONS:
[10+] years in software/ML engineering, including [4+] years in a technical leadership role owning both people management and architecture/system-design decisions.
Direct, hands-on experience with model training/fine-tuning, evaluation methodology, and production deployment (not solely API-consumer experience).
Proven experience designing and operating production ML infrastructure at scale: training pipelines, model serving/inference, GPU resource management, and MLOps tooling, on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience in distributed training, Slurm/HPC, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies.
Track record of building a technical team from scratch to a functioning, multi-workstream organization, including recruiting, leveling, and distributed team design across locations and time zones.
Demonstrated ability to translate business/product requirements from non-technical stakeholders into a technical roadmap, and to communicate technical trade-offs to executives in business terms.
Significant experience leading engineering teams responsible for cloud platforms, AI/ML systems, data platforms, workflow automation, or production software systems.
Strong technical background in cloud architecture, software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML engineering.
Experience with agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, model evaluation, RAG patterns, or AI-enabled automation platforms.
Experience evaluating commercial and open-source AI models or vendor platforms.
Experience delivering production systems that require reliability, monitoring, automation, security, and operational ownership.
Strong understanding of modern AI architectures, model-serving patterns, APIs, data pipelines, and applied AI integration.
Ability to evaluate technical options, make pragmatic recommendations, and communicate tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience leading complex technical programs from planning through production deployment and ongoing operations.
Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based leadership while operating independently from Germany.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:
Experience with speech, language, localization, dubbing, media workflows, ASR, MT, TTS, or content-processing systems.
Prior experience in media, localization, entertainment technology, or a related content-production industry — direct exposure to subtitling, dubbing, or content compliance workflows is a strong plus.
Familiarity with content-security frameworks used by major studios and broadcasters (e.g., MPA content security best practices, Trusted Partner Network) and what they require of vendor/internal systems.
Prior experience taking over or migrating away from a third-party AI/ML vendor relationship, including contract wind-down and knowledge-transfer.
Experience in media, entertainment, localization, post-production, or content supply chain environments.

Experience recruiting, hiring, and standing up the full AI/ML engineering organization from scratch: applied ML engineers, MLOps/platform engineers, data engineers, integration engineers, etc.

Lead development, hosting and ongoing improvement of our client’s cloud-native training and inference platform (compute, storage, orchestration, model serving, monitoring, cost management) for our client’s NLP technology for MT, ASR, and TTS in production.
Own technical delivery for our client’s AI platform, model-serving, workflow automation, and applied AI engineering initiatives.

Lead architecture,execution, deployment and SLA performance for scalable AI services, including inference platforms, training environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and operational support.
Own infrastructure cost efficiency (GPU utilization, training vs. inference cost trade-offs, autoscaling) as a first-class, ongoing responsibility rather than a one-time setup task.
Evaluate internal and external AI technologies on an ongoing basis, including commercial models, open-source models, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and vendor platforms.
Recommend when our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate with third-party AI capabilities.
Guide teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, DevOps, AI platform operations, applied AI engineering, and model integration.
Establish engineering standards, operating rhythms, delivery practices, documentation expectations, and technical review processes.

Establish and drive MLOps practices: continuous improvement across AI engineering practices, reproducible training pipelines, model versioning and registry, automation, CI/CD, monitoring, automated quality evaluation, testing, and release management.
Support adoption of AI capabilities across our client applications and workflows through reusable platforms, services, APIs, and technical patterns.
Create clarity around priorities, risks, technical tradeoffs, delivery timelines, and resourcing needs.
Ensure the team can operate production AI systems independently through strong documentation, runbooks, monitoring, incident response, and knowledge sharing.

Partner with U.S. and European stakeholders across engineering, product, operations, localization, media workflows, and business leadership. Partner closely with the leaders of our client’s localization business lines to understand where current MT/ASR/TTS quality falls short and translate that into a prioritized technical roadmap.
Ensure AI systems are reliable, secure, maintainable, cost-conscious, and aligned with production business needs.
Represent AI/ML technology capability and constraints to executive leadership; contribute to the company's overall technology and product strategy.

[10+] years in software/ML engineering, including [4+] years in a technical leadership role owning both people management and architecture/system-design decisions.
Direct, hands-on experience with model training/fine-tuning, evaluation methodology, and production deployment (not solely API-consumer experience).

Proven experience designing and operating production ML infrastructure at scale: training pipelines, model serving/inference, GPU resource management, and MLOps tooling, on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience in distributed training, Slurm/HPC, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies.
Track record of building a technical team from scratch to a functioning, multi-workstream organization, including recruiting, leveling, and distributed team design across locations and time zones.
Demonstrated ability to translate business/product requirements from non-technical stakeholders into a technical roadmap, and to communicate technical trade-offs to executives in business terms.
Significant experience leading engineering teams responsible for cloud platforms, AI/ML systems, data platforms, workflow automation, or production software systems.
Strong technical background in cloud architecture, software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML engineering.
Experience with agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, model evaluation, RAG patterns, or AI-enabled automation platforms.
Experience evaluating commercial and open-source AI models or vendor platforms.
Experience delivering production systems that require reliability, monitoring, automation, security, and operational ownership.
Strong understanding of modern AI architectures, model-serving patterns, APIs, data pipelines, and applied AI integration.
Ability to evaluate technical options, make pragmatic recommendations, and communicate tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience leading complex technical programs from planning through production deployment and ongoing operations.
Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based leadership while operating independently from Germany.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:
Experience with speech, language, localization, dubbing, media workflows, ASR, MT, TTS, or content-processing systems.
Prior experience in media, localization, entertainment technology, or a related content-production industry — direct exposure to subtitling, dubbing, or content compliance workflows is a strong plus.

Familiarity with content-security frameworks used by major studios and broadcasters (e.g., MPA content security best practices, Trusted Partner Network) and what they require of vendor/internal systems.
Prior experience taking over or migrating away from a third-party AI/ML vendor relationship, including contract wind-down and knowledge-transfer.
Experience in media, entertainment, localization, post-production, or content supply chain environments.

jobs.title: Strategic Technology Alliances Director
jobs.text:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.
What We Need
NetBrain is seeking a Strategic Technology Alliances Director to expand and activate our ecosystem of technology and consulting partners. This role focuses on identifying and evangelizing joint value between NetBrain and adjacent platforms—helping customers and partners understand how integrated solutions can deliver greater operational impact.
This is a customer-facing, individual contributor role that bridges product innovation and go-to-market execution. You will not be responsible for building integrations, but for ensuring the value of those integrations is clearly articulated, adopted, and scaled across the ecosystem.
The Impact You'll Make
NetBrain sits within a dense ecosystem of technologies used by the world’s largest enterprises. This role is critical in ensuring we don’t just integrate into that ecosystem—but actively shape and amplify the value created across it. Success is measured by the activation and adoption of joint solutions, not just the existence of partnerships.
What You'll Do
Identify and develop strategic alliances with software and hardware technology partners (e.g., ServiceNow, Dynatrace, ThousandEyes)
Drive thego-to-market activation of joint solutions, ensuring successful launch, positioning, and customer adoption
Partner with Product and R&D to stay aligned on integration priorities and translate them into compelling external narratives
Track and report on alliance success metrics including partner agreements, joint launches, and customer adoption
Collaborate with Marketing to support joint campaigns, webinars, and partner-facing content
Engage directly with customers and partners to position the future-state value of integrated solutions
Proactively identify new ecosystem opportunities and bring them forward for evaluation and activation
What You Bring
Experience working with or within enterprise technology ecosystems (networking, observability, ITSM, or adjacent domains)
Strong ability to understand technical concepts and translate them into business value
Background in a network vendor, SaaS company, or consulting/partner organization
Proven ability to influence without authority and drive cross-functional alignment
Highly proactive, self-directed, and results-oriented mindset
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with both technical and business audiences
Willingness to travel within your territory as required.
Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer.
Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position.
What We Offer
Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.
For this role, the estimated base is $175,000 - $210,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.
The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy.
NetBrain invites all interested and qualified candidates to apply for employment opportunities.
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.
If you have a disability that prevents or limits your ability to use or access the site, or if you require any other accommodation in the application process due to a disability, you may request a reasonable accommodation. To make a request, please contact our People Team at: and we will be happy to assist you.
In compliance with applicable laws, NetBrain conducts holistic, individual background reviews in support of all hiring decisions.
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.text:
Who we are
Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.
Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.
We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.
If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.
Your Impact
Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. 10,000+ businesses use us because we've always believed that customer relationships are the business, and that every interaction should feel like it came from someone who cares. That trust took a decade to build, and now it's the foundation for something bigger.
A lot of that trust is design. When customers tell us why they picked Help Scout over the alternatives, and when they recommend us to someone else, the reason they give most often is that it is easier to use and it feels better to work in. That's why our top source for new customers comes from human and agent referrals. Our user experience is one of the strongest advantages we have, and as Director of Product Design you'll be directly accountable for keeping our quality high as we accelerate our growth.
About the role
Lead our product design team as a player/coach. Manage and develop a small team of experienced product designers and stay close to the work through critique, design reviews, and occasional projects of your own. Your most senior individual contributors carry the most complex design problems; your job is to make sure the whole team's work meets the bar. Set clear expectations for craft and ownership and build a culture where critique and feedback make the work better.
Turn great design judgment into something that scales. Own the design principles, standards, guardrails, and decision record that make a Help Scout experience feel like Help Scout, so designers, engineers, and AI agents can create high-quality experiences with more speed and autonomy. Your most senior designers author the interaction models and product patterns that sit underneath them.
Be accountable for our design system as a product. Set the priorities and resourcing for the Help Scout Design System (HSDS), drive its adoption across Product and Engineering, and make it useful and legible to both people and machines, working with the designer who serves as its technical lead for architecture, patterns, and Figma/code parity.
Own how AI shows up in our product. AI is every designer's job, not one person's. You are accountable for Help Scout's point of view on trustworthy AI experiences: how AI communicates, gives people control, handles mistakes, and moves from assisting customers to acting on their behalf. Your most senior designers lead the design direction and patterns; you make sure that point of view is adopted and applied consistently by every designer, and that it evolves with the product.
Evolve how design gets done as AI accelerates delivery. Own the operating model: workflows, tooling standards, design debt, how design works with Product and Engineering, and how the capacity AI frees up gets reinvested. Decide which of the practices the team pilots (code prototyping, AI-assisted workflows) become the standard way we work. Your most senior designers shape how AI fits into the design process itself; you make sure that guidance becomes how the team actually works.
Help shape product direction alongside Product and Engineering. As a member of our Experience Leadership Team (XLT), bring design judgment, customer understanding, and a clear view of where design investment will have the greatest roadmap impact. Carry business context, constraints, and initiative outcomes back to the design team, and bring designers into the forums where direction for their work is being set.
Decide where design capacity goes. Match designers to workstreams based on business priority. Decide who is embedded where, when someone shifts to a higher-priority problem, and when designers move from horizontal work to a deep, time-bound embed in a single workstream.
Partner with the Brand Design team in our GTM organization to help ensure design cohesion between marketing and in-app product experiences.
About you
You're an experienced product design leader who still loves the work. You bring 10+ years in product design, including 3+ years managing designers, and have been accountable for the experience of a product, as well as the people creating it.
You have exceptional product and design judgment. You care about craft in a way that shows up in the details, can clearly articulate why an experience works, and have experience making complex B2B software feel simple and intuitive.
You know how to scale great product design. You've built or meaningfully evolved a design system that teams genuinely adopted, and you know how to translate taste and judgment into principles, patterns, and systems others can apply.
You have a strong point of view on AI and the future of product design. You use AI throughout your own design practice and think deeply about both how AI changes the way products are designed and how to create AI experiences customers can trust.
You know how to lead senior individual contributors. You've managed principal or staff-level designers, given them real scope, and made them more effective without competing with them for the work.
You're a deeply cross-functional product leader. You're technically fluent enough to earn the trust of engineers, comfortable using data and customer research to inform your decisions, and skilled at partnering with Product and Engineering on difficult tradeoffs.
You're an exceptional communicator and remote leader. You make your thinking visible through clear writing and direct feedback, treat words as part of the product experience, and know how to build trust, alignment, and a strong design culture on a distributed team.
Who you'll work with
Chief Product Officer. You report to the CPO and partner closely with them.
Chief Revenue Officer. You partner on design cohesion between marketing and product, and on how design shows up in GTM.
VP of Engineering. You collaborate on how design and engineering work together, on the design system, and on AI-assisted delivery.
Principal Designer. Our most senior individual contributor reports to you and leads product design direction across workstreams, the design direction for AI experiences, and the technical shape of HSDS.
Product Designers. A small team of experienced designers embedded in our product workstreams.
Note: This role is open to US-based applicants only.
Company values
Happy to Help
Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.
Craft over Convention
Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.
Progress not Perfection
Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.
Own the Outcome
Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.
Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.
Benefits And Perks
Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data
Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you
12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care
A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive
A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house
A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft
If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.
Hiring Guidelines:
All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.
We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.
To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.
A note on the use of AI in our interview process
While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.
On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.
Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

jobs.title: Chief Product & Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About Nira Energy
Nira's mission is to help convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free.
We are profitable!
Nira is a software platform that helps renewable energy developers find the cheapest points on the grid to connect.
We focus on estimating the cost to interconnect with the electrical grid (aka the Interconnection Process). Depending on where developers connect, they may be on the hook to pay millions of dollars to upgrade power lines, substations etc.
About The Company
Our mission is to convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free and do our part in combating climate change
The electric grid is one of the largest bottlenecks standing between us and a clean energy future. Our software helps transmission engineers plan the grid in a faster, more economic, and more reliable manner
We are the market leader in tranmission software and are currently used by >100 of the most sophisticated engineering teams in the country
We are on a path to 5x’ing our revenue as we continue to rapidly scale with both our existing customers and into new markets
We’ve been profitable since inception and have a highly unique financial profile. We aren’t subject to the traditional VC funding cycles and are anticipating material liquidity events for equity owners in the company
This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to join a company that is positioned to have a massive impact on climate change, coupled with extremely high financial upside for the leaders that help bring these products to market
About The Role
This role will sit parallel to our co-founder and Chief Transmission Officer, Andrew, who is one of the foremost transmission planners in the industry. Andrew will be responsible for high level product vision and will serve as our SME on where the industry is heading.
The CPTO will be responsible for turning that vision into a sequenced roadmap and leading the team responsible for building those products.
The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning, and our Product Managers will report to the CPTO. For context, the Transmission Planning team works hand in hand with the software engineering team to write the code needed to generate our data. The organization is currently ~17 people with 2 Product Managers, 7 Software Engineers, and 8 Transmission Planners.
Ultimately, the CPTO will be the founders technical operating partner, responsible for translating customer insights into products as we scale to $50M+ ARR.
The ideal candidate is an executive with a strong track record of building high performing teams and world class products. You’ve ideally held a prominent role at an early stage startup, i.e <50 people and $10M in revenue, and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led in that capacity. You’ve also ideally held a prominent role at at a company that has scaled, i.e. 50-250 people and >$50M in revenue and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led there as well.
What you'll own
Delivery and execution: You're the single point of accountability for how the product and engineering organization performs against its weekly, quarterly, and annual goals
Product Decisions: You’ll partner with Andrew to set the product vision / roadmap direction and will ultimately be responsible for ensuring the team is making product decisions that increase revenue and retention
People Leadership: The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning and the Product Managers will report to you. You’ll be responsible for managing their growth and performance and getting the organization to work as one smooth efficient machine.
Operating Engine: You’ll be responsible for building the systems, processes and cadences to make product delivery predictable and efficient as we scale
What we're looking for
A proven track record of building a high performing product team and executive leadership. You have led one or multiple product organizations and former reports regard you as a A+ leader that they’d join again in a heartbeat
A proven track record of building successful products. You’ve led one or many product initiatives that have delivered material customer value and can speak competently to results; i.e. Built a product from $0 to >$10M in revenue, Improve retention of a product by 30%, scaled a product from $10M to $50M etc
You are willing to be hands on and get in the weeds. This is a ~17 person org and a 30 person company. While you are ultimately in charge of managing the team we expect you to be a hands on operator and willing to roll your sleeves up
Ability and interest in learning a highly niche, complex domain fast. Transmisison planning is incredibly intricate and becoming fluent in the language of “transmission” is critical to success in the role
Low ego and mission driven. Your energized by the mission of the company and by building a team, motivating them, and partnering with world class founders
Excellent communication and people leadership skills
Ideal backgrounds
VP Product / CPO at a technical B2B SaaS company.
GM of a complex technical product line.
A product leader who has run a team or product function end to end.
A former technical or product founder who scaled into executive leadership.
Bonus points for experience in energy, grid infrastructure, climate, utilities, transmission, interconnection, or power markets, but not required

jobs.title: Director, Data Platform
jobs.text:
Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country.
Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture!
We're seeking a Director of Data Platform to provide technical and architectural leadership within the data engineering organization. In this role, you'll champion to build out modern data platform cross the data space that is critical to enable business growth with AI at scale at Credit Acceptance. As a director, you'll be responsible for leading the technical vision, strategy, architecture, and execution of modern data platform, collaborating both within the data team and outside to ensure successful deliveries in production, representing the data team in various technical forums across engineering to contribute the success at the ecosystem level. The ideal candidate brings 15+ years of engineering experience with significant depth in data technology, cloud, and AI. You'll serve as both a hands-on technical leader and a strategic advisor, helping to establish robust, scalable foundations that enable innovation across the organization.
Outcomes and Activities:
This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member.
Develop and drive the long-term vision for enterprise data platforms and architecture, ensuring alignment with business growth and AI success
Formulate and implement data platform strategy across the data space including but not limited to big data, real time, transaction/operational, governance, that transform the way how we work with data in the era of AI
Oversee the architecture, design and development of scalable data platform that enable self-serve success with various use cases across the company by taking a platform and AI first approach
Ensure solid production success that meets business need and speed, establish strong finops discipline with timely and insightful info to continuously optimize our economics including forecast, runtime and “showback” to the business
Effectively communicate data technologies, strategies, roadmap and progress to executive leadership and stakeholders, ensuring alignment with the firm’s broader vision and goals.
Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, translating them into actionable initiatives to drive innovation and maintain the firm’s market leadership.
Build strong engineering organization and foster solid engineering discipline by leading with examples and mentoring team members
Collaborate both with the data team and cross engineering on technology and architecture strategy and decision
Exemplify technical innovation and contribute to critical system design, implementation and operation success
Formulate technology and architecture decision framework that embeds engineering discipline
Become an expert in the business process domain to better support the business and align technologies with the business outcomes
Work with the engineering leadership team to develop and execute on the company’s technical and business strategy
Conduct impact analysis to proactively identify impact of a change across multiple applications/systems
Perform technical due diligence and architectural assessments of third-party technologies and solutions.
Experiment and test ideas, validate assumptions against needs, reach conclusions and recommend solutions
Document standards, best practices, and engineering artifacts so others can easily understand, build and maintain best in class software systems
Debug the critical problems which arise in production and execute effective solutions within the application and across multiple applications/systems
Lead continuous learning and process improvement activities to improve design and overall engineering practices
Grow talent by participating in hiring and mentoring team members
Competencies: The following items detail how you will be successful in this role.
Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.
Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.
One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.
Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or closely related field of study; or equivalent work experience
Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience or comparable depth of experience
Experience in the leadership role overseeing technical direction of data platform, technology and architecture
Expert knowledge of software engineering best practices with experience building modern data platform, product and solutions, especially in enabling AI success
Expert understanding and use of modern data technology end 2 end including but not limited to source system, data integration, data acquisition, data ingestion, data transformation, data aggregation, data governance, business intelligence, data warehouse, data lake, NoSQL, object storage, streaming etc.
Extensive experience with building and driving adoption of software engineering best practices
Strong understanding of AI, distributed systems, cloud computing, and microservices architectures
Demonstrated success in building strong engineering organization and attract/recruit/grow/retain talents
Demonstrated success in building mission-critical enterprise class data platform that delivers business impact
Demonstrated ability to work with business partners, cross functional team members and coach and mentor experienced team members
In-depth experience with building big data real time production system that delivers business success
Experienced in communicating and articulating technology subjects in the context of business and providing timely and clear communication
Well versed in delivery mechanisms such as Agile
Preferred:
Financial services or FinTech industry experience
Knowledge and Skills:
Architecture and Design: Ability to implement world class solutions that meet the needs of the business and customer, and help deliver growth and innovation.
Leadership: Be a thought leader and demonstrate leadership to mentor team members, influence change and drive for the business outcome
Ability to challenge the status quo and influence stakeholders to create innovative solutions
Be collaborative with other team members, seeking a diversity of thought to meet business outcomes
Ability to foster strong relationships across the organization
Bring a strong understanding of relevant and emerging technologies, provide input and coach team members and embed learning and innovation in the day-to-day
Strong experience and understanding of how to connect the work being done and how it drives business value
Ability to communicate complex technical information (both verbal and written) to all levels, including senior leadership
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Target Compensation: A competitive base salary range from $208,761 – $347,935. This position is eligible for an annual variable bonus of cash and equity, between 20-60%. Bonus amounts are based on individual performance. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications.
Candidates who reside in the following major metropolitan areas may be eligible for a premium on top of the posted range based on their specific zone: San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, New York City, Los Angeles and San Diego.
INDENGLP
#zip
Benefits
Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work
Our Company Values:
To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be:
Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions
Respectful by collaborating and actively listening
Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self-awareness and making quality decisions
Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage
Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting
To create an environment where people do their best work, we focus on the dimensions of Organizational Health. All leaders must:
Identify the Right People by recognizing top talent
Set Clear Expectations by managing change and directing others
Train team members and focus on developing talent
Performance Manage by ensuring accountability and driving results
Create the Right Environment by establishing trust and managing conflict
Maintain the Right Number of team members needed to build an effective team
Expectations:
Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines
All other duties as assigned
Attendance as required by department
Advice!
We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application!
P.S.
We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk!
Required degrees must have been earned at institutions of Higher Education which are accredited by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or equivalent.
Credit Acceptance is dedicated to providing a safe and inclusive working environment for all. As part of our Culture of Compliance, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and value our culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of the person’s age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, criminal history, or any other legally protected characteristic.
California Residents: Please click here for the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) notice regarding the personal information Credit Acceptance may collect from you.

jobs.text:
If you are currently employed at Smithfield, please log into Workday and submit your application through the Jobs Hub.
Have a seat at our table. When you join Smithfield, you become part of something special – a company that's sustainably feeding people around the world, producing good food the right way with respect for our people, animals, communities and planet. With opportunities across locations and functions, a culture grounded in our Core Four values - gratitude, communication, respect and accountability - and a strong commitment to learning, collaboration, and innovation, Smithfield offers challenging and rewarding careers where you can grow, contribute and make a real impact.
