Your contributions will be instrumental in the manufacturing of Smithfield, Eckrich, Nathan’s Famous, and other iconic brands, helping us meet the ever-evolving needs of our customers and consumers.
As Director, Engineering, you will lead and direct engineering operations across a key functional area, ensuring the efficient use of engineering resources to achieve world-class performance in our plants. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to drive strategic initiatives, resolve complex challenges, and ensure top-tier execution in everything from maintenance to capital budget management.
Your leadership will be critical in building, developing, and managing a high-performing team capable of delivering operational excellence and executing strategies that elevate the business to new heights. If you’re ready to shape the future of manufacturing and be part of an innovative, growth-driven company, Smithfield Foods is the place for you!
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
The below statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. May perform other duties as assigned.
Engineering Leadership: You'll lead engineering teams in various Engineering disciplines across plants to ensure optimal performance. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, HR, Safety, etc.) to achieve company goals. Oversee and manage Capital and Maintenance budgets and project planning. You'll also drive engineering performance to meet operational goals efficiently and cost-effectively.
Strategic Plan Development and Support: You'll create and implement short- and long-term operational plans to meet customer and quality standards. Identify and implement strategies to improve operational performance with internal and external resources. Provide clear direction on processes, schedules, and priorities for engineering teams. Develop and enforce best practices for engineering development. Ensure facilities comply with internal and external engineering standards and regulations.
Asset Utilization and Optimization: You’ll analyze asset age and utilization data and structure models on optimal replacement timing as well as methods to increase asset longevity.
Employee Development: Lead and motivate engineering teams to achieve business objectives and deliver solutions on time and on budget. Partner with HR to develop leadership programs, manage performance, and build a diverse, high-performing workforce. You'll make sure to foster a culture of workplace safety, open communication, empowerment, and recognition.
People Management: Drives a positive employee experience through leadership by way of employee development and coaching.

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university in Engineering, Business or related field and 10+ years of relevant experience in Engineering management; or equivalent combination of education and experience, required.
5+ years of experience in a position of leadership to include team development and management, required.
Prior experience in an engineer role required.
Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and SAP.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
High level of written and oral communication skills, organizational planning, teamwork, analytical reasoning, and adaptability.
Ability to communicate technical ideas to a non-technical audience effectively.
Strong interpersonal, technical and presentation skills
Ability to work well with others in fast paced, dynamic environment.
Respectful, approachable and team oriented while building strong working relationships and a positive work environment.
Energized by collaboration through travel to other locations. (50% of the time).

Knowledge of different pork products and the Meat Industry, preferred.

jobs.title: Director, Global Solutions Engineering
jobs.text:
Who are we?
At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.
We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.
We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.
At UpGuard, our Sales team continues to be the engine of our growth, moving beyond simple transactions to become trusted architects of digital resilience. In an era where third-party risk is more complex than ever, we maintain a highly collaborative, consultative culture that puts the customer’s security posture above all else.
Following a record-breaking 2025 where we shattered revenue targets and expanded our global footprint, we are entering 2026 with even greater momentum. We are seeking high-energy individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, AI-augmented sales environment. If you are hungry to sharpen your craft, possess a relentless desire to win, and want to sell a platform that is actively neutralising global cyber threats, we want to talk to you.
Why are we hiring for this role?
We're hiring a Director of Global Solutions Engineering to lead the technical engine behind our revenue organization. As a cybersecurity company, our technical credibility is central to how we win and keep customers — and this leader owns it across the customer journey. You'll run a global, two-part function as a manager of managers: Sales Engineers who drive the technical win in new business (pre-sales), and Solutions Consultants who serve as the technical escalation path for our post-sales teams. You'll report directly to the CRO.
This is a builder's role for a leader who is equally comfortable in a strategy conversation with the executive team, in a technical deep-dive with an engineer, and jumping into a live customer call to lead it when it counts. Details of the remit are below.
What will you do?
Lead a global, multi-layered team. Manage and develop distributed managers and their teams of Sales Engineers and Solutions Consultants across regions. Hire, coach, and retain top technical talent; set clear career paths; and build a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, and customer obsession.
Own the technical win in pre-sales. Lead the Sales Engineering team to drive pipeline conversion through world-class demos, proofs of concept, technical discovery, and value engineering — consistently earning the technical decision.
Own the post-sales technical escalation path. Lead the Solutions Consultants team as the technical escalation path for CSMs and the driver of technical cross-sell across our product suite. (Note: with a dedicated Professional Services team being stood up, Solutions Consultants are not expected to own customer onboarding today — though this scope may evolve.)
Stay hands-on when it counts. Be willing and able to personally jump into a high-stakes customer call and lead it — you set the technical bar by example, not just from the org chart.
Elevate RFPs and security assessments. Build a scalable, high-quality function for RFPs, security questionnaires, and technical/security assessments — improving accuracy, consistency, and turnaround, and building reusable content that raises win rates.
Enable and scale the channel. Technically enable partners — training, certification, demo readiness, and deal support — so they can independently represent and implement our product.
Partner with Enablement. Work with Sales Enablement to design and deliver technical training, certification, demo standards, and competitive playbooks that keep the team and the wider revenue org sharp.
Be the voice of the customer to Product. Capture field and technical feedback and channel it to Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.
Operate as a revenue leader. Contribute to forecasting, capacity planning, and go-to-market strategy with the CRO and revenue leadership team, and define the metrics and processes that make the function measurable and scalable.
What will you bring?
We care far more about your track record than your tenure. The bar is a leader who has built and run a world-class technical team serving technical customers with a technical product.
A demonstrated track record of building and leading a world-class Solutions/Sales Engineering team — you've raised the technical bar of an organization, not just managed headcount.
Experience selling and supporting a genuinely technical product to technical buyers and evaluators (engineers, security teams, architects). Cybersecurity or security/GRC experience is strongly preferred; adjacent deeply-technical domains considered.
Proven experience as a manager of managers leading distributed or global teams across multiple time zones.
Ownership of the technical experience across the customer journey — from the technical win in new business through post-sales technical support and cross-sell.
A hands-on disposition — you're credible and willing in the room, able to step into and lead a high-stakes customer call yourself.
A track record of building or scaling RFP / security assessment functions and lifting win rates through repeatable process and reusable content.
Experience technically enabling channel / partner ecosystems so partners can represent and implement the product independently.
A strong partnership orientation — you've worked shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Enablement.
Excellent executive communication skills; equally credible with C-level buyers and hands-on technical evaluators.
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, remote-first environment.
What's in it for you?
Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being
WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard
$1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance
Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.
18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role
Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave
Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance
Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role
Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work.
Full health and dental insurance
UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work, apply now to find out why!
As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
For applications to positions in the United States, please note, at this time we can only support hiring in the following US states: CA, MD, MA, IL, OR, WA, CO, TX, FL, PA, LA, MO, or DC.
Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks. Also please note that at this time, we cannot support candidates requiring visa sponsorship or relocation.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Clinical Data Management
jobs.text:
Company Overview
ImmunityBio, Inc. (NASDAQ: IBRX) is a commercial-stage biotechnology company developing cell and immunotherapy products that are designed to help strengthen each patient’s natural immune system, potentially enabling it to outsmart the disease and eliminate cancerous or infected cells. We envision a day when we no longer fear cancer, but can conquer it, thanks to the biological wonder that is the human immune system. Our scientists are working to develop novel therapies that harness that inherent power by amplifying both branches of the immune system, attacking cancerous or infected cells today while building immunological memory for tomorrow. The goal: to reprogram the patient’s immune system and treat the host rather than just the disease.
Why ImmunityBio?
• ImmunityBio is developing cutting-edge technology with the goal to transform the lives of patients with cancer and develop next-generation therapies and vaccines that complement, harness and amplify the immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases.
• Opportunity to join a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company with headquarters in Southern California.
• Work with a collaborative team with the ability to work across different areas of the company.
• Ability to join a growing company with professional development opportunities.
Position Summary
The Senior Director, Global Clinical Data Management will provide strategic and operational leadership for all clinical trial data management activities across the global development portfolio. This role ensures delivery of high-quality, regulatory-compliant clinical datasets to support submissions, publications, and decision-making. The Senior Director will define enterprise-wide clinical data governance strategy and ensuring consistent, high-quality data across clinical development, real-world evidence, and digital health programs.
Essential Functions
Define and execute global Clinical Data Management (CDM) strategy across Phase I–IV clinical trials
Lead end-to-end data management operations including CRF design, database build, edit check strategy, and database lock
Responsible for the oversight of the Clinical Data Management team. Lead and mentor the leadership team in the development and improvement of skills, knowledge and abilities to ensure strong succession planning and talent retention.
Responsible for indirectly leading a team of Clinical Data Management Leaders in the planning, directing, and coordinating of all Clinical Data operations across the global segment.
Own talent management processes at the leadership level.
Ensure effective quality, efficiency, and timeliness of data management projects through appropriate resource allocation and work prioritization
Establish global data standards, governance frameworks, and quality systems aligned with GCP, FDA, EMA, and ICH guidelines
Oversee clinical data vendors (CROs, FSPs, external partners) ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to quality standards
Oversee data quality, lineage, traceability, and audit readiness systems
Drive inspection readiness and regulatory audit support for clinical datasets
Lead modernization initiatives including automation, AI-enabled data review, and advanced clinical data platforms
Oversee Clinical Data Management budget planning, resource forecasting, and vendor contracts
Build and manage a high-performing Clinical Data Management team through hiring, developing, and providing performance feedback to subordinate managerial and professional talent
Collaborate within and across functional areas to evaluate, recommend, and implement process and technology improvement initiatives
Ensure compliance with GCP, SOPs, and regulatory expectations
Performs ad-hoc and cross-functional duties and/or projects assigned to support business needs and provide developmental opportunities.
Education & Experience
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in life sciences or technical discipline required
12+ years of clinical data, clinical operations, or healthcare data systems experience required
Strong enterprise data governance experience required
Experience developing and managing a team direct and indirect reports required
Experience managing a global team strongly preferred
Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities
Deep knowledge of EDC systems, CDMS platforms, SDTM/CDISC standards
Working knowledge of the clinical research, Good Clinical Practices, and regulatory requirements/guidelines
Strong regulatory inspection experience (FDA/EMA)
Strong enterprise data governance experience
Expertise in multi-study portfolio management
Ability to understand, and interpret clinical data analytics and analyze outcomes
Excellent leadership skills with the ability to build a high-performing team and lead others effectively
Excellent project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and objectives to consistently deliver to goals and timelines
Strong critical and logical thinking with ability to analyze problems, identify alternative solutions and implement recommendations for resolution
Working Environment / Physical Environment
This position works on-site or remotely depending on the candidate’s geographic location as noted in your offer letter.
Regular work schedule is Monday – Friday, within standard business hours. Flexibility is available with manager approval
This position works in an office environment and requires regular use of computer keyboards and sitting for extended periods of time
This position is eligible for a discretionary bonus and equity award. The annual base pay range for this position is below. The specific rate will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications, prior experience as well as geographic location.
National Market (all markets unless identified as Premium)
$230,000 (entry-level qualifications) to $253,000 (highly experienced) annually
Premium Market (Premium markets include Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, New York City, Chicago, & Boston)
$260,000 (entry-level qualifications) to $280,000 (highly experienced) annually
The application window is anticipated to close on 60 days from when it is posted or sooner if the position is filled or closed.
ImmunityBio uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with sourcing and identifying potential candidates for open positions. These tools help us reach qualified applicants and improve the efficiency of our recruitment outreach. No preference is given to applicants sourced or identified by AI tools.
Important: AI is not used to screen, evaluate, rank, assess, or make hiring decisions about applicants. All applications are reviewed by human recruiters and hiring managers. Hiring decisions are made solely by ImmunityBio personnel without automated decision-making.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity and ensure that all candidates are assessed based on their qualifications, skills, and experience through human review.
ImmunityBio employees are as valuable as the people we serve. We have built a resource of robust benefit offerings to best support the total wellbeing of our team members and their families. blocks.text: Company Overview

ImmunityBio, Inc. (NASDAQ: IBRX) is a commercial-stage biotechnology company developing cell and immunotherapy products that are designed to help strengthen each patient’s natural immune system, potentially enabling it to outsmart the disease and eliminate cancerous or infected cells. We envision a day when we no longer fear cancer, but can conquer it, thanks to the biological wonder that is the human immune system. Our scientists are working to develop novel therapies that harness that inherent power by amplifying both branches of the immune system, attacking cancerous or infected cells today while building immunological memory for tomorrow. The goal: to reprogram the patient’s immune system and treat the host rather than just the disease.
Why ImmunityBio?

• ImmunityBio is developing cutting-edge technology with the goal to transform the lives of patients with cancer and develop next-generation therapies and vaccines that complement, harness and amplify the immune system to defeat cancers and infectious diseases.
• Opportunity to join a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company with headquarters in Southern California.
• Work with a collaborative team with the ability to work across different areas of the company.
• Ability to join a growing company with professional development opportunities.
Position Summary

The Senior Director, Global Clinical Data Management will provide strategic and operational leadership for all clinical trial data management activities across the global development portfolio. This role ensures delivery of high-quality, regulatory-compliant clinical datasets to support submissions, publications, and decision-making. The Senior Director will define enterprise-wide clinical data governance strategy and ensuring consistent, high-quality data across clinical development, real-world evidence, and digital health programs.
Essential Functions

items: Define and execute global Clinical Data Management (CDM) strategy across Phase I–IV clinical trials
Lead end-to-end data management operations including CRF design, database build, edit check strategy, and database lock

Responsible for the oversight of the Clinical Data Management team. Lead and mentor the leadership team in the development and improvement of skills, knowledge and abilities to ensure strong succession planning and talent retention.
Responsible for indirectly leading a team of Clinical Data Management Leaders in the planning, directing, and coordinating of all Clinical Data operations across the global segment.
Own talent management processes at the leadership level.
Ensure effective quality, efficiency, and timeliness of data management projects through appropriate resource allocation and work prioritization
Establish global data standards, governance frameworks, and quality systems aligned with GCP, FDA, EMA, and ICH guidelines
Oversee clinical data vendors (CROs, FSPs, external partners) ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to quality standards
Oversee data quality, lineage, traceability, and audit readiness systems
Drive inspection readiness and regulatory audit support for clinical datasets
Lead modernization initiatives including automation, AI-enabled data review, and advanced clinical data platforms
Oversee Clinical Data Management budget planning, resource forecasting, and vendor contracts
Build and manage a high-performing Clinical Data Management team through hiring, developing, and providing performance feedback to subordinate managerial and professional talent
Collaborate within and across functional areas to evaluate, recommend, and implement process and technology improvement initiatives
Ensure compliance with GCP, SOPs, and regulatory expectations
Performs ad-hoc and cross-functional duties and/or projects assigned to support business needs and provide developmental opportunities.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
Upwave: The Brand Outcomes Measurement Platform
Upwave is a leading measurement company entirely focused on measuring and optimizing upper funnel campaigns. The world’s leading advertisers, agencies, and media partners trust Upwave’s robust, AI-driven platform to bring science to the top of the funnel.
With Upwave, marketers maximize the effectiveness of brand spend. Upwave measures Brand Lift, validates Brand Reach, and surfaces Brand Optimization opportunities in one, dynamic platform with cross-channel brand measurement for CTV, Digital, Social, Linear, Addressable, Retail Media, Streaming Audio and more.
We’re a profitable, growth-stage company backed by leading venture investors (Y Combinator, Uncork Capital, Bloomberg Beta, Initialized Capital, PivotNorth, Ridge Ventures, Industry Ventures, Conductive Ventures,) and leading AdTech founders & CEOs.
We’re a humble but ambitious team that takes its work seriously but never ourselves. Come join us.
We’re looking for a strategic and hands-on Director of Product Management to lead our product vision, strategy, and execution. This role sits at the intersection of customer needs, business objectives, and technical innovation, driving the development of products that deliver real value and measurable impact.
As a key member of the leadership team, you’ll shape the product roadmap, build and mentor a high-performing product team, and partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Customer Success to bring our product strategy to life.
What you will do:
Product Strategy & Vision
Define and drive the long-term product vision aligned with company goals and market opportunities
Translate business strategy into a clear, prioritized product roadmap
Identify new product opportunities through customer insights, data, and market trends
Customer Insight & Domain Expertise
Build a deep, experience-near understanding of customer workflows, pain points, and decision-making through regular, direct engagement (e.g., interviews, field observation, deal support)
Synthesize qualitative insights with product and market data to uncover non-obvious needs and shape high-conviction product bets
Develop and maintain deep domain expertise in adtech and brand lift, including ecosystem dynamics, buyer personas, and industry trends
Execution & Delivery
Oversee end-to-end product design and development from concept through launch and iteration
Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of product initiatives
Balance speed, quality, and innovation in a fast-paced environment
Leadership & Team Building
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing product management team
Establish clear goals, processes, and accountability across the product organization
Instill a culture of ownership, quality, and customer empathy and curiosity across the product team, ensuring decisions are grounded in real-world context—not just metrics
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Engineering and Data Science teams to deliver best-in-class B2B analytical products
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure strong product-market fit and successful go-to-market execution
Serve as the voice of the customer internally, and collaborate with marketing to define and support our Product Marketing positioning and execution
Data & Performance
Define and track key product metrics to measure success and guide decisions
Use data and experimentation to continuously improve product performance
Align product investments with business outcomes (growth, retention, revenue)
About you:
You bring 10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years in a leadership role
You have a proven track record of building and scaling successful adtech products in a growth-stage environment
You demonstrate strong strategic thinking combined with a bias toward action and execution
You have a deep understanding of product development processes and agile methodologies
You have experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and GTM teams
You bring a strong analytical mindset and use data to drive decisions
Bonus points:
Experience in ad measurement
Background in launching AI-driven or data-intensive products
Additional Information:
The annual base salary range for this role is $170,000- $205,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for the new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.
Upwave is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: VP, Technology
jobs.text:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact.
Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains.
Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable end-to-end.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
We're looking for a Technical Lead, AI & Platform to lead our engineering, ML/DS, and analytics teams while staying close to architecture and execution.
This role will lead and manage the Engineering team, ML/Data Science team, and Data Analytics team. You'll drive how we build, how we use data and AI, and how our systems scale as the company grows.
We're looking for a strong technical leader who thinks from first principles, makes clear decisions, and stays close to the technology. Someone who can step into complex problems, break them down clearly, and guide teams toward practical, scalable solutions.
You'll work closely with the CEO, Product, Sales, and Customer teams to translate real customer problems into systems, tools, and AI capabilities that drive outcomes, value to our customer and company revenue, not just features.
This is not a pure management role. It requires strong technical judgment, comfort operating across engineering and data, and the ability to lead through both direction and execution. You'll set the technical bar, strengthen how teams work together, and ensure engineering, ML, and analytics move as one cohesive capability supporting the business.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE:
Engineering, ML, and Analytics operate as a clear, structured, and high-performing unit with defined ownership and strong delivery predictability.
Technical decisions are grounded in first-principles thinking, scalable architecture, and long-term product clarity.
AI and data capabilities are consistently deployed into production and directly tied to measurable business impact.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN:
Engineering Leadership & Architecture
Drive technical direction across platform, infrastructure, and product systems
Define scalable architecture and ensure reliability, performance, and security
Improve engineering velocity, code quality, and delivery discipline
Strengthen documentation, ownership, and system clarity
Mentor tech team: Engineering, ML, Analytics
AI, Data Science & Analytics Strategy
Define how AI and data drive competitive advantage in our product
Ensure ML models move from experimentation into production environmentsStrengthen MLOps, data pipelines, and real-time data systems
Align analytics insights with product and customer decision-making
Ensure AI investments translate into real outcomes, not just experiments
Product & Business Alignment
Partner closely with Product to shape technical roadmap
Work with Sales and Customer teams to understand enterprise requirements
Guide solution design for complex customer use cases
Ensure engineering effort maps directly to business impact
Team, Culture & Organizational Development
Lead and develop Engineering, ML/Data Science, and Analytics teams
Hire strong senior talent and raise the technical bar
Create clarity in roles, responsibilities, and technical ownership
Reduce single-point dependency across critical systems
Build a culture of accountability, curiosity, and effectiveness
Hands-On Technical Leadership
Stay close to architecture and key system decisions
Review critical designs and technical proposals
Step into complex technical problems when neededPrototype or validate high-impact ideas
Lead by example in technical depth and problem solving
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
Experience:
10+ years in software engineering, data, or ML environments
Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience leading technical teams in a startup or product-driven B2B SaaS company
Track record building and scaling production AI/ML systems
Experience with distributed systems, real-time data, and cloud infrastructure
Background in logistics or supply chain industry, or data-heavy SaaS is a strong plus
Previous experience working in enterprises/fortune 500 is a plus
Technical Depth
Strong backend and system architecture expertise
Experience deploying ML/AI systems into production, not just research
Deep understanding of MLOps, data platforms, and model lifecycle management
Comfortable operating across engineering, data science, and analytics domains
Leadership & Culture
First-principles thinker who breaks down complex problems clearly
High ownership and accountability
Builder mindset with strong technical judgment
Clear communicator across technical and business teams
Focused on effectiveness and real outcomes
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:
Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe,built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious.
Tech-first team: You'll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problem using technology.
Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning the web app from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains and you'll be a major part of our story.
Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You'll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward.
Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do:
Curiosity: We stay hungry to learn and explore.
Ownership: We act like founders and take responsibility.
Raising the bar: We aim higher, never settling for good enough.
Effective: We focus on impact and outcomes that matter.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data & Information Architecture
jobs.text:
Who we are
REGENXBIO is an exceptional place to work. You'll have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the best and the brightest people, touch amazing science, and be a part of extraordinary plans. Our core values: Trust, Accountability, Perseverance, and Innovation drive everything we do. We aim to bring these values to life every day with all that we do, and we believe that what we do matters - to patients, to their families, and to their communities.
The opportunity:
As Associate Director, Data & Information Architecture, you’ll be responsible for designing and executing the enterprise data architecture strategy that enables REGENXBIO’s commercial growth. Working closely with business & IT leadership, you’ll build and lead a secure, scalable commercial data warehouse; integrate internal and third-party data; establish master and reference data standards; and partner across Commercial, Medical, Legal, and IT to deliver trusted analytics with clear lineage, quality, and privacy controls. This is a “build and scale” role focused on enabling growth: ensuring systems and data support the next phase of the business.
What you'll be doing:
Oversee data pipelines and system-to-system data flows ensuring reliable and scalable infrastructure.
Help define and maintain the target commercial data architecture for sales, CRM, payer, patient-support, and claims-linked analytics.
Own the ERP (Oracle Cloud) data model and become an expert on ERP Business Process functions including but not limited to Procurement, Planning, Inventory, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing; be able to extract and integrated data from those functions.
Identify the company’s internal and external data sources, lead the design and operation of a data warehouse and its landing, harmonized, conformed, and semantic layers.
Serve as design authority for commercial-data initiatives and chair architectural review, model review, and commercial-data governance forums.
Translate commercial priorities into quarterly roadmaps, objectives and key results, release plans, and measurable business outcomes.
Collaborate with others on the team and with Business stakeholders in gathering requirements, designing systems, and demonstrating and reviewing databases. Establish scalable processes for system governance, data integrity, and ongoing optimization
Document designs and database architecture, adhere to Change Management and Validation processes, use source code control repositories (ie; Git), conduct code reviews, eventually implement continuous integration and design with constant attention on security and keeping applications safe from penetrable threats.
Determine the requirements for new databases occasionally create and publish reports.
Audit database regularly to maintain quality
It is imperative that REGENXBIO employees embody our core values by working collaboratively, building strong relationships, and using clear communication to meet shared objectives.
What we're looking for:
We set our employees up for success. To be successful in this role and help us achieve our goals, we are looking for someone with the following skills and qualifications:
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, CIS, Mathematics, Life Science or equivalent required.
Minimum of 12 years of database architecture/engineering or Enterprise Data experience ideally in Oracle, SQL Server or equivalent.
Deep experience designing and operating enterprise data warehouses and dimensional models for analytics.
Strong command of SQL, data modeling, ELT/ETL design, orchestration, metadata, and business intelligence semantic modeling.
Hands-on experience integrating multiple commercial-data domains, including some combination of CRM/sales, marketing, payer, patient-support, specialty pharmacy, and claims data.
Strong understanding of the operation of an ERP system.
Exposure to or participation in Agile/Scrum and traditional waterfall SDLC experience.
Outstanding interpersonal skills, a can-do and team player attitude, excellent, clear written and verbal communication skills, and keen attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively in a high demand, fast-paced, and evolving environment, work on multiple projects at a time.
Why should you apply?
By joining REGENXBIO, you'll have the opportunity to be part of a growing company with an incredible team that is passionate about developing novel AAV gene therapies for patients in need.
We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefit & compensation package which includes market-competitive salaries, an annual bonus program, education assistance, retirement plan with employer match, stock options at all levels, summer hours and more! Additionally, professional development is important to us. By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to be exposed to challenging projects and have access to development resources to help you grow personally and professionally.

As Associate Director, Data & Information Architecture, you’ll be responsible for designing and executing the enterprise data architecture strategy that enables REGENXBIO’s commercial growth. Working closely with business & IT leadership, you’ll build and lead a secure, scalable commercial data warehouse; integrate internal and third-party data; establish master and reference data standards; and partner across Commercial, Medical, Legal, and IT to deliver trusted analytics with clear lineage, quality, and privacy controls. This is a “build and scale” role focused on enabling growth: ensuring systems and data support the next phase of the business.
What you'll be doing:

items: Oversee data pipelines and system-to-system data flows ensuring reliable and scalable infrastructure.
Help define and maintain the target commercial data architecture for sales, CRM, payer, patient-support, and claims-linked analytics.

Own the ERP (Oracle Cloud) data model and become an expert on ERP Business Process functions including but not limited to Procurement, Planning, Inventory, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing; be able to extract and integrated data from those functions.
Identify the company’s internal and external data sources, lead the design and operation of a data warehouse and its landing, harmonized, conformed, and semantic layers.
Serve as design authority for commercial-data initiatives and chair architectural review, model review, and commercial-data governance forums.
Translate commercial priorities into quarterly roadmaps, objectives and key results, release plans, and measurable business outcomes.

Collaborate with others on the team and with Business stakeholders in gathering requirements, designing systems, and demonstrating and reviewing databases. Establish scalable processes for system governance, data integrity, and ongoing optimization

Document designs and database architecture, adhere to Change Management and Validation processes, use source code control repositories (ie; Git), conduct code reviews, eventually implement continuous integration and design with constant attention on security and keeping applications safe from penetrable threats.
Determine the requirements for new databases occasionally create and publish reports.
Audit database regularly to maintain quality
It is imperative that REGENXBIO employees embody our core values by working collaboratively, building strong relationships, and using clear communication to meet shared objectives.

blocks.text: What we're looking for:
We set our employees up for success. To be successful in this role and help us achieve our goals, we are looking for someone with the following skills and qualifications:

items: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, CIS, Mathematics, Life Science or equivalent required.
Minimum of 12 years of database architecture/engineering or Enterprise Data experience ideally in Oracle, SQL Server or equivalent.
Deep experience designing and operating enterprise data warehouses and dimensional models for analytics.
Strong command of SQL, data modeling, ELT/ETL design, orchestration, metadata, and business intelligence semantic modeling.
Hands-on experience integrating multiple commercial-data domains, including some combination of CRM/sales, marketing, payer, patient-support, specialty pharmacy, and claims data.
Strong understanding of the operation of an ERP system.
Exposure to or participation in Agile/Scrum and traditional waterfall SDLC experience.
Outstanding interpersonal skills, a can-do and team player attitude, excellent, clear written and verbal communication skills, and keen attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively in a high demand, fast-paced, and evolving environment, work on multiple projects at a time.

blocks.text: Why should you apply?
By joining REGENXBIO, you'll have the opportunity to be part of a growing company with an incredible team that is passionate about developing novel AAV gene therapies for patients in need.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefit & compensation package which includes market-competitive salaries, an annual bonus program, education assistance, retirement plan with employer match, stock options at all levels, summer hours and more! Additionally, professional development is important to us. By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to be exposed to challenging projects and have access to development resources to help you grow personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Director, Product Growth
jobs.text:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.
We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.
This position is for an existing vacancy.
Roofr is looking for a Director, Product Growth to own how we grow through the product. You’ll work at the intersection of product, data, and go-to-market: designing the activation and expansion paths that keep contractors engaged, surfacing product signals that unlock sales conversations, and building a stronger self-serve experience anchored in friction-less SMB UI/UX. You’ll report to the CPO, sit on the product leadership team, and lead a cross-functional Growth team that includes Engineering, Design, Data Science, and a Principal PM as your direct report.
Initial building blocks are already in place. We have a clear activation metric that guides both our self-serve and sales-assist motion, a hybrid model that is actively evolving, and an AI product line in AI Receptionist that is ready to scale. The job is to take what’s working, sharpen it, and build on top of it.
What You’ll be measured on
Software adoption across the subscriber base
Orchestration of the hybrid motion
Self-serve revenue growth, shared with the GM of Measurements
What You’ll get to do
Orchestrate the hybrid motion with Sales: Identify the product signals that indicate a contractor is ready for a sales conversation and build the playbooks that turn those signals into pipeline, across both new subscriber acquisition and expansion of the existing base
Drive activation and expansion: Own the in-product experience that gets new contractors to value fast and design the expansion loops that drive deeper adoption and multi-product retention across the customer base
Grow self-serve revenue: Own the self-serve motion across transactional and subscription products, with particular focus on Measure+ and in-product upgrade paths
Lead the team and the metrics: Lead the Growth team, including Engineering, Design, and Data Science, build a fast experimentation culture, and own the growth metrics that matter to leadership
What You’ll bring to the role
8 to 12+ years of product growth experience in B2B SaaS; vertical SaaS is a strong plus
Real experience building a hybrid product-led and sales-led motion. You have felt the friction of making these work together, not just read about it
Strong activation and expansion instincts. You know how to design user journeys that drive measurable improvement in time-to-value and long-term retention
Experience working across both transactional and subscription revenue models
Comfortable running experiments end to end: designing them, setting success criteria, and shipping without waiting for perfect conditions
Fluent in growth metrics like activation rate, adoption, expansion revenue, and NRR. You run your own analysis
Experience with tools like Amplitude, HubSpot, and Snowflake or a comparable data warehouse
Experience building or scaling an AI-powered product is a meaningful differentiator
Able to lead and develop cross-functional teams in an environment where everyone doesn’t work for you. You work alongside your team, not just above it
Clear communicator at every level, from executive to analyst
Based in the US or Canada
Compensation Band: $250,000.00 - $300,000.00 USD
Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.
What we offer (US + Canada)
When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:
️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:
1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
Flexible time off
80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
RRSP/401k match
Generous Parental Leave policy
Perks:
We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
Home office setup stipend
Internet and phone allowance
Remote first culture
Weekly Friday paydays!
AI Notice
At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.
Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users ). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.
And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️
⚠️ Important Notice
We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.
To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers.
If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com.
Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!
Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

jobs.title: Director, Capacity Planning & Engineering
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox is looking for a Director of Capacity Planning & Engineering to lead the team responsible for translating platform demand into physical infrastructure reality — from supply-demand modeling and hardware procurement through data center deployment and FinOps. This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of infrastructure strategy, operational execution, and software engineering.
You will lead a team of approximately 20 people organized across four functional areas and will be responsible for scaling Roblox's infrastructure footprint as it continues to grow rapidly.
What You'll Own
Capacity Planning
Translate platform demand forecasts into hardware requirements
Own the supply-demand matching process end-to-end, working closely with Data Center, Hardware Engineering, and Supply Chain teams
Build and refine capacity models that give the business confidence in infrastructure availability months ahead
Deployment & Delivery
Oversee hardware lifecycle from procurement through physical installation and software provisioning.
Partner with platform and data center operations teams to bring new capacity online reliably and on schedule.
Own delivery execution for major milestones including new data center buildout (Q4).
Data Center Automation (Software Engineering)
Lead a software engineering sub-team that builds and maintains DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure Management) systems.
Drive automation for rack delivery, decommissioning, and capacity planning tooling.
Identify opportunities to scale automation coverage as Roblox's 25+ global data centers expand.
FinOps
Oversee cloud spend optimization and on-prem vs. cloud allocation decisions.
Grow and develop the FinOps function, which is lean today but increasing in strategic importance as cloud spend scales.
Partner with Finance to ensure infrastructure spend is visible, justified, and optimized.
You Have:
10+ years of experience in infrastructure, data center operations, or related fields, with at least 3 years in a director-level or senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in capacity planning and supply-demand analysis for large-scale infrastructure environments.
Hands-on familiarity with DCIM systems and data center automation — this role is lower in the stack than platform software (not Kubernetes/cloud-native).
Experience working across supply chain systems, hardware procurement, and deployment execution.
Proven ability to lead and scale cross-functional teams including software engineers, planners, and operations specialists.
Strong analytical and communication skills; comfortable translating complex infrastructure decisions for C-suite audiences.
Familiarity with AI/GPU infrastructure - Roblox is actively building GPU factory capacity aligned with NVIDIA's next-generation hardware roadmap.
Experience managing a FinOps function or cloud cost optimization at scale.
Background in hyperscale, colocation, or edge data center environments.
Exposure to liquid cooling infrastructure for high-density compute.
You Will
Own a critical piece of infrastructure for a platform used by hundreds of millions of people worldwide.
Scale the team to support ongoing growth and new product features.
Drive improvements in partnership with other engineering teams across Roblox
Create a culture and practice of production excellence, security, and cost-efficiency
Hire and develop senior engineers, managers, and leaders
You are:
Collaborative, low-ego environment where candid feedback is welcomed and acted on.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$399,420—$457,970 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Chef de l'ingénierie | Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
ABOUT VALPAY
Founded in 2022, ValPay is an all-in-one payment solution tailored to empower its partners' software platforms. Designed for ambitious business owners wanting to focus on growing their business rather than the logistics needed to run it, ValPay helps companies prevent fraud, gain access to real-time reporting, and accept both online and in-person payments. ValPay's PayFac-as-a-Service model gives its partners all the benefits of integrated payments while handling the heavy lifting.
ValPay is a subsidiary of Valsoft.
THE ROLE
As Head of Engineering, you will own the engineering organization at ValPay — how it is structured, how it delivers, and how good it gets. You will report to the CEO and work alongside product and go-to-market leadership to turn a talented, lean team into a predictable, high-performing engineering function.
This is a build role, not a caretaker role. ValPay's engineering team has grown quickly and now needs someone to put real operating discipline behind it: a delivery rhythm people can count on, a management layer that holds, and technical standards that let the platform scale with the business — without losing the speed and hands-on energy that got ValPay here.
We are hiring for trajectory. This role is scoped as Head of Engineering today, and it is designed as the potential path to Chief Technology Officer at ValPay. We would rather hire someone with the ceiling to grow into that seat and back them properly than hire the title and hope. What earns the step up is straightforward: a delivery organization that runs without heroics, a leadership bench you built, and a track record of technical judgment the CEO and the board can lean on.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Own engineering delivery end to end — planning, execution, release cadence, and quality — and make it predictable enough that the business can plan around it.
Build and lead the engineering management layer: hire, develop, and coach engineering managers, tech leads, and senior/staff engineers, and put a durable structure beneath you.
Partner with Product on roadmap feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Product sets the what; you own the how and the when.
Set and enforce technical standards across the platform — architecture, code quality, testing, observability, and documentation — so the system scales as GMV and merchant count grow.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for integrations with core payments partners (Adyen, Fiserv), working complex issues to resolution and feeding what you learn back into the platform.
Drive AI adoption inside engineering — in the SDLC, in developer productivity, and in the product where it measurably improves outcomes.
Own engineering operations and reliability: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and the SLAs a PCI DSS Level 1 payments platform has to hold.
Partner with security and compliance to keep PCI DSS certification and multi-jurisdiction obligations met as the platform expands.
Be a steady presence under pressure, and build the organizational muscle for the team to handle incidents increasingly without you.
WHAT YOU BRING
8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading engineering teams, with at least some of that time managing managers or tech leads.
Proven experience building, structuring, and scaling technology organizations, ideally in high-growth environments.
Experience hiring and developing engineering leaders, and the appetite to keep doing it.

À PROPOS DE VALPAY
Fondée en 2022, ValPay est une solution de paiement tout-en-un conçue pour outiller les plateformes logicielles de ses partenaires. Pensée pour les entrepreneurs ambitieux qui souhaitent se consacrer à la croissance de leur entreprise plutôt qu'à la logistique nécessaire à son exploitation, ValPay aide les entreprises à prévenir la fraude, à accéder à des rapports en temps réel et à accepter les paiements en ligne comme en personne. Le modèle de facilitation des paiements en tant que service (PayFac-as-a-Service) de ValPay procure à ses partenaires tous les avantages des paiements intégrés, tout en prenant en charge le gros du travail.
ValPay est une filiale de Valsoft.
LE POSTE
À titre de chef de l'ingénierie, vous prendrez en charge l'organisation d'ingénierie de ValPay : sa structure, sa capacité de livraison et son niveau d'excellence. Vous relèverez du chef de la direction et travaillerez aux côtés des responsables du produit et de la mise en marché afin de transformer une équipe talentueuse et restreinte en une fonction d'ingénierie prévisible et très performante.
Il s'agit d'un rôle de bâtisseur, et non de gestionnaire de statu quo. L'équipe d'ingénierie de ValPay a connu une croissance rapide et a maintenant besoin d'une personne capable d'y instaurer une véritable discipline opérationnelle : une cadence de livraison fiable, une couche de gestion solide et des normes techniques permettant à la plateforme d'évoluer au rythme de l'entreprise — sans perdre la rapidité et l'énergie concrète qui ont mené ValPay jusqu'ici.
Nous recrutons pour le potentiel. Ce poste est défini aujourd'hui comme celui de chef de l'ingénierie, et il est conçu comme la voie d'accès possible au poste de chef de la technologie (CTO) chez ValPay. Nous préférons embaucher une personne ayant la capacité de croître vers ce rôle et l'appuyer pleinement, plutôt que d'embaucher un titre en espérant que cela fonctionne. Les conditions de cette progression sont claires : une organisation de livraison qui fonctionne sans héroïsme, un banc de leaders que vous aurez bâti, et un jugement technique sur lequel la direction et le conseil peuvent s'appuyer.
CE QUE VOUS FEREZ
Assumer la livraison en ingénierie de bout en bout — planification, exécution, cadence de mise en production et qualité — et la rendre suffisamment prévisible pour que l'entreprise puisse planifier en conséquence.
Bâtir et diriger la couche de gestion en ingénierie : embaucher, développer et encadrer des gestionnaires de l'ingénierie, des chefs techniques et des ingénieurs seniors ou principaux, et mettre en place une structure durable sous votre responsabilité.
Collaborer avec le Produit sur la faisabilité, le séquencement et les compromis de la feuille de route. Le Produit définit le quoi; vous êtes responsable du comment et du quand.
Définir et faire respecter les normes techniques de la plateforme — architecture, qualité du code, tests, observabilité et documentation — afin que le système évolue avec la croissance du volume de paiements et du nombre de marchands.
Agir comme point d'escalade technique senior pour les intégrations avec les principaux partenaires de paiement (Adyen, Fiserv), en menant les enjeux complexes jusqu'à leur résolution et en réinjectant les apprentissages dans la plateforme.
Piloter l'adoption de l'IA au sein de l'ingénierie — dans le cycle de développement, dans la productivité des développeurs et dans le produit lorsque les bénéfices sont mesurables.
Assumer les opérations d'ingénierie et la fiabilité : garde, réponse aux incidents, post-mortems et niveaux de service qu'exige une plateforme de paiement certifiée PCI DSS de niveau 1.
Collaborer avec les équipes de sécurité et de conformité afin de maintenir la certification PCI DSS et les obligations multijuridictionnelles à mesure que la plateforme s'étend.
Demeurer une présence stable sous pression et développer la capacité organisationnelle permettant à l'équipe de gérer les incidents de plus en plus sans vous.
CE QUE VOUS APPORTEZ
Au moins 8 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, dont 4 ans ou plus à diriger des équipes d'ingénierie, incluant une période de gestion de gestionnaires ou de chefs techniques.
Expérience démontrée dans la création, la structuration et la mise à l'échelle d'organisations technologiques, idéalement dans des environnements à forte croissance.
Expérience d'embauche et de développement de leaders en ingénierie, et le désir de continuer à le faire.
Vous conservez une profondeur technique concrète et applicable : vous révisez l'architecture, vous pouvez approfondir une revue de conception ou un incident, et les ingénieurs respectent votre jugement. L'écriture de code en production au quotidien n'est pas attendue.
Un jugement solide sur les décisions de type « développer ou acheter », sur la dette technique et sur l'allocation de la capacité d'ingénierie — et la capacité d'expliquer ces choix en termes d'affaires à une équipe de direction non technique.
Un historique démontré d'implantation de processus de livraison dans une équipe qui avance vite, sans en freiner la rapidité : cadence de planification, discipline de mise en production, garde, et les indicateurs permettant d'en mesurer l'efficacité.
Une ambition et un potentiel démontrables. Vous visez éventuellement le poste de chef de la technologie et vous pouvez démontrer ce que vous faites pour vous y préparer.
ATOUTS RECHERCHÉS
Expérience dans les paiements, en technologie financière ou dans d'autres environnements réglementés à haute disponibilité (PCI DSS, SOC 2 ou équivalent).
Expérience dans un environnement à forte croissance ou détenu par un fonds d'investissement privé, ou en intégration d'équipes d'ingénierie issues d'acquisitions.
Expérience des architectures de plateforme multilocataire ou de produits axés sur les API.
CE À QUOI RESSEMBLE LA RÉUSSITE
Au cours des six à douze premiers mois :
Une couche de gestion est en place : des gestionnaires de l'ingénierie ou des chefs techniques responsables de leurs domaines, avec un périmètre et une imputabilité clairs.
L'ingénierie fonctionne selon une cadence de livraison sur laquelle l'entreprise peut planifier : les engagements sont pris et tenus, et les écarts sont visibles tôt plutôt qu'à l'échéance.
La livraison et la fiabilité sont mesurées, et non ressenties : des indicateurs de référence existent pour le débit, le délai de livraison, le taux d'échec des changements et la réponse aux incidents, et ils évoluent dans la bonne direction.
L'IA est utilisée concrètement au sein de l'ingénierie, avec des cas d'utilisation en production plutôt que des projets pilotes.
La garde et la réponse aux incidents sont définies et exercées, et les incidents se règlent de plus en plus sans votre présence.
Les normes techniques et l'orientation architecturale sont documentées, acceptées et réellement appliquées.
POURQUOI VALPAY
Fondée en 2022, ValPay fonctionne déjà à grande échelle : une plateforme certifiée PCI DSS de niveau 1, déployée dans plus de 40 territoires en Amérique du Nord, en Europe et en Asie-Pacifique, au service de plateformes logicielles verticales en dentisterie, en nautisme, en gestion immobilière, en automobile et ailleurs.
La croissance repose sur trois moteurs, qui s'appuient tous sur la même plateforme :
Ventes internes — convertir le volume de paiements (GMV) existant de Valsoft vers ValPay, une occasion de plus de 15 G$ dans la clientèle actuelle, à laquelle s'ajoute chaque nouvelle acquisition de Valsoft.
Canal des ISV externes — signer des ISV à l'extérieur du portefeuille de Valsoft, pour des revenus de 25 M$ à 50 M$, avec plus de 2 G$ d'ententes déjà conclues, maintenant converties en marchands actifs qui traitent des transactions.
Moteur d'acquisitions — acquérir des entreprises de passerelles de paiement : deux transactions conclues à ce jour, le même plan de conversion étant appliqué à chaque actif acquis.
Offrir des paiements intégrés au sein d'un portefeuille de plus de 150 sociétés de logiciels verticaux représente un réseau de distribution que la plupart des entreprises de paiement mettent des années à bâtir. ValPay le possède déjà. Ce qui déterminera la vitesse de ces trois moteurs, c'est l'organisation d'ingénierie qui les soutient — et c'est là le mandat de ce poste.
ValPay est soutenue par Valsoft, qui acquiert et conserve ses entreprises indéfiniment plutôt que de les revendre. Vous bâtissez sur un horizon long, et non en vue d'une sortie.
Pour en savoir plus : https://www.valpay.com/

Designed for ambitious business owners wanting to focus on growing their business rather than the logistics needed to run it, ValPay helps companies prevent fraud, gain access to real-time reporting, and accept both online and in-person payments. ValPay's PayFac-as-a-Service model gives its partners all the benefits of integrated payments while handling the heavy lifting.
ValPay is a subsidiary of Valsoft.
THE ROLE

As Head of Engineering, you will own the engineering organization at ValPay — how it is structured, how it delivers, and how good it gets. You will report to the CEO and work alongside product and go-to-market leadership to turn a talented, lean team into a predictable, high-performing engineering function.

This is a build role, not a caretaker role. ValPay's engineering team has grown quickly and now needs someone to put real operating discipline behind it: a delivery rhythm people can count on, a management layer that holds, and technical standards that let the platform scale with the business — without losing the speed and hands-on energy that got ValPay here.

We are hiring for trajectory. This role is scoped as Head of Engineering today, and it is designed as the potential path to Chief Technology Officer at ValPay. We would rather hire someone with the ceiling to grow into that seat and back them properly than hire the title and hope. What earns the step up is straightforward: a delivery organization that runs without heroics, a leadership bench you built, and a track record of technical judgment the CEO and the board can lean on.

Partner with Product on roadmap feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Product sets the what; you own the how and the when.
Set and enforce technical standards across the platform — architecture, code quality, testing, observability, and documentation — so the system scales as GMV and merchant count grow.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for integrations with core payments partners (Adyen, Fiserv), working complex issues to resolution and feeding what you learn back into the platform.
Drive AI adoption inside engineering — in the SDLC, in developer productivity, and in the product where it measurably improves outcomes.
Own engineering operations and reliability: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and the SLAs a PCI DSS Level 1 payments platform has to hold.
Partner with security and compliance to keep PCI DSS certification and multi-jurisdiction obligations met as the platform expands.
Be a steady presence under pressure, and build the organizational muscle for the team to handle incidents increasingly without you.

jobs.title: 4651-Associate Director - Implementation Engineering Operations
jobs.text:
About The Role:
This is a strategy-and-operations role, not a reporting role. The Associate Director, Delivery Operations sets the big-picture direction for how delivery runs — building the processes, models, and cadences that Implementation Engineering leadership and other delivery owners use day to day. The role facilitates and enables; it doesn't own the accountable outcomes itself, and it doesn't own report production — it owns making sure the right communication reaches the right stakeholders.
A Day in the Life:
• Work with Implementation Engineering leadership to ensure every active implementation has a live, credible milestone plan and forecast, and set the standard for how forecast accuracy (planned vs. actual) is tracked.
• Ensure account health ratings are backed by real, current evidence — usage, milestones, escalations, customer sentiment — rather than optimism or stale data.
• Build and maintain capacity models that map delivery demand against available resources by role, skill, and geography; run scenario planning (lean / balanced / high-touch) to inform hiring and staffing decisions; flag capacity risk early.
• Ensure a working change-control process exists for scope expansion on active accounts, with every change documented with rationale and impact.
• Define go-live readiness criteria together with Implementation Engineering leadership and ensure they're applied consistently; own the escalation path when readiness is contested.
• Ensure cost-to-serve is tracked at the account and portfolio level and that the numbers reconcile, partnering with Finance.
• Ensure every red or at-risk account has a real recovery plan with named owners and dates, built jointly with Implementation Engineering leadership rather than assembled after the fact.
• Ensure customer-owned and Innovaccer-owned dependencies are clearly and honestly separated in account plans, so blockers aren't hidden behind ambiguous ownership.
• Identify manual, repetitive delivery workflows that are candidates for automation or agentification, and partner with Engineering / Implementation Automation to design, pilot, and scale AI agents that reduce manual effort — tracking adoption and impact against a stated business case.
• Ensure leadership always has a real-time, trusted view of delivery health, capacity, and risk by directing what needs to be communicated and to whom — facilitating leadership reviews and driving decisions, not just relaying status.
• Partner with Legal, Security, and Finance on delivery-related risk areas such as contractual SOW commitments and data governance obligations.
What You Need
• 8–12 years of experience in delivery operations, implementation management, program/PMO, or business operations within B2B SaaS or enterprise software, ideally in a technical delivery environment.
• Demonstrated experience building and running capacity models, resource plans, or staffing scenarios tied to demand forecasts.
• Hands-on experience identifying and driving automation or AI-agent adoption in operational workflows — not just conceptual familiarity.
• Strong analytical skills — comfortable in Excel/Sheets, SQL, or BI tools to interpret delivery data and dashboards and translate them into decisions.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across Implementation Engineering, Engineering, Product, Finance, Customer Success, and C-Suite.
• Strong business acumen and judgment to prioritize, structure ambiguous problems, and drive them to closure independently, with low tolerance for unverified numbers or assumptions presented as fact.
• MBA from a premier B-school (IIM, ISB, or equivalent) preferred.

blocks.text: About The Role:

This is a strategy-and-operations role, not a reporting role. The Associate Director, Delivery Operations sets the big-picture direction for how delivery runs — building the processes, models, and cadences that Implementation Engineering leadership and other delivery owners use day to day. The role facilitates and enables; it doesn't own the accountable outcomes itself, and it doesn't own report production — it owns making sure the right communication reaches the right stakeholders.
A Day in the Life:

• Work with Implementation Engineering leadership to ensure every active implementation has a live, credible milestone plan and forecast, and set the standard for how forecast accuracy (planned vs. actual) is tracked.
• Ensure account health ratings are backed by real, current evidence — usage, milestones, escalations, customer sentiment — rather than optimism or stale data.

• Build and maintain capacity models that map delivery demand against available resources by role, skill, and geography; run scenario planning (lean / balanced / high-touch) to inform hiring and staffing decisions; flag capacity risk early.
• Ensure a working change-control process exists for scope expansion on active accounts, with every change documented with rationale and impact.
• Define go-live readiness criteria together with Implementation Engineering leadership and ensure they're applied consistently; own the escalation path when readiness is contested.
• Ensure cost-to-serve is tracked at the account and portfolio level and that the numbers reconcile, partnering with Finance.
• Ensure every red or at-risk account has a real recovery plan with named owners and dates, built jointly with Implementation Engineering leadership rather than assembled after the fact.
• Ensure customer-owned and Innovaccer-owned dependencies are clearly and honestly separated in account plans, so blockers aren't hidden behind ambiguous ownership.

• Identify manual, repetitive delivery workflows that are candidates for automation or agentification, and partner with Engineering / Implementation Automation to design, pilot, and scale AI agents that reduce manual effort — tracking adoption and impact against a stated business case.

• Ensure leadership always has a real-time, trusted view of delivery health, capacity, and risk by directing what needs to be communicated and to whom — facilitating leadership reviews and driving decisions, not just relaying status.
• Partner with Legal, Security, and Finance on delivery-related risk areas such as contractual SOW commitments and data governance obligations.
What You Need
• 8–12 years of experience in delivery operations, implementation management, program/PMO, or business operations within B2B SaaS or enterprise software, ideally in a technical delivery environment.
• Demonstrated experience building and running capacity models, resource plans, or staffing scenarios tied to demand forecasts.
• Hands-on experience identifying and driving automation or AI-agent adoption in operational workflows — not just conceptual familiarity.
• Strong analytical skills — comfortable in Excel/Sheets, SQL, or BI tools to interpret delivery data and dashboards and translate them into decisions.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across Implementation Engineering, Engineering, Product, Finance, Customer Success, and C-Suite.
• Strong business acumen and judgment to prioritize, structure ambiguous problems, and drive them to closure independently, with low tolerance for unverified numbers or assumptions presented as fact.
• MBA from a premier B-school (IIM, ISB, or equivalent) preferred.

Job Description
We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. What you will do in this role
In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.
Sector Knowledge and Expertise:
Demonstrates a clear understanding of client’s business, its objectives, strategy and industry where they operate. Supports the Portfolio Leader in the development of portfolio/sector strategy.
