jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Job Description:
Compensation & Role Details:
Expected Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is between $160,000 – $175,000 CAD/USD , depending on experience and qualifications
Role Type: New Role
AI Disclosure: AI may be used during the hiring process.
Technology Strategy
Develop and execute Company's long-term technology roadmap aligned with business strategy.
Lead modernization of the platform, including cloud architecture, scalability, performance, and security.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend investments that improve competitive advantage.
Establish technology standards, governance, and engineering best practices.
Engineering Leadership
Lead and mentor Software Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Architecture teams.
Build a high-performing engineering culture focused on accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and innovation.
Recruit, develop, and retain top technical talent.
Establish KPIs to improve engineering effectiveness, quality, and delivery.
Product Innovation
Partner with Product Management to define technical direction for future products.
Drive delivery of scalable SaaS solutions.
Champion customer-focused innovation.
Balance technical debt reduction with new product development.
Artificial Intelligence & Automation
Develop the organization's AI strategy.
Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities throughout the Company platform.
Evaluate and govern the use of technologies such as:
Azure OpenAI
Microsoft Copilot
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Intelligent automation
Predictive analytics
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with customer needs.
Infrastructure, Security & Operations
Ensure platform reliability, uptime, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Oversee cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices.
Maintain cybersecurity standards and compliance.
Implement monitoring, observability, and incident response processes.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner with:
Product Management
Professional Services
Customer Success
Sales
Executive Leadership
to ensure technology investments align with strategic priorities.
Participate in customer meetings, executive presentations, and strategic planning.
Operational Excellence
Improve software delivery speed while maintaining quality.
Reduce technical debt through disciplined modernization.
Establish engineering metrics including:
Deployment Frequency
Lead Time
Change Failure Rate
Platform Availability
Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR)
Customer Defect Rates
Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
5+ years of progressive software engineering experience.
3+ years leading engineering organizations.
Proven experience delivering enterprise SaaS platforms.
Experience leading cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of:
Microsoft Azure
Cloud architecture
APIs
Microservices
CI/CD
DevOps
Security
Scalable system design
Experience managing engineering budgets and technology roadmaps.
Strong executive communication and leadership skills.
Preferred
Experience within ERP, logistics, transportation, moving & storage, or field service software.
Experience integrating AI and machine learning into commercial software products.
Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and modern AI development frameworks.
Experience working within a private equity or software portfolio environment.
MBA or Master's degree is considered an asset.
Leadership Competencies
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Strategic thinking and business acumen
Technical depth with executive-level leadership
Customer-first decision making
Strong organizational and change leadership
Excellent coaching and mentoring abilities
Data-driven decision making
Ownership and accountability
Continuous improvement mindset
Success Measures (First 12 Months)
The successful CTO will:
Establish a multi-year technology roadmap aligned with company strategy.
Improve engineering predictability and delivery velocity.
Reduce technical debt while accelerating innovation.
Advance cloud modernization initiatives.
Launch meaningful AI-enabled product capabilities.
Improve software quality, platform reliability, and security.
Strengthen engineering culture through leadership development and talent retention.
Build stronger alignment between Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services.

Efficient Workflow Solutions
Scheduled Weekly Hours:
40
Number of Openings Available:
1
Worker Type:
Professional (Fixed Term)
More About Jonas Software:
Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.
Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.
Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.
Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Endpoint Security & XDR
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.
This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.
This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.
What You Will Be Doing
Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.
Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.
Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.
Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.
Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.
Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.
Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.
Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.
What You Bring
Genuine care for the people this product protects. Customers can tell whether the person across the table is invested in their mission, and this business runs on the trust you earn by caring consistently over time.
Business expertise running a product line or business unit in security, with comfort in the full picture: revenue, win rates, retention, pricing and packaging, and competitive positioning.
Earned credibility in endpoint security: EPP, EDR, XDR, and enough understanding of what an agent does on a machine to have real conversations with engineers and practitioners.
A strong working partnership with go-to-market teams, including experience enabling sellers and supporting deals alongside the field.
A habit of deciding with evidence: win/loss data, customer conversations, and market signals inform your calls.
A point of view on how a challenger competes and differentiates against well-funded incumbents.
Clear executive communication with executive leadership, CISOs, sales leadership, and industry analysts.
Bonus Points
Experience competing with or working at endpoint-focused security vendors, with perspective on the strengths and gaps across the market.
Experience helping a security business scale from a few hundred million toward $1B.
Familiarity with public efficacy testing (AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations) and how to participate in the open.
Experience serving customers in hard environments: regulated industries, classified networks, air-gapped and OT deployments.
A thoughtful position on AI and agentic capabilities at the endpoint, with healthy skepticism of silver bullets and a clear sense of where they genuinely help the defender.
Contributions to open source or the security community. Our work is public, and we value people who build in the open.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below.
These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.
An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
$192,500—$304,500 CAD
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.
Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)
Elasticsearch develops and distributes technology and information that is subject to U.S. and other countries’ export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, or Russia, including the Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia (The Crimea region of Ukraine, The Donetsk People's Republic (DNR), The Luhansk People's Republic (LNR), Kherson or Zaporizhzhia). If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic.

blocks.text: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role

Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.

This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.

This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.
What You Will Be Doing

items: Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.
Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.

Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.
Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.
Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.

Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.
Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.
Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.

blocks.text: What You Bring

items: Genuine care for the people this product protects. Customers can tell whether the person across the table is invested in their mission, and this business runs on the trust you earn by caring consistently over time.
Business expertise running a product line or business unit in security, with comfort in the full picture: revenue, win rates, retention, pricing and packaging, and competitive positioning.
Earned credibility in endpoint security: EPP, EDR, XDR, and enough understanding of what an agent does on a machine to have real conversations with engineers and practitioners.
A strong working partnership with go-to-market teams, including experience enabling sellers and supporting deals alongside the field.
A habit of deciding with evidence: win/loss data, customer conversations, and market signals inform your calls.
A point of view on how a challenger competes and differentiates against well-funded incumbents.
Clear executive communication with executive leadership, CISOs, sales leadership, and industry analysts.

blocks.text: Bonus Points

items: Experience competing with or working at endpoint-focused security vendors, with perspective on the strengths and gaps across the market.
Experience helping a security business scale from a few hundred million toward $1B.
Familiarity with public efficacy testing (AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations) and how to participate in the open.
Experience serving customers in hard environments: regulated industries, classified networks, air-gapped and OT deployments.
A thoughtful position on AI and agentic capabilities at the endpoint, with healthy skepticism of silver bullets and a clear sense of where they genuinely help the defender.
Contributions to open source or the security community. Our work is public, and we value people who build in the open.

jobs.title: Director of AI Engineering
jobs.text:
Location: Remote - United States only.
About the role:
Ottimate is building the AI-native future of accounts payable. Our platform processes millions of invoices across hundreds of enterprise customers, powered by a suite of ML models and agentic workflows. As Director of AI Engineering, you will own the full AI and ML layer of our product — from invoice understanding and vendor intelligence to our conversational AP Copilot and the next generation of autonomous AP agents.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will spend at least half your time writing code, architecting systems, and driving technical decisions alongside your team. You will also set the AI roadmap, partner cross-functionally with Product, Data, and Platform Engineering, and manage a distributed team of 8–10 engineers across Data and ML.
We are looking for a senior technical manager or director — ideally someone who has thrived at a smaller company and is ready for a career step up into broader ownership. If you are energized by shipping real AI products, working with noisy real-world financial data, and building the systems that will define how enterprises automate AP, this role is for you.
Responsibilities
Technical Leadership
Architect and ship production AI/ML systems — you write code, not just review it
Own the AI roadmap end-to-end: prioritization, trade-offs, delivery
Set technical standards for model quality, evals, observability, and reliability
Drive adoption of agentic coding tools to multiply team velocity
Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — measure and improve PR throughput
Partner with Platform Engineering on infrastructure, data pipelines, and APIs
People & Cross-Functional
Manage a distributed team of 8–10 engineers across Data and ML disciplines
Hire, develop, and retain engineers at all levels; build a high-trust remote culture
Partner with Product on roadmap sequencing and scope trade-offs
Work directly with customer-facing teams to close feedback loops on model quality
Communicate AI capabilities and limitations clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Model & Systems Ownership
Own model performance metrics and drive continuous improvement pipelines
Build and maintain evals frameworks — regression suites, human review, A/B testing
Oversee training data collection, curation, and labeling operations
Manage the full ML lifecycle: experimentation, deployment, monitoring, iteration
Define and enforce quality bars for agentic workflows entering production

jobs.title: Director,  Data Engineering Delivery
jobs.text:
Job Title
Director, Data Engineering Delivery
Job Description Summary
Reporting to the Global Head of Data Architecture & Engineering, the Director of Data Engineering Delivery will be a member of the Global Data Leadership team and will help shape data engineering strategy, standards, and execution across the organization. The role requires fluency with Databricks and the Azure ecosystem today, and the adaptability to evaluate and adopt additional data technologies as our platform evolves.
The Director of Data Engineering Delivery will be equally comfortable managing the deliverables and pipeline of work for a team of data engineers as they are building data platforms and developing the engineers who build on them. This is a hybrid technical and people leadership role: the successful candidate will lead, mentor, and grow a team of 5–8 data engineers and analysts whilst also contributing hands-on to data engineering deliverables on Databricks and Azure.
Job Description
Technical Leadership
Platform ownership: Lead the design, build, and continuous improvement of scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse architectures, and data products on Databricks and Azure, ensuring our engineering and architectural standards for performance, reliability, and cost are consistently delivered.
Hands-on contribution: Remain an active practitioner by contributing to high-impact pipelines, code reviews, architecture reviews, and complex troubleshooting.
Quality and governance: Champion data quality, observability, security, and governance practices, embedding them into the team’s engineering lifecycle and platform standards.
People Leadership
Team management: Directly manage a team of 5–8 data engineers, owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, compensation recommendations, and retention.
Coaching and development: Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career development planning for each team member, with clear growth paths for both individual contributor and leadership tracks.
Culture and engagement: Foster an inclusive, high-trust team culture grounded in psychological safety, technical curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.
Project and Work Orchestration
Delivery ownership: Plan, prioritize, and orchestrate the team’s portfolio of data engineering work, ensuring on-time, on-quality delivery aligned with global data and business priorities.
Agile execution: Establish and refine agile delivery practices (intake, estimation, sprint planning, retrospectives) that balance discovery work, platform investment, and run-the-business commitments.
Risk and dependency management: Proactively identify, communicate, and resolve risks, blockers, and cross-team dependencies, escalating clearly and constructively when needed.
Operational excellence: Own production health for the team’s data products, including SLAs, on-call posture, incident response, and post-incident learning.
Stakeholder Management and Cross Team Collaboration
Business partnership: Build trusted relationships with business and technology stakeholders, translating their objectives into clearly scoped, prioritized data engineering outcomes.
Global team collaboration: Partner closely with peers across the Global Data Leadership team - architecture, data engineering, AI, governance, and product - to deliver cohesive, end-to-end data solutions.
Communication and storytelling: Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, roadmaps, and progress effectively to audiences ranging from engineers to senior executives.
Cushman & Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements.
The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications.
The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role.
The compensation for the position is: $ 140,250.00 - $165,000.00Cushman & Wakefield is an Equal Opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position at Cushman & Wakefield, please call the ADA line at 1-888-365-5406 or email . Please refer to the job title and job location when you contact us.

jobs.title: Managing Director - Data & AI (Montreal, Canada)
jobs.text:
Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 400 projects and have grown to 175+ talented individuals across 7 office locations.
Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. You can learn more about what we are passionate about at and on our you can find more useful information about our business and recruiting process.
Are You the Leader We're Looking For?
As a Managing Director at Unit8, success isn't just about closing deals — it's about becoming a cornerstone of how we grow and deliver in the Canadian market. You will own both sides of the equation: originating high-value client relationships and ensuring the work we deliver actually moves the needle for our clients. If you've built your career at the intersection of commercial impact and technical credibility, and you're ready to operate with real autonomy in an expert-led environment, this is the role.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
This is a senior leadership position for someone as comfortable originating a complex engagement as overseeing its delivery. You shape and close the deal, build relationships and trust, and you stay close enough to ensure the technical execution actually delivers value. You will succeed by:
Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in the Canadian market — primarily in pharma, insurance, or chemicals — through a network earned over years of credible work in data & AI
Selling from expertise: clients engage with you because you understand their problem because of your deep problem solving skills and experience not because you have a polished pitch
Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
Bridging the gap between a senior data scientist and a C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like and holding teams to that standard
What You'll Do
Leverage your existing network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in Canada (new logos, not just expansions)
Translate complex business problems into concrete Data & AI solutions: identify where value can be created, make sure the team is building toward it, and hold the client accountable to realising it
Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations — from early problem definition through to scaled delivery — ensuring the right technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
Act as the senior point of contact for key clients throughout delivery, ensuring technical execution stays anchored to business value
Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
Work closely with our engineering and data science teams, providing business context, removing blockers and coaching them.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Strategic Sourcing & Category Management
jobs.text:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
Job Details
Serves as the single accountable owner for one or more technology categories within Cencora's global data and technology indirect spend portfolio, covering sourcing strategy, negotiation, supplier management, and portfolio and demand management for that scope. Owns the category roadmap for both near-term execution and multi-year delivery, and establishes clear sub-category ownership so every area of spend has a named owner. Directs enterprise-wide negotiations with major technology providers and owns the supplier performance, risk, and value agenda for assigned categories. Leads a team of Director-level category owners and sourcing professionals, building capability and a culture of accountability and commercial rigor. Acts as the defined sourcing business partner to assigned Technology senior leaders, translating their roadmaps and budgets into a forward demand plan so sourcing gets ahead of requirements rather than reacting to them. Establishes the governance, controls, and performance measures that convert category strategy into realized savings, improved service levels, and managed third-party risk.
Responsibilities
Directs technology category strategies for assigned spend areas, including demand assessment, sourcing approach, supplier segmentation, risk evaluation, and value engineering initiatives.
Leads category planning and sourcing execution by aligning business and technology requirements, market intelligence, financial objectives, and procurement priorities into actionable multi-year strategies.
Oversees supplier selection, negotiation, and contracting to improve commercial outcomes, service performance, and total cost of ownership.
Establishes governance, controls, and performance measures that strengthen policy compliance, implementation discipline, and realization of sourcing benefits.

jobs.title: VP, Business Technology Strategy & Integration
jobs.text:
WHAT DOES A VP, BUSINESS TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY & INTEGRATION DO?
The VP, Business Technology Strategy & Integration is a critical leadership role responsible for the strategic oversight, governance, and orchestration of business technology initiatives across a key client account.
Serving as the accountable leader for business technology strategy and execution, this role provides vision, solution leadership, and cross-functional oversight—aligning business priorities, technology capabilities, data integrations, and delivery teams to drive informed, proactive decision-making, reduce organizational friction, and enable scalable execution. Positioned directly within the Agency team, this role ensures seamless integration with brand and experience strategy, and client service, while maintaining a strong governance bridge to EVERSANA’s broader Technology, Enterprise Data, and Solutions Delivery teams.
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
Technology Strategy & Business Integration Leadership
Lead Business Technology Strategy: Serve as the strategic leader responsible for aligning commercial business objectives, agency strategy, and overall technology direction in collaboration with client lead. Translate brand and commercial priorities into clear technology strategies, capability plans, investment recommendations, and long-term maturity roadmaps that enable scalable business outcomes.
Shape the Technology Vision: Provide visionary leadership for the evolution of business technology capabilities across the portfolio. Anticipate future business needs, emerging platforms, and healthcare industry trends to proactively guide capability investments and digital innovation.
Own Strategic Technology Oversight: Maintain enterprise-level visibility across technology capabilities, integration strategies, platform dependencies, constraints, and roadmaps. Provide governance and executive oversight to proactively identify strategic risks, technical friction, and capability gaps.
Drive Executive Alignment: Partner closely with client leadership (e.g., client commercial/marketing stakeholders) and agency leads to maintain and evolve a unified technology strategy aligned with omnichannel and business goals.
Strategic Leadership & Technology Governance
Translate Strategy into Technology Direction: Serve as the primary strategic bridge between business objectives and technical execution, defining the vision, guiding principles, and functional direction that enable delivery teams to succeed.
Lead Solution Strategy: Provide consultative leadership on marketing technology approaches, validating business needs against enterprise platform capabilities (e.g., SFMC, Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud, OneTrust, Veeva, Web/CMS, CDP/Data Cloud).
Guide Enterprise Integration: Establish and oversee business technology and data integration strategies to ensure connected, scalable, and compliant solutions across brand touchpoints (HCP and Patient).
Govern Technology Decisions: Oversee technology planning, identify cross-functional dependencies early, and ensure proposed solution architectures align with enterprise standards, compliance regulations, and future-state capability roadmaps.
Business Technology Leadership & Enablement
Own the Business Technology Roadmap: Partner with EVERSANA Intouch leadership and client marketing leads to prioritize and evolve the business maturity roadmap, ensuring investments address both immediate tactical needs and long-term capability growth.
Serve as the Technology Authority: Act as the organization’s trusted advisor and authoritative voice on technology capabilities, platform constraints, integration feasibility, and digital activation opportunities.
Enable Informed Decision-Making: Guide business leaders, account teams, and client stakeholders on implementation implications, resource trade-offs, and technical considerations to improve planning and budget allocations.
Drive Cross-Functional Synergy: Facilitate executive decision-making across multidisciplinary teams—including Account, PMO, Experience Strategy (XS), Media, Analytics, Creative, and Technology Delivery.
Execution Oversight & Operational Excellence
Provide Execution Oversight: Maintain strategic oversight throughout project lifecycles to ensure technical implementations remain strictly aligned with approved solution designs, business goals, and quality standards.
Own Operational Governance: Establish and continuously evolve governance frameworks, operating models (including agency), and quality standards that drive consistency, accountability, and scalability across all digital initiatives.
Lead Operational Readiness: Own the strategy and governance for operational documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), implementation playbooks, rollout frameworks, and governance charters.
Drive Continuous Improvement: Champion ongoing optimization of technology operating models and cross-functional ways of working to reduce organizational friction, improve delivery velocity, and strengthen technical execution.
Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
Perform all other duties as assigned.
WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in technology strategy, martech consulting, enterprise digital transformation, or digital agency leadership within the Life Sciences / Healthcare & Pharmaceutical industry.
Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of commercial pharmaceutical marketing, omnichannel engagement strategies (HCP & Patient), digital operating models, and agency cross-functional workflows.
Platform Knowledge: Robust knowledge of enterprise marketing tech ecosystems, including deep knowledge in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Salesforce Data Cloud, Veeva systems, OneTrust privacy governance, Web/CMS platforms, and Analytics/Data integration frameworks.
Strategic Acumen: Proven track record translating complex business requirements into actionable technology strategies, multi-year maturity roadmaps, and execution governance.
Leadership & Influence: Outstanding executive presence with demonstrated ability to establish trust with VP/senior client stakeholders and bridge communication between non-technical business leads and technical developers/architects.
Operational Excellence: Experience building Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), governance frameworks, and cross-agency RACI models.
Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and workshop facilitation skills.
OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:
Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.
Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.
Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.
Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.
Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). This role is eligible for hire in select U.S. locations based on business and operational considerations. For a full list of locations, visit eversana.com/careers. More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at .
Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter
EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.
We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.
We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs.

Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. jobs.text:
We are a leading global asset management firm with over 3,000 employees across 20 offices in 15 countries; we help millions of investors around the world pursue their financial goals.
We hire critical thinkers. People who thrive in a collaborative culture like ours where we solve real problems while building the future of finance.
You
Are excited to be part of a vibrant engineering community that values diversity, hard work, and continuous learning.
Love solving complex real-world business problems.
Recognize that cross-functional collaboration is a core component of success for the team.
Believe there are multiple ways to solve most technical problems and are willing to debate the trade-offs.
Have become a stronger engineer by making mistakes and learning from them.
Are a doer, someone who wants to grow their career and gain experience across technologies and business functions.
We
Continuously invest in a high-performance and inclusive culture, in which a diversity of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints are celebrated and valued.
Encourage career mobility, so you can benefit from learning different functions and technologies, and we gain the benefits of your experience across teams.
Run technology pro bono programs that help the non-profit community and give our engineering community opportunities to volunteer and participate.
Offer education reimbursements and ongoing training in technology, communication, and diversity & inclusion.
Embrace knowledge sharing through lunch-and-learns, demos, and technical forums.
Consider our people to be our greatest asset—we will help you learn what PIMCO Technology has to offer so you can participate in activities that benefit your career while delivering impactful technology solutions.
We are seeking a VPlevel Senior Software Developer to lead development and implementation of analytics tools and APIs for quants and portfolio managers.
You will provide technical leadership while remaining handson: design, build, test, and deploy scalable frontend UIs, highperformance backend services, and APIs; translate quant and portfoliomanager requirements into technical designs; collaborate with engineering, quant teams, and portfolio managers to define scope and priorities; own delivery, production reliability, and incident response; and mentor peers.
Required Experience
Strong Python proficiency, advanced SQL for complex data analysis, 10+ years of software engineering experience delivering production systems, and experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
Familiarity with quantitative workflows or direct experience working with quant teams is required.
Preferred: distributed systems or largescale data processing, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD. Frontend JavaScript experience is a plus.
The role requires clear communication, results orientation, and willingness to take on multiple roles to deliver solutions under time pressure.
Technical Skills/Qualifications
BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or related technical field.
10+ years of hands-on software development experience.
Strong Python Proficiency is essential.
Strong Pandas and SQL proficiency is essential.
Familiarity with distributed systems, large scale data processing, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) a plus.
Front end development experience a plus.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS) is a plus.

We are seeking a senior, business-oriented Vice President, Product Manager to lead multi-year product strategy and execution for Credit Technology platforms that support investment research, analytics, and trading workflows. This leader will partner closely with credit analysts, portfolio managers, traders, credit analytics teams, engineers, data teams, and senior stakeholders to deliver scalable technology solutions that improve workflow efficiency, enhance data accessibility, and strengthen decision-making across the credit lifecycle. The role also provides senior leadership across governance, roadmap prioritization, resourcing, operating model maturity, and post-release accountability to ensure product outcomes are adopted, measured, and continuously improved.
Key Responsibilities
Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Credit Technology platforms supporting research, analytics, trading, and portfolio management workflows.
Serve as a senior product partner to credit analysts, portfolio managers, traders, credit analytics teams, engineering leads, and technology leadership.
Translate complex credit business needs into clear product priorities, requirements, business cases, and delivery plans for engineering and data teams.
Lead roadmap prioritization across competing stakeholder needs, balancing business value, regulatory and operational risk, technical feasibility, scalability, and time-to-market.
Lead cross-functional governance and decision forums to align stakeholders on priorities, scope, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.
Drive delivery of tools, dashboards, data products, workflow applications, analytics capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions that improve credit decision-making and operating efficiency.
Establish product success measures, adoption metrics, data quality indicators, and performance dashboards to evaluate impact and guide investment decisions.
Oversee testing, validation, rollout, change management, and user adoption for complex business logic and mission-critical credit applications.
Partner with engineering leadership on platform architecture, system design trade-offs, API strategy, data integration, and long-term modernization opportunities.
Partner with engineering leadership on capacity planning, sequencing, dependency management, and resourcing decisions across the Credit Technology portfolio.
Own post-release accountability by monitoring adoption, operational health, product stability, user feedback, and continuous improvement opportunities after rollout.
Communicate product strategy, delivery progress, risks, and recommendations to senior business and technology stakeholders in an executive-ready format.
Coach and mentor junior product managers, analysts, and cross-functional contributors while scaling consistent product practices, governance, prioritization discipline, and operating model maturity within Credit Technology.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of product management, technology strategy, business analysis, or related experience within financial services, asset management, capital markets, or enterprise technology.
Demonstrated experience leading product strategy and roadmap execution for complex platforms, data products, workflow tools, analytics applications, or trading and investment technology solutions.
Strong understanding of fixed income, credit markets, investment research, portfolio management, trading workflows, or related asset management processes.
Proven ability to partner with senior investment professionals, business stakeholders, engineers, data teams, and technology leaders to define and deliver high-impact solutions.
Experience gathering and refining complex requirements, structuring business cases, prioritizing roadmaps, and translating ambiguous needs into actionable product deliverables.
Strong analytical and technical fluency, including familiarity with data models, relational databases, APIs, dashboards, reporting tools, and modern software delivery practices.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, executive presentation, and influence skills in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Financial Engineering, Business, or a related technical or quantitative field.
Preferred Qualifications
PhD, MBA, CFA, or advanced degree in a quantitative, technical, or finance-related field preferred.
Experience with credit investment platforms, trading systems, portfolio analytics, research management tools, risk analytics, or investment data platforms.
Hands-on familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, or similar data analysis and visualization tools.
Experience delivering AI-enabled, data science, or automation capabilities for investment, research, trading, or operational workflows.
Experience operating in a highly regulated financial services environment with strong attention to controls, resiliency, auditability, and data quality.
Track record of mentoring product talent and improving product operating models, governance, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement practices.
What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will bring strategic direction and execution discipline to Credit Technology, strengthen alignment between investment teams and engineering, improve the quality and usability of credit data and analytics, and deliver platforms that enhance research, trading, portfolio management, and decision-making across the credit lifecycle.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, AI Agents
jobs.text:
At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers.
In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business.
Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2.
Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career.
About the Role:
Podium built the AI Employee local businesses now depend on to answer every lead, book every appointment, and win the moments that used to slip through the cracks. It's not a chatbot bolted onto a CRM — it's an autonomous teammate that qualifies leads, holds real conversations, and closes the loop from first message to booked revenue, 24/7.
We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to take ownership of our AI Agents product and turn it from a fast-growing platform into the industry-defining agent infrastructure for local business. This is a hands-on leadership role — equal parts zero-to-one builder and scale-up operator. You'll architect and ship the systems that let our agents reason, act, and get better over time, while building the team and the org-level muscle to run these systems reliably at massive scale, across thousands of customer-facing workflows and business verticals.
What you will be doing:
Owning the technical architecture and roadmap for Podium's AI agent platform — the orchestration layer, tool-use frameworks, memory, and reasoning systems that power customer-facing agents across every industry vertical we serve
Leading and growing a team of engineers building and operating production agent systems, setting the technical bar and staying hands-on in design, code, and incident response where it matters most
Building and maturing our evaluation infrastructure — the offline and online eval harnesses, quality metrics, and feedback loops that let us ship agent improvements with confidence instead of guesswork
Driving the "0 to 1" build-out of new agent capabilities and workflows, then the "1 to scale" work of hardening those systems for reliability, latency, and cost as usage grows into the tens of millions of conversations
Partnering closely with Product to translate business outcomes (response time, conversion, show rate, revenue recovered) into agent capabilities and prioritized technical bets
Partnering with Infrastructure/Platform teams to ensure agent systems are observable, cost-efficient, and resilient at scale — this includes model routing, latency budgets, fallback behavior, and guardrails
Working directly with customers and customer-facing teams (Sales, CS, Support) to understand where agents succeed or fail in the field, and feeding that signal back into the roadmap
Establishing best practices for prompt/context engineering, agent testing, safety and guardrails, and responsible deployment of autonomous systems in live customer environments
Representing AI Agents engineering in leadership conversations — setting a clear technical narrative, calling out risk early, and making sound build-vs-buy and model-vs-vendor tradeoffs
What you should have:
10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in engineering leadership roles (Director, Head of Engineering, or equivalent scope as a hands-on lead)
Direct experience building and operating production LLM-powered or agentic systems — not just prototypes, but systems serving real users at real volume with real reliability requirements
Deep fluency in applied AI architecture: orchestration frameworks, tool-calling/function-calling patterns, RAG and context management, and the tradeoffs between latency, cost, and quality
A track record of building and scaling evaluation systems for non-deterministic software — you know how to measure agent quality, catch regressions, and make shipping decisions without waiting for perfect certainty
Experience leading both "0 to 1" builds and "1 to scale" hardening — you've stood up something from nothing and you've also kept something running under real production load
Strong instincts for working cross-functionally with Product, Infrastructure, and customer-facing teams, and the communication skills to align technical decisions with business outcomes
Genuine, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you and your team build
What we hope you have:
Experience building agent systems specifically for customer-facing, revenue-critical workflows (sales, support, scheduling, or similar)
Familiarity with voice AI, conversational AI, or real-time multimodal systems
Experience operating in a high-growth SaaS or vertical software company, ideally one serving SMB customers
A point of view on the frontier of agentic AI — what's changing fast, what's overhyped, and where the real leverage is for a company like Podium
Why you'll love working here:
Podium is the best place to work to:
Join the leaders in AI agents — you'll be building on top of a product already trusted by 60,000+ businesses to run their AI Employee, with a real mandate and real usage to learn from
Unlock career-defining growth — this role owns a product area at the center of Podium's future, with the scope and visibility that comes with it
Build with world-class talent — join a team of engineers who ship fast, use AI tooling seriously, and care as much about outcomes as elegance
Make a real impact on local business — the agents you build directly help local businesses respond faster, convert more leads, and grow revenue without adding headcount
Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Founding CTO (AI/ML / Data Product)
jobs.text:
Startup Wise Guys (SWG) is one of Europe’s most active B2B accelerators. In Founders Club, senior builders team up to validate real B2B problems and ship the first product version in 12 weeks, fully online.
If you’ve been the person deploying models for someone else’s roadmap, this is your chance to build your own AI-powered venture—from problem selection to productization.
This is a co-founder opportunity.
The goal is to help you become (or join) a founding team and launch a venture.
Tasks
Validate a B2B problem where AI creates measurable value (time, cost, risk)
Define MVP that’s product-first (not “cool model-first”)
Design the data approach (collection, labeling, evaluation, monitoring)
Ship a reliable prototype/MVP (APIs, pipelines, guardrails, feedback loops)
Craft investor-ready tech narrative (moat, data advantage, roadmap)
Requirements
7+ years in software engineering with strong AI/ML or data product exposure
Experience shipping to production (MLOps basics, monitoring, reliability)
Strong product instinct: clarity on what “good enough” looks like for an MVP
Founder mindset; you want ownership and upside, not a service role
~10–12h/week for 12 weeks
Benefits
12-week sprint to go from insight → MVP → iteration
Weekly accountability + execution cadence (~10–12h/week)
500+ mentors including B2B, product, GTM, fundraising specialists
440+ alumni startups / 40+ countries for learning + intros
CTO toolkit for AI ventures: scope, evaluation, deployment, “moat” story
Note: The cohort includes a participation ticket after acceptance to ensure commitment.
Apply if you’re ready to stop being the “AI builder for others” and ship your own company.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Associate Director, Commercial Master Data Management
jobs.text:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.
General Description:
The Global Commercial and Medical Affairs Technology team at BeOne is seeking an Associate Director, Commercial Master Data Management to support and lead the Ex-China Commercial Master Data Management (MDM) capability and drive operational excellence across commercial data platforms, customer data, analytics, and business applications.
This role serves as a business owner for commercial master data domains, governance processes, data quality standards, stewardship programs, and cross-functional data policies that enable trusted, compliant, and scalable data-driven decision-making.
This role partners closely with Commercial Operations, Marketing, Sales, Market Access, Patient Services, Analytics, Compliance, and Information Technology to ensure commercial data assets are governed, standardized, and optimized to support business objectives.
This role will establish the foundation for a customer-centric commercial data ecosystem by creating governance frameworks, stewardship processes, master data standards, and data quality programs across HCP, HCO, payer, patient, product, and organizational data domains.
Master Data Management
Serve as hands-on business owner and architect for commercial master data domains, including HCP, HCO, payer, customer, product, and organizational hierarchies.
Build and maintain enterprise master data standards, business rules, hierarchies, and data ownership models.
Establish and run the Commercial Data Stewardship Program.
Develop and execute master data lifecycle processes, including onboarding, enrichment, maintenance, validation, and retirement.
Build and fine tune match rules, merge rules, and survivorship logic; perform customer matching, deduplication, affiliation management, and hierarchy maintenance directly to produce trusted “golden records.”
Configure and maintain customer communication preferences, consent management processes, and related compliance requirements.
Ensure MDM technologies and platforms align with commercial business requirements and configure them to meet those needs.
Identify and implement opportunities to improve operational efficiency through data standardization and automation.
Support enterprise initiatives involving AI, advanced analytics, customer engagement, and commercial transformation.
Data Quality & Stewardship
Build commercial data quality standards, KPIs, and monitoring processes, and run them on an ongoing basis.
Develop scorecards and reporting that provide visibility into data health across commercial domains.
Perform root-cause analysis and execute remediation for recurring data quality issues – writing the fixes, not just assigning them.
Partner with business stakeholders to prioritize and resolve data-related risks and opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that measurably increase trust in commercial data assets.
Commercial Data Operations & Business Enablement
Write and maintain operational support processes, documentation, SOPs, data dictionaries, and process maps to improve platform sustainability and supportability.
Translate business requirements into working technical solutions, and build the datasets, validations, and outputs directly; support user training, documentation, and adoption efforts.
Deliver and validate high-quality commercial master data provisioning across Account Planning, CRM, Customer Master, Business Intelligence, and Commercial Analytics platforms, ensuring data consistency, governance, and alignment with business requirements.
Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements, workflow automation, and operational efficiencies.
Monitor operational metrics, data quality indicators, and platform usage, and personally implement continuous improvements.
Commercial Applications Data Platform Management
Run day-to-day operations, enhancements, and support activities for commercial technology platforms including Customer Master Data and related data solutions.
Coordinate and perform platform releases, upgrades, enhancements, and defect resolution activities.
Support commercial product launches and business initiatives by preparing data, ensuring technology readiness, and testing data availability.
Conduct impact assessments and hands-on cross-functional reviews for system changes, integrations, and new data sources.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to prioritize enhancements and build improved platform capabilities.
Data Integration & Analytics
Partner with Data Engineering and Enterprise Architecture teams and build data integration and provisioning across commercial systems.
Build and coordinate integration activities between CRM, Customer Master, Marketing, Analytics, and Enterprise Data Warehouse platforms.
Write SQL and support the development and maintenance of semantic layers, reporting datasets, and business intelligence solutions.
Collaborate directly with Analytics and AI teams to improve data quality and support advanced reporting and analytical use cases.
Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations to ensure reliable and timely data delivery.
Implement automated validation rules, matching logic, and data hygiene scripts to eliminate duplicate entries and maintain database integrity.
Vendor & Offshore Team Management
Coordinate delivery activities across offshore development teams, managed service providers, and technology vendors, working hands-on in testing and validating deliverables.
Manage project execution, testing, deployments, and production support activities across internal and external teams.
Monitor vendor performance against established service levels and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Review vendor output, reproduce and diagnose issues, and facilitate root-cause analysis and operational reviews for commercial systems and data platforms.
Support release planning, environment management, documentation, and knowledge transfer activities.
Supervisory Responsibilities:
None currently, possible in the future.
Education Required:
Bachelor’s in Computer Science, or a related field.
Required Qualifications:
Technical Expertise:
Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of experience / Master's in Computer Science or related field with 6+ years of experience.
8+ years of Pharmaceutical industry Commercial operations or related experience architecting and building Enterprise Data Management platforms, with direct hands-on delivery.
Hands-on experience implementing & managing Master Data Management solutions is a must.
Demonstrated ability to personally write and tune match rules, merge rules, and survivorship logic to produce “golden records” across Capability, Consent, Payer, Patient, HCP/HCO domains.
Familiarity with master data management platforms and commercial data architectures or comparable products.
Hands-on knowledge of commercial data mastering, including identity resolution, hierarchy and relationship management, consent management, data governance, data quality monitoring, and integration across HCP, HCO, payer, patient, consent, and product systems.
Strong hands-on SQL and experience working with Cloud based platforms and technology solutions is a must (AWS Redshift, EC2, Databricks, Snowflake, Reltio etc).
Hands-on experience with MedPro & OneKey data is a must. Ultmarc data experience is nice to have.
Excellent written / verbal communication skills and presentation and project management skills.
Ability to coordinate needs assessments across the commercial & other business organizations, and an ability to build and deliver a comprehensive solution to those needs.
Demonstrated ability to work well within a matrixed environment, and an ability to build solid relationships / make connections across the organization.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills and solid business acumen with the ability to manage and provision large amounts of data to enable business analysis with high level of performance and trust.
Must be able to identify operational weakness and personally implement corrective action / plan.
Proven ability to grow and develop others.
Business Acumen & Leadership:
Strong collaboration skills with stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
Experience leading Operational/analytics initiatives that drive measurable business impact.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, making insights accessible and actionable for executives.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
Exposure to commercial, medical, or patient data ecosystems.
Hands-on experience with commercial data providers including SP/SD, IQVIA, Symphony Health, Komodo, Definitive Healthcare, Veeva Open Data, and similar sources.
Travel:
Estimated 10-15%, primarily for key planning sessions, workshops, or major launch initiatives.
Global Competencies
When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.
Fosters Teamwork
Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
Self-Awareness
Acts Inclusively
Demonstrates Initiative
Entrepreneurial Mindset
Continuous Learning
Embraces Change
Results-Oriented
Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
Financial Excellence
Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $150,200.00 - $200,200.00 annually
BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. Monitor operational metrics, data quality indicators, and platform usage, and personally implement continuous improvements.

Write SQL and support the development and maintenance of semantic layers, reporting datasets, and business intelligence solutions.
Collaborate directly with Analytics and AI teams to improve data quality and support advanced reporting and analytical use cases.
Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations to ensure reliable and timely data delivery.
Implement automated validation rules, matching logic, and data hygiene scripts to eliminate duplicate entries and maintain database integrity.

blocks.text: Vendor & Offshore Team Management

Review vendor output, reproduce and diagnose issues, and facilitate root-cause analysis and operational reviews for commercial systems and data platforms.
