Position Summary:
Reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO), the Vice President, Product Operations leads the Product Operations function and is responsible for establishing, evolving, and scaling the processes, governance frameworks, planning practices, and operating rhythms that enable effective execution across PointClickCare’s Product and Engineering organization.
This role partners closely with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, Strategy, and other key functions to improve portfolio visibility, planning effectiveness, decision-making, and organizational alignment. Through strong operational leadership, data-driven insights, and cross-functional collaboration, the VP plays a critical role in enabling disciplined execution of strategic priorities and driving continuous improvement across Product and Engineering performance.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead annual, quarterly, and ongoing Product portfolio planning processes across Product and Engineering teams.
Facilitate cross-functional planning discussions, portfolio reviews, and prioritization activities that balance strategic objectives, capacity considerations, dependencies, and resource trade-offs.
Establish and evolve governance frameworks that promote transparency, accountability, alignment, and effective decision-making across the organization.
Monitor portfolio performance and execution health, identifying opportunities to improve planning effectiveness, predictability, and delivery outcomes.
Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Product Operations processes, standards, and operating practices.
Establish planning cadences, portfolio reviews, operating forums, and governance mechanisms that support efficient execution and organizational alignment.
Partner with Product, Engineering, UX/UI, and business stakeholders to improve coordination, operational effectiveness, and cross-functional collaboration.
Develop and maintain portfolio performance reporting, operational metrics, dashboards, and executive-level insights that support business and investment decisions.
Provide leadership teams with visibility into portfolio progress, business outcomes, risks, dependencies, and execution challenges.
Leverage data and operational insights to inform prioritization, planning, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Advance product management capability by establishing operational standards, frameworks, tools, and best practices that support Product team effectiveness.
Partner with Product leaders to strengthen portfolio management, planning processes, delivery practices, and organizational maturity.
Support Product leadership planning cycles, business reviews, and strategic operational initiatives with analysis, recommendations, and decision support.
Identify operational risks, execution challenges, and cross-functional dependencies, recommending mitigation strategies and improvement opportunities.
Lead, coach, and develop Product Operations leaders and team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
MBA or other advanced degree in Business, Technology, or a related field is considered an asset.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Product Operations, Portfolio Management, PMO, Product Management, Strategy, or a related business operations function within a complex technology organization.
Demonstrated experience leading planning, governance, portfolio management, and operational processes that support execution across large, cross-functional teams.
Proven ability to influence senior leaders and build alignment across Product, Engineering, Finance, Strategy, and other business functions to achieve organizational objectives.
Strong analytical, strategic, and operational leadership skills, including experience leveraging metrics, reporting, and business insights to support planning, prioritization, and executive decision-making.
Experience leading and developing managers and professional teams, including responsibility for talent development, performance management, and organizational effectiveness.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across executive leadership teams and complex organizational structures.
Experience supporting Product and Engineering organizations within a SaaS, healthcare technology, or other technology-driven environment is preferred.
Experience implementing or improving Product Operations, portfolio management, governance, or planning practices during periods of organizational growth and change is preferred.

Position Summary:
Reporting directly to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO), the Senior Vice President, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy establishes and leads PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for Data as a Product. This executive leader is accountable for transforming PointClickCare’s unique data assets, ecosystem position, and network scale into differentiated products, strategic growth opportunities, and new sources of enterprise value.
The role owns the long-term strategy for customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability, marketplace capabilities, data monetization, and data-enabled AI solutions while ensuring appropriate protection of intellectual property, privacy, and regulatory compliance. As a member of the senior Product Leadership Team, the SVP influences corporate strategy, investment priorities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives while leading a team of senior Product leaders responsible for PointClickCare’s data product portfolio.
Key Responsibilities:
Define and lead PointClickCare’s enterprise Data Products strategy, including establishing a multi-year vision for Data as a Product that aligns with corporate objectives, growth priorities, and evolving market opportunities.
Identify, evaluate, and champion new business models and growth opportunities enabled by PointClickCare’s data assets, network scale, interoperability capabilities, and ecosystem partnerships.
Serve as the executive sponsor for customer-facing data strategy and ensure alignment across Product, Engineering, AI, Corporate Strategy, Legal, Go-to-Market, and the Corporate Data Office.
Own the strategy, roadmap, performance, and long-term success of PointClickCare’s data products portfolio, including customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability services, marketplace capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions.
Establish investment priorities, resource allocation decisions, portfolio success measures, and business outcomes that balance customer value, market opportunity, and financial performance.
Drive adoption, customer value realization, commercial performance, and scalable product growth through strong portfolio management and strategic execution.
Lead PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for data monetization, marketplace growth, and ecosystem expansion.
Define customer access models, API strategies, pricing frameworks, packaging approaches, and commercial models that support sustainable growth while preserving trust and protecting intellectual property.
Identify new revenue opportunities, strategic partnerships, and ecosystem capabilities that strengthen PointClickCare’s competitive position and expand customer value.
Represent PointClickCare’s data strategy with executive stakeholders, customers, strategic partners, industry analysts, and industry organizations.
Lead executive-level discussions related to data products, healthcare interoperability, marketplace participation, data monetization, and AI-enabled customer solutions.
Build relationships that influence product direction, market positioning, and long-term growth opportunities across the healthcare technology landscape.
Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing product leadership organization through senior leaders, including VPs and Directors.
Establish succession planning, leadership development, talent strategies, and organizational capabilities that strengthen expertise in data products, APIs, ecosystem platforms, marketplace solutions, and monetization strategies.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and execution excellence.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field.
15+ years of progressive leadership experience in product management, technology, data products, platform strategy, enterprise software, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated success defining and executing enterprise-level product, growth, or business strategies with measurable impact on organizational performance, customer outcomes, and financial results.
Proven experience leading large, complex product or technology organizations through multiple layers of leadership, including developing senior leaders and building organizational capability.
Track record of leading enterprise transformation initiatives requiring alignment across multiple functions, competing priorities, and significant organizational change.
Deep expertise in data products, APIs, interoperability, marketplace and ecosystem strategies, data monetization models, AI-enabled products, and the business dynamics of data-driven organizations.
Strong strategic, financial, and operational acumen, including ownership of portfolio-level investment decisions, business cases, risk management, and performance outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders, shape investment decisions, and represent organizational strategy with customers, partners, analysts, and other external stakeholders.
Experience leading marketplace, ecosystem, platform, or data monetization strategies is highly preferred.
Experience within healthcare technology, post-acute care, payer, provider, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
Experience engaging with industry analysts, strategic partners, customer advisory groups, or external industry bodies is preferred.
Ability to balance growth objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and intellectual property protection in a complex business environment.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO), the Senior Vice President, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy establishes and leads PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for Data as a Product. This executive leader is accountable for transforming PointClickCare’s unique data assets, ecosystem position, and network scale into differentiated products, strategic growth opportunities, and new sources of enterprise value.

The role owns the long-term strategy for customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability, marketplace capabilities, data monetization, and data-enabled AI solutions while ensuring appropriate protection of intellectual property, privacy, and regulatory compliance. As a member of the senior Product Leadership Team, the SVP influences corporate strategy, investment priorities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives while leading a team of senior Product leaders responsible for PointClickCare’s data product portfolio.
Key Responsibilities:

items: Define and lead PointClickCare’s enterprise Data Products strategy, including establishing a multi-year vision for Data as a Product that aligns with corporate objectives, growth priorities, and evolving market opportunities.
Identify, evaluate, and champion new business models and growth opportunities enabled by PointClickCare’s data assets, network scale, interoperability capabilities, and ecosystem partnerships.
Serve as the executive sponsor for customer-facing data strategy and ensure alignment across Product, Engineering, AI, Corporate Strategy, Legal, Go-to-Market, and the Corporate Data Office.

Own the strategy, roadmap, performance, and long-term success of PointClickCare’s data products portfolio, including customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability services, marketplace capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions.
Establish investment priorities, resource allocation decisions, portfolio success measures, and business outcomes that balance customer value, market opportunity, and financial performance.
Drive adoption, customer value realization, commercial performance, and scalable product growth through strong portfolio management and strategic execution.
Lead PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for data monetization, marketplace growth, and ecosystem expansion.

Define customer access models, API strategies, pricing frameworks, packaging approaches, and commercial models that support sustainable growth while preserving trust and protecting intellectual property.
Identify new revenue opportunities, strategic partnerships, and ecosystem capabilities that strengthen PointClickCare’s competitive position and expand customer value.
Represent PointClickCare’s data strategy with executive stakeholders, customers, strategic partners, industry analysts, and industry organizations.
Lead executive-level discussions related to data products, healthcare interoperability, marketplace participation, data monetization, and AI-enabled customer solutions.
Build relationships that influence product direction, market positioning, and long-term growth opportunities across the healthcare technology landscape.
Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing product leadership organization through senior leaders, including VPs and Directors.

Establish succession planning, leadership development, talent strategies, and organizational capabilities that strengthen expertise in data products, APIs, ecosystem platforms, marketplace solutions, and monetization strategies.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and execution excellence.

jobs.text:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.
General Description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Executive Director of Global Technology Solutions with a focus on Enabling Functions to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in enterprise technology, with experience supporting corporate functions such as Human Resources, Corporate Communications, Legal & Compliance, and Business Development. This leader will emphasize process excellence and leverage technology and AI to drive advancements, scalability, and automation across enterprise services.
This role will be pivotal in shaping the technology strategy that enables critical corporate functions and ensures the successful integration of cutting-edge technology solutions to support workforce strategy, communications, governance, and growth initiatives. The Executive Director will collaborate closely with senior functional leadership and will report directly to the Chief Technology Officer.
Essential Functions of the Job:
Lead the technology strategy for Enabling Functions, aligning technology initiatives with Human Resources, Corporate Communications, Legal & Compliance, and Business Development priorities.
Drive innovation by implementing advanced technology solutions that enhance the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of enterprise services and corporate operations.
Oversee the development and implementation of systems and solutions supporting core enterprise functions, including HR, communications platforms, legal and compliance tools, and business development systems.
Enable data-driven decision-making by advancing data integration, governance, analytics, and AI-driven insights across enabling functions.
Ensure the integrity, security, and governance of enterprise data, particularly across employee, communications, legal, and strategic partnership data sets.
Focus on process optimization and automation to streamline workflows across HR, communications, compliance, and business development, reducing manual effort and improving user experience.
Risk Management and Compliance: Ensure technology solutions align with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and global compliance standards, particularly in HR data privacy and legal/regulatory domains.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of technology solutions across enterprise platforms and business units.
Manage and mentor a global team of technology professionals, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, including AI, digital workplace tools, and enterprise platforms, ensuring the organization remains at the forefront of innovation.
Develop and maintain relationships with external partners, vendors, and stakeholders to enhance enterprise capabilities and support enabling function strategies.
Provide strategic leadership to a global technology organization, setting vision, priorities, and operating model to effectively support Enabling Functions.
Champion change management and adoption, partnering with functional leaders to ensure successful implementation of new technologies, processes, and ways of working.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, influencing decision-making and aligning technology priorities with broader business strategy and transformation efforts.
Promote strong cross-functional collaboration and communication, ensuring alignment between GTS teams and business stakeholders, and removing barriers to execution.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree with 14+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 10+ years of experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; Master’s preferred.
Extensive experience in technology leadership roles supporting enterprise or corporate functions (e.g., HR, Legal, Communications, Commercial/BD).
Strong understanding of enterprise platforms such as HRIS systems, collaboration tools, document management systems, and compliance technologies.
Proficiency in software development, data management, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and enterprise architecture.
Familiarity with regulatory and compliance standards relevant to HR, data privacy, and legal domains (e.g., GDPR).
Experience leveraging AI and automation to improve enterprise operations and employee or stakeholder experience.
Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple global priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in technology leadership roles within the Biotech/pharmaceutical industry.
Strong knowledge of AI technologies and their application in the Biotech industry.

Global team management responsibilities
Global Competencies

Continuous Learning

jobs.title: Director of Data Governance
jobs.text:
The Director of Data Governance sits within Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance and leads the evolution of DeepHealth's data ecosystem into a unified, high-quality enterprise asset. The role owns strategic design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Data Governance Framework so data is accurate, secure, and ready for advanced analytics and AI initiatives.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Define and execute a Data Governance roadmap aligned with the Enterprise Information and Governance vision.
Review, maintain, and enforce the Data Management Policy and Data Governance Charter against current regulatory and business needs.
Facilitate decision-making on data standards and help resolve cross-functional data conflicts.
Implement Data Quality Management procedures and establish KPIs for data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Define enterprise-wide data standards, including metadata management, data lineage, and master data management protocols.
Partner with IT and Security so data pipelines support AI applications while maintaining security boundaries.
Work with Security to define data classification levels and manage high-risk data access policies.
Ensure data practices adhere to applicable global privacy regulations and internal Enterprise Information and Governance mandates.
Align data governance priorities with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.
Mentor and develop team members as the data governance capability grows.
Requirements
Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).
7 to 10 years of progressive experience in Data Management, Data Governance, or Information Architecture in healthcare, medical technology, or another highly regulated industry (required).
Strong experience with DAMA-DMBOK frameworks and data quality lifecycle management (required).
Deep understanding of data profiling tools, metadata management, and modern data stack concepts (required).
Experience with AI systems in production or product development contexts (required).
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including explaining complex concepts to diverse audiences (required).
High level of integrity and confidentiality (required).
Preferred: Master's degree or advanced relevant certifications.
Quality Standards
Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.
Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
Practices universal safety precautions.
Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.
Travel
This position requires travel up to approximately 10%.
Working Environment
European Union. Remote-friendly or office-based role.
Physical Demands
The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Salary:

100,000.00-110,000.00 in France

jobs.title: Director of Product, Customer Experience
jobs.text:
About Voltus
Voltus is the leading platform connecting distributed energy resources to electricity markets, delivering less expensive, more reliable, and more sustainable electricity. Our commercial and industrial customers and grid services partners generate cash by allowing Voltus to maximize the value of their flexible load, distributed generation, energy storage, energy efficiency, and electric vehicle resources in these markets.
At Voltus, we live by the mantra "doing well by doing good" — and that includes actively doing our best by our team, clients, and partners.
Role Overview
Voltus is seeking an exceptional Director of Product Management to lead the team that owns the core customer-facing aspects of our platform. Reporting to the VP of Product & Design, you will lead critical product areas including customer dispatch, customer performance, market settlement, customer hardware and metering data, and the overall customer financial experience — all of which are essential to driving trust, value, and retention for customers.
As Voltus scales into new resource types, customer segments, and markets, this is the role that turns our market-leading position into a market-leading customer experience — one that lets customers self-serve, understand their economics, and earn more value per MW under management. Success means helping customers win because we've made it easy for them to perform.
This is a high-ownership leadership role with the opportunity to define bold strategy, build and scale a high-performing PM team, and apply deep product expertise to some of the most complex, commercially meaningful problems in energy. It's also a player-coach role: you will coach and develop the PMs on your team while staying hands-on, driving delivery for core features yourself. You and your team will partner closely with our market platform PM team, engineering, design, energy markets, and commercial leadership to deliver intuitive, scalable solutions that make it easier for customers to participate in (and profit from) electricity markets.
Voltus is a fully remote company. Candidates must reside and be authorized to work in the United States or Canada, aligned to a US time zone.
What You'll Do
Define and drive product strategy across the customer experience — dispatch, performance, settlement, metering and hardware data, and the financial experience — from how customers enroll and manage their assets to how they understand and trust every dollar Voltus earns them.
Lead and grow a team of product managers as a player-coach, fostering a culture of extreme ownership, rapid velocity, and customer obsession while staying close to the craft, and modeling how AI raises the ceiling on what a small, sharp product team can deliver.
Build a customer experience that scales, turning a historically high-touch, service-led relationship into a product customers can self-serve, and one ready for new resource types, segments, and markets.
Collaborate cross-functionally with the market platform PM team, engineering, design, energy markets, GTM, and executive leadership to prioritize, build, and ship impactful solutions at scale.
Balance vision and execution, moving fluidly between long-term strategy and hands-on product design, discovery, experimentation, and iteration.
Own the metrics that matter: customer engagement, retention, settlement accuracy, value per MW, and financial transparency. You don't just ship features; you create outcomes.
Qualifications & Skills
10+ years in Product Management, with at least 3+ years leading and scaling PM teams in high-growth environments.
Deep expertise in energy markets, specifically demand response, DER participation, energy storage, or grid services. You understand enrollment, dispatch, performance measurement, and settlement, and you can hold your own with our Energy Markets team. This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.
Proven track record shipping customer-facing products at scale, ideally turning high-touch, data intensive, financially driven relationships into scalable, self-serve product experiences.
Player-coach orientation, you want to lead and develop a team and stay close to the craft, and you're energized by both.
Fluency turning economic complexity into trust. You've built experiences where customers need to understand the financials — earnings, settlement, performance.
A track record of bringing AI into how product teams work. You've introduced AI tools and practices into a product organization — not just shipped AI features — and measurably improved how your team does discovery, writes specs, prototypes, and ships features. You can bring skeptics along and set a standard others follow.
Scrappy and action-oriented. You move fast, make hard calls with incomplete information but honed intuition, and do what needs to be done.
Effective communicator and cross-functional influencer, including at the executive level.
Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).
Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.
At Voltus, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer because we recognize that a diverse organization begins with a diverse candidate pool. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status, or marital status.

Voltus is a fully remote company. Candidates must reside and be authorized to work in the United States or Canada, aligned to a US time zone.
What You'll Do

Define and drive product strategy across the customer experience — dispatch, performance, settlement, metering and hardware data, and the financial experience — from how customers enroll and manage their assets to how they understand and trust every dollar Voltus earns them.

Lead and grow a team of product managers as a player-coach, fostering a culture of extreme ownership, rapid velocity, and customer obsession while staying close to the craft, and modeling how AI raises the ceiling on what a small, sharp product team can deliver.

Build a customer experience that scales, turning a historically high-touch, service-led relationship into a product customers can self-serve, and one ready for new resource types, segments, and markets.
Collaborate cross-functionally with the market platform PM team, engineering, design, energy markets, GTM, and executive leadership to prioritize, build, and ship impactful solutions at scale.
Balance vision and execution, moving fluidly between long-term strategy and hands-on product design, discovery, experimentation, and iteration.
Own the metrics that matter: customer engagement, retention, settlement accuracy, value per MW, and financial transparency. You don't just ship features; you create outcomes.
Qualifications & Skills
10+ years in Product Management, with at least 3+ years leading and scaling PM teams in high-growth environments.

Deep expertise in energy markets, specifically demand response, DER participation, energy storage, or grid services. You understand enrollment, dispatch, performance measurement, and settlement, and you can hold your own with our Energy Markets team. This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.
Proven track record shipping customer-facing products at scale, ideally turning high-touch, data intensive, financially driven relationships into scalable, self-serve product experiences.
Player-coach orientation, you want to lead and develop a team and stay close to the craft, and you're energized by both.
Fluency turning economic complexity into trust. You've built experiences where customers need to understand the financials — earnings, settlement, performance.

A track record of bringing AI into how product teams work. You've introduced AI tools and practices into a product organization — not just shipped AI features — and measurably improved how your team does discovery, writes specs, prototypes, and ships features. You can bring skeptics along and set a standard others follow.
Scrappy and action-oriented. You move fast, make hard calls with incomplete information but honed intuition, and do what needs to be done.
Effective communicator and cross-functional influencer, including at the executive level.

Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).

Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.

At Voltus, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer because we recognize that a diverse organization begins with a diverse candidate pool. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status, or marital status.

jobs.title: Head of Product and Identity Security
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE TEAM:
The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, and Threat Detection & Response.
Product Security (this role!) consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.
Identity (this role!) is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.
Threat Detection & Response focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We're proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.
While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.
As the Head of Product and Identity Security, you'll own two of those three areas, reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and operating as a peer to the Head of Threat Detection & Response. The remit spans application security, penetration testing, cloud security, artificial intelligence (AI) security, secure architecture, identity, and vulnerability operations. You'll lead a global team across the UK, Eastern Europe, and India, and you'll stay close to the technology: this is a player-manager role, where credibility is earned by doing the work as well as directing it. This is a real opportunity to make an impact and have senior influence on the cyber resilience strategy at Tide.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
As a Head of Product and Identity Security you will:
Defining the product and identity security strategy in conjunction with the CISO and operationalising it into a funded, sequenced roadmap that the team can execute against.
Leading, coaching, and growing a global team across the UK, Eastern Europe, and India; setting clear objectives; running regular 1:1s; and supporting career growth and progression.
Owning application security end-to-end, from secure design reviews and threat modelling through to secure coding standards, tooling, and remediation of findings.
Running the penetration testing programme across web, mobile and infrastructure, including internal testing and the management of external partners, and staying hands-on where it counts.
Owning cloud security posture across our cloud estate, covering configuration, workload protection, detection coverage in partnership with Threat Detection & Response, and the guardrails that keep engineering fast and safe.
Setting the approach to AI and agentic security, covering how models, agents and machine learning (ML) pipelines are designed, deployed, monitored and defended, and keeping that approach current as the technology moves.
Owning secure architecture so that security requirements are embedded from the ground up in new products, platforms, and integrations rather than retrofitted.
Owning Tide's staff identity platform and the wider identity and access management (IAM) roadmap, including zero trust, multi-factor authentication, role-based access control, and joiner, mover, and leaver processes.
Standing up and running a rapid-response vulnerability operations capability, with clear service levels for triage and remediation, and tight integration with security operations (SecOps) and engineering.
Facing off directly with executives, product leaders, and engineering leadership across the business; articulating risk, trade-offs, and investment cases in language each audience can act on.
Delivering the security enablement and security champions programmes so engineering teams can move quickly without security becoming a bottleneck.
Acting as a senior escalation point for product and identity security issues, including during high-severity incidents, working alongside Threat Detection & Response.
Recruiting and onboarding new team members as the function scales, and building technical capability across the team through mentoring and structured upskilling.
Owning performance management for the team, including feedback, development plans, and, where needed, managing underperformance.
Defining and reporting the metrics that demonstrate whether the programme is working, including vulnerability ageing and remediation, coverage of secure design reviews, and the reach and effect of enablement activity.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
At least ten years of overall experience in cybersecurity, including at least five years in a comparable leadership role, ideally within a technology company or fintech.
A background as a hands-on security engineer, ideally including application and/or mobile penetration testing, and the appetite to remain technical as a player-manager.
Great knowledge of AI, agentic security, and ML, and a clear point of view on how to secure them in production.
A strong grasp of threat modelling, and the ability to articulate risk credibly to both engineering and non-technical audiences.
A proven track record of delivering successful security enablement and security champions programmes.
Highly organized, with the ability to operationalize a programme and define strategy in conjunction with the CISO.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to face off to executives in the business directly.
Experience leading distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones.
Excellent spoken and written communication skills.
Nice to have:
Experience with identity providers (IdPs), privileged access management (PAM), and broader IAM tooling, such as Okta, Ping, and ConductorOne, or equivalents.
Experience standing up a rapid-response vulnerability operations or remediation operations function and integrating it with SecOps.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery
jobs.text:
Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery
Location: Saudi Arabia / Riyadh
Employment Type: Full-time
Company: nakhla.ai
Reports to: CEO
About nakhla.ai
nakhla.ai builds enterprise-grade, AI-enabled software solutions that help organizations automate operations, integrate business systems, and deploy intelligent agents securely at scale.
Our platform combines enterprise applications, intelligent automation, system integrations, workflow orchestration, and AI capabilities to deliver measurable business outcomes for organizations.
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery to lead the design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing delivery of enterprise technology solutions.
This role combines solution architecture, customer implementation, platform engineering, technical program management, operational reliability, security, quality assurance, and delivery leadership.
The successful candidate will own the customer delivery lifecycle, starting with technical discovery and solution design and continuing through configuration, integration, testing, deployment, production readiness, and post-launch stabilization.
This is not a traditional project management or advisory position. The candidate must be technically strong, commercially aware, customer-facing, and capable of making practical architecture and delivery decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Solution Architecture
Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers and key stakeholders.
Understand customer business processes, operational requirements, existing systems, security constraints, and success criteria.
Translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures and implementation plans.
Design solutions involving enterprise applications, APIs, AI agents, workflow automation, identity management, data migration, and third-party integrations.
Define system boundaries, data flows, integration patterns, security controls, and deployment models.
Ensure customer requirements align with nakhla.ai’s long-term product and platform strategy.
Challenge unnecessary customization and identify opportunities to create reusable product capabilities.
Produce solution architecture documents, technical specifications, implementation blueprints, and acceptance criteria.
Customer Implementation and Delivery
Own enterprise implementation projects from initial kickoff through production launch.
Develop delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and risk mitigation strategies.
Coordinate internal engineering teams, external partners, and customer stakeholders.
Manage project scope, priorities, timelines, risks, and customer expectations.
Configure enterprise applications, workflows, roles, permissions, approval processes, and business rules.
Oversee data migration, validation, reconciliation, and production transition activities.
Lead user acceptance testing, customer training, deployment readiness, and go-live planning.
Ensure implementation decisions, configurations, and technical dependencies are documented clearly.
Manage post-launch stabilization and transition customers into ongoing support and operations.
Platform Engineering and Integrations
Contribute directly to backend services, system integrations, APIs, and platform components when required.
Design and implement secure integrations with customer applications, financial systems, productivity platforms, identity providers, databases, and external services.
Work with APIs, webhooks, message queues, event-driven architectures, authentication protocols, service accounts, and secure credential management.
Support the architecture of multi-tenant enterprise systems and customer data isolation.
Contribute to platform capabilities related to authentication, authorization, usage tracking, billing, auditability, and observability.
Review technical designs and code to ensure maintainability, scalability, reliability, and security.
Establish reusable integration patterns, technical standards, implementation templates, and engineering best practices.
Enterprise Applications and Business Processes
Lead discovery, configuration, customization, migration, and integration activities for enterprise business systems.
Map customer processes across finance, procurement, sales, inventory, operations, human resources, and other business functions.
Configure workflows, approval processes, roles, permissions, reports, and operational controls.
Ensure data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation during migration from existing systems.
Identify where standard platform functionality should be used instead of unnecessary custom development.
Work closely with finance, operations, technology, and executive stakeholders to validate business logic and controls.
Ensure implemented solutions support customer governance, accountability, and operational requirements.
AI and Intelligent Automation
Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate intelligent agents and automation into enterprise processes.
Define safe and auditable agent actions, permissions, tools, approval requirements, and escalation paths.
Design human-in-the-loop workflows for sensitive, regulated, or high-impact operations.
Ensure AI-enabled capabilities comply with customer security, privacy, governance, and operational requirements.
Support the integration of AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, documents, APIs, and communication systems.
Evaluate AI use cases based on business value, operational feasibility, technical complexity, implementation risk, and scalability.
Establish monitoring, evaluation, testing, and quality controls for production AI systems.
Ensure AI capabilities remain explainable, traceable, controlled, and aligned with customer policies.
Security, Infrastructure, and Reliability
Define and enforce deployment, infrastructure, security, and operational standards.
Support cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, environment management, and release processes.
Establish appropriate separation between development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Implement or oversee monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, backups, and disaster recovery procedures.
Ensure secure secrets management, credential rotation, network controls, encryption, and access governance.
Contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and production reliability improvements.
Ensure customer environments meet agreed security, availability, performance, and data protection requirements.
Support enterprise security reviews, technical due diligence, risk assessments, and compliance readiness activities.
Maintain operational documentation, recovery procedures, escalation paths, and production support standards.
Quality Assurance
Define quality standards, release gates, and acceptance criteria.
Establish automated testing practices for APIs, integrations, permissions, workflows, data processing, and critical user journeys.
Ensure testing covers customer data isolation, role-based access, authentication, authorization, billing, data integrity, and intelligent agent behavior.
Coordinate functional, integration, regression, security, performance, and user acceptance testing.
Prevent production releases without appropriate validation, documentation, rollback plans, monitoring, and approvals.
Track defects, production incidents, recurring failures, and quality trends across implementations.
Ensure lessons from customer deployments are incorporated into platform and delivery improvements.
Delivery Operations and Team Leadership
Build repeatable delivery processes, implementation methodologies, templates, checklists, and operational playbooks.
Define ownership, accountability, and handoff points across sales, product, engineering, implementation, and support.
Improve implementation speed, delivery predictability, solution quality, and customer satisfaction.
Mentor engineers, implementation specialists, solution architects, and technical project team members.
Support the hiring and development of the future solutions engineering and delivery organization.
Identify delivery bottlenecks and recommend organizational, operational, or technical improvements.
Provide clear reporting on project status, risks, dependencies, resource needs, and delivery performance.
Participate in customer proposals, technical presentations, solution demonstrations, commercial discussions, and statements of work.
Ensure delivery commitments are realistic, measurable, and aligned with available capabilities and resources.

Support the architecture of multi-tenant enterprise systems and customer data isolation.
Contribute to platform capabilities related to authentication, authorization, usage tracking, billing, auditability, and observability.
Review technical designs and code to ensure maintainability, scalability, reliability, and security.
Establish reusable integration patterns, technical standards, implementation templates, and engineering best practices.

blocks.text: Enterprise Applications and Business Processes

items: Lead discovery, configuration, customization, migration, and integration activities for enterprise business systems.

Ensure data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation during migration from existing systems.
Identify where standard platform functionality should be used instead of unnecessary custom development.
Work closely with finance, operations, technology, and executive stakeholders to validate business logic and controls.
Ensure implemented solutions support customer governance, accountability, and operational requirements.

blocks.text: AI and Intelligent Automation

Support the integration of AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, documents, APIs, and communication systems.
Evaluate AI use cases based on business value, operational feasibility, technical complexity, implementation risk, and scalability.
Establish monitoring, evaluation, testing, and quality controls for production AI systems.
Ensure AI capabilities remain explainable, traceable, controlled, and aligned with customer policies.

blocks.text: Security, Infrastructure, and Reliability

items: Define and enforce deployment, infrastructure, security, and operational standards.

Contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and production reliability improvements.
Ensure customer environments meet agreed security, availability, performance, and data protection requirements.
Support enterprise security reviews, technical due diligence, risk assessments, and compliance readiness activities.
Maintain operational documentation, recovery procedures, escalation paths, and production support standards.

blocks.text: Quality Assurance

About IMG Academy IMG Academy is the world’s leading sports education brand, providing a holistic education model that empowers student-athletes to win their future while preparing them for college and for life. IMG Academy has been nationally recognized by organizations including Sports Business Journal, USA Today, and the Best and Brightest Companies to Work For for its workplace culture, innovation, and commitment to developing people both on and off the field.
IMG Academy provides growth opportunities for student-athletes and partners through an innovative suite of on-campus and online experiences:
Boarding school and camps, delivered on a state-of-the-art campus in Bradenton, Florida
Online coaching through IMG Academy+, focused on personal development through the lens of sport and performance
Online college recruiting through NCSA College Recruiting and SportsRecruits, providing industry-leading recruiting education, tools, and access to a network of more than 40,000 college coaches for student-athletes, families, club coaches, and event operators
Elevate by IMG Academy, a performance and personal development solution that delivers mindset, leadership, and wellbeing programming to schools, colleges, and organizations through a combination of digital content and immersive experiences
Position Summary As the Vice President, Data, you will lead transformative initiatives across omnichannel customer technology, enterprise data, analytics, and data science. Reporting directly to the SVP of Product, Data & Commercial Technology, this role is responsible for driving customer engagement, revenue growth, operational efficiency, and digital transformation across a multi-brand enterprise serving both B2B and B2C customers. The VP owns the strategy, execution, and evolution of the enterprise data roadmap, overseeing data infrastructure, business intelligence, analytics, and data science capabilities that enable personalized customer experiences, data-driven decision-making, and scalable business growth. This leader will also build, develop, and inspire high-performing teams while fostering a culture of innovation and engineering excellence.
You will lead two key functions:
Data Engineering & Business Intelligence: Responsible for modernizing enterprise data infrastructure, data platforms, governance, and business intelligence engineering.
Data Science & Analytics: Responsible for advanced analytics, machine learning, and applied data science to improve customer acquisition, onboarding, retention, engagement, and overall business performance.
You have a proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives from strategy through execution. You excel at delivering enterprise-wide programs aligned with C-suite priorities, driving measurable business outcomes while managing long-term initiatives across internal and external stakeholders. This is a highly collaborative leadership role, partnering closely with the Chief Commercial Officer, Business Unit COOs, SVP of Product & Design, SVP of Product Engineering, executive leadership, board members, and cross-functional teams to translate strategic business objectives into scalable technology solutions and deliver an integrated commercial, product, and customer experience strategy. You are a strategic, business-minded leader who builds high-performing organizations, leads through change, and consistently delivers results. You foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and empowered teams while maintaining a strong focus on business outcomes, innovation, and engineering excellence.
Position Responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership & Vision
Define and execute a comprehensive technology strategy for commercial systems, data infrastructure, and customer engagement platforms.
Build the next-generation customer engagement "Engine,” delivering measurable improvements in customer acquisition, retention, ARPU, and EBITDA.
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders from the board to practitioner- level to align technology initiatives with business objectives driving digital transformation.
Integrate data functions, unifying data infrastructure, creating self-service BI capacity, and optimizing teams to align data and analytics efforts with commercial, product, and CX goals.
Champion the shift to an integrated commercial and product strategy by enabling self- service for functional teams and delivering more high-value algorithmic work using AI/ML.
Team Leadership and Development
Build and scale a high-performing team of ~25 FTEs and consultants, including resources for Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science.
Lead the transformation of the Data organization into a value-driven (vs. technology-driven) model supporting commercial, digital product, and customer experience domains.
Guide the evolution of the team from baseline support to a mature omnichannel enablement organization leveraging data and insights to drive revenue, EBITDA and NPS.
Develop a leadership layer across Data and Engine functions through internal advancement, role re-definition, and strategic hiring to create scale and accountability for stakeholders.
Cultivate a culture of value delivery, transparency, and accountability, while driving iterative improvement, greater operational rigor and prioritization of high-value ML innovation work.
Technology Leadership
Direct the modernization of enterprise-wide data infrastructure, BI, analytics and data science tools, migrating, consolidating and standardizing tools and vendors.
Ensure alignment between BI, analytics, and Data Science initiatives and business goals, leveraging continuous testing and optimization to enhance customer and enterprise value.
Ensure alignment between commercial technology initiatives and customer-facing product roadmap, software development and integration initiatives.
Partner with external vendors including Salesforce, AWS, and implementation partners, to deliver cost-effective solutions while maintaining strategic direction and execution quality.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with the Chief Commercial Officer, COO for Online, COO for Campus, and SVP Product to ensure seamless execution of commercial technology strategies.
Collaborate with sales, marketing and partner leadership to align technology with operational goals, while navigating resistance and driving adoption.
Present strategies and outcomes to executive leadership and the Board, leveraging data and analysis to build consensus and drive decisions.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
15+ years progressive tech leadership experience with 7+ years in senior management roles.
Experience leading large-scale, full-lifecycle digital transformation initiatives and platform consolidations in B2B and B2C settings, managing internal teams and external partners.
Experience merging disparate systems and teams, with a focus on enabling personalized customer experiences for omnichannel, multi-product customer acquisition and retention.
Proven track-record leading and executing technology and data-specific transformation initiatives delivering compelling measurable impact.
Senior-level leadership background across high-growth entrepreneurial environments and companies undergoing transformational changes in corporate development.
Hands-on experience leading teams in creating business leverage (Revenue, EBITDA, NPS) using commercial technology and customer engagement platforms to grow and scale these capabilities on a strategic basis.
Track record building and scaling high-performing technical and business-facing teams
Deep understanding of the modern data stack and its deployment for BI, Analytics and Data Science applications in commercial and product use cases, with a track record of successful implementations at scale.
Demonstrated success partnering with boards, C-level executives and cross-functional implementation teams, navigating resistance and generating buy-in from stakeholders
Superior communication skills, with an emphasis on brevity, clarity, and data-driven persuasion.
Industry experience in education, B2C, or consumer-facing products/services required.
Background Requirements:
Requires a background check upon offer
Benefits:
As a full-time member of our team, you will enjoy a comprehensive offering listed below. Connect with your talent acquisition specialist to learn more about benefits for our part-time roles.
Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision
Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account options
401k with an Employer Match
Short Term and Long Term Disability
Group and Supplemental Life & AD&D
Gym Discount Program
Pet Insurance
Wellbeing Program
and more!
Don’t meet every single requirement? We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

You are a strategic, business-minded leader who builds high-performing organizations, leads through change, and consistently delivers results. You foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and empowered teams while maintaining a strong focus on business outcomes, innovation, and engineering excellence.

Strategic Leadership & Vision

items: Define and execute a comprehensive technology strategy for commercial systems, data infrastructure, and customer engagement platforms.
Build the next-generation customer engagement "Engine,” delivering measurable improvements in customer acquisition, retention, ARPU, and EBITDA.
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders from the board to practitioner- level to align technology initiatives with business objectives driving digital transformation.
Integrate data functions, unifying data infrastructure, creating self-service BI capacity, and optimizing teams to align data and analytics efforts with commercial, product, and CX goals.
Champion the shift to an integrated commercial and product strategy by enabling self- service for functional teams and delivering more high-value algorithmic work using AI/ML.

blocks.text: Team Leadership and Development

items: Build and scale a high-performing team of ~25 FTEs and consultants, including resources for Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science.
Lead the transformation of the Data organization into a value-driven (vs. technology-driven) model supporting commercial, digital product, and customer experience domains.
Guide the evolution of the team from baseline support to a mature omnichannel enablement organization leveraging data and insights to drive revenue, EBITDA and NPS.
Develop a leadership layer across Data and Engine functions through internal advancement, role re-definition, and strategic hiring to create scale and accountability for stakeholders.
Cultivate a culture of value delivery, transparency, and accountability, while driving iterative improvement, greater operational rigor and prioritization of high-value ML innovation work.

blocks.text: Technology Leadership

items: Direct the modernization of enterprise-wide data infrastructure, BI, analytics and data science tools, migrating, consolidating and standardizing tools and vendors.
Ensure alignment between BI, analytics, and Data Science initiatives and business goals, leveraging continuous testing and optimization to enhance customer and enterprise value.

jobs.title: Fractional Director of Technology (Advisor Network)
jobs.text:
Opportunity Overview
Arootah engages a curated network of senior operators to support clients across the alternative investment industry, including hedge funds, private equity firms, and family offices. Advisors are deployed on project-based engagements when client needs match their expertise. Joining the network does not guarantee placement; it provides access to opportunities as they arise.
Why Join the Arootah Network
Alt-industry-only engagements with hedge funds, private equity firms, and family offices
Project-based work that fits around existing commitments
Client origination and engagement management handled by Arootah; advisors focus on delivery
About Arootah
Arootah is a talent solutions firm purpose-built for the alternative investment industry. We advise and we execute, covering the full talent spectrum from entry to exit across five services: Talent Acquisition, Fractional Leadership, Talent Development, Retention & Compensation, and Transition.
Most talent firms solve one problem. Because we cover the full spectrum, we can help clients identify and solve the right one. We start with diagnosis, then deliver.
Our team has run alternative investment firms at the highest levels as COOs, CFOs, and CCOs. That operator experience, combined with 15+ years of alternatives-specific recruiting and a network of 700+ vetted advisors across 18 functional disciplines, is what makes the advice credible and the execution reliable. We also draw on a network of 600+ coaches, deploying those with specific experience guiding senior executives in the alternatives industry.
One industry. One talent partner. Entry to exit.
Learn more:
Who We’re Looking For
Arootah is searching for experienced Directors of Technology to consult to our highly prestigious client base. As a consultant, you will work with our Alternative Asset Firm and Family Office clients to provide expert advice. Having previously served in this leadership role, you have specific, hands-on experience strategically supporting the efforts of the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in building, maintaining, and overseeing the full technology (hardware and software) infrastructure and operations of a leading Alternative Asset Firm or Family Office.
Core Areas of Expertise
Best practice reviews.
Developing realistic and effective action plans.
Breaking apart goals into actionable steps.
Advising on vendor selection and oversight.
Creating and implementing policies, procedures, and control measures.
Evaluating each client’s advancement toward goal actualization through key performance indicators (KPIs) and scoring matrices.
Special projects or other areas of need.
Assist and support the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in managing all aspects of the day-to-day management and oversight of the full tech stack across the organization: software (full stack, mobile/web apps, AR/VR, metaverse), hardware (IT, IoT, connected devices), cybersecurity, operations (internal, external), policies, etc.
Lead and manage the design, development, and deployment of new applications, systems software, and/or enhancements to existing applications.
Ensure application optimization and transformation to enable corporate partners continued business growth and expansion.
Supervise and implement a proactive cybersecurity, disaster recovery and business continuity planning mindset across the firm to maintain industry-leading uptime on critical technology infrastructure through successful monitoring, testing processes, and system redundancy.
Provide resource management and communication across multiple product and engagement teams that rely on and are impacted by technology. Support and influence user adoption and user understanding, such as through training and demos.
Optimize and supervise IT infrastructure to ensure integrity, security, and optimal performance of an office-based and remote, distributed, and growing team of employees and contractors to the standards of leading financial service organizations.
Oversee and provide technical direction, management support and daily guidance to IT staff, ensuring adherence to technology policies, security controls, regulatory requirements, and company policies.
Working with the CTO, establish and monitor KPIs to continuously track, measure, and drive productivity.
Generate new ideas and creative solutions to complex business problems; support the development of technology roadmaps that align with business current and future needs.
Advise CTO and senior leadership on issues affecting the operations and/or strategic direction of the Technology team.
What You Bring
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
MBA or other relevant graduate degree is a plus.
6+ years of proven experience as a Director of Technology at an Alternative Asset Firm or family office.
Strong technical knowledge and expertise in all facets of IT, including Application Teams, Information Security, Business Process Management, Program and Portfolio Management, IT Partner and Supplier Management, IT Architecture Management, Digital Platforms, and IT Infrastructure and Operations.
Strong experience with Investment Technology vendors for both hosted and on-prem platforms. This could include derivatives platforms (e.g. Calypso, Murex), investment accounting platforms (e.g. Eagle, ePam), OMS vendors (e.g. Aladdin, CRD) and others (e.g. Bloomberg, FactSet).
Expertise in budget & resource planning/monitoring to ensure budget optimization.
Strong understanding of the business processes in the regulated environment of investment management and financial services firms.
Ability to collaborate and succeed in a fast-paced environment while maintaining focus on on-time delivery, customer satisfaction (both internal and external) and team morale.

jobs.title: VP of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
About CoLab
At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions. Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design. Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster.
Founded in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company. We’ve recently been recognized on Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post.
About the Role
This role is for a high-impact engineering leader who has been in the trenches at fast-scaling startups — someone who has grown from individual contributor to leader and helped scale engineering orgs through multiple phases of growth. Ideally, you've done it more than once.
As VP of Software Engineering, you'll be responsible for building and maintaining a high-performing, scalable engineering organization across Product Development, Ops, and Technical Support. This is a role for someone who’s hands-on enough to spot an issue in a pull request, and strategic enough to influence long-term roadmap, product vision, and cross-functional priorities.
You'll partner closely with Product and Design to ship great software faster, with fewer surprises. You'll also work directly with customers and support our GTM motion, stepping in when technical insight is needed on strategic deals or customer challenges.
Our Ideal Candidate
You’ve helped scale at least one startup through a period of fast growth (Series A → C or similar), and ideally done it more than once.
You’ve grown from IC to leadership, and know what it takes to help others do the same.
You’re low ego, high respect. People seek out your input not because of your title, but because you are good at what you do, genuinely helpful and motivating to work with.
You’re a builder at heart — pragmatic, resourceful, and relentlessly focused on outcomes.
What You’ll Do
Lead Software Engineering within CoLab’s Product Development org
Guide and grow our teams to improve quality, development speed and confidence
Partner with Product to drive roadmap planning, resource allocation, and feasibility tradeoffs
Ensure compliance with key standards (e.g. SOC 2, ISO) through a mature SDLC
Set and manage operating metrics (e.g. uptime, velocity, quality, cost) that drive business value
Help scale our team with world-class talent and build functions that support career growth across the team
Collaborate across departments — from GTM to CS — to support technical enablement and customer success
Join CoLab’s Senior Leadership Team and help shape company strategy across all areas of the business
What You’ll Bring
Significant experience as a software developer, including on large-scale SaaS systems
Experience with modern cloud tech stacks. Ours is: React, Python, GraphQL, Postgres, AWS
Strong knowledge of AI solutions for software development and experience deploying AI coding solutions at scale
5+ years in engineering leadership roles, with experience managing managers
Proven ability to scale teams and processes during periods of high growth
Familiarity with building secure, compliant software in a regulated environment
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Experience directly supporting customer conversations and technical sales
Extra Details
Compensation: This is a full-time, permanent position with an attractive compensation package that includes a stock options package.
Benefits: This role offers an extended health and benefits package that includes unlimited paid vacation and RRSP matching.
Remote/Hybrid Work: Our main office location is in St. John’s, NL where we offer hybrid and remote opportunities. This role has the flexibility to work from anywhere within Canada.
Equity Note
Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.
