jobs.text:
Are you driven to bring people, technology, and strategy together to build impactful software?
Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber, they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!
THE PROBLEM YOU’D OWN
Jobber has AI in production, but not yet at its full potential.
We already have AI answering calls, drafting responses, and powering parts of our product. But today, those systems are still fragmented. Some teams are ahead. Others aren’t. Some workflows are intelligent. Others are still manual. And most importantly, the system doesn’t yet think across the product.
A service pro still has to:
Manually follow up on jobs
Piece together context across workflows
Decide what to do next
The platform doesn’t proactively help them run their business. That’s the gap.
The opportunity is to evolve Jobber from: AI-powered features → AI-powered workflows → AI-powered business operations
This role owns that shift. Not a team. Not a feature. The system.
THE CUSTOMER
You’re building for people who don’t have time to think about software.
A plumber finishing their last job at 6 pm
A cleaner managing 30 clients and 5 employees
A landscaper juggling scheduling, payments, and follow-ups
They’re not asking for “AI.” They’re asking:
“What should I do next?”
“Why didn’t this job convert?”
“Who should I follow up with today?”
And eventually:
They shouldn’t have to ask at all.
The Director who succeeds here will understand:
This isn’t about building clever systems; it’s about building systems that remove thinking from already overwhelmed people.
WHAT YOU’D OWN
End-to-end ownership of Jobber’s AI system layer. You’re not owning a single team. You’re owning how intelligence flows across the entire product.
Product + Platform Scope
AI Foundations (models, orchestration, evals, guardrails)
Copilot (user-facing intelligence layer)
Automations (workflow execution layer)
Platform Experience / Marketplace (integration + ecosystem surface)
Emerging surfaces (voice, messaging, cross-product intelligence)
What this actually means
You are responsible for:
How decisions get made inside the system
How context moves across workflows
How actions get triggered (and when they shouldn’t)
How we evaluate whether AI is actually working
This includes:
Agentic workflows (reason → decide → act → evaluate)
Cross-product context (jobs, customers, payments, communication)
Reliability, safety, and failure modes
Developer experience for building on top of AI systems
Team Structure
~30 engineers across 4–6 teams
4–6 EMs / Sr EMs reporting into you
Close partnership with Product, Design, Data
WHAT “GOOD” LOOKS LIKE
Not “we shipped AI features.”
Instead:
The system proactively recommends and takes actions
Teams build on shared AI primitives, not reinventing them
AI output is reliable, measurable, and improving over time
Engineers trust the system, and move faster because of it
Customers feel like the product is working for them, not just responding
THE AI BAR (THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT)
We are not looking for:
Someone who rolled out Copilot internally
Someone who used LLM APIs for features
Someone adjacent to AI
We are looking for someone who has:
Built real systems where AI makes decisions and takes actions in production.
That means experience with:
Agent orchestration (not just prompts)
Tool use and workflow execution
Evaluation (offline + online)
Observability and failure handling
Guardrails and safety in real systems
Tradeoffs between autonomy vs. control
You don’t need to code daily, but you must be able to reason at the system level.
WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO
Define how AI should work across Jobber, not just within a team
Build and evolve a multi-team org to execute on that vision
Make tradeoffs between speed, quality, and safety
Push teams beyond feature thinking into system thinking
Challenge assumptions, including leadership’s
Drive adoption across engineering, product, and the company
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Leadership
You’ve led orgs through complexity, not just growth.
Managed managers across multiple teams
Built organizations that scale (not just teams that ship)
Driven cross-org alignment in ambiguous spaces
Product + Systems Thinking
You think in systems, not features.
You understand how user workflows connect end-to-end
You’ve partnered deeply with Product and Design
You care about customer outcomes, not just technical output
AI Depth (non-negotiable)
You’ve built or led production LLM/agentic systems.
You understand what actually works (and what doesn’t)
You’ve seen systems fail and improved them
You have opinions about evaluation, reliability, and safety
Execution
You can move fast without breaking everything.
You’ve balanced shipping vs infrastructure vs tech debt
You know when to iterate and when to redesign
WHY JOBBER · WHY NOW?
This is not “AI theatre.”
We already have:
AI Receptionist (live, handling real customer calls)
AI features embedded across the product
250,000+ businesses using the platform
What we don’t have yet is: A unified, intelligent system across the product.
That’s what this role builds.
TLDR:
Most Director roles optimize delivery. This one defines: How an entire product becomes intelligent.
Compensation:
At Jobber, we also believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $221,800 CAD, a midpoint of $261,000 CAD, and a maximum salary of $300,100 CAD, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.
We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.
We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!
What you can expect from Jobber:
A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.
A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.
A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.
To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.
We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.
A bit more about us:
Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

Close partnership with Product, Design, Data
WHAT “GOOD” LOOKS LIKE
Not “we shipped AI features.”
Instead:
The system proactively recommends and takes actions
Teams build on shared AI primitives, not reinventing them
AI output is reliable, measurable, and improving over time
Engineers trust the system, and move faster because of it
Customers feel like the product is working for them, not just responding
THE AI BAR (THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT)
We are not looking for:
Someone who rolled out Copilot internally
Someone who used LLM APIs for features
Someone adjacent to AI
We are looking for someone who has:
Built real systems where AI makes decisions and takes actions in production.
That means experience with:
Agent orchestration (not just prompts)
Tool use and workflow execution
Evaluation (offline + online)
Observability and failure handling
Guardrails and safety in real systems
Tradeoffs between autonomy vs. control
You don’t need to code daily, but you must be able to reason at the system level.
WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO
Define how AI should work across Jobber, not just within a team
Build and evolve a multi-team org to execute on that vision
Make tradeoffs between speed, quality, and safety
Push teams beyond feature thinking into system thinking
Challenge assumptions, including leadership’s
Drive adoption across engineering, product, and the company
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Leadership
You’ve led orgs through complexity, not just growth.
Managed managers across multiple teams
Built organizations that scale (not just teams that ship)
Driven cross-org alignment in ambiguous spaces
Product + Systems Thinking
You think in systems, not features.
You understand how user workflows connect end-to-end
You’ve partnered deeply with Product and Design
You care about customer outcomes, not just technical output
AI Depth (non-negotiable)
You’ve built or led production LLM/agentic systems.
You understand what actually works (and what doesn’t)
You’ve seen systems fail and improved them
You have opinions about evaluation, reliability, and safety
Execution
You can move fast without breaking everything.
You’ve balanced shipping vs infrastructure vs tech debt
You know when to iterate and when to redesign
WHY JOBBER · WHY NOW?
This is not “AI theatre.”
We already have:
AI Receptionist (live, handling real customer calls)
AI features embedded across the product
250,000+ businesses using the platform
What we don’t have yet is: A unified, intelligent system across the product.
That’s what this role builds.
TLDR:
Most Director roles optimize delivery. This one defines: How an entire product becomes intelligent.
Compensation:

At Jobber, we also believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $221,800 CAD, a midpoint of $261,000 CAD, and a maximum salary of $300,100 CAD, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.
We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!
What you can expect from Jobber:
A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.
A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.
A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.
To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.
A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering - remote opportunity
jobs.text:
Description/Responsibilities
We are seeking a Director of Data Engineering to lead the Enterprise Data Foundation (EDF) team at Tivity Health. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle of our enterprise data platform — spanning ingestion, transformation, storage, and delivery — across two distinct business domains: our core Fitness business and our Whole Health Living (WHL) healthcare business.
The Director will manage a team of approximately 10 engineers and QA professionals, set technical direction for platform architecture and evolution, and partner cross-functionally with Data Governance, BI & Reporting, Product Engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure data infrastructure meets both current operational needs and future strategic objectives. This is primarily a people management and technical leadership role — the successful candidate must be able to review architectural decisions, evaluate code and pipeline designs, and direct engineering execution, not simply approve timesheets.
This role reports to the VP of Data and works as a peer alongside the BI & Reporting Lead and the Senior Data Governance Strategist within the Data Management department.
Responsibilities:
People Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of ~10 data engineers and QA professionals across ETL development, platform operations, and quality assurance.
Conduct performance management including goal-setting, regular 1:1s, career development planning, and performance reviews.
Drive team capacity planning, hiring, and onboarding for new engineering and QA roles.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Coordinate workload across team members, balancing project delivery, operational support, and technical debt reduction.
Data Architecture & Platform Strategy
Own the architectural vision for Tivity Health's enterprise data platform, spanning Snowflake, AWS data services, and on-premises legacy systems.
Define and execute the platform evolution roadmap, including modernization of batch ETL toward real-time and event-driven architectures, adoption of open table formats (Apache Iceberg), and progressive elimination of legacy infrastructure.
Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies (e.g., zero-ETL integrations, lakehouse patterns, streaming CDC) aligned to business needs and total cost of ownership.
Ensure platform designs support scalability, reliability, security, and compliance requirements across both Fitness and WHL healthcare domains.
Establish and enforce data engineering standards, patterns, and best practices for pipeline development, infrastructure-as-code, testing, and deployment.
Partner with Data Governance to ensure platform architecture enables cataloging, lineage, quality measurement, and access control at enterprise scale.
Engineering Delivery & Operations
Oversee design, development, and maintenance of production ETL pipelines (AWS Glue, DMS, Snowflake Tasks) processing data from RDS, DynamoDB, MSSQL, Oracle EBS, SaaS APIs, and file-based sources into Snowflake.
Own pipeline reliability and incident response, maintaining 99%+ ETL success rates across both Fitness and WHL platforms.
Direct the team's infrastructure-as-code practice (Pulumi) for all Snowflake and AWS resource provisioning and change management.
Review and approve architectural decisions, pipeline designs, data models, and production changes — ensuring technical rigor without being the bottleneck.
Drive the completion of legacy platform migration (on-premises SQL Server reporting to Snowflake) and retirement of end-of-life systems.
Manage operational metrics, SLAs, and capacity planning for data infrastructure (compute, storage, pipeline throughput).
Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with the BI & Reporting team to ensure the consumption layer (Tableau, S3 exports, client deliverables) has performant, reliable, well-documented data assets.
Collaborate with Data Governance on data quality rule implementation, business term definitions, catalog completeness, and compliance controls.
Work with Product Engineering and DevOps on shared infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and platform security.
Communicate platform status, risks, and roadmap to senior IT leadership and business stakeholders.
Platform Scope
The EDF team owns and operates the foundational data platform that all analytics, reporting, governance, and data science teams consume. The current platform includes:
Snowflake Data Cloud — AWS Data tooling
Snowflake Tasks
Infrastructure-as-Code — Pulumi-managed deployments for all Snowflake resources (databases, schemas, roles, warehouses, tasks) and AWS resources (Glue, S3, IAM, DMS).
Legacy Systems.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related quantitative field preferred. Experience in lieu of education will be considered.
6+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or data architecture roles.
3+ years of direct people management experience leading technical teams.
Expert-level SQL proficiency and working knowledge of Python for data engineering.
Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or Databricks) at enterprise scale.
Demonstrated ability to define and execute multi-year platform modernization roadmaps.
Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment (healthcare, financial services, or similar).
Preferred Qualifications
10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data architecture, or data platform roles.
5+ years in a management or leadership role directing data engineering teams of 5+ members.
Deep expertise with Snowflake (architecture, performance tuning, security model, cost optimization) and AWS data services (Glue, DMS, S3, Lambda, Lake Formation).
Hands-on experience designing and operating layered data warehouse architectures (Raw/Staging → Integration → Presentation → Analytics/Consumption).
Strong background in ETL/ELT pipeline design, including incremental loading patterns, change data capture, SCD Type 2, and data quality validation.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Pulumi, Terraform, or CDK) for managing cloud data resources through CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with modern data platform patterns: Apache Iceberg / open table formats, lakehouse architectures, event-driven / streaming pipelines, and zero-ETL integrations.
Experience with healthcare data systems (claims adjudication, eligibility, provider networks) is strongly preferred given the WHL domain scope.
Understanding of data governance frameworks, metadata management, data cataloging, and lineage — sufficient to partner effectively with a dedicated governance function.
Experience managing both engineering and QA disciplines within a data platform team.
Strong communication skills with ability to translate technical platform decisions into business value for non-technical stakeholders.
The salary range for this opportunity is $137,700 to $175,000. Compensation depends on several factors: qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience.
Tivity Health offers a robust benefits package, which includes a competitive salary, company bonus potential, medical, dental, vision, 401k with match, generous paid time off, free gym membership to over 13,000 fitness locations in the US, and other great benefits.

We help adults improve their health and support them on life's journey by providing access to in-person and virtual physical activity, social and mental enrichment programs, as well as a full suite of physical medicine and integrative health services. Our suite of services support health plans, employers, health systems and providers nationwide as they seek to reduce costs and improve health outcomes. Learn more at TivityHealth.
Tivity Health is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to a proactive program of diversity development. Tivity Health will continue to recruit, hire, train, and promote into all job levels without regard to race, religion, gender, marital status, familial status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, source of income, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.text:
As Director, Data Engineering you'll take charge of data across the whole Articore Group: Martech Engineering, Core Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science, each already running with its own manager. Your job is to turn four teams pulling in their own direction into one coherent strategy, one set of standards, and one voice Execs can trust, without stripping away what makes each team work.
You'll partner closely with our Melbourne-based Product Director for Data, and report to our SVP of Engineering.
Here's the real opportunity: every function has built exactly what it needed, locally, and now the group needs someone to build the global picture. Reliable pipelines with real SLAs. A warehouse finally consolidated across four brands instead of four different ways of doing things. A genuine plan to pay down the technical debt sitting underneath all of it. This is architecture at group scale, and you're the one drawing the blueprint.
The job is holding the tension between what the business needs right now and the long-term rationalization that makes everything else possible, without dropping either ball.
Core Responsibilities
You'll partner with Executives and stakeholders across Product, Marketing, and Analytics, owning your organization's roadmap end-to-end across three areas: Delivery, People, and Technology.
Delivery
Set direction for data technology across the group, coordinating roadmaps across data engineering, analytics engineering, martech, and data science to unlock key business initiatives.
Own prioritization across OKR-driven initiatives, ad-hoc requests, and platform work — owning intake and planning, and making the case for tradeoffs directly to the executive team.
Build the architecture behind reliable, business-critical pipelines: SLAs per layer, and technical debt retired to the point teams can trust the data they run the business on.
Coordinate with adjacent teams, including product and other engineering functions, to align roadmaps and land cross-functional initiatives.
People
Hire and build out the data organization, including key hires across Australia, the US, and India.
Manage engineering managers directly, with skip-level visibility into technical leads. Set clear ownership and handoff practices so no region waits on one person or timezone.
Partner with each manager on the practices that make execution predictable — sprint planning, delivery rituals, and reporting.
Own performance, development, and comp conversations at the manager layer, and calibrate standards across four functions without erasing what makes each work.
Technology
Steward technical direction across the full data stack, and consolidate technology to reduce cost while improving reliability and simplifying systems.
Drive architectural decisions on data flows between systems, the warehouse, and downstream analytics — balancing reliability, scalability, and delivery speed.
Own data governance and privacy practices — classification, retention, and data subject requests — aligned to GDPR, CCPA, and equivalent frameworks.
Champion AI across the teams, establishing efficiencies through agentic workflows and automation.

jobs.title: Director, Data Architecture
jobs.text:
At Deckers Brands, Together, Every Step is a promise kept that every employee can bring their authentic self, is valued and supported, as a whole person, at work and beyond. Together, Every Step is how we continue to deliver exceptional business results, experience an amazing place to work, and have a positive impact on the communities and world around us.
Job Title: Director, Data Architecture
Reports to: Chief Digital & Data Officer
Location: United States (Remote)
Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington
The Role
As the Director, Data Architecture, you will be the architect of Deckers’ data future—defining, governing, and evolving our enterprise data architecture to create a consistent, scalable, and trusted data foundation. You’ll lead the design of architecture standards and domain-aligned data structures that power analytics, AI, operational reporting, and data product innovation. Your work will ensure that our data ecosystem is modern, resilient, and ready to support the business’s most ambitious goals. You’ll collaborate with engineering, analytics, governance, and business teams to drive adoption and operationalization of cutting-edge data architecture principles.
We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.
Your Impact
Define and evolve enterprise data architecture principles, standards, and reference architectures aligned to business priorities and modern practices
Lead the design and maintenance of enterprise conceptual, logical, and physical data structures, ensuring consistent definitions and shared semantics
Establish domain-oriented architecture patterns for reusable, governed data products and interoperable data flows
Develop architecture patterns supporting both batch and streaming workloads, including event-driven approaches and canonical representations
Partner with data engineering teams to translate architecture and logical designs into scalable physical implementations on AWS cloud data platforms
Ensure consistent data definitions, lineage, and metadata documentation across domains by enabling cataloging and lineage platforms
Maintain a central repository of architecture artifacts, definitions, and metadata documentation
Influence data design decisions across programs and projects through architecture reviews and standards enforcement
Facilitate architecture and data design workshops with business and technical stakeholders
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data architects and specialists, ensuring consistent delivery of architecture outcomes
Stay current on evolving architecture trends and evaluate their applicability to Deckers
Who You Are
Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field; Master’s degree preferred
10 to 15 years of experience in data architecture roles, including leadership experience
Significant experience designing and implementing architecture in cloud-based, modern data ecosystems
Experience supporting large-scale data programs within retail, consumer products, or related industries preferred
Familiarity with AWS data services such as S3, Redshift, Glue, and Lake Formation
Experience with data cataloging, metadata management, and lineage tracking platforms
Understanding of modern data formats and storage approaches including Parquet, Iceberg, and Delta Lake
Deep expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data architecture across diverse technology stacks
Strong understanding of modern data architecture concepts including data mesh, event-driven design, and data products
Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable and reusable architecture designs and standards
Excellent collaboration, facilitation, and influencing skills across technical and business teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities combined with a results-driven mindset
What We'll Give You –
Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.
$154,700.00 - $208,800.00

Job Title: Director, Data Architecture
Reports to: Chief Digital & Data Officer
Location: United States (Remote)
Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington
The Role

As the Director, Data Architecture, you will be the architect of Deckers’ data future—defining, governing, and evolving our enterprise data architecture to create a consistent, scalable, and trusted data foundation. You’ll lead the design of architecture standards and domain-aligned data structures that power analytics, AI, operational reporting, and data product innovation. Your work will ensure that our data ecosystem is modern, resilient, and ready to support the business’s most ambitious goals. You’ll collaborate with engineering, analytics, governance, and business teams to drive adoption and operationalization of cutting-edge data architecture principles.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.
Your Impact

items: Define and evolve enterprise data architecture principles, standards, and reference architectures aligned to business priorities and modern practices
Lead the design and maintenance of enterprise conceptual, logical, and physical data structures, ensuring consistent definitions and shared semantics
Establish domain-oriented architecture patterns for reusable, governed data products and interoperable data flows
Develop architecture patterns supporting both batch and streaming workloads, including event-driven approaches and canonical representations
Partner with data engineering teams to translate architecture and logical designs into scalable physical implementations on AWS cloud data platforms
Ensure consistent data definitions, lineage, and metadata documentation across domains by enabling cataloging and lineage platforms
Maintain a central repository of architecture artifacts, definitions, and metadata documentation
Influence data design decisions across programs and projects through architecture reviews and standards enforcement
Facilitate architecture and data design workshops with business and technical stakeholders
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data architects and specialists, ensuring consistent delivery of architecture outcomes
Stay current on evolving architecture trends and evaluate their applicability to Deckers

blocks.text: Who You Are

items: Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field; Master’s degree preferred
10 to 15 years of experience in data architecture roles, including leadership experience
Significant experience designing and implementing architecture in cloud-based, modern data ecosystems
Experience supporting large-scale data programs within retail, consumer products, or related industries preferred
Familiarity with AWS data services such as S3, Redshift, Glue, and Lake Formation
Experience with data cataloging, metadata management, and lineage tracking platforms
Understanding of modern data formats and storage approaches including Parquet, Iceberg, and Delta Lake
Deep expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data architecture across diverse technology stacks
Strong understanding of modern data architecture concepts including data mesh, event-driven design, and data products
Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable and reusable architecture designs and standards
Excellent collaboration, facilitation, and influencing skills across technical and business teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities combined with a results-driven mindset

jobs.title: VP of Product, Foundation
jobs.text:
🚀 VP of Product, Foundation | United States | Remote | Pax8
Join Pax8 as our VP of Product, Foundation and shape the future of the world's leading cloud marketplace platform, driving the product strategy behind the commerce engine that powers thousands of managed service providers across the globe.
🌟 Why This Role?
This is a rare opportunity to own the product vision for Pax8's largest and most strategically important portfolio. Foundation sits at the heart of our marketplace, enabling everything from product discovery and purchasing to provisioning, billing, subscriptions, integrations, and partner growth.
As AI reshapes software development and customer experiences, you'll help define how a modern, intelligent commerce platform evolves. You'll influence how thousands of partners buy, sell, manage, and grow through technology while building capabilities that support both hypergrowth and enterprise-grade financial rigor.
You'll join at a pivotal moment where platform scale, artificial intelligence, automation, and operational excellence converge, giving you the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on both Pax8 and the wider technology ecosystem.
💜 Life at Pax8
At Pax8, business is personal. We're passionate about creating an environment where people can do their best work while continuously learning and growing. Guided by our values of Compassionate Candor, Seek to Understand, We Before Me, Do What You Say, Light Up Learning, and Driven by Passion, we foster a culture built on trust, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
You'll join a global organization that embraces emerging technologies, invests heavily in learning, and empowers individuals to challenge conventional thinking while delivering exceptional outcomes for our partners.
🎯 What You'll Be Responsible For
📈 Define the Future of Commerce at Pax8
Establish and execute the long-term product vision for Foundation, Pax8's core commerce platform.
Create a strategic roadmap that balances operational excellence, compliance, financial controls, scalability, and growth.
Guide investment decisions across marketplace capabilities, billing, subscriptions, ordering, provisioning, analytics, integrations, and partner experiences.
💡 Drive Growth Through Product Innovation
Create frictionless experiences that improve partner acquisition, engagement, retention, and expansion.
Shape product experiences that help partners discover, purchase, manage, and maximize technology investments.
Identify new opportunities to increase platform adoption through analytics, recommendations, APIs, ecosystem integrations, and intelligent automation.
🤝 Lead Through Partnership
Act as the strategic product counterpart to the VP of Engineering, jointly driving outcomes across the Foundation platform.
Partner closely with Architecture, Finance, Operations, Commercial Leadership, Design, and User Research to align priorities and deliver results.
Establish clear ownership boundaries across a complex product ecosystem to ensure teams move quickly and effectively.
🧠 Build for an AI-Powered Future
Develop a point of view on how AI and agent-assisted experiences will transform partner commerce.
Guide teams through new ways of working that leverage AI to accelerate discovery, validation, delivery, and decision making.
Help evolve product practices to remain effective as technology and customer expectations continue to change.
👥 Develop Exceptional Product Talent
Lead and inspire a high-performing product management organization.
Create an environment where strategic thinking, commercial acumen, technical depth, and customer empathy flourish.
Coach leaders and product managers to operate effectively across a broad and complex portfolio.
🌍 Your Impact
Foundation is the engine behind the Pax8 marketplace. Your leadership will directly influence partner satisfaction, operational excellence, financial integrity, and future growth.
You'll help create the platform that thousands of businesses rely on every day while ensuring Pax8 is positioned to scale sustainably, innovate rapidly, and remain the trusted marketplace for technology professionals worldwide.
✅ What Success Looks Like
We're searching for someone who combines strategic vision with an ability to execute in highly complex environments.
You bring:
Demonstrated success leading large-scale product organizations with executive-level scope.
Proven experience owning complex marketplace, commerce, platform, SaaS, or partner ecosystem products.
Deep understanding of commerce journeys including purchasing, subscriptions, provisioning, billing, invoicing, and partner operations.
Strong experience balancing growth initiatives alongside governance, compliance, operational control, and scalability requirements.
Ability to influence across executive stakeholders, engineering leaders, operational teams, and commercial functions.
Strong understanding of platform architecture concepts and product decision-making within complex technical environments.
Experience leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve product strategy, delivery, prioritization, and organizational effectiveness.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to move seamlessly between executive strategy, technical discussions, and customer-focused outcomes.
A customer-first mindset grounded in real-world experience serving businesses, partners, marketplaces, or technology ecosystems.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity while maintaining strategic clarity and organizational alignment.
🛡️ Trust and Hiring
At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust based relationships — starting with how we hire.
To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you're applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we're excited to meet you.
We also use thoughtfully applied AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. These tools may assist with tasks such as reviewing or prioritising applications, but hiring decisions are made by our people. More information is available in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. If you have questions about how we hire or would prefer not to have your application supported by these tools, you can opt out at any part of our process.
🌈 Inclusion Matters
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria. We're committed to diverse perspectives, inclusive hiring and sharing your transferrable skills. To fulfil this role, you must hold valid right to work in United States.
🎁 Benefits
Competitive executive compensation package based on skills, experience, and market location
Annual performance bonus opportunity
Equity participation through Pax8 stock programs
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible paid time off
Paid parental leave
Retirement savings plans with company contribution opportunities
Learning and development investment
LinkedIn Learning access
Wellbeing resources and coaching support
Remote-first flexibility
Employee recognition programs
Company events and celebrations
📚 Growth & Development
There's extensive room for a talented individual to grow at pace — whether that's advancing quickly in this role or exploring one of the many opportunities across our global organisation. You'll have access to our internal development hub designed to accelerate your skills and stretch your potential. Alongside specialist Learning & Development trainers, you'll also tap into AI powered tools, "born in the cloud" mentors, and cross continent collaboration that broaden your perspective and sharpen your expertise. We'll give you the space, trust, and the right projects to help you thrive — and full visibility of what it takes to reach your next level.
🚀 About Pax8
Our mission is to build the managed intelligence marketplace and empower small businesses to do more with smarter technology. We are a fast-growing, dynamic, and high-energy organisation with a start-up feel, allowing you to make a meaningful impact on the business. Culture is also important to us, and at Pax8, it's business, and it IS personal. We are passionate, creative, and unconventional. We work hard, keep it fun, and expect the best! We Elev8 each other. We Advoc8 for our partners. We Innov8 continuously. We Celebr8 life.
🔍 Background Checks
As part of our hiring process, we are required to undertake pre-employment checks on all candidates that are successful in their application with Pax8. As part of these checks Pax8 will request ID verification, reference requests and qualification checks (additional checks may be completed for certain countries, such as criminal and financial). All checks are completed by our third-party provider, First Advantage. Once checks have been completed all candidates will receive a copy for their records.
Equal Opportunities
Pax8 are an equal opportunities employer and welcome individuals who are in possession of the appropriate requirements to work within the country you have applied for. Offered individuals will be asked to undertake identity, security compliance and reference checks. Your privacy is important to us. Your data will be held in accordance with local best practices and processed only in accordance with our recruiting processes. Privacy notice:

By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you’re applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we’re excited to meet you.

At Pax8 we believe that your Total Rewards should include a benefits package that shows how much we value our greatest assets. All FTE Pax8 people enjoy the following benefits:

jobs.title: Vice President of Data and Analytics
jobs.text:
Overview
To drive innovation and operational excellence through technology that enables teams to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences. The Business Systems department delivers software to drive business process optimization through automation, intuitive workflows, and data governance. Our goal is to serve our internal customers (operators & support departments) with solutions that empower them to maximize their performance and enhance the customer journey.
Position Summary
The Vice President Data & Analytics leads the strategic direction, delivery, and operational maturity of RPM Living's Data & Analytics organization within Product & Engineering. This role partners directly with the SVP, Data & Analytics to build and scale internal data engineering, analytics, and governance capabilities, reducing reliance on third-party contractors while establishing RPM Living as a data-driven, insight-led organization.
Responsibilities
Serve as the senior operating leader for the Data & Analytics team, translating the SVP's vision into staffing plans, delivery roadmaps, and quarterly priorities.
Serve as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to executive leadership, influencing enterprise priorities and translating business strategy into actionable data, analytics, and technology initiatives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with C-suite executives and senior business leaders, effectively communicating complex data and technology concepts, surfacing business implications, and driving alignment on strategic decisions.
Own end-to-end delivery of the Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold/semantic layers) in partnership with the Data Engineering Lead and Lead Data Architect.
Directly manage and develop a team spanning data engineering, analytics/BI, data governance, and QA, including performance management, career development, and org design.
Partner with business stakeholders across property operations, finance, and technology to prioritize analytics and reporting initiatives, including cross platform data integrations and business processes.
Establish data governance, quality, and security standards across 30+ source integrations (Yardi, RealPage, UKG, Salesforce, and others).
Evaluate and drive adoption of AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude, CodeRabbit) to accelerate engineering velocity and analytics delivery.
Present roadmap progress, risks, and organizational health to senior executive leadership.
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, budgets, and resourcing decisions for the Data & Analytics function.
Define and enforce architectural and coding standards, working closely with the Lead Data Architect to ensure long-term platform scalability.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field. Experience may substitute for education.
Twelve years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence, including Five+ years in a people-leadership role.
Five year’s experience with modern cloud data platforms (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse/SQL, or equivalent) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
Experience in multifamily, real estate, or another property-operations-driven industry is a plus but not required.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical strategy for non-technical senior leadership.
Knowledge of data architecture patterns (medallion/lakehouse), data governance frameworks, and modern BI/semantic modeling practices.
Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing technical teams in a rebuild/turnaround environment.
Strong vendor management and contract negotiation skills, particularly related to managed services and staff augmentation.
Comfort operating with ambiguity and evolving scope typical of a growing, newly-formed department.Working knowledge of AI-assisted development and analytics tooling and its application to team productivity.
Qualifications
Physical Requirements:• May be required to sit for extended periods of time • May occasionally be required to lift or carry items such as files or office supplies weighing up to 15 pounds • Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment • Must be able to read documents, computer screens, and data • Must be able to hear and understand verbal communications in person and over the phone or computer
Work Environment:• This is a remote role. The associate must have a dedicated workspace that is free from distraction and has reliable internet.• Overnight travel may be required quarterly for various business reasons.
Company Information
Join RPM Living and experience exceptional benefits designed to enhance your life.
Weekly pay for all associates working onsite at an apartment community
Comprehensive healthcare coverage available for all full-time, regular associates
Employer-paid employee assistance, mental health, and wellness programs
Ancillary benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance
401(k) with robust company match
Opportunities for professional development, career growth, and role-based learning plans
Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) and multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERG)
Paid time off plus floating holidays and volunteer days
Discounted Perks (Costco membership, movie tickets, health & wellness, entertainment & travel discounts)
Employment with RPM Living is contingent upon successful completion of a background check as local and federal state requires. A valid driver’s license is preferred; candidates without a license will be provided a liability waiver.
RPM Living participates in E-Verify. For more information, see the E-Verify Participation Poster and the Right to Work Poster.
RPM Living is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: VP - Product Management, Digital Assets Proxy
jobs.text:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
Broadridge is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and execution-oriented VP, Product Management – Digital Assets Proxy to lead the strategy, development, delivery and ongoing management of Broadridge’s Digital Assets Proxy capabilities. This highly visible leadership role will define the product vision and roadmap for innovative, scalable, and compliant digital assets proxy solutions that address the evolving needs of institutional clients and support Broadridge’s long-term growth objectives.
The VP will operate at the intersection of product, technology, operations, commercial teams, legal, compliance, and risk. The successful candidate will combine deep product-management discipline with a strong understanding of digital asset market infrastructure, regulatory considerations, and the proxy ecosystem. They will translate market opportunity and client insight into differentiated product offerings, drive delivery from concept through launch, and continuously optimize the portfolio based on performance and market feedback.
What You’ll Do
Define and lead the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for Broadridge’s Digital Assets Proxy products and capabilities
Develop a clear point of view on the evolution of digital assets, tokenization, governance, and governance related market infrastructure, translating market developments into actionable product priorities
Identify and assess client needs, market opportunities, competitive dynamics, and regulatory developments to inform product strategy and investment decisions
Own the evaluation, prioritization, development, launch, and enhancement of digital asset proxy focused products and features aligned with client demand, strategic objectives, and operational readiness
Build compelling business cases, including market sizing, financial analysis, pricing, return-on-investment assessments, and commercialization plans. This can also include development of white papers and related thought pieces
Partner closely with engineering and technology teams to establish product requirements, guide execution, manage trade-offs, and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions
Collaborate with operations, legal, compliance, risk, and control functions to ensure products are operationally viable and aligned with applicable regulatory, risk, and governance requirements
Develop go-to-market strategies in partnership with sales, marketing, relationship-management, and client facing teams
Establish product performance measures and use adoption data, client feedback, commercial results, and market intelligence to improve product outcomes and portfolio performance
Serve as a senior thought partner and subject matter expert on digital assets proxy-related product strategy across Broadridge
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across business, technology, and control functions
What We’re Looking For
Significant product-management experience, including a demonstrated record of leading complex products, platforms, or market-infrastructure capabilities from strategy through execution and commercialization
Strong knowledge of digital assets and related market infrastructure, including relevant experience with tokenized assets, blockchain-based products, custody, wallets, trading, settlement, staking, or adjacent capabilities
Experience developing products within a regulated financial services environment, ideally including exposure to SEC regulated businesses
Demonstrated understanding of proxy, corporate governance, issuer services, or related workflows is strongly preferred
Strong commercial acumen, with experience developing product strategies, business cases, pricing models, and go-to-market plans
Proven ability to lead through influence across technology, operations, legal, compliance, risk, sales, and other cross-functional stakeholders
Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, problem solving, communication, and decision making skills
Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technical, regulatory, and commercial concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
A client focused, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a rapidly evolving market
What Sets You Apart
Deep understanding of trends shaping the digital assets landscape and their implications for institutional and enterprise clients
Experience building and scaling product offerings in emerging, regulated, or rapidly changing markets
Ability to balance innovation with strong operational, regulatory, and risk discipline
A strong network and credibility within digital assets, capital markets, proxy, governance, or financial market infrastructure communities
A collaborative leadership style that aligns diverse stakeholders around a clear product vision and measurable business outcomes
Why Join Us
You will have the opportunity to shape the future of digital assets products within a dynamic and highly visible leadership role. You will work with cross-functional teams to bring new capabilities to market, solve complex industry challenges, and help define how digital asset solutions evolve in a changing financial and regulatory landscape.
Compensation Range: The salary range for this position is between $240,000 to $250,000
Bonus Eligibility: Bonus Eligible
Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.
Benefits Information: Please visit for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings.
We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

We recognize that ensuring our long-term success means creating an environment where everyone is welcome, where everyone's strengths are valued, and where everyone can perform at their best. Broadridge provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ethnic origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, and other protected characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Platform & Data Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.
We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.
We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.
Role
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.
You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on
Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS.
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery.
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint.
Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Data
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
We are seeking a visionary and execution-focused Senior Director of Enterprise Data to lead the transformation and maturity of our data ecosystem. Having recently scaled to $2 billion in annual revenue, we are actively building the infrastructure, governance, and operational models required to sustain our trajectory to $4 billion and beyond.
In this role, reporting to the CIO, you will own the end-to-end data strategy, evolving our data platform architecture, scaling our Master Data Management (MDM) systems into an active operational hub, and institutionalizing federated data governance. You will bridge the gap between complex engineering and business execution, transforming data from a utility into a high-octane product that powers real-time decision-making, predictive analytics, agentic AI and operational efficiency across the global enterprise.
What You Will Be Doing
Data Strategy & Platform Evolution
Architect the Future: Design, execute, and evolve a scalable data platform roadmap capable of handling a multi-billion dollar enterprise’s volume, velocity, and variety of data.
De-bottleneck Legacy Infrastructure: Transition our centralized pipelines into a modern, decoupled data architecture.
Data as a Product: Implement a "Data as a Product" mindset across engineering teams, ensuring datasets have strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs), rigorous uptime, and high catalog discoverability.
Streaming & Real-Time Analytics: Drive the evolution from purely batch-oriented processing to real-time event streaming for critical business domains like Engineering, Finance, and Customer Experience.
Enterprise Master Data Management (MDM)
Build the Golden Record: Evolve our current cross-referenced registry into a highly integrated, multi-domain operational MDM hub (Customer, Product, Vendor/Supplier).
Operational Syncing: Ensure mastered data seamlessly flows bidirectionally between analytic environments and core operational execution systems (ERP, CRM, eCommerce).
M&A Readiness: Standardize ingestion frameworks to quickly harmonize data from future acquisitions or new business units without interrupting daily operations.
Data Governance, Quality, & Compliance
Federated Governance: Establish an enterprise-wide data governance council. Move governance away from gatekeeping and toward a collaborative data stewardship model owned by business units.
Automated Observability: Implement modern, automated data lineage, cataloging, and quality testing tools to monitor data health and proactively catch pipeline degradation before it hits business dashboards.
Security & Compliance: Partner with Security and Legal teams to ensure the enterprise data platform natively adheres to global regulatory frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) through robust RBAC/ABAC and automated data masking.
Team Leadership & Operating Model
Scale the Organization: Restructure and grow a high-performing data team consisting of data engineers, MDM specialists, platform architects, and data governance managers.
Centralized Infrastructure, Embedded Analytics: Champion a hub-and-spoke operating model, providing a central platform layer while enabling embedded data analysts within business units to move fast safely.
Cultivate Data Ops: Instill software engineering rigor into data workflows, including CI/CD deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and comprehensive automated test suites.
What You Bring
Proven Scale Experience: Minimum of 12+ years of progressive leadership in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data management, with explicit experience inside an organization operating in a B2B environment at a $1B to $5B+ revenue scale.
Architectural Fluency: Deep hands-on and strategic familiarity with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, AWS/Azure data suites) and enterprise MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica, Reltio, Semarchy, Profisee).
Change Management Mastery: Documented success in leading complex corporate data migrations or massive MDM implementations across multi-business-unit enterprises.
Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex technical jargon into clear business value, financial ROI, and strategic alignment for C-suite executives.
People Leadership: Minimum of 5 years managing manager-level and architect-level direct reports, with a track record of hiring, mentoring, and retaining top-tier engineering talent.
Bonus Points
Experience navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments characterized by rapid organizational restructuring or frequent Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).
Expertise in setting up a Data Mesh or federated data architecture in a hybrid or multi-cloud environment.
Active engagement or understanding of integrating AI/ML infrastructure readiness into core enterprise data platforms.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.
These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.
An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
$212,100—$335,600 USD
The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:
$254,900—$403,200 USD
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

items: Build the Golden Record: Evolve our current cross-referenced registry into a highly integrated, multi-domain operational MDM hub (Customer, Product, Vendor/Supplier).

M&A Readiness: Standardize ingestion frameworks to quickly harmonize data from future acquisitions or new business units without interrupting daily operations.

blocks.text: Data Governance, Quality, & Compliance

items: Federated Governance: Establish an enterprise-wide data governance council. Move governance away from gatekeeping and toward a collaborative data stewardship model owned by business units.

Automated Observability: Implement modern, automated data lineage, cataloging, and quality testing tools to monitor data health and proactively catch pipeline degradation before it hits business dashboards.

Security & Compliance: Partner with Security and Legal teams to ensure the enterprise data platform natively adheres to global regulatory frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) through robust RBAC/ABAC and automated data masking.

items: Scale the Organization: Restructure and grow a high-performing data team consisting of data engineers, MDM specialists, platform architects, and data governance managers.

Centralized Infrastructure, Embedded Analytics: Champion a hub-and-spoke operating model, providing a central platform layer while enabling embedded data analysts within business units to move fast safely.
Cultivate Data Ops: Instill software engineering rigor into data workflows, including CI/CD deployment pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and comprehensive automated test suites.

blocks.text: What You Bring

items: Proven Scale Experience: Minimum of 12+ years of progressive leadership in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data management, with explicit experience inside an organization operating in a B2B environment at a $1B to $5B+ revenue scale.

Architectural Fluency: Deep hands-on and strategic familiarity with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, AWS/Azure data suites) and enterprise MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica, Reltio, Semarchy, Profisee).
Change Management Mastery: Documented success in leading complex corporate data migrations or massive MDM implementations across multi-business-unit enterprises.
Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex technical jargon into clear business value, financial ROI, and strategic alignment for C-suite executives.
People Leadership: Minimum of 5 years managing manager-level and architect-level direct reports, with a track record of hiring, mentoring, and retaining top-tier engineering talent.

items: Experience navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments characterized by rapid organizational restructuring or frequent Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).
Expertise in setting up a Data Mesh or federated data architecture in a hybrid or multi-cloud environment.
Active engagement or understanding of integrating AI/ML infrastructure readiness into core enterprise data platforms.

jobs.title: Director of Product, AML & Digital Asset Compliance
jobs.text:
About the Company
Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem. Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.
CertiK has spent years building security, risk, monitoring, and blockchain expertise across thousands of digital asset companies and institutional customers. As digital assets increasingly become part of mainstream financial infrastructure, security, financial crime risk, and regulatory compliance are converging. We believe there is an opportunity to build a new generation of institutional digital asset risk and compliance products at that intersection. This role will have significant influence over what that product becomes. We are looking for someone who wants to build it.
About the Role
CertiK is building the next generation of risk and compliance products for financial institutions and digital asset businesses. We are looking for a product leader to own this product area from customer discovery and product strategy through delivery, go to market, adoption, and expansion. This is not an internal compliance role. You are here to build the products that compliance, AML, financial crime, and risk teams use. You will work directly with financial institutions, exchanges, VASPs, fintechs, and other digital asset businesses to understand how their compliance teams operate, identify the problems that matter most, and turn those problems into scalable products. The product space may include areas such as blockchain and entity risk, transaction and wallet monitoring, sanctions and KYT, risk scoring, investigation and case management workflows, continuous monitoring, and compliance evidence and reporting. A core part of your job will be deciding which problems CertiK should solve first and which ones we should not. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Compliance, Business Development, and company leadership to build this product line.
Responsibilities
Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for CertiK's AML and digital asset compliance products.
Spend significant time with customers and prospective customers, including CCOs, MLROs, AML teams, investigators, and risk leaders, to deeply understand their workflows and unmet needs.
Identify repeatable market problems behind individual customer requests and determine which problems should become scalable products.
Translate customer and market insights into product concepts, prototypes, requirements, and clear engineering priorities.
Drive products from discovery through design, development, launch, adoption, and iteration.
Define the key workflows, risk models, decision systems, and user experiences required by institutional compliance teams.
Work closely with Engineering and Data teams to make appropriate product and technical trade offs.
Partner with Business Development and customer facing teams during strategic sales cycles, including discovery, product demonstrations, pilots, and design partnerships.
Work with Compliance and regulatory experts to translate evolving AML, sanctions, and digital asset requirements into scalable product capabilities.
Measure success through customer adoption, product usage, enterprise wins, expansion, and other measurable business outcomes.
Requirements
Significant product management experience building B2B software in fintech, regtech, financial services, risk, compliance, or digital assets.
A track record of owning meaningful products or product areas from discovery through launch and adoption.
Deep understanding of AML, financial crime, transaction monitoring, sanctions, KYC/KYB, investigations, or related compliance workflows.
Experience building or working closely with products such as transaction monitoring, blockchain analytics, wallet screening, risk engines, case management, investigation platforms, or compliance workflow systems.
Strong customer discovery skills. You can speak credibly with senior compliance leaders and frontline analysts, understand both what they say and what they actually need, and translate those insights into product decisions.
Strong product judgment. You know the difference between a one off customer request and a repeatable market need, and you are comfortable making hard prioritization decisions.
Commercial instincts. You understand that a successful enterprise product must not only work, customers must adopt it, pay for it, and expand their usage.
Ability to operate in an ambiguous, early stage product environment and personally drive work forward rather than simply coordinate across teams.
Bonus Points
Experience building AML or compliance products at a blockchain analytics, fintech, regtech, exchange, bank, or financial infrastructure company.
Experience with blockchain analytics, KYT, wallet screening, on chain investigations, or digital asset risk.
Previous experience as an AML practitioner, compliance officer, MLRO, investigator, or financial crime professional.
Experience working with regulated financial institutions and understanding how compliance products are evaluated, procured, implemented, and operated.
Experience with regulatory examinations, VASP licensing, or financial crime remediation.
CAMS or another relevant professional qualification.
Relationships with compliance and risk leaders across banks, fintechs, exchanges, VASPs, regulators, or law enforcement.
Compensation
Additional Information
The expected annual base salary range for this position in the United States is $150,000 to $220,000. Compensation for candidates outside the United States will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.
