jobs.title: Director of Product, Logistics
jobs.text:
We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Overview
About the Team
Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the Logistics product organization and take it to its next phase of growth. This is a highly visible leadership role with executive sponsorship, owning a pillar with company-wide impact on Instacart’s long-term growth and profitability. You will set the multi-year vision and strategy for Logistics, lead and grow a team of product managers, and partner closely with engineering, machine learning, data science, and operations to build products that generate value for all sides of the marketplace. You will be responsible for key outcomes core to the company’s success — fulfillment cost, speed, quality, and shopper experience — and trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions in a complex, ambiguous, and highly interconnected domain.
About the Job
Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.
Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.
Solve complex fulfillment problems and build 0-to-1 products and services that create synergistic value across customers, shoppers, and retailers, while continuously improving efficiency, speed, and quality at scale.
Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.
Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.
Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.
Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.
About You
Minimum Qualifications
10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).
Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.
Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).
Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence executive leadership and align cross-functional teams in a complex domain.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain high-performing PMs and build healthy, high-trust teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a multi-sided dynamic marketplace-oriented role, envisioning or evaluating algorithms-based products and services.
Background in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or operationally complex physical environments.
Experience with e-commerce or grocery technology.

jobs.text:

Location: Warrington/London with regular travel across the Healthcare LIFT portfolio
Benefits: 25 days AL + BH, Life Insurance, Car Allowance, Pension Scheme, Employee Assistance Programme, salary sacrifice schemes, gym & retailer discounts.
Kudos Services is a specialist facilities management provider delivering high-quality Hard FM services across complex healthcare environments. We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Head of Engineering to lead our Engineering & Maintenance team across our Healthcare LIFT portfolio.
Key Requirements
Significant experience managing Hard FM services across complex, multi-site estates within a PPP/PFI environment, ideally healthcare.
Strong technical knowledge of building services engineering, statutory compliance and healthcare maintenance requirements, including HTMs and HBNs.
Proven leadership experience managing engineering teams, contractors and multiple stakeholders.
Commercially aware, with experience of performance management, contract delivery and budget accountability.
HNC/HND (or equivalent) in a Mechanical, Electrical or Building Services Engineering discipline.
About the Role
Reporting directly to the CEO, this is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic and operational management of Engineering & Maintenance services across our Healthcare LIFT portfolio.
You will lead the Engineering Team, ensuring the safe, compliant and effective delivery of Hard FM services whilst maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and contractual performance. Working closely with Contract Managers and the Compliance Team, you will oversee statutory compliance, technical governance, engineering performance and quality assurance across the estate.
You will act as the lead representative for engineering audits and technical reviews, ensuring robust processes, clear audit trails and full compliance with contractual and statutory obligations. The role will also take ownership of engineering reporting, resource planning, contractor performance, asset management and lifecycle activities.
As a key member of the senior leadership team, you will contribute to commercial and financial performance, supporting budget setting, forecasting, procurement activities and business-wide continuous improvement initiatives.
About You
You are an experienced engineering leader who combines strong technical expertise with excellent people management and stakeholder engagement skills. You thrive in complex, highly regulated environments and have a proven track record of delivering engineering services within healthcare, PPP or PFI contracts.
You are commercially aware, solutions-focused and capable of balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day operational demands. You are committed to maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and compliance whilst developing strong working relationships with colleagues, clients and partners.
Most importantly, you are a proactive leader who can inspire teams, drive performance and support the continued success of our healthcare portfolio.
Our Values:
Supportive - We embrace partnership working.
Ethical - We act with integrity.
Innovative - We take ownership for understanding and improving our business.
Ambitious - We continually strive to deliver the best possible service.
Passionate - We are proud of the part we play and the service we deliver.
Application Process:
Application & CV Screening
First Stage Interview Head of HR & Kudos CEO
Final Stage Interview Asset CEO/Director & FIM CEO
As part of the recruitment process, you may be required to complete a profiling assessment and/or a role-specific scenario based assessment.

jobs.title: Director of Analytics
jobs.text:
Lyst is a global fashion shopping platform founded in London in 2010 and catering to over 160M shoppers per year. We offer our customers the largest assortment of premium and luxury fashion products in one place, curating pieces from 27,000 of the world's leading brands and stores. In 2025, Lyst joined Zozo, operators of Zozotown, the leading fashion e-commerce platform in Japan. This partnership marks a bold new era for Lyst, as we accelerate our vision and work together to transform the future of fashion shopping through AI and technology.
At Lyst, we obsess over the customer, providing a search and discovery experience which offers inspiration, fulfilment, and personalisation. We believe that fashion is amazing but shopping for fashion often isn't, and we use our technology, data and creativity to bring more joy, greater choice and fewer fails. Our mission is to help fashion shoppers make better decisions and help fashion partners find better audiences as the category-leading destination for every fashion shopper.
The Role
We're looking for a Director of Analytics to lead our lean, multi-disciplined, best-in-class analytics team. As director, you will set the mission, technical direction, and culture of the analytics function. You will provide technical direction on product analytics, experimentation, attribution, forecasting, and manage analytical frameworks. You will promote a culture of discovering and communicating insights, as well as enabling self-service analysis capabilities for stakeholders. You will also evangelise and inspire best practices across the company.
You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with the Director of Data Platform and Directors in other functions such as Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Finance and Marketing. Our stack includes AWS, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Python, R and other best in class, modern tooling for business reporting, experimentation, and analysis. We are heavily invested in advanced AI-enhanced analytics tools across the company, and you will drive the evaluation, deployment and adoption of more powerful tools to scale self-serve analytics.
Responsibilities
Leadership and Team Management:
Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing, diverse analytics team
Foster a culture of deep analysis, commercial sense, innovation, best practices and evangelizing non-obvious insights (not simply reporting data)
Align team objectives with company goals and strategic initiatives
Apply strong commercial intuition, customer-focus and data analysis to drive strategic decision-making
Technical Direction and Innovation:
Provide expert guidance on horizontal technical analytical areas, including experimentation, attribution, forecasting, predictive analytics, and observability
Continuously identify opportunities for advanced analytics and data methodologies and enable implementation
Identify and track appropriate metrics to measure success across all areas of the business
Ensure trustworthiness and timeliness of data used by stakeholders from all departments of the company
Analytics and Strategy:
Collaborate with senior leadership to provide insights for decision-making around key initiatives and strategic objectives
Work with FP&A and product leads to align customer impact with commercial outcomes - working to a common growth-model/metric tree
Stay abreast of industry trends, the competitive landscape, advances in technology, methodologies and tools, and market dynamics to inform commercial strategies
Data Strategy and Governance:
Partner with the Director of Data Platform to define and execute the vision for how data can be leveraged effectively across the business
Work alongside the Data Platform team to ensure high data quality and robust data governance
Develop and maintain analytics roadmaps to support the progress of the data strategy
Crossfunctional Collaboration:
Empower the team to execute on reporting, analytics, and experimentation
Drive with product development to identify and apply new data opportunities
Drive understanding of key metrics and their importance across the business
Evangelize opportunities and trends discovered through insights across all stakeholders and ensure that insights and data leads to sound decision-making
Empower stakeholders through increased self-service usage of analytics tools, while freeing up analysts to contribute deeper insights requiring greater analytical skills

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Assistant Director (Programme Evaluation), Data Office
jobs.company: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI)
jobs.text:
The Programme Evaluation (PE) team in MDDI’s Data Office oversees the MDDI Family’s Programme Evaluation framework and collaborates across MDDI-Family divisions to design, plan, and conduct programme evaluation, as well as to deepen capabilities in programme evaluation.
Job Responsibilities
As a member of the PE team in MDDI’s Data Office, you will be given the opportunity to partner with a diverse mix of stakeholders in varying stages of evaluation across a range of programmes in the digital, communications and information domains.
You will provide guidance to programme owners in planning, designing and evaluating projects of strategic importance to the organisation. You may be directly involved in working with programme owners to conduct evaluation deep-dives. As the central PE unit for MDDI Family, you will also have the opportunity to connect with other central PE units across whole-of-government and refine standards and guidelines for MDDI-Family to keep pulse with developments in programme evaluation.
This role includes but may not be limited to the following responsibilities:
Monitor key performance indicators for MDDI and its agencies’ programmes within the scope of the MDDI-Family Programme Evaluation Framework
Conduct in-depth evaluations of selected programmes (during planning and post-implementation) and identify opportunities to optimise policy implementation. This will involve:
o Using frameworks such as Theory of Change to clarify programme goals and desired outcomes
o Collating and analysing relevant data to assess performance indicators and desired outcomes, as well as derive evaluation insights
o Scope and participate in programme walk-throughs and field observations alongside programme owners to identify process improvements
o Making data-informed recommendations to senior management, programme and policy owners
Provide guidance and support to MDDI-HQ and agencies in designing appropriate programme evaluation approaches. This includes:
o Engaging policy and programme owners to understand programme intent and design, identify needs for evaluation and the suitability of evaluation methods
o Reviewing and providing input to programme owners’ Theory of Change frameworks based on their programme goals
o Reviewing implementation plans for proposed solutions, which includes setting S.M.A.R.T (Specific, Measurable, Attainable, Relevant and Time-bound) key performance indicators, data collection plans and evaluation plans
Strengthen MDDI-Family Capability Development in Programme Evaluation, which requires
o Developing learning materials on evaluation methodologies and principles,
o Leading internal communications of Ministry PE resources and workshops and brownbag sessions
o Building a networking of evaluation practitioners within the MDDI family

jobs.title: HCM Practice Technology Director
jobs.text:
About Concept Plus
Concept Plus is a mission-focused technology solutions provider that transforms IT concepts into impactful solutions for federal agencies. Headquartered in Fairfax, VA, we bring the agility, responsiveness, and customer intimacy of a small business combined with the quality and infrastructure of a larger firm.
Recognized as an award-winning Oracle partner, we have delivered innovative solutions across Defense, Intelligence, Civilian, Health IT, and Tribal sectors. Our highly certified experts build systems that drive efficiency, accelerate modernization, and ensure mission outcomes with certainty.
We offer competitive pay, comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid life insurance, paid time off, 11 paid holidays, performance bonuses, tuition reimbursement, unlimited training, and the opportunity to thrive in a collaborative, flexible, and innovative environment.
For more information, visit .
About the role
We are seeking an accomplished Practice/Technology Director to lead enterprise Integration and Data Migration services while driving Cloud Adoption and Organizational Change Management initiatives. This executive-level role is responsible for establishing strategic direction, leading delivery teams, managing client relationships, and ensuring successful implementation of large-scale transformation programs. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in enterprise integrations, data migration strategies, cloud technologies, and change management methodologies. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, oversee complex consulting engagements, and contribute to the growth and maturity of the organization's technology consulting practice.
What you'll do
Practice Leadership
Lead the Integration and Data Migration practice, establishing methodologies, standards, and delivery frameworks.
Develop strategic roadmaps and service offerings aligned with client business objectives and emerging technology trends.
Mentor and develop managers, architects, consultants, and technical delivery teams.
Support business development activities including solution development, proposal responses, client presentations, and capability demonstrations.
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with clients and key stakeholders. Integration and Data Migration Leadership
Provide executive oversight for enterprise integration initiatives involving cloud and on-premises systems.
Lead data migration strategies, planning, governance, and execution for enterprise modernization programs.
Establish best practices for data quality, data governance, validation, reconciliation, and risk mitigation.
Ensure successful delivery of integration and migration projects through effective planning, monitoring, and quality assurance.
Cloud Adoption and Transformation
Lead cloud adoption strategies and enterprise modernization initiatives.
Guide organizations through cloud readiness assessments, migration planning, and operational transformation.
Oversee technical and functional cloud solution implementation efforts.
Establish cloud governance frameworks, operating models, and adoption strategies.
Organizational Change Management
Direct change management activities to support technology transformation and user adoption.
Develop stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and organizational readiness strategies.
Assess organizational impacts and implement mitigation plans to support successful adoption.
Ensure business processes and workforce readiness align with technology transformation objectives.
Program and Delivery Oversight
Provide leadership for large-scale, multi-workstream transformation programs.
Manage program risks, issues, dependencies, budgets, and resource planning.
Ensure project delivery meets quality, schedule, and performance objectives.
Present program status, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership and client sponsors.
Qualifications
US Citizen with ability to obtain a US Public Trust
10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, systems integration, data migration, cloud transformation, or related disciplines.
5+ years of consulting, practice leadership, program management, or related technology leadership experience.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives.
Extensive experience with integration architectures, data migration methodologies, and enterprise modernization programs.
Experience leading cloud adoption and organizational change management initiatives.
Strong understanding of governance, risk management, compliance, and enterprise architecture principles.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex client relationships.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and executive stakeholder management skills.
Preferred
Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, and enterprise SaaS transformation programs.
Experience leading Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations involving integrations, security, reporting, and data migration.
Knowledge of enterprise integration platforms, APIs, middleware technologies, ETL tools, and cloud-native integration services.
Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
Experience supporting federal government agencies and highly regulated environments.
Knowledge of federal security, compliance, and governance requirements.
Experience implementing organizational change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent frameworks.
Professional certifications in cloud technologies, enterprise architecture, project/program management, change management, or data management disciplines.
Concept Plus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As such, we will give your application full consideration without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

Recognized as an award-winning Oracle partner, we have delivered innovative solutions across Defense, Intelligence, Civilian, Health IT, and Tribal sectors. Our highly certified experts build systems that drive efficiency, accelerate modernization, and ensure mission outcomes with certainty.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid life insurance, paid time off, 11 paid holidays, performance bonuses, tuition reimbursement, unlimited training, and the opportunity to thrive in a collaborative, flexible, and innovative environment.

About the role

Strategic Leadership

jobs.title: Director, Security Engineering
jobs.text:
Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.
The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and is trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.
About the Role
As Director of Security Engineering, you will lead the modernization of Fireblocks’ security infrastructure — across both our in-house-built tooling and the SaaS platforms we rely on. You will own the architecture behind security operations, our security data lake, SaaS security, and cloud security, and build the infrastructure that makes Fireblocks’ security tooling faster, more efficient, and ready for an agentic operating model.
This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the technical direction, build out a team and processes, and personally drive projects from architecture through implementation and measurable impact.
What You’ll Do
Security Infrastructure Strategy & Modernization
Own the multi-year modernization roadmap for Fireblocks’ security infrastructure, spanning in-house tooling and SaaS.
Analyze the needs across security domains, ensure we have the appropriate architecture for a centralized security data lake, and propose and drive optimized designs for agentic flows.
Security Data & Detection Engineering
Build and evolve Fireblocks’ security data lake and the logging, detection, and analytics pipelines built on top of it.
Optimize security data infrastructure to support faster detection, detailed investigation and automated response.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Coordinate and align with Security, R&D, and DevOps stakeholders to drive infrastructure projects end-to-end.
Lead projects from concept to delivery, and define the metrics that demonstrate their impact.
Requirements
7+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including leadership roles in SecOps, Application Security, or DevSecOps.
At least 3–4 years in a formal leadership or management capacity.
Security Engineering background — hands-on experience implementing and optimizing security systems is a must.
Proven experience building security systems and workflows that handle large-scale data (e.g., security data lakes, SIEM), including hands-on work with security auditing, logging, and cloud infrastructure.
Hands-on experience implementing AI processes, workflows, and tools to optimize security operations and workflows, and familiarity with AI security tooling.
Strong track record coordinating across Security, R&D, and DevOps stakeholders.
A builder mentality: the desire and ability to create infrastructure from scratch, lead projects end-to-end, and measure their impact.
Nice to Have
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP).
Fireblocks’ mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect & Data Governance Head
jobs.text:
To supercharge this next decade of unprecedented growth, we are seeking a visionary Enterprise Architect to join the Chief Digitalization Officer’s (CDO) Leadership Team.
Reporting directly to the CDO, s/he/they will serve as the strategic architect and technical anchor for Masdar’s global digital ecosystem. S/he/theywill spearhead the Enterprise Digital function, designing a flexible, best-of-breed composable architecture that seamlessly bridges modern corporate systems with agile, field-level renewable asset operations. Crucially, s/he/they will own and steer the global Data Management & Data Governance strategy, defining the universal data taxonomies that transform cross-border operational insight into a competitive advantage.
S/he/they will build up high-performing domain architects, to safeguard and scale our Digital Architecture and infrastructure, as well as a robust team of competent data management specialist. Masdar’s future Enterprise Digital Architecture will empower Masdar to continue scaling and expanding securely, rapidly, and intelligently, and powering the world's clean energy future.
Minimum Requirements
15+ years of progressive experience operating at a global, enterprise-level architecture capacity, preferably within heavily asset-intensive or energy environments.
10+ years of direct experience leading, managing, and developing a team of specialized domain architects.
10+ years of hands-on experience in ERP and Data architecture design, with a proven track record of transitioning legacy setups into modern, composable designs.
8+ years of experience architecting and managing global data management platforms.
5+ years of dedicated experience driving Data Governance initiatives (establishing policies, frameworks, and master data hierarchies), as well sa running governing bodies.
5+ years of people management and stakeholder management
Strong & clear Communicator who can translate complex technical design into business languages/value, while influencing peers and stakeholders for consensus.
Ability of resolving design difference, prioritizing enterprise architecture design build-up into phases that matter to Masdar operations and efficiency.
A collaborator and a team player, who can mentor and coach team members across the CDO team
Preferred & Plus Factors
Prior experience with SAP S/4HANA ERP Core and O&M (Operations & Maintenance) global deployment.
Deep familiarity with cybersecurity and industrial architectural frameworks specific to critical infrastructure (e.g., NIST, NERC CIP, or IEC 62443).
As part of the application process, we will collect, store and process personal information about you.
Masdar will use your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice, which provides details on the purposes for which your data is processed.
Established in 2006, Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company) is a global clean energy leader, transforming how the world produces and consumes energy through bold innovation and commercial excellence.
Masdar is a clean energy investor, developer and operator, advancing renewable energy projects across key markets and technologies, with a global project portfolio capacity to date of over 65 gigawatts (GW).
Jointly owned by TAQA, ADNOC and Mubadala, Masdar is driving the scale-up of renewables worldwide, targeting a portfolio capacity of 100GW by 2030.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run 30,000 programs, welcomed 1.2 million applicants, and facilitated the distribution of more than $10 billion in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.
We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change.
About the Role
Submittable is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to own our engineering vision, architecture, and execution as we continue to scale. This is a pivotal leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, responsible for building and leading a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization spanning India and the US. The CTO will partner closely with Product, Sales, and the broader Executive Leadership Team to translate strategic vision into technical execution including platform stability, scalable architecture, and cross-border effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Strategy & Architecture
Define and own the multi-year technology roadmap and architecture strategy in alignment with business goals
Evaluate and evolve the technology stack to support scalability, security, and reliability
Champion product stability and platform resilience as a top engineering priority
Own build-vs-buy and vendor/technology partnership decisions
Maintenance of legacy platforms and potential for migration strategies, profit optimization
Engineering Leadership
Lead a distributed engineering organization across US and India
Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent; build a strong leadership bench
Establish engineering best practices: code quality, testing, CI/CD, incident response, and security posture
Drive cross-border collaboration and communication practices to close gaps between distributed teams
Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with Product on roadmap prioritization and technical feasibility
Work with Sales and Customer Success to address technical escalations and enterprise requirements
Represent engineering in ELT strategic planning, budgeting, and board-level initiatives
Operational Excellence
Own engineering KPIs (i.e. uptime/reliability, velocity, technical debt reduction, defect reporting, AI utilization/leverage, etc.)
Oversee security and compliance team inclusive of SOC II audits, pen testing, privacy compliance, etc.
Manage engineering budget, Saas platform margin, headcount planning, and vendor contracts
Ensure compliance with data security, privacy, and industry regulations relevant to SaaS
Qualifications
12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in senior technology leadership (CTO or equivalent) at a SaaS company
Proven experience leading distributed/global engineering teams, ideally including India-based teams
Track record of scaling engineering organizations through growth stages (startup to mid-market SaaS)
Demonstrated experience building or scaling AI/ML-powered product features and driving AI adoption within an engineering organization"
Strong technical foundation in modern web architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), APIs, and data security
Experience partnering with executive leadership on business strategy, not just technical execution
Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and the board
Experience with M&A technical due diligence, platform migrations, or major re-architecture projects is a plus
Success Metrics (First 12 Months)
Established technical roadmap aligned to ELT strategic priorities
Measurable improvement in platform stability and uptime
Strengthened US/India engineering collaboration model
Key senior engineering leadership hires and retention milestones met
We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States; however, we cannot accommodate scholastic or employment visas at this time. In addition, we are not able to consider applicants who reside in the following states: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maine, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, West Virginia, and Wyoming.
Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Submittable will NEVER request bank details, payment, or personal information during the hiring process, nor extend offers without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official submittable.com email addresses. If you receive suspicious outreach, please report it to people@submittable.com. (Please do not submit applications, resumes, cover letters, or other candidacy materials to this email address. Emails of this nature will not be reviewed or considered.)
Why Submittable?
Joining Submittable means becoming part of a forward-thinking, mission-driven company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. We empower organizations working for social good with technology that accelerates their work, amplifies their impact, and drives meaningful change.
At Submittable, you’ll find a supportive, dynamic work environment where your contributions directly influence our success. If you thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and are excited to be part of a company dedicated to social impact, we invite you to apply!
Benefits: We are proud to offer highly competitive benefits to our full-time employees, including:
Comprehensive health and life insurance with optional HSA, FSA, and DCA accounts
401(k) plan with employer match starting day one
Equity stock options to share in our success
Flexible hours, remote work options, and generous vacation and sick leave
Paid parental leave for mothers, fathers, and adoptive parents
Professional development stipends to support your career growth
Opportunities to participate in community outreach and volunteer programs
Monthly company-sponsored happy hours and gatherings to connect and unwind
Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging
At Submittable, we believe technology is a force for good, driving social impact and enabling corporate social responsibility on a global scale. To achieve this, we are committed to fostering a workplace that values inclusion and belonging as central pillars of our culture.
We embrace the strength of our diverse community by creating a safe space where employees feel empowered to share ideas, celebrate unique experiences, and learn from one another. By prioritizing inclusion, we aim to build an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and make innovative contributions that enable our customers to tackle complex challenges and spread more good.
As a globally used platform, we are dedicated to hiring and supporting employees who represent a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. This includes diversity in ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, religion, ability, culture, and socioeconomic background.
About Our Process
Our goal is a fair, efficient, and thorough evaluation process that benefits you and our team and respects your time. As you can imagine, we have received a high volume of applications. Your willingness to participate in I.D. Verification and answer a few questions early allows us to move through the process more quickly.
Let's Talk About AI:
Guidelines for using AI in our Hiring Process: At Submittable, we believe that Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be a powerful tool for good. We are committed to leveraging AI technologies responsibly, ensuring their use is equitable, fair and safe. To ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during take home tests or interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, please let us know.
For additional information and guidance on using AI to prepare an interview at Submittable, please click here.
We believe our approach streamlines the hiring process and respects your time by ensuring that every conversation is substantive and focused on your unique qualifications. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to learning more about you.

jobs.title: Director Procurement - Technology Tower Lead (Remote, Texas, US)
jobs.text:
About Foundever
Foundever® is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 150,000 associates across the globe, we’re the team behind the best experiences for +750 of the world’s leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.
Job Summary
The Global Tech/IT Tower Lead is responsible for leading the global category management strategy across the organization's Technology/IT spend portfolio, including software, infrastructure, hardware, cloud, telecommunications, cybersecurity, and IT services.
This role serves as the strategic procurement partner to Technology and business leadership, and is accountable for category strategy development, supplier selection, commercial negotiations, supplier relationship management, and delivery of savings and broader procurement value objectives across the assigned portfolio.
The Tower Lead manages a globally distributed team and partners closely with executive and cross-functional teams to support enterprise priorities, procurement transformation initiatives, and operational scalability within a complex global environment. This role serves as a member of the Global Procurement Leadership team and contributes to broader procurement strategy, operating model evolution, and capability development initiatives.
Duties and Responsibilities
Strategic Category Leadership
Develop and execute category management strategies across the Technology/IT spend portfolio (7-10 subcategories across approximately $200-250M including multi-year roadmaps aligned to business priorities, savings objectives, supplier management, risk mitigation, and operational requirements.
Partner and engage with senior stakeholders, including C-suite, to align procurement strategies with enterprise objectives, transformation initiatives, and functional priorities.
Provide market intelligence, supplier insights, and category expertise to support strategic decision-making, long-term planning activities, evolving business and Technology priorities, and alignment of category strategies with key stakeholders.
Support and contribute to enterprise digitalization initiatives and evolving Technology strategies, including alignment to broader AI-related priorities where applicable.
Supplier & Commercial Management
Lead strategic sourcing activities, supplier selection decisions, contracting activities, and complex commercial negotiations across the assigned Technology categories.
Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships, governance models, and risk mitigation approaches to support cost optimization, service quality, scalability, operational resilience, and broader risk management objectives.
Oversee contracting, supplier governance, and commercial management activities in partnership with Legal, Finance, Security, Privacy, Operations, and business stakeholders.
Support adherence to procurement governance standards, enterprise policies, and sourcing controls across the Technology procurement portfolio.
Financial & Business Value Delivery
Own category savings targets and identify opportunities for demand management, vendor consolidation, commercial optimization, process improvement, and broader procurement value creation.
Monitor supplier performance, category spend trends, contractual commitments, and market conditions to proactively identify risks and optimization opportunities.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and spend management activities related to the Technology procurement portfolio.
Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, develop, and mentor a globally distributed procurement team while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused, and high-performance environment.
Support capability development, knowledge sharing, and implementation of procurement best practices across category management and supplier management activities.
Coach and mentor procurement talent to support organizational capability growth and future procurement leadership development.
Qualifications - Experience
Minimum:
10+ years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or category management experience within complex global organizations.
5 years' experience supporting Technology/IT procurement categories, including software, infrastructure, cloud, hardware, telecommunications, cybersecurity, and/or IT services.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing category strategies across large and complex global spend portfolios.
Experience leading strategic supplier negotiations and managing executive-level supplier relationships.
Experience partnering with senior business and Technology stakeholders in a matrixed global environment.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong commercial, analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred:
Experience supporting procurement transformation, operating model redesign, or global centralization initiatives. Experience within multinational, technology, services, or BPO environments.
Familiarity with procurement technologies, source-to-contract processes, and supplier governance frameworks.
**Some global travel may be required (20-30%)

jobs.title: Director of Data Science
jobs.text:
Who You Are
You are passionate about leveraging data, machine learning/AI and operational execution to improve patient outcomes. Your mandate will be to build a worldclass data science function that develops, deploys and maintains data marts and machine learning models that can also assess the impact of our clinical interventions. You’re a leader who cares deeply about outcomes and impact. You are a collaborative leader who can help bridge the gap between clinical strategy, operational execution and technology. You have rich experience with health plan (claims, eligibility, pharmacy) and clinical (EMR, HIE) data. You can build data-marts in DBT and leverage those data marts to build new machine learning models.
Who We Are
Oasis Health Partners (Oasis) is an all-in-one partner for independent primary care practices. We focus on Medicare value-based care programs, including Medicare Advantage and MSSP, and surround practices with the practical support they need to deliver better care while building durable, independent businesses.
Our model helps physicians spend more time on proactive, high-value care for seniors while Oasis brings the data, tools and team to support them behind the scenes. We are building a fast-growing network of independent PCPs and IPAs, backed by leading healthcare investors and scaling into new markets as we expand our suite of provider solutions. We are committed to keeping independent medicine strong — and we are looking for people who want to build that future with us.
Together, we will boldly advance primary care for those that need it most. We are excited for you to join us on this journey. We invite you to be a part of Oasis, where you will discover we do the right thing, build things together and go all in --- all while having fun!
As a Director of Data Science, you will:
Own our machine learning strategy and execution
Collaborate within the tech team, clinical, and operations to implement best-in-class clinical interventions
Set up analytics data models in DBT
Identify additional sources of data we can use to identify / risk stratify patients for intervention, and understand the impact of our program
Build out predictive models to identify high risk patients
Utilize AI/LLMs to advance patient and provider engagement
Analyze clinical data we receive from payors and providers
Analyze clinical program performance
Analyze workflow and operational data
Develop the analytics layer to support executive and operational dashboards
Investment In Our Team
We invest in the personal and professional success of our team. We take care of our people and offer robust benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401k, and generous time off plans. We are committed to supporting your growth with a development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career. As an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team, you will partner with professionals who understand the importance of high-value, high-impact patient care.
We invite you to be a part of Oasis, where you will discover we listen first, build things together, always do the right thing, have fun and most importantly, are all in!
About You
Minimum 8 years of experience in healthcare analytics with hands-on expertise in real-world data
Minimum 3 years of experience leading data science teams in healthcare
Advanced SQL skills for complex data analysis and reporting
Advanced Python skills for building and productionalizing machine learning models
Experience in developing impactful BI reports and dashboards for end-users
Quick learner with a demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies
Comfortable working in the ambiguity and rapid change of a startup environment
Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with technical and non-technical teams, including operational and clinical teams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks and projects effectively
Preferred Experience
Previous experience at a health plan or Managed Service Organization
Familiarity with Medicare Advantage populations and their unique healthcare needs
Background in value-based care organizations
Experience with the Oasis data stack, including AWS, DBT, and Snowflake
The salary range listed reflects the full compensation range for this role level at Oasis and is designed to support growth over time. Actual offers may vary based on a candidate’s skills, experience, and alignment with the scope of the role. Offers near the top of the range are uncommon and generally reflect exceptionally deep, directly relevant experience.
At this time, we are unable to sponsor employment visas. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without a current or future visa sponsorship. This role is open to applicants currently residing in the United States.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director of Data
jobs.text:
About Spoiler Alert
Spoiler Alert is a CPG and retail tech company on a mission to expand consumer access to affordable, everyday essentials by unlocking the value in surplus inventory. We've powered the sale of over $6 billion of inventory from leading CPG brands like Unilever, Kraft Heinz, and Mondelez into hundreds of value channel retailers and wholesalers - recovering value for brands, reducing waste, and creating savings for consumers. We're building the marketplace infrastructure to transform CPG surplus into opportunity for retailers to meet consumer demand at scale, and infusing AI-native products into a segment of the CPG supply chain that is ripe for improvement.
The Opportunity
We're hiring a Director of Data to make data the indisputable engine of our results and market differentiation. The next chapter of Spoiler Alert is defined by how well we turn our marketplace data into better outcomes for our suppliers and buyers, resulting in platform value and analytics that compounds with every transaction.
This is a hands-on, cross-functional leadership role for someone who has done this work before in the CPG-retail world and built data teams that drive business outcomes. You'll own the customer-facing analytics that make our platform more valuable, the insights that show us how to make the marketplace more valuable to suppliers and buyers, and the team behind both. You'll partner closely with Product on what we build, Operations on how we advise our customers, and GTM on how we effectively bring our category and aggregated insights to the market.
You will be expected to bring an expert, outside-in point of view on where CPG and retail data practices are headed. You'll lead a small team of analysts and have the opportunity to grow the team to match the ambition of the role. This role will report to the VP of Product and will partner closely with the senior leadership team, Engineering, Operations, and GTM teams.
Responsibilities
Drive Differentiation & Platform Value
Partner with the VP of Product on the data strategy that drives results for suppliers and buyers, network effects across the marketplace, and compounding platform differentiation — including the embeddable, customer-facing analytics (aggregated insights, pricing intelligence, performance benchmarks, applied AI/ML) that deepen platform stickiness
Equip Operations with the data and intelligence to advise customers on best-in-class liquidation strategies
Identify and develop the commercial value of our data - including new data-driven products and premium offerings
Draw on your CPG and retail data fluency to shape product opportunities and customer-facing intelligence suppliers and buyers will value and act on.
Evaluate strategic data partnerships and technical investments that accelerate our roadmap, including liaising with other CPG and retail tech companies
Power Better Decisions Across the Business
Define and maintain the marketplace liquidity metrics that matter, and deliver clear, accessible monitors that drive decisions for Operations, Product, GTM, Senior Leadership, and the Board of Directors
Strengthen and scale how Spoiler Alert uses data and AI/ML in everyday decisions and execution, with internal adoption, accessibility, and impact as the measures of success
Partner across the leadership team using data and AI with Product on what problems to prioritize, Engineering on how to solve them, Operations and Account Management to improve customer outcomes, and GTM to drive revenue.
Contribute to external thought leadership, including the publishing of aggregated insights and category analyses, as well as participation in webinar and speaking opportunities
Build the Team & Foundations
Recruit, develop, and lead a team with a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and business impact, growing team members into partners who influence decisions across the company
Partner with Engineering and senior leadership to ensure data quality, consistency, and accessibility can support how the company and our customers want to use data and AI
Qualifications
7-10+ years in analytics or data science, with 3+ years leading data teams - ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS, marketplace, or data products company
Direct experience with CPG and/or retail data: the metrics suppliers and buyers use, and how it moves and gets used between manufacturers, distributors, and retailers
Experience differentiators: category management, pricing optimization, demand planning, applied AI/ML, supply chain management, auction theory, retail media
Track record of shipping customer-facing data products that drive measurable customer and business value - not just dashboards, but decisions and value
Commercial instinct for where data creates business value - including new products, premium offerings, or partnerships
Hands-on comfort with SQL and the modern data stack - close to the work alongside the team and a credible partner to Engineering
Hands-on expertise to coach and collaborate with data team members across the stack, from dbt, SQL, semantic modeling languages, and data visualization in BI tools to python, pandas, jupyter notebooks, and LLMs in AI/ML tools.
Power user of AI with an ambitious and pragmatic viewpoint on its impact within retail and CPG including expert insight on where the modern data stack and AI/ML products are heading
Track record of hiring and developing strong analysts
Cross-functional credibility with Product, Engineering, GTM, and senior leadership; brings clarity in ambiguity and drives decisions
Operates with a bias for action and communicates data clearly to a wide variety of stakeholders
Benefits
Spoiler Alert is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. Employee benefits include the following:
Remote-first environment, with co-working access for locals in BOS, NYC, & DEN
Competitive salary and stock option packages
Subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance plans
Climate-focused, pre-tax 401(k) and post-tax Roth 401(k) options
12-16 weeks of paid parental leave + flex return to work
15+ company holidays, including an "End of Year Reset Week"
20 vacation days and 10 sick days per year
Focus Fridays (no meetings after 1PM local)
Summer Fridays (1/2 day)
Paid volunteer outings and civic engagement leave
Annual flex funds for remote work needs, learning & development, and socializing with colleagues
Company-sponsored $500 FSA contribution
The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $190,000, determined by level of experience and expertise - not a negotiation range.
We are a diverse team committed to a safe and inclusive work environment, free of discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetics, national origin, ancestry, age, medical condition, mental or physical disability, handicap or veteran status, or marital status.
Please note that applicants should be authorized to work in the United States. Though we are interested in every qualified candidate, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time.

jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

Articulate strategy, progress, and trade-offs to internal leadership and external institutional clients.

PM experience at a crypto exchange on Custody OES, or at a custody, or background from traditional finance on Collateral / Tri-party / CCP solutions. Deep market knowledge and an end-to-end grasp of how counterparties, custody, execution, and settlement connect.

Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools for market research and product operations. Building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features.

jobs.title: Product Director, Localisation & AI Evals
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"
Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.
We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:
A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.
A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.
This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.
This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.
What You’ll Be Doing
You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.
Own the agentic translation system
Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.
Build the agentic QA and quality automation
Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.
Make it self-improving
Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.
What We Look For In You
PM leader who has taken a frontier agentic product from 0 to 1, beyond translation.
Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.
Accountable for business outcomes and measured on business metrics, not delivery volume.
Deep hands-on experience building large-scale, frontier-LLM agentic systems from 0 to 1.
Experience with harness/orchestration layers, multi-agent workflows, and LLM-as-a-judge or automated evaluation pipelines.
Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.
International product experience serving users across multiple languages and regions.
Nice to Haves
Built an agentic system from scratch
Shipped agentic / LLM applications in production
Finance, payments or another highly regulated industry.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Director of Data Management
jobs.text:
Founded by the Sisters of Charity of New York, the University of Mount Saint Vincent is an academically excellent, authentically inclusive, Catholic and ecumenical liberal arts university. The University combines a strong core curriculum with a full array of majors in the liberal arts and, within the tradition of liberal education, selected professional fields of study.
At Mount Saint Vincent, a student’s education extends beyond knowledge, skills, and preparation for work. We seek the development of the whole person. In the spirit of Vincent de Paul and Elizabeth Ann Seton, we foster an understanding of our common humanity, a commitment to human dignity, and a full appreciation of our obligations to each other.
Position Summary:
The Director of Data Management serves as the School of Nursing's lead administrator for data analytics, reporting, compliance, and institutional effectiveness. Working closely with the Dean and academic leadership, this position oversees the collection, management, analysis, and reporting of data related to student success, faculty productivity, program outcomes, accreditation, and regulatory compliance. The Director transforms complex data into actionable insights that support strategic planning, continuous quality improvement, accreditation activities, and evidence-based decision-making across the School of Nursing.
Responsibilities:
Accreditation, Compliance, and Regulatory Reporting
Manage data collection and reporting processes required for accreditation, state, and federal regulatory agencies.
Prepare and submit reports for organizations including the New York State Education Department (NYSED), Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE), and other regulatory bodies.
Monitor program outcomes, including retention, graduation, licensure and certification pass rates, employment outcomes, and student learning outcomes.
Ensure accuracy, integrity, and compliance of institutional data in accordance with FERPA, HIPAA, and university policies.
Maintain and validate data reported on School of Nursing websites, publications, and external reports.
Data Analytics and Strategic Decision Support
Develop dashboards, reports, and performance metrics that support academic and operational decision-making.
Analyze trends related to enrollment, retention, progression, graduation, licensure outcomes, faculty workload, and resource utilization.
Provide data analyses and reports to support strategic planning, budgeting, program development, and growth initiatives.
Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and operational effectiveness.
Data Systems Management
Oversee the integration and management of institutional and program-specific data systems.
Coordinate data collection, validation, and reporting across academic and administrative departments.
Develop efficient processes for data entry, retrieval, analysis, and reporting.
Maintain data dictionaries, reporting procedures, and documentation standards.
Evaluate and implement technologies that enhance reporting and analytics capabilities.
Training and Collaboration
Serve as a resource to faculty and staff on data reporting requirements, dashboards, and data management practices.
Provide training and support related to data systems and reporting tools.
Collaborate with university offices including Institutional Research, Information Technology, Admissions, Registrar, Finance, and Academic Affairs to ensure data quality and consistency.

jobs.title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
jobs.text:
📋 DESCRIPTION (About Norbloc + Why This Role Matters + What You'll Own)
Norbloc builds the trust infrastructure behind modern financial compliance. Our RegTech and blockchain platform powers Know Your Customer (KYC) and secure data-sharing for banks, financial institutions and government bodies, replacing slow, fragmented, manual onboarding with a shared, distributed-ledger-backed ecosystem that regulators, banks and customers can all rely on.
Our clients are not forgiving of shortcuts: systemic banks, regulators and government bodies across Europe and the Middle East operate under some of the strictest security, resilience and compliance standards in the industry. Building for them means every architectural choice has to hold up under real scrutiny.
We're now looking for a Chief Technology Officer to take that foundation and scale it, leading technology through Norbloc's next phase of growth.
Why This Role Matters Now
Norbloc sits where two worlds meet: the pace and ambition of blockchain and data innovation versus the risk tolerance of enterprise banking. Few technology leaders are fluent in both. This role exists to be that bridge, someone who can architect for scale and security, lead engineering teams through rapid growth and sit across the table from a bank's CIO or a regulator's compliance officer and speak their language fluently.
This is a board-level seat with real ownership: over architecture, over the technology organization and over how Norbloc is perceived by the institutions that matter most to our growth.
What You'll Own
Technology Strategy & Architecture
Set Norbloc's end-to-end technology strategy and multi-quarter roadmap, in step with company vision and enterprise client needs
Architect secure, cloud-native systems that bridge banking-grade infrastructure with blockchain/DLT, cryptography and modern data and AI capabilities
Own the platform's operating model, including SLAs, observability, incident response and on-call practices, to a standard that satisfies regulated financial clients, not just internal targets
Make build-vs-buy and vendor/platform calls backed by clear-eyed cost, scalability and governance analysis. Be willing to defend the "boring" choice when it's the right one
Data, Governance & Compliance
Build the data governance, lineage, metadata and quality foundations that make the platform auditable and trustworthy at scale
Own technology risk management and IT governance, including compliance with KYC/AML, data residency and audit requirements across our operating jurisdictions
Work with Compliance and external legal counsel so that technical decisions are made with regulatory consequences already priced in, not discovered afterward
Team & Delivery Leadership
Lead, mentor and scale Engineering, Data, DevOps and QA, building strong managers under you, not just individual contributors
Instill the delivery discipline that enterprise clients expect: code quality, CI/CD, testing rigor, predictable roadmaps
Take ownership of any externally delivered components and bring them fully in-house where it makes sense to do so
Executive & Client Engagement
Be Norbloc's senior technical voice to C-level executives, IT leadership and compliance officers at bank and government clients
Represent Norbloc's technology vision to investors, partners and prospective enterprise clients
Translate technical trade-offs (cost, risk, scalability) into terms a systemic bank's leadership can act on with confidence
