The VP of Product will lead a Product and Design team and work as a close partner to Engineering. Scope may expand based on the individual, potentially including Analytics, Consumer, or broader GM responsibilities.
Responsibilities

items: Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across Seated’s consumer and restaurant products
Partner with the CEO and executive team to identify, evaluate, and validate Seated’s next major product bets
Lead product discovery, customer research, experimentation, business-case development, and validation
Evaluate opportunities across consumer marketplace expansion, restaurant software, AI, and adjacent products
Strengthen critical product infrastructure, including merchant identification and transaction recognition
Partner closely with Engineering on technical tradeoffs, prioritization, and execution
Identify opportunities for product-led growth across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization
Build and lead a small, high-performing Product and Design team
Translate company strategy into a focused product roadmap with clear priorities and measurable outcomes
Develop a deep understanding of consumer behavior, restaurant operator needs, unit economics, and marketplace dynamics

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Personal Loans Growth
jobs.text:
About the Role
Upgrade is seeking a Director of Product Management to help drive the next phase of growth for our Personal Loans business. In this role, you’ll identify and develop high-impact growth opportunities across the customer journey — from acquisition and conversion to new loan programs, partnerships, market expansion, and deeper relationships with existing customers. You’ll operate as an individual contributor, working closely with Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Risk, Credit, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Operations. You’ll combine customer insights, data, and business economics to identify opportunities, build the case for investment, and lead cross-functional teams from strategy through execution. This is an ideal role for a highly analytical and commercially minded product leader who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and turning new ideas into measurable business results.
This is a hybrid role based in either our San Francisco, CA, or Wilmington, DE, office, with onsite work on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
What You’ll Do:
Own and evolve the growth product strategy for Personal Loans, identifying opportunities to grow funded volume, expand our addressable market, improve economics, and increase customer lifetime value.
Develop a deep understanding of the Personal Loans funnel, customer behavior, acquisition channels, credit and fraud constraints, and key drivers of business performance.
Identify, size, and prioritize new growth opportunities, including new loan programs, customer segments, credit capabilities, distribution partnerships, and conversion improvements.
Partner closely with Marketing to connect product strategy with acquisition, customer segmentation, lifecycle marketing, and channel performance.
Partner with Partnerships to identify new distribution opportunities, develop partner-specific experiences, and improve performance across existing relationships.
Work with Risk, Credit, Finance, and Analytics to evaluate opportunities based on customer impact, credit performance, economics, and incremental profitability.
Lead high-impact initiatives that span multiple product and functional teams, creating alignment and driving execution from concept through launch.
Use experimentation, customer research, competitive insights, and data to identify growth constraints and uncover new opportunities.
Define clear hypotheses and success metrics, evaluate performance after launch, and determine where to iterate, scale, or change direction.
Serve as a senior thought partner to Personal Loans leadership on product strategy, prioritization, and investment decisions.
What We Look For:
9+ years of product management experience, including experience operating at a Principal or Director level and a track record of driving meaningful business outcomes.
Proven ability to identify growth opportunities and translate ambiguous problems into clear product strategies, prioritized roadmaps, and successful products.
Strong analytical and commercial instincts, with experience using data to understand customer behavior, conversion funnels, unit economics, and business tradeoffs.
Experience in consumer lending, credit cards, fintech, or another data-intensive consumer financial product strongly preferred.
Experience partnering closely with Marketing, Growth, Business Development, or Partnerships teams.
Familiarity with credit decisioning, payments, funding infrastructure, or loan origination is a plus.
Strong quantitative skills and comfort with experimentation, financial analysis, funnel analytics, and SQL.
Ability to understand and navigate tradeoffs across growth, customer experience, risk, fraud, compliance, and economics.
Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Risk, Finance, and other functions without direct authority.
Experience working with external partners or vendors to develop and test new capabilities is a plus.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex problems, develop compelling business cases, and create alignment around strategic decisions.
High degree of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, quantitative, or technical degree a plus.
What We Offer You:
Competitive salary and stock option plan
Paid coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible PTO
Opportunities for professional growth and development
Paid parental leave
Health & wellness initiatives
The compensation range for this position is USD $190,000–$250,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. An individual’s base salary within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Location: Bangalore, India (Hybrid) - regular travel expected, primarily to China, with occasional travel to the UK
Department: Technology
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
WHO WE ARE
At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.
With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.
YOUR NEXT ROLE
As VP of Engineering, you are the number two in Acclaro's technology organization - reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, deputizing for them, and owning the engineering org end to end. You will lead a globally distributed team across India and China that we expect to scale to 20–30 engineers when fully staffed.
You're joining at a pivotal moment. Acclaro is undergoing a major structural transformation, building our own proprietary AI platform to stay competitive, and evolving into a truly tech-enabled company. This role sits at the center of that shift - you'll build new technology from the ground up while keeping our existing systems running reliably through the transition.
Two things matter more than anything else in this job. The first is hiring: you will personally build the team that builds the platform, and the quality of that team is the single biggest determinant of whether this transformation works. The second is that you stay technical -s this is not a delegation-only leadership position. You'll be in the codebase, in the pull requests and on the incident calls, and the engineers you hire will judge you on it.
We are building AI-first in both senses: AI in the product, and AI in how the engineering team itself works. If you thrive at the intersection of technology, leadership and business impact, and want the kind of ownership that comes from building something rather than inheriting it, this is that opportunity.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Hire an exceptional team. Own engineering recruiting as your primary deliverable: Defining the bar and the scorecards, sourcing and pitching candidates yourself, running the technical loop, and closing senior hires. Scaling to 20–30 engineers across India and China without lowering the bar is the job.
Lead and grow them. Set org design, career ladders and a performance culture people want to be part of. Develop first-line managers and tech leads, give direct feedback, and act quickly on both high performers and mis-hires.
Stay hands-on. Write code where it counts - prototypes, spikes and the hard production problems - and be a regular, visible participant in code reviews and design reviews. Technical credibility is how you will lead this team, and how you will recruit into it.
Build the AI platform. Lead the build-out of Acclaro's proprietary AI platform: LLM orchestration, retrieval, agentic workflows, evaluation and quality harnesses, model selection and routing, latency and cost control, and human-in-the-loop review at production scale.
Make the engineering org AI-native in how it works. Set the standard for agentic coding tools, AI-assisted review and testing, and automated toil reduction - then measure the leverage it creates and raise it every quarter. You are expected to hold strong, current opinions here and to change them as the tooling changes.
Own the architecture. Drive architectural reviews and major technology and build-versus-buy decisions, balancing innovation, scalability, reliability, security and maintainability across both green-field and legacy estates.
Ship predictably. Establish and continuously improve engineering standards, development practices, CI/CD, testing and quality frameworks - and own delivery predictability, uptime and platform health through measurable goals and KPIs.
Partner across the business. Work with Product, Design, Operations and commercial leaders to translate company priorities into scalable execution plans and technology roadmaps.
Be there when it breaks. Be personally present during major incidents - not just briefed afterward - and own disaster recovery planning, security readiness and business continuity.
Deputize for the CTO. Represent engineering at executive level and act as a trusted technical voice with clients, partners and external stakeholders. Own engineering budgets, infrastructure investment and vendor relationships alongside the CTO.
Keep us safe and compliant. Ensure technology practices align with security, privacy and data protection requirements across global markets.
THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF YOU
Have 10+ years building software and 5+ years leading engineers, including responsibility for a team of 20 or more across multiple locations
Are still a genuinely strong engineer - you can design a system, review a pull request with authority, and debug a production issue yourself. Expect a technical deep dive as part of our process
Have hired at pace and at quality: senior and staff-level hires you closed personally, an interview process you designed that other teams trusted, and a track record of retaining the people you hired
Have built with LLMs in production, not just in prototypes - retrieval, agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt and model operations, and the latency, cost and quality trade-offs that come with them, including knowing when AI is the wrong answer
Use AI tooling in your own daily engineering work and have rolled it out across a team, with a clear view of what it did and didn't improve
Have done this in a startup or scale-up environment - comfortable with ambiguity, constrained budgets and no existing playbook, and energized by building rather than inheriting
Have run green-field development and legacy modernization in parallel without letting either one stall
Are experienced with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure or GCP), APIs, microservices, data pipelines, and modern development practices such as CI/CD and infrastructure as code
Have led distributed engineering teams across multiple countries, cultures and time zones, and write clearly enough to lead asynchronously
Are an exceptional communicator who can adapt complex technical concepts for executive, customer and non-technical audiences, and who leads with clarity and empathy
Hold a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or have equivalent professional experience
YOU’LL STAND OUT IF YOU
Have been a CTO, VP of Engineering or founding engineer at an early-stage company that scaled successfully
Have taken a multi-tenant SaaS platform from zero to enterprise-grade, including the security and reliability work enterprise customer’s demand
Bring hands-on experience with localization technologies, translation management systems, or global content platforms
Have hired and led engineering teams in India and other countries.
Have led modernization projects that turned legacy systems into scalable, integrated solutions
Understand global compliance and security frameworks such as GDPR, SOC 2, or ISO certifications
Are multilingual, or have deep experience working across distributed, multicultural teams
Have a public body of technical work – open-source contributions, writing, or conference talks
WHAT SUCCESS LOOK LIKE
First 90 days. The hiring plan, scorecards and interview loop are in place, and the first senior hires are in flight. You have completed a clear-eyed assessment of the AI platform and the legacy estate - and you have shipped something yourself.
By six months. The team is growing to plan with no compromise on quality, first-line leadership is in place, and engineering standards and CI/CD are established. The AI platform has a predictable delivery cadence.
By twelve months. The team is at or near full strength at 20–30 engineers, retained and performing. The AI platform is live and carrying real client volume, and there is measurable improvement in delivery velocity and engineering leverage from AI-native ways of working.
INCLUSION & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY - Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

jobs.title: Field CTO, Public Sector
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As a Field CTO, Public Sector at GitLab, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor for public sector customers and prospects, helping them connect DevSecOps strategy, security, and compliance goals to real business and mission outcomes. You will work closely with executive stakeholders during the pre-sales process, offering strategic guidance on how GitLab can support secure software delivery, modernization efforts, and platform adoption across complex environments.
In this role, you will combine technical depth with executive communication. You will build relationships with leaders such as Chief Information Security Officers, Chief Security Officers, Chief Technology Officers, and chief security architects, while also partnering across GitLab with sales, marketing, and product teams. Your perspective from the field will help shape customer conversations, influence go-to-market strategy, and inform how GitLab continues to serve public sector organizations.
Note: This is an individual contributor, customer-facing technical advisory role; it does not include direct people management responsibilities.
This role is well suited for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology strategy, customer engagement, and market leadership. You will help customers understand the value of a single DevSecOps platform, contribute to industry conversations around standards and guidance, and represent GitLab in a way that reflects our values of transparency, collaboration, and results.
Some examples of our projects:
Supporting strategic public sector opportunities with executive-level DevSecOps and security guidance
Contributing to government working groups, standards discussions, and public sector thought leadership content
What you'll do
Engage with customers in a technical consulting and advisory role during the pre-sales process, providing technical assistance and strategic guidance.
Deliver executive-level thought leadership on DevSecOps, security, and compliance for strategic public sector opportunities, including new and growth accounts.
Build and maintain relationships with customer leaders such as Chief Information Security Officers, Chief Security Officers, Chief Technology Officers, and chief security architects.
Partner with the marketing team to develop content and support media engagement opportunities that increase awareness of GitLab in the public sector market.
Educate customers on the value of the GitLab platform and related technologies, and support conversations across multiple levels of the organization to help enable successful deployment.
Assist with requests for information and responses related to government publications and public-private partnership opportunities.
Participate in and contribute to working groups connected to government publications, standards, and demonstrations.
Curate and communicate public sector field feedback, collaborate on prioritization with marketing and product teams, and contribute to sales strategy, playbooks, enablement, and reusable technical content for the field.
What you'll bring
Demonstrated expertise in DevSecOps strategy, application security, and compliance for regulated environments, including providing risk-based guidance.
Experience selling to, supporting, or working within the public sector.
Experience creating and delivering technical thought leadership content (presentations, demos, written materials) independently.
Working knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including CI/CD and modern engineering and operations practices.
Experience with cloud computing and modern platform architectures that support secure software delivery.
Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical strategy effectively to audiences ranging from executives to engineers.
Comfort working in a fully remote, distributed, and asynchronous environment.
Ability to coordinate across time zones and adapt schedules to customer and internal stakeholder needs.
Experience in technical pre-sales, consulting, solutions architecture, or comparable customer-facing IT roles, including using GitLab (and willingness to learn quickly) to support customer conversations and demonstrations.
Living in the Washington D.C. Metro area preferred
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by applicable law.
About the team
The Field CTO, Public Sector role works across customer-facing and internal teams to help GitLab meet the needs of public sector organizations with clarity, credibility, and deep technical insight. This role partners closely with sales, solutions, marketing, and product stakeholders to represent customer priorities, strengthen technical strategy in the field, and support GitLab's position in a highly regulated and mission-driven market.
The team environment is collaborative, remote, and asynchronous, with a strong focus on sharing knowledge and turning field insight into action. The work is especially meaningful because it brings together executive advisory skills, platform expertise, and an understanding of security and compliance expectations that matter in public sector environments. Success in this role comes from being able to translate complex technical topics into clear guidance, while also helping GitLab improve how we serve this market over time.
At GitLab, you'll do this work in a values-driven culture built on collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.
How GitLab will support you
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental leave
Home office support

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

As a Field CTO, Public Sector at GitLab, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor for public sector customers and prospects, helping them connect DevSecOps strategy, security, and compliance goals to real business and mission outcomes. You will work closely with executive stakeholders during the pre-sales process, offering strategic guidance on how GitLab can support secure software delivery, modernization efforts, and platform adoption across complex environments.

In this role, you will combine technical depth with executive communication. You will build relationships with leaders such as Chief Information Security Officers, Chief Security Officers, Chief Technology Officers, and chief security architects, while also partnering across GitLab with sales, marketing, and product teams. Your perspective from the field will help shape customer conversations, influence go-to-market strategy, and inform how GitLab continues to serve public sector organizations.
Note: This is an individual contributor, customer-facing technical advisory role; it does not include direct people management responsibilities.

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology strategy, customer engagement, and market leadership. You will help customers understand the value of a single DevSecOps platform, contribute to industry conversations around standards and guidance, and represent GitLab in a way that reflects our values of transparency, collaboration, and results.

items: Supporting strategic public sector opportunities with executive-level DevSecOps and security guidance
Contributing to government working groups, standards discussions, and public sector thought leadership content

Partner with the marketing team to develop content and support media engagement opportunities that increase awareness of GitLab in the public sector market.
Educate customers on the value of the GitLab platform and related technologies, and support conversations across multiple levels of the organization to help enable successful deployment.
Assist with requests for information and responses related to government publications and public-private partnership opportunities.
Participate in and contribute to working groups connected to government publications, standards, and demonstrations.

Curate and communicate public sector field feedback, collaborate on prioritization with marketing and product teams, and contribute to sales strategy, playbooks, enablement, and reusable technical content for the field.

The Field CTO, Public Sector role works across customer-facing and internal teams to help GitLab meet the needs of public sector organizations with clarity, credibility, and deep technical insight. The team environment is collaborative, remote, and asynchronous, with a strong focus on sharing knowledge and turning field insight into action. jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.
What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.
For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.
Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.
The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:
As a Director of Engineering reporting to the Chief Technology Officer in our Provider Domain, your purpose will be to own the technical strategy and delivery for the systems hundreds of thousands of independent businesses run on every day. You will:
Own end-to-end delivery across 4–5 cross-functional teams, leading through Engineering Managers and Staff+ Engineers in a deliberately flat structure with no layers in between.
Set the engineering standard for the domain — building the frameworks for architecture decisions, technical proposals and how teams work.
Lead our AI transformation of the engineering lifecycle, and define the measures that prove it worked.
Partner with Product to turn commercial strategy into engineering strategy, and back it with experimentation and data.
Build a team of exceptional density, coaching leaders who can operate autonomously.

jobs.title: Design Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
VML Detroit is seeking an award-winning Design Director to serve as the visual lead across a major automotive account. In this role, you will elevate both big-picture brand storytelling and day-to-day creative output across all workstreams, including Brand, Retail, and Services. You will maintain graphic standards while pushing visual boundaries across global campaigns, retail communications, and digital touchpoints for an iconic American brand.
You are a hands-on leader skilled in brand design, digital experiences, motion graphics, and next-gen AI video generation. Partnering closely with creative teams, you will oversee visual quality across all deliverables to ensure exceptional craft. You must bring strong presentation skills, a passion for mentoring, and hands-on experience building case studies, award submissions, and executive pitch decks.
What you’ll do:
Craft | You’ll lead design territories and set the visual benchmark for major brand campaigns from concept through final execution. You will be directly hands-on in crafting visual languages, brand systems, advanced typography, motion graphics, and leveraging next-gen AI video generation tools to explore cutting-edge concepts. You will oversee all creative output across various account workstreams (including Retail and Automotive Financial Services), ensuring strict adherence to graphic standards while continually elevating the overall look and feel.
Collaborate | You’ll partner closely with workstream leads to integrate visual storytelling seamlessly across every channel. You’ll inspire the team to push creative boundaries, explore innovative visual techniques, and raise the bar on daily output. You will also lead the design of award show case studies, agency reels, and high-stakes executive presentations that showcase our best work on a global stage.
Partner | You will serve as a trusted visual design authority for internal leadership and senior client partners. You’ll articulate complex design choices with authority and clarity, advocate for visual innovation, and champion design excellence across every brief. Additionally, you will assist with recruitment, portfolio screening, and mentoring senior and mid-level design talent.
Who you are:
Visual Master & Master Typographer | You possess an exceptional eye for visual aesthetics, layout, grid systems, and typography. You see design as a fundamental storytelling tool and have a proven track record of creating iconic visual work on a global scale. You are fluent in static, interactive, and motion design, with an active mastery or deep exploration of emerging technologies like AI video generation.
Hands-On Leader & Craft Obsessor | You don’t just direct from a distance—you roll up your sleeves and lead by example. You are obsessed with the details, from pixel-perfect UI and motion keyframes to brand guidelines and production fidelity, ensuring that both high-profile campaign work and daily retail assets maintain an award-winning standard of craft.
Inspiring Storyteller & Presenter | You excel at presenting design concepts, building persuasive pitch decks, and crafting compelling case studies that win awards and executive buy-in. You have an infectious passion for design that motivates creative teams to take risks, innovate, and produce career-defining work.
What you’ll need:
A minimum of 7+ years specializing in visual design, brand design, and art direction within a progressive, top-tier creative agency or global design studio.
An award-winning portfolio featuring iconic work and absolute mastery of craft, typography, brand identity systems, motion design, and digital experiences.
Hands-on expertise in design applications (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, After Effects/motion software) and demonstrated experience using or directing next-gen AI image and video generation tools.
Proven experience overseeing visual work across diverse brand touchpoints, including brand campaigns, retail, and financial services divisions.
Demonstrated track record of upholding, evolving, and maintaining brand graphic standards across large-scale accounts.
Proven ability to build and deliver compelling presentations, award show submissions, and case studies.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate design decisions clearly and confidently to executive clients and internal partners.
Strong leadership, collaboration, and mentorship abilities to inspire a multi-disciplinary creative department.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Agentic Software Delivery
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.
What you’ll do
Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.
Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.
Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
Executive-level communication and influence.
Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.
About the team
The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.
What you’ll do

items: Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.

Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.

Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.

Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.

blocks.text: What you’ll bring

items: Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
Executive-level communication and influence.

Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.

blocks.text: About the team

The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.

The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Brazil
jobs.text:
Space Inch is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our engineering function within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.S. Partnering closely with our CTO, you'll be the most senior engineering leader on the account: owning day-to-day operational and people leadership, serving as the senior engineering point of contact for the client's stakeholders, and driving AI adoption across the team. This client operates in a highly regulated environment with work spanning many technical stacks, so we want someone who thrives in that variety and brings real operational excellence and care for engineers to an agency environment.
This is first and foremost a people-leadership and communication role. We're looking for an exceptional communicator who earns the trust of engineers and senior client stakeholders alike. You must come from an engineering background, current or former, but hands-on technical depth isn't the primary requirement.
We're also still building out this account's leadership structure, so there's no layer of Engineering Managers under this role yet. You'll lead individual contributors and team leads directly and stay hands-on with delivery yourself, at least for now, with the opportunity to develop engineers on your team into Engineering Managers over time.
Our Mission, Vision, and Values
At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.
Working at Space Inch
Our remote-first team of around 80+ people is based across the EU (mostly Croatia), the US, and Latin America, with a growing presence in Brazil.
Occasional travel for client visits and company retreats.
This role is embedded within a single long-standing client partnership, though you'll draw on Space Inch's broader engineering community and practices.
We support work/life balance for our team.
Requirements
10+ years in software development, with at least 5+ leading engineering teams, including technical delivery leadership (ideally in an agency, consultancy, or client-embedded environment). Distributed team experience is a plus.
Exceptional communicator and mediator who bridges client demands with team reality, builds real trust with engineers, and handles sensitive topics (compensation, retention, disengagement, underperformance) directly and with care. Strong across written, async, live, and cross-cultural communication
Proactive problem solver who spots delivery, scope, budget, and process breakdowns early (from PTO coverage gaps to missing test data) and fixes them without waiting for permission
Hands-on, demonstrable fluency with AI as a working tool: You've personally driven AI adoption in an engineering team with measurable outcomes (tooling rolled out, productivity gains, initiatives delivered); your credibility comes from execution, not commentary
Enough technical fluency across modern architecture, SDLC, and common stacks (e.g., React, Vue, Angular, Node.js, Python, Java, C#) to challenge assumptions, guide decisions, and turn vague client requests into execution plans alongside tech leads. You don't need to write production code
Experience coordinating multiple teams or workstreams in parallel, with strong stakeholder management on ambiguous or contentious topics, plus staffing, onboarding, interviewing, and resource planning
Strong commercial sensibility: translating technical work, operational fixes, and AI-driven gains into a value story clients understand and continue to invest in
A systems thinker: organized enough to hold many threads, decisive enough to act without waiting for permission, self-aware enough to loop in leadership after. Experience with internal developer platforms, MCP-style tooling, or prototype-to-production workflows is a plus
Key Responsibilities
People leadership, coaching, and retention: Build trust with engineers through regular 1:1s, candid feedback, and development support. Handle sensitive topics directly (compensation, disengagement, underperformance, burnout, departures) and resolve retention risks before they escalate.
Client stakeholder management and partnership: Be the senior point of contact for the client, building trust with senior stakeholders, managing shifting priorities, and turning ambiguous requests (a prototype, an HTML mockup, a new app idea) into practical execution plans.
Technical program coordination: Coordinate delivery across frontend, backend, DevOps, platform, and tooling workstreams; clarify ownership, align dependencies, and bridge communication gaps between internal teams and the client. Partner with tech leads on architecture and trade-offs.
Resourcing and operational ownership: Oversee hiring, onboarding, and staffing; keep engineers productive through client delays; spot and fix delivery, budget, and process breakdowns before they reach the client.
AI-driven team uplift: Lead a step-change in how the team uses AI (tooling, upskilling, workflow design) with standards tied to seniority and autonomy. Focus on measurable productivity and code-review quality, not adoption for its own sake.
Decisive action and commercial storytelling: Propose and execute fixes without waiting for permission, keeping the CTO informed of what you're doing and why. Translate delivery metrics, technical decisions, and AI gains into a value narrative for the client.
Typical Challenges You'll Be Solving
AI adoption that produces measurable outcomes, focused on actual productivity, code review quality, and autonomy.
Turning ambiguous client requests into execution plans across multiple workstreams.
Maintaining team morale and stability: keeping engineers motivated, engaged, and retention risk low through shifting client priorities, scope changes, or client access delays.
Creating clarity in messy space: stepping into situations where domain ownership is unclear, bridging fragmented cross-team conversations, and making sure everyone understands what needs to be done.
Balancing short-term delivery needs with longer-term team and technical health.
Qualities for Success
Exceptional communicator: empathetic, honest, and transparent. Engineers trust your guidance, feel supported in 1:1s, and follow your lead when priorities shift.
Credible in AI as a working tool, with practical experience to back it up.
A systems thinker who designs how work happens, quickly spots broken communication loops or process gaps, and fixes them before they escalate.
Comfortable making decisions and owning the outcome, even when the first attempt fails.
Adapts communication style across coaching, escalation, and client conversations.
Calm under client pressure, and doesn't pass that pressure to the team.
The Role Is Right for You If
You lead through trust, presence, and communication as much as technical depth, and you're just as comfortable mediating and coaching as you are talking architecture.
You're comfortable staying hands-on with delivery and team leadership while this account's structure is still being built out, rather than expecting a team of managers already in place.
You see leading AI adoption as one of the most important things a senior engineering leader can do right now, and you want to help engineers navigate a profession that's changing under their feet.
You enjoy turning ambiguity into action: spotting what isn't working, proposing a path, and trying it.
You're at home in messy situations between people, delivery, client communication, and operations, and take ownership without being asked.
The Role Is Not Right for You If
You want a primarily hands-on coding role.
You'd rather lead through technical authority than through relationships, trust, and communication.
You're looking for a role where a layer of managers already reports to you: that structure doesn't exist yet on this account.
You prefer leading through process and approval rather than presence and initiative.
You'd rather wait for direction than propose a way forward.
What's In It for You
Shape how AI shows up in this account's delivery: visible, measurable, tied directly to client value.
Partner with the CTO on engineering at scale.
Work across a range of high-impact initiatives within a long-standing client partnership.
Remote-friendly, collaborative, pragmatic culture.
Leadership team that values people-first thinking and technical excellence.
Compensation & Benefits
Monthly salary: $10,000-$13,000 for a full-time B2B collaboration (with flexibility for an exceptional candidate), based on experience and skills
Remote-first setup
Health & Wellbeing: PTO + 100% Paid sick leave + Annual health checkup
Stay active: Wellness subsidy
Continuous Growth: An education budget specifically designed to fuel your learning and help you expand your knowledge base.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Conversations
jobs.text:
Who we are
Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.
Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.
We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.
If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.
Your impact
Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. 10,000+ businesses use us because we've always believed that customer relationships are the business, and that every interaction should feel like it came from someone who cares. That trust took a decade to build, and now it's the foundation for something bigger.
The support industry is changing shape. AI will take on more of the tedious work so humans can lean into the relationship part. At Help Scout, the place where that relationship actually happens is the Conversations product group, which spans two product lines. Inbox is the workspace: every channel and every conversation in one place, built for the people who spend their whole day inside it. Copilot is AI working alongside them: drafts ready to review, context at their fingertips, and the tedious parts handled so every reply is faster and better.
Conversations is the most-used surface we have. This is where every user spends most of their day, so speed, reliability, and craft are the product. It's also where the rest of the platform becomes real: Agent hands conversations to humans at the right moment, customer context shows up right where the work happens, and every one of those moments either builds trust or spends it. You'll be accountable for bringing it all to life with clarity and impact.
About the role
You'll own the Conversations product group end to end: vision, roadmap, monetization, and results for the Inbox and Copilot product lines. You'll report to Scott Rocher, our Chief Product Officer, and you'll be accountable for the revenue growth of the group. This is a player/coach role.
Inbox and Copilot are the surfaces our customers touch most, the core of the business today and the front door to everything we build next. You'll do the strategic product work on them yourself: deciding what needs to get built next, how the workspace and its AI evolve together, and where investment in craft pays off. As the group grows, you'll hire and manage a team of PMs.
Note: This role is open to US-based applicants only.
What you'll do
Set the vision and strategy for the Conversations group, and decide how Inbox and Copilot evolve together as one experience where AI makes every support pro faster without breaking their flow.
Drive the Inbox roadmap hands-on: the workspace where every channel comes together and where our users spend their time in the product. This surface is held to a bar where speed, reliability, and polish are a differentiator.
Drive the Copilot roadmap hands-on: integrations, contextual summaries, suggestions, and in-the-moment assistance that make each person on a support team meaningfully better at their job.
Own how your products are monetized. Conversations spans seats and AI usage, and you'll design the packaging that makes each seat more valuable as Copilot does more. You'll collaborate with partners across Help Scout to model the impact of the products you ship.

That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. jobs.title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE
Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.
You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:
Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.
Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.
DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).
Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.
You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:
Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
This role is part of our Seobility team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.
Seobility joined saas.group in 2022. The Seobility all-in-one SEO suite empowers businesses and marketers around the world to boost their website visibility with professional SEO tools. Starting in 2013 with a commitment to usability and actionable advice to make professional-grade SEO accessible, Seobility today has over 700,000 users and earned international awards along the way!
Role Overview
As the Head of Engineering at Seobility, you lead the technical heart of a mature, high-traffic SEO SaaS product. We've just completed a large relaunch of the platform last year — and are digging into the real work now: evolving what an SEO tool does as AI rewrites how people search and what they expect from software. In a rapidly changing market shaped by AI-driven search, you lead our organizational and technical evolution. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will bridge the gap between engineering challenges and business impact. You guide the team through a transformation toward greater autonomy and lead them towards outcome-focussed execution and AI-native engineering. We're a small, senior team — ambitious and driven, but we genuinely look out for each other. You'll find real scope to own and room to grow.
Your Impact (First 3-6 Months)
Build Trusting Partnerships: Establish deep working relationships with the engineering team and tech leads to foster our culture of psychological safety and high performance.
Enable Distributed Ownership: Support the team in fostering ownership for outcomes. Guide the transition from functional (FE/BE) to end-to-end ownership.
Optimize and Leverage: Partner with the team to identify friction, bottlenecks and AI leverage potential. Implement a value-driven delivery flow with improved predictability and velocity.
Strategic Roadmap: Start executing on a roadmap that balances the strategic transformation of our engineering (e.g. tech debt, AI-native engineering, upskilling) with our product innovation goals.
Responsibilities
AI-Native Engineering: Spearhead the adoption of AI-native engineering practice to substantially increase engineering efficiency.
Organizational Transformation: Guide the evolution from functional roles to broader roles and outcome-orientation. You bridge gaps between Product and Engineering and make the two grow closer, reduce dependencies and empower the team to deliver end-to-end value.
Technical Vision: Own and co-create the technical vision & roadmap with your Tech Leads, balancing "tech debt" reduction with feature delivery.
Platform Health: Make sure our data-heavy platform is fast, reliable, and secure as it scales — with data privacy and GDPR handled as a matter of course.
People Development: Mentor and empower an international engineering team to embrace full ownership and foster confidence in autonomous decision-making.
Strategic Collaboration: Act as a high-level sparring partner to the CEO and Product leadership, and partner with the saas.group Central Platform team on DevOps and infrastructure topics. Navigate trade-offs between technical sustainability and delivery speed.
What you bring to the table
SaaS Leadership: Proven track record of leading engineering teams in a high-scale production environment, with a focus on efficient team structures and operational excellence.
Technical Credibility: You possess high technical credibility across modern stacks (ideally PHP/Laravel, Vue.js, and cloud infrastructure) and bring a particular strength in architecture and system-design.
AI First: A forward-thinking approach to AI as a core lever for both product features and engineering productivity.
Product-First Mindset: With your strong product-sense, you are a key partner for user value creation and prioritize engineering efforts based on customer value and business impact rather than technical elegance for its own sake.
Change Management: You are skilled at building alignment during transitions, leading teams through change and resistance to a new rhythm and velocity.
Enabler Mentality: You measure your success by what your team (incl. you) ships, not only by what you personally build.
Domain understanding: Domain understanding of SEO-related web technologies (websites, crawling, indexing, content analysis) is a strong plus.
Communication: Fluent English is a must; German is a strong advantage given the brand’s roots.
What’s in It for You
Ultimate Flexibility: Fully remote role with optional Nuremberg office; preferred time zone ±2 hours CET.
High Trust & Autonomy: We hire experts and get out of their way. You’ll have the freedom to solve problems your way with minimal bureaucracy.
The saas.group Network: Direct access to a global community of SaaS founders, engineering leaders, and experts to exchange knowledge and scale your own career.
Impact: A seat at the leadership table of a brand with thousands of users where your decisions move the needle every day.
Seobility is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.
—
saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.
We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.
