blocks.text: ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:

items: Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026

We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

blocks.text: ABOUT THE ROLE

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:

items: Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

blocks.text: This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

items: Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

jobs.title: Director, Technology Alliances
jobs.text:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
Apollo has hundreds of technical integrations across its ecosystem. Only a select few graduate into full Technology Alliances — partnerships significant enough to warrant real commercial investment: co-selling, joint go-to-market programs, and coordinated effort across product, marketing, sales, and partnerships. This is where Apollo puts the large majority of its focus and resources once an integration has proven it's worth building a genuine alliance around.
You'll own 360-degree responsibility for a select group of Apollo's most important technology alliances — the commercial and relationship layer that turns a technical integration into a real go-to-market motion. Where Product Partnerships owns integration depth and breadth (the technical relationship with each partner's R&D org), you own everything commercial: field-level co-selling, joint business planning, co-marketing execution, and stakeholder alignment from the executive level down to the field. You'll start by owning and running a focused portfolio of these alliances yourself. As Apollo's technology alliance ecosystem and revenue contribution scale, you'll hire and lead a team of Technology Partner Managers to carry that portfolio forward.
What you'll do:
1. Own 360-Degree Alliance Relationships
Take full ownership — commercial, relational, and operational — of a select portfolio of Apollo's graduated technology alliances
Build and maintain joint business plans with each partner, and be the single point of accountability for the health and growth of the relationship
Work with Product Partnerships to help decide which integrations are ready to graduate into a full alliance, and which alliances need to evolve or wind down
2. Drive Field-Level Co-Selling and Revenue
Get Apollo's own sales org and each partner's sales org actually selling together, not just aware of each other
Broker rep-to-rep introductions and build the field enablement that makes co-selling easy on both sides
Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue as a core, measurable outcome of the role
3. Design and Run Co-Marketing Programs
Build joint go-to-market programs that span demand generation, field events, and content — not one-off co-marketing moments
Partner with Apollo's marketing team to execute programs that generate real pipeline, not just brand association
4. Align Stakeholders Across the Business
Drive alignment across every level of the organization — from executive sponsors to management to the field — on each alliance's priorities and goals
Be the connective tissue between Partnerships, Product, Marketing, and Sales for each alliance you own
5. Build and Lead the Team as You Scale
Start as an individual contributor, personally owning and running a focused portfolio of alliances
As the technology alliance ecosystem and revenue contribution grow, hire, coach, and lead a team of Technology Partner Managers
Design how ownership divides as the team grows — by partner, partner type, or motion — and build the operating rhythm (QBRs, planning cadence, reporting) the team runs on
Minimum Qualifications
8+ years in technology alliances, strategic partnerships, or channel roles, with a demonstrated track record driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue
Experience owning the full commercial lifecycle of a technology partnership — joint business planning, field co-sell, and co-marketing execution
A track record designing and running joint go-to-market programs across demand generation, field events, and content, in partnership with a marketing team
Proven ability to align stakeholders across levels (executive, management, field) and across functions (product, marketing, sales, partnerships) around a shared plan
Comfortable starting as an individual contributor owning a personal portfolio, with a clear trajectory toward hiring and leading a team as the function scales
Comfortable operating as the commercial counterpart to a technical partnerships function — you don't own integration depth, but you make sure the partnership generates real business value
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with major CRM, cloud, or platform ecosystems and their partner/alliance programs
Experience running rep-to-rep co-sell motions and marketplace listings
Prior people-management experience, or demonstrated readiness to build and lead a team, is a plus
Background at a high-growth SaaS company with both a self-serve and enterprise/mid-market motion, where alliance revenue had to be earned rather than assumed
The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.
Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)
$220,000—$275,000 USD
Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)
$190,000—$238,000 USD
We are AI Native
Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.
Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo
At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.
We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.
If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.
Learn more here!

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
Description
Checkmarx is the AI-powered application security leader helping the world’s most security-conscious enterprises secure the software that powers modern life. For more than two decades, our unified platform and services have helped organizations protect human and AI-generated code from the first line through runtime, reducing risk across applications, cloud, and the software supply chain without slowing innovation.​
We’re trusted by 1,600+ customers in 70+ countries, including some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world. Guided by research-led innovation and a developer-first mindset, we help every developer, security team, and enterprise build software that is risk-free by design.
You will lead a team of product managers, set the quality and performance bar across engines, and partner with R&D, Research, Design, and GTM to deliver capabilities that meet enterprise expectations for accuracy, scale, and trust.
What you’ll do
Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for the engine portfolio, and make the investment trade-offs across engines that determine where Checkmarx competes and wins.
Build and lead a high-performing product management team, setting direction, developing talent, and holding a consistent standard across domains.
Establish detection quality and performance as accountable business outcomes, with clear targets and the evidence to demonstrate progress against them.
Partner with R&D leadership to align engineering capacity and delivery commitments to the roadmap.
Translate customer, market, and competitive insight into a differentiated strategy that drives adoption and revenue growth.
Align GTM, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success behind the engine narrative, and own its credibility in the market.
Engage enterprise customers and C-level stakeholders to validate direction, build long-term partnerships, and resolve escalations that matter to the business.
Represent the engine strategy internally and externally, including at executive reviews, customer briefings, industry events, and analyst engagements.
Requirements
What We're Looking For
10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a SaaS environment.
3+ years of experience leading product teams in a fast-paced technology environment.
Proven success launching and scaling B2B SaaS or enterprise security products.
Deep understanding of product lifecycle management, Agile methodologies, and lean principles.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with data-driven decision-making.
Experience engaging with enterprise customers, C-level stakeholders, and technical users.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, high-growth, and security-conscious environment.
Strong point of view on AI/ML product development, with familiarity across the AI/ML lifecycle (data, model development, evaluation, deployment)
Background in cybersecurity, application security, or developer tooling strongly preferred
The ideal candidate location is the East Coast
What we have to offer
Medical, dental, vision, 401(K), and additional incentives
Culture of community and opportunity to work in a growing organization
Room for career growth and professional development
Training and educational opportunities
Checkmarx Inc. is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: VP of Product Management, Conversational AI and Digital Servicing
jobs.text:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
As VP of Product Management, Conversational AI & Digital Servicing, you will define the future of how millions of customers engage with Empower when they need help, guidance, or service.
Your most important mandate will be defining and bringing to life Empower’s conversational AI strategy – creating experiences that allow customers to engage with an intelligent digital advisor, seamlessly transition to a human advisor when needed, and resolve everyday needs simply and intuitively. The opportunity is not to digitize traditional servicing, but to fundamentally rethink how digital intelligence and human expertise come together.
You will own the strategy from vision through execution. Near-term, that means identifying high-impact opportunities across conversational experiences, live chat, FAQs, and digital containment. Over time, the portfolio will expand across the foundational capabilities customers use to manage their relationship with Empower.
This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who combines rigorous strategic thinking with exceptional product judgment and strong technology fluency. You will work across Product, Technology, Design, Data, Innovation, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Legal, and Compliance to turn an ambitious vision into experiences operating at significant scale.
You will report to Empower's Head of Digital and build an ambitious product team to bring our vision and strategy to life.
What you will do
Define Empower’s conversational AI strategy and product vision, identifying where AI can fundamentally improve how customers receive guidance, collaborate with Empower, and resolve service needs.
Create a seamless digital-to-human experience, enabling customers to move naturally between AI-powered experiences, digital servicing, and their human advisor without losing context or continuity.
Reimagine digital servicing from first principles, using AI, automation, and exceptional product design to improve customer outcomes while materially increasing digital containment and operational efficiency.
Turn strategy into a focused roadmap, balancing immediate opportunities such as live chat, methods to address top customer questions, and servicing journeys with the longer-term capabilities required to transform the customer experience.

jobs.title: Sr Director, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Your Future Evolves Here
Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.
Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.
Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Sr. Director, AI Platform Engineering
Job Summary
The Sr. Director of AI Platform Engineering leads the engineering teams supporting Evolent's enterprise AI platform initiatives, with a focus on three capability areas: the document pipeline, event-driven architecture, and agentic user interfaces. The role is accountable for engineering execution in these areas — staffing the teams, delivering the software, and operating it in production — working within the platform direction set with Enterprise Architecture and Product.
This is a build-the-team-while-you-build-the-platform role. The leader will stand up and grow multiple engineering teams from an early-stage footprint and deliver capability on a roadmap where later work depends on the foundations landing first. Success requires equal strength in enterprise-scale delivery judgment and in hiring, organizing and developing engineering talent under delivery pressure.
Architectural direction and platform design standards are set in partnership with Enterprise Architecture. This role is a primary contributor to and implementer of them rather than their sole owner. The Sr. Director partners closely with Architecture, Product, Data Engineering, Security and the core system engineering teams, and represents the platform engineering organization in executive forums. As a leader in the engineering organization, the Sr. Director fosters a culture of quality, customer obsession, product mindset, and technical excellence.
What You Will Be Doing
Support New Enterprise-Scale Platform Initiatives
Lead the engineering teams delivering the document pipeline, event-driven architecture and agentic user interface capabilities, from build through production support.
Support roadmap sequencing with architecture and product partners, so foundational capabilities land ahead of the work that depend on them and hold that sequence when delivery pressure argues for shortcuts.
Implement the platform contracts and standards agreed with Enterprise Architecture and contribute to the engineering perspective that shapes them before dependent teams build against them.
Drive capabilities from first production consumer to broader enterprise adoption, proving each one at production volume rather than declaring it complete at first release.
Partner with the infrastructure and security organizations on the underlying cloud, messaging and hosting foundations the platform depends on.
Build and Grow the Teams
Stand up and scale the engineering teams behind each capability area, including the team topology, role mix and skill profile each one requires as it moves from early build into production operations.
Recruit, hire and onboard engineers and engineering managers at pace, and set the hiring bar for full-stack, platform, integration and UX engineering roles on the platform.
Mentor and develop engineering and technical staff, foster leadership and technical growth, and build a bench as the organization grows.
Build and maintain a strong engineering culture focused on innovation, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement, with domain expertise and quality treated as first-class outcomes.
Contribute to Technical Direction and Standards
Work with executive leadership, enterprise architecture, product management, and other stakeholders to shape the platform's roadmap and long-term strategy and translate it into executable engineering plans.
Apply and reinforce enterprise standards for software development, architecture, and quality assurance.
Oversee development and delivery of scalable, high-quality software consistent with the approved architecture, with observability, cost telemetry and operational readiness built in from the start.
Support the core system engineering teams in defining integration seams, migration paths and fallback handling so existing systems adopt platform capabilities incrementally.
Act as a trusted partner to the business by understanding its needs deeply, influencing through technical expertise, and representing the engineering organization in discussions on progress, risks and opportunities.
AI-Enabled Delivery
Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools, and lead teams that use them, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting and analysis activities.
Ensure AI-generated outputs are evaluated and validated for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before they reach production.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
Contribute reusable prompts, workflow templates, engineering playbooks and AI-assisted development patterns that benefit the broader engineering organization.
Deliver systems that leverage AI services, APIs, agents and automation capabilities where appropriate, partnering with architecture, security and platform teams on how those capabilities are integrated into enterprise applications.
Governance and Compliance
Follow and enforce enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling and Responsible AI practices across the teams.
Ensure no confidential, regulated or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
Establish peer review and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions and ensure audit visibility and traceability are built into the capabilities the teams deliver.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent experience.
12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 7+ years in leadership roles managing large, distributed teams.
Proven track record of delivering complex, enterprise-scale software projects on time and within budget, including at least one initiative launched from inception rather than inherited in flight.
Demonstrated experience building engineering teams as part of a new initiative: defining the organization, hiring at pace, and delivering while the team is still forming.
High technical acumen, with the ability to influence technical strategy beyond immediate team scope.
Strong technical expertise in software architecture, API development and system integration, and deep understanding of cloud services and DevOps practices.
Experience using AI-assisted development platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar tools, and familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted testing and AI-enabled software delivery practices.
Experience establishing effective engineering operating models and implementing agile methodologies across teams to drive predictable delivery.
Exceptional leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to lead through change, build a product mindset, and foster a culture of innovation and accountability.
Strong business acumen, with the ability to align technical strategies with organizational goals and priorities.
Outstanding communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization and articulate complex technical concepts clearly.
Preferred Qualifications
Healthcare domain knowledge, particularly medical claims, prior authorization and clinical documentation workflows.
FHIR experience — especially prior-authorization workflows (PAS implementation guide, X12 278 crosswalk) or other healthcare interoperability (HL7v2, CDA).
Knowledge of Domain Driven Design and of identity, access control and observability patterns for AI systems.
Experience integrating AI services, models or agents into production applications, including human-in-the-loop review and approval workflows.
Azure cloud experience (Azure AI services, Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, containerized deployment).
Experience delivering solutions built on event-driven architectures and enterprise messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus.
Experience delivering document processing or content pipelines at production scale.
Experience delivering production user interfaces for operational workflows, including review, approval and role-based access.
· Healthcare, payer, or other regulated-domain engineering experience
To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.
Technical Requirements:
We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router.
Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact for further assistance.
The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $175,000 - 185,000. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Award Management
jobs.text:
The exciting world of scientific research is fueled by people with a passion for solving complex problems. At Cayuse, we are committed to our customers’ success by empowering organizations to conduct globally connected research that advances their impact on science, discovery and society. We build on that commitment with proven, integrated and easy-to-use technology that delivers exceptional value, and world class service and support that accelerates outcomes.
But we are more than just an empowering platform powered by advanced technologies. We are a collaboration of exceptional, highly skilled people with multi-disciplinary expertise, and are building our team to support our ambitious growth plans. Cayuse’s foundational strength comes from our customer and employee focused values and commitment to industry-leading solutions. It’s an exciting time to become a key member of our growing team.
At Cayuse, we power the research lifecycle. Our cloud based platform supports universities, hospitals, government agencies, and research institutions in their pursuit of scientific advancement. With over two decades of domain expertise, we’re on a mission to accelerate research, ensure compliance, and reduce administrative burden, so our customers can focus on making discoveries that improve lives.
Joining Cayuse means becoming part of a company that is transforming how research is managed globally. This is a unique opportunity to lead the products that manage billions of dollars in research funding, from proposal through award, agreement, and closeout.
Reporting into our SVP of Product Management, we’re looking for an experienced product leader to own and grow our Award Management suite, the portfolio that helps research institutions plan, fund, and manage sponsored projects. This is a player-coach role. You’ll build and lead a team of product managers, set the multi-year strategy across a multi-platform portfolio, and represent Award Management to the executive team and the market. You’ll work cross functionally across engineering, sales, marketing, customer success, and support, serving as the connective tissue between internal teams and the institutions we serve.
Success in this role means a coherent, well sequenced product strategy for Award Management, a product management team that is growing and delivering, and a roadmap that balances customer needs, platform investments, and business objectives.
Responsibilities
Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for the Award Management suite, aligned to company strategy and growth goals.
Build, lead, and develop a team of product managers, setting goals, coaching performance, and growing talent within the function.
Define and execute a multi-platform strategy across the Award Management portfolio, sequencing investment across products that serve different stages of the sponsored project lifecycle.
Partner with engineering leadership to plan platform migrations, consolidations, and modernization work, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform health.
Represent the Award Management strategy and roadmap to the executive team and other stakeholders, and contribute to company-level product and portfolio planning.
Partner with sales, marketing, and customer success on packaging, pricing, and go-to-market readiness for the portfolio.
Lead customer and market discovery across research institutions to validate strategic bets and surface unmet needs.
Champion Agile practices across the product management team and holds the group accountable to consistent, high-quality execution.
Serve as the voice of the customer within Cayuse, ensuring product decisions reflect the needs of research administrators and institutional leaders.
Qualifications
8+ years of B2B product management experience, including experience leading and managing a team of product managers.
Proven experience defining and executing product strategy across a multi-platform or multi-product portfolio at a B2B SaaS company.
Skilled at working within Agile environments across distributed teams.
Experience with platform migrations, product consolidations, or modernization efforts, and an understanding of the customer, commercial, and technical dynamics involved.
Strong track record of setting roadmap priorities based on customer needs, business impact, and technical feasibility.

We build on that commitment with proven, integrated and easy-to-use technology that delivers exceptional value, and world class service and support that accelerates outcomes.

But we are more than just an empowering platform powered by advanced technologies. We are a collaboration of exceptional, highly skilled people with multi-disciplinary expertise, and are building our team to support our ambitious growth plans. Cayuse’s foundational strength comes from our customer and employee focused values and commitment to industry-leading solutions. It’s an exciting time to become a key member of our growing team.

At Cayuse, we power the research lifecycle. Our cloud based platform supports universities, hospitals, government agencies, and research institutions in their pursuit of scientific advancement. With over two decades of domain expertise, we’re on a mission to accelerate research, ensure compliance, and reduce administrative burden, so our customers can focus on making discoveries that improve lives.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (Interim)
jobs.text:
PSG Global Solutions is Hiring!
PSG is the world’s largest and fastest growing provider of outsourced recruiting support to the global staffing and recruiting industry, with over 20% of the top 100 staffing companies utilizing our service today. Our recruiting centers are based in the Philippines, the preferred offshore location for supporting the US and global English speaking countries.
PSG combines the cost advantages of an offshore delivery model with the high-performance approach of a top-tier staffing company to deliver value to its clients. As with any high-performance business, having a strong and highly motivated team is critical to our success. PSG invests heavily in our people, as evidenced by our employee satisfaction score consistently exceeding 90% (we measure it every month).
Privacy Notice
We, at PSG Global Solutions, LLC (a Teleperformance company), are committed to respecting your privacy and the protection of your personal data. PSG Global Solutions, LLC (a Teleperformance company) needs to use your personal data to ensure that we can meet all the requirements in relation to your application to us. We also need to ensure we comply with laws and regulations, can respond to requests from supervisory authorities, handle legal claims, detect, and prevent fraud, and carry out our business activities. Our Privacy Notice is provided to inform you of how PSG Global Solutions, LLC (a Teleperformance company) processes your personal data, and we regularly review it to ensure that it is up to date.
Before proceeding with your application, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice to understand how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data in connection with the recruitment process.
By clicking “Apply”, you acknowledge that you have been provided access to and have had the opportunity to review our Candidate Privacy Notice.
Click here to read the PSG Global Solutions US Candidate Privacy Notice.
Job Description
Position Summary
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) defines and executes PSG Global Solutions’ enterprise technology, artificial intelligence, and innovation strategy. The role leads PSG’s transition to an AI-first operating model—turning emerging technologies into secure, scalable products and operational capabilities that improve recruiting outcomes, increase productivity, and generate measurable value for clients.
As a member of the executive leadership team, the CTO connects corporate strategy, product innovation, enterprise technology, data, cybersecurity, and operational transformation. The position partners with leaders across operations, client services, sales, finance, human resources, compliance, and global delivery to strengthen PSG’s competitive position as a technology-enabled recruitment and workforce-solutions provider.
Key Responsibilities
Vision to Execution
Lead the delivery and continued evolution of PSG’s AI-first operating model.
Translate enterprise strategy into executable technology, product, data, and automation roadmaps.
Lead the development and launch of Anna AI, PSG’s production-grade generative voice AI platform.
Embed AI capabilities throughout PSG’s recruiting and service-delivery operations.
Ensure technology investments produce measurable improvements in client outcomes, operational productivity, revenue, and profitability.
AI Strategy and Product Innovation
Lead PSG’s AI-first operating model and multiyear technology roadmap.
Direct the development and evolution of Anna AI, PSG’s production-grade generative voice AI platform.
Transform AI pilots into scalable products that automate candidate engagement, screening, interviewing, scheduling, onboarding, and compliance workflows.
Establish responsible-AI standards covering accuracy, bias, transparency, privacy, security, and human oversight.
Measure technology investments through productivity, client outcomes, revenue contribution, and return on investment.
Architecture and Integration
Lead PSG’s Rapid Build and Integration framework for orchestrating agentic AI workflows.
Enable integrations with applicant-tracking systems, HR platforms, client systems, and best-in-class specialist applications.
Define enterprise architecture, data exchange, testing, deployment, reliability, and documentation standards.
Evaluate build, buy, and partnership opportunities based on strategic value, scalability, speed, cost, and risk.
Data and Evidence-Based Leadership
Establish an enterprise data and analytics strategy supporting AI, operational decisions, client reporting, and workforce intelligence.
Partner with leading research institutions, including the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, to scientifically evaluate AI’s impact on hiring efficiency.
Use controlled experiments and operational data to validate new solutions before large-scale deployment.
Translate research findings into product improvements, client insights, and market thought leadership.
Enterprise Technology and Risk
Oversee PSG’s enterprise platforms, cloud environment, corporate applications, technology services, and client integrations.
Lead cybersecurity, data privacy, technology risk, incident response, business continuity, and regulatory compliance.
Ensure technology platforms remain secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective.
Manage technology budgets, strategic vendors, licensing, and investment priorities.
Executive and Organizational Leadership
Advise the CEO, executive team, and board on technology opportunities, investments, and risks.
Partner with operations, sales, and client leaders to develop differentiated technology-enabled services.
Build and lead global teams across AI, product, data, architecture, cybersecurity, integration, and technology operations.
Promote a culture of experimentation, responsible innovation, disciplined execution, and measurable results.
Measures of Success
Adoption and business impact of Anna AI and related products
Recruiter productivity and operational-capacity improvements
Revenue, margin, and client-retention contribution from technology
Successful conversion of AI pilots into scaled products
Improvements in time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and service quality
Platform reliability, integration performance, and user satisfaction
Security, privacy, compliance, and audit results
Return on technology and innovation investments
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in technology, engineering, business, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
Significant executive leadership experience in technology, AI, digital transformation, product innovation, or enterprise architecture.
Demonstrated success taking AI and automation solutions from pilot through enterprise-scale adoption.
Experience with generative AI, voice AI, agentic automation, cloud platforms, integrations, data architecture, and cybersecurity.
Experience in recruitment, staffing, RPO, BPO, healthcare services, or another technology-enabled service industry is preferred.
Proven ability to lead global teams, manage significant investments, and communicate effectively with clients, executives, and boards.
Equal Opportunity Employment
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race. color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic information or any other consideration prohibited by law or contract.
Compliance with Disability Laws
It is the policy of PSG Global Solutions that qualified individuals with disabilities not be discriminated against because of their disabilities in regard to job application procedures, hiring, and other terms and conditions of employment. It is also our policy to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of the employment process. We are prepared to modify or adjust the job application process or the job or work environment to make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of the applicant or employee to enable the applicant or employee to be considered for the position he or she desires, to perform the essential functions of the position in question, or to enjoy equal benefits and privileges of employment as are enjoyed by other similarly situated employees without disabilities, unless the accommodation will impose an undue hardship.
VEVRAA
Federal Contractor requesting appropriate employment service delivery systems, such as state workforce agencies and local employment delivery systems, to provide priority referrals of protected veterans.
Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision
The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-I.35(c)

jobs.title: Associate Director - Technology Practice
jobs.text:
About Modern Executive Solutions
Modern Executive Solutions is a fully integrated talent management consultancy with a specific focus on developing diverse, modern leadership teams. We provide services that include talent and organization strategy, culture and change management, leadership assessment and development and executive search. Everything we do is forward-looking and focused on creating modern organizations, leadership team and leaders. We are headquartered out of Atlanta, Georgia but work on a remote-first basis with employees across the United States and a team also in the United Kingdom. As a part of our embedded purpose to change lives for the better we donate 10% of our annual profits to charities that support youth and education in order to develop the diverse talent of tomorrow.
The Role
The Associate Director leads core components of retained executive searches within our Technology Practice.
This is a research-led role including candidate first-round interviews. You are responsible for defining the target market, executing rigorous market mapping, building accurate and high-quality pipelines, and engaging candidates directly through structured first-stage interviews. You contribute to candidate assessment discussions and slate development.
Associate Directors typically manage ~5 concurrent retained searches.
Team Structure
Searches are typically staffed with a three-person team. Most often, this includes a Senior Partner, a Managing Director (or Senior Director), and an Associate Director. In some cases, the team may consist of a Partner, a Senior Director, and an Associate Director.
As the Associate Director, you lead research and market mapping and conduct first-round candidate interviews and early-stage candidate development. You work directly with senior leadership on search strategy, target identification, and candidate evaluation.
Because teams are small and accountability is clear, scope and responsibility are visible. Progression from Associate Director to Director is based on demonstrated capability and readiness rather than tenure, and can occur more quickly than in larger, more layered search firms where advancement is often tied to structure or time in seat.
Scope of Responsibility
Lead research strategy, including systematic market mapping and target company identification
Build and maintain high-quality candidate pipelines
Achieve 80%+ mapping accuracy through disciplined and creative sourcing methods
Conduct first-round candidate interviews
Contribute to structured candidate assessment and slate construction
Produce client-ready candidate summaries and search materials
Maintain disciplined search workflow and data integrity
Your work directly impacts market coverage, pipeline strength, and candidate quality.
Experience / At-Level Expectations
Demonstrated ability to manage ~5 concurrent retained searches with consistent quality and pace (approximately 12+ searches annually)
Proven strength in research strategy and systematic market mapping
Track record of building accurate target company lists and candidate pipelines, achieving 80%+ mapping accuracy
Experience conducting first-round candidate interviews and contributing to structured candidate assessment
Ability to independently draft client-ready materials with minimal edits
Strong discipline in maintaining accurate search workflow within an ATS
Experience supporting VP, SVP, or C-suite searches
Technology search experience is helpful but not required. We are open to outstanding researchers from retained executive search firms with a strong interest in building depth within technology leadership markets.
We will also selectively consider executive search researchers or executive recruiters from in-house executive recruiting teams supporting VP, SVP, or C-suite hiring within technology companies or large, complex enterprises (e.g., Fortune 500 organizations). This may include executive-level technical recruiters who have experience engaging senior technology leaders.
Candidates should demonstrate rigor in market mapping, structured candidate assessment, and executive-level engagement.
Why Modern?
• Purpose-Driven Work: Join a team that is committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) and gives back to the community by donating 10% of annual profits to support underserved youth and educational opportunities.
• Impactful Projects: Contribute to meaningful projects that positively impact clients’ organizations, communities, and the development of diverse leaders.
• Professional Growth: Gain exposure to various aspects of the business, with opportunities for mentorship, leadership development, and career advancement.
• Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with a 401(k) match.
• Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from a flexible remote work environment, paid parental leave, and an office setup stipend to support your work-from-home needs.
Our Values
• Be Bold: Think strategically, seeing implications and creative paths. Innovates commercially – seeks to understand client perspective to drive impact. Innovates internally - seeks to improve processes, procedures, and technology used within and across their teams.
• Be Excellent: Deliver client ready work, with attention to detail, raising the bar of expectations within team and with data integrity to include the use of all company tools and systems. Motivated by excellence to the benefit of clients and our firm.
• Be United: Be an inclusive ‘team player,’ willing to support, develop and ‘go the extra mile’ to deliver impact with others. Proactively develops trusting relationships both within and outside our firm.
• Be Authentic: Demonstrate awareness, coachability and a desire to grow with continuous improvement. Motivated by a personal purpose aligned with our firm’s mission and values. Is accountable for delivery of client ready work.
The pay range for this role is: 90,000 - 100,000 USD per year with a 10% annual target bonus (Remote)
Modern Executive Solutions is dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, veteran or military status or care-giver status. Please contact us at if you need assistance completing this application.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM
The Engineering team at GenLogs builds and sustains the end-to-end systems that power the country’s most advanced commercial-vehicle sensing and intelligence network. Our engineers develop everything from roadside hardware and embedded software to computer vision pipelines, distributed cloud infrastructure, and real-time data services. We are responsible for the reliability, accuracy, and security of the Trident network and the data products it fuels.
Operating across edge, cloud, and field environments, the team partners closely with Deployment, Data Science, and Product to turn complex, real-world requirements into scalable systems that function under demanding conditions and national-level workloads. We value technical rigor, speed of execution, and a commitment to building durable infrastructure that delivers measurable, mission-critical impact.
ABOUT THE JOB
As a Director of Software Engineering for GenLogs, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for building, deploying, and scaling our core applications that tens of thousands of users rely on daily to fulfill critical supply chain operations.
This is a cross-disciplinary people leadership role spanning cloud/software platforms and solid understanding of machine learning and developing analytical based products. You will lead and develop a team of engineers while setting technical direction, establishing strong engineering practices, and ensuring the organization can deliver reliable products at scale.
You will work closely with Product, Deployment, Data Science, and company leadership to translate product strategy and real-world operational requirements into an effective engineering roadmap. You’ll be responsible for creating the structure, processes, and technical foundation needed to move quickly without sacrificing reliability, quality, or long-term scalability.
This role is ideal for an engineering leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of people, technology, and physical-world systems—and who is energized by solving complex problems where hardware and software must work together reliably in the field.
WHAT YOU’LL DO Lead & Develop the Engineering Organization
Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team spanning software engineering, product development, machine learning applications, and agentic development.
Build a high-performing engineering culture centered on ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Establish clear expectations, goals, career development paths, and performance standards for engineers and engineering leaders.
Recruit and retain exceptional engineering talent as the organization scales.
Develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, creating leverage through effective delegation and leadership.
Foster strong collaboration across engineering disciplines and ensure teams operate with shared goals and accountability.
Set Technical Direction
Define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture for the user facing applications and services
Guide architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs across the full product lifecycle.
Ensure engineering investments balance near-term product delivery with long-term reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
Establish engineering standards and practices that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality.
Identify technical risks and dependencies early and drive them to resolution.
Partner with senior engineers to evaluate new technologies, tools, and approaches that can improve the product and engineering organization.
Drive Product Delivery
Partner closely with Product and Deployment to translate business and customer requirements into executable engineering plans.
Own engineering execution against product and technology roadmaps, ensuring teams are aligned on priorities and delivery expectations.
Create effective planning and development processes that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Remove organizational and technical blockers and ensure teams maintain a strong bias toward action.
Ensure hardware and software development are coordinated effectively across design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish mechanisms for learning from field deployments and incorporating operational feedback into product and engineering decisions.
Build Reliable, Scalable Systems
Drive improvements in system availability, performance, observability, security, and operational resilience.
Establish rigorous testing and validation practices across hardware, embedded software, and cloud systems.
Partner with Deployment and Operations to improve installation, monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of deployed systems.
Develop processes for diagnosing and resolving complex production and field issues with urgency and ownership.
Ensure engineering teams build systems that can scale from current deployments to a national-level sensing network.
Collaborate Across the Company
Serve as the senior engineering partner to Product leadership for user facing product lines
Work closely with Deployment to ensure engineering solutions are practical, supportable, and optimized for real-world deployment.
Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering teams to ensure sensor systems produce accurate, reliable, and usable data.
Communicate technical strategy, roadmap, tradeoffs, and risks clearly to company leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Build strong relationships across the organization and create alignment around technical and business priorities.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
10+ years of engineering experience, with significant experience leading engineering teams and organizations.
5+ years of people management experience, including experience managing senior engineers and/or engineering managers.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams across two or more of the following: hardware, embedded systems, edge computing, backend software, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.
Experience building and operating products that combine physical hardware with software systems.
Proven experience scaling engineering teams, processes, and technical infrastructure as a company or product grows.
Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and production systems.
Experience establishing engineering standards, development processes, testing practices, and operational excellence.
Demonstrated ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Strong track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering talent.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
High effectiveness and communication working in a remote and distributed team.
English proficiency is required
IDEAL CANDIDATE
You are a builder and a leader. You enjoy developing people and organizations while remaining technically engaged enough to understand complex systems and make sound technical decisions.
You think across the entire system. You can connect hardware, embedded software, edge systems, cloud infrastructure, and data into a cohesive product architecture.
You prioritize impact. You understand that engineering exists to solve meaningful customer and business problems, and you focus teams on delivering measurable outcomes.
You operate with urgency and ownership. You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, removing obstacles, and driving issues to resolution.
You raise the bar. You establish clear standards for engineering quality, reliability, execution, and accountability—and consistently hold yourself and your team to them.
You develop people. You invest in coaching, feedback, career development, and creating opportunities for engineers to take on greater responsibility.
You balance speed with durability. You know when to move quickly, when to invest in foundational work, and how to make pragmatic technical tradeoffs without accumulating unnecessary complexity.
You thrive in complexity. You are energized by systems that operate in the real world and understand that building reliable technology often requires solving problems across organizational and technical boundaries.
You communicate clearly. You can translate complex technical concepts into clear decisions, priorities, and tradeoffs for engineers, product leaders, executives, and cross-functional partners.
You value transparency and collaboration. You actively seek input, give direct feedback, and build trust through clear communication and accountability.
You are curious and adaptable. You continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and look for better ways to build both technology and teams.
You are comfortable in a remote environment. You create clarity, alignment, and accountability across distributed teams without relying on proximity.
WHY GENLOGS
At GenLogs, you have the opportunity to build technology that operates at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. Our Integrated Sensor platform is foundational to our vision of creating ubiquitous visibility into the movement of commercial vehicles across the United States.
You will have a direct impact on the technology, people, and systems required to scale that network—and the opportunity to build an engineering organization capable of supporting one of the most ambitious sensing and intelligence platforms in freight.

jobs.title: VP, Product Design
jobs.text:
About Us
Powered by one of the largest global newsrooms in sports media, The Athletic brings sports fans the most comprehensive stories about the teams, sports and athletes they love. The Athletic’s newsroom of 500+ full-time staff delivers in-depth coverage of hundreds of professional and college teams across more than 47 North American markets and all 20 football clubs in the English Premier League, as well as many Championship clubs.
About the Role
The Athletic is redefining what a sports app is. We need a design leader who is hands-on, opinionated, and genuinely obsessed with sports, with a clear vision for what the "essential sports app" becomes over the next several years.
This role is reporting into our Chief Product Officer.
This role is 100% remote for candidates based in the United States or Canada.
Responsibilities
Product vision and prototyping the future. We want working prototypes and opinionated concepts that demonstrate what the next-generation sports app looks like, and where the biggest opportunity is for us to lead. You own the process and the design output behind ongoing strategic visioning with cross-functional leadership, driving toward decisions the exec team rallies behind.
A strategic voice in product direction, with real weight in the business. You bring informed, data-backed points of view to planning, and help design shape where the product goes. You partner directly with the VP Eng, the VP Data, and the CPO on the business priorities and metrics that matter, and you make sure design has a seat at the table.
Day-to-day craft leadership. You stay in the work: reviewing flows, jumping into Figma, and prototyping directly alongside your team.
AI-native transformation of the design practice. You set the direction for how design works in an AI-native world, covering tools, workflows, and team structure, so that velocity and craft rise together.
Org leadership and performance. You build, coach, and manage a design org (~10) that can operate at this level, with clear accountability for what each team and person delivers.
Collaboration. You are part of the leadership team of The Athletic. As such, your role goes beyond “design” and you work hand in hand with the other leads (engineering, product, data, marketing, commercial etc.).
Requirements
Someone who is a sports fan first, who uses the product, has opinions about it, and lets that passion show up in the work.
A design leader with a track record of hands-on craft at senior levels. We want to see recent, personal work.
Experience leading a design org through a step-change in how it works, ideally involving AI tooling and workflow, at a company shipping consumer product at scale.
Strong, well-argued opinions about what makes a sports product, or a comparable habit-forming consumer product, great, along with the conviction to defend them in a room of product and engineering leaders.
Comfort operating in ambiguity.
Nice to have: experience starting or running your own company or side project.
This is a remote-based role requiring some regular travel.
The annual base salary range for this role is $270,000.00 - $295,000.00 USD. The total compensation offered for this position may vary based on factors such as education, experience, skills, and location. It may also include non-cash rewards and benefits. The base salary range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.
For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.
We are excited to learn more about you and your experience. To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process. If you are a candidate for a technical role, we will let you know what specific tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.
The Athletic Media Company is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. The Athletic will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Strategy
jobs.text:
Position Purpose: Oversee the product development function, including formulating product vision and strategy, defining future product needs and enhancements, and driving the creation of profitable, highly engaging, easy-to-use products across all business units.
Develop and oversee the model for managing product development strategy.
Develop and oversee product roadmap in alignment with company strategic goals, market trends, competitive landscape, client, and consumer needs.
Drive digital and data/analytics product innovation ensuring highly engaging products with high ease of use.
Partner with strategic business unit team leadership (Operations, Pharma sales, Provider Sales and Account Management) and portfolio management to plan and manage complex set of priorities and resources to meet dynamic business, client, and market needs.
Build an effective and efficient product organization, including product management, consumer engagement, strategic partnerships and innovation.
Drive efficiency within the RFP and client implementation processes.
Review market landscape, analyze usage of product offerings, and review business case and key metrics to ensure ROI.
Monitor and measure product competitiveness and support new business opportunities.
Manage, measure and monitor strategic partners.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Complies with all policies and standards.
Education/Experience: Bachelor's degree in related field or equivalent experience required
For Operations: 10+ years of progressive experience in product development, ownership and management, business strategy, technology delivery, operations, or a related field, including 5+ years leading cross-functional product initiatives, managing complex roadmaps, and influencing senior stakeholders in a matrixed environment. required.
Pay Range: $188,900.00 - $359,800.00 per year
At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.
Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.
Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

Build an effective and efficient product organization, including product management, consumer engagement, strategic partnerships and innovation.
Drive efficiency within the RFP and client implementation processes.
Review market landscape, analyze usage of product offerings, and review business case and key metrics to ensure ROI.
Monitor and measure product competitiveness and support new business opportunities.
Manage, measure and monitor strategic partners.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Complies with all policies and standards.

jobs.title: Director, Product Growth
jobs.text:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.
We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.
This position is for an existing vacancy.
Roofr is looking for a Director, Product Growth to own how we grow through the product. You’ll work at the intersection of product, data, and go-to-market: designing the activation and expansion paths that keep contractors engaged, surfacing product signals that unlock sales conversations, and building a stronger self-serve experience anchored in friction-less SMB UI/UX. You’ll report to the CPO, sit on the product leadership team, and lead a cross-functional Growth team that includes Engineering, Design, Data Science, and a Principal PM as your direct report.
Initial building blocks are already in place. We have a clear activation metric that guides both our self-serve and sales-assist motion, a hybrid model that is actively evolving, and an AI product line in AI Receptionist that is ready to scale. The job is to take what’s working, sharpen it, and build on top of it.
What You’ll be measured on
Software adoption across the subscriber base
Orchestration of the hybrid motion
Self-serve revenue growth, shared with the GM of Measurements
What You’ll get to do
Orchestrate the hybrid motion with Sales: Identify the product signals that indicate a contractor is ready for a sales conversation and build the playbooks that turn those signals into pipeline, across both new subscriber acquisition and expansion of the existing base
Drive activation and expansion: Own the in-product experience that gets new contractors to value fast and design the expansion loops that drive deeper adoption and multi-product retention across the customer base
Grow self-serve revenue: Own the self-serve motion across transactional and subscription products, with particular focus on Measure+ and in-product upgrade paths
Lead the team and the metrics: Lead the Growth team, including Engineering, Design, and Data Science, build a fast experimentation culture, and own the growth metrics that matter to leadership
What You’ll bring to the role
8 to 12+ years of product growth experience in B2B SaaS; vertical SaaS is a strong plus
Real experience building a hybrid product-led and sales-led motion. You have felt the friction of making these work together, not just read about it
Strong activation and expansion instincts. You know how to design user journeys that drive measurable improvement in time-to-value and long-term retention
Experience working across both transactional and subscription revenue models
Comfortable running experiments end to end: designing them, setting success criteria, and shipping without waiting for perfect conditions
Fluent in growth metrics like activation rate, adoption, expansion revenue, and NRR. You run your own analysis
Experience with tools like Amplitude, HubSpot, and Snowflake or a comparable data warehouse
Experience building or scaling an AI-powered product is a meaningful differentiator
Able to lead and develop cross-functional teams in an environment where everyone doesn’t work for you. You work alongside your team, not just above it
Clear communicator at every level, from executive to analyst
Based in the US or Canada
Compensation Band: $250,000.00 - $300,000.00 USD
Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.
🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)
When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:
🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:
1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
Flexible time off
80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
RRSP/401k match
Generous Parental Leave policy
🤝 Perks:
We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
Home office setup stipend
Internet and phone allowance
Remote first culture
Weekly Friday paydays!
🤖 AI Notice
At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.
Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.
And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️
⚠️ Important Notice
We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.
To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: .
If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at .
Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!
Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.
