jobs.title: Head of Product - Personal Banking
jobs.text:
In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem.
Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. Mercury is building personal banking* to that standard.
Personal Banking is how Mercury earns a place in someone's financial life. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving growth and engagement, and owning business performance.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.
Key responsibilities:
Build a personal banking experience so good that people tell their friends and colleagues about it
Own the metrics, product strategy and the propositions we take to our customers, covering personal money management, banking, savings, investments, money movement, and in the future, lending
Set the craft bar: sweat the details — copy, latency, empty states — that decide whether a consumer product feels inevitable rather than adequate
Drive the use of AI in products where it makes the experience meaningfully better
Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set a cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
Grow the business: own acquisition, activation, retention, and the loops that compound, including how personal banking connects to the businesses Mercury already serves
Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
Align the ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy
Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:
A consumer product leader with taste: you have built products millions of people chose to use, and can point to the decisions that made them work
You have shipped AI-led products to real consumers and have opinions about what AI makes possible and where it fails
An exceptionally high bar for craft, and a customer-centered, data-driven, and experimentation-oriented approach
10+ years building consumer products, including time owning a product's growth and economics, not only its roadmap
5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
Experience launching and scaling 0-1 products, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it
Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, and partners
Nice to have: banking, payments, or fintech experience. We can teach you the rails; we cannot teach product judgment
Sound judgment in a regulated environment: you balance a delightful experience with the controls a banking product requires, and know which corners are never worth cutting
Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
Total Rewards
The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.
Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

10+ years building consumer products, including time owning a product's growth and economics, not only its roadmap
5+ years leading product managers: hiring, coaching, org design, and performance management
Experience launching and scaling 0-1 products, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it
Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, and partners
Nice to have: banking, payments, or fintech experience. We can teach you the rails; we cannot teach product judgment
Sound judgment in a regulated environment: you balance a delightful experience with the controls a banking product requires, and know which corners are never worth cutting

jobs.title: Head of Information Technology
jobs.text:
The Opportunity
We're looking for a Head of Information Technology who can shape the technology strategy of a rapidly growing defence engineering business - leading our IT team while driving secure, resilient and scalable technology across our UK and international operations.
This is an opportunity for an experienced IT leader who enjoys being close to the business, making things happen and balancing strategic thinking with practical delivery. You’ll have the scope to shape how we use technology, data, automation and AI as we continue to grow, while ensuring our infrastructure and security are ready for what comes next.
Who We Are
OpenWorks is a rapidly growing business operating globally with a passion for exceptional engineering and building on a legacy of defence innovation in the North East of England.
Our products provide ultra-high performance, real-time detection, tracking, identification and targeting of dynamic aerial threats. They have been deployed internationally to protect high profile military and civilian assets, and contribute towards the defeat of nuisance, misguided and maliciously deployed drones during operations.
We are very proud to have supported a wide range of law enforcement and military operators, protecting many of the most high profile sites and individuals around the world.
The amazing things we do are only possible because of a dedicated and passionate team.
Security Vetting Information
OpenWorks Engineering operates within the defence sector. As part of our recruitment and onboarding processes, we collect information that may be required to support future security vetting and clearance requirements, should these become necessary during employment.
Why You’ll Love Working With Us
Join a high-energy, collaborative team where great ideas thrive, challenges are embraced, and people genuinely love what they do.
Here’s what our benefits have to offer:
Rewarding Success - Competitive salary, starting from £80,000, plus a discretionary annual bonus of up to 25% of salary alongside a structured pay progression framework.
Enhanced Pension - Up to 8% employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.
More Time to Recharge - 25 days’ holiday plus public holidays, long-service rewards, and the option to buy up to 5 extra days.
Breakfast & Lunch on Us - Enjoy team breakfasts and freshly prepared lunches every day courtesy of Chef Mark and his team.
Health & Wellbeing - Private healthcare and life assurance for added peace of mind.
Sustainable Travel - Salary sacrifice schemes, including EV car and Cycle to Work options.
Team Socials - Regular events, from quiz nights and football to board games and more.
Learning & Growth - A culture that empowers you to challenge, grow and make an impact, plus a £250 annual learning budget to invest in the development that matters most to you.
What you’ll be doing:
Team Leadership
Lead and develop the IT team: Build a high-performing team with clear priorities, accountability and ownership.
Manage delivery: Balance day-to-day IT support with proactive improvement and longer-term technology development.
Lead technology change: Oversee key IT projects and external technology partners, ensuring effective delivery.
IT Strategy
Shape our technology strategy: Work with the CIO and leadership team to ensure IT supports OWE’s growth and future direction.
Understand business needs: Partner with departments across the business to identify technology priorities and deliver practical solutions.
IT Infrastructure
Build for growth: Ensure our infrastructure, networks, systems and workplace technology are secure, reliable and scalable.
Improve how we work: Drive improvements across systems integration, data, automation, collaboration and user experience.
Support international growth: Oversee UK and US technology requirements, connectivity and country-specific considerations.
Information Security
Strengthen our security: Provide leadership and direction to the Security & Compliance function, ensuring security, resilience and compliance are embedded across IT and the wider business.
Manage technology risk: Ensure security priorities align with our business objectives, risk appetite and future growth.
Systems & AI
Drive smarter technology: Oversee the selection, integration and development of business systems, ensuring they deliver genuine business value.
Lead AI adoption: Identify practical opportunities to use AI, automation and data to improve efficiency and decision-making, with appropriate security and governance.
Budgeting & Resource Management
Plan for the future: Manage IT budgets, resource planning and investment proposals, providing clear reporting and recommendations to the CIO and Board.
What we’re looking for:
Experienced IT leader: Significant experience leading an IT function and developing high-performing teams.
People focused: Able to build strong relationships, set clear direction and create accountability across a team.
Broad technical expertise: Strong experience across IT infrastructure, hardware, software systems and technology platforms.
Security-conscious: Experience working in a regulated or security-focused environment, ideally within defence, aerospace or another complex engineering sector.
Commercially minded: Able to understand business requirements and translate them into practical, scalable technology solutions.
Growth experience: Experience scaling IT operations within a growing technology, engineering or similarly complex organisation.
Future focused: Experience or strong interest in AI, automation, data integration and emerging technologies.
Essential: Able to obtain Security Clearance
What else would be great
Defence experience: Experience working within the defence industry or a similar security-focused environment.
AI implementation: Experience developing or delivering an AI implementation strategy.
Data integration: Demonstrable experience integrating data from separate systems into effective reporting and management tools.
International IT: Experience managing IT across operational sites, including US requirements.
Cyber security: Knowledge of defence cyber-security standards and experience handling classified information.
Security clearance: Current UK Security Clearance
More about us:
Vision
Help protect the territory and airspace of NATO countries and their allies.
Mission
Be a world-leading provider of autonomous technology for Surveillance applications and Defence
Values
Be a Good Egg: Earn respect, have mutual trust and be honest
Do cool stuff: We develop cool tech with an awesome team, and we get stuff done
Be empowered: We are autonomous, reliable and take personal responsibility
We are one team: Look out for each other and the team
Things go wrong: Fail fast, learn and move on
Have fun: We’re doing amazing things with passionate people
We Get It Done: Focus on what matters and work with energy to bring ideas to life

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Science: Small Commercial (SC) Product Design and Modeling
jobs.text:
Description
The creative problem solvers in Liberty Mutual’sUS Retail Markets Data Science Teamharness the power of data, analytics and technology to develop innovative solutions that drive our US Retail Markets business forward and support a high-performing culture. This group brings together highly talented thinkers and doers ready to challenge the status quo and make an impact. As a member of this cross-functional group, you’ll collaborate with teams across Liberty Mutual to deliver analysis that unlocks insights and sparks new, better ways of working.
The Small Commercial (SC) Product Design and Modeling team is hiring a Senior Director I, Data Science to lead the development and delivery of predictive analytics tools and insights, to enable data driven strategic decision making. This executive-level role will overseeSC General Liability and SC Property data science resources. You will provide strategic and tactical direction at the highest levels within own function and department. This level reflects deep knowledge of data science techniques, and advanced application of applying those techniques to business issues.
**Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote with occasional travel.**
Responsibilities:
Responsible for the management, technical oversight and development a team of data scientists, which may include subordinate managers.
Coaches team to understanding of organizational vision and goals.
Collaborates with business partners to develop tools and services such as modeling, dashboard development, and decision aids to drive strategic decision making.
Provides strategic and tactical direction at the highest levels.
Has accountability for the performance and results of one or more large, strategically important business unit in an extremely large market.
Works on issues of diverse scope where analysis of situation or data requires evaluation of a variety of factors, including an understanding of current business trends.
Owns relationship with a defined segment of the business, delivering advanced tools and insights, including ongoing monitoring of metrics and initiatives.
Responsible for highly technical, individualized and difficult to develop tools and their usage which are transformative in nature and have broad strategic impact to the aligned business units(s).
Leads highly technical, complex, and cross functional projects that drive change across function, SBU or Corporate Department.
Directs and may perform highly complex, technical and creative predictive analytics projects and cross functional assignments within designated business unit collaborating with multiple functions.
Shapes the data science community and/or larger audiences and leads cross functional working groups.
Qualifications
Deep knowledge of predictive analytic techniques and statistical diagnostics of models.
Expert knowledge of predictive toolset, to include highly technical tools.
Proven ability to lead and drive projects and assignments to completion through others, to include prior experience effectively managing talent.
Exchanges ideas and conveys complex information clearly and concisely, verbally, visually (presentations and exhibits), and in writing, consistent with the audiences and stakeholders with which s/he interacts up to and including SBU/Corp Dept leadership.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills required to establish and build effective relationships within and outside the aligned functional area and client group.
Ability to give effective training and presentations to all levels of the organization.
Interacts with senior executives.
Demonstrated ability to anticipate areas of senior management concern, integrate different perspectives, and respond accordingly.
Deep knowledge of business drivers and market context.
Deep understanding of insurance operations and the procedures of Financial, Underwriting, Claims, Statistical, Information Technology, Legal and Sales departments.
Utilizes significant business experience and judgment to direct work of unit and communicate results.
Has a value driven perspective with regard to understanding of work context and impact. Competencies typically acquired through an advanced degree (in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science or other relevant field of study) and 8 years of relevant experience or may be acquired through a Bachelor`s degree (scientific field of study) and 10 years of relevant experience.
Insurance or financial services industry experience preferred.
About Us
Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.
At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.
We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit:
Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Our Story
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com!
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
As a Director of Engineering, you’ll lead an established engineering organisation responsible for one of our key business areas, with the autonomy and accountability to make a significant impact on how engineering performs at Zopa. You’ll set direction, build high-performing teams and drive meaningful improvements across people, technology and ways of working. This isn’t a role focused on incremental change: we’re looking for someone who can identify where the biggest opportunities exist, create a clear strategy and turn it into measurable progress. You’ll have the scope to influence significant technical and architectural decisions, improve engineering effectiveness and shape how we build and operate technology.
Your impact will extend beyond the teams you directly lead. Our Directors are expected to raise the level of engineering across Zopa, working closely with Product, Commercial and Technology leaders to turn engineering improvements into better business outcomes. You’ll bring strong people leadership, technical credibility and a genuinely data-led approach to understanding what’s working and where we can improve, while helping us push further in areas such as AI-enabled engineering.
This is an opportunity for an experienced engineering leader to take real ownership, drive substantial change and clearly see the results of the decisions they make.
As a highly collaborative role, you’ll attend our Canary Wharf office 3 days per week

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
About Freedom
Freedom Digital Bank France will form part of Freedom Holding Corp., a diversified international financial services group publicly listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker FRHC. The Group operates across Europe, the United States and Central Asia, with activities spanning banking, brokerage, investment services, insurance, payments and digital consumer services.
About the role
We are looking for an experienced Chief Technology Officer to define and lead the technology strategy of Freedom Digital Bank France.
The CTO will be responsible for technology architecture, infrastructure, engineering, cybersecurity, data governance, IT operations and digital transformation. The role will work closely with the wider Freedom Holding Corp. technology organisation to develop a secure, resilient and scalable digital banking platform.
As a member of the founding executive team, the CTO will contribute to the bank’s regulatory authorisation, establishment and launch in France. The successful candidate will ensure that the technology environment meets applicable French and EU regulatory, cybersecurity, data-protection and operational-resilience requirements.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
jobs.text:
Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Pakistan
Pakistan is home to the third-largest concentration of technology team members at Moniepoint, and it's one of the fastest-growing markets we hire into, with real headroom for growth in seniority and scope. We look for people here who understand first-hand what it means for financial services to be difficult to access, and who want to work on problems at a genuine international scale - changing how banking works across emerging markets.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Pakistan.
About the role
Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.
The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.
We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.
That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.
There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.
As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:
Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.
Who you are
You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What Success Looks Like
The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
The platform ready to support a new market.
A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.
Why Join Us
A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.
What To Expect in The Hiring Process
A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director Engineering, Retail Media& Marketplace
jobs.text:
About your tasks:
Shape Retail Media & Marketplace: Set the engineering direction across both domains, deciding where the platforms should converge to create the most value for brands, sellers and Redcare.
Lead and grow the organisation: Develop your Engineering Managers and their teams, shaping the organisation as the domains evolve while creating an environment with clear ownership and autonomy.
Drive engineering excellence: Own delivery, reliability, architecture and technical debt, continuously raising engineering maturity and enabling teams to move quickly without compromising quality.
Turn technology into commercial impact: Co-own roadmaps with Product and Commercial, connecting engineering priorities to outcomes such as take rate, advertiser ROAS, seller economics and contribution margin.
Own strategic partnerships: Lead engineering relationships with external platforms, integrators and agencies, including build/buy/partner decisions, integrations, SLAs and vendor performance.
About you:
You have 3+ years of experience leading multiple engineering teams through managers or leads and have successfully led organisations through significant change, such as merging domains, introducing new scope or replacing a platform.
You have led development of commercial B2B platforms such as a marketplace, retail media, ad tech, payments or a seller/partner platform, with experience across high-traffic and transactional systems.
You combine strong technical judgement with commercial thinking, connecting engineering decisions to business outcomes and confidently partnering with senior Product and Commercial stakeholders.
You care deeply about engineering excellence, can demonstrate measurable improvements you have driven, and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, external partners and competing priorities. Strong English communication skills are essential.
About your benefits:
In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family, or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:
Sports: Stay healthy. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, so that you can take advantage of a huge variety of sport offers.
Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings.
Vacation: 30 days paid vacation per annum (plus another day on Rosenmontag) and the option to take unpaid vacation of up to 10 days (after one year working with us).
Corporate pension plan: We offer a company pension scheme and have a dedicated external consultant to offer you the best guidance and advice.
About Redcare Pharmacy:
As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.
About the role:
Retail Media and Marketplace are two of Redcare Pharmacy’s fastest-growing and most strategically important domains — and this is your opportunity to shape how they evolve together. Leading an engineering organisation of around 40 engineers across 5–7 teams, you will decide where these two distinct platforms should converge to create a seamless experience for brands and sellers, and where they should remain separate to perform at their best.
This is a high-visibility leadership role where your decisions will directly influence our customer experience and commercial growth. Reporting to our Executive Director of Engineering / VP of Engineering, you will lead through two Engineering Managers and partner closely with Product and Commercial leadership to turn engineering strategy into measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: SVP, Product
jobs.text:
The big picture: Axios is a media company built around clarity, trust, and smart, essential coverage. As AI reshapes how companies operate, Axios has an opportunity to become more AI-native in how we build products, improve workflows, and help teams move faster with better judgment.
Axios is hiring an SVP, Product to lead how Axios builds products across the company, strengthening Product and Design while turning promising AI-enabled ideas into durable, supported products.
Why it matters: Axios builds and ships at multiple levels. Product and Design lead the development of durable, company-wide products and shared platforms. AI Enablement partners with departments to identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools and workflows, and help teams put useful solutions into practice.
The SVP, Product will connect these levels by making decision rights, prioritization, and handoffs clear: what should remain a local workflow, what AI Enablement should support, and what Product and Design should develop into a durable, supported product or shared capability. The role spans the products, platforms, and workflows that power Axios, from the CMS, axios.com, newsletters, and Local products to internal tools and shared platforms supporting editorial, revenue, and company operations, as well as the growing set of AI-enabled solutions being developed closer to the work.
As Axios becomes more capable of building with AI, more teams will identify and prototype solutions for their own needs. Reporting to the CTO, this leader will establish the product operating model that allows Axios to evaluate, prioritize, and scale those ideas without creating fragmented, duplicated, or unsupported systems.
What you’ll do:
Lead Product, Design, and AI Enablement, setting strategy, priorities, decision rights, and operating cadence.
Look ahead: turn a clear point of view on emerging technologies, behaviors, and opportunities into credible product choices and experiments.
Partner with business leaders to translate company and functional goals into clear product opportunities, outcomes, and investment choices.
Raise the product management bar through clear expectations, coaching, and accountability.
Create a clear path from promising experiments to durable, supported products.
Go deeper: This leader must be a trusted partner to the CTO and senior leaders, with a clear point of view on where technology is moving, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the judgment to turn ambiguity into decisions.
Success means a clear company-wide model for deciding what Axios should build and why, stronger and faster Product and Design decisions, and a repeatable path from promising AI experiments to durable, supported products.
What we’re looking for:
A trusted partner to senior leaders who can challenge assumptions, form a clear point of view, make hard tradeoffs, and keep decisions moving.
A clear vision for where product development is headed and how Axios can succeed as the technology landscape rapidly evolves.
Demonstrated AI fluency: you personally use AI to accelerate your work and prototype ideas, and you know how to turn AI capabilities into useful products and workflows.
Senior product leadership experience in software, information services, media, or another fast-moving environment, with a record of bringing Product and Design together.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Alliances
jobs.text:
Identity has become a critical to an organizations security posture. This is true across their entire digital landscape include cloud, traditional on prem and emerging technologies like agentic ai.Britive is at the forefront of a modern approach to delivering identity security with the only modern privileged access management platform that provides unified Privileged Access Visibility, Dynamic Privilege Management and Secrets Governance across infrastructure, platforms & SaaS.
Our patent-pending technology is deployed at companies of all sizes around the world, including Fortune 500 companies. We have repeatedly ranked among the hottest Cloud Security startups. Britive is founded by CyberSecurity industry veterans with a successful prior exit and is backed by top-tier VCs.
About Britive
Britive is the cloud-native Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform built to secure human, machine, and agentic identities across multi-cloud and hybrid environments. Founded on a Zero Standing Privileges (ZSP) model, Britive replaces static, standing entitlements with just-in-time, ephemeral access — closing off the identity attack surface that traditional PAM and IAM tools leave exposed. Recognized as an architect of Third-Gen PAM, Britive is API-first and built to serve as the identity security control plane for modern, cloud-first enterprises.
Role Summary
Britive is hiring a Director, Technology Alliances to build and lead our technology partner ecosystem across the identity and security landscape. This is a revenue-focused role: the mandate is to identify, prioritize, and build partnerships with technology vendors (IAM, IGA, SIEM/SOAR, cloud security, DevOps/CI-CD, ITSM, and adjacent categories) whose customer bases, integrations, and go-to-market motions can generate measurable pipeline and revenue for Britive — not partnerships that are simply interesting from a technology standpoint.
The ideal candidate brings deep, credible knowledge of the identity and security technology landscape and an established network of relationships with alliance, product, and BD leaders at relevant vendors. They will independently evaluate partnership opportunities against commercial criteria, build the business case and integration requirements for the partnerships worth pursuing, and work cross-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, and sales to bring those partnerships to market.
Key Responsibilities
Partnership Strategy & Prioritization
Maintain a prioritized view of the identity and security technology landscape (IAM/IGA, PAM, SIEM/SOAR, CSPM/CNAPP, ITSM, DevOps/CI-CD, cloud service providers) and identify which vendors represent the highest-value alliance opportunities for Britive.
Score and rank prospective partners against clear commercial criteria — overlapping customer base, co-sell motion, deal size influence, and pipeline/revenue potential — rather than technical novelty alone.
Say no to partnerships that lack a credible path to revenue, even when they are technically compelling, and be able to articulate why.
Deal Development & Business Casing
For each prioritized partner, define and document the value proposition: what joint problem is solved, why customers would buy the combined solution, and how the partnership differentiates Britive competitively.
Author the business requirements for how the two platforms should integrate — use cases, API/data touchpoints, deployment model, and shared customer workflows — in partnership with product and engineering.
Define the monetization model for each partnership (co-sell, referral, OEM/embed, marketplace, technology royalty, etc.) and the commercial terms needed to make it work for both parties.
Negotiate and close partnership agreements, working with legal and finance as needed.
Go-To-Market Execution
Translate signed partnerships into active go-to-market programs: joint solution briefs, co-sell playbooks, enablement for sales and SEs, and marketing campaigns.
Partner with sales leadership to build pipeline generation motions with alliance partners and track sourced/influenced revenue.
Represent Britive at partner and industry events, and build/maintain executive relationships with key alliance contacts.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Act as the primary interface between Britive and partner alliance, product, and BD teams.
Brief product and engineering leadership on partner-driven integration requirements and advocate for roadmap investment where it unlocks revenue.
Report regularly to sales and executive leadership on alliance pipeline, partnership health, and revenue impact.
What Success Looks Like
A short list of active, well-documented technology partnerships — each with a clear value proposition, integration requirements, and monetization model — rather than a long list of loosely-defined technical integrations.
Measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue within the first 6–12 months.
Strong working relationships with key alliance and BD leaders across the identity and security ecosystem.
What You’ll Need
Required Qualifications
7+ years in technology alliances, business development, or partnerships, with at least 3 years focused on identity, security, or adjacent enterprise infrastructure categories.
Deep working knowledge of the identity and security technology landscape — IAM, PAM, IGA, SIEM/SOAR, CNAPP/CSPM, and how these categories intersect with cloud infrastructure and DevOps.
An existing, active network of contacts among alliance, product, and BD leaders at relevant technology vendors.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate partnerships commercially — building business cases, prioritizing against revenue potential, and saying no to low-value opportunities.
Experience defining integration requirements and working directly with product/engineering teams to scope joint solutions.
Experience in a solution design / architecture role listening to and translating client requirements into proposed designs including those with integrations to other products.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to executives internally and externally.
Willingness to travel for partner and industry events (estimated 20–30%).
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience at a cybersecurity or identity-focused SaaS company, ideally in a high-growth or startup environment.
Experience building tech alliances from the ground up.
Familiarity with cloud-native and Zero Standing Privileges / just-in-time access concepts.
Existing relationships with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) marketplace and partner teams.
How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit a resume and a brief note describing a technology partnership they built or led — including the commercial rationale, integration scope, and revenue outcome.
The estimated base salary for this role is $140,000 - $180,000 annually. This position is also eligible for variable compensation tied to the performance of technology partnerships. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate, including experience, expertise, location, and other factors.
Perks + Benefits:
Work from anywhere in the US! We are fully remote (US only, other areas are subject to review).
Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Paid parental leave benefits
401k (U.S.)
Flexible + Unlimited PTO (U.S.)
Career development opportunities and paths
Home office and connectivity stipends
Team socials + Offsites

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data & Analytics Lead
jobs.text:
JOB SUMMARY
The Associate Director, Data & Analytics Lead, is a senior regional leadership role responsible for defining and driving the data, analytics, business intelligence, and AI agenda across the APACMEA region, with China as a major strategic focus market.
This role will act as the strategic bridge between business leadership, BTS, regional/global data teams, vendors, and functional stakeholders to turn enterprise data and AI capabilities into measurable business value, scalable products, and trusted insights.
In addition to strong technical depth across data analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, BI, data platforms, governance, and lifecycle management, the role requires a strong people leader and strategic thinker who can shape the APACMEA data and AI roadmap, translate regional priorities into market-relevant execution, lead cross-functional delivery, supervise and develop team members, supports commercial growth, operational excellence, and innovation.
Major Responsibilities
Set APACMEA data and AI strategy: Define and continuously evolve the APACMEA data, analytics, BI, and AI roadmap, ensuring alignment with regional business priorities, and global BTS technology strategy.
Drive AI and GenAI adoption responsibly: Lead the identification, evaluation, prototyping, scaling, and governance of AI/ML and GenAI use cases, ensuring business relevance, measurable ROI, responsible AI practices, and compliance with enterprise standards.
Own BI and analytics transformation: Advance reporting modernization, KPI standardization, self-service analytics, dashboard adoption, and insight generation to enable faster and more trusted business decision-making through close working with related business stakeholders like IMCO, Business Excellence, AMI…etc
Build data foundations compliance with global governance and local regulatory requirement: Strengthen data architecture, master data management, data quality, and lifecycle management to support scalable analytics, AI outcomes in line with company policies and applicable regional and local regulatory requirements, including China-specific considerations such as PIPL, CSL, DSL, cybersecurity, privacy, and data localization.
Lead people and capability development: Supervise, coach, and develop team members; build clear priorities, capability plans, and succession readiness for the APACMEA data function, while strengthening China-focused execution capability.
Champion data-driven culture: Promote data literacy, AI literacy, adoption of modern analytics tools, and AI/data-driven culture in company.
Supervisory Responsibility
Reports to China BTS Lead with dotted-line alignment to the International Data & Analytics lead. The role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy and provide leadership across APACMEA markets, China business, BTS, regional, global, and vendor teams.
Supervises at least one FTE and may lead cross-functional project teams, matrix resources, vendors, and data/AI communities of practice across APACMEA, with strong hands-on focus on China-related priorities. Accountable for team performance, capability development, coaching, prioritization, and delivery quality.
Education and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field; master’s degree or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, BI, digital technology, product management, or AI-related roles, with at least 3 years in leadership, people management, or large-scale matrix leadership.
Proven track record of defining and delivering enterprise data, BI, analytics, AI/ML, or GenAI initiatives that generate measurable business outcomes.
Experience working across APACMEA or other multi-market regional environments preferred, with strong understanding of China market context, local data compliance, business dynamics, stakeholder expectations, and regulatory considerations.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical aesthetics, consumer health, retail, financial services, or other data-intensive regulated industries preferred.
Professional certifications in data governance, cloud, analytics, AI, agile/product management, privacy, or project/program management are advantageous.
Knowledge and Skills
Leadership and strategic thinking: Ability to set vision, shape strategy, influence senior stakeholders, make trade-off decisions, and lead teams through ambiguity and transformation.
Business acumen: Strong understanding of commercial priorities, customer engagement, sales/marketing analytics, operational performance, and how data and AI create measurable business value.
Data and analytics expertise: Deep knowledge of data modeling, data engineering concepts, analytics design, KPI frameworks, self-service BI, visualization, advanced analytics, and data product lifecycle management.
AI and GenAI fluency: Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, GenAI use cases, model evaluation, prompt-enabled solutions, responsible AI, MLOps/AI operations, automation, and human-in-the-loop adoption patterns.
Technology platforms: Familiarity with modern data platforms, cloud data services, BI tools, CRM/commercial data ecosystems, APIs, data integration patterns, and analytics enablement technologies.
Language: Fluent English required for regional and global collaboration; Mandarin Chinese highly preferred given the role’s strong China focus and stakeholder engagement needs.

Build data foundations compliance with global governance and local regulatory requirement: Strengthen data architecture, master data management, data quality, and lifecycle management to support scalable analytics, AI outcomes in line with company policies and applicable regional and local regulatory requirements, including China-specific considerations such as PIPL, CSL, DSL, cybersecurity, privacy, and data localization.

Lead people and capability development: Supervise, coach, and develop team members; build clear priorities, capability plans, and succession readiness for the APACMEA data function, while strengthening China-focused execution capability.
Champion data-driven culture: Promote data literacy, AI literacy, adoption of modern analytics tools, and AI/data-driven culture in company.

blocks.text: Supervisory Responsibility

Reports to China BTS Lead with dotted-line alignment to the International Data & Analytics lead. The role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy and provide leadership across APACMEA markets, China business, BTS, regional, global, and vendor teams.

Supervises at least one FTE and may lead cross-functional project teams, matrix resources, vendors, and data/AI communities of practice across APACMEA, with strong hands-on focus on China-related priorities. Accountable for team performance, capability development, coaching, prioritization, and delivery quality.

items: Education and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field; master’s degree or MBA preferred.

10+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, BI, digital technology, product management, or AI-related roles, with at least 3 years in leadership, people management, or large-scale matrix leadership.
Proven track record of defining and delivering enterprise data, BI, analytics, AI/ML, or GenAI initiatives that generate measurable business outcomes.

Experience working across APACMEA or other multi-market regional environments preferred, with strong understanding of China market context, local data compliance, business dynamics, stakeholder expectations, and regulatory considerations.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical aesthetics, consumer health, retail, financial services, or other data-intensive regulated industries preferred.
Professional certifications in data governance, cloud, analytics, AI, agile/product management, privacy, or project/program management are advantageous.

blocks.text: Knowledge and Skills

items: Leadership and strategic thinking: Ability to set vision, shape strategy, influence senior stakeholders, make trade-off decisions, and lead teams through ambiguity and transformation.
Business acumen: Strong understanding of commercial priorities, customer engagement, sales/marketing analytics, operational performance, and how data and AI create measurable business value.

Data and analytics expertise: Deep knowledge of data modeling, data engineering concepts, analytics design, KPI frameworks, self-service BI, visualization, advanced analytics, and data product lifecycle management.

AI and GenAI fluency: Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts, GenAI use cases, model evaluation, prompt-enabled solutions, responsible AI, MLOps/AI operations, automation, and human-in-the-loop adoption patterns.
Technology platforms: Familiarity with modern data platforms, cloud data services, BI tools, CRM/commercial data ecosystems, APIs, data integration patterns, and analytics enablement technologies.
Language: Fluent English required for regional and global collaboration; Mandarin Chinese highly preferred given the role’s strong China focus and stakeholder engagement needs.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering (w/m/d)
jobs.text:
das wichtigste im überblick
Wir suchen: eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die unsere wachsende Engineering-Organisation mit aktuell zwei Development Teams und jeweils circa 10 Mitarbeitenden weiterentwickelt, erweitert, verlässliche Delivery sicherstellt und technische Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und AI-Kompetenz über mehrere Produkte hinweg systematisch voranbringt.
Wir bieten: 30 Urlaubstage, 100 % Remote und flexible Arbeitszeiten auf Basis eines unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrags
Wir zahlen: bis zu 90.000 Euro Bruttojahresgehalt (Fixgehalt) zzgl. einer leistungsabhängigen Bonuszahlung
das ist dein job
Engineering Delivery: Du verantwortest die Softwareentwicklung über die verschiedenen Produkte und Teams hinweg und sorgst dafür, dass Roadmaps realistisch geplant, Abhängigkeiten früh sichtbar und Commitments verlässlich eingehalten werden. Gemeinsam mit Product & Growth steuerst du Engineering-Kapazitäten entlang der Unternehmens- und Produktprioritäten, etablierst klare Delivery-Routinen und löst teamübergreifende Blocker mit konkreten Optionen und Empfehlungen.
Leadership & Organisation: Du führst und entwickelst Engineering Leads sowie technische Schlüsselpersonen und schaffst klare Rollen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Erwartungen innerhalb der Development Teams. Gemeinsam mit P&O und unserem CPTO entwickelst du Organisation, Karrierepfade, Nachfolgeplanung, Hiring und Onboarding weiter. Du gibst deinen Teams den nötigen Spielraum für eigene Entscheidungen, definierst die notwendigen Leitplanken und stehst für die Ergebnisse deines Bereichs und deiner Verantwortung als Head-Of ein.
Engineering Excellence & AI: Du entwickelst verbindliche Standards für Codequalität, Reviews, Testing, Dokumentation und Release Readiness. Außerdem sorgst du dafür, dass technische Optimierungsbedarfe transparent bewertet und systematisch priorisiert werden. Gleichzeitig machst du AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung zu einem festen Bestandteil unseres Engineering-Systems, von Standards und Trainings über sichere Tool-Nutzung bis hin zu wiederverwendbaren Best Practices.
Zusammenarbeit & Schnittstellensteuerung: Du arbeitest eng mit Product & Growth, IT Operations, Cyber Security, Customer Success, Partner Management sowie weiteren technischen Ansprechpartner:innen innerhalb der comrce group zusammen. Dabei klärst du Zielkonflikte zwischen Product Delivery, technischer Qualität und verfügbaren Kapazitäten und sorgst für transparente Entscheidungen, klare Übergaben sowie abgestimmte Release-, Rollback- und Incident-Prozesse. Gemeinsam mit unserem Head of IT Operations stellst du sicher, dass unsere Software stabil, sicher und effizient betrieben werden kann.
Secure Software Development: Du verankerst Secure Software Development und Security-by-Design im Development Lifecycle. Dabei sorgst du dafür, dass Security-Anforderungen in Architektur, Implementierung, Reviews, Testing und Dependency Management berücksichtigt werden. Bei Security Findings und Incidents stellst du die passenden Engineering-Ressourcen für Analyse, Behebung und nachhaltige Verbesserungen sicher.
das bringst du mit
Leadership & Organisationsentwicklung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von Softwareentwicklungsorganisationen mit, idealerweise in einem SaaS-, Plattform- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld. Du hast bereits mehrere Engineering Teams oder Engineering Leads geführt und verstehst, wie man technische Organisationen strukturiert weiterentwickelt und Verantwortung sinnvoll verteilt.
Software Development & Architektur: Du verfügst über ein sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitektur, APIs, Datenmodelle, Software Delivery und skalierbarer Entwicklungsprozesse. Erfahrung mit Legacy-Systemen, Modernisierung und schrittweisen Architekturtransformationen bringst du ebenfalls mit.
Delivery & Engineering Excellence: Du hast Erfahrung mit Kapazitätsplanung, Priorisierung, automatisierten Tests, Release Readiness und der Zusammenarbeit mit CI/CD- und Plattformteams. Du kannst zwischen Hotfix, tragfähiger Zwischenlösung und nachhaltigem Zielbild unterscheiden und triffst pragmatische Entscheidungen mit Blick auf Qualität, Risiko, Kundenwirkung und Business Impact.
AI & Developer Experience: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung, modernen Coding Assistants oder Agentic-Engineering-Workflows und kannst deren Einsatz in Engineering Teams sinnvoll einführen. Du verstehst, wie AI Qualität, Lead Time und Developer Experience verbessern kann, und kannst gleichzeitig verbindliche Standards für Sicherheit, Nachvollziehbarkeit, Datenschutz, Intellectual Property und Codequalität etablieren.
Security & Betriebsfähigkeit: Du bringst Erfahrung mit Secure Software Development, Security-by-Design und der Bearbeitung technischer Security Findings mit. Außerdem verstehst du, wie wichtig stabile Übergaben zwischen Development und Betrieb sind, und kannst Anforderungen an Deployability, Observability, Reliability und technische Betriebsfähigkeit in Entwicklungsprozessen verankern.
Kommunikation & Zusammenarbeit: Du kommunizierst klar, direkt und verantwortungsbewusst auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du kannst technische Entscheidungen in Business Impact, Risiken und Trade-offs übersetzen, machst Abhängigkeiten früh sichtbar und arbeitest souverän mit Product & Growth, IT Operations, Cyber Security, Geschäftsführung und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen.
das erwartet dich
Team & Kultur: Dich erwartet ein dynamisches Team mit vielfältigen Stärken, Hands-on-Mentalität und offener Kommunikation. Wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe, fördern Vielfalt und ein respektvolles Miteinander, probieren Neues aus und entwickeln uns gemeinsam stetig weiter.
Vertrauen & Kommunikation: „With freedom comes responsibility“ ist für uns gelebter Alltag. Gute Arbeit entsteht nur in einem Umfeld aus Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung. Deshalb setzen wir auf klare und verlässliche Kommunikation – intern im Team ebenso wie mit Kolleg:innen, Stakeholdern und User:innen.
Gemeinschaft: Auch wenn wir komplett remote arbeiten, ist uns persönlicher Austausch wichtig. Daher treffen wir uns regelmäßig bei Events, Meetups oder unserem jährlichen Offsite. Wir freuen uns, wenn du dabei bist, dich einbringst und mit uns gemeinsam wächst.
Tools: Wir arbeiten gruppenweit mit Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, Miro, Langdock und Personio. Je nach Bedarf nutzen die Teams weitere spezialisierte Tools.
Benefits: Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns komplett wohlfühlst und alles hast, um dein Bestes zu geben. Deshalb bieten wir dir unter anderem:
Hardware-Ausstattung nach Wunsch
JobRad
Monatliche Gutscheinauswahl im Wert von 50€ über emplu
Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Vermögenswirksame Leistungen
CSR-Spendenbudget
Bis zu 3 Monate Remote-Arbeit innerhalb der EU pro Jahr
wir sind für dich da
Deinen Bewerbungsprozess wird Anna begleiten. Hast du vorab Fragen? Zögere nicht, sie einfach per E-Mail an kontaktieren.

jobs.title: Field CTO
jobs.text:
About the Role
As a Field CTO (Strategic Pursuits), you will serve as a strategic bridge between our customers, go-to-market (GTM) teams, and product organization. You will partner closely with Sales, Technical Success, and Product to shape high-impact deals, guide customer architecture decisions, and influence our product roadmap based on real-world adoption and feedback.
This is a highly cross-functional, externally facing leadership role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and customer empathy.
In this role, you will:
Customer & Deal Strategy
Partner with Sales, Product and Technical Success teams to support complex, high-value deals as a technical and strategic advisor.
Translate customer business needs into scalable technical solutions and architectures.
Engage with senior customer stakeholders (CTO/CIO/VP-level) to drive alignment on vision, roadmap, and adoption.
Lead technical strategy discussions during key deal stages, including discovery, solution design, and executive presentations.
Architecture & Implementation Guidance
Guide customers on best practices for deploying and scaling AI-driven solutions in production.
Provide architectural oversight across use cases such as LLM applications, integrations, data pipelines, and security.
Act as a trusted advisor to ensure long-term success, not just short-term wins.
Product & Feedback Loop
Bring structured customer insights back to Product and Engineering teams to inform roadmap and prioritization.
Identify gaps, opportunities, and emerging patterns from customer deployments.
Influence product direction based on real-world usage, scalability needs, and enterprise requirements.
GTM Strategy & Thought Leadership
Help shape GTM strategies by identifying repeatable patterns across industries and customer segments.
Develop scalable frameworks, reference architectures, and playbooks for broader field teams.
Represent the company externally through customer engagements, industry events, and thought leadership.
Experience
15+ years of experience in technical leadership roles.
Strong background in enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, and modern software systems.
Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles or working closely with GTM teams.
Exposure to AI/ML systems, especially LLMs and applied AI use cases, is highly preferred.
Skills & Capabilities
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving skills with a bias for action and ownership.
Excellent communication and executive presence.
Proven ability to influence without authority across cross-functional teams.
About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.
OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Enterprise Core Platform
jobs.text:
Role Summary
Scale builds AI applications for organizations where reliability, security, and measurable results matter. Our core platform, SGP, gives teams the capabilities to build, deploy, evaluate, and operate those applications in customer environments.
We're looking for a product leader to own the strategy and roadmap for SGP's core platform and lead the PM team responsible for it. You will work with customers, platform engineering, and forward deployed teams to build capabilities customers need, productize work developed in the field when it has broader value, and improve how teams build, deploy, and operate AI applications.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will connect work across teams into a coherent product, make difficult scope and investment decisions, and stay close enough to the details to know whether what we ship works for the people using it.
What you'll do
Own the platform strategy and roadmap. Prioritize across developer experience, capabilities customers need, and productizing work built in the field where it has broader value. Sequence investments against customer value, commitments, and dependencies.
Define how the product should work. Work with users and engineers to write clear requirements and vibe code prototypes, user journeys, and measure success through customer outcomes, capability adoption, delivery time, and production performance, and follow through on gaps after launch.
Align teams across the business. Work with platform engineering, forward deployed PMs, and business leaders to agree on shared capabilities, rollout priorities, and necessary differences across environments. Make clear what is available, where it works, and what remains to be delivered.
Build and lead a strong PM team. Establish clear ownership across related product areas, hire and coach PMs, and raise the quality of product thinking and written requirements. Stay directly involved in the most consequential decisions.
What we're looking for
A track record of owning platform, infrastructure, or developer products from problem definition through launch and sustained production use.
Experience managing and developing product managers, setting direction across multiple related product areas, and remaining hands-on with important product decisions.
Strong product judgment. You can explain which problems you chose to solve, what you decided against, how you sequenced the work, and what changed for users as a result.
Technical depth to work credibly with engineers on APIs, runtime behavior, identity and authorization, deployment, observability, and data isolation. You can reason through architectural tradeoffs and their consequences for users, security, and operations.
Experience driving adoption across teams with different needs and constraints. You can reach decisions, establish ownership, and follow through when progress depends on people outside your reporting line.
Clear, precise writing and communication. You can turn an ambiguous problem into requirements engineers can act on and explain priorities and tradeoffs to customers and executives.
Nice-to-Haves
Experience with AI platforms, including agent runtimes, workflow orchestration, evaluation, datasets, human review, or production AI observability.
Experience building products for regulated industries or deploying into on-premises, air-gapped, or classified environments.
Experience turning capabilities developed for individual customers into reusable platform products.
Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend.
Please reference the job posting's subtitle for where this position will be located. For pay transparency purposes, the base salary range for this full-time position in the locations of San Francisco and New York is:
$273,600—$342,000 USD

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.

jobs.title: VP of Technology Delivery & Transformation
jobs.text:
Kurt Geiger | About Us
We are an inclusive, creative footwear and accessories brand powered by kindness. We want to empower our talent to be confident and true to themselves, the London way. London is our home, our heartbeat, and we draw inspiration from the energy and spirit of the city; its diversity and creativity. For over fifty years our team of in-house shoe and accessory designers have been creating authentic, distinctive designs from our London headquarters. The rainbow is our signature. It represents the good energy and love we have for our community and the many ways we collectively express our individual style.
Kurt Geiger Digital
Kurt Geiger’s Digital Team is a leading edge, multichannel, global, fully integrated function within the business. We have built an inclusive and diverse team that operates across 4 layers of the Business: Back End Systems and Engineering; Platforms; Marketing; Customer Service.
Our in-house team of over 100 Digital experts are augmented with expertise from partners across the globe to deliver the very best in Retail Technology with a firm eye on the future. We operate in a fully Agile, fast paced environment, with a strong focus on individual leadership talent and development through an integrated Excellency Framework to ensure every member of the team develops the very best leadership development for themselves whilst delivering business objectives in line with growing our Global Digital Brands.
Purpose of the Role
This role is responsible for the successful delivery and operation of the organisation’s technology platforms and engineering capability. It ensures that technology programmes are executed effectively, engineering teams are high performing, and operational systems continue to meet business needs throughout a period of significant transformation.
The role provides leadership across software engineering, enterprise applications and major business systems, overseeing the transition from the current technology landscape to the organisation’s future operating model. It works closely with the SVP of Architecture, Data & AI to ensure all delivery aligns with approved technology strategy, architecture principles and transformation roadmaps.
Initially, the role will oversee IT Operations, ERP, Wholesale & Warehouse Systems, and Software Engineering. As organisational responsibilities transition to the parent company, the role will increasingly focus on two strategic delivery domains:
ERP Transformation (Retail Express → Infor M3)
Digital Engineering Transformation (Adobe Commerce → Shopify)
The role is deliberately focused on execution, delivery, operational excellence and engineering leadership rather than defining long-term technology strategy or enterprise architecture.

jobs.text:
The CTO will drive the group’s technology vision, strategy, and execution. As a key member of the executive team, the CTO will lead the digital transformation journey, enhance technological capabilities across all business units, and ensure that technology aligns with overall business goals, enhancing operational efficiency and customer engagement.
Technology Strategy & Vision

aftersales, mobility services, and logistics.

performance.

• Collaborate with other executives to integrate technology into all areas of the organization, from
customer service to operations and finance.

infrastructure.

journey.

• Develop and maintain robust cybersecurity policies, risk management strategies, and disaster
recovery plans.
Vendor & Budget Management
• Manage relationships with external technology vendors and service providers.
• Optimize the technology budget, ensuring cost-effectiveness and strategic investments.
