jobs.title: Head of Solution Engineering
jobs.text:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a Head of Solution Engineering to join one of our clients' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in an innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.
Responsibilities:
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Solution Engineers.
Provide technical leadership throughout all stages of client engagement: pre-sales, solution architecture, and implementation.
Act as a key technical consultant throughout the sales cycle: clearly and convincingly present product capabilities and business value to prospective clients.
Work closely with sales, product management, and development teams to design and deliver optimal client solutions.
Oversee the integration and implementation of solutions for clients, ensuring smooth and timely deployment.
Take into account all aspects when developing solutions: liquidity flows, execution models, risk parameters, and infrastructure compatibility.
Create and maintain up-to-date documentation, technical guides, and training materials for clients and internal teams.
Actively identify customer needs and suggest improvements based on feedback and market trends.
Define and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to assess team productivity and customer satisfaction levels.
Represent the company in technical meetings with external stakeholders, maintaining high standards of professionalism and technical expertise.
Requirements
Extensive technical experience in financial technology, trading platforms, risk management systems, and enterprise SaaS solutions.
Proven experience managing technical teams, preferably in solution engineering, pre-sales engineering, or technical sales within the financial sector.
Deep knowledge of liquidity aggregation, order routing, execution models, the FIX protocol, and trading system APIs.
Expertise in trading technologies and market infrastructure, particularly in the FX, CFD, and digital assets segments.
Familiarity with institutional platforms such as MetaTrader, cTrader, OneZero, PrimeXM, and proprietary OMS/EMS solutions.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to business audiences.
A proactive, client-oriented mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and a successful track record of working with diverse stakeholders.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Content Platform (Catalog)
jobs.text:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.
As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.
We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

jobs.title: Head of Product Operations
jobs.text:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.
Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.
As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.
We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.
Building the AI Infrastructure for Construction
Construction is one of the largest industries in the world - and one of the most operationally fragmented.
Before anything gets built, projects must move through permitting and pre-construction workflows spread across ~20,000 jurisdictions, each with different rules, systems, and processes.
The result is a massive bottleneck slowing down housing and infrastructure across the country.
PermitFlow is rebuilding this layer from the ground up - using modern software and AI systems to automate and orchestrate permitting end-to-end.
We are still early. The product surface area is expanding rapidly, the workflows are deeply complex, and the opportunity to shape how this industry operates is enormous.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Supply Chain
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Poland
Poland is a new and deliberate addition to our engineering map. We recently made our first technology hire in the country, and we see it as a long-term strategic location for senior hires, particularly within engineering. Joining now means joining early, and helping shape what our presence here becomes.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Supply Chain to join us in Poland.
About The Role
POS Hardware and Device Platforms owns the software behind the physical side of Moniepoint's business: the systems that track, move, maintain and account for millions of POS terminals in the field. That covers inventory and warehouse management, logistics and distribution, repair and maintenance workflows, and the operational tooling the business runs on day to day. It is a backend and distributed systems challenge at real scale - making operational data about millions of physical devices visible, trustworthy and consistent across every market we operate in. It is not a hardware engineering role.
The Head of Engineering, POS Supply Chain, oversees that software estate and is vital as Moniepoint expands internationally and scales device operations globally. The position involves leading the technical strategy for the domain and managing a large engineering organisation in a remote, distributed environment. As Head of Engineering, Supply Chain, your responsibilities will include:
Owning the technical strategy and architecture for inventory and logistics tools and repair management software.
Leading an engineering organisation of approximately 25 engineers, including managers, QA, SRE and Data Engineering.
Driving platformisation of inventory and supply chain systems so operational data is visible, trustworthy and consistent across millions of terminals.
Bridging the gap between operational practice and software systems by building operationally disciplined solutions.
Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics across squads to ensure reliability and data integrity.
Collaborating with business and operational stakeholders to translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
Hiring, mentoring and developing engineering managers and senior engineers to support team growth up to 30+ members.
Who You Are
10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
Deep hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory, warehouse or logistics software at scale.
Fintech or regulated-industry experience, with an understanding of the operational stakes of device management in a payments environment.
Strong backend engineering skills for data-intensive, distributed, operational systems.
Proven system design ability at large scale, managing hundreds of thousands of devices or more.
Experience managing and developing large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
Excellent stakeholder management, translating complex technical concepts for non-technical leaders.
A product-minded approach to solving operational problems with engineering solutions.
Cultural Alignment
As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.
Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.
What Success Looks Like In The Role
Scalable inventory and logistics systems delivered, supporting millions of devices across multiple countries.
A high-performing, motivated engineering team aligned with company growth.
Operational data visibility and trust established across multiple global markets.
Robust architecture standards enabling reliability and data integrity.
Effective collaboration with business and operational teams to meet rapid expansion needs.
What we can offer you
Lead engineering for one of Africa's largest POS networks and directly influence our global expansion.
Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment at the intersection of fintech and hardware operations.
Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.
What to expect in the hiring process
A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders, 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project/system you built in the past. 30 minutes will be focused on testing for leadership attributes.
60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management, collaboration skills with product/business.
60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Head of Developer Relations, SEA and OCE
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As the Head of Developer Relations you will own the strategy, execution, and outcomes for Roblox developer growth strategies of Southeast Asia (SEA). You will work directly with publishers, developers, emerging studios, and industry partners across SEA to drive adoption, accelerate development, and build long-term ecosystem relationships.
You will serve as a strategic partner to developers, represent Roblox at industry events, and collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Creator, and International teams to scale Roblox as a destination for high-quality, game development.
You Will:
Proactively set team goals, monitor progress and conversation trends with key partners.
Partner with data scientists, product, engineering and leaders across the company.
Become the voice of your partners, identifying and quantifying the critical action items that will impact our product growth in the region.
Communicate risk factors of the region and make difficult decisions.
Actively share reports to reflect the impact of your work with the company.
Requirements:
Residency in Singapore or willing to relocate.
10+ years of experience in technical project management.
Able to proactively communicate with all key stakeholders.
Experience with launching a technical product in international markets.
Experience with using Roblox Studio or another game development engine. (eg. Unity or Unreal)
A researcher with a unique skill set to quickly ramp up and understand your target audience needs.
Passionate, full of positive energy, and a role model to others.
Driven by teamwork, naturally encourages people to work together.
Able to lead by example, building a clear high-level strategy and holding yourself and others accountable to the long-term company vision.
Data and feedback driven, your decisions are inspired by the product usage, the users’ qualitative insights, and your expertise.
Communication focused with excellent verbal and written skills.
Self-Directed with the ability to establish your work and processes.
Advance Educational degree or equivalent practical experience
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

Why Portugal
We have a small but strong group of team members in Portugal, having joined us from companies like Feedzai and OLX. As we continue to build out our engineering organisation across Europe, Portugal is a market we are actively hiring into.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway to join us in Portugal.
About The Role
Monnify is Moniepoint's online payment acceptance platform: the gateway layer connecting merchants to card networks, banks and payment aggregators, and the tools that let businesses and developers accept and send money digitally. The division owns transaction reliability, routing and throughput at scale, together with the developer experience that sits on top of it - APIs, SDKs, documentation and ease of integration. Built first for Nigerian businesses and developers, the platform is now scaling internationally and moving towards multi-currency, multi-market support.
The Head of Engineering owns the technical direction and architecture of that platform, ensuring scalability, security and developer experience for both technical and non-technical users. The role involves leading multiple engineering teams through their managers, setting strategic architecture, and ensuring platform reliability, security and scalability across Payment In, Payout, Commerce Tools and developer-facing features. As the Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway, your responsibilities will include:
Own the full technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Monnify platform across all capability areas.
Lead multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, setting quality standards and building organisational capability.
Own the developer experience end-to-end, including APIs, documentation, SDKs and integration ease.
Drive platform evolution towards multi-currency and international scalability.
Ensure platform reliability, scalability and security within a regulated environment.
Partner with product, commercial and operations teams to align technical investments with business goals.
Hire, mentor and develop engineering managers and senior engineers to support growth.

Over 10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering leadership roles.
5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not only years spent overseeing teams who write it.
At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
Experience in payments, fintech or financial services products, with a working understanding of payment flows and compliance.
Deep knowledge of API-first products, developer platforms and API integration.
Proven leadership of multiple engineering teams via managers in a scaling organisation.
Strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, distributed transactional systems.
Experience building or operating a payment gateway or multi-currency payment platform is a strong plus.

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

blocks.text: Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why Portugal

We have a small but strong group of team members in Portugal, having joined us from companies like Feedzai and OLX. As we continue to build out our engineering organisation across Europe, Portugal is a market we are actively hiring into.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway to join us in Portugal.
About The Role

Monnify is Moniepoint's online payment acceptance platform: the gateway layer connecting merchants to card networks, banks and payment aggregators, and the tools that let businesses and developers accept and send money digitally. The division owns transaction reliability, routing and throughput at scale, together with the developer experience that sits on top of it - APIs, SDKs, documentation and ease of integration. Built first for Nigerian businesses and developers, the platform is now scaling internationally and moving towards multi-currency, multi-market support.

The Head of Engineering owns the technical direction and architecture of that platform, ensuring scalability, security and developer experience for both technical and non-technical users. The role involves leading multiple engineering teams through their managers, setting strategic architecture, and ensuring platform reliability, security and scalability across Payment In, Payout, Commerce Tools and developer-facing features. Drive platform evolution towards multi-currency and international scalability.
Ensure platform reliability, scalability and security within a regulated environment.
Partner with product, commercial and operations teams to align technical investments with business goals.
Hire, mentor and develop engineering managers and senior engineers to support growth.

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.text:
Welcome to Fi.
We’re a passionate team from Square, Google, Oura, Peloton, Uber, and more working to transform the human-pet relationship. Our mission? Develop cutting-edge technology to revolutionize what it means to be a pet parent. The pet industry remains firmly stuck in the past and we are here to change that. Fi is leveraging our team's talent and expertise to improve the lives of millions of pets in the U.S. Real-time location tracking, activity, sleep and behavior monitoring – and that's just the beginning.
The most exciting aspect of our work? Bridging the communication gap between pets and humans. Imagine a world where everyone knows how their pet feels in real time and how to keep their best friend in good shape. That's the future we're building at Fi.
If you're someone who thrives in innovative, collaborative work environments and feels strongly about helping pets live longer, better lives, Fi could be the perfect fit. Join us in our pursuit of the “impossible,” or as we call it here “let me find a way,” to redefine the future of pet ownership together.
Fi is looking for a Head of Data!Fi is looking for a Head of Data to own our data platform end to end. You'll model our device, membership, and operational data into the pipelines and warehouse layers the company runs on, lead a team of four analysts, and be the numbers person Finance and Product turn to for board reporting, forecasting, and experiment reads. This is a hands-on role for someone who's built a data function before and wants to do it again, this time with real leverage.
What You'll Do:
Own Fi's data platform and analytics roadmap: model our device, membership, and operational data into pipelines and warehouse layers the whole company can build on
Design and maintain event-driven, incremental pipelines over raw device telemetry — turning millions of collar signals into usable product and fleet data models
Manage, coach, and grow a team of four analysts; run their pipeline of work, unblock them technically, and raise the bar on rigor and documentation
Partner with Finance on subscription and unit economics: membership forecasting, retention and LTV modeling, hardware margin, and the reporting our board and investors see
Partner with Product and Hardware on activation, engagement, and device performance analytics — including the sensor and firmware data behind features customers actually feel
Build self-serve BI that stakeholders genuinely use, rather than a dashboard graveyard
Design and read experiments on pricing, onboarding, and retention, and hold the org to honest interpretation of results
Shift the data team from a ticket-taking service function into a strategic partner embedded in the business
What You'll Bring:
7+ years in analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or analytics engineering, including time as the person who built or substantially rebuilt a data function
Experience leading analysts — formally or as a player-coach — with a real point of view on how to develop them
Deep SQL, plus hands-on work in a modern warehouse and orchestration stack (Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, Airflow, dbt or similar)
Fluency in dimensional and event-driven modeling, and clear opinions on ELT tradeoffs, incremental builds, and cost control
Strong BI craft in Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent — you build for the stakeholder, not the demo
Comfort partnering with Finance on models that carry real consequences: forecasts, diligence materials, margin analysis
Ability to work in ambiguity at Series B scale, where you'll sometimes be the entire data team for a given problem
Why You'll Love Us:
Time to Recharge: Enjoy flexible PTO to take the breaks you need.
Top-Notch Health Coverage: We’ve got your back (and teeth and eyes) with full medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Wellness Perks: Free access to One Medical, Kindbody, and Talkspace to keep you feeling your best.
Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your pup to work — they’re part of the team, too.
Give Back to the Pups: Make tails wag with a $500 annual donation to a dog charity of your choice through our BarkBack Program.
Free Fi Membership: Your furry best friend(s) get all the benefits of a Fi collar, on us!
Love for Friends + Family: Share the Fi magic with loved ones through our gifting program.
The anticipated base salary range for this position is $150,000–$300,000. Actual compensation will vary based on multiple factors, including skills, experience, market conditions, and role scope, which may evolve during the hiring process. As a fast-growing Series B startup, Fi evaluates compensation opportunistically to align with the right candidate. This role is also eligible for equity compensation.
Fi is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Fi makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and our needs at the time.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Product Director
jobs.text:
About OLX
OLX is a global leader in facilitating trade. It builds leading marketplace ecosystems enabled by tech, powered by trust, and loved by customers.
Serving tens of millions of people every month around the world, OLX helps people buy and sell cars, find housing, get jobs, buy and sell household goods, and much more. Its well-loved consumer brands (including OLX, Otomoto, Property24, and more) offer safe, smart, and convenient online trading platforms and services for its customers.
OLX is powered by global teams, united in a common purpose to build a more sustainable world through trade. For more information, visit .
OLX is backed by Prosus, a global consumer internet group and one of the largest technology investors in the world. Prosus has a primary listing on Euronext Amsterdam (AEX:PRX) and a secondary listing on the JSE Limited (XJSE:PRX), and is majority-owned by Naspers. For more information on Prosus and its companies and investments, please visit .
The Opportunity
OLX is looking for an experienced and hands-on Product Director to lead product function for our core horizontal marketplace, spanning household goods, electronics, and other general merchandise categories. This is a global role with responsibility for the strategy and execution of Horizontal across a focused set of European markets. You'll be a key voice shaping how this business grows within the broader OLX portfolio.
You'll lead a product organization of around 15 people, working closely with engineering, design, and commercial leadership to define and deliver a product roadmap that drives growth, engagement, and monetization for both consumers and sellers on the platform.
This role reports to Michael Bullion, Chief Product Officer.
What You'll Do
Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Horizontal, in partnership with the CPO and broader leadership team.
Drive customer-centric product innovation with a focus on growth, retention, and monetization across the buyer and seller journeys.
Lead AI transformation for the horizontal domain
Lead the incubation, development & transition to a fully agentic horizontal marketplace.
Lead a product organization of around 15 people, with an emphasis on strong product management fundamentals — experimentation, documentation, and upstream opportunity discovery.
Work closely with engineering and commercial teams across markets to align product development with business priorities.
Identify and execute strategic opportunities, including creative monetization levers, cross-market improvements, and long-term category positioning.
Establish and scale best practices in product thinking and execution across your teams.
Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and product leaders.
Partner with senior stakeholders across finance, commercial, and other functions to build consensus around strategy and priorities.
Act as a thought partner and sparring peer to other product and business leaders in shaping the future of OLX.
What We're Looking For
Proven experience leading product teams in online B2C/B2B2C environments, ideally in marketplaces, e-commerce, or classifieds. Experience navigating the dynamics of two-sided marketplaces (consumer buyers and sellers).
Strong hands-on product management background—not just a strategic leader, but someone who has built products and worked closely with engineers and commercial stakeholders.
Several years of experience hiring, growing, and directly managing Product Managers at all stages of their careers, ideally leading teams of a similar size (~15 people).
Comfort working in cross-functional, multicultural teams across multiple markets.
Strategic thinker, able to balance long-term vision with short- and medium-term goals.
Experience in both 0->1 and scaling phases of product development.
Proven track record of jumping between domains and sectors. Ability to learn fast.
Experience in developing and managing AI-based products.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX
At OLX, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management - Risk & Quality (Payer)
jobs.text:
About the Role
Reporting to executive leadership, the Senior Director of Product Management – Risk & Quality is a key leader within Innovaccer’s Payer vertical. In this role, you will hold end-to-end accountability for the product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market (GTM) execution across our Risk Adjustment, RADV/Audit Readiness, Quality (HEDIS/Stars), and Compliance solution portfolio.
We are looking for a seasoned product leader who possesses deep domain expertise in clinical and financial risk operations across Commercial (ACA), Medicare Advantage, and Managed Medicaid markets. You will translate complex regulatory requirements, coding workflows, and risk-capture dynamics into a market-leading, AI-native product platform that drives verifiable revenue accuracy, audit defensibility, and operational efficiency for our health plan partners.
A Day in the Life
1. Product Strategy & Domain Leadership (Risk & Quality)
End-to-End Portfolio Vision: Own the multi-year product strategy for Risk Adjustment (Prospective, Concurrent, and Retrospective), RADV Audit Management, Risk Analytics, and integrated Quality/HEDIS products.
AI-First Innovation: Translate market needs into an AI-native product roadmap—leveraging NLP, LLMs, and automated chart retrieval/coding engines to eliminate manual touchpoints and maximize risk accuracy.
Regulatory Agility: Stay ahead of evolving CMS, HHS, and state regulatory landscapes (e.g., V28 model updates, RADV audit rule changes, submission deadlines) to ensure continuous product compliance and market differentiation.
Strategic Alignment: Partner with VP Payer, CPO, and Market President- Payer Growth to shape the overall Payer product narrative and co-own revenue targets for your products.
2. Execution, Architecture & AI-Native Product Craft
Harmonized Suite: Direct and develop product managers to unify risk analytics, suspecting, chart review, coding workflows, and audit trail tools into a single, seamless product experience.
AI-Native Operational Rigor: Enforce an AI-first development lifecycle—from discovery and automated feedback synthesis to generative prototyping and intelligent backlog management.
Delivery & Quality: Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Clinical SMEs, and Platform teams to build scalably on Innovaccer's Healthcare Intelligence Cloud, maintaining a predictable release cadence.
Impact & ROI Metrics: Establish strict outcome-based success metrics (e.g., chart review accuracy, suspecting yield rates, RADV audit mitigation rate, coding velocity) and track customer value realization.
3. Customer, GTM & Market Engagement
Executive Single Point of Contact (SPOC): Build direct relationships with plan executives (CMOs, Chief Risk Officers, Actuarial Leads, VPs of Risk Adjustment) to understand operational pain points and serve as the product authority for strategic discussions and escalations.
GTM Enablement & Revenue Co-Ownership: Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success to refine sales pitches, participate in key customer pursuits, support upsell/cross-sell initiatives, and validate product-market fit.
Industry Representation: Represent Innovaccer’s Risk Adjustment perspective in external forums, industry advisory boards, and regulatory consultations.
What You Need
Experience: 10+ years in Product Management or related technology leadership roles, with at least 5+ years of direct experience building and scaling Risk Adjustment, RADV/Audit, or Quality solutions for health plans/payers.
Domain Mastery: Deep expertise in Risk Adjustment methodologies (CMS-HCC, RxHCC, HHS-HCC), coding workflows (ICD-10, MEAT criteria), retrospective chart reviews, prospective point-of-care nudges, and RADV audit prep.
AI & Data Fluency: Proven track record of shipping AI/ML capabilities into healthcare workflows (e.g., NLP for unstructured clinical documentation, predictive suspecting models, generative summaries for coders).
Enterprise Scale: Demonstrated success in shipping and embedding SaaS products within complex payer environments and multi-payer enterprise systems.
People Leadership: Strong track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product management teams while fostering a culture of ownership and AI adoption.
Communication & Influence: Exceptional memo-writing and executive presentation skills; comfortable discussing risk models with actuaries, NLP accuracy with data scientists, and ROI with CFOs.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Health Informatics, Business, or related quantitative field required; Master’s/Advanced degree preferred.
We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.
Here’s What We Offer
Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.
Innovaccer Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered regardless of any characteristic protected by federal, state or local law including, without limitation, race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, medical condition, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status. Innovaccer Inc. participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility of all newly hired employees based out of the U.S. and employed by Innovaccer Inc.

You will translate complex regulatory requirements, coding workflows, and risk-capture dynamics into a market-leading, AI-native product platform that drives verifiable revenue accuracy, audit defensibility, and operational efficiency for our health plan partners.
A Day in the Life
1. Product Strategy & Domain Leadership (Risk & Quality)

items: End-to-End Portfolio Vision: Own the multi-year product strategy for Risk Adjustment (Prospective, Concurrent, and Retrospective), RADV Audit Management, Risk Analytics, and integrated Quality/HEDIS products.

AI-First Innovation: Translate market needs into an AI-native product roadmap—leveraging NLP, LLMs, and automated chart retrieval/coding engines to eliminate manual touchpoints and maximize risk accuracy.

Regulatory Agility: Stay ahead of evolving CMS, HHS, and state regulatory landscapes (e.g., V28 model updates, RADV audit rule changes, submission deadlines) to ensure continuous product compliance and market differentiation.
Strategic Alignment: Partner with VP Payer, CPO, and Market President- Payer Growth to shape the overall Payer product narrative and co-own revenue targets for your products.

blocks.text: 2. Execution, Architecture & AI-Native Product Craft

items: Harmonized Suite: Direct and develop product managers to unify risk analytics, suspecting, chart review, coding workflows, and audit trail tools into a single, seamless product experience.
AI-Native Operational Rigor: Enforce an AI-first development lifecycle—from discovery and automated feedback synthesis to generative prototyping and intelligent backlog management.

Delivery & Quality: Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Clinical SMEs, and Platform teams to build scalably on Innovaccer's Healthcare Intelligence Cloud, maintaining a predictable release cadence.

Impact & ROI Metrics: Establish strict outcome-based success metrics (e.g., chart review accuracy, suspecting yield rates, RADV audit mitigation rate, coding velocity) and track customer value realization.

blocks.text: 3. Customer, GTM & Market Engagement

items: Executive Single Point of Contact (SPOC): Build direct relationships with plan executives (CMOs, Chief Risk Officers, Actuarial Leads, VPs of Risk Adjustment) to understand operational pain points and serve as the product authority for strategic discussions and escalations.

GTM Enablement & Revenue Co-Ownership: Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success to refine sales pitches, participate in key customer pursuits, support upsell/cross-sell initiatives, and validate product-market fit.
Industry Representation: Represent Innovaccer’s Risk Adjustment perspective in external forums, industry advisory boards, and regulatory consultations.

blocks.text: What You Need

items: Experience: 10+ years in Product Management or related technology leadership roles, with at least 5+ years of direct experience building and scaling Risk Adjustment, RADV/Audit, or Quality solutions for health plans/payers.

Domain Mastery: Deep expertise in Risk Adjustment methodologies (CMS-HCC, RxHCC, HHS-HCC), coding workflows (ICD-10, MEAT criteria), retrospective chart reviews, prospective point-of-care nudges, and RADV audit prep.

AI & Data Fluency: Proven track record of shipping AI/ML capabilities into healthcare workflows (e.g., NLP for unstructured clinical documentation, predictive suspecting models, generative summaries for coders).
Enterprise Scale: Demonstrated success in shipping and embedding SaaS products within complex payer environments and multi-payer enterprise systems.
People Leadership: Strong track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product management teams while fostering a culture of ownership and AI adoption.
Communication & Influence: Exceptional memo-writing and executive presentation skills; comfortable discussing risk models with actuaries, NLP accuracy with data scientists, and ROI with CFOs.

jobs.title: Head of Technology and Product
jobs.text:
About Welo Data
Welo Data, a Welo Global brand, is the multilingual data and evaluation partner for foundation labs and enterprises deploying GenAI systems globally. They deliver the human judgment, data infrastructure, and evaluation systems that ensure AI models perform reliably across languages, cultures, and real-world contexts, at every stage from training through deployment. Its global network of 500,000+ vetted experts spans 300+ languages and locales, enabling high-quality multilingual data creation and structured model evaluation across the full spectrum of modern AI applications — from large language models and voice and speech systems to agentic workflows and robotics and embodied AI. This breadth of linguistic, cultural, and domain expertise enables Welo Data to address critical AI development challenges, including safety, bias, inclusivity, and cross-lingual reliability. A unified global operating model, led by specialized program and quality experts and grounded in assessment-driven talent selection, localized rubrics, and continuous calibration, ensures consistent performance across languages, domains, and modalities. Underpinning all of this is NIMO™ (Network Identity Management and Operations), Welo Data's proprietary identity and fraud-prevention framework. Built to maintain data integrity and workforce trust across a global contributor base, NIMO combines advanced verification, continuous monitoring, and structured QA to ensure every dataset is accurate, traceable, and culturally grounded. welodata.ai
ROLE SUMMARY
The Head of Technology and Product for WeloData, a Welo Global business, is a hands-on leader accountable for both product and engineering for this fast-growing service line. This is a build and scale mandate: the role owns strengthening platform reliability, release quality, monitoring, and product delivery as the foundation for WeloData’s next stage of growth, and is empowered to move fast and decisively. Working in close partnership with Welo Global’s Technology team, and stakeholders within WeloData: Talent, Operations, and the Director of Delivery Engagement, the Head of Technology and Product elevates WeloData’s platforms to match the pace of the business while building the 2–3 year technology and product roadmap that positions WeloData for what’s next, delivering measurable impact on customer success, operational efficiency, and financial performance.
TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES
Build the next generation of WeloData’s platform foundations: raise the bar on release quality, monitoring, and audit readiness, and build the engineering discipline to match the pace of the business’s growth.
Define and execute the product and technology strategy for WeloData, shaping the domain’s 2–3-year roadmap,coordinated with Welo Global’s corporate goals.
Anticipate market, client, and technology trends to position WeloData as an industry leader in the rapidly evolving AI training data space
Partner with EL leaders to shape cross-domain strategy and ensure integration with the wider Welo Global technology ecosystem.
Lead product and technology professionals across geographies.
Build a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within WeloData Technology and Product.
Recruit, develop, and retain top technical talent; provide mentorship and succession planning for future technology leaders.
Be the executive technology partner for WeloData, working closely with internal teams and Clients to co-create solutions grounded in real operational impact.
Be the WeloData technology expert and advocate externally, enhancing the company’s visibility and reputation in the AI, data, and localization technology space.
Define and execute the technology strategy for WeloData, shaping the domain’s 2–3-year roadmap in alignment with Welocalize’s corporate goals.
Anticipate market, client, and technology trends to position WeloData as an industry leader in data-driven language and AI services.
Partner with the CTO and other EL leaders to shape cross-domain strategy and ensure integration with the wider Welocalize technology ecosystem.
Direct the architecture, design, and delivery of scalable data and analytics platforms, AI/ML capabilities, and automation solutions for WeloData.
Drive adoption of new technologies that improve efficiency, quality, and innovation across the service line.
Oversee large-scale, complex projects that deliver significant enterprise value and set precedents for future growth.
Ensure delivery of secure, reliable, and cost-effective infrastructure, platforms, and applications that power WeloData solutions.
Establish governance standards for data integrity, interoperability, and compliance across systems.
Optimize technology investments through effective budgeting, vendor partnerships, and in-house development.
Lead and inspire a multi-disciplinary team of engineering, data, and technology professionals across geographies.
Build a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within WeloData Technology.
Recruit, develop, and retain top technical talent; provide mentorship and succession planning for future technology leaders.
Act as the executive technology partner for WeloData, working closely with Product, Operations, Sales, and Clients to co-create innovative solutions.
Represent WeloData technology externally, enhancing the company’s visibility and reputation in the AI, data, and localization technology space.
REQUIREMENTS
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
Experience:
Extensive leadership experience in technology strategy, product development, and operations at scale, ideally within data, AI/ML, or SaaS domains.
Demonstrated success in setting long-term technology vision and executing multi-year roadmaps at the domain or enterprise level.
Proven ability to lead global, high-performing technical teams and deliver innovation in fast-paced, client-centric environments.
Strong background in building and scaling data platforms, analytics frameworks, and AI-driven solutions.
Skills & Knowledge:
Deep knowledge of emerging technology trends in data, AI/ML, and cloud infrastructure.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence across executive leadership and clients.
Strong financial acumen with P&L responsibility for technology investments.
Track record as a change agent, driving organizational and technological transformation.
KEY COMPETENCIES
Customer Obsession: Puts the customer first in every decision, with deep understanding and proactive solutions that anticipate needs before they're expressed.
Relentless Innovation: Continuously seeks smarter, more creative ways to work and challenges the status quo.
Winning Together: Builds trust, collaboration, and shared accountability across the business.
Commitment to Excellence: Strives for growth and high-quality outcomes through active, never passive, management.
ADDITIONAL LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES
Beyond the core competencies above, this is a rare opportunity for a leader who is direct, hands-on, and energized by building at pace. This role will shape the technology and product foundation of Welo Data, working closely with a strong existing team to accelerate what is already in motion. The ideal candidate thrives on getting into the details, moves quickly, and makes bold, well-reasoned decisions with confidence. Success in the first year looks like a stronger, more resilient platform, a high-performing engineering culture, and visible progress on new capabilities that unlock WeloData’s next stage of growth.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer/Co-Founder Digital Health, Computer Vision, Ambient AI
jobs.text:
Chief Technology Officer & Co-Founder
Location: Remote
Alloy Partners is a venture builder with a radical thesis: that we can build and scale advantaged companies in partnership with corporations and entrepreneurs. Alloy Partners and the University of Notre Dame partnered to establish a first-of-its-kind venture studio and venture fund — the 1842 Studio and 1842 Fund — aligned with Notre Dame's mission of serving as a "Force for Good" in the world. In close partnership with the University and its vast network of alumni, corporate, community, and academic leaders, the 1842 Studio co-creates startups that address critical societal challenges, including improving health outcomes for vulnerable patient populations.
Healthcare professionals spend much of every shift documenting care they have already delivered, manually and from memory, hours after the fact. That time competes directly with patient care, and the record it produces captures only a fraction of what actually happened in the room. Making that care visible gives healthcare professionals back their time at the bedside and shows care teams, for the first time, an accurate picture of the care being delivered. That picture lets healthcare leaders staff, train, and support their people on evidence rather than estimation.
Co-developed with a leading academic medical center, StealthCo is an ambient AI platform that transforms medical care. By deploying AI models that continuously monitor patients and care teams through existing hospital camera and sensor infrastructure, StealthCo delivers real-time protocol and actionable clinical decision support to healthcare professionals at the point of care.
We are seeking a hands-on computer vision architect and builder to join as CTO and Co-Founder and personally build the StealthCo platform from the ground up alongside the founding CEO. This is a builder role, not a research role. First-year output is a working pilot and a viable product — not papers, not a hiring plan, not a research agenda.
What You'll Own
Computer vision. Build detection and activity recognition that works on commercially available cameras in real clinical environments, whether a hospital already has them installed or is deploying them for the first time.
Data as the asset. Start from off-the-shelf models to move fast, then build a proprietary dataset that gets better over time. You own that pipeline end to end.
Annotation. Stand up the labeling operation and the quality bar behind it. Domain experts say what matters clinically. You decide what is reliably detectable.
Deployment. Help us architect the right distribution of technology, from cloud to on-premise. You have been through enterprise IT security review before.
Architecture. Own the technical design and set the boundaries between components so specialists can be brought in later without breaking it.
Lean resource management. You will build using an intelligent mix of your own hands-on work, AI agents, and targeted contractors — minimizing full-time headcount until revenue and milestones warrant it.
Future technical hiring. As StealthCo grows, you will help recruit and evaluate future engineering headcount growth.
Customer and investor presence. You will be in the room with the design partner's clinical and IT teams, at Seed investor pitches, and at future health system customer meetings. You need to hold substantive technical conversations across the table from a hospital IT leader or clinical informatics team and be taken seriously by them.

jobs.title: Head of Product Transformation
jobs.text:
About the Role
We are building the next generation of healthcare technology — an AI-native product organization that moves fast, operates with intention, and ships products that meaningfully improve care. The Head of Transformation is a senior operating role that sits at the center of that mission in product.
Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, you will serve as a force-multiplier for the CPO — translating vision into operating rhythm, building the connective tissue across product, design, engineering, and the business, and ensuring that the organization's most important bets get the attention, structure, and follow-through they deserve.
The right candidate is equally comfortable writing a strategy memo, facilitating a cross-functional alignment session, designing a planning process from scratch, and rolling up their sleeves to program management a strategic project.
A Day in the Life
CPO Leverage & Office of the CPO
Serve as the CPO's thought partner and operational deputy, preparing briefing materials, driving follow-through on key initiatives, and acting as a proxy in select forums.
Own the CPO's planning calendar: quarterly business reviews, product leadership offsites, board and executive updates, and annual planning cycles.
Distil complex, cross-functional inputs into crisp written recommendations, decision documents, and narratives for senior audiences.
Identify issues before they surface to the CPO — proactively resolving blockers, brokering alignment, and escalating only what truly requires executive attention.
Product Operations & Operating Rhythm
Design and stand up the product operating model for an AI-native organization — including portfolio prioritization, OKR processes, roadmap governance, and cross-functional rituals.
Build lightweight, high-signal reporting cadences that give the CPO and product leadership real-time visibility into progress, risks, and decisions.
Drive quarterly and annual planning: coordinating inputs from product, engineering, design, data science, and go-to-market teams into a coherent, executable plan.
Identify operational inefficiencies and eliminate them — the goal is a product organization that ships faster and with less friction, not more process.
Transformation & Strategic Initiatives
Lead high-priority transformation programs on behalf of the CPO — spanning organizational design, AI adoption, new capability builds, and cross-functional change management.
Act as a program manager for initiatives that cut across multiple teams and do not have a natural single owner.
Build the infrastructure for how the product organization makes and communicates decisions — from DACI frameworks to async-first working norms.
Partner with People, Finance, and Legal as needed to bring structure to people and resource decisions in the product org.
AI-Native Ways of Working
Help shape what it means to operate as an AI-native product organization — piloting new tools, workflows, and norms and socializing them across the team.
Build muscle around how the product organization consumes, generates, and acts on AI-driven insights.
Partner with product and design leadership to embed AI-first thinking into how we scope, prototype, and evaluate work.
What You Need
7–12+ years of experience in product management, strategy, management consulting, chief of staff, or business operations roles — ideally with meaningful time in a high-growth technology or healthcare technology company.
Track record of building from scratch. You have stood up new processes, teams, or functions and know how to earn buy-in without authority.
Familiarity with AI tooling and modern product operating models. You are curious and opinionated about how AI changes how teams work, and you have practical experience putting AI to use.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can write a crisp one-pager for the CEO and a detailed PRD spec in the same week. You tailor your message to the audience.
Strong product intuition. You do not need to be a product manager, but you need to speak the language fluently — roadmaps, trade-offs, customer insight, technical constraints.
Structured thinking under ambiguity. You can hold complexity, work through incomplete information, and still drive decisions forward.
Genuine comfort as an individual contributor. You are not waiting to manage people. You are energised by the idea of building something from the ground up and rolling up your sleeves.
High emotional intelligence and organisational savvy. You build trust quickly, navigate competing priorities with empathy, and know how to influence without creating friction.
We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.
Here’s What We Offer
Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.

Distil complex, cross-functional inputs into crisp written recommendations, decision documents, and narratives for senior audiences.
Identify issues before they surface to the CPO — proactively resolving blockers, brokering alignment, and escalating only what truly requires executive attention.

blocks.text: Product Operations & Operating Rhythm

items: Design and stand up the product operating model for an AI-native organization — including portfolio prioritization, OKR processes, roadmap governance, and cross-functional rituals.
Build lightweight, high-signal reporting cadences that give the CPO and product leadership real-time visibility into progress, risks, and decisions.
Drive quarterly and annual planning: coordinating inputs from product, engineering, design, data science, and go-to-market teams into a coherent, executable plan.
Identify operational inefficiencies and eliminate them — the goal is a product organization that ships faster and with less friction, not more process.

blocks.text: Transformation & Strategic Initiatives

items: Lead high-priority transformation programs on behalf of the CPO — spanning organizational design, AI adoption, new capability builds, and cross-functional change management.
Act as a program manager for initiatives that cut across multiple teams and do not have a natural single owner.
Build the infrastructure for how the product organization makes and communicates decisions — from DACI frameworks to async-first working norms.
Partner with People, Finance, and Legal as needed to bring structure to people and resource decisions in the product org.

blocks.text: AI-Native Ways of Working

items: Help shape what it means to operate as an AI-native product organization — piloting new tools, workflows, and norms and socializing them across the team.
Build muscle around how the product organization consumes, generates, and acts on AI-driven insights.
Partner with product and design leadership to embed AI-first thinking into how we scope, prototype, and evaluate work.

items: 7–12+ years of experience in product management, strategy, management consulting, chief of staff, or business operations roles — ideally with meaningful time in a high-growth technology or healthcare technology company.
Track record of building from scratch. You have stood up new processes, teams, or functions and know how to earn buy-in without authority.
Familiarity with AI tooling and modern product operating models. You are curious and opinionated about how AI changes how teams work, and you have practical experience putting AI to use.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can write a crisp one-pager for the CEO and a detailed PRD spec in the same week. You tailor your message to the audience.
Strong product intuition. You do not need to be a product manager, but you need to speak the language fluently — roadmaps, trade-offs, customer insight, technical constraints.
Structured thinking under ambiguity. You can hold complexity, work through incomplete information, and still drive decisions forward.

jobs.title: SVP, AI & Data
jobs.text:
SVP, AI & Data
Remote Opportunity
About Reveleer
Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value-based care. Trusted by 80+ customer organizations nationwide, the platform integrates data, analytics, and intelligent workflow automation into one governed system designed to support traceable documentation across diagnoses, quality measures, and submissions. With regulatory expertise and transparent, human-in-the-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence.
About the role
Reveleer is hiring an SVP, AI & Data to lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of the AI, machine learning, and data systems that power risk adjustment and quality programs across Medicare Advantage and value-based care. The role owns the platform that extracts ICD and HEDIS® information from medical charts, the data warehouse and business intelligence layers that surface that work, and the data science research that advances accuracy over time.
This is a working executive role. The SVP, AI & Data sets technical direction and architecture, partners with engineering and product leadership on delivery, and stays close enough to the systems to make sound build decisions — while giving team leaders the autonomy to own their domains. The position leads seven teams totaling roughly 27 engineers, data scientists, and analysts through their respective leaders.
What you will own
AI and machine learning for chart intelligence
Direct the engineering teams that extract medical codes and quality data from charts: retrospective risk extraction built on Textract OCR, Comprehend Medical, and Gemini; prospective risk extraction that runs PDF and CCDA charts through Gemini and a custom rules engine to surface candidate ICD codes; and quality and HEDIS extraction that applies large language models to chart content.
Own the internal API that returns extraction results to downstream engineering teams, including its contracts, accuracy, and reliability.
Guide the data science research program — a team including two PhDs and an MD — as it advances from model-based ICD extraction to a retrieval-augmented generation system on Gemini, and shepherd that research into production alongside the retrospective risk team.
Data warehouse and business intelligence
Set the architecture for the data warehouse on Azure Synapse and Microsoft Fabric, including ingestion from AWS SQL source databases.
Direct the business intelligence function that builds reporting in Looker on top of warehouse data, with quality assurance built into the delivery process.
Risk analytics
Oversee risk analytics expertise in determining Medicare Advantage value from coded medical charts, supporting a substantial share of the IVA business.
Core responsibilities
Technical strategy and architecture. Define the architecture for the AI, data, and analytics platform end to end, and make the build-versus-buy and model-selection decisions that shape it.
Innovation direction. Provide the guiding voice on innovation across all teams, evaluating new approaches in extraction, retrieval, and clinical AI while preserving each team’s autonomy to decide how to execute.
Delivery and reliability. Hold the teams accountable for accuracy, throughput, and uptime of the extraction of APIs and the data and reporting layers that depend on them.
Leadership and org development. Lead seven team leaders, grow technical talent, and redeploy team capacity toward higher-value clinical and research work as automation matures.
Cross-functional partnership. Work with product, engineering, and clinical leadership to align the AI and data roadmap with commercial and regulatory priorities.
Governance and compliance. Establish data governance, model evaluation, and privacy practices appropriate to protected health information and CMS-regulated programs.
What we are looking for
Required
A track record of leading AI and data organizations, with enough technical depth to evaluate architecture, model-selection, and build-versus-buy decisions made by the teams reporting in. Personally, building production systems is not required.
Deep experience with applied machine learning and large language models in production, including modern patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, OCR and document understanding, and clinical natural language processing.
Experience leading data warehouse and business intelligence functions, with working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable) and BI tools such as Looker.
Demonstrated leadership of multiple technical teams and their leaders, with a style that sets direction and architecture while granting autonomy on execution.
Working fluency in healthcare risk adjustment, medical coding (ICD), and quality measurement (HEDIS®), or the ability to reach it quickly.
Preferred
Direct experience with Medicare Advantage risk adjustment, IVA, or RADV audit workflows.
Familiarity with cloud AI services across providers, including Google Gemini, AWS Textract, and AWS Comprehend Medical.
Advanced degree in computer science, data science, biostatistics, or a clinical field, or equivalent applied experience.
How success is measured
Accuracy and coverage of code and quality extraction across retrospective, prospective, and HEDIS® workflows.
Reliability and adoption of the internal results API by downstream engineering teams.
Timeliness and trustworthiness of warehouse data and the reporting built on it.
Movement of data science research into production, measured by accuracy gains realized in live extraction.
Growth, retention, and autonomy of the team leaders and their teams.
WHAT YOU’LL RECEIVE:
• Competitive salary
• Medical, Dental and Vision benefits
• 401k with Employer Match
• Generous PTO plan
Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
Reveleer E-Verifies all new hires.
Reveleer is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.
Salary: $305,000 – $355,000 / year
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.text:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
About the Role
This level is for developing leaders who make significant contributions through deep expertise and strategic execution. It spans three related titles: Associate Director and Lead on the management path, and Principal on the senior individual-contributor path. Individuals here lead teams or operate as senior ICs, spearheading complex projects aligned to long-term objectives, providing input into strategy within their function, and beginning to carry account-economics accountability - workstream profitability, scope discipline, and growth signals - ahead of full P&L ownership at Director. On the individual-contributor path, Principal is the senior technical-authority apex of the practice - a peer in influence to the management titles - creating value through methodology leadership, productized IP, and delivery economics rather than through P&L ownership.
The work differs by team - Global Accounts, Content, Media-First, or Marketing/Web/CRM/Tech - but the standard is consistent: own complex, high-stakes work; influence outcomes across functions or client portfolios; and start to think and act like an owner of the relationship, not just the deliverable.
Responsibilities:
Complex Program & Engagement Leadership
Lead complex projects or programs end to end across one or more accounts - shaping the approach, orchestrating the team, and owning the outcome at a senior level.
Early Account Economics
Take first-line accountability for the economics of your workstreams - utilization, scope discipline, and margin within your remit - and partner with account leadership on planning and resourcing.
Strategic Input & Influence
Provide input into strategy within your function and influence outcomes across functions or client portfolios. Connect the analytics to the client’s broader business agenda.
Principal Track – Senior Expert
For the senior-IC path: serve as a senior expert and authority whose depth shapes the practice, leads the most demanding work, and sets methodological direction.
AD / Lead Track – Team Leadership
For the management path: lead a team, own delivery quality across multiple workstreams, develop talent, and manage performance within your remit.
Client Advisory & Growth Signals
Hold senior working relationships and at least one executive-adjacent relationship. Identify and qualify growth opportunities, and bring them to account leadership with a defined client need and rough scope.
AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation
Identify qualified AI use-cases, build early business cases, and integrate Monks.Flow and partner platforms into how the team delivers and how clients measure.
About You
The essentials:
7+ years in analytics, consulting, or strategic advisory across agency, holding company, or in-house at scale
Track record leading complex projects or programs, or recognized as a senior expert in domain
Emerging account-economics literacy - utilization, scope, margin within a remit
Demonstrated influence across functions or client portfolios
For the AD/Lead track: experience leading and developing teams
Credible senior client relationships and the ability to advise, not just deliver
Strong plus:
Quantified contribution to account growth or scope expansion
Recognized domain authority - frameworks, methods, or thought leadership
Experience integrating GenAI or agentic platforms with measurable outcomes
Shipped productized methodology or accelerator beyond a single account
Senior platform partnership experience (Google, Meta, Adobe, Amazon, or similar)
Cross-domain experience across more than one IMA practice area
At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.
Monks is committed to ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. We are committed to treating people with disabilities in a way that allows them to maintain their dignity and independence. We believe in integration, and we are committed to meeting the needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner. We will do so by removing and preventing barriers to accessibility and by meeting our accessibility requirements under local accessibility laws.
This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. If you reside within a commutable distance of one of our office locations, you will be expected to work from the office a set number of days per week. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.
Monks has provided a compensation range that represents its good faith estimate of what Monks may pay for the position at the time of posting. Monks may ultimately pay more or less than the posted compensation range. The salary offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on job-related factors, but not based on a candidate’s sex or any other protected status.
Salary Range
$140,000—$150,000 CAD
About Monks
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long-term impact.
Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025), runner-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024). Additionally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.
