jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!
A Little About Us
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
A Little About You
You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.
Position Overview
As the Director of Engineering, you will lead a high-performing global team of software engineers and engineering managers responsible for the S365 and SmartShopper applications. Reporting to the Senior Director of Product Engineering, you will play a key role in delivering scalable, high-quality solutions that power provider search, rate calculation, and member rewards.
You will oversee application engineering teams, partnering closely with Product to execute against a product-led modernization strategy. This role emphasizes strong execution, people leadership, and technical stewardship to enhance client and member experiences.
What You’ll Do:
Foster a collaborative, inclusive engineering culture that values diverse perspectives and continuous learning
Provide coaching and mentorship to managers and senior engineers, strengthening leadership depth and team effectiveness
Support organizational priorities through thoughtful talent planning, development, and retention strategies
Partner with leadership to reinforce a culture of accountability, transparency, and engagement
Engineering Strategy and Execution:
Translate enterprise and product strategy into clear engineering priorities, roadmaps, and deliverables
Partner closely with Product and Architecture to deliver scalable, customer-centric solutions
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices and technologies to improve speed, quality, and reliability
Ensure strong alignment across platform and service teams to deliver cohesive, integrated capabilities
Operational Excellence
Establish and maintain engineering standards, processes, and metrics to drive consistent, high-quality delivery
Optimize team performance through data-driven insights, continuous improvement, and effective resource allocation
Promote cross-functional collaboration to ensure seamless execution across Technology, Product, and business partners
Support operational rigor across global teams, ensuring effective delivery across time zones
What You’ll Bring to Zelis:
10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with 5+ years leading teams
Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred
Strong familiarity with technologies aligned to our stack (e.g., Ruby on Rails, C#, Angular, JavaScript, AWS, caching and persistence technologies)
Proven experience leading distributed teams and delivering complex, scalable systems
Demonstrated ability to drive execution of technical initiatives and support organizational change
Demonstrated understanding of cloud utilization and total cost of tech ownership
Proven track record with legacy app modernization and performance optimization
Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.
Location and Workplace Flexibility
Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies.
While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule.
Base Salary Range
$169,000.00 - $213,750.00
At Zelis we are committed to providing fair and equitable compensation packages. The base salary range allows us to make an offer that considers multiple individualized factors, including experience, education, qualifications, as well as job-related and industry-related knowledge and skills, etc. Base pay is just one part of our Total Rewards package, which may also include discretionary bonus plans, commissions, or other incentives depending on the role.
Zelis’ full-time associates are eligible for a highly competitive benefits package as well, which demonstrates our commitment to our employees’ health, well-being, and financial protection. The US-based benefits include a 401k plan with employer match, flexible paid time off, holidays, parental leaves, life and disability insurance, and health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the role. We believe in the value of diverse perspectives and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive workplace for all.
Accessibility Support
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require a reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email .
Disclaimer
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities, duties, and skills from time to time.

jobs.title: VP of Automation Engineering
jobs.text:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.
About the Company
Our client is an operator-led, AI-powered revenue systems company building next-generation go-to-market (GTM) infrastructure for scaling businesses. They design automation-first revenue engines that transform real-time market signals into predictable pipeline growth.
With a deeply AI-native stack—including workflow automation, LLM-powered systems, and custom-built internal products—they support companies scaling from $1M to $100M+ ARR. Engineering is not a support function here—it is the company’s competitive advantage.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary
We are hiring a VP of Automation Engineering to act as the foundational technical leader and strategic partner to the CEO. This is a hands-on executive role where you will architect and scale automation systems, build internal products, and lead a high-performing engineering team.
You will operate in an AI-first environment, where tools like Claude Code are part of daily development workflows—not optional add-ons.
Key Responsibilities
Automation Architecture & Infrastructure
Own and scale end-to-end automation systems using n8n and API integrations
Architect orchestration layers for complex, multi-client environments
Build resilient systems with monitoring, alerting, and self-healing capabilities
Integrate tools like Clay, CRMs, and outbound platforms into a unified infrastructure
Product Development
Build internal and client-facing products using Node.js, TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Own the full product lifecycle—from architecture to deployment
Develop scalable automation products and operational dashboards
Establish engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation
AI Systems & Intelligence Layer
Design and deploy production-grade AI/LLM systems (Claude, OpenAI, etc.)
Use Claude Code as a core development accelerator across the team
Build intelligent pipelines for classification, enrichment, and decision-making
Optimize prompt engineering, evaluation systems, and reliability at scale
Leadership & Technical Strategy
Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing engineering team
Define and execute the technical roadmap aligned with company growth
Partner directly with the CEO on product and engineering strategy
Lead sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery execution
Requirements
Non-Negotiable
Deep, production-level experience with n8n automation systems
Strong full-stack development skills (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, databases)
Proven experience leading engineers while remaining hands-on
Daily, hands-on use of Claude Code in development workflows
Strong working experience with Clay for data enrichment, signal detection, or GTM automation
Experience building and scaling AI/LLM systems in production
Strong systems architecture thinking (scalability, reliability, fault tolerance)
Executive-level mindset with the ability to align technical decisions with business outcomes
Preferred Experience
Agency or services background with multi-client automation systems
Experience building SaaS or productized internal tools
Familiarity with tools like Airtable, HubSpot, Slack APIs, and outbound infrastructure
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, etc.)
Benefits
💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams
🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services
🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network
🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement
💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director - Product Management
jobs.text:
The Company
Serving the People Who Serve the People
Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.
Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.
Want to know more? See more of what we do here.
Job Summary
We’re seeking a visionary and strategic Director of Product Management to lead a high-performing team in shaping the future of Granicus products. This is a unique opportunity for a seasoned product leader who is passionate about civic technology and its power to strengthen democracy, enhance citizen engagement, and increase government transparency.
You’ll be responsible for translating our long-term vision into actionable product strategies, mentoring a team of talented Product Managers, and driving innovation across our suite of solutions. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, implementation, support, customer success, and executive leadership to deliver products that delight users, drive measurable impact, and contribute to overall product success and profitability.
What Your Impact Will Look Like
Define and Drive Strategy: Translate Granicus’s 3–5 year vision into a clear, actionable product roadmap aligned with business goals, customer needs, and financial outcomes.
Lead and Inspire: Manage, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers, fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, continuous improvement, and effective use of AI in product discovery, delivery, and decision-making.
Own the Roadmap: Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, customer value, and technical feasibility. Make informed trade-offs to maximize ROI and product profitability.
Champion the User: Advocate for user-centric design and data-driven decision-making. Leverage analytics, customer feedback, and market research to guide product direction.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Engineering, Design, Implementation, Support, Customer Success, and Sales to ensure seamless product delivery and go-to-market execution.
Drive Operational Excellence: Establish and refine product management processes, tools, and best practices to scale product development effectively.
Be a Thought Leader: Represent Granicus externally and internally as a product evangelist, articulating our vision and value proposition to stakeholders and customers, and helping shape how AI can responsibly accelerate product strategy, execution, and customer impact.
You Will Love This Job If You Have
Experience: 5+ years in product management, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. Proven success managing and scaling product teams in an Agile environment.
Leadership: A servant-leader mindset with a track record of coaching and developing high-performing teams.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect the dots between market trends, customer needs, and business objectives to craft compelling product strategies.
Execution Excellence: Skilled at breaking down complex problems into clear, actionable plans. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities.
Communication: Exceptional communicator who can influence across all levels of the organization, from engineers to executives.
AI Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead AI adoption within product organizations, including coaching Product Managers to use AI tools effectively for research, prioritization, writing, experimentation, and team productivity.
Business Impact: Demonstrated ability to drive product success and profitability through strategic planning and execution.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Math) or equivalent experience. MBA is a plus.
Bonus: Experience working in a private equity-backed environment is a strong plus. Nice to have: experience in Agenda Management, Video Streaming, and Records Request markets for SaaS products.
Pay Range
USD $170,000.00 - USD $200,000.00 /Yr.
About Us
Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!
Security and Privacy Requirements
Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.
The Team
We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.
The Culture
At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.
A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.
Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employeepopulation
The Impact
We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.
The Benefits
At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:
Flexibility & Balance
Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life.
Company-Wide Wellbeing Days – Paid days off to unplug and focus on your mental health.
Work From Home Reimbursement – Support a productive home office environment.
Health & Wellness
Multiple Health Plan Options – Including a 100% employer-paid plan.
Employer HSA Contributions – When enrolled in a High-Deductible Health Plan.
Fitness Reimbursement Program – Stay active, your way.
On-Demand Mental Health Support – Access to Headspace and other wellness tools.
Family & Future
Paid Parental Leave – For both birthing and non-birthing parents.
Traditional & Roth 401(k) – With a generous company match.
Life & AD&D Insurance – 100% employer-paid coverage for peace of mind.
Growth & Recognition
Online Learning Platforms – Fuel your professional development.
Competitive Salary & Bonuses – Your contributions are valued and rewarded.
Equal Opportunity Employer
Granicus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.
Want to know more? See more of what we do here.
Job Summary

We’re seeking a visionary and strategic Director of Product Management to lead a high-performing team in shaping the future of Granicus products. This is a unique opportunity for a seasoned product leader who is passionate about civic technology and its power to strengthen democracy, enhance citizen engagement, and increase government transparency.

You’ll be responsible for translating our long-term vision into actionable product strategies, mentoring a team of talented Product Managers, and driving innovation across our suite of solutions. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, implementation, support, customer success, and executive leadership to deliver products that delight users, drive measurable impact, and contribute to overall product success and profitability.
What Your Impact Will Look Like

items: Define and Drive Strategy: Translate Granicus’s 3–5 year vision into a clear, actionable product roadmap aligned with business goals, customer needs, and financial outcomes.

Lead and Inspire: Manage, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers, fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, continuous improvement, and effective use of AI in product discovery, delivery, and decision-making.
Own the Roadmap: Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, customer value, and technical feasibility. Make informed trade-offs to maximize ROI and product profitability.
Champion the User: Advocate for user-centric design and data-driven decision-making. Leverage analytics, customer feedback, and market research to guide product direction.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Engineering, Design, Implementation, Support, Customer Success, and Sales to ensure seamless product delivery and go-to-market execution.
Drive Operational Excellence: Establish and refine product management processes, tools, and best practices to scale product development effectively.

Be a Thought Leader: Represent Granicus externally and internally as a product evangelist, articulating our vision and value proposition to stakeholders and customers, and helping shape how AI can responsibly accelerate product strategy, execution, and customer impact.

blocks.text: You Will Love This Job If You Have

items: Experience: 5+ years in product management, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. Proven success managing and scaling product teams in an Agile environment.
Leadership: A servant-leader mindset with a track record of coaching and developing high-performing teams.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect the dots between market trends, customer needs, and business objectives to craft compelling product strategies.
Execution Excellence: Skilled at breaking down complex problems into clear, actionable plans. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities.
Communication: Exceptional communicator who can influence across all levels of the organization, from engineers to executives.

AI Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead AI adoption within product organizations, including coaching Product Managers to use AI tools effectively for research, prioritization, writing, experimentation, and team productivity.
Business Impact: Demonstrated ability to drive product success and profitability through strategic planning and execution.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Math) or equivalent experience. MBA is a plus.
Bonus: Experience working in a private equity-backed environment is a strong plus. Nice to have: experience in Agenda Management, Video Streaming, and Records Request markets for SaaS products.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Remote-based in the US
Overview
GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.
Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.
GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.
Job Summary
GoodPower is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to own our end-to-end technology organization spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate/platform cybersecurity. Reporting directly to the CEO and partnering with executive leadership, this role provides comprehensive executive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer will report into this role.
Key Responsibilities
Internal IT Strategy & Enterprise Governance
Drive the overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for GoodPower’s core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget, driving cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner closely with executive leadership to bring new products from beta to market launch while managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Enterprise IT & Collaboration Architecture
Lead day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures, enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on, and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close partnership with other leaders ensuring high uptime and integration security.
Corporate Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance
Lead organization-wide information security initiatives across all corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit comprehensive enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness (e.g., SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries) across internal architectures in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Cross-Functional Alignment & Platform Boundaries
Partner closely with other leadership to turn high-level concepts and early-stage prototypes into operational reality. Evaluate alpha projects and PoCs built across departments and lead the execution to either seamlessly integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, highly scalable services.
Act as the primary advisor to staff, leadership, and the Board on technological capabilities, emerging enterprise risks, and digital transformation initiatives.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across all corporate SaaS applications.
Product, Engineering, and Data Oversight
Serve as the direct manager for the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), setting shared goals and ensuring alignment between product/engineering/data strategy and enterprise technology, infrastructure, and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Team Leadership & Operational Culture
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing, service-oriented IT and security team tailored to GoodPower's mission and growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for employees.
Qualifications
12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including as a Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or CTO.
Demonstrated experience running enterprise IT and IS stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, encompassing SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executives, and Board members.
Proven track record of building and leading technical staff across a wide range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through a period of organizational growth.
This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.
Compensation, Benefits, and Perks
Annual salary range: $220,000-$230,000, commensurate with experience
Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
2 weeks of US office closure
10 days of paid sick leave annually.
403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)
8 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of employment
8 weeks of paid parental leave
GoodPower offers competitive compensation and benefits packages to employees around the world. Because we operate in multiple countries, benefits will vary based on local laws, regulations, customary practices, and organizational policies applicable in each location.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Connected Experience
jobs.text:
Head of Product, Connected Experience
About Safeguard Global: We enable global expansion without the risk.
Safeguard Global has been at the forefront of global workforce enablement since we pioneered centralised global payments in 2008 and launched the employer of record (EOR) category globally in 2010. And we haven't stopped there.
Today, with our 500+ in-country HR experts, cutting-edge technology, and comprehensive solutions, we've helped over 2,000 organisations hire, recruit, pay, and manage employees in 170+ countries.
Because we created this category, we've learned that successful global expansion isn't driven by technology alone. It requires deep global expertise. We call this the marriage of expert and technology, human when it matters.
This means we have the people and the technology to ensure 100% compliance with local, regional, national, and international laws. Together, this ethos and our solutions portfolio allow businesses to scale up or down wherever, however, and whenever they want to expand, without the risk.
Overview of the role
We're looking for a Head of Product, Connected Experience to own the experiences shared across every application: things like home, user access, and knowledge, together with the integrations that connect us to the outside world. What makes them shared is that every application touches or relies on them.
The role is accountable for the experience, delivery, and outcome achievement across those shared surfaces, and for the standard other product teams build to wherever their work touches them, even though most of those teams sit outside your direct reporting line. You'll translate that target experience, combined with the product strategies set by the Directors of Product into a prioritised order of work; leading the product managers who deliver it and ensuring we deliver on business and customer experience objectives.
Several of our biggest growth opportunities for 2027 sit in this area.
What you will be responsible for
Shared surfaces and standards
Own the experience across the shared surfaces and services that sit between applications
Own the governance of shared components with the Lead Designer, so that changes to capability every team depends on are made deliberately and once
Own how external systems connect to the platform, through integrations
Own regulatory and compliance obligations as product requirements within your area, particularly where integrations, white labelling, and access to client data are concerned, working with legal and the in-country teams so that they are designed in rather than retrofitted
Prioritisation and roadmap
Translate the platform strategy and commercial priorities into a prioritised order of work for your area
Feed that prioritisation into the single prioritised roadmap owned by the SVP, Product
Recommend what is built, what is deferred, and what is retired within your area, and secure agreement with the SVP, Product and the Directors of Product
Build the case for significant investment, including the value expected, the payback, and the trade-off against the alternatives
Delivery
Hold accountability for delivery against commitment, on time and to the quality bar set in the definition of done
Work hand in hand with engineering and design leadership, from the earliest shaping of an idea through to release, so that trade-offs between client need, technical feasibility, and cost are made together
Work with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and legal so that what we build is understood, sellable, supportable, and compliant on the day it launches
Sequence work that other teams depend on so that shared capability lands ahead of the work requiring it
Identify conflicts between applications early, while there is still time to resolve them
Customer insight and product performance
Build the relationships, with clients, integration partners, and internal teams, that sustain a continuous understanding of customer and internal pain points, and of the opportunities they point to
Ground product decisions in client insight, usage data, and market evidence
Raise the standard of discovery and validation across your teams
Define the expected outcome for each investment and own the value delivered against it
Identify opportunities to cross-sell across the platform, drawing on usage and adoption data, and work with sales to act on them
Act as the product expert in senior client, prospect, and partner conversations, and represent the platform externally where it helps us win and keep clients
Team leadership
Line manage the product managers within your area
Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and address performance issues early
Work with each product manager to understand their individual development needs, and take a coaching approach to growing their capability
Drive AI adoption where it creates the best outcome, recognising that it serves some tasks well and others poorly, and help the product team keep pace with how the role of product is rapidly changing
What will give you an advantage
Eight or more years in product
A proven track record of driving growth and commercial outcomes from product teams, including through product led growth
Proven experience owning platform, integration, or API products in B2B SaaS, with external developers or partners as users
A record of setting and holding shared standards across teams outside your reporting line, whether a design system, a component library, or an integration pattern
Technical enough to hold your own in a conversation on integrations, data flows, and data products, without needing to be an engineer yourself
Experience of building products in a regulated environment, where compliance shapes what can be built
At least five years leading people, including globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones
Primary performance metrics
Delivery:commitments delivered on time and to quality
Business impact:value delivered against the outcomes committed at the point of investment
Experience:platform NPS
Adoption:how widely the shared surfaces are used across the platform
Baselines and annual targets are set with the SVP, Product at the start of each financial year.
Competencies
Strategic thinking:sets a direction for the shared platform that connects client need, market direction, and commercial goals
Systems thinking:designs each service around what matters most to the customer, and focuses only on the work that delivers value
Technical fluency:holds a credible conversation with engineering leadership on integration patterns, data, and access
Delivery leadership:maintains a predictability and quality bar across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck
Communication:strong written and verbal communicator at all levels of the organisation, from SLT to team
People development:understands what each individual needs and coaches them to grow
Influencing:gets other product teams to adopt standards for the shared surfaces, without formal authority over how they run their own area
Commercial judgement:determines what is worth building next, and evidences the case
Key personal attributes
Grit and determination:moves work forward despite obstacles, and does not give up easily
Curiosity:actively seeks out different points of view, customer needs, and the problems worth solving
A leader and a doer:operates strategically while staying close to the detail
Warm, open, honest, and fun to work with
We are hiring this position across multiple countries; compensation varies by hiring location. For target markets located within the European Union (EU), base salaries start from (Gross):
Spain: €100,000.00
Portugal: €95,000.00
Who we are and what we do:
Safeguard Global is…Global! We help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. ✈️
Our Global Benefits
👨‍💻 Autonomy & Flexibility (Work in Any Way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include school runs and gym breaks in your schedule all while maintaining a high standard of work.
🧑‍🍼 Bonding Leave: Enjoy paid leave to bond with your new family member.
🎁 2 Charitable Days: Contribute to causes you believe in.
🏆 Reward & Recognition Program: Be rewarded for your success and championing our values.
💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
🏢 Coworking Space: Need to meet with a client, utilize admin services or just get out of the house? We’ve got you covered with flexible workspace options based on location.
Why become a Guardian:
✈️ International Environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
⭐ Our Culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
📚 Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace.
Next Steps:
To express your interest, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time.
Welcome to the Future of Work!
At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

We're looking for a Head of Product, Connected Experience to own the experiences shared across every application: things like home, user access, and knowledge, together with the integrations that connect us to the outside world. What makes them shared is that every application touches or relies on them.

The role is accountable for the experience, delivery, and outcome achievement across those shared surfaces, and for the standard other product teams build to wherever their work touches them, even though most of those teams sit outside your direct reporting line. You'll translate that target experience, combined with the product strategies set by the Directors of Product into a prioritised order of work; leading the product managers who deliver it and ensuring we deliver on business and customer experience objectives.
Several of our biggest growth opportunities for 2027 sit in this area.
What you will be responsible for
Shared surfaces and standards
Own the experience across the shared surfaces and services that sit between applications
Own the governance of shared components with the Lead Designer, so that changes to capability every team depends on are made deliberately and once
Own how external systems connect to the platform, through integrations

Own regulatory and compliance obligations as product requirements within your area, particularly where integrations, white labelling, and access to client data are concerned, working with legal and the in-country teams so that they are designed in rather than retrofitted
Prioritisation and roadmap
Translate the platform strategy and commercial priorities into a prioritised order of work for your area
Feed that prioritisation into the single prioritised roadmap owned by the SVP, Product
Recommend what is built, what is deferred, and what is retired within your area, and secure agreement with the SVP, Product and the Directors of Product
Build the case for significant investment, including the value expected, the payback, and the trade-off against the alternatives
Delivery
Hold accountability for delivery against commitment, on time and to the quality bar set in the definition of done

Work hand in hand with engineering and design leadership, from the earliest shaping of an idea through to release, so that trade-offs between client need, technical feasibility, and cost are made together
Work with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and legal so that what we build is understood, sellable, supportable, and compliant on the day it launches
Sequence work that other teams depend on so that shared capability lands ahead of the work requiring it
Identify conflicts between applications early, while there is still time to resolve them
Customer insight and product performance
Build the relationships, with clients, integration partners, and internal teams, that sustain a continuous understanding of customer and internal pain points, and of the opportunities they point to
Ground product decisions in client insight, usage data, and market evidence
Raise the standard of discovery and validation across your teams
Define the expected outcome for each investment and own the value delivered against it
Identify opportunities to cross-sell across the platform, drawing on usage and adoption data, and work with sales to act on them
Act as the product expert in senior client, prospect, and partner conversations, and represent the platform externally where it helps us win and keep clients
Team leadership
Line manage the product managers within your area
Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and address performance issues early
Work with each product manager to understand their individual development needs, and take a coaching approach to growing their capability
Drive AI adoption where it creates the best outcome, recognising that it serves some tasks well and others poorly, and help the product team keep pace with how the role of product is rapidly changing
What will give you an advantage
Eight or more years in product
A proven track record of driving growth and commercial outcomes from product teams, including through product led growth
Proven experience owning platform, integration, or API products in B2B SaaS, with external developers or partners as users
A record of setting and holding shared standards across teams outside your reporting line, whether a design system, a component library, or an integration pattern
Technical enough to hold your own in a conversation on integrations, data flows, and data products, without needing to be an engineer yourself
Experience of building products in a regulated environment, where compliance shapes what can be built
At least five years leading people, including globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones
Primary performance metrics
Delivery:commitments delivered on time and to quality
Business impact:value delivered against the outcomes committed at the point of investment
Experience:platform NPS
Adoption:how widely the shared surfaces are used across the platform
Baselines and annual targets are set with the SVP, Product at the start of each financial year.
Competencies
Strategic thinking:sets a direction for the shared platform that connects client need, market direction, and commercial goals
Systems thinking:designs each service around what matters most to the customer, and focuses only on the work that delivers value
Technical fluency:holds a credible conversation with engineering leadership on integration patterns, data, and access
Delivery leadership:maintains a predictability and quality bar across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck
Communication:strong written and verbal communicator at all levels of the organisation, from SLT to team
People development:understands what each individual needs and coaches them to grow
Influencing:gets other product teams to adopt standards for the shared surfaces, without formal authority over how they run their own area
Commercial judgement:determines what is worth building next, and evidences the case
Key personal attributes
Grit and determination:moves work forward despite obstacles, and does not give up easily
Curiosity:actively seeks out different points of view, customer needs, and the problems worth solving
A leader and a doer:operates strategically while staying close to the detail
Warm, open, honest, and fun to work with
We are hiring this position across multiple countries; compensation varies by hiring location. For target markets located within the European Union (EU), base salaries start from (Gross):

jobs.title: Director Of Engineering - Platform Services
jobs.text:
About Truveta
Truveta is the world’s first health provider-led data platform, with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care.
Achieving this vision requires a talented and diverse team with expertise across healthcare, software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and artificial intelligence. We are looking for people who are motivated by purposeful work and committed to building technology that can improve healthcare outcomes.
This position is based in Hyderabad, India.
Who We Need
Truveta is expanding its engineering presence in India to solve complex healthcare and technology challenges at global scale. We are seeking a collaborative and experienced engineering leader who can operate effectively across ambiguity, scale, and evolving requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong software and infrastructure fundamentals with the ability to build high-performing teams, influence technical direction, and deliver reliable platforms. You should be comfortable balancing hands-on technical leadership with people management and working with distributed teams across India and the United States.
If you are motivated by purposeful work, enjoy building teams and platforms from the ground up, and want to shape how data, AI, and engineering systems are powered internally, Truveta may be the right fit for you.
This Opportunity
We are seeking a Director Of Engineering (POD Lead) to lead the Platform Services team in India.
The Platform Services team will build, manage, and operate the infrastructure that supports engineering teams across India and globally. The team will also own critical backend and platform services, including authentication, authorization, customer and consumer identity and access management, CI/CD, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, developer productivity tools, observability, and shared engineering services.
These services form the backbone of Truveta’s engineering platform and have dependencies across multiple Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Product, and Security teams.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role with people-management responsibilities. You will be accountable for technical direction, delivery excellence, platform reliability, and team growth. You will work closely with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams in India and the United States.
What You’ll Do
Technical and Platform Leadership
Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Platform Services and internal engineering platforms.
Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure and backend services.
Guide architecture decisions across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, identity, security, developer tooling, and shared services.
Build and operate platforms that support engineering, data, machine learning, annotation, and internal workflow requirements.
Lead the development and management of Kubernetes-based platforms and cloud-native services.
Build and improve authentication, authorization, identity management, and access control services.
Drive the development of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, infrastructure-as-code, and developer self-service capabilities.
Establish engineering standards for system design, API development, testing, code quality, observability, and operational readiness.
Improve platform availability, scalability, performance, security, disaster recovery, and operational efficiency.
Provide hands-on technical guidance through design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, production-readiness reviews, and incident responses.
Balance near-term delivery commitments with long-term platform scalability, maintainability, and technical health.
Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce operational overhead, and improve engineering productivity.
Product and Delivery Leadership
Partner with Product, Technical Program Management, Data, Machine Learning, Security, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and define priorities.
Translate business and engineering needs into clear technical strategies, milestones, and delivery plans.
Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery across multiple platform initiatives.
Manage cross-team dependencies and proactively address execution risks.
Define and track success metrics related to platform adoption, reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity.
Communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and technical decisions to stakeholders and senior leadership.
POD and People Leadership
Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team in India.
Provide technical direction, coaching, and support to engineers at different career levels.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
Establish effective processes for planning, execution, prioritization, and retrospective learning.
Encourage engineers to take ownership of services throughout their lifecycle, from design and development through production operations.
Create an inclusive environment where team members can contribute, learn, and grow.
Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration
Work closely with engineering teams across India and the United States to develop shared platforms and services.
Partner effectively with U.S.-based stakeholders across time zones.
Represent the India Platform Services team in architecture, planning, and organizational forums.
Serve as a key technical voice in discussions about platform strategy, engineering effectiveness, and future growth.
Build strong relationships with internal customers and ensure that platform services meet the needs of the broader organization.
Key Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
3+ years of experience in technical leadership, engineering management, or people management.
Experience leading engineering teams responsible for shared platforms, infrastructure, backend services, or developer tooling.
Strong experience designing and building distributed systems and production-grade backend services.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and cloud-native technologies.
Strong understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, service discovery, and infrastructure operations.
Experience building engineering infrastructure, internal platforms, workflow-heavy systems, or developer productivity tools.
Experience with authentication, authorization, identity management, or security-focused backend services.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Go, Python, or similar.
Experience with modern API architectures, microservices, event-driven systems, and service integration patterns.
Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence.
Familiarity with open-source technologies and the ability to evaluate and adopt open-source solutions.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices and Agile delivery methods.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, clinical data, or other highly regulated domains.
Experience building platforms that support data engineering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or annotation workflows.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or other major cloud platforms.
Experience with identity and access management technologies and protocols such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
Experience with service mesh, API gateways, secrets management, policy enforcement, and zero-trust security models.
Experience defining service-level objectives, reliability standards, and platform maturity models.
Experience leading teams through significant organizational or platform growth.
Experience working with globally distributed engineering organizations.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, cost management, and optimization.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture & Technology
jobs.text:
Provides strategic leadership for enterprise architecture and technology governance across the organization. Establishes architecture direction, standards, and governance practices that enable technology investments, support business priorities, and manage enterprise risk. Partners with senior technology and business leaders to drive alignment, modernization, and long-term technology strategy while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence.
Lead and drive the development and evolution of enterprise architecture strategy, principles, standards, and governance practices in partnership with technology executives and broader architect team.
Provide guidance and recommendations that align technology decisions with business objectives, risk tolerance, operational needs, and long-term strategy.
Establish and maintain architecture governance processes to support consistent, scalable, and effective technology decision-making.
Partner with executive and technology leaders to evaluate priorities, recommend technology direction, and support enterprise transformation initiatives.
Facilitate collaboration across architecture, engineering, security, data, infrastructure, cloud, and pillar architects to ensure alignment and integration of technology solutions.
Assess enterprise technology roadmaps and identify opportunities to improve business value, reduce risk, enhance capabilities, and optimize enterprise investments.
Provide leadership and oversight for transition and target architecture roadmaps which include modernization efforts to meet business outcomes and goals.
Develop architecture talent, build organizational capabilities, and foster high-performing teams and collaborative communities of practice.
Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends to inform strategic technology planning and innovation opportunities.
Communicate architecture vision, priorities, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
Job Specifications
Typically has the following skills or abilities:
Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent experience; Minimum of 3 additional years of experience related to functional area
Minimum of 6 years of management experience with responsibilities for hiring, training, assigning work and managing performance of direct reports
In depth technology knowledge for functional area and ability to define and mature enterprise architecture strategy, standards, priciples, policies, guardrails, reference architectures, and target state direction
Ability to aggregate business-unit and domain technology plans, assess enterprise alignment, identify overlaps and gaps, and develop architecture-informed recommendations
Working knowledge across integration, data, infrastructure, cloud, AI, security, and custom application architecture
Ability to balance enterprise guardrails with delivery speed, business priorities, innovation, and practical implementation realities
Enterprise architecture strategy, standards development, roadmap synthesis, etc.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Excellent business and leadership skills
Ability to lead and effectively collaborate at the enterprise level
Ability to regularly exercise discretion and independent judgment in the performance of job duties
Continuous improvement through metrics and feedback
For roles that are remote (i.e., Work From Home (WFM)) or hybrid (i.e., partial onsite at a VSP location and WFM), must demonstrate a high level of engagement in virtual environments, including maintaining camera presence during meetings to support effective communication and team alignment
Working Conditions
The working environment is generally favorable lighting and temperature is adequate, and there are no hazardous or unpleasant conditions caused by noise, dust etc.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering & Operations
jobs.text:
At Tatum, we're looking for a Head of Engineering & Operations – a hands-on leader who likes working closely with engineers and helping them do good work. At its core, the job is about people: supporting the team, removing the blockers in their way, keeping priorities clear, and making sure what we ship is reliable and useful to our customers.
The role spans a few areas – infrastructure, engineering, blockchain operations, and quality management. It's broad, and you'll be close to the work rather than managing from a distance: you'll be leading engineers directly and shaping how it all fits together.
At Tatum, we value ownership, flexibility, respect, and practical execution. We work in a fast-paced blockchain environment with flat hierarchies, informal communication, and a strong focus on individual contribution and autonomy.
What we need help with
Leading the team
Run team planning, prioritization, estimates, backlog, and delivery.
Support people management, coordination, and day-to-day operational decisions.
Improve collaboration across Product, Engineering, Support, and Security.
Infrastructure & platform
Own infrastructure reliability, observability, monitoring, and on-call.
Find and fix reliability, performance, and operational issues before they reach customers.
Research, integrate, and operate blockchain networks in the Tatum ecosystem.
Support work on Tatum's Dashboard, API platform, backend services, and internal tools.
Handle production operations, debugging, and incident resolution.
Standards & quality
Set technical standards and improve documentation and engineering processes.
Define and improve quality and release quality.
Cost & commercial
Keep an eye on infrastructure and vendor costs, and their impact on COGS and margins.
Assess technical feasibility and cost impact for new deals, trials, and commitments.
Guide vendor decisions – reliability, SLAs, pricing, and operational fit.
Our technology stack
Cloud & infrastructure: GCP, OVH
Ops & CI/CD: Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform
Frontend: TypeScript, React.js, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Node.js, Nest.js
Data: MongoDB, Firestore, Redis
Messaging: RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub
Blockchain: 200+ blockchain networks
Observability & on-call: Grafana, BetterStack
Code quality & security: Snyk, SonarCloud
Cooperation: ClickUp, Notion

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, EV/BESS
jobs.text:
About Us
Highland Electric Fleets’ mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all, enabling communities to realize the benefits of cleaner, quieter and healthier fleets. Highland is North America’s leading provider of Electrification-as-a-Service (EaaS). Founded in 2019, Highland partners with school districts, municipalities, and fleet operators to make the transition to electric fleets simple and affordable.
Highland proudly serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. From pioneering vehicle-to-grid technology to managing some of the nation’s largest electric school bus fleets, Highland delivers reliable, cost-effective solutions that support local communities and drive the future of transportation.
Role Summary
The Director of Engineering leads Highland's engineering and design team — drafting, project engineering, and utility interconnection — that supports a fast-moving portfolio of EV charging, battery energy storage (BESS), and edge compute sites from qualified sites through construction-ready.
This leader owns the engineering standards, the design package content and quality gates, and the throughput of the entire function, and partners with Project Development to deliver build-ready sites at portfolio scale and on an aggressive timeline.
Reporting to the Vice President, Development & Construction, the Director builds and leads a team of internal and external engineering resources. The Director serves as Highland's senior technical authority on utility and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements, owns the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget, and builds the standards, playbooks, and tooling that make design faster, more repeatable, and more cost-effective.
This position is remote with an expectation of approximately 10-15% travel.
Responsibilities Overview:
Lead and scale Highland's project engineering function — drafting, design engineering, and utility interconnection — with end-to-end accountability for taking a large portfolio of EV charging, BESS, and edge compute sites from qualified site to permit-ready and construction-ready.
Own the engineering function's throughput and quality: define the design package content and the internal approval gates for every stage — conceptual, 30%, Issued-for-Permit (IFP), and Issued for Construction (IFC) — and keep packages moving on an aggressive, portfolio-wide timeline.
Build, develop, and retain a high-performing team of internal engineering resources
Own Highland's external engineering-partner strategy — select, contract, scale, and manage the performance of engineering design and interconnection consultants so that internal and external capacity flex with portfolio volume.
Set and enforce Highland's engineering, CAD, and design specifications and standards, and own the repositories of utility and AHJ requirements that make design compliant, consistent, and repeatable across the portfolio.
Serve as Highland's senior technical authority on utility interconnection and AHJ permitting across EV charging, BESS, and edge compute; resolve the most complex technical and jurisdictional issues and represent Highland's engineering position externally.
Own the engineering inputs to project schedule and budget — sequence and resource design, interconnection, and permitting milestones so each site is build-ready when construction needs it, and contribute to Highland's repeatable unit-cost installation model.
Partner cross-functionally with Development, Execution, Origination, Procurement, and Fleet Operations to align engineering with portfolio priorities and continuously improve the site-to-energized process.
Drive continuous improvement through tooling and process automation (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, template- and data-driven design) to increase design velocity and improve unit economics as the portfolio scales.
Provide engineering leadership on technical due diligence, estimating, and risk for new opportunities, supporting Origination and Development on feasibility, buildability, and cost.
Qualifications:
Required
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related engineering discipline, or 12+ years of directly related professional experience.
10+ years of progressive engineering experience in EV charging, renewable energy, power/electrical infrastructure, or utility-scale development, including design management from concept through construction.
5+ years leading engineering teams, including managing managers and building or scaling a design organization.
Demonstrated ownership of engineering standards, design package content, and QA/QC across a portfolio of concurrent projects.
Proven experience selecting, contracting, and managing external engineering consultants at scale.
Deep working knowledge of utility interconnection, new electrical service, and AHJ permitting requirements.
Familiarity with interconnection standards and processes (e.g., IEEE 1547, utility tariffs, and interconnection rules).
Expertise with CAD-based design delivery (AutoCAD) and design/review tooling (Procore, Bluebeam).
Preferred
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Experience delivering EV charging infrastructure, BESS, and/or edge compute / data-center power projects.
Experience building repeatable, unit-cost-driven design programs in a high-growth environment.
Master's degree in engineering or an MBA.
What You Can Expect from Highland:
Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus program
A supportive, highly collaborative, team-oriented environment
Ability to work with bright, innovative, and forward-thinking colleagues
Health, Vision, and Dental coverage for employees & their dependents
Generous Paid Time Off
401(k) program and company match
Highland Electric Fleets provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Highland Electric Fleets complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.text:
Sunday
Director of Engineering
Full-time · Reports to CEO/Leadership Team · Boulder, CO or Remote
About the Role
Sunday is looking for a Director of Engineering to lead and elevate a talented, close-knit engineering team through a pivotal moment. We're building something novel in the lawn care category, not reinventing an existing category, and our engineers are energized by that focus. This role exists to protect and grow that momentum: setting technical vision, building org-level capability, and bringing in an AI focus.
This is a hands-on leadership role with real strategic ownership. You'll need to be credible in the weeds, able to understand what's happening in the codebase and the business, while also sitting close to company leadership, translating company vision into an engineering roadmap, and making the structural calls the team doesn't have bandwidth to make themselves.
Above all, we need a builder. Someone who gets genuinely excited about writing code and shipping products, not solely a people manager. You'll rally the team by being in it with them, and you'll partner directly with Product as a true collaborator, not an order-taker: we need someone who understands how product and engineering decisions shape each other.
Vision & Strategy
Develop a technical vision for engineering that ties directly to Sunday's business goals, and translate it into a 6–12 month roadmap built with Product and the Leadership Team
Build and own Sunday's AI strategy for engineering, establish a consistent approach to AI-assisted and agentic development, and use it to help the team move faster and fail faster
Serve as the connective layer between business/product priorities and the engineering team
AI-Native Product Direction
Push Sunday toward becoming a genuinely AI-native product company, not a deterministic product with a chatbot bolted on, but one where core functionality is LLM-driven where it makes sense
Bring real excitement and a point of view about this shift, and get the team energized about building toward it together
Support early agent-based project work and help set a broader, more consistent direction for how the team builds and evaluates agentic systems
Establish evaluation practices (evals) for AI-driven functionality; fluency with eval tooling (e.g., Braintrust, Langfuse, or similar) is a strong plus, since non-deterministic, LLM-driven logic can't be tested the way traditional deterministic code is
Technical Maturity & Architecture
Bring maturity to foundational infrastructure and architecture decisions
Identify and invest in the technical decisions that save the team time now, rather than accumulating further shortcuts
Bring a builder's mindset to this work personally; this isn't a hands-off architecture review function; it's active, credible participation in solving it
Org Building & Talent
Own hiring strategy and interview process for both ICs and future managers, partnering closely with the People team; instill and maintain a high hiring bar
Prevent single points of failure, put institutional knowledge, documentation, and cross-training in place
Give engineers real paths to grow, including mentorship, stretch opportunities, and regular, honest development feedback
Execution & Delivery
Hold the team accountable to its own goals; regularly evaluate team structure and workflow to keep the org moving quickly
Codify and disseminate engineering best practices, testing, code review, PR norms, and how those practices scale as AI-assisted development increases velocity, so speed doesn't outpace quality
Own engineering metrics — delivery against roadmap, quality/bug backlog, system performance and uptime, and team velocity, and use them to surface bottlenecks to leadership
Deliver honest, frequent, and respectful feedback, and build a culture where the team gives and receives it the same way
Cross-Functional Leadership & Product Partnership
Represent engineering as part of company leadership, communicate plans, tradeoffs, and challenges to other functional heads in terms the whole business can act on
Act as a true product partner given how much of Sunday's product is (and will increasingly be) LLM-driven; engineering and product decisions are directly intertwined, not sequential handoffs
Understand how product thinks, and bring engineering's perspective into product conversations early — this is a collaboration, not a request queue
What Success Looks Like
The team feels led, not managed, with clear priorities, cleared blockers, and visible follow-through
Strong opinions, held loosely: you set direction but trust engineers to own execution
The team has real conviction that engineering is heading in the right direction
A working AI strategy the whole team is aligned on, with visible gains in velocity and quality
What You Bring
Proven experience leading engineering at a small-to-mid-size or growth-stage company, with a track record of taking on increasing scope
A genuine builder, you want to be hands-on writing code and shaping product, not solely managing people and process
Strong individual technical credibility — you can go deep enough to earn trust with senior engineers, not just manage from a distance
Direct experience with, or strong enthusiasm for, AI-native product development — building products where core functionality is LLM-driven rather than deterministic, not just adding an AI chat feature to an existing product
Familiarity with LLM evaluation practices and tooling (Braintrust, Langfuse, or similar), given the shift toward non-deterministic, AI-driven functionality
Front-end depth, or demonstrated ability to grow it across a team
Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows, and a clear point of view on how to scale them responsibly
A naturally curious, learning-oriented mindset, hungry to keep growing and to bring the team along with you
Experience building org structure, hiring processes, and team practices from a lighter-weight or informal state
A true product-collaboration mindset: understands how product and engineering decisions shape each other, and doesn't need — or want — a roadmap simply handed to them
A business-minded, collaborative style, comfortable building relationships across the whole company, not just within engineering
Humility and directness, able to talk openly about mistakes and how they were resolved, and to give feedback as a gift
A communicator who can move fluidly between technical depth and company-wide clarity
A Note on Team Culture
Sunday's engineering team values being in the weeds together, moving quickly, and staying focused on one clear, differentiated product direction. We're looking for a leader who amplifies that — someone the team describes the way they describe their best examples of leadership: present, communicative, and unafraid to tackle the hard stuff directly.
As a company rooted in nature, we deeply understand the benefits of diversity. We work to build a culture that attracts a diverse mix of talented people to help us bring lawn care out of the dark ages. We are committed to building a diverse, vibrant team that brings determination and passion to our work everyday.
Originally posted on Himalayas
