blocks.text: Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Director of Development Engineering to join our team.
Position Description

The Director of Development Engineering oversees all civil, site, and nuclear engineering activities required to advance Aurora powerhouse sites through development and into construction readiness. Your team produces the technical deliverables — site layouts, basis-of-design packages, geotechnical and environmental assessments, and engineering inputs to permitting — that underpin state/local approvals and NRC licensing (coordinated with Oklo's Environmental & Permitting team), project financing, and construction handoff. Environmental & Permitting and Project Finance are coordinated with Oklo's dedicated teams.
Specific responsibilities may include:

items: Lead development engineering across all active sites: site layout, civil/grading design, geotechnical investigation, hydrology, and infrastructure planning
Solutions engineering for potential co-located buildings such as advanced manufacturing and data centers
Produce basis-of-design documentation sufficient for project finance due diligence and EPC handoff
Manage third-party engineering consultants and coordinate with Oklo's internal nuclear design team
Provide engineering inputs to NRC licensing and NEPA processes coordinated by Oklo's Environmental & Permitting team
Develop and maintain engineering standards, templates, and quality protocols for the Development organization

Partner with Oklo’s New Product Integration (NPI) team to translate reactor design requirements, siting criteria, and product evolution into site-specific technical constraints and development scope — ensuring early alignment between product design and site realities

Develop and own site constraints packages for each Aurora powerhouse development site, synthesizing geotechnical, hydrological, environmental, grid, and regulatory inputs into a single authoritative technical baseline that governs site selection, design, and permitting decisions

Integrate and quality-control deliverables from civil, geotechnical, environmental, and nuclear engineering consultants — ensuring all third-party work products are consistent, current, and accurately reflected in the site constraints package and project schedule

Own the development engineering schedule and provide cross-functional technical leadership to identify, prioritize, and mitigate technical risks and fatal flaws on project sites — coordinating with Project Development, Transmission & Interconnection, and Oklo’s Environmental & Permitting team to surface issues early and preserve development optionality

Lead structured technical risk reviews at each stage gate, evaluating site constraints packages against go/no-go criteria and escalating unresolved fatal flaw risks to the VP of Development with clear options analysis and recommended disposition
Build and manage a team of engineers across civil/site/electrical and nuclear development disciplines
Provide engineering support for Isotope production facilities, including facility layout, utility infrastructure design, and integration with co-located Aurora powerhouse systems
Lead development engineering for Nuclear Lifecycle Innovation Campuses (NLICs), coordinating multi-use site design across power generation, isotope production, and research facility components

blocks.text: Minimum Qualifications:

items: 12+ years in energy, infrastructure, advanced manufacturing or data center project development engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
Strong civil/site engineering background; nuclear project experience highly valued
Experience producing engineering deliverables for project financing and EPC handoff
PE license strongly preferred; experience with DOE or NRC-regulated facilities a significant advantage

Passionate about making advanced fission a reality

Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

jobs.title: Sr Director, Product Management - Capital One Shopping - Growth (Remote-Eligible
jobs.text:
Sr Director, Product Management - Capital One Shopping - Growth (Remote-Eligible)
About Capital One Shopping
Capital One Shopping is an industry-leading consumer technology business that is changing the way people buy and save online. The team operates with extreme focus to accelerate growth of the Shopping business, find best-in-market savings for shoppers, and create unique value for our merchant partners.
Technology and a lean/rapid test-and-learn methodology are applied to nearly all of our business challenges. The team has a flat organizational structure that emphasizes clear ownership, small teams, and leverage through technology.
We are looking for a Sr. Product Director to join our team to improve and integrate new product and revenue opportunities with our merchant partners, and drive cross-functional execution within Shopping.This Product Director will have a demonstrated interest and aptitude for AI. While formal on-the-job experience with AI is a plus, we highly value candidates who have proactively incorporated AI into their personal projects, explored AI-driven development environments (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), or built automations using AI agents. Show us how you've used AI to learn, build, and solve complex and data-intensive problems independently.
Role Description:
In this role, you will be a key driver of business growth - owning all aspects of the team, technology, and tooling that onboards and activates merchant relationships across Shopping’s suite of product experiences:
Work directly with engineering in an individual contributor and cross-functional leadership capacity to design and build optimized consumer incentive and reward experiences
Manage the day-to-day operations and engineering execution of directly owned and supporting teams to iteratively launch and test new experiences
Operate with a high degree of autonomy, exhibiting data and market backed judgment from ideation through to launch
Own the business case, prioritization, and monitoring for the product experiences under your purview, building a suite of operational reports and models using SQL, Excel, and financial modeling to drive optimal investment decisions
Who We’re Looking For:
The ideal candidate is a high-leverage, data-driven product leader who combines startup grit with the technical depth and product intuition to build products that deliver world-class results.
Competitive and Ambitious Mindset: You are a self-driven performer who aims to be among the best in the world at what you do. You independently and continuously seek to grow and improve and want to be around others who are similarly driven. You observe and study other best-in-class companies and people and have a well-formed opinion about what makes them great.
Quantitatively Rigorous and Results Focused: You measure your success by the impact you drive, not the output. You possess exceptional data and SQL skills and are recognized as one of the strongest business analysts in your company. You make rigorous, data-backed decisions and do not need others to acquire insights from data. You monitor and model results of your experiences, prioritizing all effort based on the highest expected return. You are comfortable “making the call” because you’ve personally examined the data and evaluated all important considerations.
Unnatural Focus, Intensity, and Speed: You operate with a level of leverage and speed that most competent people believe is impossible. By focusing exclusively on the primary drivers of value, mastering the "art of saying no," you lead teams toward 10x and 100x outcomes rather than incremental gains.
Performant Design and Iterative Development: You are a student of performant user experience design, driven by a deep understanding of user psychology and product testing experience. You likely have a library of "good and bad" product examples saved as screenshots and use this to drive engagement and conversion excellence. You observe and take note of areas of opportunity every time you personally install a new app or digital service. You have a strong preference to rapidly AB test experiences and observe real results vs. debate what the “perfect design” is.
Technical Curiosity and Depth: You have a passion for technology and seek every opportunity to understand all of the pieces that power your experiences. You are likely building with AI in your spare time and prefer working as “one team” with engineering in a lean, fluid environment rather than through rigid planning processes. Engineering teams are used to hearing you ask “Can you walk me through how this would work?” as you evaluate whether our technical approaches are as simple and elegant as possible.
Lean, High Ownership Execution: You have a bias for action and value working in a flat, lean, startup-like organization structure where you will roll up your sleeves to solve problems with firsthand knowledge on a daily basis. If there is an important job to be done you’re the first to lean in and help drive it to completion no matter what the task is.
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 7 years of Product Management experience
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field) or Computer Science or Engineering
At least 5 years of experience in a high growth/startup technology environment
At least 5 years experience working with SQL
At least 5 years of business analysis experience
At least 8 years of experience working directly with software engineering departments to build tooling and processes to support and scale new product experiences
Demonstrated application of AI to build digital products
Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer-facing digital products
At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.
The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.
McLean, VA: $269,600 - $307,700 for Sr. Dir, Product ManagementNew York, NY: $294,100 - $335,700 for Sr. Dir, Product ManagementRemote (Regardless of Location): $245,100 - $279,800 for Sr. Dir, Product Management
Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.
This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.
Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at theCapital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.
This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.
If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at . All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.
For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to
Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.
Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).

jobs.title: VP, Data Operations & Governance (f/m/x)
jobs.text:
CEPRESis the leading and fastest growing digital investmentplatform for private capital markets, an institutional asset class which becamevery relevant in global investment portfolios of sovereign wealth fund,insurances, pension plans and others. This global institutional client basebenefit from our award-winning investment solutions for their investmentactivities while we connect via the CEPRES platform thousands of professionalsto the largest private investment network worldwide.
CEPRESGmbH / Corp is headquartered in Munich and New York,with additional offices in Denver, Heidelberg, and several locations in middleeast. Our team is incredibly diverse with over 20 nationalities globally. Wevalue smart and innovative people who also work effectively in a teamenvironment and who are global players.
Role Overview
The VP, Data Operations &Governance is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing theend-to-end lifecycle of investment data across the CEPRES Platform. This roleleads global data operations and analyst teams, driving the collection,processing, validation, and delivery of high-quality investment data whilecontinuously improving efficiency, scalability, and accuracy.
The VP will focus on optimizingdata operations to meet evolving client and business requirements, ensuringprocesses, workflows, and data delivery capabilities support a high-qualityclient experience. This includes establishing KPIs and SLAs to maintainconsistent quality, productivity, turnaround times, and service performanceacross global operations.
The role is also responsible forbuilding and developing a high-performing global organization, fosteringaccountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Byleveraging process improvements, automation, and scalable operating models, theVP will drive operational effectiveness while ensuring CEPRES can supportincreasing client demands and business growth.
Working closely with Product,Engineering, Commercial teams, and senior leadership, the VP will act as a keybridge between client needs and data operations, translating clientrequirements into scalable operational solutions and data delivery enhancementswhile ensuring the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and service.
Experience with privatemarkets or financial data is strongly preferred.
Key Responsibilities
Data Operations & Quality
Lead anddevelop a high-performing global data management organization, including dataanalysts and operations specialists, ensuring the capabilities, processes, andaccountability needed to deliver high-quality financial data and operationalexcellence.
Driveoperational performance by managing KPIs and SLAs that support clientrequirements, data quality standards, delivery timelines, and overall serviceexcellence.
Lead thealignment and standardization of operational reporting, KPI definitions, andperformance measures across the data organization, ensuring consistentperformance tracking and continuous process improvement.
Establishscalable processes and tools that ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness,and timeliness across all datasets.
Optimize datamanagement processes from end-to-end within the data value flow to increaseefficiency and reduce cost.
Create aculture of continuous improvement, using KPIs, and automation to optimizeworkflows and elevate data quality.
Drive adoptionof documentation, standardization, and best practices across the data analystfunction.
Ensure fullcompliance with data governance, privacy, and security frameworks
Build and runKPI driven data flow and quality measurement systems that optimizesproductivity serving as a basis for senior management reporting.
Developcapacity and workforceplans aligned with business demand, ensuring the right organizationalstructure, skills, and resources are in place to support growth.
Ensuresuccessful execution of contractual commitments by overseeing service deliveryperformance, monitoring compliance with agreed SLAs and obligations, andproactively addressing risks to client satisfaction and business outcomes.
Technology and AI
Drive adoptionof emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI tools, to improve dataquality, automation, and decision-making capabilities.
Partner with tech,product, and business leadership to prioritize data initiatives and ensuretimely, high-quality delivery.
Establish andenforce data governance, quality, and security standards across all systems andteams.
Governance, Quality &Compliance
Driveinitiatives to measure and improve data quality, consistency, andcompleteness.

jobs.title: Head of Clinical Data Innovation (Remote, IT)
jobs.text:
About us
Chiesi is an international research-focused biopharmaceutical group with 90 years’ experience, operating in more than 30 countries, with its Headquarter in Parma, Italy. More than 8,000 employees across the group are united by a singular purpose: promoting a healthier world for our people, patients, and the planet. This is what drives us as we research, develop, and market innovative drugs across our main therapeutic areas. Discover more here.
At Chiesi we are thinking generations ahead, driving sustainable innovation with purpose. This fosters a culture of reliability, transparency, and ethical behaviour at every level. As a Benefit Corporation and a certified B Corp, we have embedded sustainability in our bylaws and continuously measure our impact.
Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of who we are. We believe our differences make us stronger. We are a vibrant ecosystem of passionate, talented individuals united by strong values, each bringing unique perspectives that help us to continuously challenge the status quo for the better.
Chiesi Global Rare Diseases
Chiesi Global Rare Diseases is a Chiesi Group’s business unit established in February 2020 and focused on research, development and commercialization of treatments and patient support services for rare and ultra-rare disorders, many of whom have limited or no treatments available.
This unit is based in Boston, Massachusetts, with a strong synergy with the headquarters in Parma.
Rare unit has a focus on research and product development for lysosomal storage diseases, rare hematology, ophthalmology disorders and rare immunodeficiencies. The unit is also a dedicated partner with global leaders in scientific research, patient advocacy and care. Discover more here.
What we are looking for
This is what you will do
The Head of Clinical Data Innovation is responsible for defining and executing the clinical data innovation strategy across the Global Rare Disease portfolio. The role drives the adoption of emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, automation, advanced analytics, and modern data management methodologies to accelerate clinical development, improve data quality, increase operational efficiency, and enhance regulatory readiness.
The individual serves as a strategic bridge between Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Clinical Operations, Digital/IT, and external partners to modernize clinical data processes and establish a future-ready clinical data ecosystem.
You will be responsible for
Strategic Leadership
Define and maintain the Clinical Data Innovation roadmap aligned with organizational objectives.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, automation, and digital technologies across the clinical development lifecycle.
Establish long-term strategies for clinical data architecture, interoperability, standardization, and data reuse.
Serve as innovation ambassador within Clinical Development and across R&D.
AI and Automation
Lead evaluation, implementation, and governance of AI-enabled solutions supporting: Data review & Data cleaning, Query generation, Medical coding, Risk-based quality management, Database build automation, (Automated) Metadata generation, regulatory submission preparation
Develop frameworks and standard operating procedures for responsible and compliant AI use in accordance with company governance and regulatory expectations.
Monitor emerging technologies and assess applicability to clinical development.
Data Management Transformation
Drive modernization of clinical data management processes and operating models.
Lead initiatives to improve scalability and efficiency across internal and outsourced studies.
Optimize interactions between Data Management, Programming, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, and Clinical Operations.
Technology and Platform Leadership
Act as business owner and subject matter expert for clinical data technologies. Collaborate with IT and Digital functions regarding EDC platforms, Data lake architectures, Analytics environments, AI platforms and Data visualization tools
Lead vendor evaluations and technology selection processes.
Establish KPIs demonstrating technology value and business impact.
Advanced Analytics and Insights
Promote use of advanced analytics and visualization to improve study oversight.
Enable near real-time monitoring of data quality, study conduct, operational performance and Risk indicators
Partner with Biostatistics and Programming to enhance integrated data review capabilities.
Innovation Management
Build and manage a portfolio of innovation initiatives.
Prioritize projects according to strategic value, feasibility, risk, and return on investment.
Establish business cases and success metrics for innovation projects.
Present innovation strategies and outcomes to senior leadership.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with stakeholders within R&D and related to R&D (i.e. Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, IT)
Build relationships with external vendors, technology providers, and industry consortia.
Team and Capability Development
Develop organizational capabilities in AI, automation, and innovative data practices.
Mentor teams on emerging technologies and new ways of working.
Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and innovation.
Contribute to workforce planning and future capability models.
You will need to have
Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biostatistics, Data Science, Computer Science or related field.
10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech or CRO industry, with strong exposure to clinical development.
Solid experience in Clinical Data Management and the clinical trial data lifecycle.
Proven experience in AI, automation, advanced analytics and/or digital innovation applied to clinical development.
Experience with clinical data technologies, data architecture, interoperability and data standards.
Strong cross-functional leadership experience across Clinical Development, Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations and IT/Digital.
Proven track record of leading clinical data innovation and transformation initiatives, including vendor and technology management.
Location
Europe with hybrid or remote options.
Compensation range
he minimum salary for this role is €59.000, aligned to our established salary framework. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s skills, experience, qualifications and internal equity considerations.
This role is eligible to participate in an annual bonus scheme, subject to company and individual performance.
In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including pension, private medical insurance, wellbeing programme, flexible benefits programme and more.
The package outlined above is based on the role being located in Italy. Where the role is offered in a different country, the applicable salary, bonus and benefits will be aligned to the relevant local market and internal frameworks. Full details of the applicable package will be provided at the appropriate stage of the recruitment process.
What we offer
No matter where your path starts at Chiesi, it leads to inspiring possibilities. Your future is our focus, and we are committed to nurturing your development in our dynamic, friendly environment with access to resources and training every step of the way.
We provide top-class benefits, including comprehensive healthcare programs, work-life balance initiatives, and robust relocation support. Our salary package is competitive, comprising a basic salary, performance bonuses, and benefits benchmarked against the external market. Additionally, we offer flexible working arrangements, remote work options, and tax assistance services for foreign colleagues, all designed to help you thrive.
Chiesi is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce at all levels of our business. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment based on attitude and merit, without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by applicable laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, transfer, promotion, compensation, eligibility for benefits, and termination.

jobs.title: Vice President, Information Technology
jobs.text:
About Net at Work
Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.
Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.
About this Position
Net at Work is seeking a hands-on, business-oriented Vice President of Information Technology to lead the company's internal technology organization. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the VP of IT will be responsible for the reliability, security, scalability, and performance of the company's business applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and technology operations.
The VP of IT will provide strategic and operational leadership for internal technology while partnering closely with executive leadership to ensure technology investments support business objectives, operational excellence, employee productivity, and company growth. This leader will oversee technology operations, enterprise applications, cybersecurity, vendor relationships, and technology governance while driving continuous improvement across the organization.
Job Responsibilities
Own and oversee Net at Work’s internal business application ecosystem, ensuring systems are reliable, secure, scalable, well-supported, and aligned with business operations.
Lead rollouts of new internal applications and major system enhancements across departments, including planning, requirements, testing, training, adoption, and post-launch support.
Apply sound SDLC practices, development best practices, and delivery frameworks to application rollouts, integrations, vendor-led implementations, and internal technology projects.
Oversee core technology operations, including infrastructure, cloud platforms, network operations, collaboration tools, end-user support, monitoring, escalation, and incident management.
Head the company’s internal security function, including security policies, controls, access management, risk management, vulnerability management, security awareness, and incident readiness.
Establish practical technology roadmaps, governance processes, operating standards, and prioritization models that support day-to-day business needs and company growth.
Manage technology vendors, implementation partners, licensing, renewals, support contracts, budgets, forecasts, and related technology spend.
Support technology due diligence and integration planning for acquisitions, with a focus on applications, infrastructure, security, vendors, licensing, and operational continuity.
Build and lead a service-oriented technology organization focused on reliability, responsiveness, security, documentation, accountability, and business partnership.
Partner closely with the COO and leaders across Finance, Legal, Compliance, People & Learning, Sales, Service, Operations, and customer experience to support business priorities.
Job Requirements
15+ years of progressive experience in IT, technology operations, business systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity, application delivery, or related areas.
8+ years in senior technology leadership roles.
Experience owning enterprise business applications, internal systems, infrastructure, end-user support, and technology operations.
Demonstrated success leading internal application implementations, platform rollouts, business systems transformations, or vendor-led technology projects.
Strong understanding of SDLC, application delivery best practices, implementation frameworks, integrations, testing, release management, and production support.
Cybersecurity leadership experience, including security controls, access management, risk management, compliance, incident response, vendor oversight, and executive reporting.
Experience managing technology budgets, vendors, licensing, renewals, implementation partners, and support contracts.
Experience in professional services, managed services, consulting, SaaS, technology services, or B2B services environments strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree preferred.
Leadership Attributes
The successful candidate will be:
Operationally disciplined and execution-oriented
A strategic business partner who aligns technology with organizational goals
Service-oriented and focused on delivering exceptional internal customer experiences
Security-minded and risk-aware
An effective leader capable of developing high-performing teams
Skilled at balancing strategic planning with hands-on operational leadership
Comfortable working with executive leadership and translating business needs into technology solutions
Customer Requirements
This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.
Core Competencies
Client Champion – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
Problem Solver – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
Promise Keeper – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
Collaborative Integrator –Team player, unifier, relationship-oriented, win-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
Driven Intrapreneur – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self-confidence, and a can-do attitude.
Inspiring Coach – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.
Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range: $180,000 to $200,000.
This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.
Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or product-specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws.
We provide competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from healthy body to healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life:
Health and Welfare (Medical, Dental, Vision)
Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Life and AD&D Insurance
Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
Transportation and Parking Accounts
Health Savings Accounts (with company contribution)
Retirement Planning (401k with matching contribution)
Legal Benefits
Identity Theft Protection
Pet Insurance
Wellness Program Offerings
Paid Time Off, accrued per pay period based on years of service starting at 15 days annually.
8 Paid Holidays per year, including 1 floating holiday.
The compensation and benefits information is accurate of the date of this posting and subject to plan eligibility. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.
The Company expects to accept applications for this position until September 31, 2026 but encourages interested applicants to apply as soon as possible. We will review this information and one of our Talent Acquisition professionals will reach out if your background aligns to the positions.
EOE/Diversity & Inclusion Statement
Net at Work is dedicated to unleashing the power and potential of our employees and teams by creating a vibrant and inclusive workplace where each employee can be their best. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity and inclusion. We embrace and encourage equitable treatment of our employees and strive to create a work environment free of discrimination at all organizational levels and in all forms. Net at Work recognizes the rights of all individuals to mutual respect and the acceptance of others without biases based on differences of any kind.
Net at Work is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fair hiring practices and to creating a welcoming environment for all team members that is free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Net at Work are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Position Summary
The Head of Product is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, roadmap, and commercialization of Resolve Tech Solutions' Juno Labs portfolio and future AI-enabled offerings. This role serves as the business owner for the Juno platform, partnering closely with executive leadership, engineering, architecture, sales, marketing, customer success, and clients to align product investments with market opportunities, customer needs, and company growth objectives. The Head of Product leads product discovery, portfolio governance, and roadmap prioritization while establishing scalable product management practices that support innovation, adoption, and long-term growth. This leader leverages customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to drive product decisions and ensure successful execution throughout the product lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
Define and execute the product vision, strategy, roadmap, portfolio priorities, and go-to-market plans for the Juno Labs portfolio
Lead, mentor, and develop Product Managers and product teams while fostering a culture of innovation and accountability
Establish product management processes, governance structures, prioritization frameworks, and lifecycle management standards
Partner with executive leadership to develop business cases, pricing strategies, investment recommendations, and product priorities
Conduct market research, competitive analysis, customer discovery, and stakeholder engagement activities to validate product direction and identify growth opportunities
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, AI, and Delivery teams to translate business requirements into scalable product solutions
Drive adoption of AI-enabled capabilities, emerging technologies, and innovation initiatives
Define product success metrics, KPIs, and reporting frameworks to support data-driven decision making
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to support product positioning, adoption, retention, and growth
Champion customer-centric product development and ensure alignment between customer needs, market demand, and business objectives
Other duties as assigned
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
Minimum ten (10) years of progressive experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, Product Leadership, or related disciplines required.
Minimum five (5) years of experience leading Product Managers, product teams, or product organizations required.
Demonstrated success developing and executing product strategies, roadmaps, commercialization plans, and product-market fit initiatives for enterprise software, SaaS, AI, cloud, healthcare, or technology products required.
Demonstrated success building, scaling, or transforming product organizations and operating models required.
Experience serving as the business owner for a software, platform, SaaS, AI, or technology product portfolio required.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and lead cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Architecture, AI, UX/UI, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other business functions required.
Experience leading AI-enabled product initiatives, including solutions leveraging machine learning, large language models (LLMs), analytics, automation,oremerging technologies preferred.
Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, agile methodologies, product analytics, pricing strategies, go-to-market planning, and portfolio management required.
Strong business acumen with the ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, operational considerations, and commercial objectives required.
Excellent verbal, written, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills required.
Alignment with RTS Core Values

jobs.title: Corporate Vice President - Enterprise PKI & Cryptographic Engineering (Remote, a
jobs.text:
Location Designation: Hybrid - 3 days per quarter
Technology, Data, AI and Ventures:
Within the Tech, Data, AI, Ventures (TDAV) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, AI and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for New York Life's businesses. We build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes.
Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world-class financial services company competes in the AI era - all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last.
The Corporate Vice President – Enterprise PKI & Cryptographic Engineering is a senior, hands-on technical leader accountable for the architecture, engineering, and modernization of New York Life's enterprise Public Key Infrastructure, certificate lifecycle, and cryptographic services across data center, cloud (AWS, Azure, and GCP), applications, devices, workloads, and non-human identities. This is a builder role, not a purely advisory one: you'll move from architecture into hands-on design, automation, and production delivery.
You'll own PKI and certificate lifecycle automation end to end, serve as the CISO organization's PKI and cryptographic subject matter expert for the Security Review Board and IS Exception process, and help position NYL for cryptographic agility and post-quantum readiness.
What You'll Do:
Design, engineer, and modernize enterprise PKI services and trust hierarchies — offline root CAs, issuing/subordinate CAs, and cloud-native issuance — spanning users, applications, devices, workloads, APIs, and non-human identities.
Engineer and administer Microsoft AD CS, including CA configuration, certificate templates, auto-enrollment, trust chains, CRLs, OCSP, and recovery capabilities.
Own Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM): drive discovery, inventory, issuance, renewal, revocation, and reporting from fragmented manual processes toward centralized, policy-driven automation.
Build automation and reusable, self-service certificate APIs using ACME, SCEP, EST, REST, PowerShell, and Python; integrate with ServiceNow, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and DevOps tooling.
Engineer HSM/KMS backed CA and signing services, including key ceremonies, backup, rotation, access control, and disaster recovery, across on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Serve as the PKI and cryptographic engineering subject-matter expert for the Security Review Board and Architecture Review Board, and provide authoritative technical risk recommendations on IS Exception requests.
Maintain strong knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID where they intersect with certificate services, certificate-based authentication, device identity, Conditional Access, and Privileged Identity Management.
Maintain the enterprise cryptographic inventory and drive cryptographic agility, short-lived certificates, and post-quantum migration readiness.
Treat PKI as business critical infrastructure: define resiliency, monitoring, and recovery procedures, and lead incident response and root-cause analysis for certificate, key, and trust failures.
Serve as the senior technical authority for complex production certificate, trust, and cryptographic issues, translating decisions into reusable enterprise patterns.
What You'll Bring:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in PKI, cryptographic engineering, identity engineering, or security engineering, with significant responsibility for enterprise PKI environments.
Deep hands-on experience engineering or operating enterprise certificate authority environments, including Microsoft AD CS, certificate templates, trust chains, CRLs, and OCSP.
Strong understanding of X.509, TLS/mTLS, certificate enrollment, revocation, trust models, and cryptographic key management.
Experience implementing or operating an enterprise CLM platform and automating certificate lifecycle processes with ACME, SCEP, EST, REST APIs, PowerShell, or Python.
Experience with certificate discovery and inventory across complex enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, containers, and Kubernetes.
Experience with HSMs, KMS platforms, private-key protection, or cloud key-management services.
Experience integrating PKI with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), APIs, DevOps pipelines, service meshes, and workload identity patterns.
Strong knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, particularly where they intersect with PKI, certificate-based authentication, device identity, or non-human identity.
Ability to conduct deep technical security reviews, identify material PKI and cryptographic risks, and define practical remediation or compensating controls.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex PKI and cryptographic risk to engineers, architects, governance bodies, auditors, vendors, and senior leaders.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with enterprise CLM platforms such as Venafi, AppViewX, Keyfactor, or DigiCert Trust Lifecycle Manager.
Experience modernizing Microsoft AD CS or migrating toward managed private CA or PKI-as-a-Service.
Experience with cloud PKI technologies such as AWS Private CA, Google Cloud Certificate Authority Service, or Azure Key Vault/Cloud PKI.
Experience integrating certificate lifecycle capabilities with ServiceNow or similar workflow platforms.
Experience with code signing, S/MIME, device certificates, Kubernetes certificate management, or service-mesh mTLS.
Experience with cryptographic inventory, cryptographic-agility programs, or post-quantum migration initiatives.
Experience implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Access Model, Tier 0 protections, or privileged-access modernization.
Prior experience supporting a Security Review Board, Architecture Review Board, or IS Exception process; financial services or other regulated enterprise experience; relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or a cloud security credential).
Job Level: LEVELPF5
Pay Transparency
Salary Range: $147,500-$211,000
Overtime eligible: Exempt
Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes
Sales bonus eligible: No
Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.
Company Overview
At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.
Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.
As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.
Our Benefits
We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site.
Our Commitment to Inclusion
At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. We have a longstanding commitment to creating an environment where individuals can contribute their best and succeed together. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. By embracing a broad range of perspectives and experiences, we achieve greater success and fulfill our promise of providing financial security and peace of mind to families across all communities. Click here to learn more about New York Life’s leadership in this space.​
Recognized as one of Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies, New York Life is committed to improving local communities through a culture of employee giving and volunteerism, supported by the Foundation. We're proud that due to our mutuality, we operate in the best interests of our policy owners. To learn more about career opportunities at New York Life, please visit the Careers page of .

jobs.title: Directeur·rice des produits et de l'ingénierie | Head of Product and Engineering
jobs.text:
ProgressionLIVE développe des logiciels web et mobiles de gestion des opérations de service sur le terrain, utilisés par des centaines d’organisations canadiennes dans les secteurs du CVC, de la plomberie, de l’électricité, de la construction, du transport et de la maintenance.
Votre rôle
Relevant du directeur général, vous dirigerez toute l’équipe produit et technologie et serez responsable de la feuille de route et de la livraison. Vous définirez avec le directeur général les orientations produit, les priorités majeures et les investissements structurants, tout en exerçant votre autonomie sur les décisions courantes et l’exécution.
Vous combinerez jugement produit, leadership et contribution technique directe : accompagner les développeurs, renforcer leurs compétences avec l’IA et programmer certaines fonctionnalités jusqu’à leur mise en production. Vous vous appuierez sur les expertises de l’équipe pour les décisions techniques spécialisées.
Vos responsabilités
Piloter la feuille de route à partir des échanges clients, des données d’utilisation et des objectifs commerciaux. Collaborer avec les ventes et le service client, puis mesurer l’adoption et l’impact.
Diriger l’exécution : définir la portée, organiser les priorités, lever les obstacles et accompagner l’équipe jusqu’à la mise en production et à la validation des résultats.
Programmer et livrer certaines fonctionnalités, en respectant les exigences de tests, de revue de code et de sécurité. Créer aussi des prototypes et des outils internes.
Recruter et développer l’équipe. Accompagner les développeurs par le travail en binôme, les revues de code, la formation et le partage des connaissances.
Définir et diriger un modèle opérationnel activé par l’IA pour le produit et l’ingénierie. Habiliter les développeurs, l’assurance qualité et les DevOps à utiliser l’IA efficacement tout au long du cycle de vie du développement, de la recherche et des spécifications à la mise en œuvre, aux tests, à l’examen du code, à la documentation, au débogage, au déploiement et à la réponse aux incidents.
Identifier et automatiser les activités répétitives ou à faible valeur ajoutée. Prototyper les flux de travail agentic à fort impact et les outils internes, les évaluer en fonction des améliorations mesurables dans la vitesse de livraison, la qualité, la fiabilité et la capacité de l’équipe, pas seulement les taux d’adoption.
Établir des normes pratiques pour l’utilisation responsable de l’IA (sécurité, confidentialité, propriété intellectuelle, qualité, responsabilité). Créer une culture d’expérimentation tout en veillant à ce que les gens restent responsables de l’exactitude et de la sécurité.
Identifier les opportunités d’IA orientées client qui créent une valeur significative et différenciée, distinguant les capacités authentiques des features motivées par la nouveauté. Partenaire avec les clients et l’équipe pour valider et hiérarchiser.
Équilibrer nouvelles fonctionnalités, dette technique, fiabilité et sécurité. Évaluer les compromis avec l’équipe et maintenir des exigences claires de qualité et de confidentialité.
Votre profil
8+ années de leadership en développement logiciel, incluant la construction et la mise à l’échelle d’équipes d’ingénierie.
Expérience pratique en développement logiciel et capacité actuelle à comprendre une base de code, programmer, tester et livrer des fonctionnalités en production.
Expérience de direction d’une équipe de développement, avec responsabilité de la livraison et capacité à recruter, coacher et faire progresser les développeurs.
Solide jugement produit : comprendre les problèmes clients, piloter une feuille de route, prioriser les investissements et mesurer les résultats.
Maîtrise pratique des outils de développement assisté par l’IA et capacité à transmettre des méthodes efficaces, avec validation critique du code généré.
Bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais pour collaborer avec les équipes et utiliser la documentation technique.
Notre environnement technologique
Java, Spring, Hibernate, Vue 3, TypeScript, AWS, GitHub Actions et Terraform. Nos applications mobiles fonctionnent hors ligne et se synchronisent. La maîtrise de chaque technologie n’est pas requise.

Your role
Reporting to the General Manager, you will lead the full product and technology team and own the roadmap and delivery. You will jointly agree with the General Manager on product direction, major priorities, and significant investments, while exercising autonomy over day to day product decisions and execution.
You will combine product judgment, team leadership, and direct technical contribution. Your software development experience will enable you to coach developers, build their AI skills, and personally code and ship selected product features. You will draw on the team’s expertise for specialized technical decisions.
Your responsibilities
Own the roadmap, drawing on customer conversations, usage data, and business objectives. Collaborate with sales and customer service, then measure adoption and impact.
Lead execution: define scope, sequence priorities, remove obstacles, and guide the team through release and validation of results.
Personally code and ship selected features, meeting testing, code review, and security standards. Build prototypes and internal tools as needed.
Recruit and develop the team. Coach developers through pair programming, code reviews, training, and knowledge sharing.
Define and lead an AI enabled operating model for product and engineering. Empower developers, QA, and DevOps to use AI effectively across the full development lifecycle, from research and specification through implementation, testing, code review, documentation, debugging, deployment, and incident response.
Identify and automate repetitive or low-value activities. Prototype high-leverage agentic workflows and internal tools, evaluating them based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, reliability, and team capacity, not just adoption rates.
Establish practical standards for responsible AI use (security, privacy, IP, quality, accountability). Build a culture of experimentation while ensuring people remain accountable for correctness and security.
Identify customer-facing AI opportunities that create meaningful, differentiated value, distinguishing genuine capabilities from novelty-driven features. Partner with customers and the team to validate and prioritize.

items: Piloter la feuille de route à partir des échanges clients, des données d’utilisation et des objectifs commerciaux. Collaborer avec les ventes et le service client, puis mesurer l’adoption et l’impact.

Identifier et automatiser les activités répétitives ou à faible valeur ajoutée. Prototyper les flux de travail agentic à fort impact et les outils internes, les évaluer en fonction des améliorations mesurables dans la vitesse de livraison, la qualité, la fiabilité et la capacité de l’équipe, pas seulement les taux d’adoption.

Identifier les opportunités d’IA orientées client qui créent une valeur significative et différenciée, distinguant les capacités authentiques des features motivées par la nouveauté. Partenaire avec les clients et l’équipe pour valider et hiérarchiser.

jobs.title: Head of Product - B2C
jobs.text:
Renmoney Microfinance Bank is on a mission to empower individuals and businesses across Nigeria by building a comprehensive financial ecosystem. From lending and savings to insurance, remittances, payments, and lifestyle services, we are creating innovative solutions that drive financial inclusion and economic growth.
Your Mission
As Chief Product Officer (CPO), you will own the vision and strategic direction of Renmoney’s retail product ecosystem. This includes core lending and banking products, as well as adjacent services such as insurance, remittances, and lifestyle solutions. Given the seniority of the CPO position and its strategic impact on the business, the role requires relocation to Lagos, Nigeria for the on-site work in the headquarters of the company.
You will work closely with the executive team to:
Drive product innovation and profitability.
Enhance customer experience and adoption.
Ensure products are competitive, compliant, and scalable in Nigeria’s fast-evolving financial services landscape.
You will lead multidisciplinary teams across Product Management, Design, Data, and Technology — ensuring that what we build creates measurable value for customers, partners, and the business.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Vision
Define and deliver Renmoney’s ecosystem product strategy, balancing growth, profitability, and risk.
Translate market opportunities into scalable product roadmaps across lending, banking services, insurance, remittances, payments, and lifestyle.
Stay ahead of regulatory requirements and competitive dynamics in Nigeria.
Product Development & Execution
Lead the design and rollout of customer-centric products tailored to Nigeria’s retail segments.
Champion research, data analytics, and customer feedback to shape product decisions.
Drive adoption of AI, automation, and digital channels to improve efficiency and customer experience.
Establish robust product governance and compliance processes.
Ecosystem & Partnerships
Build and manage strategic partnerships with fintechs, telcos, insurers, remittance providers, and lifestyle platforms.
Develop cross-sell, bundled, and embedded finance opportunities that expand customer value.
Negotiate favorable commercial terms that balance growth and cost efficiency.
Leadership & Performance
Lead and grow a high-performing product team with a culture of accountability, innovation, and delivery.
Partner with Risk, Finance, and Collections to optimize pricing, yields, impairments, and capital allocation.
Track and report KPIs: adoption, profitability, NPS/CSAT, revenue contribution, and ecosystem expansion.

jobs.title: Director of Strategy & Analytics
jobs.text:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.
While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.
About the Role
Beyond Finance is a data-driven FinTech where the Director of Strategy & Analytics will play a pivotal role in generating actionable analyses to ensure the company's continued growth and success through informed decision-making. The Director will conduct analyses focused on optimizing and understanding marketing and sales growth, client retention, debt consolidation performance, and customer lifetime value (LTV). The role will collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, operations, product, and data teams to deliver novel insights that contribute to achieving company goals. The Director must be able to prioritize tasks, delegate effectively, and manage resources efficiently to ensure key projects receive top priority and timely execution. Upon joining the team, a successful Director will quickly build a deep understanding of the business and effectively communicate results and present recommendations to senior executives.
The ideal candidate will be a results-driven, strategic thinker able to thrive in a dynamic, rapid-growth environment. Exceptional candidates will have best-in-class data skills including SQL, Excel, dataset manipulation, data visualization, and presentation.
What You'll Do
Lead a small team of analytics professionals conducting analyses of major operational trends, challenges, and opportunities
Drive data analysis yourself as an Individual Contributor as well, focusing on analyzing data and presenting actionable recommendations to executive stakeholders
Define and continually challenge KPIs critical to achieving company goals; lead the design of stakeholder dashboards and executive reporting
Collaborate with Product and Operations to define tests and experimental design, and communicating results to senior management
Work with the Data Engineering and Business Intelligence team to ensure data integrity
What We Look For
Proven record of addressing marketing, product, or business challenges, conducting data-driven analyses, and delivering actionable insights that lead to measurable results
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business, STEM, or other analytical field
5 – 10 years professional experience in marketing, product, strategy, or business analytics
Prior experience in strategy consulting, financial services, or start-up environments
Best-in-class data skills including SQL, Excel, dataset manipulation, data visualization, and presentation
An ownership mindset, experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, and proven record of successful, rapid execution
Beyond Finance is a Chicago based company and is looking for candidates in the Chicagoland area. Candidates from other markets may be considered if they have proven success working in a fully remote environment.
#LI-AW1
The base annual salary range is listed below. This role is eligible for additional incentives, including an annual bonus.
Base Salary Range
$146,810—$203,084 USD
Why Join Us?
While you make a difference for others, we’ll work to make a difference for you, providing an uplifting, collaborative work environment and benefits that reflect your value to us. For eligible full-time employees, we offer:
Considerable employer contributions for health, dental, and vision programs
Generous PTO, paid holidays, and paid parental leave
401(k) matching program
Merit advancement opportunities
Career development & training
And finally, our team spirit and culture! We cultivate an environment of community, connection, and belonging across our entire organization.
Beyond Finance does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job positions. No fee will be paid to their parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to Beyond Finance employees or the Beyond Finance HR team. No placement fee will be paid to any third party unless such a request has been made by the Beyond HR team.

jobs.title: VP, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Vice President, Software Engineering — Seven Bridges
Location: Remote. US preferred. India or EMEA candidates considered.
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
Who are we?
Velsera is the precision engine company. We build the software researchers, scientists, and clinicians use to drive precision R&D and bring analytics closer to the point of care. Seven Bridges, Pierian, and UgenTec came together to form Velsera; we are headquartered in Boston, MA, with [current headcount] colleagues across [current country count] countries.
The Seven Bridges Platform is our research genomics platform — roughly 130 containerized services, multi-cloud, running in commercial and FedRAMP Moderate environments, where scientists run CWL, WDL, and Nextflow workflows over petabyte-scale genomic data. Current priorities are federated data management, compliance as a product capability, and governed AI.
Reporting line and scope
You report to the CTO and own engineering for the Seven Bridges Platform: architecture, delivery, and production operations, including reliability, cost, technical debt, and observability. The team is primarily in India, with a smaller group in Serbia; you lead across both sites and work daily with stakeholders in other time zones. You hold architecture authority for the platform, co-own boundary decisions with security, federal compliance, and quality leadership, and partner with a cross-business AI Engineering team.
The role is roughly 40% hands-on technical work and 60% people leadership and organizational delivery. Hands-on means owning architecture decisions of record, leading design reviews, reviewing code and infrastructure changes, and prototyping where needed. You should be credible to your most senior engineers, with a clear view of what this class of platform should become and the ability to take a team and a business there.
What will you do?
Own the technical vision for the platform over the next three years, and turn it into an architecture and roadmap the team and the business believe in.
Own architecture decisions of record, design reviews, multi-tenant isolation, and complexity reduction across the service estate.
Keep delivery governed and modern: infrastructure-as-code under CI with policy-as-code, short-lived credentials, progressive rollout, and change evidence that holds up to audit in a federally authorized environment.
Own reliability: SLOs and error budgets on the paths customers depend on, on-call design that works across two sites, and turning repeat incidents into architectural change.
Ship governed AI in the product and apply AI to how the team builds, both under a governance policy co-owned with Risk & Compliance, and both measured.
Build the team: management depth you can trust with delivery, the specialist skills the roadmap needs, and maintaining a thriving team through a period of growth.

What do you bring to the table?
Must have
12+ years in software engineering, including several years leading multi-team organizations through managers.
Distributed-systems and platform architecture ownership at scale — multi-tenant isolation, service decomposition, and the judgment to reduce complexity.
Domain depth in scientific or biomedical data platforms — genomics, bioinformatics, life sciences, or comparable data-intensive, workflow-driven scientific computing.
Delivery inside a regulatory boundary such as FedRAMP, HIPAA, ISO 13485, or GxP.
Reliability and modern delivery engineering: SLOs, error budgets, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with policy-as-code and progressive rollout.
Production AI/LLM capability shipped under a compliance regime, or AI-assisted engineering you landed, governed and measured — beyond pilots.
A track record of setting technical vision for a platform and carrying an organization there.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to have
CWL/WDL/Nextflow, GA4GH standards (DRS/WES), FHIR or OMOP.
Federated or cross-institutional data access at scale — bringing analysis to data held by someone else.
Federal program delivery and artifact literacy — authorization packages, significant-change requests, and corrective-action plans.

Vision

articulates where the platform must be in three years, and why
combines scientific, regulatory, and technology trends into one coherent direction
spots opportunities for the platform early and acts on them

Personal command of the technology the platform is built on, enough to shape and challenge its biggest decisions.
reads code, designs, and test results first-hand rather than relying on summaries
changes a team’s technical direction with evidence rather than authority
is treated as a peer by senior engineers in design review

The ability to lead and develop others so they perform at their best — setting direction, providing the means, and holding the bar.
builds a management layer capable of running delivery without them, then holds it accountable
makes hiring and performance decisions promptly and explains them plainly
builds confidence and momentum and creates a thriving team environment

designs for auditability, traceability, and reproducibility from the outset
converts recurring incidents into architectural and process change
declines shortcuts that would trade a compliance position for a delivery date

The ability to make timely, defensible decisions on incomplete information, and to revisit them when the evidence changes.
commits to a sequence when the data is partial, and states what would change their mind
separates reversible from irreversible decisions and spends attention accordingly
records the reasoning as well as the outcome

People first. We create collaborative and supportive environments by operating with respect and flexibility to promote mental, emotional and physical health. We improve our sustainability by encouraging discussion and taking action as it relates to our natural, social and economic resource footprint. We are devoted to our humanitarian mission and look for new ways to make the world a better place.

Who are we?

Velsera is the precision engine company. We build the software researchers, scientists, and clinicians use to drive precision R&D and bring analytics closer to the point of care. jobs.title: Director, Product (M/F/X)
jobs.text:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française
Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !
Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.s
HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses !
Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.
Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !
L'opportunité:
HelloFresh France place le produit au cœur de sa croissance, et ce rôle en est le moteur. En tant que Directeur(rice) Produit, vous piloterez une équipe pluridisciplinaire couvrant le culinaire, le développement recettes, l'innovation produit et l'analytique, avec la responsabilité pleine et entière de ce qui se retrouve au menu chaque semaine : les ingrédients que nous sélectionnons, les concepts que nous créons, et les arbitrages commerciaux qui les sous-tendent. Cela implique la gestion directe du budget coût des marchandises et la responsabilité de son impact sur le compte de résultat. C'est un rôle concret et exigeant, à la croisée de l'alimentaire, de la stratégie et des opérations, là où la qualité du produit est ce qui fidélise nos clients.
Vos missions:
Construire et développer une équipe produit performante
Fédérer, inspirer et manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire — en posant une vision claire, en instaurant des rythmes de travail qui permettent d'avancer vite, et en investissant dans les personnes qui porteront le prochain chapitre de HelloFresh France.
Définir et challenger la vision produit
Construire une vision claire et ambitieuse de ce que doit devenir notre produit physique — ancrée dans la connaissance client, rigoureuse sur le plan commercial, et suffisamment différenciante pour gagner. Développer un point de vue propre et indépendant, nourri des insights de l'équipe Produit globale, mais enraciné dans la réalité du marché français.
Garantir l'accès aux informations, analyses et données nécessaires pour prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de développement produit, et traduire la vision en actions concrètes.
Pousser l'équipe et l'entreprise à aller au-delà de la feuille de route actuelle — en remettant en question les hypothèses, en interrogeant les arbitrages, et en s'assurant que nous travaillons toujours sur ce qui a le plus d'impact.
Piloter la rétention client et la performance commerciale
Faire de la rétention client votre boussole. Construire une vision rigoureuse et fondée sur les données de ce qui la détermine, et mobiliser l'équipe autour des actions qui font vraiment la différence.
Prendre des décisions produit en ayant pleinement conscience de leurs implications financières. Prendre des risques calculés, mesurer les résultats honnêtement, et ajuster rapidement quand un pari ne fonctionne pas.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Opérations (Achats, Qualité, Production, etc.) pour assurer une approche coordonnée des initiatives produit, à l'échelle locale comme globale.
Aligner produit et stratégie marketing
Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe brand & marketing pour que la feuille de route produit et la stratégie marketing soient pleinement synchronisées — ce que nous construisons, comment nous en parlons et comment nous le vendons doivent former une proposition cohérente.
Être la voix du produit au sein du comité de direction, en portant une vision convaincante de là où le produit doit aller et pourquoi.
Votre profil:
Expérience : 8 à 10 ans minimum dans le Produit, la Stratégie ou un rôle de leadership commercial similaire, idéalement dans l'alimentaire, le FMCG, les meal kits ou l'abonnement.
Outils : Maîtrise avancée d'Excel / Google Sheets et de PowerPoint / Google Slides ; curiosité et aisance avec l'IA indispensables.
Leadership : Au moins 3 ans de management d'équipes pluridisciplinaires à différents niveaux de carrière — avec un vrai sens du coaching, une direction claire et l'envie de faire grandir les gens
Un(e) leader qui passe à l'action. Vous donnez le cap, vous emmenez votre équipe avec vous, et vous mettez la main à la pâte pour que ça se concrétise.
Orienté(e) client et rigoureux(se) dans l'analyse. À l'aise pour interroger vos propres données et challenger vos hypothèses. Capable d'aller dans le détail, de faire le lien avec la vision d'ensemble, et de restituer les insights avec clarté.
Orienté(e) business. Vous comprenez comment les décisions produit se répercutent sur les coûts et les revenus — et vous vous tenez responsable des résultats, pas seulement des réalisations.
Fédérateur(rice) transversal(e). Vous installez rapidement la confiance, faites avancer les choses par l'influence, et savez inscrire les bonnes priorités dans les agendas des autres équipes.
Bon(ne) résolveur(se) de problèmes — à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté, déterminé(e) à trouver des solutions, avec un réflexe naturel pour l'action.
Excellent(e) communicant(e). Vous écrivez et présentez avec clarté et conviction — que ce soit pour un narratif stratégique, une mise à jour pour le leadership ou un brief produit.
Organisé(e) et structuré(e), avec de solides compétences en gestion de projet et la capacité à tenir des délais serrés.
Passionné(e) de food, avec la capacité à transformer les tendances et les signaux marché en offres produit attractives.
Ce que nous t’offrons :
Un environnement dynamique et international, avec une culture d'entreprise forte
Une courbe d’apprentissage rapide garantie !
Une équipe française bienveillante, passionnée, proactive et dynamique
Des bureaux au cœur de Paris, dans le 1er arrondissement
Nos avantages : de délicieuses réductions sur nos Box HelloFresh, tickets restaurant Swile, réduction sur le transport, un accès privilégié à Gymlib
Le déroulé du processus de recrutement :
Nous examinons ton CV et ta lettre de motivation. Si c’est un match, nous t’invitons à une série d’entretiens et à réaliser un case study. Nous nous engageons à organiser rapidement les entretiens, afin de t’accueillir chez HelloFresh au plus vite !
Tes débuts chez HelloFresh :
A ton arrivée, nous te concoctons des sessions d’onboarding qui te permettront de rencontrer chaque manager et de t’imprégner ainsi du fonctionnement de HelloFresh. Tu auras aussi du temps pour faire plus ample connaissance avec ton équipe avant de plonger dans le vif de tes missions !

jobs.title: VP, Data and Analytics (Remote US)
jobs.text:
Overview
HarperCollins Publishers is seeking a Vice President, Data. In this role, you will lead the function responsible for data infrastructure, engineering, governance, and analytics across North America. You will own the enterprise data strategy, modernizing our architecture on Microsoft Fabric and driving a multi-year transformation roadmap. The ideal candidate must be a seasoned data leader with the vision to define our future state and the drive to deliver it. You must thrive in a complex, dynamic environment, possess exceptional stakeholder management skills, and have a proven track record of leading high-performing technical teams through significant organizational change.
Responsibilities
Lead a data function responsible for data infrastructure, engineering, governance, and analytics for HarperCollins across North America.
Build a cohesive team of leaders across data disciplines and design the organization for accelerated delivery and future scalability.
Own the enterprise data strategy, focusing on modernizing and converging data architecture on Microsoft Fabric.
