jobs.title: Director of Product, Customer Care
jobs.text:
At Lyft, our mission is to improve people’s lives with the world’s best transportation. To do this, we start with our own community by creating an open, inclusive, and diverse organization.
Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product leaders who bring exceptional creative and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company’s vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate product leaders to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry from our San Francisco and New York offices.
The Safety & Customer Care (SCC) Product team builds the platforms, products, and experiences that support riders and drivers when they need help most — and help keep them safe every time they ride. As the Director of Product, Customer Care, you’ll lead a team of product managers driving Lyft’s customer care strategy end to end: AI-powered support across chat and voice, the contact center platforms our support teams run on, and the underlying data layer which is critical to understand where our products can be improved. It’s a rare chance to shape how a category-defining company delivers support at scale — across emerging AI capabilities, global expansion, autonomous vehicle partnerships, and new lines of business.
Responsibilities:
Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Lyft’s Customer Care product portfolio — spanning AI-driven support automation, contact center platforms, self-service and issue resolution, and the trust and safety products underpinning every interaction
Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, execution, and career development
Partner with senior leaders across engineering, data science, design, operations, and finance to set priorities and deliver org-level outcomes
Drive Lyft’s shift to AI-first customer support — from agent-assist and automation to autonomous resolution across chat and voice
Set the strategy for the platforms and tooling that power a global support organization and its BPO partners. Make build/buy decisions to optimize for best and most efficient customer experiences.
Represent Customer Care product in executive and cross-functional forums, translating complex tradeoffs into clear recommendations and securing investment
Make disciplined prioritization and resourcing decisions across a broad portfolio, balancing near-term operational needs against long-term platform bets
Define the metrics that matter — cost, quality, and customer experience — and hold the organization accountable to measurable impact
Extend Lyft’s support capabilities into new frontiers, including autonomous vehicle partnerships, international markets, and emerging business lines
Experience:
10+ years of product management experience, including several years leading and managing product managers
Proven track record of building, scaling, and developing high-performing product teams
Experience owning a large, multi-workstream product portfolio and setting multi-year strategy
Experience in Vendor Management
Deep fluency in one or more of: customer support and contact center platforms, AI/ML-driven automation, or trust & safety products
Strengths:
Strategic vision: You define a compelling long-term direction and translate it into a roadmap the team can execute
People leadership: You hire, coach, and retain exceptional product managers and create the conditions for them to do their best work
Executive presence: You communicate crisply with senior leadership and build alignment across a complex stakeholder set
Technical depth: You engage credibly with engineering and data science on AI/ML systems, platform architecture, and technical tradeoffs
Operational rigor: You make data-informed decisions and drive measurable outcomes across cost, quality, and experience
Bias to action: You navigate ambiguity, decide with incomplete information, and move the organization forward with urgency
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, a related field, or equivalent experience
Benefits:
Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have unlimited paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
401(k) plan to help save for your future
18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
Pre-tax commuter benefits
Lyft Pink - Lyft team members get an exclusive opportunity to test new benefits of our Ridership Program
Lyft is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.
This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members are expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.
The expected range of pay for this position in the San Francisco or New York areas is $236,000 - $295,000. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Range is not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you're ready to see your impact and embrace meaningful challenges, join us, and build real world value.
Every payment, every custody operation, and every line of code at Ripple runs on the infrastructure our platform teams build. We operate a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-native environment spanning multiple regions and regulatory jurisdictions, engineered for the availability and security standards our financial institution customers expect — and for the developer velocity our engineers need. The systems this organization owns are the substrate for everything Ripple ships.
We have a big vision and the ambition to match. We are seeking the same in engineering leaders. You see infrastructure not as plumbing but as leverage: the difference between an engineering organization that ships weekly and one that ships continuously, between a platform that survives a regional outage and one that doesn't notice it happened.
We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to develop and guide the teams responsible for Ripple's cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platform, and developer experience.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead the technical and organizational strategy managing multi-cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platform at Ripple, balancing reliability, security, cost, and developer velocity y
Lead multiple teams and managers across compute platform, cloud infrastructure, developer experience, and reliability engineering
Define and deliver the multi-year infrastructure roadmap, including cluster architecture, workload orchestration, service networking, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD
Set the standard for operational excellence — SLOs, incident response, on-call health, blameless postmortems, and dynamic rollout practices — and hold the organization to it

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
As CTO, you will be the technical leader of the business, working closely with the founders to shape our product and technology strategy as we scale from Series A towards Series B.
You will lead our 6-person engineering team in India, while remaining sufficiently hands-on and responsible for the architecture, performance, and roadmap of Nina and Trace, and for building the engineering organization behind them whilst staying close enough to the code and models to make sharp technical calls.
Key responsibilities
Own the company’s technology and AI strategy, including the end-to-end technical vision and architecture for Nina and Trace.
Lead, mentor and scale the distributed engineering team, establishing the culture, standards, processes and hiring strategy needed for the next stage of growth.
Drive the evolution and performance of Nina and Trace, improving agent accuracy, reliability, latency, cost and scalability.
Establish robust approaches to AI agent evaluation, orchestration, safety & reliability.
Design and scale the underlying data pipelines, integrations, verification workflows and infrastructure supporting the agents.
Own technology practices around data privacy, security and responsible AI, particularly for sensitive candidate and background-check data.
Translate product, customer and commercial priorities into a clear technical roadmap and execution plan, working closely with founders, product and go-to-market teams.
Make strategic architecture, technology, build-vs-buy and model-vs-API decisions to optimise long-term capability, cost and scalability.
Shape the future technology organisation, including team structure, engineering processes and talent strategy.
Represent technology and engineering with customers, partners, the board and investors as required.

jobs.title: Director of Data Science and Bioinformatics
jobs.text:
This is an exciting opportunity to lead and grow the Data Science and Bioinformatics function supporting Natera's Women's Health and Organ Health product portfolios. In this role, you will build the bioinformatics capability within the Data Science development team, establish scalable AWS cloud infrastructure, and ensure the quality and reproducibility of the genomic algorithms powering our clinical products.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strategy and Vision
Build and define the Bioinformatics function within the Data Science development team, identify technical tooling gaps, and execute a roadmap to advance genomics-based algorithm development.
Establish and enforce pipeline and algorithm quality standards, including review processes, validation frameworks, and documentation practices
Infrastructure and Automation
Own and architect scalable AWS-based data science and bioinformatics infrastructure, ensuring quality, reproducibility, and reliable deployment of Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) algorithms.
Implement MLOps tooling and automated validation frameworks to support reliable algorithm deployment into clinical production.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Research, Product Development, Laboratory Operations, Engineering, and Quality teams to implement stable, scalable pipelines and support successful productization
Team Leadership
Lead, mentor and hire a high-performing team of bioinformaticians and data scientists, establishing technical quality standards and clear operational ownership.
Build technical depth within the team to support expanding product roadmaps across Women's Health and Organ Health.
QUALIFICATIONS:
Master of Science or Ph.D. in a quantitative technical discipline (Biostatistics, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or equivalent).
Minimum of 10 years of experience in Data Science or Bioinformatics, with at least 5 years of direct people management experience leading technical teams.
Hands-on experience architecting AWS cloud infrastructure for data-intensive bioinformatics workloads and NGS pipeline execution.
Demonstrated ability to identify capability gaps independently, build scalable infrastructure, and drive execution without waiting for formal structure.
Strong communicator who builds cross-functional alignment across Research, Engineering, and Quality teams through technical clarity, direct engagement, and data-driven reasoning.
Track record of developing bioinformatics talent and delivering computational pipelines that support commercial product development.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Experience developing software and pipelines within regulated environments (CLIA, FDA, or ISO framework).
Experience with MLOps frameworks and pipeline tools (MLflow, Nextflow, WDL, Docker).
Advanced knowledge of statistical inference, machine learning, and genomic data processing.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$186,300—$232,900 USD
OUR OPPORTUNITY
Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.
The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.
WHAT WE OFFER
Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!
For more information, visit www.natera.com.
Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.
All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.
If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.
Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/
Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Global marketplaces — Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify and over a hundred others — are the engines of modern commerce. But the data sits locked inside each channel, fragmented and rarely adding up to a clear picture.
MerchantSpring is the API-first data infrastructure for the businesses that operate, advise on, and build for digital commerce. We consolidate cross-channel marketplace data into a single source of truth that our customers reach through a visualisation platform, an API gateway, MCP tools and embeddable widgets.
We are profitable, self-funded, and seven years in — scaling on our own revenue rather than someone else’s runway. We are headquartered in Australia with a growing presence in Kuala Lumpur, and we operate as a single team across sites.
Today the platform spans 120+ e-commerce channels, manages roughly 12TB of data across 35,000 seller accounts in 29 countries, serving agencies, enterprise brands, and ecosystem and technology partners.
The role
We are looking for a Head of Engineering to take full ownership of our engineering function and lead the next chapter: our evolution into a true API-first data platform. You will inherit a team of 11 engineers across our ETL, API and AI/MCP squads, report to our CEO, and own the technical vision, the architecture, and the culture that carries us from startup to scale-up.
This is a builder’s leadership role. We want someone who leads from within the architecture — setting direction, making the hard technical calls, and rolling up their sleeves to code when it helps the team move or unblocks a problem. As the team grows, the role is expected to evolve further toward organisational leadership, and we say so openly because we want someone who wants that trajectory.
What you’ll own
Technical vision and architecture. Translate business goals into a technical roadmap, set direction across the squads, and own the architectural bets — with our API-first data layer as the centrepiece.
Platform scale. Take our API and data platform from where they are today to scale: more channels, more volume, and more external builders relying on our endpoints, MCP tools and widgets.
Infrastructure economics. Own the unit economics of the platform. A large and growing share of our cost base sits in database and infrastructure spend, and you will be accountable for managing and driving it down as we scale with a focus on database cost:
TimescaleDB compression, retention and continuous aggregates
Postgres query and index optimisation and right-sizing
MongoDB indexing and sharding.
Data integrity and reliability. 35,000 accounts depend on financially accurate data. Own incident practices and resilience that keep serious problems rare — and provide visible, decisive leadership on the rare occasions they aren’t.
The team culture. Hire, mentor and grow engineers; set delivery standards and best practices from documentation to deployment; and build a team where engineers want to do their best work.
Set direction. Provide oversight and guidance to talented, junior teams in AI/MCP to DevOps and infrastructure.
Partnership and foresight. Bridge Engineering with Sales and Client Success so feedback, escalations and market signals reach the roadmap, and engage the CEO and co-founder proactively on technical strategy.

jobs.title: Sr Director, Data Strategy and Information Systems
jobs.text:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.
Job Details
The Senior Director of Data Strategy and Information Systems will lead the data strategy agenda for business units and enhance strategic decision making through the enablement of data assets. This role partners with business leaders to leverage data to drive revenue generation and cost savings, while ensuring regulatory compliance and effective risk management. In addition, this position is responsible for product management, data methodologies, data processing and quality control, and supporting both internal and external customers of the data asset.
Responsibilities
Manages development and deployment team members as well as Reporting Analysts in the delivery of value-added solutions and the implementation of best practices.
Serves as the primary technical representative for assigned business units and works directly with corporate and client IT teams to resolve issues, including but not limited to: completing security assessments, implementing new IT initiatives and communicates impacts, and addressing AWS infrastructure needs or issues, including SQL databases, servers, and application vulnerabilities.
Functions as a Product Owner to liaison with corporate data and development teams while providing data related expertise across programs and projects.
Develops and maintains data roadmap, prioritizing data work, and ensuring progress is made against the strategic roadmap. Manages data programs and supports strategic initiatives where data management is a critical factor.
Leads team members in monitoring, measuring and driving compliance with data governance, data quality and data sourcing policies.
Collaborates with business leaders to develop, implement and champion evolving data capabilities.
Serves as a thought leader, drives the use of data-driven approaches, and seeks to expand the range of fields in which data insight adds value to decision making.
Fosters the adoption of common terminology, language and perspectives for data management
The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.
Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Education
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, similar technical field of study, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
Master’s degree in computer science or similar technical field of study preferred.
Experience
10+ years of prior healthcare and/or PBM industries, required.
10+ years of management experience.
10+ years of experience with Data Warehouse methodologies as well as SQL database development, working with the full Microsoft SQL Server toolset (SSIS, SSRS, SSMS, SSAS, RDBMS).
Experience in healthcare technology, online pharmacy claims adjudication preferred.
Skills & Abilities
Proven ability to create, motivate and inspire interdisciplinary teams focusing on resolution(s) of identified issues by translating strategic plans into priorities and procedures for the work team and implementing tactical operating policies and procedures.
Demonstrated ability to articulate complex issues, plans, and concepts to diverse populations. Excellent oral and written communication skills as well as excellent presentation skills.
Demonstrated ability to make decisions and take actions to improve the overall operational efficiencies for the team and service to the marketplace.
Demonstrated technical expertise in engineering, data and business analytics, business intelligence with experience in the following: agile methodology (Scrum, Kanban, Lean, etc.); PowerShell, Python; AWS, GitLab, Visual Studio; .NET, C#, JSON, XML, VisualCron, PowerBI, Tableau; and, cloud-based database solutions (e.g., Azure SQL Database, AWS RDS).
Advanced SQL skills, including data modeling, DBO creation, management, OLAP principles and indexing.
Expertise in identifying and diagnosing application and database related issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions.
Demonstrated ability to architect, design, develop and implement solutions around micro-service and monolithic architectures.
Proven knowledge of:
Non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) and big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark);
Pharmacy industry standards such as NCPDP, HL7, ANSI X12, and/or related drug database terminologies and classifications; and,
Medicare Part D, PDE submissions & returns, pharmacy claims and benefit management
Physical/Mental Demands: This position is administrative in nature and will present physical demands requisite to a position requiring: hearing, seeing, sitting, standing, talking, and walking. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Must be able to commute to multiple site locations within assigned territory. May be necessary to work extended hours as needed.
Schedule: This is a full-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.
Travel: Travel may be required for special organization or department events, department team meetings, trade shows, conferences, and other client engagements.
This is a remote position.
AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire.
AnewHealth provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self-identify when applying. Local applicants are encouraged to apply. We maintain a drug-free work environment. Applicants must be eligible to work in this country.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Total Rewards, HRIS and Data
jobs.text:
Sr. Director, Total Rewards, HRIS, and Data — People Team (Remote)
Full-Time, Remote / Salaried, Exempt
Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity
Steno was built on a simple idea - litigation support shouldn't be an obstacle. Since 2018, we've been delivering on that promise, growing into a business with over $90M raised, a team that continues to scale, and a multi-product platform serving thousands of law firms nationwide. We combine expert services, proprietary data, and modern technology in a way no one else in the legal industry can.
As the business scales, so does the complexity of supporting our people. This is a first-of-its-kind role at Steno with a clear mandate to build the Total Rewards, HRIS, and People Data function with the full support of executive leadership.
Who are you?
You are a senior Total Rewards and HRIS leader with deep functional expertise and experience helping organizations scale. You've built compensation frameworks, benefits programs, HR systems, and people analytics capabilities at high-growth companies and you know the hard part isn't administering the program, it's making sure it’s designed to drive the talent strategy and holds up as the business scales. You lead with data and judgment. You're as comfortable presenting a compensation philosophy to executive leadership as you are in the details of a systems integration.
You're a builder. Foundational work energizes you. You carry the culture with you, earn trust across functions quickly, and understand that Total Rewards and HRIS done well is a meaningful business driver.
What you’ll drive
Shape Steno's Total Rewards and HRIS philosophy and strategy, ensuring our programs are competitive, equitable, and built to scale.
Build a total compensation framework that is rigorous, market-informed, and designed to attract and retain exceptional people, spanning job architecture, pay bands, bonus, and equity.
Oversee benefits strategy and administration end to end, ensuring programs are competitive, compliant, and meaningful to the people who rely on them.
Build an HRIS and People Data foundation that powers smart people decisions across the org including systems roadmap, data integrity, integrations, and reporting.
Partner with IT, Data, and functional leaders as the go-to thought partner on People technology, tools, and metrics, closing systems gaps and ensuring solutions keep pace with the business.
Design and manage employee recognition programs that reinforce Steno's culture and values.
Stay close to market trends, benchmarking data, and regulatory requirements to ensure Steno's programs remain competitive and compliant.
Lead a high-performing Total Rewards, HRIS, and Data team, setting a clear direction and developing the people on it.
Own the Total Rewards budget and vendor relationships, making smart tradeoffs and advocating for what the roadmap needs.
You’ll thrive here if
You've spent 10+ years in total rewards or a related HR discipline and have led a team.
You've built or significantly evolved compensation frameworks, benefits programs, and equity plans at a high-growth company.
You've owned an HRIS roadmap and understand what it takes to build a people data infrastructure that the business relies on.
You understand the regulatory and security landscape that governs compensation, benefits, and people data and stay current as it evolves.
You take accountability for compensation and benefits spend and bring the financial discipline that stewarding investments of this scale requires.
You're comfortable being both the strategist and the builder. You like getting in the weeds and no job is too small.
You lead with data and judgment. You can build the model and present the recommendation with equal confidence.
You've navigated ambiguity and change with composure and know how to bring people along with you.
You're fluent in the tools that power this work - Rippling, Carta, Google Workspace, and Slack.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary — $200,000-$230,000
Health, Vision, & Dental Benefits — generous, low-cost plans for employees and their families
Wellness & Mental Health — shared benefits designed to support the whole person
Flexible Paid Time Off — trust-based and meant to be used
Equity options — so you share in what we're building
Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
Home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs
Application Information
Steno is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristics that are protected under the law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
Applicants needing special assistance or accommodations for interviews or website access should contact us at .
Steno personnel will always have either a steno.com email address or will contact you via Rippling Recruiting. Act with caution if asked for personal information. Background checks, for example, are only conducted after an offer is extended.
Applicants should receive a confirmation email immediately after applying. If you haven’t received it, check your email spam folder and approve the sender address to ensure receipt of future communications.
Information provided to Steno, such as professional credentials and skills, educational and work history, the results of technical skills assessments or working exercises, and other information that may be included on a resume or application, is collected and stored in our system. Still, we never disclose or sell your personal information.
​​Steno uses AI-assisted tools to help review applications and identify candidates whose experience aligns with the role. All hiring decisions are made by our People team, and a member of our team will personally reach out to candidates selected to move forward in the process.

jobs.title: VP Engineering
jobs.text:
Overview
The Vice President, Engineering is a senior leadership role within the Engineering organization, responsible for defining and executing the product engineering strategy and leading the development and delivery of high-quality, scalable software products.
This role oversees a global engineering organization and partners closely with Product Management, Design, and Go-to-Market teams to build innovative, customer-centric solutions that drive business growth and market differentiation. The VP is accountable for delivering impactful product outcomes, accelerating time-to-market, and ensuring engineering excellence across the product lifecycle.
The role operates at both strategic and execution levels, ensuring alignment between engineering delivery, product vision, and customer needs.
Responsibilities
Serve as executive leader for a global product engineering organization.
Partner with Product Management to define priorities and deliver high-quality software products.
Lead distributed engineering teams across multiple locations.
Focus on AI Coding and AI DLC driven development, deployment and Quality.
Drive SaaS and cloud-based product development.
Plan and manage engineering budgets and resources.
Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across product systems.
Act as a technical advisor to executive leadership.
Contribute to design decisions, reviews, and resolution of complex technical challenges.
Engage with customers and support go-to-market and sales initiatives.
Collaborate across functions and promote a strong customer-focused culture.
Contribute to annual planning and product strategy.
Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that is able to assist in employing best in class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications
12+ years of progressive engineering experience with strong focus on product development.
8+ years of leadership experience managing engineering teams and leaders of leaders.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
Strong experience building and delivering customer-facing software products (SaaS preferred).
Expertise in modern software development practices and full product lifecycle delivery.
Experience with cloud-based application development environments.
Proven track record delivering scalable and high-quality software products.
Strong partnership with Product Management to drive product strategy and execution.
Proven ability to align engineering delivery with business goals and customer outcomes.
Cognitive / Mental Requirements
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on involvement when needed.
Experience operating in fast-paced, product-driven environments.
Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area that is free from distractions, to allow and maintain high levels of productivity.
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Base compensation ranges from $215,000 to $300,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.
Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.
Date of posting: 8/27/2026
Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 9/27/2026 but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.title: Director of Technology Operations
jobs.text:
The Role We Need
We’re hiring a Director of Technology Operations to lead the three functions that keep PadSplit’s technology and business operations healthy: Quality Assurance, IT & internal tooling, and Security. You’ll inherit existing teams across each area and be responsible for modernizing how they work: moving QA toward automation, IT toward proactive enablement, and Security toward a structured, risk-based program.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set strategy and own outcomes across all three areas, while staying close enough to the work to evaluate a test architecture, challenge a vendor renewal, or lead an incident review yourself.
The Person We Are Looking For
We’re looking for a technology leader who has led multiple technology operations functions and knows how to turn reactive, manual processes into scalable systems. You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution, developing teams while also getting into the details when the situation calls for it.
You’ll need strong technical judgment, particularly across QA, IT operations, and Security, and the ability to translate technical risks and tradeoffs into clear business decisions. Most importantly, you’re a player-coach who can modernize these functions without losing sight of the people and teams responsible for delivering the work.
Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day
Set QA strategy: Define what quality means at PadSplit, how it’s measured, and how quality is built into the development lifecycle rather than addressed at the end.
Modernize testing: Increase test automation, improve CI/CD quality gates, and move the team from manual regression toward automation engineering.
Scale with AI: Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted testing tools for test generation, maintenance, and triage so QA can keep pace with product demand without relying solely on headcount growth.
Develop teams: Coach existing QA, IT, and Security team members, create career paths, and hire where additional expertise is needed.
Improve IT: Modernize internal tools and workflows, automate repetitive processes, manage the SaaS portfolio, and identify opportunities to consolidate vendors and reduce costs.
Build service standards: Establish IT SLAs, self-service resources, and documentation so employees receive fast, predictable support as the company scales.
Lead security: Own the security roadmap across application, infrastructure, corporate/endpoint security, and vendor risk while establishing policies, training, vulnerability management, and incident response processes.
Lead incidents: Serve as the escalation point for security incidents, leading response and communication and facilitating blameless postmortems that turn incidents into improvements.
Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful
Leadership experience: 10+ years in technology roles and 5+ years leading teams, including direct leadership experience in at least two of the three areas: QA, IT, or Security, and strong working knowledge of the third.
Modernization track record: Experience transforming a manual QA organization, ad hoc Security function, or reactive IT organization into a more automated, structured, and proactive operation.
QA expertise: Strong knowledge of test automation, CI/CD integration, quality metrics, agile product development, and modern approaches to AI-assisted testing.
AWS experience: Hands-on experience with AWS and enough infrastructure knowledge to make informed QA, IT, and Security decisions.
IT operations: Strong grounding in IAM/SSO, MDM, SaaS administration, network security tooling, and IT budget management.
Automation knowledge: Familiarity with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, with enough technical depth to evaluate architecture and coach the team.
Business judgment: Strong judgment around build-vs-buy decisions, vendor selection, and how to prioritize limited resources across competing technology needs.
Executive communication: Able to communicate clearly and directly and translate technical risks, tradeoffs, and decisions into language executives and non-technical stakeholders can understand.
The Interview Process:
Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.
If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our CTO for one (1) hour.
If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our key stakeholders for one (1) hour.
If warranted, the final step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for two (2) hours.
The panel interview will require a candidate to work on a technical assessment where you will showcase your technology experise to the panel for discussion.
If warranted, then we move to offer!
Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:
Fully remote position - we swear!
Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity
National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
Company provided life insurance policy
Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
401(k) plan
Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents
The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis
Notice to Applicants:
PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.
PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Here at Precision AQ we are building a Data Hub, a centralized platform team, to be responsible for consolidating legacy data infrastructure, establishing enterprise data foundation and governance and enabling AI/ML capabilities across the organization. The Data Hub is moving from strategy to execution. We have a charter, a roadmap, executive sponsorship, and a clear mandate: consolidate fragmented data pipelines into a governed, scale able platform that serves multiple business units and product lines. We are now hiring an engineering leader who can build and run the team.
Job Summary:
Stand up and scale a high-performing engineering team
Own day-to-day engineering operations: sprint delivery, technical quality, capacity planning
Drive technical excellence: architecture decisions, code quality, DevOps/GitOps practices, production reliability
Be the primary escalation point for technical blockers, cross-team dependencies and delivery risks
Partner with the SVP on hiring, team development, vendor relationships and strategic planning
Key Responsibilities:
Engineering Team Leadership: Build, lead, and develop a team of data engineers, analytics engineers, and platform engineers. Set expectations, run 1:1s, manage performance, and create an environment where strong engineers want to stay and grow. You are accountable for the team’s output, quality, and morale.
Sprint Delivery and Capacity Management: Own the engineering delivery cadence. Run sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives. Manage capacity across concurrent workstreams (platform build, migrations, feature development). Ensure commitments are realistic and met.
Technical Design and Architecture: Lead technical design reviews and architectural decisions. Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with our medallion data architecture. You don’t need to design everything yourself, but you need to ensure designs are sound before they go to production.
Engineering Quality and Standards: Establish and enforce engineering practices: such as code review, branching strategy, CI/CD, testing, documentation, incident management.
Partner with SVP on Hiring and Onboarding.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the engineering interface to Insights Hub, Evidence Solutions, Product Solutions, and IT. Translate business requirements into technical scope. Manage dependencies with Corporate IT, Security, and external vendors. Escalate blockers early and clearly.
Platform Operations and Reliability: Ensure production systems meet SLAs. Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes.
Education and Experience:
5/8+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or platform engineering roles
3+ years leading engineering teams (hiring, performance management, delivery accountability)
Direct experience with modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred), transformation frameworks, orchestration tools
Track record of delivering complex data platform initiatives, such as migrations, consolidations, greenfield builds
Experience operating in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments
Be able to review code, debug production issues and make sound architectural judgements.
This hands-on leadership role is for you if:
You’ve built and scaled engineering teams and enjoyed it
You’re energized by the challenge of consolidating legacy systems into something better
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and can make progress without perfect information
You care about engineering craft: clean code, good tests, clear documentation
You want to be close to the work
You can balance delivery pressure with sustainable team health
You’re excited by the opportunity to shape a function, not just manage one
Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.
Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at .
Recruitment Fraud Warning: Please be aware that fraudulent individuals and websites may impersonate Precision Medicine Group or its affiliates and attempt to obtain personal, financial, or banking information through fake job postings or employment offers. Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process. If you believe you have been targeted by a recruitment scam, we encourage you to report the incident to your local law enforcement authorities, consumer protection agency, or relevant cybercrime reporting organization in your country. Please also notify us at so we can investigate and take appropriate action.

jobs.title: 2026 - VP, Engineering – HR Technology
jobs.text:
VP, Engineering – HR Technology (Enhanced to Emphasize HR Data Expertise)
The successful candidate is expected to:
Lead and build full‑stack, enterprise‑grade platforms using Python, Java, Spring Boot, ReactJS, and SQL/NoSQL databases, while remaining hands‑on with code.
Own and drive Low‑Level Design (LLD) and High‑Level Design (HLD) with deep understanding of distributed systems, data modeling, and integration patterns.
Architect and develop secure, compliant systems.
Design, build, and maintain scalable APIs that support internal and external consumers with high performance and reliability.
Drive non‑functional requirements including security, availability, scalability, resiliency, performance, and observability.
Lead engineering initiatives involving HR, people‑operations, and workforce‑analytics data, ensuring secure ingestion, modeling, governance, and integration of sensitive employee datasets across the firm's technology ecosystem.
Partner with HR, Talent, and People Analytics teams to translate workforce‑planning, compensation, performance‑management, and organizational‑design requirements into scalable technical solutions and data products.
Implement robust data‑quality, lineage, and privacy controls for HR data, ensuring compliance with regulatory, contractual, and internal governance standards.
Actively mentor, coach, and develop junior and mid‑level engineers, setting high engineering standards and fostering a strong engineering culture.
Partner with product, data, and HR stakeholders to translate investment and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Provide strong technical leadership and hands‑on guidance across the full software development lifecycle.
Demonstrate an excellent understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design tradeoffs.
Qualifications & Experience
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Experience:
8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Proven track record of hands‑on development in enterprise‑scale systems, preferably in HR.
Strong proficiency in at least one core programming language (Python or Java).
Deep experience with relational databases, NoSQL stores, and complex query design.
Comfortable operating in fast‑paced, iterative environments, balancing delivery with long‑term architecture.
Experience working with HR, people‑operations, or workforce‑analytics data, including sensitive‑data handling, HRIS integrations (e.g., Dayforce, Culture Amp, etc.), and secure data‑exchange patterns.
Demonstrated ability to build or support platforms involving employee lifecycle data, compensation structures, organizational hierarchies, and talent‑management workflows.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure, including infrastructure‑as‑code and cloud‑native services.
Experience with modern data engineering stacks including Snowflake, PowerBI, and analytical data platforms.
Prior experience supporting HR operations technology platforms.
Working knowledge of HR Information Systems platforms.
Experience integrating HR data with enterprise analytics, financial systems, or operational platforms to support firm‑wide reporting, compliance, and workforce insights.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior business leaders and align technology delivery with investment, operational, and people‑strategy priorities.

jobs.title: Director of Production Engineering
jobs.text:
Director of Production Engineering
Remote, United States
About this Position
Are you passionate about building the reliability, automation, and security foundations that let engineering teams move fast with confidence? At Legion, we are seeking a Director of Engineering, DevOps & SRE to lead the teams responsible for the availability, scalability, and security of our production environment. Our production infrastructure runs on AWS, leveraging services such as EKS, RDS, and a broad set of AWS-native technologies. You will partner closely with engineering and IT to build resilient systems, drive operational excellence, and ensure our platform meets the highest standards of security and compliance.
This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll spend ~20-30% of your time contributing directly to architecture, tooling, and incident response, and the rest driving vision, roadmap, and cross-team execution.
Responsibilities
Hire and build a globally-distributed DevOps/SRE engineering team. Recruit, mentor, and manage engineers, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Own the reliability and infrastructure roadmap for our AWS-based production environment, including EKS, RDS, and related AWS services, ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency.
Lead the organization's security operations (SecOps) practice, including vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation, to proactively identify and resolve security issues before they impact customers.
Define and drive engineering OKRs for infrastructure reliability, automation, and security, and track progress against measurable outcomes.
Champion observability and alerting best practices (e.g., Datadog), including automating alert triage and response to reduce mean-time-to-resolution.
Solid understanding of agentic AI infrastructure and how AI agentic workflows apply to SDLC and DevOps processes (e.g., automated investigation, remediation, and PR-generation pipelines).
Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automation practices to increase engineering velocity and reduce operational toil.
Work closely with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure standards, access controls, tooling, and compliance requirements across the organization.
Ensure the platform meets the highest standards of security, compliance, and data protection; implement and maintain robust security controls and audit-readiness.
Lead and participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation, working with SRE and development teams to meet and exceed availability goals.
Stay current on cloud, DevOps, and security best practices, and provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the broader engineering organization.
Required Qualifications
8-12 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or production infrastructure roles, including people management experience.
Deep hands-on experience running production workloads on AWS, including EKS (Kubernetes), RDS, and other core AWS services (e.g., VPC, IAM, Lambda, S3).
Demonstrated experience running security operations (SecOps) — vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation of production security issues.
5+ years of experience leveraging observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) to drive reliability, performance, and alerting improvements.
Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD automation.
Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or Bash, with day-to-day use of Git and test automation pipelines.
Hands-on experience operating Linux/Unix production platforms (Amazon Linux, Ubuntu, RHEL/CentOS).
Proven track record partnering cross-functionally with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure, tooling, and security standards.
Demonstrated experience leading incident management and on-call practices for high-availability production systems.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; Master's degree preferred.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with major cloud providers beyond AWS, such as Google Cloud Platform or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, CKS).
Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA.
3+ years of experience with Kubernetes or other containerization/orchestration platforms at scale.
Experience with Kubernetes-native delivery tooling, including Argo Workflows and Helm.
5+ years of experience leading teams in an agile/scrum environment.
Experience building or scaling automated investigation and remediation pipelines for production error classes.
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
Salary Range: Base Salary Range $220,000 - $265,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and the internal equity for the same position within the company.
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
$0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment
401k plan
Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
Parental Leave
Equity
Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
Monthly Lunch on Legion
ABOUT LEGION
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
For more information, visit https://legion.co
EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.
DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

blocks.text: Director of Production Engineering
Remote, United States
About this Position

Are you passionate about building the reliability, automation, and security foundations that let engineering teams move fast with confidence? At Legion, we are seeking a Director of Engineering, DevOps & SRE to lead the teams responsible for the availability, scalability, and security of our production environment. Our production infrastructure runs on AWS, leveraging services such as EKS, RDS, and a broad set of AWS-native technologies. You will partner closely with engineering and IT to build resilient systems, drive operational excellence, and ensure our platform meets the highest standards of security and compliance.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll spend ~20-30% of your time contributing directly to architecture, tooling, and incident response, and the rest driving vision, roadmap, and cross-team execution.
Responsibilities

items: Hire and build a globally-distributed DevOps/SRE engineering team. Recruit, mentor, and manage engineers, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Own the reliability and infrastructure roadmap for our AWS-based production environment, including EKS, RDS, and related AWS services, ensuring scalability, high availability, and cost efficiency.

Lead the organization's security operations (SecOps) practice, including vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and remediation, to proactively identify and resolve security issues before they impact customers.
Define and drive engineering OKRs for infrastructure reliability, automation, and security, and track progress against measurable outcomes.
Champion observability and alerting best practices (e.g., Datadog), including automating alert triage and response to reduce mean-time-to-resolution.
Solid understanding of agentic AI infrastructure and how AI agentic workflows apply to SDLC and DevOps processes (e.g., automated investigation, remediation, and PR-generation pipelines).
Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automation practices to increase engineering velocity and reduce operational toil.
Work closely with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure standards, access controls, tooling, and compliance requirements across the organization.
Ensure the platform meets the highest standards of security, compliance, and data protection; implement and maintain robust security controls and audit-readiness.
Lead and participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation, working with SRE and development teams to meet and exceed availability goals.
Stay current on cloud, DevOps, and security best practices, and provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the broader engineering organization.

blocks.text: Required Qualifications

items: 8-12 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or production infrastructure roles, including people management experience.
Deep hands-on experience running production workloads on AWS, including EKS (Kubernetes), RDS, and other core AWS services (e.g., VPC, IAM, Lambda, S3).
Demonstrated experience running security operations (SecOps) — vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation of production security issues.
5+ years of experience leveraging observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana) to drive reliability, performance, and alerting improvements.
Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD automation.
Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or Bash, with day-to-day use of Git and test automation pipelines.
Hands-on experience operating Linux/Unix production platforms (Amazon Linux, Ubuntu, RHEL/CentOS).
Proven track record partnering cross-functionally with engineering and IT teams to align on infrastructure, tooling, and security standards.
Demonstrated experience leading incident management and on-call practices for high-availability production systems.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; Master's degree preferred.

blocks.text: Preferred Qualifications

items: Experience with major cloud providers beyond AWS, such as Google Cloud Platform or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, AWS Security Specialty, CKS).
Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA.
3+ years of experience with Kubernetes or other containerization/orchestration platforms at scale.
Experience with Kubernetes-native delivery tooling, including Argo Workflows and Helm.
5+ years of experience leading teams in an agile/scrum environment.
Experience building or scaling automated investigation and remediation pipelines for production error classes.

blocks.text: ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Zignal Labs
Zignal Labs is at the forefront of real-time media intelligence and AI analytics, supporting mission-critical defense and intelligence programs worldwide. Our platform ingests massive volumes of social media, news, forums, broadcast, and online content, transforming them into curated datasets and actionable insights for national security, defense, and commercial missions.
Fully remote, with Silicon Valley roots and team members in over 20 states, Zignal serves customers around the world. Learn more at .
About the Role
We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead and scale our AI and Engineering teams. In this role, you will drive technical strategy, application architecture, and delivery across our frontend, backend, and AI feature teams. You will transform complex machine learning models and multi-source analytics into intuitive, enterprise-ready web applications for national security operations.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, mentor, and scale software teams across full stack engineering, core application services, data engineering, and AI/ML integrations
Architect and drive the execution of user-facing web platforms, ensuring seamless integration between UI workflows, backend APIs, and real-time AI model inference
Collaborate with Data Science and Product teams to operationalize and productize advanced AI capabilities (e.g., LLMs, computer vision, narrative detection) within high-performance, enterprise-ready features.
Drive the transformation of our engineering lifecycle to an AI-first SDLC, leveraging AI-assisted coding, automated code review, and intelligent CI/CD pipelines to accelerate developer velocity.
Implement an AI-driven automated QA strategy, utilizing generative testing and self-healing test suites to increase release confidence and reduce manual regression cycles.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in engineering leadership managing full stack and software development teams; Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Proven track record of shipping and scaling enterprise-grade full stack web applications that leverage production AI/ML services
Proven experience leading the implementation of AI-augmented development environments and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong understanding of shifting quality left through AI-driven automated testing strategies.
Demonstrated experience operationalizing AI-driven services and integrating machine learning models into robust, scalable full-stack web applications.
Demonstrated success recruiting, hiring, and retaining top-tier remote engineering talent
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting software delivery for DoD, IC, or defense contractor environments
Why Join Zignal Labs?
At Zignal, you will work at the forefront of AI data intelligence, supporting mission-critical defense and intelligence programs worldwide. You will play a pivotal role in shaping our engineering culture, leading top-tier software talent, and building the intuitive full stack applications that power national security decisions.

Director of Product Management – Portals and AI Experience
About the Business
LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at
About the Role
LexisNexis Risk Solutions delivers data, analytics, and technology that help customers make informed decisions and improve outcomes across a range of risk-related workflows.
We are seeking a Director of Product Management to lead the evolution of our digital experience platform. This leader will shape how customers interact with our solutions, driving innovation in user experience, workflow efficiency, and intelligent automation.
This role is ideal for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of enterprise software and consumer-grade experience design. You will work closely with cross-functional teams across design, engineering, and data science to deliver differentiated, high-impact solutions that enhance customer productivity and satisfaction.
Candidate can be remote in the continental US or hybrid from one of our US offices.
Responsibilities
Define Product Vision and Strategy
Develop and communicate a multi-year vision for our digital experience platform.
Drive initiatives that simplify how customers access insights, complete workflows, and achieve outcomes.
Identify opportunities to modernize user interactions and improve end-to-end experiences, with an AI-forward philosophy for both assisting users and leveraging agentic workflows.
Lead Product Discovery
Establish continuous customer discovery as a core operating model.
Spend significant time with investigators, fraud analysts, collections professionals, compliance teams, and other users to uncover unmet needs and opportunities.
Build a deep understanding of customer jobs-to-be-done, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes.
Work closely with our User Experience and UI Design teams to validate opportunities through rapid experimentation, prototyping, and iterative learning.
Deliver Innovation with AI and Automation
Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to enhance user productivity and efficiency.
Partner with technical teams to bring new capabilities from concept to production.
Ensure solutions meet requirements related to security, compliance, and trust.
Deliver Exceptional User Experiences
Champion world-class user experience design and interaction design.
Bring consumer-grade usability, simplicity, and delight to complex investigative workflows.
Raise the organization's standards for design quality, product craftsmanship, and customer-centricity.
Ensure products are intuitive, beautiful, and outcome focused.
Lead Through Product Operating Principles
Promote outcome-oriented product management and evidence-based decision-making.
Empower cross-functional teams to solve customer problems.
Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement with focus on understanding customers and their problems.
What We're Looking For
Requirements
10+ years of product management experience, including leadership of product managers and cross-functional teams.
Experience leading significant digital product transformations.
Demonstrated track record of shipping beautiful, highly usable products — you care deeply about aesthetics, interaction design, and reducing friction.
Demonstrated success introducing AI-powered products, workflows, copilots, or intelligent automation capabilities.
Deep expertise in product discovery, customer research, experimentation, and product strategy.
Experience defining and measuring customer outcomes rather than feature delivery.
Preferred Experience
Experience in consumer technology, digital platforms, marketplaces, fintech, productivity software, or other organizations known for exceptional user experiences. B2C background highly preferred.
Familiarity with fraud prevention, financial crime, compliance, collections, investigative workflows, or adjacent domains.
Experience applying modern product operating principles inspired by leading product organizations.
Experience working with generative AI, large language models, agentic systems, and conversational interfaces.
Background partnering closely with UX research and product design organizations.
Ability to travel 5-10%
