jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
Our Story
At Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline. Our software empowers sales associates to have more personal, effective conversations with customers through AI-powered tools that drive measurable revenue.
Despite retail being 6x larger than eCommerce, most platforms overlook the in-store experience. We’re changing that. We’re helping brands like Reformation, Gorjana, Glossier, Frame, and Mizzen+Main turn real customer relationships into growth powered by intuitive software and thoughtful design.
With rapid growth ahead, we’re scaling our Product organization and need a steady, capable leader to help us get there.
Position Overview
Endear is hiring a VP of Product to take day-to-day ownership of the product organization during a pivotal phase of growth. Partnering closely with leadership on long-term vision, you will translate company goals into clear product priorities and lead execution against the agreed mission.
This role is central to making Endear’s product team AI-native. You will improve how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, make decisions, and accelerate shipping—not just shape Endear’s AI product direction. You will bring a zero-to-one mindset, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and build the operating model needed for product, design, and engineering to move faster together.
This is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You will lead and develop the product team, partner deeply with Design and Engineering, assess team structure and resourcing, and hire additional product talent as needed. We are looking for someone who has shipped products in lean environments, can go deep when needed, and knows how to build scalable processes without adding unnecessary overhead
What You’ll Accomplish
In your first 6 months, you’ll…
Take clear day-to-day ownership of product, turning company priorities into an actionable roadmap and measurable outcomes.
Align leadership, Product, Design, and Engineering around a cohesive product vision and a clear path to execution.
Assess the current team, operating model, and resourcing; identify what needs to change to improve speed, ownership, and accountability.
Establish stronger product rituals and decision-making systems that help the team ship with more focus and less friction.
Build practical customer-feedback loops into roadmap and prioritization decisions.
Make the product organization more AI-native by improving how the team uses AI to frame problems, prototype, prioritize, and ship.
In your first year, you’ll…
Build a high-performing product organization with clear ownership, strong psychological safety, and the right team structure for the next stage.
Hire and develop product talent, including an additional PM, while evaluating the capabilities and resourcing the team needs.
Deliver high-impact roadmap work that improves product adoption and business outcomes.
Establish scalable planning, execution, and communication systems that keep teams aligned as Endear grows.
Help shape and execute Endear’s AI product direction while ensuring the team can move quickly from idea to shipped product.
You’ll Thrive in This Role If…
You Have Experience With
Leading product at a lean B2B SaaS company, with both strategic ownership and hands-on execution.
Turning company goals into clear product priorities, success metrics, and decisions.
Building and communicating product vision, then translating it into focused execution.
Partnering deeply with Design and Engineering, including going technical when needed.
Leading, mentoring, and growing Product Managers while maintaining a high bar for delivery.
Building product processes that add clarity and speed without creating unnecessary overhead.
Using AI tools in day-to-day product work—from research and problem framing to prototyping, prioritization, and execution.
Transforming how product teams work in an AI-native environment.
Using customer feedback, usage data, and market insight to guide roadmap decisions.
Operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving growth-stage environments.
Align With What We Value
At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:
Customer First: Prioritize real customer problems over internal assumptions. Use research, feedback, and product data to ensure the roadmap delivers meaningful value to merchants and sales associates.
Take Ownership: Own outcomes, not just outputs. Take responsibility for product direction, team performance, and the impact product decisions have on the business.
Enable Autonomy: Build clear product strategy, priorities, and processes so product, design, and engineering teams can execute with confidence and independence.
Under Promise, Over Deliver: Set realistic expectations for product initiatives and deliver consistent, measurable improvements that build trust with customers and the team.
Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: Balance thoughtful strategy with a bias toward action. Test ideas, iterate quickly, and ship improvements that create real business impact.
About the Team
You’ll partner most closely with:
Executive Team: Align product strategy with company goals, provide visibility into roadmap priorities and performance, and partner on key decisions around growth and product direction.
Head of Product Design: strategy, feedback, and design system development
Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, and merchant needs
Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration
We’re a small team with big ambitions—collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.
Our Hiring Process
Recruiter Screen
Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager + Co-Founder
Panel interview with key Product and Engineering team members
Final conversation with Co-Founder + CTO
Offer 🎉
Compensation & Benefits
Base Salary: $190+240k
Equity Eligible
Fully remote team
Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
Co-working or home office stipend
Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation
Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry
Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box
If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. We care about skills, motivation, and how you think more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.title: Data Governance and Analytics Architecture Director
jobs.text:
Overview
The Data Governance & Analytics Architecture Director is a leader within the Health Enablement Analytics organization responsible for ensuring all data, analytics, and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, standardized, and governed foundation. This role serves as a subject matter expert for data governance, analytics architecture, and AI/ML best practices across Health Enablement. This role provides advisory leadership, technical guidance, and architecture standards to ensure analytics and innovation efforts are aligned to enterprise data strategy and built in a scalable, sustainable manner.
This position operates as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Analytics, and Reporting teams helping shape how solutions are designed and delivered; enabling Health Enablement Analytics to operate as a reliable, high-impact capability, driving measurable business outcomes.
Responsibilities
Data Governance & Standards
Contribute to the development of data governance standards, and best practices across analytics and reporting.
Provide guidance on data quality, consistency, and appropriate use of enterprise data assets.
Support the standardization of data models, business metrics, and reusable data assets to improve consistency and efficiency.
Implement governance frameworks, ensuring policies are embedded into day-to-day data and analytics workflows.
Establish clear data stewardship accountability across business and analytics teams.
Oversee data quality processes, metadata management, and governance monitoring to ensure sustained data integrity.
Serve as the primary point of contact for Information Governance, data risk, and compliance alignment.
Data Architecture & Platform Alignment
Drive standardization of data assets to reduce fragmentation and enable consistent cross-domain insights.
Provide subject matter expertise on analytics architecture across BI, reporting, and advanced analytics.
Partner with teams to ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise data platforms and long‑term strategy.
Recommend architectural approaches that support scalability, interoperability, and reuse.
Technical Enablement & Scalable Delivery
Serve as a technical SME contributing to AI/ML standards and best practices.
Provide guidance to ensure analytic and AI solutions are designed for scalability and sustainability.
Advise on approaches to monitor performance, manage technical debt, and identify architectural risk.
Assess technical feasibility of innovation and analytics initiatives and provide input on viable solution approaches.
Consult on solution design to support production readiness and scalability.
Identify constraints in data or architecture and propose practical workarounds to enable business outcomes.
Define guardrails that enable faster decision-making and reduce execution friction.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
Serve as a consultative technical partner to Innovation, Data Science, Reporting, and broader enterprise teams.
Translate business and analytics requirements into technical solutions and executable designs.
Provide input on feasibility, architecture, and standards to support solution development.
Collaborate across teams to ensure analytics solutions are aligned with enterprise direction while meeting business needs.
Contribute technical expertise to vendor evaluations and platform decisions as needed.
Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that is able to assist in employing best in class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field required.
10+ years of experience in data governance, data architecture, data engineering, and analytics roles.
5+ years of leadership experience driving data governance, data architecture, and analytics platform initiatives at enterprise scale.
Proven ability to define and implement data governance frameworks, standards, and data quality processes.
Strong expertise in: data modeling, data warehousing and lakehouse architectures, cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems.
Experience enabling analytics and AI/ML solutions to scale from prototype to production deployment.
Strong understanding of BI platforms, ETL/ELT frameworks, and data lifecycle management.
Experience working across analytics, product, engineering, and innovation teams in complex environments.
Ability to translate business and analytics priorities into scalable technical architecture and design.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making capabilities.
Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment as part of a distributed team with effective communication and collaboration skills.
Proven ability to handle stressful situations, multiple tasks, and deadline Enterprise project management methods and process management experience preferred.
Shares information with all appropriate stakeholders and escalates to director in a timely, effective.
Strong written and oral communication The ability to communicate effectively (clear, concise, and professionally) at all levels within Cotiviti.
Demonstrated teamwork, leadership, and project management discipline.
Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally to drive business outcomes.
Cognitive/Mental Requirements:
Communicating with others to exchange information.
Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
Critical thinker and problem solver with strong analytic modeling and technical skills.
Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.
No adverse environmental conditions expected
Base compensation ranges from $150,000 to $200,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.
Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.
Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.
Date of posting: 08/27/2026
Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 09/27/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.title: Director I, Data Science, Enterprise Data & Data Science
jobs.text:
Description
We're seeking an exceptional, hands-on Data Scientist with deep expertise in data science, MLOps, and building GenAI solutions to join our Enterprise Data & Data Science team. In this role, you'll identify, evaluate, and develop solutions at the intersection of data science, generative AI, and enterprise data strategy—including GenAI evaluation frameworks and semantic data layers. You'll also serve as a community champion, driving the adoption of best practices across a large, collaborative data science organization.
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and evaluate generative AI solutions and agentic systems
Develop and maintain data semantic layers and knowledge graphs for enterprise-scale data accessibility
Build evaluation frameworks and tools to assess GenAI systems' performance, reliability, and safety
Collaborate with other data scientists, machine learning engineers, data engineers, and business partners
Champion best practices and tooling across a broad data science community
Lead cross-functional working groups and contribute to innovation in AI/ML methods
Communicate complex technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Serve as a technical consultant on complex, high-impact projects
Please note this is an individual contributor role
Qualifications
Broad knowledge of predictive analytic techniques and statistical diagnostics of models.
Advanced knowledge of predictive toolset; reflects as expert resource for tool development.
Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely.
Ability to establish and build relationships within and outside the organization.
Ability to give effective training and presentations to management and other groups.
Ability to use results of analysis to persuade team, department management or senior management to a particular course of action.
Broad knowledge of business drivers and market context.
Has a value driven perspective with regard to understanding of work context and impact.
Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. degree (in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other scientific field of study) and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, a Master`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience or may be acquired through a Bachelor`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
Preferred Experience:
Strong foundation in data science and machine learning
Proven MLOps expertise across the complete data science lifecycle
Experience building GenAI solutions and agentic systems
Familiarity with GenAI evaluation methodologies
Experience with data semantic layers and/or knowledge graphs
Track record of cross-functional collaboration in a large enterprise environment
Ability to work ET hours
About Us
Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.
At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.
We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit:
Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: VP of Software Engineering - Platform
jobs.text:
Who We Are
At Firstup, our mission is to improve the employee experience at every moment that matters, large and small. As the communication pipeline for the world's workforce, we now serve 40 of the Fortune 100 companies, reaching and connecting more than 17 million employees daily.
Our employees are experts in the employee experience, workforce communications and technology.
Joining Firstup means joining a movement to make work better for every worker. As the world’s first intelligent communication platform, Firstup meaningfully engages employees at every moment from hire to retire, and delivers engagement insights to help companies support, promote and retain their talent. Our movement has taken root and is evident in our world-class customer base. Now we need your help. Ready to make a difference in the world?
We are seeking a VP of Software Engineering, Platform to lead one of the company’s most strategic engineering functions: the platforms that enable our product teams to build faster, integrate more deeply, operate more reliably, and deliver AI-native enterprise software at scale.
This leader will own the strategy and execution for our application development platform, agentic AI platform, integration platform, data platform, reporting and analytics capabilities, and AI-native software development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical executive who can set long-term strategy, lead multiple teams, develop senior technical talent, and engage deeply in architecture across cloud-native systems, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and enterprise integrations.
What You'll Do
Define and Execute Platform Strategy
● Lead the platform engineering vision, roadmap, operating model, and execution plan.
● Build a cohesive organization across shared services, AI platform, integrations, data engineering, reporting, analytics, and developer experience.
● Translate business and product strategy into platform capabilities that improve speed, reliability, security, scalability, and customer value.
● Establish ownership models, platform adoption strategies, service maturity standards, and measurable outcomes
Build Enterprise-Grade Application Platforms
● Own foundational services including API Gateway, Developer Portal, Authentication, Authorization, Logging, Audit Trail, service templates, and platform libraries.
● Drive a paved-road development model that improves velocity while preserving appropriate team autonomy.
● Ensure shared services are reliable, observable, secure, well-documented, and easy to adopt.
● Provide technical leadership across AWS, Kubernetes, Ruby on Rails, Node, Python, PostgreSQL, and related cloud-native technologies.
Lead the Agentic AI Platform
● Own the strategy, architecture, and execution for the company’s agentic AI platform.
● Build reusable capabilities for tool definition, retrieval and grounding, model interaction, permission context, tracing, evaluation, versioning, and usage reporting.
● Enable teams to develop AI-powered features safely and quickly using OpenAI SDK, MCP, Python, Node, and related technologies.
● Establish patterns for permission-aware agents, grounded responses, tool execution, model orchestration, evaluations, and production observability.
Transform Software Development with AI
● Lead the company’s AI-native software development lifecycle strategy.
● Standardize agent skills, plug-ins, local development environments, templates, and workflows.
● Enable AI-assisted development across coding, testing, code review, documentation, release management, support, and operations.
● Define guardrails for security, code quality, data privacy, intellectual property, and responsible AI usage.
Own Enterprise Integrations
● Define the technical strategy for enterprise integrations and ecosystem connectivity.
● Lead integration capabilities using APIs, MCP, agents, and scalable integration patterns.
● Own integrations with HRIS, ITSM, Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and other enterprise operational systems.
● Reduce integration complexity through reusable connectors, authentication patterns, monitoring, documentation, and supportability standards.
Lead Data Platform, Reporting & Analytics
● Own data engineering, customer-facing reporting, internal analytics infrastructure, and analytics products.
● Build scalable data pipelines, data models, warehouse architecture, reporting infrastructure, and analytics enablement.
● Provide leadership across PostgreSQL, Redshift, AWS data services, and related data technologies.
● Drive data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, access control, and reliability.
Build and Lead the Organization
● Lead multiple teams across platform engineering, AI platform, integrations, data engineering, analytics, and developer experience.
● Hire, mentor, and develop managers, architects, staff engineers, and senior engineers.
● Create clear goals, ownership, operating rhythms, and accountability across the organization.
● Build strong partnerships with Product, CloudOps, Security, Customer Success, Implementation, Data, and executive leadership.
What We're Looking For
Executive Engineering Leadership
● 15+ years of software engineering experience, with significant leadership experience in enterprise SaaS, platform engineering, data platforms, integrations, infrastructure, or AI-enabled product development.
● 5+ years leading engineering organizations at senior director, VP, or equivalent levels.
● Proven ability to translate business and product strategy into technical strategy, operating plans, and measurable outcomes.
● Experience leading multiple teams, managers, senior technical leaders, and complex cross-functional initiatives.
Technical Judgment
● Experience building shared platform services, internal developer tooling, integration platforms, data platforms, and AI platform capabilities.
● Hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Ruby on Rails, Node, Python, PostgreSQL, Redshift, OpenAI SDK, MCP, and related technologies.
● Ability to engage deeply in architecture reviews, technical tradeoffs, implementation approaches, and operational risk decisions.
Strategic Platform Mindset
● Ability to identify repeated engineering needs and convert them into reusable, scalable, well-adopted platform capabilities.
● Strong product mindset for internal platforms, with focus on adoption, usability, documentation, developer experience, and measurable impact.
● Strong judgment on when to standardize, when to allow flexibility, when to build, and when to buy.
Leadership & Mindset
● Hands-on technical executive who earns trust through depth, clarity, and follow-through.
● Pragmatic, collaborative leader who can operate in ambiguity and create alignment.
● Strong communicator across engineers, executives, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
● Passion for building high-performance teams, developing leaders, and creating a durable engineering culture.
● Bias toward outcomes, leverage, simplicity, customer impact, and continuous improvement.
Why Firstup?
Because you care - about people, the work you do, and the connections you make. Work is such a large part of life; it only makes sense to make it awesome.
If you want to engage brilliant minds in a high-growth and inclusive environment where ideas are rewarded regardless of who they come from, join us. This is a rapidly changing space so if you thrive on ambiguity, are hungry for a challenge, and have the guts to speak your mind, you could be a perfect fit.
We offer an excellent PTO program, great health benefits, a casual and friendly environment, remote work, and a leadership team who truly believes in your growth – both personally and professionally.
Firstup is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and to all employees, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, protected disability, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Director, Technology FP&A
jobs.text:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 126 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .
Reddit is seeking a solid, analytical, strategic, creative, knowledgeable, and visionary finance leader to join our Finance team as a Director, Technology FP&A . In this role, you will provide strategic and value-added financial leadership in partnership with our Engineering organization. You will partner with the Engineering teams to drive alignment and resourcing planning decisions, helping to align the needs of the business to the financial plan for the company. This person will be a thought partner, owning and driving the agenda in their area of responsibility, by driving financially responsible opportunities, and improving accuracy of reporting/insights. Additionally, you will be involved in continuing to stand up a financial process for evaluating and tracking Global Technology decisions, including working cross-functionally with other organizations within Reddit to ensure decisions are well-thought through (tax, legal, accounting, audit, etc.).
If you are someone who is passionate about growing with a rising business, values efficiency and creative problem-solving using financial/quantitative metrics, and thrives in a fast-paced, open and fast-growing environment, then this is a great role for you!
Responsibilities
Support Reddit’s Engineering Organization - Partner with Engineering leadership to provide financial modeling assistance for key business decisions including prioritizing resources and investments to get the best ROI. Develop understanding of Engineering related issues and priorities; reconcile those matters with long term forecasts.
Strong Thought Leadership - Bring insights from industry knowledge and your business acumen to show a capability of influencing business leadership to drive results. You will have a passion for improving existing processes and be able to work across teams to achieve results.
Deliver engineering P&Ls - Own financial forecasts, annual operating plan, budget tracking, and long range plan by partnering with various stakeholders. Establishing and communicating information about financial targets on a quarterly and annual basis; identifying and reporting risk and opportunity levels determined for the overall financial plan; providing actionable insights (e.g. productivity analysis, ROI, contractor spend optimization, capex management, etc).
Cloud Reporting - Work closely with our team to track and report our KPIs against our most strategic Cloud Hosting agreements. Continue to optimize costs by working with engineers to balance workloads across our dual cloud environment. Run strategic projects in partnership with program management and engineering leaders to drive efficiencies and accountability for promised returns.
Communications and Presentations – Provides strategic input for business decisions by overseeing the production of complex financial models that incorporate assumptions, expectations, and known risks; preparing presentations and other supporting materials for recommendations.
Talent and Leadership – Develops and implements strategies to attract and maintain a highly skilled and engaged workforce by diagnosing capability gaps; recruiting, selecting, and developing talent
Qualifications
BA/BS degree in Engineering, Finance, Economics or similar quantitative discipline (MBA, CPA, not required, but highly preferred)
13+ years in FP&A experience with 2+ years of experience supporting cloud infrastructure and cloud cost analysis, and 5+ years of people management (role will be actively managing a small but highly productive team)
Must have experience working with AWS or GCP cloud products
Experience working in investment banking or consulting required
Experience working with Engineering a plus
Strong understanding of financial statements including B/S, P&L and drivers for margin.
Experience with owning and leading planning and forecasting, large data sets and sophisticated models, proven proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint presentations and deck creation
Strategic thinker who demonstrates leadership, vision, and insight
Hands-on manager with a strong finance background
Strong work ethic; high sense of urgency; ability to learn and deliver results in tight timeline
Experience partnering with stakeholders across the organization and drive projects forward
Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines while managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
Benefits:
Annual Personal & Professional development funds
Comprehensive Health benefits
Workspace benefits for your home office
401k Matching
Family Planning Support
Flexible Vacation (please use them!) & Monthly Global Wellness Days
4+ months paid Parental Leave
Paid Volunteer time off
Pay Transparency:
This job posting may span more than one career level.
In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.
The base salary range for this position is:
$245,800—$344,100 USD
In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.
During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.
Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Poland - Director of Software Engineering (Experiences)
jobs.text:
About Tripadvisor
The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.
We are hiring a Director of Engineering for our fast-growing Tripadvisor Experiences org. Tripadvisor Experiences (Viator) is the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.
We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally maximum up to 1.5 hours) from our Krakow office.
What You'll Do:
Build and lead a high-performing technical team by hiring, training, and mentoring engineers of all levels.
Foster a collaborative and innovative team culture and champion effective Agile development processes.
Develop project plans, timelines, budgets, and resource allocation strategies, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope and budget.
Show leadership as a hands-on developer in multiple layers of the software stack and data stack. Perform code and design reviews.
Work closely with principal engineers to drive technology strategy and roadmap that aligns to the wider organisation vision.
Work closely with your Product Manager counterpart and the business owner to prioritize product features along with the engineering-driven tasks, striving for a good balance between business results and engineering robustness.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals, commitments, and timelines.
Define and enforce engineering best practices to ensure deliverables are complete, on time, and meeting a high-quality standard.
Skills & Experience:
10 years’ experience of commercial software development
Proven track record as a second-line leader with experience directly managing, coaching, and developing Engineering Managers
Background of working in a product-focused company, collaborating closely with stakeholders to build up a backlog of product and technical initiatives
Directly responsible for giving performance feedback and providing formal career planning to their team
Strong mentorship skills, helping engineers to grow technically and professionally
Solid understanding of the technologies and tools used by their team, with hands-on experience of designing and building scalable, high-performance systems
Excellent ability to break down complex problems into simple solutions
Proven leadership in driving major projects and actively participating in cross-functional teams in fast-paced, dynamic environments
Accountable for high-quality execution, operations and overall team performance
Uses strong analytical skills to identify risks early, mitigate issues and provide contingency plans
Adept at making high-level decisions about product and technical direction, balancing business objectives with engineering capabilities.

blocks.text: About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

We are hiring a Director of Engineering for our fast-growing Tripadvisor Experiences org. Tripadvisor Experiences (Viator) is the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally maximum up to 1.5 hours) from our Krakow office.

Work closely with principal engineers to drive technology strategy and roadmap that aligns to the wider organisation vision.

Work closely with your Product Manager counterpart and the business owner to prioritize product features along with the engineering-driven tasks, striving for a good balance between business results and engineering robustness.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals, commitments, and timelines.
Define and enforce engineering best practices to ensure deliverables are complete, on time, and meeting a high-quality standard.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product
jobs.text:
About Avo
Avo is the leading AI platform for healthcare enterprises, helping clinicians make better decisions, move faster, and improve the quality of patient care. Serving as a central hub for care teams, Avo brings together patient data, clinical knowledge, and AI-powered workflows to support diagnosis, care planning, documentation, orders, and evidence-based decision-making at the point of care. Clinicians today navigate dozens of tabs, applications, datasets, hospital protocols, medical guidelines, and payer policies to deliver high-quality care. Avo changes that.
We are product-obsessed, collaborative, and scrappy, united by a mission to improve healthcare delivery through AI. Our investors include Noro-Moseley Partners, AlleyCorp, Scrub Capital, and several leading hospitals and universities.
The Role
Avo is hiring a Senior Director of Product to lead product strategy and execution across our platform. This is a leadership role and the ideal candidate will work with our CPO to refine, and operationalize Avo's product vision, driving roadmap decisions that accelerate customer value and long-term platform differentiation. You’ll work directly with our Engineering, Product, Clinical , Customer, and Commercial teams to shape what we build and ship fast.
You will report directly to our Co-Founder/CPO and be a key voice in how Avo evolves its AI copilots, clinical decision support capabilities, and enterprise platform. This role is ideal for someone who has shipped complex, technically sophisticated products in a fast-moving environment - ideally in healthcare or with a deep interest in clinical workflows - and who thrives owning problems end-to-end rather than coordinating around them.
Avo operates as a highly distributed organization, this leader will also be responsible for driving alignment and execution across Product and Engineering teams spanning the United States and South Korea, ensuring strong collaboration, communication, and delivery across multiple time zones.
What You'll Do
Drive the product roadmap across Avo’s suite of products and platform infrastructure, balancing near-term customer value with long-term platform differentiation
Translate insights from customers, clinicians, sales, and the market into a clear product direction, turning complex clinical workflows and user needs into actionable product requirements and differentiated customer value.
Translate complex clinical use cases into product requirements that engineering can act on and customers can clearly recognize
Demonstrate deep expertise and understanding in UI/UX design by translating complex clinical workflows and product functionality into intuitive, scalable, and customer-centric experiences. Lead the application of user-centered design best practices, driving usability, adoption, and measurable customer value through thoughtful interaction and visual design
Partner with implementation and customer success to close the loop between what we promise, what we ship, and what actually works at the bedside
Work hand-in-hand with engineering leads to scope, sequence, and ship features - from early spec through rollout and iteration, tracking adoption and engagement and various impact metrics
Drive clarity on requirements and tradeoffs, unblocking engineering rather than adding process.
Lead cross-functional collaboration across distributed Product and Engineering teams , establishing effective operating rhythms and communication practices that enable rapid execution across time zones
Maintain a strong perspective on emerging AI technologies, market trends, and competitive dynamics to help define where Avo product should lead
Contribute to sales cycles and customer conversations as a product authority, helping close and retain enterprise accounts.
Mentor junior product team members and help build Avo's product culture as the team scales
What You Bring
7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead PM role
Experience in clinical decision support, or enterprise SaaS serving regulated industries, a plus
Hands-on experience building or managing AI-powered product experiences, with an understanding of how LLM capabilities and limitations impact user-facing workflows and UX
Track record of shipping complex, multi-stakeholder products and iterating them to scale
Strong instincts for product strategy - you can identify the right problem to solve before prescribing the solution.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you write crisp specs, give clear demos, and can hold your own in a room with health system executives
Experience working closely with engineering and clinical teams - you understand technical architecture well enough to have useful tradeoff conversations
Prior experience at a startup or high-growth company, comfort with ambiguity and the ability to move quickly
Comfortable working across US and Asia-Pacific time zones, including early morning or evening hours as needed
Periodic travel to Korea 2–3 times per year, approximately one week per trip. This is not symbolic travel; dedicated in-person engagement is a core responsibility of the role.
Why Join Avo
Impact: Avo’s products run inside hospitals, helping clinicians make better calls at the point of care. The work is real, and the mission is meaningful.
Ownership: You will own the execution of our product roadmap from clinical discovery through roadmap decisions, launch, and iteration
High Agency: We move fast, trust our people, and avoid bureaucracy.
Great Team: Work alongside a talented, low-ego group of clinicians, engineers, and product folks who care deeply about craft.
Remote-First: Work from anywhere in the US. The company has offices in NYC, so if you’re in the area we’d love the chance to work in-person together 2 days/week.
How We Take Care of Our Team
Generous Time Off: Flexible and generous PTO
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
401K Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future
Personal Device Allowance: Tax-free funds for personal device usage
Compensation and Equity: $200,000 - $225,000 base salary and equity
Avo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Underwriting Technology Transformation
jobs.text:
Company :
Highmark Health
Job Description :
JOB SUMMARY
This job is responsible for leading the enterprise technology transformation of the underwriting technology operating model, decisioning systems, and technology products that enable a unified, scalable, and data-driven ecosystem.
The role shapes and delivers innovative product technology delivering enterprise-level value, integrating workflow orchestration, advanced analytics, and automation to improve underwriting productivity, pricing accuracy, and margin performance. It directly incorporates analytic insights, tools, and decisioning capabilities into day-to-day underwriting workflows, enabling realization of measurable financial outcomes at scale.
This position operates across a highly matrixed environment, partnering with product management, underwriting, actuarial, finance, sales, and technology leadership, and influencing senior leaders across the enterprise on the technological innovation needed to achieve desired business outcomes.
The role demands a high degree of strategic leadership, independent decision-making, and accountability for innovation and sustained business results, serving as the primary point of contact across technology teams to ensure successful execution of technology product development and deployment . Working with the health plan segments, it establishes enterprise standards for tools, data integration, and decisioning capabilities. The role will work directly with Executive Leadership, Senior Vice Presidents and other senior leaders to develop and influence cross-functional strategy.
ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead and provide expertise to technological innovation as part of the underwriting transformation, co-led in partnership with Underwriting, Actuarial, Technology and Product Management.
Leads the continuous innovation of the product technology, ensuring we are addressing aging technology and embracing new, cutting-edge technology.
Sets the technical direction across technology teams to determine what needs to be built and how it will integrate into the broader ecosystem, in alignment with the product roadmap.
Perform management responsibilities to include, but not limited to: involved in hiring and termination decisions, coaching and development, rewards and recognition, performance management and staff productivity. Plan, organize, staff, and manage the day-to-day operations of the team; develop and implement policies and programs as necessary; manage to assigned budgets.
Partner with senior stakeholders across UW, Actuarial, Finance, IT, Sales, Product Management, Architecture, Analytics, Infrastructure, Platform Operations
Drive implementation of analytics, tools, and workflow-integrated decisioning. Oversee development and deployment of tools, applications, and decision support capabilities that translate insight into action and measurable outcomes. Ensure underwriting insights are directly embedded into day-to-day workflows to enable consistent decision-making and performance improvement
Collaborate with Product Management, Underwriting, Segment, and other stakeholders in the creation, maintenance and communication of the underwriting technology portfolio, roadmap, and investment governance.
Collaborate with Product Management, Underwriting, Segment, and other stakeholders on build/buy decisions, vendor strategy, and platform selection, leading the technical evaluating in each. Provide critical input into the business case, supporting alignment to ROI expectations.
Establish enterprise standards for underwriting tools, data integration, and analytics capabilities. Drive implementation of analytics, tools, and workflow-integrated decisioning
Provides deep understanding of underwriting, actuarial, and/or technology/analytics functions and uses that expertise to provide critical input into and shape the product technology strategy and roadmap.
Other duties as assigned or requested.
EXPERIENCE
Required
10 years with Leadership role multi-layer teams
7 years of experience with Technology transformation leadership
5 years of Underwriting and/or revenue generation experience
Preferred
5 years of Actuarial pricing experience
SKILLS
Enterprise transformation leadership (technology and operating model)
Underwriting/pricing/risk management domain expertise
Deep technology product lifecycle knowledge
Actuarial and/or advanced analytics experience
Executive communication and stakeholder alignment
Vendor and partner management
Data, analytics and AI enabled decisioning
EDUCATION
Required
Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience and/or education as determined by the company in lieu of bachelor's degree.
Preferred
Master Degree in MBA, Actuarial Science, Math, Statistics, Analytics, Technology
LICENSES or CERTIFICATIONS
Required
None
Preferred
None
Language (Other than English):
None
Travel Required:
0% - 25%

Position Type
Office-Basedor RemotePosition
Physical work siterequired
Occasionally

jobs.text:
Job Title:
Director, HR Technology & Digital AI Transformation
Job Description:
AtEntegris, we’re enabling the technologies that power the world’s most advanced industries. Behind that mission is a modern, data‑driven people ecosystem—and we’re looking for a senior HR technology leader to help shape its future, and drive AI enabled HR excellence at Entegris.
The new Director, HR Technology & Digital AI Transformation, will serve as a leader for theHR Technology COE, partnering closely with senior leaders to define strategy, solve complex enterprise challenges, and lead innovation acrossWorkday, payroll platforms, analytics, and emerging AI technologies.
If you thrive at the intersection ofstrategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and cutting‑edge HR technology, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape how HR operates at scale.
What You’ll Do:
Shape Strategy & Influence at the Enterprise Level
Act as a trusted advisor to senior HR and enterprise leaders on HR Operations, HRIS strategy, risk, controls, and long‑term capability roadmaps.
Represent HR Operations and HR technology perspectives in complex, high‑stakes discussions that impact multiple functions and geographies.
Define principles and governance models that elevate global HR data integrity, compliance, and operational excellence.
Lead Through Ambiguity & Complexity
Own resolution of enterprise‑impacting issues across Workday, payroll, and downstream systems—often with incomplete information and significant complexity.
Apply sound judgment, deep expertise, and systems thinking to drive outcomes that balance risk, user experience, and scalability.
Innovate Through AI, Analytics & Emerging Technologies
Drive innovative operating models and system enhancements leveragingWorkday, analytics, Agentic AI, and emerging HR technologies.
Use data, insights, and trends to identify root causes, uncover improvement opportunities, and influence smarter decision‑making.
Partner with cross‑functional teams and external vendors to test, implement, and scale new capabilities globally.
Enable Process Excellence at Scale
Design and sustain best‑in‑class HR operations through clear standards, controls, and continuous improvement routines.
Establish quality metrics, service benchmarks, and scalable processes that support long‑term growth and audit readiness.
Influence leaders and teams across regions to adopt consistent, high‑quality ways of working.
What Sets You Up for Success:
Strategic & Commercial Mindset
You think beyond systems—connecting technology, operating models, and business outcomes.
You’re comfortable making decisions that impact multiple functions and enterprise priorities.
Stakeholder Leadership
You build strong, credible relationships across HR, Finance, IT, and business leadership.
You know how to tailor communication, challenge thinking respectfully, and align diverse stakeholders toward outcomes.
Technology & Data Fluency
Strong appreciation foranalytics, data governance, and AI‑enabled process design, including emerging Agentic AI capabilities.
Passion for leveraging technology to simplify work, improve accuracy, and elevate employee experience.
Familiarity with Workday and ability to connect Workday to the broader technology landscape.
What we seek:
Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business, Management Information Systems, or a related field
12+ years of progressive experience in HR Technology, HRIS, HR Operations, Payroll, IT, or related enterprise environments
5+ years of people leadership experience, preferably leading teams in a matrixed and global environment
Ability to travel occasionally, both domestically and internationally
Proven experience leading enterprise technology operations strategy, governance, and large-scale transformation initiatives
Demonstrated success driving technology-enabled change in complex, global organizations
Experience working in a global environment with the flexibility to support stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones, including North America, Europe, and Asia
Experience partnering with senior leaders across HR, IT, Finance, and business functions to influence strategy and drive organizational outcomes
Experience with Microsoft Co-Pilot a plus
What we offer:
Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.
Compensation: $158,500.00-$211,500.00 a year range with actual pay dependent on candidate overall skills for the role
Annual bonus eligible
Progressive paid time off policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge
Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match with no delayed vesting
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs
Education assistance to support your learning journey
A values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence
Company anticipates the application window closing approximately 5 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require Company to shorten or extend the application window

Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.

blocks.text: Job Title:
Director, HR Technology & Digital AI Transformation
Job Description:

AtEntegris, we’re enabling the technologies that power the world’s most advanced industries. Behind that mission is a modern, data‑driven people ecosystem—and we’re looking for a senior HR technology leader to help shape its future, and drive AI enabled HR excellence at Entegris.

The new Director, HR Technology & Digital AI Transformation, will serve as a leader for theHR Technology COE, partnering closely with senior leaders to define strategy, solve complex enterprise challenges, and lead innovation acrossWorkday, payroll platforms, analytics, and emerging AI technologies.
If you thrive at the intersection ofstrategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and cutting‑edge HR technology, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape how HR operates at scale.
What You’ll Do:
Shape Strategy & Influence at the Enterprise Level
Act as a trusted advisor to senior HR and enterprise leaders on HR Operations, HRIS strategy, risk, controls, and long‑term capability roadmaps.
Represent HR Operations and HR technology perspectives in complex, high‑stakes discussions that impact multiple functions and geographies.
Define principles and governance models that elevate global HR data integrity, compliance, and operational excellence.
Lead Through Ambiguity & Complexity
Own resolution of enterprise‑impacting issues across Workday, payroll, and downstream systems—often with incomplete information and significant complexity.
Apply sound judgment, deep expertise, and systems thinking to drive outcomes that balance risk, user experience, and scalability.
Innovate Through AI, Analytics & Emerging Technologies
Drive innovative operating models and system enhancements leveragingWorkday, analytics, Agentic AI, and emerging HR technologies.
Use data, insights, and trends to identify root causes, uncover improvement opportunities, and influence smarter decision‑making.
Partner with cross‑functional teams and external vendors to test, implement, and scale new capabilities globally.
Enable Process Excellence at Scale
Design and sustain best‑in‑class HR operations through clear standards, controls, and continuous improvement routines.
Establish quality metrics, service benchmarks, and scalable processes that support long‑term growth and audit readiness.
Influence leaders and teams across regions to adopt consistent, high‑quality ways of working.
What Sets You Up for Success:
Strategic & Commercial Mindset
You think beyond systems—connecting technology, operating models, and business outcomes.
You’re comfortable making decisions that impact multiple functions and enterprise priorities.
Stakeholder Leadership
You build strong, credible relationships across HR, Finance, IT, and business leadership.
You know how to tailor communication, challenge thinking respectfully, and align diverse stakeholders toward outcomes.
Technology & Data Fluency
Strong appreciation foranalytics, data governance, and AI‑enabled process design, including emerging Agentic AI capabilities.
Passion for leveraging technology to simplify work, improve accuracy, and elevate employee experience.
Familiarity with Workday and ability to connect Workday to the broader technology landscape.
What we seek:

items: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business, Management Information Systems, or a related field
12+ years of progressive experience in HR Technology, HRIS, HR Operations, Payroll, IT, or related enterprise environments
5+ years of people leadership experience, preferably leading teams in a matrixed and global environment
Ability to travel occasionally, both domestically and internationally
Proven experience leading enterprise technology operations strategy, governance, and large-scale transformation initiatives
Demonstrated success driving technology-enabled change in complex, global organizations
Experience working in a global environment with the flexibility to support stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones, including North America, Europe, and Asia
Experience partnering with senior leaders across HR, IT, Finance, and business functions to influence strategy and drive organizational outcomes
Experience with Microsoft Co-Pilot a plus

blocks.text: What we offer:

Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.
Compensation: $158,500.00-$211,500.00 a year range with actual pay dependent on candidate overall skills for the role
Annual bonus eligible
Progressive paid time off policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge
Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match with no delayed vesting
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs
Education assistance to support your learning journey
A values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence

Company anticipates the application window closing approximately 5 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require Company to shorten or extend the application window

Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future.

At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.

jobs.title: Head of Global Technology Partners - Oracle
jobs.text:
Job Description:
The Head of Global Technology Partnersis responsible fordefining, leading, and executing Vertex’s strategic partnership with Oracle. This role owns the Oracle relationship end-to-end, including executive engagement, joint business planning, solution and integration strategy, partner enablement, commercial alignment, and joint go-to-market execution. Serving as Vertex’s senior leader for the Oracle ecosystem, this position works closely with cross-functionalteams,including product, sales, marketing, alliances, solutions, and legal—to strengthen Vertex’s presence within the Oracle ecosystem and drive measurable revenue and product outcomes. The role initiallyleads toa small matrixed team, withanticipatedgrowth in scope and headcount as the partnership expands.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own and lead Vertex’s overall Oracle partnership strategy across product, commercial, and ecosystem initiatives.
Build, maintain, and deepen senior-level relationships with key Oracle stakeholders across alliances, product, cloud, sales, industry, and partner organizations.
Develop and execute joint business plans with Oracle, including strategic priorities, pipeline targets, partner initiatives, and performance metrics.
Identify and drive joint solution development, integrations, co-sell motions, and co-innovation opportunities within the Oracle ecosystem.
Align internal cross-functional teams to support Oracle partnership priorities, including product, field sales, marketing, solution engineering, customer success, and legal.
Define and operationalize rules of engagement with Oracle, including account mapping, opportunity prioritization, commercial alignment, and escalation paths.
Lead joint go-to-market readiness through partner enablement, sales plays, technical readiness, field alignment, and marketing activation.
Identify whitespace opportunities through joint account planning, pipeline analysis, and market insights.
Support the development of new commercial models and joint offerings, including embedded, OEM, marketplace, or other partner-led routes to market.
Monitor partnership performance, including pipeline creation, influenced revenue, solution adoption, and progress against strategic initiatives.
Proactively identify risks or performance gaps and implement corrective action plans.
Serve as the internal and external executive spokesperson for Vertex’s Oracle partnership.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead and develop a small matrixed team focused on Oracle partnership execution, with potential for future direct team growth.
Provide strategic direction and influence to cross-functional teams supporting Oracle initiatives.
Establish clear objectives, accountability, and operating cadence for partnership planning, execution, and performance reviews.
Coach and influence senior stakeholders to ensure consistent execution against Oracle partnership priorities.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Senior-level experience leading technology partnerships, strategic alliances, or ecosystem partnerships within enterprise software environments.
Proven success owning and scaling a strategic partnership with Oracle or a comparable Tier 1 enterprise software ecosystem.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted executive relationships and operate effectively at the C-level.
Strong commercial acumen, including joint business planning, co-sell strategy, revenue alignment, and performance management.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in highly matrixed organizations.
Deep understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, including cloud platforms, ERP, data, integration, and ISV partnerships.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, with the ability to translate strategy into execution.
Bachelor’s degree in business, Technology, or a related field required.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Director or Senior Director-level experience in technology partnerships, strategic alliances, or partner business development.
Direct experience working at Oracle in alliances, ecosystem, cloud, or ISV-related roles, and/or direct experience owning the Oracle relationship from an ISV or enterprise software company
COMMENTS:
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.
Vertex Values: Together We Win
We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.
Play to Win or We Don't Play — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.
Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.
Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.
Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.
Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.
Pay Transparency Statement:
US Base Salary Range: $189,600.00 - $246,400.00
Base pay offered to new hires may vary based upon factors including relevant industry and job-related skills and experience, geographic location, and business needs.* The range displayed does not encompass the full potential of the role, which allows for further growth and career progression.
In addition, as a part of our total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Vertex Bonus Plan (VOB), a role-specific sales commission/bonus, and/or equity grants.
Learn more about Life at Vertex and connect with your recruiter for more details regarding Vertex's compensation and benefit programs.
*In no case will your pay fall below applicable local minimum wage requirements.

jobs.title: Director, Data Strategy
jobs.text:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.
Bounteous is looking for an experienced Director to join the Modern Business Platforms (MBP) practice. This role acts as a trusted client partner and leads teams to drive results for clients through effective use of data to activate marketing use cases. This role involves embracing and evangelizing new marketing, data, and analytics technologies in addition to leading initiatives to improve the competency of the Martech platforms practice, generating ideas and processes to deliver successful project solutions, maintaining a focus on learning and professional growth, leading strategic cross-competency accounts, and providing partnership to client service and business development teams to expand account opportunities.
The Director of Data Strategy will be responsible for the strategic development of digital marketing data ecosystems, accomplishing data-driven analysis and activation through solution architectures integrating measurement, modeling, and martech / adtech to meet client business objectives. Within client programs, this role will create and oversee comprehensive data programs to enable complex digital strategies. This role will be highly cross-functional and interface with Data & Analytics, Marketing, Experience Design, and Technology teams.
This role will develop practice-wide data perspectives, help build the Data Strategy team, and advance the capacity of consultants across the MBP practice in project execution. As a leader in digital data and analytics, this role will also be involved in pitches, estimates, and SOWs for related projects when needed.
Information Security Responsibilities
Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information
Role and Responsibilities:
Leads cross-functional engagements, and ensures cohesive delivery across competencies.
Uncovers use cases and data initiatives in alignment with marketing business objectives.
Conducts data strategy programming, including assessing data signals, KPI setting, ecosystem and readiness assessments, co-innovation studio sessions, roadmapping deliverables, and value creation cycles.
Assesses client data maturity, understands stakeholder needs, facilitates prioritization, and coordinates a strategic data and agile roadmap of program activities.
Provides perspectives on necessary data advancement recommendations, including data warehousing, modeling, engineering, business intelligence, or other data activities to support business outcomes.
Works with delivery pods (channel owners, competencies, functional teams) to harmonize activities and deliverables across the co-innovation program, translating business objectives into activities & marketing objectives, ideating on innovation and outlining the tactics necessary to achieve results.
Provides oversight to Data Strategy team members on complex accounts.
Uses the results of analysis to communicate program success and persuade account and client stakeholders for expansion and investment, including opportunities for accelerator engagements.
Preferred Qualifications:
6+ years of relevant work experience in digital, consulting, or analytics.
Functional expertise with digital analytics platforms (Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics).
Knowledge and familiarity with BI tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar and SQL is a plus.
Familiarity in cloud technologies (Snowflake, AWS, Azure) and their capabilities as they relate to customer, digital, and operational data and digital analytics.
Familiarity with a variety of marketing technology platforms (Adobe, Salesforce, etc).
Industry knowledge of the advanced analytics landscape.
Understanding of data governance, compliance, and privacy issues.
Expectations:
Build and advance a team with skills and knowledge appropriate to be a trusted advisor to help clients see a clear path to overcome their challenges
Maintain subject matter expertise as platforms evolve, including leading development of playbooks and documentation for scaling solutions
Collaborate with internal marketing team on strategic collateral, collaborative case studies, or other marketing materials
Work with CSEs and BD to support pitches for new business or additional follow-on work for clients, especially relating to activation; participate in QBRs as needed
Maintain billable utilization while uncovering additional project opportunities
We invite you to stay connected with us by subscribing to our monthly job openings alert here.
Bounteous is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Bounteous does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. Bounteous is willing to sponsor eligible candidates for employment visas.
