jobs.title: Engineering Director, Application Security
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Founded in 2012 by 3 expert hackers with no investment capital, Trail of Bits is the premier place for security experts to boldly advance security and address technology’s newest and most challenging risks. It has helped secure some of the world's most targeted organizations and devices. Our combination of novel research with practical solutions reduces the security risks that our clients face from emerging technologies. Our work helps drive the security industry and the public understanding of the technology underlying our world.
Cybersecurity preparedness is a moving target. Companies like ours are the tip of the spear in the fight against attackers. Our research-based and custom-engineering approach ensures that our client’s capabilities are at the forefront of what’s available. For companies and technologies that live and die by their security, a proactive, tailored approach is required to keep one step ahead of attackers.
Democratizing security information is essential. As part of our business, we provide ongoing informational support through blogs, whitepapers, newsletters, meetups, and open-source tools. The more the community understands security, the more they’ll understand why a company like ours is so unique and valuable.
Role
You will lead Trail of Bits' Application Security practice: a team of 12 security engineers who perform code audits, vulnerability research, and secure design reviews for some of the most technically demanding clients in the industry.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will personally review audit findings, guide technical approaches, and maintain the credibility to engage with sophisticated clients who expect their security partner to operate at their level. You will own the practice's financial performance, project staffing, and team development.
Your team works on source code. They do static analysis, manual code review, fuzzing, and protocol-level vulnerability research across Rust, Go, C/C++, Python, Solidity, and JavaScript. You need to be able to do this work yourself, not just manage people who do it.
What You’ll Achieve
Lead technical delivery. Own the quality and profitability of every engagement your team ships. Review findings, guide technical direction on complex audits, and step in when projects need senior expertise. Maintain direct relationships with your most important clients.
Staff and grow the practice. Make project assignment decisions that balance engineer development, client needs, and profitability. Manage utilization, identify when to hire, and build the pipeline through the intern program and recruiting. Own the practice's P&L.
Develop your engineers. Create space for your team to present at conferences, publish research, contribute to open source tools, and advance their careers. Identify and remove obstacles. Your success is measured by their output, not yours.
Set technical direction. Decide where the practice invests in tooling, methodology, and capability development. Stay hands-on enough to know what's working and what isn't. Ensure the team's approach evolves with the threat landscape and client needs.
Integrate AI into the practice. Champion and model the use of AI tools across your team's workflows. Help engineers adopt AI-assisted auditing, reporting, and research practices that amplify their effectiveness.
What You’ll Bring
10+ years in security, including significant time performing source code audits, not only penetration testing
Recent, demonstrable hands-on security work (code review, vulnerability research, tool development) within the last 12 months
Experience leading a team of 8+ engineers through client engagements with direct financial accountability
Proficiency in at least 4 of: Rust, Go, Python, C/C++, Solidity, JavaScript/TypeScript
Track record of managing project profitability, utilization, and staffing decisions in a consulting environment
Experience building team members' careers and external visibility (conference talks, publications, open source contributions)
Proficiency with AI coding and analysis tools in your own work
Active contributions to the security community (research, tools, advisories, publications)
The base salary for this full-time position ranges from $250,000 to $300,000. This position will come with great benefits and strong bonus potential in addition to the salary above. Various factors influence our salary ranges, including the specific role, level of seniority, geographic location, and the nature of the employment contract. An individual's specific work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will determine the final offer within this range. The presented salary range encompasses the starting salaries for all U.S. locations. For a precise salary estimate tailored to your preferred location, please discuss it with your recruiter during the hiring process.
Trail of Bits, Inc. participates in E-Verify, the US federal electronic employment eligibility verification program. Learn more.

jobs.title: Director of Product Strategy
jobs.text:
About MyUtilities
MyUtilities make moving easier by helping consumers establish essential home services, including electricity, internet, security, insurance, gas, and water.
Behind that customer experience is an enterprise technology platform integrated into mortgage and real estate workflows. Our products include a proprietary CRM, a data insights layer, partner APIs, and AI agents that automate lead-to-close processes. We are expanding the platform and looking for a product leader who can turn customer needs into scalable products and measurable commercial results.
The Opportunity
Exemplify our Core Values: Grit, Integrity, Excellence in Everything, and are Others-Focused.
As Director of Product Strategy, you will own the strategy and commercial performance of our core product portfolio: the CRM platform, data products, integrations, and AI agents.
This is a hands-on, subject matter expert role for someone who is equally comfortable setting product direction, working directly with customers, partnering closely with engineering, and helping Sales and Customer Success bring products to market. You will translate the needs of mortgage, real estate, and home-services partners into a focused roadmap that improves adoption, retention, revenue, and operational efficiency.
What you’ll own
Set the product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap across the CRM, data, integrations, and AI-agent portfolio.
Conduct customer discovery with mortgage, real estate, and home-services partners to identify high-value workflow problems.
Prioritize investments using clear customer and commercial outcomes, including adoption, retention, revenue expansion, conversion, and automation.
Partner with Engineering from discovery through launch, defining requirements, success measures, release plans, and quality expectations.
Lead the development of partner-facing APIs and integrations that are reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.
Own product commercialization, including packaging and pricing input, pilots, go-to-market planning, sales enablement, and adoption programs.
Establish a disciplined product analytics practice using cohort analysis, controlled rollouts, experiments, and customer feedback.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and external partners to increase product adoption and identify expansion opportunities.
Represent MyUtilities in strategic customer conversations, partner presentations, and selected industry events.
Ensure product decisions account for relevant security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Governance & Compliance
jobs.text:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
Vanta is the AI-powered Trust Management platform redefining how businesses earn and prove trust. As a Director of Product, you will lead Vanta’s expansion of agentic workflows, focused on audit and proof outcomes. You will own the strategy and vision for how agentic features and products can accelerate and simplify earning trust through audits, trust centers, questionnaires and more. You will drive an opinionated vision for how LLMs and agentic workflows are natively embedded into enterprise software and own the product strategy and deliver key capabilities that enable Vanta’s GRC product to meet the needs of our largest enterprise customers.
You will drive company-wide initiatives requiring deep partnerships across PMM, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams. You will help scale Vanta’s capabilities alongside our rapidly growing customer base and shape the culture and processes of the product team, all while growing the talented PMs you lead. This role reports directly to the VP of Product for Governance and Compliance.
What you’ll do as a Director of Product at Vanta:
Set the vision and product roadmap for autonomous audit agents—transforming manual internal/external audit workflows into automated workflows, powered by AI
Own Questionnaire Automation and Trust Centers, turning customer security postures into a competitive growth driver while partnering directly with EPD and GTM leadership to unblock enterprise deals.
Architect the multi-entity, multi-region, and complex organizational structures (business units, divisions, subsidiaries) required to support Fortune 500-level enterprise deployments.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for across trust, audit, and segmentation
Inherit, lead and grow a product team: Hire and mentor product managers while establishing strong product thinking and execution.
Evolve your area’s product strategy to an AI-first approach, enabling agentic workflows within the product and with the outside ecosystem
Be accountable for critical business metrics, including:
Revenue from products and add-ons under your purview.
Enterprise customer adoption and satisfaction metrics.
Collaborate cross-functionally to define a vision and roadmap that balances innovation, scalability, and customer impact.
How to be successful in this role:
12+ years of Product Management experience with deep enterprise product instincts, having built for complex organization structures and B2B workflows.
5+ years of experience hiring, managing, and growing high-performing teams.
A passion for scaling B2B SaaS products that serve SMB and enterprise customers alike.
A track record of setting clear product vision and business strategies for complex product areas.
Proven experience in a high-growth environment similar to Vanta’s size or larger; if coming from a large enterprise incumbent, must have experience leading a fast-moving business unit.
A bias toward shipping and learning quickly
A deep commitment to building high-quality products and fostering that culture across the organization.
Strong decision-making skills, effectively balancing ambiguity, data, speed, and iteration.
Experience with security or compliance products is helpful but not required.
What you can expect as a Vanta’n:
Industry-competitive salary and equity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans
16 weeks fully-paid Parental Leave for all new parents
Health & wellness stipend
Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend
Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office
Family planning benefits
Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting
Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time
11 company-paid holidays
Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!
Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.
#LI-remote
At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.
About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.
Referral Instructions
If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

Set the vision and product roadmap for autonomous audit agents—transforming manual internal/external audit workflows into automated workflows, powered by AI
Own Questionnaire Automation and Trust Centers, turning customer security postures into a competitive growth driver while partnering directly with EPD and GTM leadership to unblock enterprise deals.
Architect the multi-entity, multi-region, and complex organizational structures (business units, divisions, subsidiaries) required to support Fortune 500-level enterprise deployments.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for across trust, audit, and segmentation
Inherit, lead and grow a product team: Hire and mentor product managers while establishing strong product thinking and execution.
Evolve your area’s product strategy to an AI-first approach, enabling agentic workflows within the product and with the outside ecosystem
Be accountable for critical business metrics, including:
Revenue from products and add-ons under your purview.
Enterprise customer adoption and satisfaction metrics.
Collaborate cross-functionally to define a vision and roadmap that balances innovation, scalability, and customer impact.
How to be successful in this role:
12+ years of Product Management experience with deep enterprise product instincts, having built for complex organization structures and B2B workflows.
5+ years of experience hiring, managing, and growing high-performing teams.
A passion for scaling B2B SaaS products that serve SMB and enterprise customers alike.
A track record of setting clear product vision and business strategies for complex product areas.
Proven experience in a high-growth environment similar to Vanta’s size or larger; if coming from a large enterprise incumbent, must have experience leading a fast-moving business unit.
A bias toward shipping and learning quickly
A deep commitment to building high-quality products and fostering that culture across the organization.
Strong decision-making skills, effectively balancing ambiguity, data, speed, and iteration.
Experience with security or compliance products is helpful but not required.
What you can expect as a Vanta’n:
Industry-competitive salary and equity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans
16 weeks fully-paid Parental Leave for all new parents
Health & wellness stipend
Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend
Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office
Family planning benefits
Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting
Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time
11 company-paid holidays
Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!
Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.
#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.
About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.title: (Senior) Director UX, Operations
jobs.text:
About the role
HelloFresh is reorganising UX to work AI-native — practitioners either go deep as platform and skills experts, or broad as generalists who move fluidly across product, design and engineering to drive experience quality and innovation. This role leads UX for our Operations organisation: the part of the business that bridges technology with physical fulfilment, procurement, quality assurance and supply chain, across every market and brand we operate in.
You'll take over from a Director who spent two years shifting this function from reactive delivery to a high-leverage, AI-native strategic partner — including building an internal design platform, integrated with AI tooling, that other parts of the business have since adopted. You inherit that trajectory, not a finished product: some of our highest-stakes bets for 2026, including how we plan menus algorithmically at scale and how we run the internal tools that power supply-chain decision-making, are still being actively designed, not maintained.
This is a Berlin-based, in-person leadership role. Operations is one of several major, Berlin-anchored parts of our technology organization, and regular physical presence — with peers, with your team, and in the room for cross-functional decisions — is a deliberate requirement of how we want this function led going forward.
What you'll own
UX strategy and quality across four core areas of Operations: menu planning and food systems (algorithmic menu planning, ranking, demand forecasting, assortment), fulfillment (production, order management, inventory, logistics, manufacturing, supplier reliability), an internal operations-research platform that runs dozens of optimization models across the supply chain, and the technology backbone that keeps our warehouses and production sites running.
Continued build-out of an AI-native design practice: extending our design system directly into AI-assisted workflows, and using that as proof that UX can lead — not just support — the company's AI-first agenda.
Service design for the internal-facing tools that operators, planners and analysts depend on every day — often the least glamorous and highest-impact surface area in the company.
Talent leadership for a distributed team spanning multiple geographies: hiring, career development, and consistent design-quality standards.
A seat at the Operations leadership table, partnering directly with the senior Product and Engineering leaders for the organization, and representing UX's interests in company-wide strategy.
What we're looking for
10+ years in UX/product design, including several years leading design for complex, operational, or B2B/enterprise-grade systems — supply chain, logistics, marketplace operations, or similar domains are a strong plus.
A track record of shifting a design function from reactive delivery to strategic, AI-native practice — not just familiarity with AI tools, but experience redesigning how a team works because of them.
Experience building or scaling design systems/platforms that other teams adopt, and comfort operating at the intersection of design, product and engineering.
Strong stakeholder management — this role sits at the table with senior product, engineering and exec leadership and needs to hold its own there.
Comfort with ambiguity and unglamorous domains: this is service design for internal operators and planners, not consumer-facing polish, and the highest-value problems here are rarely the most visible ones.
Location & ways of working
Based in our Berlin office, with an expectation of regular in-person presence — this is one of the small number of senior UX roles at HelloFresh where onsite leadership is a deliberate requirement rather than a preference.
Reporting line
Reports to HelloFresh's VP of UX, who also leads UX for two other major parts of the business and reports into senior Product leadership. UX holds a more central, cross-functional reporting line than is typical for Product or Engineering here, reflecting the company's investment in design and experience quality as a differentiator — with visible sponsorship at the executive level.
What we offer
Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.
Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

jobs.title: Director of Product Development
jobs.text:
POSITION SUMMARY
The Director of Product Development is a senior scientific, technical, and functional leader responsible for setting the direction and leading the end-to-end development, formulation, commercialization, and continuous improvement of new and existing products across the Company’s portfolio.
This role provides leadership throughout the complete product development lifecycle from concept and technical feasibility through ingredient evaluation, formulation, reformulation, prototype and pilot-scale development, scale-up, validation, technology transfer, commercial manufacturing, product costing, launch, and post-launch optimization. The Director is accountable for ensuring that product concepts are successfully translated into scientifically sound, commercially viable, and consistently manufacturable products.
Working closely with the Founder & CEO and cross-functional partners including Research, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Planning, Regulatory, and other business functions, the Director provides scientific direction, evaluates technical and commercialization risks, and drives cross-functional execution to ensure products meet the Company’s standards for quality, efficacy, stability, manufacturability, cost, regulatory compliance, and consumer experience.
The ideal candidate will bring significant scientific and technical depth within nutraceutical or dietary supplement product development, including a strong understanding of biochemistry, ingredient functionality and interactions, formulation science, stability, and manufacturing processes. Experience across adjacent categories including functional foods and nutrition bars, chocolate and confectionery products, cosmetics and personal care products, or environmentally responsible and sustainability focused products is highly desirable.
This position requires a hands-on leader who combines scientific rigor, sound technical judgment, and practical commercialization experience with the ability to establish priorities, lead technical teams, influence cross-functional partners, and drive multiple product development initiatives through successful execution in a fast-paced, vertically integrated manufacturing environment.

jobs.title: Group Director, Analytics-First Party Data & Loyalty
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
ABOUT US
The WPP l Ford Team is an integrated operating network made up of a dynamic multi-agency ecosystem that serves Ford Motor Company and its many diverse units around the world. This operating team provides a breadth of marketing experience for Ford across Communications, Marketing, Brand and Customer Experience, A.I., Creative, Production, Media, Strategy, Analytics, Commerce & Technology and more.
Operated under a central leadership team, it draws best-in-class talent from leading WPP agencies including VML (Brand & Customer Experience), WPP Media (Media), GTB (Precision Retail Marketing), WPP Production (Brand Design & Production), Zubi & UWG (Multicultural), and Burson (Corporate Communications/ Public Relations), among other key WPP specialists. WPP l Ford team members work in a highly integrated environment, with direct exposure across virtually every discipline of modern marketing.
This role is imbedded within VML agency as part of the WPP network. At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration.
About the Role
This role will oversee and advise on Ford's first-party customer data, including ownership history, customer journey behavior, and loyalty program activity across Ford Rewards and Lincoln Access Rewards. This is an increasingly important source of competitive differentiation for Ford — loyalty programs generate rich behavioral signals that can meaningfully improve targeting precision, message sequencing, personalization, and ultimately customer retention and lifetime value.
The Group Director, First-Party Data & Loyalty Analytics will serve as WPP Ford's US subject matter expert for first-party customer data, responsible for building the analytical bridge between Ford's loyalty programs and its owner marketing communications. This is a net-new leadership position, established to create a domestic center of expertise. The role will be part of WPP Ford's Marketing Intelligence team, but partners closely with other global WPP business units.
The emphasis of this role is on insight and business impact rather than reporting volume. Success is measured by the quality of the recommendations produced and their influence on marketing decisions — identifying what matters in the data and translating it into clear, actionable guidance for Ford's marketing leadership.
What You'll Do
Own the first-party data agenda
Analyze ownership and customer journey data to identify the behavioral patterns that predict loyalty, retention, and customer lifetime value
Work directly within Ford's first-party data and martech ecosystem — including customer data platforms (e.g., Adobe Real-Time CDP), Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and adjacent identity and audience management tools — to access, structure, and interrogate customer-level data
Advise on data architecture and readiness for first-party use cases: unified customer profiles, identity resolution, audience schemas, consent and preference signals, and the data quality required to support them
Build and maintain measurement frameworks for loyalty program performance and its downstream effect on owner marketing outcomes
Identify opportunities where personalization and targeting performance can be improved through better integration of loyalty and owner marketing data, and quantify the associated business value
Integrate loyalty and owner marketing analytics
Serve as the analytical link between Ford Rewards, Lincoln Access Rewards, and owner marketing communications
Develop evidence-based recommendations for targeting, message sequencing, and personalization informed by loyalty behavior signals
Translate loyalty behavior insights into activation-ready guidance — audience definitions, segmentation logic, suppression rules, and journey triggers — that CRM and platform teams can implement in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and the CDP
Identify areas of duplication or misalignment between the loyalty and owner marketing workstreams and drive their resolution
Lead client engagement and strategic narrative
Translate analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives that enable marketing executives to make informed decisions
Present recommendations directly to Ford marketing stakeholders; this is a client-facing leadership role with regular executive engagement
Support Enterprise Solutions with first-party data expertise on broader customer experience and personalization initiatives, and build the delivered-work case for expanded CX investment
How You'll Work
You will operate at the intersection of several teams:
WPP Ford Marketing Intelligence — your home team, reporting to the Global Data & Analytics Officer, with proximity to the broader measurement agenda (unified data modeling, MTA/MROI, geographic analysis)
Audience Intelligence & Martech — partnering on first-party audience strategy, identity, and activation across the martech stack, including the CDP and marketing automation platforms
Ford CRM and loyalty program teams — your primary client stakeholders and the owners of the data assets central to this role
Platform and data engineering teams — collaborating on data pipelines, schemas, and platform configurations (Adobe Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, cloud data environments) so that analytical requirements are reflected in how first-party data is captured, unified, and made available
APAC loyalty analytics team — an established WPP team supporting Ford loyalty in the region; you will serve as their domestic counterpart, sharing methodologies and frameworks across markets
This role serves as the analytical connective tissue across these groups. Success requires hands-on analytical depth, working fluency in the enterprise martech and customer data platforms where first-party data lives, and executive presence — the ability to conduct rigorous analysis directly, and to present the resulting insights and recommendations credibly to senior marketing stakeholders.
What You'll Bring
Required
10+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or customer data strategy, with deep hands-on experience in first-party/owned customer data (not primarily ad platform or media data)
Specific experience in loyalty, retention, or customer lifecycle analytics — not general-purpose marketing analytics
Fluency querying, joining, and analyzing data with reproducible code (SQL required; Python or R a plus)
Hands-on experience with enterprise customer data and marketing platforms — Adobe Experience Platform / Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or comparable CDP and marketing automation tools — including how customer profiles, identity resolution, segmentation, and activation work within them
Demonstrated experience building measurement frameworks from raw behavioral or transactional data, not just reporting against existing dashboards
Ability to connect business and marketing context to data strategy — identifying and prioritizing use cases, asking the questions that matter, and translating findings for executives
Track record of presenting analytical findings directly to marketing executives and having those findings change a decision
Experience working across and influencing matrixed, cross-functional teams, both internally and with clients
Proactive ownership: the initiative to work through ambiguity and drive issues to resolution
Preferred
Automotive or considered-purchase category experience (long consideration cycles, ownership data, dealer/retail hybrid models)
Direct exposure to loyalty program mechanics — points and rewards structures, tiering, redemption behavior
Experience within a holding company or agency model, balancing client-facing credibility with internal delivery accountability
What Good Looks Like in 12 Months
Loyalty program data and owner marketing targeting are demonstrably connected, with at least one measurable change in targeting or sequencing driven by loyalty behavior insight
Ford stakeholders treat you as the default first call on first-party data questions
Your recommendations have directly changed a marketing decision, with the outcome tracked
A working operating rhythm exists with the APAC loyalty analytics team, with shared frameworks in use across markets
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.
_
$100,000—$230,000 USD
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

jobs.title: Director, Global WMS Software Engineering and Product Design
jobs.text:
Join our R&D Tech Hub in Warsaw
We’re building a new R&D Tech Hub in Poland and are looking for people who want to make a real impact from day one. You’ll be part of a globally connected team, helping to shape the culture and ways of working at our new location. This is a hands-on role in a supportive environment, where collaboration, learning, and adaptability are key.
We value practical problem-solving, diverse perspectives, and people who take ownership. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and help lay the foundation for a growing team, we’d like to hear from you.
About the role: What's in the Box
HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Software Engineering and Product functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.
You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across technology, operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.
The Director of WMS Engineering and Product will work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.
What you’ll do: The Recipe
WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations
Integration Architecture & Reliability: Drive WMS application layer Integration architecture to upstream tooling and host systems via CI/CD pipelines [Debezium/Kafka to Snowflake/Databricks]
Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS
Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate
CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments
Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods
Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership
Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning
Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability
People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development
International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally
Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level
What you’ll bring: The Ingredients
Technical/Engineering Experience
10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment
3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server
3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines
Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks
Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact
Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting
Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies
Product Experience
Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties
Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization
Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh Group better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.
What we offer: The Toppings
Health - You’re covered from your first day with private health insurance.
Flexible Working - We work in-office 3 days a week to align on goals, with flexible hours to support work-life balance and personal needs
Time Off - You receive 26 days of paid vacation each year, providing you time to rest and recharge.
Learning and Development - An annual Learning & Development budget and a Mentoring Program to support your ongoing professional growth.
Employee Referral Program - Our team members can take part in our internal employee referral program and receive a bonus for recommending successful candidates to open roles.
Daily Comforts - Free coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are available to keep you refreshed throughout the day.

jobs.title: Associate Director- AI Product Strategist
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
ABOUT US
The WPP l Ford Team is an integrated operating network made up of a dynamic multi-agency ecosystem that serves Ford Motor Company and its many diverse units around the world. This operating team provides a breadth of marketing experience for Ford across Communications, Marketing, Brand and Customer Experience, A.I., Creative, Production, Media, Strategy, Analytics, Commerce & Technology and more.
Operated under a central leadership team, it draws best-in-class talent from leading WPP agencies including VML (Brand & Customer Experience), WPP Media (Media), GTB (Precision Retail Marketing), WPP Production (Brand Design & Production), Zubi & UWG (Multicultural), and Burson (Corporate Communications/ Public Relations), among other key WPP specialists. WPP l Ford team members work in a highly integrated environment, with direct exposure across virtually every discipline of modern marketing.
This role is imbedded within VML agency as part of the WPP network. At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration.
ABOUT FORD AND THE OPPORTUNITY
This is an exciting opportunity to join the team dedicated to WPP’s critically important client, Ford Motor Company. The AI Product Strategist is the connective layer between WPP | Ford business and capability owners and the central AI team, ensuring that AI product development aligns to Ford's strategic priorities rather than evolving as disconnected, parallel efforts. This is a cross-functional, discovery-led role: it bridges the operational needs of the business (Shopper, Media, Web, Production, Creative SMEs) with the technical build capacity of the AI program, translating requirements into a shared architecture and roadmap.
Ford is in a period of rapid transformation, modernization, and evolution. This exciting challenge is about more than just marketing vehicles. It’s about lifestyle, experiences, technology and helping to build a better world, where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams. Ford is a global company founded on powerful shared ideals - valuing service to the world as much as they do to their customers. After 123 years, this iconic brand has learned to adapt and change, continuously evolving to focus on services, experiences and software, in addition to vehicles.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as the primary strategic interface between WPP | Ford business and capability owners and the central AI team
Conduct structured discovery and requirements-gathering across SME teams (Shopper, Media, Production, Creative), mapping current-state workflows before recommending AI-enabled solutions
Re-engineer and document business processes as a precondition to any agent or AI build — ensuring solutions are architected around real workflows, not assumptions
Translate business needs into clear, technically actionable briefs for the AI Architect and Applied AI Product Manager
Partner with the AI Architect and Development on feasibility assessments, ensuring SME-identified needs are properly scoped and prioritized into the product roadmap
Ensure workstreams build toward a shared AI architecture rather than in silos — flagging duplication, misalignment, or gaps early
Track execution of SME-requested builds through to deployment; manage timelines and communicate status to stakeholders
Partner with the AI Value Engineering & Measurement function to ensure every use case sourced from SMEs is logged, centralized, and routed to measurement
Flag blockers, risks, and architectural gaps to Rachel Beecroft; maintain visibility into AI program status across all business-facing workstreams
Act as a change-sensitive advocate for the business — ensuring the AI program builds with the business, not in a vacuum
Required Experience
6–8 years in solutions consulting, technical product management, business process consulting, or delivery management
Comfortable operating across creative, media, production, and shopper/retail domains simultaneously
Experience translating ambiguous business requirements into structured technical briefs for engineering/product teams
Familiarity with AI/ML tools and platforms in a marketing, content, or commercial environment
Strong stakeholder management skills; ability to build trust with both SME teams and technical product owners
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving program with incomplete information and shifting priorities
The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.
_
$75,000—$180,000 USD
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Trading Risk Engine
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
Our Trading Product Group leads the design of all the products on OKX's derivatives trading exchange, including spot trading, spot margin, futures, leveraged tokens, trading options, etc.
We seek a senior trading product manager to join the Trading team.
The successful candidate will manage the development and delivery of our product, including defining and executing product strategy, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring that our product meets the needs of traders in onboarding and Spot & Derivatives trading experience.
What You’ll Be Doing
Plan and design risk monitoring and risk-related solutions for our crypto asset trading products, including mark price, liquidation system, insurance fund, etc.
Optimize risk control rules, improve the efficiency of the risk control system, reduce the probability of and losses from abnormal events, and increase the amount and growth rate of the insurance fund.
Monitor risks and collect feedback on our risk control system after its launch, and continue to optimize the system based on effective iterative mechanisms.
Monitor project progress and coordinate with developers, designers, market team, operation team and other departments.
Instruct junior product managers to form a methodology on risk control products.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor's degree with product manager experience, preferably from a well-known internet or blockchain company.
Have a strong interest in trading, blockchain and the financial industry.
Solid product design and project management knowledge, especially skilled at discovering user demands through data analysis.
Ability to think logically, work in a team and communicate effectively. Be able to organize and coordinate resources to solve problems and achieve goals in collaboration with different departments.
Proactive, enthusiastic, responsible to our customers and your team.
Proficient in English language, Chinese Language is an added bonus but not a requirement (to work cross functionally with the tech team).
Nice-To-Haves
Experience in designing or trading financial products such as stocks, funds, forex, futures, options is preferred.
Having in-depth insight based on data analysis, with extensive experience using Excel, SQL, Python and other tools for data processing and analysis is preferred.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Trading Risk (Parameter Management & Price Protection)
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
The Core Trading Risk Product team builds the core trading infrastructure and platform-level risk capabilities that support OKX’s spot and derivatives businesses across multiple account and margin modes.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the delivery of trading risk workflow automation, agentic parameter governance, agent-driven execution, and foundational price-protection capabilities. Your scope will also include margin-tier rules, collateral haircuts, price limits, index price, and mark price across spot, derivatives, and Perp DEX scenarios.
You will work closely with Risk Management, Quantitative Research, Engineering, Data, Trading Operations, Legal, Compliance, and regional market teams to translate risk-control methodologies into configurable, verifiable, and observable platform capabilities. Success in this role means continuously improving liquidity, users’ capital efficiency, and the trading experience while safeguarding platform resilience and market integrity.
What You’ll Be Doing
Drive product planning and roadmap execution. Own product discovery and delivery across risk parameter governance, AI-agent workflow automation, controlled execution, and price protection. Translate risk-control needs and operating SOPs into product requirements, priorities, 3-12-month delivery plans, and success metrics; partner with engineering, risk, quant, data, and operations teams to launch, measure adoption, and iterate.
Research and iterate on risk-control methodologies. Research, formulate, and continuously improve risk-control methodologies, including pricing logic, risk-scoring models, and approaches for handling market volatility.
Build platform-level risk controls. Build and optimize platform-level risk-control mechanisms to ensure stability under extreme market conditions.
Drive effective implementation of risk systems. Collaborate with engineers, quants, data analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure risk systems are effectively implemented and continuously monitored.
Drive continuous improvement. Continuously improve the product through feedback loops and retrospective analysis of past market incidents or system performance.
Stay close to markets and users. Maintain regular communication with traders, institutional clients, and market-making teams. Continuously study crypto and traditional financial market structures, competitor mechanisms, and regulatory changes; determine when to lead and when to fast-follow; and adjust product priorities accordingly.
Strengthen team methodologies and AI leverage. Codify risk product methodologies, decision records, parameter dictionaries, and incident case libraries, and mentor other product managers. Design automation and AI-native workflows to improve efficiency in analysis, configuration review, monitoring and troubleshooting, documentation, and product operations..
What We Look For In You
Five or more years of product management experience in trading-related domains. Be familiar with trading system principles, understanding users' trading, and be able to identify risky scenarios.
An AI-native approach to work, with the ability to design multi-step automation or agentic workflows incorporating tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and human-review checkpoints, together with an understanding of the access-control and audit boundaries required in risk-control contexts.
Strong systems thinking and technical judgment, with the ability to work closely with engineering and quantitative teams on real-time, highly available, data-intensive systems and the related configuration, monitoring, resilience, and audit requirements.
Experience in data-driven product decision-making and risk change management, with the ability to define effective metrics and drive continuous improvement through simulation, backtesting, stress testing, production monitoring, and incident reviews.
Mature cross-functional leadership and project execution capabilities.
Rigorous logical thinking, clear written and verbal communication, and fluency in both Chinese and English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and cross-functional teams across global and Chinese-language working environments.
A bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or Mathematics.
Nice-To-Haves
A deep understanding of the trading and risk mechanisms for spot, margin, perpetuals, expiry futures, or options, with familiarity with core concepts including the order lifecycle, margin, leverage, liquidation, position tiers, index price, mark price, and price limits.
Experience working at a digital asset exchange, securities or futures exchange, brokerage, clearing platform, market-making firm, quantitative trading firm, or another high-throughput trading environment.
Experience scaling automation, AI agents, or human-in-the-loop workflows in safety-critical environments.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Head of Product- Contact Center
jobs.text:
About the Role
We are looking for an exceptional product leader to build and scale our next-generation AI-powered Contact Center and Customer Operations platform.
This leader will own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for transforming traditional contact centers into AI-native, increasingly autonomous operations. The platform will combine conversational AI, voice, intelligent routing, agent assist, AI agents, workflow automation, knowledge, analytics, and enterprise systems into a unified experience that dramatically improves customer experience while reducing cost and creating capacity.
This is a high-impact leadership role for a product executive who can operate at the intersection of AI, enterprise software, customer experience, and business transformation. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable defining a multi-year product vision with executives, working deeply with engineering and AI teams, and sitting with customers to understand complex operational problems.
A Day in the Life
Define and drive the product vision and strategy for an AI-native contact center platform.
Build a differentiated product roadmap spanning:
AI voice and conversational experiences
Virtual agents and autonomous AI agents
Agent assist and human-AI collaboration
Intelligent routing and orchestration
Knowledge and enterprise context
Workflow automation
Quality management and interaction intelligence
Workforce optimization
Contact center analytics and business intelligence
Customer journey orchestration
Establish a clear path from human-assisted → AI-assisted → AI-led → autonomous customer operations.
Develop the platform architecture and product strategy required to unify voice, digital channels, data, AI, workflows, and enterprise applications.
Partner closely with engineering, AI/ML, design, GTM, sales, marketing, and customer success to translate strategy into market-leading products.
Work directly with strategic customers and executives to identify high-value use cases and convert them into scalable products.
Define product-led growth and commercialization strategies, including packaging, pricing, consumption models, and ROI measurement.
Build the product organization, operating model, talent strategy, and culture required to scale the business.
Establish measurable product outcomes including automation rate, containment, resolution rate, cost per interaction, customer satisfaction, revenue impact, and time created for employees.
Serve as a senior product evangelist with customers, partners, analysts, and the broader AI ecosystem.
The Opportunity
The contact center is undergoing a fundamental transformation.
Traditional contact centers were built around humans using software.
The next generation will be built around AI agents using enterprise context, tools, workflows, and humans when needed.
Our ambition is to build the platform that enables enterprises to make this transition — moving beyond point solutions and chatbots toward end-to-end autonomous customer operations.
The successful leader will define what this category looks like and build the product that becomes its foundation.
This is an onsite role based in San Francisco, CA, requiring five days a week in the office.
What You Need
Product Leadership
12+ years of product management experience, with significant leadership responsibility for enterprise software products.
Proven experience taking products from concept → launch → product-market fit → scale.
Experience owning a large product portfolio and influencing business strategy, revenue, and growth.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing product organizations.
AI & Contact Center Expertise
Deep understanding of several of the following:
Contact center / CCaaS
Conversational AI
Voice AI and speech technologies
AI agents and agentic workflows
Customer experience platforms
CRM and enterprise applications
Enterprise AI infrastructure
Leadership Characteristics
We are looking for a builder, not simply a roadmap manager.
You are:
Customer obsessed — you spend time with customers and understand their operational reality.
AI native — you understand what AI fundamentally changes about product design and user experience.
Commercially minded — you think in terms of revenue, margins, adoption, and ROI.
Platform oriented — you see the underlying infrastructure and reusable capabilities behind individual use cases.
Outcome driven — you measure success by business impact, not feature velocity.
High velocity — you can move from insight to prototype to production quickly.
Strategic and hands-on — comfortable setting a three-year vision while diving into today's product decisions.
Exceptional communicator — able to influence engineers, customers, executives, investors, and partners.
We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.
Here’s What We Offer
Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.
Innovaccer Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered regardless of any characteristic protected by federal, state or local law including, without limitation, race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, medical condition, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status. Innovaccer Inc. participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility of all newly hired employees based out of the U.S. and employed by Innovaccer Inc.
For any additional information, please visit the below websites:
E-Verify
Right to Work (English)
Right to Work (Spanish)
Disclaimer:
Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.text:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
The Third-Party Risk Management team drives product development excellence across Vanta's EPD organization. This area is responsible for building and improving the tools, practices, and systems that enable product squads to move faster and deliver higher-quality experiences. As Director of Design, you will lead a team of product designers, set the design strategy for the area, and ensure Vanta ships world-class user experiences across your squads.
As a Director of Product Design at Vanta, you will define a net-new experience vision, strategy, and execution for a highly AI-centric workflow builder. You’ll partner cross functionally to align others around your vision and execution, championing your experience strategy to scale your customer impact. You’ll enable Vanta to serve our most complex enterprise use cases while opening up an entirely new class of automation and extensibility across the product.
What you’ll do as a Director of Design at Vanta:
Set the vision and design strategy for Vanta’s Risk product area, helping customers understand, prioritize, and act on risk across their organizations.
Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of product designers while fostering a culture of craft, experimentation, accountability, and customer obsession.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Design Systems, and Go-to-Market teams to shape strategy and deliver cohesive customer experiences.
Translate complex risk management workflows into intuitive, scalable experiences for security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.
Define experiences that help customers identify, assess, treat, monitor, communicate, and report on risk.
Create simple, connected workflows across risks, assets, vendors, controls, tasks, frameworks, owners, approvals, and organizational hierarchies.
Guide the design of enterprise-grade risk registers, dashboards, reporting experiences, and workflows that give customers a clear view of their risk posture.
Lead customer-centered discovery and research with risk managers, security leaders, compliance professionals, and other Vanta customers to identify meaningful problems and validate solutions.
Establish a high bar for interaction design, visual design, information architecture, accessibility, content, and overall product quality.
Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, customer insights, prototypes, and compelling narratives.
Develop frameworks and processes that help the Risk design team make effective decisions, move quickly, and maintain consistency across complex product experiences.
Partner with the Design Systems team to evolve reusable patterns that support a coherent and scalable Vanta experience.
Bring clarity to ambiguous, highly complex problems and help cross-functional teams align around a shared vision of the customer experience.
Define and measure the impact of design through customer outcomes, product adoption, usability, efficiency, and business results.
Help shape AI-powered experiences that make risk management more proactive, actionable, and accessible while applying sound judgment around trust, transparency, and responsible use of AI.
Represent Design in leadership discussions, planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums.
Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, mentoring leaders and designers, and strengthening how Vanta approaches product design.
Working AI-natively: uses AI tools throughout the design process, and has shipped designs for non-deterministic, AI-powered experiences (chat, agentic modalities, etc).
How to be successful in this role:
10+ years of experience designing digital products, including significant experience leading product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
4+ years of experience managing and developing product designers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
Experience setting design direction for a product area and translating company strategy into clear team priorities and outcomes.
A track record of designing intuitive workflows for complex, data-rich, or highly configurable products.
Strong product thinking and systems thinking, with the ability to understand relationships across interconnected objects, users, workflows, and business processes.
Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver high-quality products.
A deep understanding of customer-centered design practices, including qualitative research, journey mapping, prototyping, usability testing, and iterative product development.
Strong interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful and high-quality work.
Experience designing products in risk management, cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.
Familiarity with design systems and experience creating scalable patterns that support consistency across a growing product.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executives, cross-functional partners, and customers.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.
A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to build trust, encourage diverse perspectives, and bring teams together around a shared vision.
A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.
Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.
Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results.
Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.
What you can expect as a Vanta’n:
Industry-competitive salary and equity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans
16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents
Health & wellness stipend
Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend
Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office
Family planning benefits
Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting
Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time
11 company-paid holidays
Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!
Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.
#LI-remote
At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.
About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.
Referral Instructions
If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.
