jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Partnerships - Oncology
jobs.text:
Job Description Summary
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.
Job description summary
The Data Innovation, Partnerships and Products team, under the Data Products and Foundations pillar within Strategy, Platforms and Transformation, enables improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. The Associate Director, Data Partnerships - Oncology will play a critical role in establishing, managing, and strengthening oncology-focused data partnerships that sup-port the US Commercial organization and advance priority business needs across oncology brands, customer engagement, patient access, and field execution.
This role is responsible for overseeing Novartis’ strategic oncology data partnerships within SPT to ensure compliance, quality, business relevance, and effective use of external data assets. The Associate Director will bring depth in healthcare and oncology data, including experience working with or for a data vendor, and will help implement the data partnership strategy, monitor spend and partnership performance, enforce data stewardship practices, and partner with internal teams to identify the most relevant oncology data sets to support business needs and data-driven decision-making.
Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
Implement the organization’s oncology data partnership strategy, including the identification of critical data needs across US Commercial oncology brands, functions, and priority use cases.
Establish, manage, and strengthen strategic oncology data partnerships with external data providers, platforms, and vendors to maximize the value of external oncology data assets.
Apply deep understanding of oncology data sources, vendor capabilities, data limitations, and fit-for-purpose use cases to guide partnership decisions and business recommendations.
Monitor adherence to data quality, security, privacy, and compliance standards for external oncology data sources, platforms, and vendors, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and internal data management policies.
Collaborate with data vendors, business stakeholders, analytics teams, field enablement, access, and cross-functional oncology teams to address data quality issues and communicate corresponding changes.
Implement oversight mechanisms for external oncology data partnerships, ensuring compliance with data standards, data-sharing agreements, governance expectations, and internal policies.
Implement data stewardship practices across platforms, vendors, and technology solutions to verify that oncology data is properly managed, governed, and leveraged throughout the partnership lifecycle.
Track oncology data partnerships and spend, provide performance metrics and governance reporting to senior leadership, and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, improved governance, and enhanced collaboration.
Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand oncology business needs, recommend relevant data sets, and guide teams on how to extract actionable insights from available data sources.
Provide ongoing data advisory support to internal stakeholders, including guidance on recurring deliverables, interpretation of data outputs, data availability, limitations, and appropriate use of rare disease data to support business decisions.
Experience:
Novartis seeks an individual with extensive experience establishing and managing oncology data partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of healthcare and oncology data, including the strengths, limitations, governance considerations, and business applications of external data assets. Prior experience working with or for a data vendor is strongly preferred, as this role requires the ability to assess vendor capabilities, challenge data assumptions, manage partnership performance, and translate oncology business needs into practical data solutions. A proven ability to navigate data-related risks, including privacy, security, quality, and compliance, while building mutually beneficial vendor partnerships is essential. The successful candidate will be committed to continuous improvement in the organization’s oncology data partnership strategy, leveraging data insights, vendor expertise, and industry trends to strengthen collaboration and maximize the value of external data assets.
Essential Requirements:
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 6+ years of experience establishing and managing data partnerships, with a strong focus on oncology, healthcare data, data governance, data management, or related roles.
Prior experience working with or for a data vendor, data provider, healthcare data platform, or analytics organization is strongly preferred.
Deep understanding of oncology data assets, including data sourcing, data coverage, refresh cadence, linkage, quality considerations, and fit-for-purpose business use cases.
Expert understanding of data partnership principles, frameworks, and best practices, with a proven ability to forge strategic collaborations with external data providers and vendors.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to healthcare data privacy, security, quality, compliance, and appropriate use of oncology data.
Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and change management skills in a complex organizational environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess vendor data quality, identify data gaps, manage risks associated with external data partnerships, and ensure the integrity, security, and quality of shared data.
Experience working with IQVIA, Komodo, MMIT, Symphony, Definitive Healthcare, Veeva, Flatiron, or similar healthcare and oncology data sources is highly desirable.
Ability to translate oncology business needs into data solutions and guide teams in selecting and leveraging the right data sets to support decision-making.
Novartis Compensation Summary:
The salary for this position is expected to range between $145,600.00 and $270,400.00 per year.
The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.
Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.
US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.
EEO Statement:
The Novartis Group of Companies are Equal Opportunity Employers. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
Accessibility and reasonable accommodations
The Novartis Group of Companies are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to or call +1(877)395-2339 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.
Salary Range
$145,600.00 - $270,400.00
Skills Desired
Cross-Functional Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Customer Insights, Data Analytics, Digital Marketing, Market Research, Media Campaigns, Product Marketing, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Team Leadership, Waterfall Model

jobs.title: Vice President - Product [Remote-US]
jobs.text:
To help keep everyone safe, we encourage all applicants to pay close attention to protect themselves during their job search. When applying for a position online you are at risk of being targeted by malicious actors looking for personal data. Please be aware we will only reach out via email using the domain quanata.com. Anything that does not match those domains should be ignored and considered a security risk.
About Us
Quanata is on a mission to help ensure a better world through context-based insurance solutions. We are an exceptional, customer centered team with a passion for creating innovative technologies, digital products, and brands. We blend some of the best Silicon Valley talent and cutting-edge thinking with the long-term backing of leading insurer, State Farm.
Learn more about us and our work at quanata.com
Our Team
Quanata, LLC is an insurance technology innovation company that engineers advanced risk prediction and prevention solutions, develops risk-focused acquisition capabilities, and builds/supports a full-stack, flexible, digital & increasingly AI-native insurance platform. This helps our primary clients, State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company, adapt to evolving market needs. Quanata, LLC is wholly owned and funded by State Farm.
As a company that prioritizes an inclusive and positive culture, we believe the core of our success is in hiring talented people — across disciplines — who want to help us make a quantifiable impact.
The Role
We’re looking for a strategic and customer-obsessed product leader to shape the future of insurance through AI-native, data-driven solutions. As the leader of our product portfolio, you’ll define vision, strategy, and operating models that deliver measurable impact for our clients, including State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company. This is a highly influential leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, technology, data, operations, and business strategy. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, modernize how products are built and scaled, and help drive innovation in a highly regulated industry.
Your Day-to-Day
Define and lead the product vision, portfolio strategy, and roadmap across the organization
Partner with executive leaders and clients to align product investments with business priorities and customer outcomes
Drive product lifecycle excellence from discovery and prioritization through launch and continuous improvement
Build and evolve product operating models, governance practices, and portfolio decision frameworks
Use customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to identify opportunities for innovation and growth
Collaborate closely with Technology, Data, Operations, Underwriting, and Actuarial teams to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions
Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing product organization grounded in accountability, clarity, and collaboration
Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and product performance to senior stakeholders across the business
About You
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Insurance, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
12–15 years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, insurance products, or related leadership roles
Deep insurance industry expertise, ideally within P&C, insurtech, or data-enabled insurance products
Proven success leading product vision, portfolio strategy, prioritization, and cross-functional execution at scale
Strong understanding of modern technology platforms, AI-driven capabilities, and product development tradeoffs
Experience influencing executive stakeholders and connecting product strategy to enterprise business goals
Exceptional communication, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex, matrixed environments
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams while fostering healthy collaboration and accountability
Passion for building customer-centered, AI-native experiences that modernize the insurance industry
Bonus Points
Experience in insurtech, fintech, or another highly regulated, technology-enabled industry
Background leading organizational transformation, modernization, or product operating model evolution
Experience building or scaling direct-to-consumer digital products
Advanced degree or certifications in business, product, technology, strategy, or insurance
Experience launching AI-native products, capabilities, or transformation initiatives
Salary: $550,000 – $650,000*
*Please note that the final salary offered will be determined based on the selected candidate's skills, and experience, as well as the internal salary structure at Quanata. Our aim is to offer a competitive and equitable compensation package that reflects the candidate's expertise and contributions to our organization.
Additional Details:
Benefits: We provide a wide variety of health, wellness and other benefits.These include medical, dental, vision, life insurance and supplemental income plans for you and your dependents, a Headspace app subscription, monthly wellness allowance and a 401(k) Plan with a company match.
Work from Home Equipment: Given our virtual environment— in order to set you up for success at home, a one-time payment of $2K will be provided to cover the purchase of in-home office equipment and furniture at your discretion. Also, our teams work with MacBook Pros, which we will deliver to you fully provisioned prior to your first day.
Paid Time Off: All employees accrue four weeks of PTO in their first year of employment. New parents receive twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave which may be taken within one year after the birth and/or adoption of a child. The twelve weeks is applicable to both birthing and non-birthing parent.
Personal and Professional Development: We’re committed to investing in and helping our people grow personally and professionally. All employees receive up to $5000 each year for professional learning, continuing education and career development. All team members also receive LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and access to multiple different coaching opportunities through BetterUp.
Location: We are a remote-first company for most positions so you may work from anywhere you like in the U.S, excluding U.S. territories. For most positions, occasional travel may be requested or encouraged but is not required. Some positions might require travel per the job description provided to the employee. Employees based in the San Francisco Bay Area or in Providence, Rhode Island may commute to one of our local offices as desired.
Hours: We maintain core meeting hours from 9AM - 2PM Pacific time for collaborating with team members across all time zones.
Quanata, LLC is an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
If you are a San Francisco resident, please read the City and County of San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance notice.
This role is employed by Quanata, LLC which is a separate company in the State Farm family of companies.
If you require a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner for assistance.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
👋 Welcome to Hi Rasmus!
At Hi Rasmus, people are at the heart of everything we do. Whether you're just joining us or have been part of our journey, we’re excited to have you on board! We’re on a mission to make evidence-based autism care accessible to families everywhere. 🌍 Families shouldn’t have to uproot their lives to access support—that’s why we break down barriers while keeping the human touch at the center of our work. Our goal? To positively impact the lives of 1 million children with autism. Rooted in a culture that values trust, collaboration, and balance, we foster a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. 🎯 Our Core Values 🔹 Innovation 🧠 – We embrace creativity and seek better solutions. 🔹 Integrity ⚖️ – Honesty and trust guide everything we do. 🔹 Collaboration 🤝 – Together, we achieve more. 🔹 Growth 🌱 – We’re committed to personal and professional development. 🔹 Empathy ❤️ – We prioritize understanding and human connection. 🚀 What It’s Like to Work Here 🧩 Collaborative ownership – We believe the best ideas can come from anywhere. While we have a flat structure, you’ll have regular access to your manager and plenty of team support, we just skip the bureaucracy. ⏳ Sustainable pace – We aim for momentum, not burnout. We deliver continuously, but value thoughtfulness over rushing. 🌱 Grow while doing good – You'll have opportunities to expand your skills while contributing to a platform that changes lives.
📢 About the Role
Hi Rasmus is entering an important next chapter. We are scaling our product, expanding into new markets, and rethinking how Product, Design, and Engineering work together in an AI-first world.
We are moving quickly toward AI-first engineering and QA. That changes the shape of the job. When building and testing get dramatically cheaper, engineering capacity stops being the constraint and clarity becomes the constraint: which problem, modeled how, worth what. Cheap build makes a correct domain model more valuable, not less, because a wrong abstraction now propagates at speed. And it makes commercial judgment the scarce input, because when you can build almost anything, choosing well is the job.
This is why we are hiring a Head of Product rather than more PMs.
Our approach is Human-Centered AI. We want to use AI to expand access, reduce friction, improve quality, and help clinicians and providers spend more time on the work that matters most. But we also believe the human role becomes even more important: strong judgment, empathy, domain expertise, customer understanding, and responsibility for what we choose to build.
We are looking for a Head of Product who can help us build that reality.
This role is ideal for a product craft leader and coach who is also commercially sharp. Two things make the coaching mandate unusually real here. First, we increasingly hire PMs out of the industry itself: clinicians and provider-side operators who arrive with deep domain knowledge and need to be built into strong product people. Second, we practice Domain-Driven Design, and we are pulling lead engineers closer to the domain rather than handing them specs. You will be coaching in both directions: teaching product craft to people who know the domain cold, and building shared domain fluency across product and engineering.
Coaching here is not a soft complement to the real work. It is how the operating model gets built.
This is not a traditional top-down product executive role. It is a hands-on leadership role for someone who loves developing product talent, shaping strong team habits, and creating the connective tissue between strategy, discovery, design, engineering, delivery, and measurable outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
✅ Lead and develop the Product organization. Coach and support Product Managers and Product Designers, helping the team grow its discovery, prioritization, design, product judgment, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
✅ Own the commercial case for the roadmap. Understand our unit economics, segment dynamics, pricing, packaging, and expansion motion well enough to argue about them. Every significant bet should have a defensible answer to "what does this do for the business," and you own that answer alongside the CCO and CTO.
✅ Strengthen product discovery. We work from Marty Cagan's model: empowered teams, product trios, problems to solve rather than features to build, continuous discovery. Build lightweight, repeatable practices for customer discovery, problem framing, hypothesis development, opportunity sizing, and validation.
✅ Lead teams toward data-driven outcomes. Help Product, Design, and Engineering move beyond traditional feature delivery by defining the outcomes we are trying to change, the signals that tell us if we are making progress, and the tradeoffs required to get there.
✅ Lead Product Design as part of Product. Ensure Product Design is integrated into the way our product teams work, helping create cohesive user experiences, strong design patterns, and simple, human-centered tools across the platform.
✅ Carry forward our Human-Centered AI philosophy. Help Product, Design, and Engineering use AI to move faster and think better, while keeping human judgment, clinical responsibility, customer empathy, and product quality at the center of every decision.
✅ Partner deeply with Engineering. Work closely with the CTO and engineering leads to ensure Product and Engineering operate as one team around domain understanding, use cases, architecture, quality, and outcomes.
✅ Help teams model the world clearly. Guide PMs, designers, and engineers in translating complex clinical, operational, and customer workflows into clear product models and product decisions.
✅ Translate strategy into focused execution. Partner with the CEO and leadership team to turn company priorities into clear product bets, team missions, and measurable outcomes.
✅ Create clarity without bureaucracy. Build product rhythms, decision frameworks, roadmap practices, and review cadences that help teams align without slowing them down.
✅ Create roadmap clarity across the organization. Help the company understand where the product is going, why certain bets matter, what is changing now, and what direction we are moving toward beyond the current OKR cycle.
✅ Partner with Design on user experience. Ensure discovery, usability, accessibility, and simplicity are embedded early in product thinking, not added at the end.
✅ Partner closely with Marketing. Help Marketing understand product direction, customer value, launch timing, positioning, and the outcomes our products create so they can tell a clear and compelling story to the market.
✅ Raise the quality of product communication. Help teams communicate clearly about problems, tradeoffs, decisions, launches, and impact.
✅ Build the product organization thoughtfully. Help us define the right PM profiles, hiring bar, team structure, and development path as the company scales.
🔭 Focus Areas
In your first 6-12 months, you will focus on:
Building a strong product coaching model for current and future PMs
Creating shared discovery and product decision-making practices
Improving Product, Design, and Engineering collaboration
Helping teams connect roadmap priorities to measurable customer, clinical, and business outcomes
Supporting product work across core provider workflows, outcomes intelligence, AI-enabled capabilities, and school district expansion
Clarifying what great product management looks like at Hi Rasmus
Helping teams use AI thoughtfully in discovery, synthesis, prototyping, delivery, and decision-making
Integrating Product Design more fully into the Product organization
Creating clearer roadmap communication across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Customer Success, and Marketing
🤝 How You’ll Partner
With the CEO:
Translate product vision and strategic priorities into focused, actionable product direction
Provide thoughtful pushback, structure, and product judgment
Help reduce dependency on founder-led execution by building strong PM and Design decision-making muscles
Turn strategic ideas into clear product bets, team priorities, roadmap direction, and measurable outcomes
With the CTO:
Create a strong Product and Engineering partnership rooted in shared ownership
Align around domain modeling, technical foundations, quality, speed, and customer impact
Help teams collaborate earlier and more deeply before solutions are defined
Support an AI-first approach to product development while keeping architecture, quality, and domain integrity at the center
With Product Design:
Lead Product Design as an integrated part of the Product organization
Ensure design is treated as a strategic product partner, not a downstream function
Embed user empathy, simplicity, accessibility, and usability into discovery and product decisions
Help create cohesive product patterns and experiences across the platform
Help teams move from insight to prototype to validated direction with clarity and care
With Customer, Clinical, and Commercial Teams:
Turn customer and market signals into clear product opportunities
Balance customer requests with long-term product strategy
Connect product work to adoption, retention, outcomes, and revenue impact
Ensure product decisions reflect the needs of providers, clinicians, families, and the children we ultimately serve
Create clarity around roadmap direction so Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation teams can communicate confidently with customers
With Marketing:
Partner on product positioning, launches, and customer-facing narratives
Help translate product direction into clear market messages rooted in customer value and outcomes
Ensure Marketing has the roadmap clarity and product context needed to support launches, campaigns, and growth
💬 What Success Looks Like
In 12-18 months:
PMs and Product Designers are stronger, more confident, and operating with clearer ownership
Product, Design, and Engineering are working as deeply connected teams
Product decisions carry a defensible commercial rationale, and product work is visibly connected to expansion, retention, and segment win rates
We have a shared, documented domain model that product and engineering both use and defend
Discovery is more consistent, practical, and tied to real customer and business outcomes
Roadmap decisions are more focused, better communicated, and easier to explain
Teams are making fewer, higher-conviction bets
AI is being used thoughtfully to improve product thinking, team workflows, and speed without lowering the bar for quality or responsibility
Nikolaj is less pulled into day-to-day product execution because the product team has stronger operating muscle
Product work is clearly connected to Hi Rasmus’s mission of impacting one million children through evidence-based autism care
Product teams are focused on measurable outcomes rather than traditional feature deliveryRoadmap direction is clearer across the organization, helping Commercial, Customer Success, Implementation, and Marketing teams understand where we are going and why
Product launches are better connected to positioning, customer value, adoption, retention, and revenue impact
💙 Why This Role Matters
You will help shape how Hi Rasmus builds product in its next stage of growth.
As AI changes what is possible, we believe the human side of product leadership becomes even more important. This role will help our teams use new tools with curiosity and care, while staying grounded in clinical quality, customer empathy, strong judgment, and our mission.
You will help us move faster, but more importantly, you will help us think better. You’ll coach talented people, create clarity across teams, and make sure every product decision moves us closer to helping one million children through evidence-based autism care.
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
✅ 8+ years of product management experience, including experience leading or coaching PMs
✅ Strong product discovery craft and a track record of helping teams make better product decisions
✅ Experience leading or partnering closely with Product Design, with an understanding of how design strengthens product quality, usability, and cohesion
✅ Experience working closely with engineering in technically complex SaaS environments
✅ Comfort working in an AI-first product environment, with curiosity about how AI can improve discovery, synthesis, prototyping, delivery, and decision-making without replacing human judgment or domain expertise
✅ Ability to operate in ambiguity and bring clarity without over-process
✅ Strong systems thinking and comfort with complex workflows, domain models, and customer ecosystems
✅ A coaching-oriented leadership style rooted in trust, clarity, curiosity, and high standards
✅ Strong communication skills and the ability to align executives, PMs, designers, engineers, marketers, and customer-facing teams
✅ Experience in healthcare, education, outcomes, AI-enabled products, or mission-driven SaaS is a plus
Benefits
🏥 Health & Wellness:
100% covered health, dental, and vision premium for employee-only standard plan (Family can join too, with a variable cost)
Employer Sponsored Short-Term Disability Coverage
Employer Sponsored Life Insurance
Optional group benefits: AD&D, long-term disability
Participation in a 401k plan through Empower
🎓 Growth & Development:
Professional development opportunities
Room for growth within the company
🏖️ Time Off to Recharge:
Paid Time Off: 10 vacation days, 5 sick days, 7 paid holidays + 3 floating holidays for ultimate flexibility
🐣 Parental Leave:
All Parents/Caregivers: 6 weeks fully paid
Birthing Parents: Up to 14 weeks paid
🏡 Work Style That Works for You:
Fully remote and flexible work environment—work from wherever feels right!
Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the Autism healthcare space
📩 How to Apply
Use our applicant tracking system Pinpoint to answer the role-specific application questions. These questions were thoughtfully designed to give you more insight into the role and to give us more insight into you. Please write a thoughtful response—a human really reads these.
If you need accommodations during the application process, just let us know—we’re happy to help. 😊

jobs.title: Head of Engineering - Options
jobs.text:
Head of Engineering: Options
About Keyrock
Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
Today, we rock with over 200 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Madrid, Brussels, Singapore , New York and Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks as well as asset and wealth management. Keyrock is looking to expand and establish itself as a full-service capital markets and asset & wealth management financial institution through both organic innovation and inorganic growth.
But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We have been pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading systems, and champions of its use in the industry. We upgrade Web3 ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
Mission statement
We are looking for a Head of Engineering / Engineering Lead with strong experience in systematic options trading to lead our Options Engineering team.
In this role, you will be responsible for leading the Options Engineering team, driving continuous improvement across the trading infrastructure, and supporting the evolution of our systematic options trading platform. This includes areas such as automated quoting, execution, risk controls, pricing workflows, and production reliability.
We are primarily looking for candidates based in European time zones or the US East Coast time zone.
We are looking for someone who can:
Lead and grow an Options Engineering team of around 7 engineers
Bring hands-on experience in systematic options trading, ideally including options market-making, automated quoting, execution, and risk management
Own and evolve an existing Rust-native systematic options trading platform
Provide strong technical direction across trading infrastructure, system design, performance, reliability, and risk controls
Work pragmatically through complex engineering and trading-system challenges
Partner closely with trading, quant, product, risk, and infrastructure stakeholders
Balance technical leadership with people leadership, delivery ownership, and operational discipline
Required Experience
7+ years of experience in systematic trading, options market-making or low-latency trading systems
Strong hands-on experience with Rust, C++, or C
Willingness to become deeply proficient in Rust, if not already
Strong understanding of algorithmic options trading, including automated quoting, execution, pricing, risk controls, and market data workflows
Experience building or maintaining low-latency trading systems, ideally within options or derivatives markets
Experience working with SQL databases in production environments, with PostgreSQL preferred
Familiarity with functional testing, component testing, and production-grade validation practices
Strong understanding of distributed systems, service boundaries, and production reliability
Strong knowledge of gRPC and experience working with Node.js-based services is preferred
Previous experience with crypto exchange connectivity and/or FPGA technologies is strongly preferred
Leadership & Working Style
Strong team player with the ability to lead, mentor, and guide engineers
Pragmatic approach to problem-solving, system design, and implementation
Able to balance latency, reliability, safety, complexity, and delivery speed
Comfortable making technical decisions under uncertainty
Demonstrates outside-the-box thinking while staying grounded in practical delivery
Communicates clearly and effectively, especially in unfamiliar or ambiguous contexts where clarity is critical
Able to work closely with traders, quants, risk, product, and infrastructure stakeholders
Strong ownership mindset, especially for production trading systems
Our recruitment philosophy
We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
Our offer
A competitive salary package
Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence
As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

blocks.text: Head of Engineering: Options
About Keyrock
Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.

Today, we rock with over 200 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Madrid, Brussels, Singapore , New York and Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.

We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks as well as asset and wealth management. Keyrock is looking to expand and establish itself as a full-service capital markets and asset & wealth management financial institution through both organic innovation and inorganic growth.

But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We have been pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading systems, and champions of its use in the industry. We upgrade Web3 ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
Mission statement
We are looking for a Head of Engineering / Engineering Lead with strong experience in systematic options trading to lead our Options Engineering team.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the Options Engineering team, driving continuous improvement across the trading infrastructure, and supporting the evolution of our systematic options trading platform. This includes areas such as automated quoting, execution, risk controls, pricing workflows, and production reliability.
We are primarily looking for candidates based in European time zones or the US East Coast time zone.
We are looking for someone who can:
Lead and grow an Options Engineering team of around 7 engineers
Bring hands-on experience in systematic options trading, ideally including options market-making, automated quoting, execution, and risk management
Own and evolve an existing Rust-native systematic options trading platform
Provide strong technical direction across trading infrastructure, system design, performance, reliability, and risk controls
Work pragmatically through complex engineering and trading-system challenges
Partner closely with trading, quant, product, risk, and infrastructure stakeholders
Balance technical leadership with people leadership, delivery ownership, and operational discipline
Required Experience
7+ years of experience in systematic trading, options market-making or low-latency trading systems
Strong hands-on experience with Rust, C++, or C
Willingness to become deeply proficient in Rust, if not already
Strong understanding of algorithmic options trading, including automated quoting, execution, pricing, risk controls, and market data workflows
Experience building or maintaining low-latency trading systems, ideally within options or derivatives markets
Experience working with SQL databases in production environments, with PostgreSQL preferred
Familiarity with functional testing, component testing, and production-grade validation practices
Strong understanding of distributed systems, service boundaries, and production reliability
Strong knowledge of gRPC and experience working with Node.js-based services is preferred
Previous experience with crypto exchange connectivity and/or FPGA technologies is strongly preferred
Leadership & Working Style
Strong team player with the ability to lead, mentor, and guide engineers
Pragmatic approach to problem-solving, system design, and implementation
Able to balance latency, reliability, safety, complexity, and delivery speed
Comfortable making technical decisions under uncertainty
Demonstrates outside-the-box thinking while staying grounded in practical delivery
Communicates clearly and effectively, especially in unfamiliar or ambiguous contexts where clarity is critical
Able to work closely with traders, quants, risk, product, and infrastructure stakeholders
Strong ownership mindset, especially for production trading systems
Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
Our offer
A competitive salary package
Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Personal Lines Auto Product
jobs.text:
Description
At Liberty, our Personal Lines Auto Product team partners across the company to build and roll out auto insurance solutions that keep pace with what customers and agents need. We focus exclusively on auto, bringing deep expertise, data and analytics to deliver strong state-by-state results while modernizing how we price policies and the technology that supports them. Organized around four core areas—Delivery & Development, Underwriting Effectiveness, State Management, and Mobility Solutions—we work collaboratively to live our purpose: helping people embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.
It's an incredibly exciting time to join the Auto Product Telematics organization. As telematics continues to become a larger and more strategic component of Liberty Mutual's business, we are scaling capabilities across Personal Auto, Claims, and Small Commercial to unlock new sources of customer value, operational efficiency, and competitive advantage.
We are seeking an exceptional product leader to lead our Auto Product Telematics organization. This leader will be responsible for defining and delivering the telematics strategy, driving business outcomes across a rapidly growing portfolio of products and capabilities, and partnering across the broader enterprise to maximize the value of telematics across the enterprise.
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, strong people leader, and proven operator who can balance long-term vision with flawless execution while leading a high-performing, multi-disciplinary organization.
**This position may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location.**
Key Responsibilities
Lead the Auto Product Telematics Product organization, including Product Design & Experience, Product Monitoring & Analytics, Program Delivery & Support Capabilities, and Product Owners.
Define and execute the long-term telematics strategy in support of USRM's growth, profitability, and customer experience objectives.
Lead the evaluation of telematics program performance, economics, and value realization, ensuring products and capabilities deliver measurable outcomes for customers and the business.
Scale telematics capabilities across Personal Auto, Claims, Small Commercial, and other emerging enterprise use cases.
Own the telematics product portfolio, including roadmap development, prioritization, investment planning, and value realization.
Partner with Product, Data Science, and Technology leaders to deliver innovative and scalable telematics capabilities.
Develop and manage a portfolio of telematics data use cases that unlock value across underwriting, claims, customer experience, and operational workflows.
Oversee telematics vendor strategy, vendor relationships, and vendor investment/performance management to maximize business value and performance.
Drive the design and evolution of telematics customer experiences, including ownership of key mobile app experiences and customer touchpoints.
Ensure successful rollout and adoption of telematics products and capabilities through strong program delivery and cross-functional execution.
Partner closely with Service organizations to support frontline readiness, training, knowledge management, escalations, and customer support experiences.
Monitor competitive trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices to inform future telematics strategy and investments.
Build, develop, and inspire a high-performing team while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Influence and align senior leaders across the enterprise to advance strategic priorities and deliver business outcomes.
Qualifications
Highly developed quantitative analysis and problem-solving skills
Excellent leadership and communication skills
Proven ability to influence other leaders across an organization 10+ years progressively responsible work experience in an analytically driven environment
Previous experience in consulting or call center / customer service analytics in insurance or financial services preferred but not required
MBA or advanced degree in quantitative field preferred but not required
About Us
Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.
At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.
We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit:
Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.
We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!
What we’re looking for
We’re seeking a Head of Product to join our Product team and own the full product vision across our growing AI platform, spanning accounts receivable, accounts payable, and analytics.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional ownership and technical depth, and wants to take a hands-on role in shaping product strategy, raising the bar for the PM team, and driving innovation that connects data, AI, and payments into a coherent product experience.
This role is available to candidates eligible to work in New York or Toronto, hybrid.
What you’ll do
Own the product roadmap across AR, AP, and analytics: understanding how these products intersect and where the gaps create friction for customers and engineering.
Manage and grow a team of product managers and product designers, overseeing product design scope across the organisation.
Work closely with PMs to sharpen PRDs and bring technical rigour to requirements, acting as the bridge between product and engineering when needed.
Define and own the future product vision for Alternative Payments, synthesising market signals, customer insight, and company strategy into a coherent roadmap.
Implement AI thoughtfully across the product organization, not just for workflow efficiency, but as a genuine product capability that creates value for partners.
Propose and establish best practices for how the product team operates: discovery, prioritization, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
What you’ll bring
10+ years of product experience, with meaningful time in financial technology (payments, lending, or money movement) or a vertical SaaS company with large payments revenue contribution.
Proven experience managing product managers and designers across a multi-product portfolio.
Technical enough to read a system design doc, challenge an engineering estimate, and help PMs write PRDs that engineering teams trust.
Fluency with AI as a product capability: you can articulate how you’ve implemented AI in a product org, not just team tooling, but as a product surface.
Conceptual depth with AI technology: familiarity with embeddings, RAG, and agent-based architectures at a level that earns engineering credibility.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to write clean strategy docs and run tight leadership reviews.
Nice to have
Experience managing design across an organization (product design + marketing design + sales collateral).
Prior experience transitioning product ownership from a founder — navigating that trust-building and handover process.
Track record of raising the technical floor in a PM team through coaching, process changes, or targeted hiring.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where the roadmap evolves quickly.
What We Offer
Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.
The base salary range for this role is $160K–$250K, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.
Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.
Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.
Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.
Why Choose Alternative Payments?
At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.
Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.
Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.
Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.
Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.
Want to see what we're actually building?
We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.
Our Values
Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.
Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.
Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.
Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.
Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.
Applying to Alternative Payments
We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!
All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We’re also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know upon being selected to interview.

jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering
jobs.text:
About PSD Citywide
Ready to make a real impact on communities across North America?
PSD Citywide isn’t just a software company; we’re transforming how Local, First Nations, and Regional Governments achieve success and build sustainable futures for their communities. As a recognized leader in Enterprise Asset Management, maintenance management, and planning solutions, we provide cutting-edge software and expert advisory services that improve infrastructure and public services.
Why join us? We are a "Fun-clusive" organization! This means we intentionally foster a supportive and engaging culture where your contributions are celebrated, your skills are rewarded, and your career growth is encouraged.
Ready to influence change? Bring your expertise in technology and data to our team and directly shape how local governments improve service delivery. Apply now!
Job Description
Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and making a difference. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a VP, Engineering to fill an existing vacancy and join our IT Department in a fully remote role (though occasional travel will be required) based in Canada. If you’re passionate about technology, problem-solving, and helping businesses maximize their potential, we want you to be a part of our team!
PSD Citywide is seeking a VP, Engineering to lead the delivery, performance, and continuous improvement of our integrated SaaS platform serving municipalities and public sector organizations across North America.
Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the VP, Engineering, will translate the Company's technology and product strategy into effective engineering execution. The role leads Software Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA) / Quality Engineering, and Systems Administration / Infrastructure, with day-to-day accountability for engineering operations, software delivery, technical standards, quality, infrastructure, talent, and continuous improvement.
The VP, Engineering will oversee the development, delivery, quality, reliability, and technical operation of PSD Citywide's cloud-based software solutions, including Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Maintenance, GIS, Budgeting, and Permitting. The role will evolve the engineering operating model as the company scales, with particular focus on AI-enabled software development, quality engineering, automation, organizational effectiveness, and increasing the speed and reliability with which customer value is delivered.
What We Offer
Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognize your skills and experience.
Wellness Coverage: Enjoy a comprehensive health and wellness benefits package that keeps you and your family secure and healthy.
Flexible Working: Work where you thrive! Enjoy remote work flexibility (specific regional options apply) while staying connected to our supportive team.
Work-Life Balance: Benefit from Flex Hours to manage your personal life and Paid Time Off (PTO) so you can fully recharge.
Unwind Early: Say hello to summer with our popular Summer Fridays—shorter work weeks to help you kick-start the weekend.
Culture & Community: Participate in fun social events (both virtual and in-person) and contribute to charity initiatives as part of our community focus.
Career Growth: Our Career Framework provides clear, structured paths for growth and ongoing learning, ensuring you reach your professional goals.
Job Duties & Responsibilities
Lead Software Engineering, QA / Quality Engineering, and Systems Administration / Infrastructure, building a high-performing, accountable, and collaborative organization.
Oversee the design, development, enhancement, maintenance, quality, reliability, and technical operation of PSD Citywide's cloud-based SaaS platform.
Partner with the CTO, Product Management, Business Analysis, and business leaders to prioritize engineering initiatives, translate product and business priorities into executable engineering plans, and maintain clear accountability between product ownership and engineering delivery.
Develop and lead the Company's AI-enabled engineering strategy, taking direct ownership of the evaluation, adoption, governance, and effective use of AI tools and practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across software development, QA / Quality Engineering, and technical operations where appropriate, including design, coding, code review, documentation, debugging, testing, release processes, systems administration, monitoring, and operational workflows.
Establish, monitor, and communicate meaningful engineering performance metrics, including delivery predictability, development cycle time, team capacity, release frequency, software quality and escaped defects, test automation, platform reliability, operational performance, budget effectiveness, and measurable outcomes from AI-enabled engineering practices.
Lead the modernization of software quality practices, including increased test automation, AI-assisted test development, improved regression testing, CI/CD practices, release quality controls, and greater engineering ownership of software quality.
Lead the engineering technology strategy and architectural direction of PSD Citywide's SaaS platform, ensuring architecture, technical debt, scalability, performance, maintainability, and modernization support long-term product and business objectives.
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and operating rhythms across Engineering teams and technical leaders, including delivery commitments, capacity planning, technical quality, risk identification, performance measurement, and timely escalation of issues affecting product commitments or customer outcomes.
Provide leadership and oversight for systems administration and infrastructure operations, including cloud environments, deployment infrastructure, platform reliability, monitoring, backup and recovery, operational resiliency, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Product, Support, Advisory Services, Implementation, and other business functions to manage the upstream and downstream impacts of increased engineering capacity, automation, and delivery velocity and ensure engineering improvements translate into customer and business outcomes.
Develop and manage departmental budgets, financial plans, resource allocation, vendor relationships, contractor utilization, software licensing, and technology investments to ensure responsible financial stewardship and cost effectiveness.
Support business case development, effort estimation, and resource planning to ensure technology initiatives are appropriately scoped, prioritized, and budgeted.
Continuously evaluate and evolve the structure, skills, roles, leadership capacity, and operating model of the Engineering organization as the company scales and technology practices change; lead workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, recruitment, and performance management.
Ensure security, compliance, resiliency, and risk management are incorporated into engineering operations and software development practices, and establish appropriate AI governance covering customer data protection, source code confidentiality, intellectual property, vendor risk, responsible use, and cost management.
Other duties as required.
Qualifications
10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology operations, or software delivery leadership, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, technical leads, or multidisciplinary software development teams.
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling a multidisciplinary engineering organization of comparable size and complexity, including developing technical leaders, establishing effective management structures, and evolving processes as the organization grows.
Demonstrated experience successfully leading an engineering organization through the adoption of AI-enabled software development practices, with direct leadership involvement in strategy, implementation, adoption, and measurement of results.

blocks.text: About PSD Citywide
Ready to make a real impact on communities across North America?

PSD Citywide isn’t just a software company; we’re transforming how Local, First Nations, and Regional Governments achieve success and build sustainable futures for their communities. As a recognized leader in Enterprise Asset Management, maintenance management, and planning solutions, we provide cutting-edge software and expert advisory services that improve infrastructure and public services.

Why join us? We are a "Fun-clusive" organization! This means we intentionally foster a supportive and engaging culture where your contributions are celebrated, your skills are rewarded, and your career growth is encouraged.
Ready to influence change? Bring your expertise in technology and data to our team and directly shape how local governments improve service delivery. Apply now!
Job Description

Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and making a difference. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a VP, Engineering to fill an existing vacancy and join our IT Department in a fully remote role (though occasional travel will be required) based in Canada. If you’re passionate about technology, problem-solving, and helping businesses maximize their potential, we want you to be a part of our team!

PSD Citywide is seeking a VP, Engineering to lead the delivery, performance, and continuous improvement of our integrated SaaS platform serving municipalities and public sector organizations across North America.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the VP, Engineering, will translate the Company's technology and product strategy into effective engineering execution. The role leads Software Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA) / Quality Engineering, and Systems Administration / Infrastructure, with day-to-day accountability for engineering operations, software delivery, technical standards, quality, infrastructure, talent, and continuous improvement.

The VP, Engineering will oversee the development, delivery, quality, reliability, and technical operation of PSD Citywide's cloud-based software solutions, including Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Maintenance, GIS, Budgeting, and Permitting. The role will evolve the engineering operating model as the company scales, with particular focus on AI-enabled software development, quality engineering, automation, organizational effectiveness, and increasing the speed and reliability with which customer value is delivered.
What We Offer

items: Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognize your skills and experience.
Wellness Coverage: Enjoy a comprehensive health and wellness benefits package that keeps you and your family secure and healthy.
Flexible Working: Work where you thrive! Enjoy remote work flexibility (specific regional options apply) while staying connected to our supportive team.
Work-Life Balance: Benefit from Flex Hours to manage your personal life and Paid Time Off (PTO) so you can fully recharge.
Unwind Early: Say hello to summer with our popular Summer Fridays—shorter work weeks to help you kick-start the weekend.
Culture & Community: Participate in fun social events (both virtual and in-person) and contribute to charity initiatives as part of our community focus.
Career Growth: Our Career Framework provides clear, structured paths for growth and ongoing learning, ensuring you reach your professional goals.

jobs.title: Vice President, Systems Engineering [595]
jobs.text:
D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: .
About the role
D-Wave is seeking an experienced Vice President of Systems Engineering to build and lead a world-class Systems Engineering organization supporting our Gate Model Quantum Computing program. In this leadership role, you will define the systems engineering strategy, architecture, integration, and technical executionrequiredto deliver scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing systems.
You will lead the organization responsible for ensuring the Quantum Processing Unit (QPU), control electronics, cryogenic systems, calibration software, runtime software, cloud services, and system monitoringoperateas a single, integrated platform that meets product, performance, and reliabilityobjectives.
Working closely with Product Management, Research, Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, and Executive Leadership, you willestablishthe engineering processes, technical governance, and organizational capabilities needed to transform breakthrough quantum technology into commercial products.
What you'll do
Define and execute the Systems Engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap supporting D-Wave's Gate Model Quantum Computing platform
Establish and continuously improve systems engineering processes, architecture governance, requirements management, verification, validation, and technical readiness practices across the organization
Partner with Product Management to translate customer and business requirements into achievable product specifications and integrated system architectures
Own the end-to-end system architecture, including decomposition of system requirements into subsystem requirements, interfaces, and verification strategies across the QPU, cryogenic systems, control electronics, calibration software, runtime software, and LEAP Quantum Cloud Service
Lead cross-functional system integration, verification, validation, and technical execution to ensure delivery of highly integrated quantum computing platforms
Drive resolution of complex system-level trade-offs while balancing technical performance, schedule, risk, manufacturability, and productobjectives
Build strong partnerships across physics, hardware, software, product management, manufacturing, and operations to ensure alignment throughout thedevelopmentlifecycle
Build, lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing Systems Engineering organization, including engineering managers and senior technical leaders
Develop organizational capabilities, engineering standards, and technical governance that enable scalable product development across multiple generations of quantum computing systems
Represent Systems Engineering as a senior technical leader with executive leadership, customers, strategic partners, and external stakeholders
About You
Bachelor's orMaster's degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, ora relatedtechnical discipline
15+ years of progressive systems engineering experience leading development of complex hardware and software products involving advanced technologies
10+ years leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations delivering integrated technical systems
Demonstrated success defining system architectures and delivering large-scale products from concept through commercialization
Extensive experience in systems engineering disciplines including architecture, requirements management, interface definition, system integration, verification, and validation
Proven ability to build, mentor, and lead engineering managers and highly technical multidisciplinary teams
Exceptional communication, collaboration, and executive leadership skills with the ability to align diverse technical organizations around commonobjectives
Demonstrated experience driving technical strategy while balancing engineering excellence, product delivery, schedule, and organizational priorities
A D-Waver's DNA
We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.
Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:
We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.
During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) offerings. The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level.
Inclusion:
We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.
The Fine Print:
No 3rd party candidates will be accepted
It is D-Wave policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, local law.
The base pay range for this role is:
$247,000– 460,000 USD

jobs.title: Director of Data & Analytics
jobs.text:
About SafeLease
At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.
SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.
We're a team of 70, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.
Location: New York City or Austin, TX - (Hybrid)
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly strategic, hands-on Director of Data & Analytics to lead all analytics initiatives across the organization. This leader will oversee the full analytics function—data management, collection, insights, reporting, and advanced strategic planning—spanning both our portfolio of real estate investments and insurance operations.
This leader must be able to roll up their sleeves, work autonomously, move fast, and drive measurable impact without requiring extensive support or infrastructure. They will set the vision for analytics and ensure the company leverages data to make intelligent, high-velocity decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Analytics Strategy and Leadership
Lead the analytics strategy, setting the direction for data collection, management, analysis, and insight generation across insurance and investment management operations.
Oversee and develop a growing analytics function, ensuring high-quality reporting, modeling, and data practices.
Translate complex data into actionable insights that inform executive decision-making, operational improvements, and capital allocation.
Drive automation and analytics tooling, identifying opportunities to modernize systems and improve velocity of insight generation.
Mentor and build a high-performing analytics team while still being willing to execute hands-on work when needed.
Data Collection & Governance
Design and execute data collection frameworks, ensuring inputs are accurate, timely, and consistent across business units.
Build and operate analytics workflows personally when needed, including hands-on data analysis, dashboard creation, modeling, and KPI development.
Establish data governance standards, ensuring data quality, consistency, and compliance across the enterprise.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with cross-functional executives (Finance, Operations, Product, and Technology) to embed analytics rigor throughout key initiatives.
Own analytics across a portfolio of investments, coordinating data gathering and reporting across our insurance and investment business to drive visibility and performance management.
Develop reporting platforms that support underwriting optimization, claims performance, distribution insights, financial forecasting, and operational measurement.
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of experience in a leadership capacity, managing teams/direct reports.
10+ years of experience in analytics, data strategy, business intelligence, or a related field.
Proven experience leading company-wide analytics programs, preferably in a fast-moving start-up environment.
Demonstrated ability to operate both strategically and tactically—comfortable working autonomously and rolling up sleeves to execute.
Strong background in data operations, statistical analysis, dashboarding, and data governance.
Experience working with or supporting investment portfolios and/or insurance/financial services analytics.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into executive-ready insights.
Track record of building and leading high-performing analytics teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in insurance operations, insurtech, or commercial real estate investment analytics.

blocks.text: About SafeLease

At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 70, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible.
