jobs.text:
Dynata is seeking a Vice Presidentof Data Platform Products to lead the strategy, development, and adoption ofDynata'snext-generation data platform andlakehouseecosystem.This leader will define and execute the product vision forDynata'sdata platform, ensuring the underlying architecture, governance, and capabilities enable high-value business outcomes across the organization.
Reporting to theChief Product Officer, theSeniorVice President will establish the roadmap for a scalable, governed, and reusable data platform that supports both internal and external use cases.The portfolio includes lakehouse capabilities, federated data access, pricing and feasibility services, semantic-baseddata products, feature management, graph-enabled assets, and externallyaccessibleAI-ready datasets.
Initially, this role will operate as a hands-on product leader responsible for platform strategy, use case prioritization, implementation oversight, and stakeholder alignment. As the platform matures, this leader will build and scale a team to support continued growth and innovation.
Key Responsibilities
Platform Strategy & Product Leadership
Define and execute the vision, strategy, and roadmap forDynata'senterprise data platform andlakehouseecosystem.
Ensure platform investments are aligned to business priorities and deliver measurable value across analytics, operations, AI, and data product initiatives.
Identifyopportunities toconsolidateoverlapping data assets, services, and workflows, driving greater reuse, consistency, and platform efficiency across the organization.
Establish platform investment priorities, business cases, success metrics, and adoption goals to maximize enterprise impact.
Platform Delivery & Adoption
Lead the product strategy and implementation ofDynata'slakehouseplatform, partnering closely with engineering, architecture, data science, and vendor teams.
Translate business and product requirements into platform capabilities that support current and future use cases.
Partner with business stakeholders to ensure platform-enabled capabilities are adopted, trusted, and embedded into operational and commercial decision-making.
Continuously evaluate platform performance andidentifyopportunities for optimization, expansion, and innovation.
Use Case Development & Prioritization
Define and prioritize business use cases enabled by the platform, including feasibility prediction, dynamic pricing, router optimization, graph analytics, syndicated data products, synthetic data products, AI-ready datasets, and advanced analytics.
Ensure platform capabilities are designed to support reusable, scalable, and governed data products.
Balance near-term business needs with long-term platform strategy and architectural sustainability.
Partner with business stakeholders to continuouslyidentifyandvalidatenew platform-enabled opportunities.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner closely with Product,Panel,Technology, Research & Data Science, and Commercial leaders.
Align stakeholders around investment priorities, platform roadmap decisions, operating models, and adoption strategies.
Lead cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable platform capabilities, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, governance requirements, and business impact.
Build and scale a team of product managers as the data platform portfolio grows.
Qualifications
10+ years of experience in product management, platform products, data platforms, data infrastructure, analytics, or related fields.
Proven experience leading large-scale data platform,lakehouse, data warehouse, data mesh, or data infrastructure initiatives.
Strong understanding of modern data architectures and technologies, includinglakehouse, metadata, governance, semantic layers,ontologies, featurestores, APIs, and platforms such as Snowflake,theApacheecosystem,Iceberg, Spark, Kafka, and Airflow.
Experience translating complex business requirements into scalable platform capabilities that support analytics, optimization, decision support, and data product use cases.
Demonstrated success defining product strategy and roadmaps for enterprise platforms or technical products.
Demonstratedsuccessleveragingconsultants and contractors in addition to internal resources.
Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to evaluate platform investments and prioritize competing needs.
Strong communicationand stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing VP-level and executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated successoperatingeffectively in ambiguous environments and leading early-stage platform initiatives, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution.
Experience building and leading high-performing product teams.
Experience working with cloud platforms,preferably AWS,data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, or enterprise software ecosystems preferred.

Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg)

Experience with data governance frameworks, data mesh, and data product thinking
Executive communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders
MBA or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred
Experience with budget management and P&L ownership

jobs.title: Managing Director, Technology Officers Practice - Retained Search
jobs.text:
About Modern Executive Solutions
Modern Executive Solutions is a fully integrated talent management consultancy with a specific focus on developing diverse, modern leadership teams. We provide services that include talent and organization strategy, culture and change management, leadership assessment and development and executive search. Everything we do is forward-looking and focused on creating modern organizations, leadership team and leaders. We are headquartered out of Atlanta, Georgia but work on a remote-first basis with employees across the United States and a team also in the United Kingdom. As a part of our embedded purpose to change lives for the better we donate 10% of our annual profits to charities that support youth and education in order to develop the diverse talent of tomorrow.
The Opportunity
Modern Executive Solutions is seeking a high-impact Managing Director to lead the execution of retained executive search engagements with rigor, judgment, and credibility. This role is central to the success of each search, owning the day-to-day execution of the engagement and helping clients navigate to the right leadership decision through a thoughtful, consultative approach.
Working under the guidance of a Senior Partner, the Managing Director is accountable for running a successful search process from kickoff through close. This person will shape the search strategy, lead and motivate the research team, build trust with the client’s hiring stakeholders, and ensure the engagement remains on track even when conditions become complex or challenging.
The right person brings strong executive search execution skills, commercial judgment, and the emotional intelligence to know when to support, when to challenge, and when to elevate issues in a client’s process that may be limiting the outcome.
Key Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end execution of executive search engagements under the supervision of a Senior Partner.
Translate client needs into a clear, practical, and differentiated search strategy.
Lead the research team to develop target company lists, market maps, candidate pipelines, and search hypotheses.
Drive momentum throughout the engagement, keeping workstreams moving with pace, discipline, and accountability.

jobs.title: Sr Director Product Management
jobs.text:
AtEZCORPwe are a growing team focused on creating and changing the pawn industry as we know it today. We believe that our platform enabled lending and e-commerce solutions will revolutionize our ability to attract, engage and service our customers across the United States, Mexico and Latin America.
Join us now for an opportunity to be a part of a team that wants to provide access to short-term cash for every person – everywhere!
The Company:
Founded in Austin in 1989, EZCORP has grown into a leading provider of pawn loans in the United States, Mexico and Latin America. We are dedicated to satisfying the short-term cash needs of consumers who are both cash and credit constrained and providing an industry-leading customer experience.
What’s in it for you:
Ground Floor opportunity with EZCORP, a company with a start-up, purpose-driven mentality where innovative and agile problem solving are part of our DNA along with competitive compensation and benefits.
Address:
Ontario
The Sr. Director, Product Manager is a senior leadership role reporting to the Head of Product Management, responsible for leading strategic product initiatives and driving product excellence across the Digital Product organization. This role provides deep product leadership for critical customer-facing products and platforms while building product management capabilities, establishing best practices, and mentoring product teams throughout the organization.
The Sr. Director serves as a key strategic partner to executive leadership, translating business strategy into product vision and roadmaps that deliver measurable customer and business value. This position requires balancing hands-on product ownership with organizational leadership, coaching product managers, and driving consistent product discipline across teams.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Product Strategy & Leadership
Define and own multi-year product strategy aligned with EZCORP’s business and operating objectives.
Translate executive priorities into structured product roadmaps and investment plans.
Ensure consistent prioritization across platforms based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and operational efficiency.
Customer & Business Outcomes
Champion a customer-centric approach grounded in measurable business outcomes.
Drive improvements in customer satisfaction, digital adoption, and revenue performance.
Improve operational efficiency across store and corporate workflows.
Ensure product performance is measured, reviewed, and continuously improved.
Team Leadership & Development
Lead and develop senior product leaders, including Directors and Group Product Managers.
Establish consistent product management standards, governance, and accountability.
Build leadership depth and succession readiness within the product organization.
Foster a culture of ownership, transparency, and execution discipline.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Operations, IT and Design teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule and on budget
Collaborate with Marketing to drive product adoption, positioning, and go-to-market strategies
Work with Operations and Store Experience teams to ensure products meet field team needs and drive operational efficiency
Engage with Compliance and Legal to ensure regulatory adherence in financial services products
Build strong relationships with business stakeholders across functions to understand needs, gather requirements, and align priorities
Lead cross-functional product planning sessions, roadmap reviews, and stakeholder alignment meetings
Product Excellence & Standards
Establish and drive consistent product management practices, standards, and operating rhythms across the Digital Product organization
Define and implement product frameworks for discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, and delivery
Create templates, tools, and resources that enable product teams to work more effectively
Drive adoption of product analytics, user research, and experimentation capabilities
Advocate for technical excellence, platform thinking, and reduced technical debt in product decisions
Champion customer-centric design and accessibility in all Digital products
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:
15+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, or Platform Leadership roles.
8-10+ years in senior leadership positions (Director / Senior Director or equivalent).
Demonstrated experience delivering complex products in regulated industries, preferably financial services, lending, payments, or retail finance.
Proven ability to scale and modernize large, mission-critical platforms.
Strong cross-functional leadership experience with Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Finance.
Track record of driving execution predictability and measurable business outcomes.
Exceptional communication and decision-making skills at the executive level.
Experience with AI-assisted prototyping (Claude Code, Cursor, Figma AI) to create stateful, interactive prototype
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Design, or related field required
MBA or Master's degree strongly preferred
EZCORP is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Director, Data Solutions & Engineering
jobs.text:
Must be located and authorized to work in the US
Role Overview
Statara is seeking a Data Solutions & Engineering leader to guide the design and evolution of client-facing data and analytics solutions while serving as the department head for Data Products & Engineering. This dual mandate combines solution architecture with organizational leadership, bridging business needs with Statara’s Data, Insights, and Activation capabilities.
As department head, this person will assume direct leadership of the Data Products & Engineering team—setting technical direction, managing priorities, and ensuring the reliability and continued evolution of Statara’s core data infrastructure, with particular emphasis on Snowflake and modern cloud data architecture.
On the solutions side, this role partners closely with Business Development, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape scalable solution approaches, support pre-sales technical strategy, and help ensure complex opportunities are well-defined and feasible.
This role is ideal for a strong technologist with leadership instincts—someone who can own a technical function, contribute meaningfully to client conversations, and bring structure to how Statara designs and delivers solutions. You don’t need to have done all of this before, but you should be ready to grow into the full scope.
Key Responsibilities
Department Leadership: Data Products & Engineering
Serve as the head of the Data Products & Engineering department, setting vision, priorities, and technical direction
Lead, manage, and develop team members, including coaching, mentorship, performance oversight, and capacity planning
Own the operational health of Statara’s data infrastructure, including pipeline reliability, platform stability, and data product quality
Drive continued evolution of Snowflake-based architecture and modern data workflows across the organization
Align engineering and data product priorities with commercial objectives and the broader product roadmap
Solution Architecture & Strategy
Lead the technical shaping of client solutions, from initial concept or test through high-level design and delivery planning
Translate business objectives into clear data, analytics, and activation approaches that align with Statara’s capabilities
Serve as a key technical voice on complex or novel solution designs
Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across clients and use cases
Client & Pre-Sales Support
Partner with Business Development to scope opportunities, clarify technical requirements, and assess feasibility
Participate in client conversations as a technical resource, translating capabilities into clear business value
Support the development of technical demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, and related materials for key opportunities
Feasibility & Validation
Guide data and analytical validation efforts to confirm solution viability, scalability, and expected outcomes
Review data structures, assumptions, and analytical outputs to ensure technical soundness
Support proof points (e.g., pilots, prototypes, demonstrations) where they strengthen solution confidence
Cross-Functional Alignment
Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to align solution designs with platform capabilities and delivery realities
Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early to maintain momentum and clarity
Bridge commercial intent and technical execution across teams
What Success Looks Like
The Data Products & Engineering team operates with clear direction, strong execution, and alignment to company priorities
Snowflake-based data infrastructure is reliable, well-maintained, and evolving to meet growing demands
Client opportunities are scoped accurately and efficiently, with strong technical grounding
Technical solutions are feasible, scalable, and clearly aligned to business value
Cross-functional teams are aligned on requirements, risks, and delivery plans
The solutions function becomes more repeatable, effective, and scalable over time
Requirements
We’re looking for demonstrated technical depth and sound judgment—earned through real exposure to complex problems—more than a specific career path or title history.
Snowflake working experience required. You should have hands-on working knowledge of Snowflake. You don’t need to be a certified architect, but you need to be able to contribute to technical decisions confidently in a Snowflake-centric environment.
Experience in solutions engineering, data engineering, analytics, data products, or a related technical role
Familiarity with data integration, pipelines, data modeling, and solution architecture concepts
Experience with modern cloud data platforms and analytics workflows; AWS environment experience is a plus, as is Alteryx
Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and executable solution plans
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with complex datasets
Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Team leadership experience required—whether through direct management, tech-lead roles, or running cross-functional workstreams. Formal people-management experience is preferred but not the only path.
Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, or analytics functions is a strong plus
Plus: Background in data onboarding, identity resolution, audience strategy, martech/adtech, or measurement partnerships. Experience in activation, programmatic, or audience deployment.
Benefits
We believe that a diverse, inclusive staff is a fundamental strength. We’re committed to hiring people of all races, ethnicities, religions, ages, sex, genders, sexual orientations, and gender identities. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and members of untapped groups are strongly encouraged to apply and are welcome on our teams.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process and employment. If you require an accommodation to apply for or interview for this position, please let us know (email Gideon at ).
We encourage candidates to apply even if their experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.
COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION
Including a 401(k) with generous company matching.
100% REMOTE WORKING OPPORTUNITY
Always have been and always will be.
TOP-NOTCH MEDICAL COVERAGE
Domestic-partner inclusive, health, dental, vision, life, cancer coverage, and long-term disability insurance for you and your dependents.
GENEROUS PAID TIME OFF
23 days of PTO per year. We believe in work-life balance and encourage you to use your time off.
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE
10 weeks of fully paid time off. All genders qualify equally, and the policy includes adoptions.

jobs.title: Director, People Partners - Product, Design & Engineering
jobs.text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
As Director, People Partners for Product, Design & Engineering (PDE), you'll be partnering with the leaders that are responsible for the teams building Figma and leading a team of highly skilled People Partners. You'll operate as a trusted advisor - coaching, challenging, and guiding the organization through rapid growth, reorganization, and change. As a member of the People team, you’ll partner closely with all of our People functions to build a best in class people function. If you’re energized by ambiguity, adept at building deep relationships, and excited to shape what great People Partnering looks like at Figma, we’d love to hear from you!
This is a full time role held from our San Francisco hub.
What you'll do at Figma:
Serve as the strategic People Partner to Figma’s CTO and Chief Design Officer, building the credibility and trust to influence how they lead, organize, and grow their teams
Lead and develop a talented team of People Partners across the Product, Design and Engineering organizations
Lead and execute our People Programs such as org design, resource management, performance, and change management through periods of rapid scaling, reorganization, and shifting priorities
Drive the core people cycles for your orgs across performance, calibration, talent reviews, succession planning while raising the bar on quality and consistency
Partner across the People function and our cross functional partners to help execute the People strategy across the PDE organization

jobs.title: Director, WMS Product Design/Development [OPERATIONS TECHNOLOGY]
jobs.text:
About the role
HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Product Design and Software Engineering functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.
You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.
This location-flexible position can be physically based in any of our North America corporate offices or fulfillment centers with a hybrid working model, but must be flexible with work hour scheduling as teams and solutions are dispersed globally.
The Director of WMS Product Design and Software Engineering will work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.
What you'll own
WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations
Integration Architecture & Reliability: Own WMS layer Integrations to host systems and CDC pipelines (Debezium/kafka) to Snowflake/Databricks
Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS
Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate
CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments
Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods
Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership
Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning
Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability
People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development
International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally
Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level
What you bring
Technical/Engineering Experience
10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment
3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server
3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines
Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks
Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact
Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting
Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies
Product Experience
Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties
Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization
Additionally With This Role, You will have....
The opportunity to shape global operations at a leading food technology company with significant reach and impact.
A high-ownership, low-bureaucracy environment where your work is visible and your decisions matter.
Flexible working arrangements to support your work-life balance.
Continuous development through HelloFresh Academies and access to internal mobility across 18 countries.
An egoless, collaborative culture focused on learning, growth, and building something exceptional together.
And you’ll get…
Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation
Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks
Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)
Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)
Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain
This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

$194,250—$235,000 USD

Arizona Pay Range
$169,050—$204,500 USD

jobs.title: Senior Director, Decision Analytics
jobs.text:
Description
Sprout Social is seeking a Senior Director, Decision Analytics to join our Strategy & Business Operations team. In this senior leadership role, you will head our centralized Decision Analytics function, overseeing the data science and analytics teams that power strategic choices across the entire company.
This isn't a passive reporting role. You are tasked with reinventing how Sprout approaches data—moving beyond retrospective reporting to build a predictive, insights-driven culture where data actively shapes business outcomes. Inheriting a team mid-transformation, you will define how every major function at Sprout utilizes data to accelerate growth and maximize business impact for years to come.
Why Join Sprout's Strategy & Business Operations Team?
As a pillar of the Strategy & Business Operations organization, you will sit at the critical intersection of business strategy and technical data infrastructure. We are completely rebuilding our centralized data approach, making this role the single most important hire for our department's future.
What we offer: The opportunity to manage real ambiguity with true ownership, backed by direct visibility to the Chief Product Officer and Sprout's executive leadership.

What you'll do
Own and lead Decision Analytics, Sprout's centralized analytics and data science function, spanning domain-specialized pods supporting Marketing, Revenue, Product, and Finance across the full organization
Set the vision, standards, and operating model for how Decision Analytics works at Sprout, including how the team prioritizes, partners with stakeholders, and measures its own impact
Drive a fundamental shift in how Sprout's business teams use data: from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-driven decision-making that creates measurable business impact
Serve as the primary analytics and data science thought partner to senior business stakeholders across the organization, building deep relationships, understanding what each team is trying to accomplish, and guiding the team to deliver the highest-leverage work
Connect the dots across the organization, understanding what individual pods are working on, what business stakeholders need, and what is the best use of the team's time and capability
Be a hands-on leader: willing to get into the weeds alongside your team when needed, help work through a complex analysis or model, unblock a problem, or bring the right people into the room
Lead and develop a team of managers, analysts, and data scientists across multiple domain pods, creating a culture of proactive partnership, intellectual curiosity, and high standards
Partner closely with the Director of Data Enablement on data infrastructure and analytics engineering requirements, ensuring the analytical layer is built on a trustworthy and scalable data foundation
Champion AI-forward thinking across the analytics and data science function, identifying opportunities to incorporate AI and automation into how the team works and what it delivers
Drive change management as the organization completes its transition to a centralized analytics model, building trust with stakeholders, establishing new ways of working, and helping the team thrive in a new operating structure
Collaborate cross-functionally without ego; this role requires a genuine collaborator who is more invested in outcomes than ownership
What you'll bring
You are a seasoned data leader who pairs technical and analytical depth with sharp business fluency. You are just as comfortable diving into a complex modeling problem with a data scientist as you are advising a CRO on pipeline strategy. A natural collaborator, you excel at translating sophisticated data science into clear, actionable business strategies, and you thrive when transforming ambiguous challenges into structured, high-impact solutions.
Minimum Qualifications
Experience: 12+ years in analytics, data science, or a related field, including 5+ years leading teams within a SaaS or subscription-based business.
People Management: 5+ years experience of hiring, developing, and mentoring a high-performing team of managers, analysts, and data scientists.
Leadership: Proven success scaling and managing a centralized or hybrid analytics function that simultaneously supports diverse cross-functional business units.
SaaS Fluency: Deep, fluent understanding of core SaaS metrics across the customer lifecycle (e.g., ARR growth/composition, NRR, GRR, pipeline velocity, CAC payback, LTV:CAC, and product activation).
Strategic Altitude: The ability to move fluidly between high-level executive strategy and granular, hands-on technical execution.
Preferred Qualifications
Change Management: Experience leading an analytics organization through a major consolidation, restructure, or operating model transformation.
Technical Depth: Hands-on familiarity with the modern data stack (SQL, Python, dbt, cloud warehouses, BI/visualization tools like Tableau/Hex/Looker) and a foundational understanding of ML modeling frameworks and experimentation design.
Capability Building: Experience expanding advanced data science capabilities alongside core analytics, including predictive modeling and ML-based forecasting.
AI Innovation: An AI-forward mindset with practical experience integrating AI tools and automation to accelerate and scale analytical workflows.
How you'll grow
Within 1 month, you'll plant your roots, including:
Build relationships with your direct reports, key business stakeholders, and cross-functional partners across Data Enablement, Product Operations, and Strategy & Business Operations
Develop a deep understanding of Sprout's business model, the domains your team supports, and the current state of the analytics and data science function you're inheriting
Assess the team's current ways of working, backlog, and stakeholder relationships — and identify the highest-leverage opportunities to build trust and early momentum
Within 3 months, you'll start hitting your stride by:
Establishing a clear operating model for how Decision Analytics works — how work gets prioritized, how pods partner with stakeholders, and how the team communicates its impact
Building credibility as a strategic analytics and data science partner with senior stakeholders across the organization
Identifying gaps in tooling, process, or capability and developing a clear point of view on how to address them
Within 6 months, you'll be making a clear impact through:
Owning the full Decision Analytics function with confidence — managing pod leads, guiding prioritization across domains, and serving as the primary escalation path for the business
Demonstrating a measurable shift in how business stakeholders experience the analytics function: more proactive, more strategic, more trusted
Beginning to shape the longer-term vision for how Decision Analytics evolves as Sprout's data maturity and analytical ambition grow
Within 12 months, you'll make this role your own by:
Leading Decision Analytics through its next phase — from a newly consolidated function to a mature, high-performing team with a clear identity and a strong reputation across Sprout
Establishing a team culture defined by curiosity, proactive partnership, and a relentless focus on business impact — not just analytical output
Positioning Decision Analytics as an indispensable driver of how Sprout makes decisions, allocates resources, and pursues growth

Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).

jobs.title: Director, WMS Product Design and Engineering
jobs.text:
About the role
HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Product Design and Software Engineering functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.
You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.
This location-flexible position can be physically based in any of our North America corporate offices or fulfillment centers with a hybrid working model, but must be flexible with work hour scheduling as teams and solutions are dispersed globally.
The Director of WMS Product Design and Software Engineering will work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.
What you'll own
WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations
Integration Architecture & Reliability: Own WMS layer Integrations to host systems and CDC pipelines (Debezium/kafka) to Snowflake/Databricks
Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS
Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate
CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments
Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods
Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership
Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning
Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability
People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development
International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally
Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level
What you bring
Technical/Engineering Experience
10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment
3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server
3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines
Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks
Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact
Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting
Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies
Product Experience
Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties
Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization
What we offer
Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing: Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.
Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.
Flexibility & Work-Life: Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings. Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.
Career & Development: Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.
Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.
To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.
#LI-HYBRID
HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.
Toronto, ON Pay Range
$174,300—$184,300 CAD

jobs.title: Director of Data, Payments
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍London or UK Remote | 💰 £150,000 - £200, 000 + Equity + Benefits
About our Data Discipline
We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.
Our Data discipline is centralised, but deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.
Our Payments team ⭐
At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.
The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.
You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform.
To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness
Your day-to-day
Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline
Co-drive Payments strategy and product decisions with Product and Engineering, bringing Data into discovery early to shape priorities and challenge thinking
Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth
Set the data strategy for Payments, including the operating model, team priorities, architecture, technical debt and key metrics and drivers
Translate between technical, product and commercial perspectives to help teams make clear, high-impact decisions
Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.
You should apply if:
What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!
You have experience driving payments innovation and product strategy forward in a fast-growing business
You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement.
You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and business outcomes
You are an empathetic people leader who can build trust quickly, raise the performance bar and retain excellent talent
You have experience growing and leading a full stack data team, including individual contributors and managers across Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering and Analytics
You have experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing and risk/control functions
The Interview Process
After an informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!
Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior data leaders.
Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as behavioural and leadership interviews. You can have this all in one day or split these across multiple days, whichever your prefer.
Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com
How we work 💻:
Locations & Flexible Working :
Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.
We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨
Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.
Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.
At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.
You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨
Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼
What’s in it for you
💰Base salary £150, 000 - £200, 000 + Equity + Benefits
✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK
✅ We can sponsor visas
📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).
⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Director, Benefits Technology - IAS, West
jobs.text:
The Baldwin Group is an award-winning entrepreneur-led and inspired insurance brokerage firm delivering expertly crafted Commercial Insurance and Risk Management, Private Insurance and Risk Management, Employee Benefits and Benefit Administration, Asset and Income Protection, and Risk Mitigation strategies to clients wherever their passions and businesses take them throughout the U.S. and abroad. The Baldwin Group has award-winning industry expertise, colleagues, competencies, insurers, and most importantly, a highly differentiated culture that our clients consider an invaluable expansion of their business. The Baldwin Group (NASDAQ: BWIN), takes a holistic and tailored approach to insurance and risk management.
The Director, Benefits Technology leads the technology team and works alongside the Employee Benefits business segment by overseeing benefit eligibility management systems offered to clients. The Director, Benefits Technology is responsible for the tactical and operational leadership of team projects, manages benefit carrier sites, supports colleagues in undertaking new opportunities and developing their careers, and promotes and maintains strong colleague and client relationships.
Principal Responsibilities:
Lead EBG Technology Team and activities
Develop and drive EBG Technology annual goals and objectives
Keeps colleagues up-to-date on decisions, changes, and other relevant information, and articulates reason behind the decisions
Creates an environment for open feedback through effective communication and regular meetings to address concerns regarding new requirements
Evaluates colleague performance by providing objective and timely feedback on an ongoing informal basis; conducts annual performance evaluations incorporating 360 feedback
Coaches, mentors, and trains team colleagues on a continuous basis
Oversee EBG Technology Solution Systems, their infrastructure, and administration
Develop long term strategic business plan for EBG Technology Team that is scalable for rapid firm growth
Oversee Project Management process, vendor support services, and technology solutions access
Develop and communicate solutions to resolve complex issues
Oversee EDI with insurance companies, HRIS, and payroll systems; manage RFIs for clients adopting new Payroll systems
Negotiate Fees for systems and services
Represent organization at national meetings
Research and identify new products, system developments, database management and administration trends
Evaluate and establish procedures/technologies to ensure system security
Partner with leadership team to assess how EBG Technology Solutions can best streamline processes and add business value, create an equivalent electronic process to improve business speed and internal costs
Encourages Technology team to analyze, evaluate and prioritize requirements to deliver business process or automated application solutions to address business needs
Promotes the firm culture and a high degree of client satisfaction
Looks for opportunities to improve the firm, Business Segment and processes; brings issues and discrepancies to the attention of appropriate leadership
Completes special projects as assigned
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
Minimum of five (5) years working experience with benefit administration systems, payroll systems and/or HRIS systems and team leadership experience
Superb client relations skills with the ability to diffuse tense situations
Experience in working and configuring an HRIS Database
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Word and PowerPoint
Possesses an advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including the ability to manipulate data, compare two data sets, perform pivot tables and lookups.
Demonstrates strong organizational skills and high attention to detail
Demonstrates effective presentation skills through both verbal and written communications.
Possesses the ability to learn appropriate insurance company and firm software systems.
Possesses the ability to grow in benefits product knowledge.
Demonstrates the ability to multi-task and prioritize workloads while maintaining deadlines.
Demonstrates the ability to interact and communicate effectively within a team environment to share knowledge and manage workflows.
Current Florida 2-15 License, as required by the State Department of Insurance to provide risk management consulting or risk transfer solutions as necessary in states where the firm functions
Must demonstrate core values, exuding behavior aligned with the firm’s culture.
Special Working Conditions:
Fast paced, multi-tasking environment.
Periodic local travel may be required.
The starting salary is $185,000-$204,000 annually. Salary is negotiable upon time of hire.
Click here for some insight into our culture!
The Baldwin Group will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate who applies on our career site. Any unsolicited resumes sent to The Baldwin Group, including unsolicited resumes sent via any source from an Agency, will not be considered and are not subject to any fees for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product
jobs.text:
About Tekmetric
Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.
Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.
Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.
But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.
Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.
Working the Tekmetric Way
At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.
We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.
We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.
Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.
At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.
What You’ll Do
The Senior Director of Product Management will be a thought leader who can drive strategy, innovation, and execution.We’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit, a creative problem-solver, and a strategic thinker who can take a bold approach to product development
Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Vision
Define and communicate a compelling product vision and multi-year strategy aligned to company goals.
Identify new opportunities across customer segments, markets, and workflows—balancing innovation with strong business fundamentals.
Lead annual and semi-annual product planning cycles, ensuring clear prioritization and resource alignment.
Leadership & Team Development
Directly lead multiple Directors/Group PMs and indirectly oversee the entire PM organization.
Recruit, coach, and mentor a high-performing PM team with a strong emphasis on accountability, customer insight, and product excellence.

blocks.text: About Tekmetric
Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.
Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.
Working the Tekmetric Way
At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

jobs.title: Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO)
jobs.text:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
We are seeking a highly technical, visionary, and customer-centric Field CTO to act as our premier technical ambassador. In this role, you will bridge the gap between MinIO’s engineering innovation and the strategic business needs of our largest, most complex enterprise customers.
As a Field CTO, you will engage in peer-to-peer conversations with enterprise C-suites (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs) and lead architectural discussions with principal engineers. A deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI architectures (LLMs, RAG, deep learning pipelines) and modern analytics data systems (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Trino, Spark) is mandatory. You will not only evangelize MinIO’s capabilities but also act as a trusted advisor, helping organizations architect their data infrastructure to support next-generation workloads.
What You Will Do
Executive Advisory & Evangelism: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies. Articulate the strategic value of high-performance object storage in the context of AI readiness and data democratization.
Architectural Leadership: Design and validate complex, large-scale architectures for enterprise customers. Guide them in integrating MinIO seamlessly into their AI/ML pipelines and modern data lakehouse ecosystems.
Industry Thought Leadership: Represent MinIO at major industry conferences, webinars, and meetups. Write technical whitepapers, reference architectures, and blog posts focusing on the intersection of object storage, generative AI, and modern analytics.
Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Strategic Support: Partner closely with enterprise sales and customer success teams on high-stakes deals. Unblock technical objections and provide strategic guidance during Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and large-scale deployments.
Product Strategy Feedback Loop: Serve as the "voice of the customer" to MinIO’s product and engineering teams. Distill market trends, customer pain points, and emerging AI/Analytics patterns into actionable product requirements.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of experience in technical leadership roles (e.g., Enterprise Architect, Chief Architect, VP of Engineering, or previous Field CTO).
Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing or evangelist capacity, successfully presenting to both highly technical audiences and C-level business executives.
AI & Machine Learning Architectures:
Deep architectural understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
Strong knowledge of AI/ML data pipelines and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ray, Hugging Face).
Understanding of hardware bottlenecks in AI, specifically the challenge of feeding data to GPUs (GPU data starvation) and how high-throughput storage solves this.
Modern Analytics & Data Systems:
Expertise in Open Table Formats (Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Delta Lake) and their integration with object storage.
Proficiency with modern query engines and compute frameworks (Trino, Presto, Apache Spark, Flink, StarRocks).
Solid grasp of the evolution from traditional data warehouses to modern Data Lakehouse architectures.
Infrastructure & Cloud-Native Tech:
Strong command of Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native orchestration.
Deep understanding of the AWS S3 API, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems design.
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Sr. Technology Partner Director - AI Code-Gen & Apps
jobs.text:
RDQ427R146
At Databricks, we are building the platform for the next generation of AI-built applications, where developers can go from idea to production using AI coding agents and app-building platforms. We partner with the leading tools developers use to generate, build, and deploy applications, connecting them directly to Databricks data, AI, and application infrastructure. With Databricks Apps and Lakebase, developers can build with their preferred code-gen tools and deploy secure, data-driven applications directly on Databricks. These partnerships are critical to making Databricks a core platform for the rapidly growing ecosystem of AI-generated applications.
Founded in 2013 by the original creators of Apache Spark, Databricks has grown from a tiny corner office in Berkeley, CA to a global organization with over 8,000 employees. Thousands of organizations, from small startups to Fortune 100, trust Databricks with their mission-critical workloads, making us one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the world and one of the top 5 move valuable private companies.
More about the Team
As the Sr. Technology Partner Director, AI Code-gen & Apps, you will be responsible for recruiting, developing, managing, and scaling our global partner ecosystem that makes Databricks the best place to build and run AI-generated applications. You will build and own strategic partnerships with leading AI coding agents, app builders, and developer platforms, creating deep product integrations, joint solutions, and GTM plays that connect these ecosystems to Databricks Apps, Lakebase, and the broader Databricks platform.
We are looking for someone with experience building and scaling strategic partnerships across AI code-gen, app-building, or developer tool ecosystems, with a strong track record of driving product integrations, joint GTM, and partner-led growth. The role requires strong technical and GTM acumen, with the ability to work across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to drive integrations, joint solutions, and go-to-market execution. Success requires deep expertise in large-scale technology ecosystems, strong communication and prioritization skills, and a scrappy, entrepreneurial mindset to build partnerships that establish Databricks as the best place to run transactional database workloads.
The impact you will have
Build and own partnership strategies for a portfolio of leading AI coding agents and app builders, spanning product integrations, joint solutions, GTM, and marketing initiatives that drive measurable customer adoption and business impact.
Lead strategic partnerships from opportunity identification and joint product planning through launch and scale, working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to bring integrations to market and drive adoption.
Drive enablement and field readiness to ensure both Databricks and partner teams can effectively position and deliver these joint offerings.
Serve as the internal voice of top partners in category, collaborating with Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership to influence our roadmap and ensure our strategy addresses the evolving needs of the Developer Tooling & Database Ecosystem landscape.
What we look for
7+ years of experience in product partnerships, business development, or partner management, including 3+ years working across AI code-gen, app-building, or developer tool ecosystems.
Proven track record of launching strategic ISV integrations and joint GTM motions with leading developer platforms, AI code-gen companies, or hyperscalers.
Deep understanding and network across Developer Tool & Database ecosystem — Postgres (big plus), Developer Marketplaces, next-gen Platform-as-a-Services, AI Coding, and CI/CD workflows, and ability to develop joint value propositions that resonate with technical and business decision-makers alike.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills — able to influence Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Business Operations teams.
Experience navigating co-opetition dynamics and sensitive partner relationships.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
Grit, humility, and the ability to operate in a high-growth, founder-led environment.
**Most of all, we look for relentless problem solvers and will consider candidates with non-traditional backgrounds.
