jobs.title: Director, Product (physical) (f/m/x)
jobs.text:
Reporting Relationships
Primary Manager: COO and Co-MD
Dotted Line: CMO and Co-MD
Direct Reports: ~10 people spanning Culinary, Product Innovation, Product Strategy, Product Operations, and Product Analytics
The Opportunity
Factor is a healthy, ready-to-heat meal delivery service that has built a category-defining business in the US and Canada. Now we're building Factor in Europe — and although we have strong blueprints from North America, we have the opportunity to leverage the very rich multi-cultural environment in Europe to tailor both our physical and digital products to five different markets.
As our Director, Product, you will own the full product vision and execution for Factor Europe. You will lead a multi-layered team of ~10 people, sit on the Factor Europe leadership team, and maintain a close dotted-line relationship with our CMO to ensure product and marketing move as one.
This is a rare kind of role: senior strategic ownership and real infrastructure, with the pace and ambition of an early-stage scale up. If you are a visionary builder who leads with curiosity, earns conviction through data, and holds your team to the same high standard you hold yourself — we'd love to hear from you.
What You'll Do
Lead and Develop a High-Performance Product Team
Build, inspire, and manage a multi-disciplinary team — setting a clear vision, establishing the operating rhythms that allow the team to move fast, and investing in the people who will drive Factor Europe's next chapter.
Own and Challenge the Product Vision
Define a clear and compelling vision for what Factor's physical product must become in Europe — grounded in customer insight, commercially rigorous, and differentiated enough to win. Develop a deep, independent point of view on where the North American model translates and where European markets demand something different.
Push the team and the business to think beyond the current roadmap — challenging assumptions, interrogating trade-offs, and ensuring we are always working on the highest-leverage version of the product.
Act as the liaison to our global Digital Product team — representing Factor Europe's priorities in the feature roadmap and collaborating on shared global initiatives that benefit the wider business.
Drive Customer Retention and Commercial Performance
Own customer retention levers as your north star. Build a rigorous, evidence-based view of what drives it and rally the team around interventions that move the needle.
Make product decisions with full awareness of their P&L implications. Take calculated risks, track outcomes honestly, and move quickly to learn and adjust when bets don't pay off.
Build for Multiple European Markets
Lead our effort to find product-market fit across five distinct markets — understanding how consumer preferences vary by culture, and building a proposition that resonates locally while scaling efficiently.
Share learnings across geographies and partner with peers across the HelloFresh Group to continuously raise the bar.
Support new channel strategies, understanding and adapting products for different customer bases.
Align Product and Marketing Strategy
Work closely with the brand & marketing team to ensure product roadmap and marketing strategies are fully synchronised — so what we build, how we talk about it, and how we sell it form one coherent proposition.
Act as the product voice on the leadership team, articulating a compelling vision for where the product needs to go and why.
Who You Are
A visionary leader who executes. You set a compelling direction, bring your team with you, and roll up your sleeves to make it happen.
Customer-obsessed and analytically rigorous. Sharp instincts backed by disciplined discovery. Comfortable querying your own data and stress-testing assumptions.
Commercially minded. You understand how product decisions flow through to the P&L — and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not just outputs.
A cross-functional influencer. You build trust quickly, drive execution through others, and get the right priorities onto other teams' roadmaps.
Internationally curious. You find the complexity of building for multiple European cultures energising, and you seek out the nuances that matter.
An exceptional communicator. You write and present with clarity and conviction — from strategy narratives to leadership updates to product briefs.
Food and/or nutrition obsessed!
Requirements
Experience: 8–10+ years in Product, Strategy, or a closely related commercial leadership role; 3+ years managing multi-disciplinary teams.
Technical toolkit: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; AI proficiency and curiosity required.
Strong preference for:
○ Experience in D2C subscription businesses — retention, lifecycle, and recurring revenue models.
○ Multi-market European experience and an understanding of how consumer preferences vary across the continent.
○ Experience in physical products or FMCG, especially food & beverage.
○ A track record of scaling a product in a new market and finding product-market fit.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing
Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.
Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA.
You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop, a €250 home office setup budget, and contribute to the Bedrijfspensioenfonds Levensmiddelen pension scheme (2025 rate 27.6%; employer pays 19.64%, employee pays 7.96%).
Health & Wellbeing
Benefit from discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland, free bootcamp classes (Amsterdam), and free subscriptions to Headspace and OpenUp.
Get a 10% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis in 2025.
Flexibility & Work-Life
Work flexibly with our hybrid setup (50% office, 50% remote), plus a €2.40 daily remote work allowance.
Receive 24 days of annual leave (pro-rated), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).
Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, plus €0.23 per km for car and bicycle travel.
Eligible employees can work from another country for up to 8 weeks per year.
Career & Development
Grow with our "Learning Never Stops" mindset: participate in Pantry Staple trainings, access internal/external opportunities, and join our cross-market mentoring program.
Culture & Environment
Enjoy fresh homemade lunches in the office (€3.00/day), weekly vrij-mi-bo (Friday drinks), quarterly strategy sessions, and team events.

jobs.title: Group Head of Product- Payer
jobs.text:
About the Role
The Head of Product- Payer Solutions leads Innovaccer’s payer product portfolio, spanning AI applications in IT, financial and clinical operations. Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, the Head of Payer Solutions is a senior leadership role with broad organizational scope — you will own the product strategy and roadmap end to end, lead a team of product managers, partner deeply with engineering, data science, design, and clinical operations, and work hand-in-hand with go-to-market teams to personally grow, mature, and scale the go-to-market strategy.
The ideal candidate is someone who has taken a product or a business from a standing start to a real, referenceable market position. You should be equal parts strategist, innovator and closer: someone who can build the plan and then walk into a room with a health plan CXOs and sell it.
A Day in the Life
Business & Product Strategy
Define and own the end-to-end strategy for Galaxy, Innovaccer's payer solution spanning risk adjustment, quality management, payment integrity, and utilization management, with agentic AI as the operating model rather than a feature layer.
Develop a differentiated point of view on where the market is heading and translate that into an AI-first product roadmap that positions Innovaccer ahead of the curve, defining where Galaxy expands next — new use cases, new payer segments, new regulatory surface area — and building the business case for each bet.
Partner with the CPO to shape Innovaccer's overall product narrative and communicate strategy to customers, investors, and internal stakeholders.
Lead a team of product leaders to develop world-class products with the agility of an early-stage startup
Go-to-Market & Commercial Ownership
Build and own the go-to-market plan for Galaxy: target segments, buyer personas, sales motion, and the proof points that move a payer CXO from interested to signed.
Be the lead seller in strategic deals — you will personally pitch, negotiate, and help close alongside sales, not hand off a deck, do demos, and step back.
Partner with sales, marketing, and customer success to build and convert pipeline, and be direct with yourself and the team about what is working and what is not.
Team & Execution Leadership
Work seamlessly with GTM and commercial teams to execute at the pace the market demands
Set a high operating cadence: fast decisions, clear prioritization, and a bias toward shipping and closing over deliberating.
Partner with engineering, data science, and clinical and regulatory SMEs to make sure what gets built is what the market will actually buy.
Own the metrics that matter to the business — pipeline, bookings, retention, and product adoption — and build a rhythm of accountability around them.
Market & Customer Engagement
Be Galaxy's most visible external voice — with customers, at industry conferences, in analyst and KLAS conversations, and in the press.
Develop deep relationships with payer CXOs, VPs of Risk Adjustment, VPs of Quality and Stars, and Medical Directors of UM, understanding their world well enough to sell into it credibly.
Represent Innovaccer in competitive evaluations against point payer vendors and payer-owned solutions, and win the room.
Turn every customer conversation into product and GTM insight, and close the loop back into strategy fast.
What You Need
This role demands a rare combination of builder instincts, commercial range, and payer domain fluency.
8+ years of experience in product, strategy, or general management, with a demonstrated track record of launching new products or new businesses into market from an early stage, including the strategy, the go-to-market plan, and the first wave of customers.
Entrepreneurial, founder-operator mindset: you have owned P&L responsibility, you have taken products from idea to market, and you have a track record of consulting with payer clients on growth and market entry.
A demonstrated ability to sell: You can personally pitch, negotiate, and close with senior executives — you do not just build the product and hand it to someone else to sell.
Payer domain fluency: in risk adjustment, quality and Stars performance, utilization management, or value-based care economics — or the speed to get fluent fast.
Comfort owning a business outcome, not just a roadmap: pipeline, bookings, and market share, in addition to product quality and adoption.
A track record of building and leading high-performing, cross-functional teams: You hire well, develop talent, and build teams from a standing start.
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills: equally credible in a boardroom, an analyst briefing, or a working session with a health plan's VP of Risk Adjustment.
Comfort operating in ambiguity: You do not wait for a fully built playbook. You build the plan as you go and create clarity for the people around you.
Nice to have
Prior experience selling to health plan or payers.
Experience competing against or partnering with payer point vendors or payer-owned solutions.
Experience scaling a health-tech or payer-tech business from early revenue to a durable, referenceable market position.
Direct P&L ownership at a startup or business unit, including pricing and packaging decisions.
Familiarity with agentic AI or AI-native product architectures in healthcare.
Here’s What We Offer
Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.
Innovaccer Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered regardless of any characteristic protected by federal, state or local law including, without limitation, race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, medical condition, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status. Innovaccer Inc. participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility of all newly hired employees based out of the U.S. and employed by Innovaccer Inc.
For any additional information, please visit the below websites:
E-Verify
Right to Work (English)
Right to Work (Spanish)

jobs.title: Director, AI & Agentic Engineering
jobs.text:
About the job
Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?
With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!
Who We Are
Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.
We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.
Find out more at artefact.com.
What you will be doing
You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.
AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.
Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.
Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.
Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.
Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.
Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.
Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.
What we are looking for
The ideal candidate has a substantial software engineering and AI background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.
Strong expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering — context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and agentic coding — and in cloud-native software architecture, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on command of agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor), and modern full-stack frameworks (TypeScript/React front ends; Python/Node backends).
Experience designing cloud architectures: microservices, serverless, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Solid grasp of AI system design: agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and LLMOps.
Experience with data & context modeling and ingestion/processing pipelines on data lakes and data warehouses, including vector and graph storage strategies (embeddings, knowledge graphs).
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.
Why Join Us
We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.
There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.
The estimated base compensation for this role starts at $200,000 (NYC location). Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for competitive benefits.

blocks.text: About the job
Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?

With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!
Who We Are

Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.

We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.
Find out more at artefact.com.
What you will be doing

You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.

items: AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.

Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.

Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.

Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.

Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.

Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.

Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.

blocks.text: What we are looking for

items: The ideal candidate has a substantial software engineering and AI background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.
Strong expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering — context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and agentic coding — and in cloud-native software architecture, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

Hands-on command of agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor), and modern full-stack frameworks (TypeScript/React front ends; Python/Node backends).
Experience designing cloud architectures: microservices, serverless, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Solid grasp of AI system design: agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and LLMOps.
Experience with data & context modeling and ingestion/processing pipelines on data lakes and data warehouses, including vector and graph storage strategies (embeddings, knowledge graphs).
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.

blocks.text: Why Join Us
We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.

items: There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
VP, Product
Role Overview
Ad Results Media (ARM) is building the next-generation operating platform that powers how the agency plans, buys, measures, and reports across audio and emerging channels. Internally known as the ARM Suite, this platform unifies order management, finance connectivity, and — over time — planning, buying, communications, and measurement into a single environment used by ARM, our clients, and our network partners.
We are seeking a Vice President, Product to serve as the internal product owner of the ARM Suite. This role is responsible for product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and governance. The VP, Product will partner closely with Analytics, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Client Services to translate agency and client needs into a durable, scalable product.
This role is both strategic and hands-on. The VP, Product will set long-term product direction while operating in the day-to-day decisions that shape how ARM Suite is built, governed, and adopted.
Platform Ownership & Impact
ARM Suite is transitioning from a vendor-led build to an internally owned product. This role mitigates vendor dependency risk, restores institutional knowledge, and ensures the platform evolves in alignment with how ARM actually wins, retains, and grows business.
The VP, Product will be accountable for ARM Suite as a product — not as a collection of features, dashboards, or vendor deliverables. That means owning the charter, defining what the platform is (and is not), establishing a prioritization framework, and making the trade-offs required to ship a durable system rather than a set of bespoke responses to internal requests.
ARM Suite is, at its core, an API-driven platform. It depends on durable pipelines to media buying systems, measurement partners, finance, network partners, and client-side data sources to keep users in ARM’s environment rather than dependent on parallel tools. The VP, Product owns the API and integration strategy that makes this possible.
Key Responsibilities
Product Vision & Roadmap
Be accountable for the end-to-end product vision and multi-year roadmap for the ARM Suite, including order management, finance connectivity, planning, buying, communications, and measurement workflows.
Translate ARM’s commercial strategy, client needs, and partner relationships into a clear product narrative and sequenced roadmap.
Define what ARM Suite is, what it is not, and what “done” looks like at each phase, with explicit trade-offs documented for leadership.
Own ARM Suite’s API and integration strategy, including API pipelines into media platforms, measurement partners, finance and billing systems, network partners, and third-party enrichment sources that keep users inside ARM Suite.
Vendor Reduction & Internal Capability Building
Lead the structured reduction of third-party dependency by extracting institutional knowledge, documenting business rules, and transitioning ownership of roadmap and prioritization in-house.
Review and approve product designs, scope, and delivery plans proposed by vendors; ensure work aligns to ARM’s long-term roadmap
Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure clean separation between platform design (Product) and data correctness and pipeline ownership (Engineering / Analytics).
Governance, Prioritization & Intake
Establish and operate a product-governed intake and prioritization framework that replaces ad hoc requests with a defensible, transparent process — while preserving fast paths for revenue-critical work.
Define and enforce the authority split between Product (system design and prioritization) and Analytics (metric definitions, QA, and interpretation).
Document and socialize standards for product decisions, business rules, and platform constraints so they persist beyond individual contributors.
Partner with Analytics to operationalize a formal QA delegation model within ARM Suite intake and delivery workflows.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as a trusted partner to Analytics & Insights, Reporting, Data Science, Strategy, Planning, Operations, Finance, and Client Services.
Bridge the gap between platform capability and agency workflows, ensuring product decisions reflect how ARM teams actually plan, buy, and report.
Influence and align senior leaders on roadmap sequencing, trade-offs, and investment cases without relying on positional authority alone.
Build a product practice over time — starting solo, with a clear path to scale through hires and contributors as the platform matures.
Client & Partner Orientation
Ground product decisions in real client and network-partner needs through structured exposure to top-revenue accounts, partner conversations, and pitch motions.
Ensure ARM Suite produces standardized, credible artifacts for sales, planning, and renewal motions rather than bespoke, one-off deliverables.
Position ARM Suite as a durable differentiator that creates switching costs and supports long-term client retention and expansion.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Required Experience
10+ years of product management experience, including senior product leadership (Director, Sr. Director, or VP) at a SaaS, agency-tech, ad-tech, mar-tech, or analytics platform company.
Demonstrated experience owning a B2B platform or product line end-to-end — vision, roadmap, prioritization, governance, and stakeholder management.
Track record of leading internal product ownership through transitions away from third-party engineering vendors, contractors, or outsourced build partners.
Experience operating in environments that combine internal teams with external engineering partners, with a clear philosophy on what should be owned in-house vs. outsourced.
Deep, hands-on capability with API-driven product design — including standing up API pipelines, integrating third-party data sources for user-facing enrichment, and shipping products built on APIs from scratch.
Preferred Experience
Prior experience in media, advertising, agency, ad-tech, or mar-tech environments, with an understanding of planning, buying, measurement, and client reporting.
Familiarity with order management, finance/billing connectivity, and workflow tools that span multiple internal stakeholders.
Broad working knowledge of APIs across the advertising, media, and ad-tech ecosystem (e.g., DSPs, programmatic platforms, measurement and attribution partners, audio and CTV systems), with a track record of using them to extend product capability.
Comfort working closely with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Data Science functions; able to engage substantively on data models, BI tooling, and measurement frameworks without owning them.
Experience standing up product governance, intake frameworks, and prioritization processes in organizations transitioning from ad hoc to durable operating models.
Personal Attributes
Strong communicator and executive-level storyteller; can move comfortably between vendor architecture reviews, leadership strategy discussions, and client-facing conversations.
Pragmatic and business-oriented, with an appreciation for balancing ideal product strategy with real-world commercial and operational constraints.
High ownership mindset; comfortable being the only product leader in the room and building the function from the ground up.
Collaborative, curious, and motivated by building durable systems that compound the value of every team they touch.
Ad Results Media is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and believe strong product organizations are built at the intersection of operational excellence, business judgment, and a deep understanding of how teams and clients actually work.

jobs.title: Director, Data & Enterprise Architecture Transformation
jobs.text:
About Valiantys
Here at Valiantys, we are one of the world’s largest Atlassian partners, helping organizations work better through scalable, people-centered solutions. As an Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner with a global footprint, we support customers across industries as they adopt ITSM, Agile at Scale, and modern work management practices.
Our teams work at the intersection of strategy and delivery, partnering closely with customers to translate complex business challenges into clear, actionable solutions built on best practices and leading platforms.
Join Valiantys and be part of something extraordinary!
Job summary
Valiantys is looking for a Director, Data & Enterprise Architecture Transformation to drive sales and growth across a portfolio of Valiantys' strategic and enterprise accounts. They will act as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, and VPs of Data & Architecture -- translating their business goals into multi-year transformation roadmaps spanning enterprise data strategy, data platform modernization, data governance, and enterprise architecture. They will own new logo acquisition and existing account expansion, facilitate executive alignment and value realization, and lead pursuit and delivery consultants to win and execute high-impact engagements.
What you’ll be working on
Own executive relationships across a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts; serve as the single point of accountability for client outcomes, satisfaction, and growth.
Co-develop and execute account strategies that expand Valiantys' footprint across data strategy, data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), data governance, and enterprise architecture.
Lead solutioning for complex pursuits -- partnering internally to scope data modernization, data mesh/fabric, MDM, and enterprise architecture engagements.
Shape and communicate target architectures spanning business, application, data, and technology domains -- including cloud data platforms, analytics, AI/ML foundations, and governance frameworks.
Govern delivery quality in partnership with engagement managers; intervene on escalations and ensure architectural integrity.
Represent Valiantys in executive briefings, QBRs, industry events, and joint go-to-market activities.
Mentor consultants and architects, contributing to Valiantys' practice development in data strategy and enterprise architecture.
Do you have what it takes to be our new Director, Data & Enterprise Architecture Transformation?
10+ years in consulting, professional services, or enterprise technology roles, with at least 5 years in client-facing leadership (Client Partner, Engagement Director, or equivalent).
Data Strategy expertise: proven track record defining and executing enterprise data strategies -- data operating models, governance, data quality, MDM, and analytics & BI modernization.
Enterprise Architecture expertise: demonstrated experience leading EA programs across business, application, data, and technology architecture domains, including target operating models and cloud architecture blueprints.
Data Platform/Engineering background: hands-on or architectural depth across modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), data mesh/fabric patterns, lakehouse architectures, ELT/ETL, and streaming.
Cloud & Infrastructure foundation: strong foundation in cloud architecture -- networking, identity, security, scalability, and reliability engineering at enterprise scale across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Certifications: Active AWS, Azure, or GCP Solutions Architect Professional certification; TOGAF 9 or TOGAF 10 Certified preferred
Demonstrated ability to lead multi-million-dollar account portfolios and complex pursuits.
Excellent executive communication, commercial acumen, and consultative selling skills.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field; advanced degree a plus.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience within the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rovo).
Additional certifications: Snowflake SnowPro, Databricks Certified Data Engineer/Architect, Azure/GCP Data Engineer.
Experience designing AI/ML data foundations -- feature stores, vector stores, and governed data products supporting RAG and agentic workflows.
Delivery experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, life sciences) with familiarity in GDPR, HIPAA, SOX, and BCBS 239.
Established network within AWS and Azure partner organizations and joint GTM motions.
Prior P&L ownership in a consulting or systems integrator environment.
Location: This role can be located in Canada or in the United States. We offer flexible remote working policy.
Why you should apply ?
Our team members are our greatest asset and we work hard to ensure that Valiantys is not only a great place to work, but also a platform for you to grow.
Sense. We're committed to giving you the level of information you need to make sense of your assignments. You will witness the impact of your actions.
Training. We will provide you with the necessary time and budget to help you develop your skills and continue to build your career.
Flexibility. We understand that life is all about balance and we offer you the flexibility and support to help you maintain balance across the different pillars of your life.
What we offer - Employee Perks & Benefits
Competitive compensation with an annual performance-based bonus
Comprehensive Health Insurance401(k) with Company Match
Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) - 4 weeks per year, plus public holidays
A flexible remote work policy
A multicultural and international team environment
To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada or the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.
Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. Valiantys provides a barrier-free workplace and embraces all qualified applicants with varied perspectives and backgrounds.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Product Engineering, the Director, Content Engineering is responsible for leading the technology organization for GHX’s Content Engineering portfolio. The role requires leading geo distributed engineering organizations to deliver key solutions in Content space focusing on Content Workbench, Price Workbench and Contract Management services.
Role Responsibilities
Lead the strategic direction, planning and execution for Content Engineering leaders and teams to deliver business and customer focused roadmaps.
Bring deep domain expertise and hands on experience with Software Engineering, Data products, AI in SLDC and System architecture, preferably in Supply Chain Domain.
Strong Experience in cloud-based SaaS services, API & UI frameworks, and Microservice architectures.
Hands on experience with GenAI and Agentic Frameworks
Leading and mentoring geo distributed leaders and building high performance cross geo organizations.
Develops relationships at all levels of the organization as a trusted leader and strong communication skills.
Excel in all areas of strategy development, including project management, analysis, problem solving, verbal and written communication, consensus building, and people development.
Understand the financial impacts and manage budgetary decisions for technology solutions and forecast future technology practices needed within the area of expertise.
Skill Requirements
Experience in building and leading geo distributed teams to deliver critical roadmap items.
Experience leading and mentoring leaders and managers to build high performance organizations.
Deep domain experience in Data, SaaS and System Architecture space.
Deep experience in building mission critical SaaS/Cloud based service
Strong communication and collaboration skills, and experience working with cross functional partners and executives.
Experience with high availability architecture and design for mission critical applications.
Experience building CI/CD pipelines that do security scans, code quality scans, unit testing, and automated testing.
Role Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or a relevant area.
15+ years of Software Engineering experience in a SaaS environment.
7+ years' experience in an Engineering Leadership role
Experience managing large teams (40+ people) and scaling a business appropriately based on available resources.
Technical Strength in cloud architectures, application architecture, engineering processes and SDLC.
Experience with offshore development
Estimated Salary: $150,000 - $214,000 plus bonus
GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare
Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.
GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.
It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
Director of Product Management
Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)
Shape the Future of Privacy
Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.
We are looking for a Director of Product Management to own the strategy, outcomes, and people of one of our product pillars. This is a fully accountable leadership role: you'll set the direction for your team, develop product talent, and make sure the work your team ships connects clearly to company-wide goals. You'll combine hands-on team leadership with pillar-level strategy, working closely with peers across Product, Engineering, and the broader business.
How We Work: AI-Native by Default
Usercentrics is actively pushing AI adoption across Product for real efficiency gains. This isn't background context, it's a working expectation. As a Director, you're expected to actively drive AI-native ways of working within your team: using AI to speed up research synthesis, discovery, spec writing, and prototyping, and building the judgment in your PMs to use it well rather than uncritically. This is a real, current expectation on how you'll run your team from day one, not an aspirational nice-to-have.
What You Will Do
Own product strategy
Take full ownership of your team's outcomes: adjust strategy, roadmap, or process proactively when results aren't tracking, and spot diminishing returns before they bite.
Define clearly what your team should focus on, why the investment matters, and what outcomes Usercentrics can expect
Contribute meaningfully to pillar-level strategy and connect your team's work to the priorities of the management team
Identify novel areas of investment that advance the product vision, and build the case for new strategic initiatives
Drive product execution
Set and uphold high standards for specification, delivery, and quality across your team, reviewing and shaping key product work
Make the tough trade-off calls between projects and investment areas to maximize the value your pillar delivers
Build and maintain best practices for specification, delivery, and quality, and hold your team accountable for outcomes
Anticipate your team's resourcing, skills, and tooling needs based on the roadmap ahead, and act before gaps become blockers
Stay close to the domain
Align market insight across teams and pillars, grounding strategy in a deep understanding of customer needs, competitive dynamics, and market opportunity
Partner closely with engineering leadership to align technical strategy and address cross-functional challenges
Lead cross-team efforts to address industry trends and regulatory challenges, ensure compliance across product areas, and help position Usercentrics as an industry leader
Turn insight into direction
Make sure your team has the data, user feedback, and market insight it needs to make informed decisions, and use that data to set and communicate quarterly goals
Coach your product managers to use data and customer insight to shape recommendations and roadmap direction, not just to report on results
Strengthen the relationship between PMs and design, and push for design that keeps pace with how AI is changing product experiences, not just how it's changing engineering
Lead and grow your people
Identify strengths and development areas for each team member, and proactively close skills gaps across the team
Manage your team's careers, not just their performance, and look for opportunities to help them grow into product leaders
Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships across the company, keeping key partners informed and avoiding last-minute surprises
Influence prioritization and resourcing decisions at the pillar level, and ensure your team's progress has visibility and support at the VP level.

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Associate Director - Data Governance
jobs.text:
Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI. Our business value and leadership have been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.
We are looking for a Senior Manager / Associate Director to lead delivery workstreams within a large-scale enterprise Data Governance, Architecture & Controls Program.
Responsibilities:
Lead pods focused on data lineage documentation (consumption through ADS to system of origin), target-state ADS landscape and architecture design, and aggregation layer controls including DQ rules, variance analysis, and anomaly detection.
Shape the data modeling and architecture decisions that underpin the target-state ADS landscape, working with enterprise architecture to evolve domain and subdomain taxonomy.
Conduct SME interviews across engineering and business data offices, translate enterprise data management policy into actionable delivery and build plans, and manage a small team of analysts through design and implementation.
Operate as the bridge between engineering, enterprise architecture, and data office stakeholders, and present findings and recommendations directly to senior client leadership.
Define and standardize repeatable playbooks, templates, and execution frameworks for data lineage harvesting and Authoritative Data Source (ADS) onboarding to ensure consistency across multiple pods.
Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture and Tooling teams to evaluate, select, and drive the adoption of data governance and lineage platforms.
Establish, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics reflecting the progress of lineage coverage, ADS compliance, and data quality improvement to senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Head of Machine Learning - Aquaeye
jobs.text:
AquaEye is a fast-growing company transforming the global water rescue industry by developing rapid-deployment, intelligent sonar solutions. Our flagship product, AquaEye, is a handheld sonar device with built-in AI detection to help first responders locate drowning victims faster and more effectively. As we continue to expand our global reach and develop new product lines, we are seeking a driven, hands-on Head of Machine Learning to own and advance innovation in our product’s algorithms.
This role is central to AquaEye’s core technology and strategic vision. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading ML strategy, overseeing end-to-end development, and solving some of our most challenging embedded ML problems.
Job Responsibilities
ML Strategy and Technical Direction
Define and execute our machine learning strategy aligned with evolving product and business objectives.
Lead the design and evolution of signal processing and machine learning architectures for production systems.
Establish technical standards, best practices, and development processes for ML systems.
Evaluate emerging machine learning technologies and identify opportunities to enhance product capabilities and competitive advantage.
Provide technical leadership on architecture decisions, model selection, and system performance optimization.
Machine Learning Platform & Model Development
Oversee the development, validation, deployment, and lifecycle management of machine learning models.
Oversee the design, optimization, and scalability of our signal processing pipelines.
Define model performance metrics and continuously drive improvements through rigorous evaluation and experimentation.
Ensure robustness, maintainability, and scalability of production ML infrastructure, data pipelines, and supporting databases.
Oversee ML Ops practices, including model versioning, reproducibility, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Data Strategy & Dataset Governance
Establish standards for dataset acquisition, quality, governance, and lifecycle management.
Lead planning and execution of field data collection initiatives to ensure datasets meet product development and validation objectives.
Continually innovate on existing methodologies for data labeling, preprocessing, quality assurance, and representativeness across operational scenarios.
Oversee continuous expansion and refinement of training datasets to improve model accuracy and generalization.
Product Innovation & Cross-Functional Leadership
Work alongside Product Management, Engineering, and executive leadership to define the AI roadmap and prioritize development initiatives.
Translate customer needs and operational challenges into innovative machine learning solutions and product capabilities.
Provide technical leadership during customer demonstrations, field trials, and critical deployments.
Serve as the organization's subject matter expert for machine learning technologies, advising stakeholders on technical direction and product strategy.
Team Leadership & Organizational Development
Provide leadership and mentorship to develop a high performing machine learning team within the product development group.
Establish project priorities, resource allocation, and development plans to ensure successful delivery of strategic objectives.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive project execution through effective planning, risk management, and use of project management tools such as Jira.
Build organizational capability by defining engineering processes, conducting technical reviews, and promoting knowledge sharing across teams.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, Generative AI
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Senior Director, Generative AI
About the Role
Roblox Build is our generative creation product, the platform where creators design, build, and publish 3D experiences. We are looking for a Senior Director of Generative AI to lead the Applied AI organization inside Build, responsible for turning state-of-the-art foundation models into high-quality, reliable creation systems at Roblox scale. This leader will own the full applied AI stack: model strategy and routing, model adaptation and fine-tuning, code generation (CodeGen), 3D layout generation (LayoutGen), and the evaluation science and infrastructure that tells us what actually works.
You Will
Own model strategy and routing for Build. Design and build an intelligent model layer that selects the right model for each creation task based on quality, capability, latency, cost, and safety, leveraging both frontier models and Roblox-adapted open-source models.
Lead model adaptation across the Applied AI org, including fine-tuning, distillation, synthetic data generation, human feedback pipelines, and preference optimization for Roblox-specific creation tasks such as Luau code generation and 3D scene understanding.
Drive CodeGen capabilities forward by building AI systems that understand creator intent, reason across multi-file Roblox experiences, execute tools, and reliably make complex changes to existing games, going well beyond code completion.
Build LayoutGen intelligence by developing the AI capability that turns a creator's intent into coherent 3D scenes, including object selection, spatial reasoning, placement, aesthetic quality, and iterative editing.
Own evaluation as a core technical discipline. Build the benchmarks, quality metrics, judge methodologies, experiment infrastructure, and human evaluation pipelines that answer whether model, prompt, or routing changes actually improve creator outcomes.
Close the feedback loop between model development, evaluation, and production, ensuring that quality signal flows continuously from creator outcomes back into training data, model updates, and release decisions, rather than operating as separate silos.
You Have
10+ years of experience in machine learning and AI, with 5+ years in senior technical leadership roles overseeing applied AI or ML engineering organizations that have shipped generative AI systems into production at scale.
Deep technical grounding across multiple areas of applied AI, including LLM post-training (RLHF, DPO, distillation), model routing and adaptation, agentic systems, code generation, or evaluation science, with enough depth to recruit, challenge, and lead exceptional scientists and engineers in each area.
Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing organizations that span both AI research scientists and production engineers, including hiring, developing talent, and making difficult personnel decisions.
Strong evaluation fluency, with a track record of building eval frameworks that predict production outcomes, designing benchmarks that measure what matters, and building the infrastructure to run experiments continuously at model, prompt, and routing level.
Experience operating cross-functionally in complex technical organizations, with the ability to influence and align across research, product engineering, and platform teams without relying on hierarchy.
Genuine interest in the creation problem. You find the specific challenge of AI-assisted 3D world creation and domain-specific code generation compelling, not just as a vehicle for building AI systems.
You Are
A builder and a shipper who cares about getting things into production and measuring whether they actually work, not just publishing promising results.
Technically credible across the stack. You can engage deeply with scientists on evaluation methodology, data quality, and model behavior, and equally deeply with engineers on architecture, inference latency, and reliability.
Decisive under ambiguity. You make principled tradeoffs between rigor and velocity, know when good enough is good enough, and can articulate your reasoning clearly.
Direct and honest. You give clear feedback, surface problems early, and create an environment where your team can do the same.
Mission-driven. You care about the people building on Roblox, and you connect the technical work of the Applied AI org to the experience of the millions of creators using the tools.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Senior Director, Generative AI
About the Role

Roblox Build is our generative creation product, the platform where creators design, build, and publish 3D experiences. We are looking for a Senior Director of Generative AI to lead the Applied AI organization inside Build, responsible for turning state-of-the-art foundation models into high-quality, reliable creation systems at Roblox scale. This leader will own the full applied AI stack: model strategy and routing, model adaptation and fine-tuning, code generation (CodeGen), 3D layout generation (LayoutGen), and the evaluation science and infrastructure that tells us what actually works.
You Will

items: Own model strategy and routing for Build. Design and build an intelligent model layer that selects the right model for each creation task based on quality, capability, latency, cost, and safety, leveraging both frontier models and Roblox-adapted open-source models.

Lead model adaptation across the Applied AI org, including fine-tuning, distillation, synthetic data generation, human feedback pipelines, and preference optimization for Roblox-specific creation tasks such as Luau code generation and 3D scene understanding.

Drive CodeGen capabilities forward by building AI systems that understand creator intent, reason across multi-file Roblox experiences, execute tools, and reliably make complex changes to existing games, going well beyond code completion.

Build LayoutGen intelligence by developing the AI capability that turns a creator's intent into coherent 3D scenes, including object selection, spatial reasoning, placement, aesthetic quality, and iterative editing.

Own evaluation as a core technical discipline. Build the benchmarks, quality metrics, judge methodologies, experiment infrastructure, and human evaluation pipelines that answer whether model, prompt, or routing changes actually improve creator outcomes.

Close the feedback loop between model development, evaluation, and production, ensuring that quality signal flows continuously from creator outcomes back into training data, model updates, and release decisions, rather than operating as separate silos.

blocks.text: You Have

items: 10+ years of experience in machine learning and AI, with 5+ years in senior technical leadership roles overseeing applied AI or ML engineering organizations that have shipped generative AI systems into production at scale.

Deep technical grounding across multiple areas of applied AI, including LLM post-training (RLHF, DPO, distillation), model routing and adaptation, agentic systems, code generation, or evaluation science, with enough depth to recruit, challenge, and lead exceptional scientists and engineers in each area.

Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing organizations that span both AI research scientists and production engineers, including hiring, developing talent, and making difficult personnel decisions.

Strong evaluation fluency, with a track record of building eval frameworks that predict production outcomes, designing benchmarks that measure what matters, and building the infrastructure to run experiments continuously at model, prompt, and routing level.

Experience operating cross-functionally in complex technical organizations, with the ability to influence and align across research, product engineering, and platform teams without relying on hierarchy.

Genuine interest in the creation problem. You find the specific challenge of AI-assisted 3D world creation and domain-specific code generation compelling, not just as a vehicle for building AI systems.

blocks.text: You Are

items: A builder and a shipper who cares about getting things into production and measuring whether they actually work, not just publishing promising results.

Technically credible across the stack. You can engage deeply with scientists on evaluation methodology, data quality, and model behavior, and equally deeply with engineers on architecture, inference latency, and reliability.
Decisive under ambiguity. You make principled tradeoffs between rigor and velocity, know when good enough is good enough, and can articulate your reasoning clearly.
Direct and honest. You give clear feedback, surface problems early, and create an environment where your team can do the same.
Mission-driven. You care about the people building on Roblox, and you connect the technical work of the Applied AI org to the experience of the millions of creators using the tools.

jobs.title: Director of Digital & Product Management
jobs.text:
Position Summary
The Director of Digital & Product Management leads ACCC’s digital product strategy and is accountable for ensuring the organizations digital products, platforms, and experiences support its strategic, operational, and client-service objectives.
This role owns the digital product roadmap and provides leadership across the full product lifecycle from discovery and prioritization through design, development, testing, implementation, adoption, performance management, and continuous improvement. The Director serves as the primary connection between ACCC’s business areas and Information Technology, ensuring that business needs are translated into well-defined, user-centered, compliant, and measurable digital solutions.
Operating within ACCCs operating system, the Director owns the Digital & Product Management function on the accountability chart and is responsible for establishing clear priorities, rocks, scorecard measures, operating rhythms, and team accountabilities.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities
This job description does not limit management’s ability to assign or adjust duties and responsibilities at any time.
•Develop and maintain ACCC’s digital product vision, strategy, multiyear roadmap, translating organizational priorities, client needs, and operational needs into actionable initiatives.
•Establish product goals, business outcomes, success measures, and value propositions in partnership with business leaders.
•Lead a structured process for evaluating, prioritizing and managing digital product requests based on strategic alignment, user impact, risk, effort, and expected value.
•Balance new product development with enhancements, regulatory requirements, technical dependencies, platform maintenance, and defect resolution.
•Identify opportunities to improve digital client experiences, employee tools, self-service capabilities, and operational workflows.
•Partner with IT to assess feasibility, define and document requirements, manage dependencies, and support delivery.
•Oversee user acceptance testing, launch readiness, communications, training coordination, implementation, and post-launch support.
•Monitor product performance, adoption, user feedback, and business impact, using results to drive continuous improvement.
•Maintain visibility into product priorities, active initiatives, risks, dependencies, and progress, and communicate recommendations to senior leadership.
•Lead, coach, and develop the Digital & Product Management team.
•Support vendor evaluations and partnerships related to digital products and platforms.
•Ensure digital products incorporate accessibility, privacy, security, compliance, and operational considerations.
MA Pay Transparency Salary: $150,000

jobs.title: Director - IT Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is the role?
The enterprise software landscape is undergoing a structural shift. AI-assisted development has dropped the cost and time required to build custom internal tools by more than half. Retool's 2026 State of Internal Software report found that 35% of enterprises have already replaced SaaS tools with purpose-built software, and 78% plan to build more in the year ahead. The calculus has changed: what previously required a six-figure vendor contract and a year-long implementation is now a small engineering team and a few focused sprints.
Elastic is at the beginning of this journey. We operate the Elastic Stack — Elasticsearch, Kibana, Elastic ML, and a growing set of AI-native capabilities — at production scale for thousands of customers. And we are increasingly building on our own platform internally: replacing expensive SaaS tools with Elastic-native systems that are faster, more intelligent, and owned entirely by us.
We are looking for a Director, IT Engineering to join our Information Technology team to lead this effort. This is not a passive IT management role or a SaaS administration leadership position. It is a high-impact engineering leadership role where you will manage a small, agile team of engineers who look at $500,000 annual SaaS contracts, ask: 'Could we build a better version of this on Elasticsearch in twelve weeks?' — and execute.
This is a rare opportunity to lead original product engineering inside an IT organization, working with a platform that most engineers only get to use as a customer — and to build systems that directly shape how a public company operates.
What You Will Be Doing:
Lead strategic build-vs-buy engineering
Work with IT leadership, Finance, and Engineering to evaluate Elastic's internal SaaS portfolio and identify where custom-built systems — backed by Elasticsearch, Kibana, and Elastic's AI capabilities — deliver better value than continued vendor contracts.
Own the architectural oversight, build plan, and overall delivery of the highest-priority replacements.
Lead a high-performing engineering team
Build, mentor, and lead a small, focused team of software engineers executing on internal tool replacements and Elastic-native platforms.
Manage delivery roadmaps, unblock your team, and balance engineering rigor with rapid execution speed.
Design & build Elastic-native internal Platforms: Guide your team in designing and delivering systems across five primary focus areas:
Platform productivity tools: Internal developer portals, knowledge search layers, engineering onboarding systems, and workspace tooling that unifies disparate SaaS tools into a single Elasticsearch-backed search and intelligence layer.
FinOps and AI cost governance: A consolidated cost visibility and anomaly detection system across Elastic's AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Google Gemini) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), replacing commercial FinOps SaaS with an Elastic ML-powered alternative.
IT service management: Evaluating and building replacements for commercially purchased SaaS products including incident management, knowledge base search, internal developer portal, and SIEM-correlated security workflows, using Elastic Observability and Elastic Security as the backbone.
Enterprise efficiency systems: Custom tooling that reduces manual process overhead across IT, Finance, HR, Legal and Operations, using the LLM Gateway, RAG pipelines, and Elasticsearch as the data and intelligence layer.
New use cases : New use cases that traditionally SaaS paid services did not address and can now be built with AI native architecture.
Set the engineering standard
Establish and own the architectural standards, design patterns, and engineering practices for all IT platform engineering work.
Define how internal systems are built — data models, API design, observability, cost governance, security posture — and serve as the engineering authority for your team.
Collaborate across the company
Partner closely with Elastic's IT infrastructure team, the Security organization (Elastic Security is your SIEM backbone), the Platform Engineering team, and Finance.
Engage with tool owners across the company to understand requirements, challenge assumptions about what needs to be bought versus built, and ensure that the systems your team builds actually get used.
Dogfood and validate Elastic's own products
Run Elastic's own technology in the most demanding possible context: as the engineering leader responsible for the internal systems that the company depends on every day.
Every system your team builds is a reference architecture. Ensure that insights generated about what works and what doesn't feed directly into Elastic's product and go-to-market strategy.
What You Bring
Required experience
12+ years of software engineering experience, including experience managing or leading direct engineering reports or small engineering teams.
Hands-on familiarity and technical capability with Elasticsearch — data modeling, query design, aggregations, performance tuning, and production operations.
Proven track record of guiding full-stack engineering delivery end-to-end, from Logstash ingest pipelines to Kibana dashboards to React frontends.
Proven track record of building, shipping, and managing commercial software or platform systems — not just maintaining existing ones.
Architectural judgment: the ability to scope a problem correctly, choose the right components, and make executive calls on when to build versus integrate versus buy.
Strong written communication to author architecture decision records, engineering standards documents, executive proposals, and build-vs-buy analyses.
Valued experience
Experience leading teams that build on the Elastic Stack beyond basic logging — Elastic ML, ELSER semantic search, vector search, Kibana Canvas, Watcher, or Elastic Security.
Experience with FinOps practices: cloud cost management, LLM API cost attribution, or building cost visibility tooling.
Familiarity with Information Technology managed systems — understanding the core domain problems solved by platforms like Salesforce or ServiceNow.
Experience working in a hypergrowth or post-IPO technology company where engineering rigor and business speed have to coexist.
Experience with LLM integration patterns: RAG pipelines, prompt engineering for enterprise use cases, LLM gateway design, or AI-powered workflow automation.
Contributions to internal developer experience, platform engineering, or engineering productivity tooling.
What This Role Is Not
Not a SaaS administrator or vendor manager: This is an engineering execution role, not a role for managing third-party vendor contracts, Salesforce admins, or ServiceNow developers.
Not a pure infrastructure or DevOps role: Your team uses cloud infrastructure, but the primary deliverable is production-grade software systems, not infrastructure configuration.
Not a hands-off hands-free manager: While you will manage a small team, you are expected to stay deep in the architecture, review code, and set technical directions hands-on.
Not a role for rigid processes: Projects begin with open-ended questions ('Could we build this?') and require you and your team to define and ship the answer.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.
These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.
An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
$199,700—$315,900 USD
The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:
$239,800—$379,300 USD
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
Generous number of vacation days each year
Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.
Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)
