jobs.title: Director of Data Operations and Governance
jobs.text:
Our Future Health is an ambitious collaboration between the public, charity and private sectors, designed to help people live healthier lives for longer through better prevention, earlier detection and improved treatment of diseases. With over 2.7 million volunteers across the UK, we’re now the world’s largest health research programme of our kind, with a volunteer group that is more diverse than other similar health research programmes.
Data is at the heart of our mission. We bring together health records, genetic and laboratory data, questionnaires and other participant-generated data to create an incredibly rich resource for health research. We use this data to support discovery research, recruitment into clinical trials, and health insights for participants. As we grow, both the volume and variety of data we manage will increase considerably.
We are looking for an experienced Director of Data Operations & Governance to lead how we operationally manage and govern data across Our Future Health.
This is a Senior Leadership role reporting to the Chief Data Officer, with responsibility for the operational management and governance of data across Our Future Health. You will help ensure data moves efficiently and securely from source to user, while maintaining the quality, provenance and controls required of one of the world's largest health research programmes.
This is fundamentally a data operations and delivery leadership role. You will develop the operating models, standards and ways of working that allow us to onboard and release data efficiently, improve its quality and ensure governance, security and compliance are considered from the outset.
You will join an established Data Management capability, initially managing a senior Data Management lead with five Data Managers within the wider team, alongside additional budgeted roles expected to report directly to you. You'll have the opportunity to shape the future structure and capability of the function as we grow.
What makes this exciting?
Help define what good looks like at the forefront of health data. Few organisations are working with our combination of data volume, variety, sensitivity and potential research use. You'll help create the operational approach rather than simply inherit one.
Work on complex data challenges at scale. Our data comes from the NHS, laboratories, technology partners and participants. You'll shape how that data moves from source through to being trusted and available for research.
Shape a growing capability. You'll join an established team, but the future operating model isn't fixed. You'll help determine how the function evolves as our data landscape becomes increasingly complex.
Work collaboratively across the organisation. You'll bring together colleagues across Data Engineering, Product, Science, Operations, Legal, Compliance and Security to establish practical standards, clarify responsibilities and improve how we manage data.
Bring experience from another sector. Healthcare experience isn't essential. We're interested in people from complex, regulated and data-intensive environments who can bring useful experience of data operations at scale.
Responsibilities
Data Operations & Delivery
Lead the end-to-end operational management of data, from supplier onboarding and acquisition through to clinic laboratory operations, data release, retention and withdrawal
Create clear responsibilities, milestones, dependencies and escalation routes across complex data flows, drawing on support from our delivery team
Develop scaling strategies for onboarding and using data at increasing volumes and variety, setting out the volume targets and working with the data engineering team on technical implementation
Oversee the operational aspects of data releases, including the cross-functional coordination required to make these successful
Develop effective reporting across operational performance, data volumes, quality, risks and issues
Oversee reliable, customer-focused managed data services, including the airlock service that researchers use to move data and tooling into and out of our trusted research environment
Help teams navigate and resolve complex operational issues so that data can be delivered efficiently
Data Governance & Quality
Embed governance, security, privacy and compliance requirements into data processes from the outset
Develop practical data standards and controls, helping teams across the organisation understand their responsibilities for data on topics such as quality and retention and overseeing implementation
Improve how we understand and manage data quality, integrity, provenance and lifecycle
Partner with colleagues in Data Protection, Security, Legal and Compliance to ensure data is managed ethically, securely and appropriately
Partners & People
Manage data-facing operational relationships and negotiations with the NHS, laboratories, technology partners and other data suppliers
Lead, support and develop a team of Data Managers and governance professionals
Shape the future structure and capability of the function as Our Future Health grows
Build trusted relationships with senior colleagues across Data, Technology, Product, Science, Operations, Legal, Compliance and Security
Bring people together around shared priorities and help establish clarity where responsibilities cross teams

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Operations Planning
jobs.text:
S'more about the team
The Operations Data and Decisions Tribe at HelloFresh is responsible for driving operations planning by creating high quality, reusable data assets, data science models, and algorithmic solutions. Additionally, the tribe. This team has a direct impact on the customer experience and is constantly optimising for various Business KPIs. They build in-house products using modern technologies to handle a massive scale of transactions (>8.5 million active customers) and continuously improve the SDLC for fast flow and continuous delivery.
As a Director of Operations Planning Engineering, you will lead engineering teams (Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, & Analytics) and Staff Engineers across the mid-term planning domain, supporting their technical decision-making processes. Your responsibilities will include spearheading initiatives that traverse multiple teams and domains, such as those focused on network planning, demand planning, and production planning. Drawing upon your comprehensive understanding of the domain, you will own the planning architecture strategy and drive the long-term vision for how our planning systems should be integrated and scaled.
Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for
Lead an engineering squad comprising 10-15 engineers, managing Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers across Warsaw, Berlin, & USA.
Own the GenAI transformation — define and drive a concrete roadmap for becoming a genuinely AI-native engineering organisation: from AI-assisted development and automated incident response, to agentic workflows and LLM-powered tooling embedded in day-to-day operations.
Own the availability and reliability of HelloFresh's planning infrastructure — drive SRE practices, incident management, SLOs/SLIs, and on-call maturity across high-throughput systems serving multiple markets.
Set technical direction across Python, GoLang, PostgreSQL, Kafka, React, and React Native services on AWS, ensuring systems.
Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, and Procurement providers to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage, coach, and develop Engineering Managers & Engineers — holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
Navigate organisational change with maturity, keeping teams focused and motivated through evolving priorities.
Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for
AI proficiency and advocacy. Hands-on familiarity with AI technologies and a demonstrable track record of championing their adoption — whether through AI-assisted development workflows, LLM-powered tooling, or driving team-wide GenAI-native ways of working.
Deep Technical Expertise. Mastery of a broad range of technical skills relevant to Operations Planning — including planning systems, data science modeling, data engineering, database systems, distributed computing, and backend development frameworks. Hands-on familiarity with full stack application development.
Systems Thinking. The ability to understand complex systems holistically, recognising how components interact and impact each other, and leveraging this to design scalable, resilient solutions in a high-throughput environment where downtime means direct revenue loss.
Proven Leadership at Scale. 10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years managing Engineering Managers — not just individual contributors. Demonstrated ability to lead distributed teams across multiple offices, building trust and maintaining high engineering standards without daily co-location.
Operational Excellence Mindset. Strong grounding in SRE practices — SLOs/SLIs, incident management, on-call culture, and observability tooling (Grafana or similar). Experience owning payments infrastructure in regulated, multi-market environments is a strong plus.
Cross-Functional Collaboration. Exceptional ability to work across engineering disciplines, Product, business stakeholders, and external service providers — fostering alignment towards common goals and translating business outcomes into engineering priorities.
Effective Communication Across Disciplines. Strong ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, from engineers to senior business stakeholders.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.
Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here
Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing: Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.
Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.
Flexibility & Work-Life: Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings. Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.
Career & Development: Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.
Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.
To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.
#LI-HYBRID
HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.
Toronto, ON Pay Range
$174,300—$184,300 CAD

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
jobs.text:
Career Category
Information Systems
Job Description
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will advance Enterprise Data Governance, FAIR data practices, and a data product operating model that makes trusted, reusable, and responsibly accessible data available for analytics, automation, and AI innovation.
The successful candidate will lead cross-functional data strategy and delivery across data domains, translating scientific and business priorities into scalable governance, metadata, quality, semantic interoperability, and data product capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the enterprise Data Governance, FAIR, and data product strategy and roadmap, aligning investments to scientific and business priorities.
Establish a value-realization framework to measure business outcomes, adoption, and return on investment from data initiatives.
Execute the Enterprise Data Strategy, including data ownership, reusable data products, lifecycle management, data contracts, and adoption measures.
Evolve a federated governance operating model with clear decision rights, data ownership, stewardship accountabilities, data councils, data standards, and escalation paths.
Evolve FAIR maturity across the enterprise, including embedding FAIR practices in the data lifecycle, metadata standards, persistent identifiers, controlled vocabularies, and access patterns.
Advance active metadata, data catalog, lineage, business glossary, semantic and knowledge graph capabilities to improve discovery, context, interoperability, and trust.
Set governance policies and controls for data quality, observability, privacy, security, retention, and responsible use; ensure fit-for-purpose data for regulated and AI-enabled use cases.
Partner with Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Digital, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to operationalize governed data products across platforms and domains.
Enable responsible AI by defining and enforcing data readiness criteria.
Serve as the data engagement lead for an assigned business function, driving adoption of data management practices, including FAIR, to deliver measurable data improvements and business value.
Manage large-scale data programs, cross-functional initiatives, and external partners; communicate outcomes, risks, dependencies, and value realization to senior leadership.
What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is adata management leader with biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience with these qualifications.
Basic Qualifications
Doctorate degree and 2 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Master’s degree and 6 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Associate degree and 10 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
Mandatory Skills and Qualifications
Experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry, with an understanding of regulated data, business processes, and compliance requirements.
Demonstrated leadership of enterprise data governance, data management, active metadata, data quality, or data product initiatives across business and technology teams.
Hands-on understanding of FAIR data principles and their practical application through active metadata, standards, semantics, interoperability, and access controls.
Experience establishing data governance operating models, including data ownership, stewardship, policy, standards, controls, and issue management.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex data topics into business value and decisions.
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
Experience implementing enterprise data strategy, scaling FAIR, data products operating model, and data contracts.
Knowledge of modern data management capabilities, including active metadata, data observability, lineage, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and policy-as-code.
Experience with master data, data catalog, governance, quality, active metadata, and semantic technologies: Collibra, Databricks Unity Catalog, Reltio, SciBite, or TopQuadrant.
Experience enabling responsible AI, including data readiness for machine learning, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI agent use cases.
Ability to define measurable outcomes for data investments, including data product adoption, quality, time-to-discovery, reuse, compliance, and AI readiness.
Experience managing external partners and geographically distributed delivery teams in complex stakeholder environments.
What you can expect of us
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.
In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:
A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
Stock-based long-term incentives
Award-winning time-off plans
Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.
Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.
careers.amgen.com
In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
Application deadline
Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.
Sponsorship
Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.text:
You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.
The Director, Data Management & Intelligence, is responsible for leading the Company's enterprise data strategy, governance, business intelligence, analytics, and data management capabilities. As the steward of enterprise data, this leader ensures information is trusted, accessible, secure, and actionable, enabling data-driven decision making and alignment with strategic business priorities.
This highly visible role partners with executive, operational, clinical, and technology leaders to translate business needs into scalable data solutions, actionable insights, and AI-ready data foundations. The Director is accountable for advancing data quality, governance, metadata management, and architecture practices that support analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and emerging agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise.
Success in this role requires strong leadership, influence, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and execution across a complex organization.
The Director leads teams responsible for data governance, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data services, and data product management, ensuring the Company can effectively leverage trusted data as a strategic asset to improve operational performance, customerexperiences, growth, innovation, and the responsible adoption of AI.
Qualifications
Education Required:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data Science, Information
Systems/Technology or related field.
Work Experience Required:
• 10+ years of experience leading data management, governance, and business intelligence
functions that deliver measurable business value and continuous improvement.
• 3+ years of experience with healthcare industry data.
• 2+ years hands-on experience with Snowflake, certified/semantic data layers.
• 7+ years of leadership experience; 3+ years leading managers.
Preferred Qualifications, Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience, etc.:
• Master’s Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science or related field.
• Experience with the Epic EMR data model (Clarity)
Expertise with healthcare business processes within physician practices and associated application software necessary to support those processes within an integrated delivery system.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Experience in leading healthcare data warehouse design and builds, specifically using Snowflake.
• Proven experience establishing data governance frameworks, data catalog solutions, quality standards, scorecards, access controls, and data-sharing policies – with the goal to enable self-service analytics across key business areas
• Demonstrated success delivering enterprise BI and data platform enhancements, including requirements gathering, technology partnership, implementation, and change management.
• Strong track record of building trusted relationships and influencing senior leaders across multiple business functions in support of enterprise-wide initiatives
• Ability to present data strategy, governance, and business performance insights to executive audiences.
• Experience with Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or similar analytics and visualization platforms
• Advanced SQL skills and deep experience with cloud data warehouse technologies, with Snowflake required.
• Understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals, including Azure services (VMs, Azure SQL, IaaS, and PaaS).
• Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams and leaders.
• Strong people leadership skills with experience managing managers and individual contributors.
• Ability to set clear priorities, align teams to business objectives, and drive accountability for results.
• Effective change leadership skills, with the ability to guide teams through organizational and technology transformations.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
• Successfully complete current Snowflake optimization tasks, certified data and semantic layer efforts.
• Deliver actionable insights to the business and leadership to better inform decisions and provide timely feedback on key performance indicators.
• Establish the governance, performance metrics and quality standards practices (committees, roles, data standards, processes, policies, etc.) for the organization's data management and ensures compliance across the organization.
• Responsible for defining a data cataloging strategy, data dictionary, data lineage, data and metric definitions in support of driving single source of truth and self-service.
• Lead the design, measurement, and monitoring of company key performance indicators as well as high priority metrics in partnership with areas such as finance, marketing and joint venture operations.
• Influence and align executive leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, and external partners to establish enterprise priorities, drive decision-making, and ensure delivery of high-value data and analytics initiatives.
• Champion enterprise data literacy and serve as a recognized thought leader who promotes the effective use of data, analytics, and performance insights across the organization
Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams responsible for enterprise data governance, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data services, and data product management.
• Provide ongoing leadership through performance management, coaching, feedback, succession planning, and career development to build a highly engaged, high-performing team and leadership pipeline.
• Develop a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement that enables the team to deliver meaningful business impact while maintaining a highly collaborative and supportive work environment.
Key AI-Readiness Responsibilities
• Establish and maintain enterprise data governance, quality, lineage, and metadata standards needed to support AI and advanced analytics.
• Create a trusted, scalable, and discoverable data ecosystem that enables self-service analytics, machine learning, and AI applications.
• Partner with business, technology, and AI leaders to prioritize and operationalize data products that power automation, predictive analytics, and agentic AI solutions.
• Ensure enterprise data assets are managed in accordance with security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI principles.
• Develop a multi-year data strategy and roadmap that positions GoHealth to maximize the value of AI and emerging technologies.
GoHealth Core Values
GoHealth’s Core Values, listed below, are essential functions of this position:
• Collaboration: Takes ownership for collectively establishing productive partnerships and relationships and seek to gain joint understanding of priorities and objectives so that the greater good of the organization and those we serve is always at the forefront.
• Innovation: Consistently uses good judgment, applying creativity to overcome obstacles and increasing effectiveness and efficiency through process and other forms of innovation.
• Diversity & Inclusion: Fosters diversity and inclusion, to be able to better understand team members, our customers and partners. Engages the strengths and talents of each
GoHealth team member, creating an environment of involvement, respect and connection where the richness of ideas, backgrounds and perspectives are harnessed.
• Courage & Integrity: Models and practices the highest ethical and professional standards; demonstrates pride and personal interest in our patients, partners and fellow team members, deeply engaging in the business. Makes decisions, with a focus on doing the right thing; treats team members, our customers, partners and vendors with dignity, consideration, open-mindedness and respect.
• Accountability: Always shows initiative, demonstrates a bias to action and gets things done. Actively accepts responsibility for diverse roles, obligations and actions that positively influence patient and customer outcomes, our partnerships and the healthcare needs of our communities.
GoHealth Leadership Principles
GoHealth’s Leadership Principles, listed below, are essential functions for this position:
• Create Shared Purpose: Breathe life into our vision and mission. Speak to our future and create a line of sight for our team members. Set goals and communicate a plan of action.
Empower others to deliver.
Inspire and Motivate: Celebrate and share success. Grow and develop our team members.
Provide direct feedback that enables others to reach their potential. Identify when to lead and embrace the opportunity to follow.
Additional Requirements
• Office Environment: Tasks may be conducted within a climate-controlled office setting.
• Physical Activity: The role may require the ability to lift, carry, push, or pull materials, supplies, and equipment (up to 15 lbs.) Duties typically involve a combination of sitting, standing, and walking, with frequent changes in position.
• Travel: Travel may be required, including travel between Company locations and out-oftown destinations as needed, up to 15%.
• Safety Equipment: May require the use of safety equipment for infection prevention.

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Associate Director, Data Governance, FAIR, and AI-Readiness
What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will advance Enterprise Data Governance, FAIR data practices, and a data product operating model that makes trusted, reusable, and responsibly accessible data available for analytics, automation, and AI innovation.
The successful candidate will lead cross-functional data strategy and delivery across data domains, translating scientific and business priorities into scalable governance, metadata, quality, semantic interoperability, and data product capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the enterprise Data Governance, FAIR, and data product strategy and roadmap, aligning investments to scientific and business priorities.
Establish a value-realization framework to measure business outcomes, adoption, and return on investment from data initiatives.
Execute the Enterprise Data Strategy, including data ownership, reusable data products, lifecycle management, data contracts, and adoption measures.
Evolve a federated governance operating model with clear decision rights, data ownership, stewardship accountabilities, data councils, data standards, and escalation paths.
Evolve FAIR maturity across the enterprise, including embedding FAIR practices in the data lifecycle, metadata standards, persistent identifiers, controlled vocabularies, and access patterns.
Advance active metadata, data catalog, lineage, business glossary, semantic and knowledge graph capabilities to improve discovery, context, interoperability, and trust.
Set governance policies and controls for data quality, observability, privacy, security, retention, and responsible use; ensure fit-for-purpose data for regulated and AI-enabled use cases.
Partner with Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Digital, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to operationalize governed data products across platforms and domains.
Enable responsible AI by defining and enforcing data readiness criteria.
Serve as the data engagement lead for an assigned business function, driving adoption of data management practices, including FAIR, to deliver measurable data improvements and business value.
Manage large-scale data programs, cross-functional initiatives, and external partners; communicate outcomes, risks, dependencies, and value realization to senior leadership.
What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is adata management leader with biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience with these qualifications.
Basic Qualifications
Doctorate degree and 2 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Master’s degree and 6 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
OR
Associate degree and 10 years of Data Management, Information Systems, or related experience
Mandatory Skills and Qualifications
Experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry, with an understanding of regulated data, business processes, and compliance requirements.
Demonstrated leadership of enterprise data governance, data management, active metadata, data quality, or data product initiatives across business and technology teams.
Hands-on understanding of FAIR data principles and their practical application through active metadata, standards, semantics, interoperability, and access controls.
Experience establishing data governance operating models, including data ownership, stewardship, policy, standards, controls, and issue management.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex data topics into business value and decisions.
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
Experience implementing enterprise data strategy, scaling FAIR, data products operating model, and data contracts.
Knowledge of modern data management capabilities, including active metadata, data observability, lineage, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and policy-as-code.
Experience with master data, data catalog, governance, quality, active metadata, and semantic technologies: Collibra, Databricks Unity Catalog, Reltio, SciBite, or TopQuadrant.
Experience enabling responsible AI, including data readiness for machine learning, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI agent use cases.
Ability to define measurable outcomes for data investments, including data product adoption, quality, time-to-discovery, reuse, compliance, and AI readiness.
Experience managing external partners and geographically distributed delivery teams in complex stakeholder environments.
What you can expect of us
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
Stock-based long-term incentives
Award-winning time-off plans

jobs.text:
Job Title: Director, Real-World Evidence Data Platform
Job Location: Remote Position (USA), Remote, US
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Job ID
REQ-10084861
Aug 14, 2026
USA
Available in: English
Summary
This role will be part of the Real-World Evidence team and will support the development, implementation, and operationalization of scalable real-world data platforms that enable high-quality, timely, and strategically relevant evidence generation. The Director will help advance connected data capabilities across claims, electronic health records, registries, specialty data sources, and other fit-for-purpose data assets to support priority evidence needs across the portfolio.
The Director will partner closely with HEOR leads, medical strategy teams, data partners, RWE colleagues, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure that data platform capabilities are aligned with evidence generation priorities. This includes supporting the development of linked longitudinal data capabilities, helping evaluate and onboard data sources, strengthening data quality and documentation standards, and enabling more efficient activation of data assets for priority research questions.
As a member of the RWE team, the Director will contribute to evidence generation planning and execution by helping translate strategic evidence needs into practical data platform requirements. The role requires strong collaboration, technical knowledge of real-world data, and the ability to work across internal and external partners to support high-impact RWE deliverables.
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.
About the Role
Key Responsibilities:
Support the development and operationalization of scalable real-world data platforms that enable efficient and high-quality RWE generation.
Partner with RWE leads and medical strategy teams to understand evidence needs and translate them into data platform requirements.
Support integration and use of relevant RWD sources, including claims, electronic health records, registries, specialty data, and other fit-for-purpose datasets.
Contribute to the development of linked longitudinal data capabilities to enable robust real-world analyses and endpoints.
Help evaluate, onboard, and manage external data vendors and platform partners in collaboration with senior team members.
Support data quality frameworks, validation protocols, documentation standards, and governance processes for RWE platform use.
Collaborate with analytics, epidemiology, biostatistics, medical, access, and other cross-functional partners to ensure data assets are fit for purpose.
Contribute to RWE project execution by enabling timely access to appropriate data assets and supporting efficient study activation.
Identify opportunities to improve data platform usability, scalability, and efficiency for evidence generation.
Communicate data platform capabilities, limitations, and opportunities clearly to internal stakeholders.
Support development of materials, summaries, and recommendations for leadership discussions related to RWD platform strategy.
Maintain awareness of evolving RWD sources, data linkage approaches, analytical platforms, and industry trends relevant to RWE.
Essential Requirements:
Education: A Bachelors degree is required. An Advanced degree in health economics, epidemiology, statistics, public health, health policy, data science, or a related field is required. Doctoral-level training or PharmD with relevant RWE, HEOR, epidemiology, or data science experience is preferred.
7+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, consulting, or data/analytics sector.
Experience working with real-world data sources such as claims, electronic health records, registries, specialty pharmacy data, laboratory data, or linked datasets.
Experience supporting RWE, HEOR, epidemiology, outcomes research, medical affairs, market access, or related evidence-generation activities.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and external data vendors or platform partners.
Demonstrated ability to support complex projects, manage multiple priorities, and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with data quality assessment, data documentation, governance processes, or fit-for-purpose data evaluation is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of real-world data sources and their application to evidence generation.
Working knowledge of RWE study designs, observational research methods, and data considerations for healthcare research.
Familiarity with data linkage, longitudinal patient journeys, endpoint development, and fit-for-purpose data assessment.
Understanding of US healthcare data ecosystems, including payer, provider, and specialty data sources.
Ability to partner with analytics and technical teams to support data platform development and implementation.
Knowledge of data privacy, compliance, documentation, and governance expectations for RWE use.
Novartis Compensation Summary:
The salary for this position is expected to range between $185,500 and $344,500 per year.
The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.
Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.
Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together?
Benefits and Rewards: Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.
Read our handbook (PDF 30 MB)

The Novartis Group of Companies are Equal Opportunity Employers. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
Accessibility & Reasonable Accommodations
The Novartis Group of Companies are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to [email protected] or call +1(877)395-2339 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

jobs.title: Power Engineering Director
jobs.text:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.
Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.
Position Title:Power Engineering Director
Position Location:Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States
Salary
DLB recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.
Job Summary
DLB isestablishingits Power Engineering practice and is seeking a Power Engineering Director to lead and grow this service line from the ground up. This is a practice-buildinghire —the person whoexecutesthestrategicdirection, makes the hires,builds technical credibilityand positions DLB as a credible provider of utility-scale substation, BESS, microgrid, and grid integration engineering services across utility, renewable energy, data center, and industrial markets.
The Power Engineering Director will serve as the senior technical and operational leader for the practice, partnering with executive leadership to set strategy, develop engineering standards, drive business development, and build the team and capabilities necessary to scale.
ThePower Engineering Directoroperates with a high degree of autonomy, receiving strategic direction from executive leadership. This role is responsible for leading engineering teams, driving strategic initiatives, supporting organizational planning, and developing the people, processes, and technical capabilities necessary to scale the practice. As the practice matures, the Director may also be called upon to support executive leadership in evaluating strategic M&A or partnership opportunities that could accelerate PowerSolutionsgrowth, expand delivery capabilities, or add technical depth to the team.
ThePower Engineering Directorwill communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.The power engineering director will reportintothe Design Department Executive Director.
Essential Functions
Practice Leadership & Team Management (40%)
Lead, manage, and develop the power engineering team including Lead Engineers, Senior Engineers, andsupportingstaff across substation, BESS, and grid integration disciplines
Lead strategic planning for the Power Engineering practice in partnership with executive leadership
Provide technical direction, mentorship, and quality oversight across all power engineering projects and deliverables
Serve as the senior technical authority for substation design, BESS/IBR interconnection, protection & control, and grid integration engineering
Establish, implement, and maintain engineering standards, design criteria, QA/QC processes, and quality management systems for the power engineering practice
Oversee engineering deliverables for technical accuracy, constructability, code compliance, and EOR accountability
Partner with DLB executive leadership on practice growth strategy, service line development, and resource planning
Build and maintainDLB'sreputation as a qualified power engineering firm with clients, utilities, developers, and industry partners
Develop and execute initiatives that support the long-term growth of the practice, including staffing strategy, technical capabilities, and new service offerings
Identify and develop strategic industry partnerships with specialty engineering firms, electrical contractors, testing companies, and construction partners to support larger and more complex Power Solutions engagements and to extend field execution capability where required.
Client Development & Technical Leadership (25%)
Serve as the senior technical authority and primary engineering point of contact for Power Solutions client engagements, converting ecosystem-sourced opportunities into scoped, contracted work.
Lead technical proposal development, statements of qualification, and RFP responses for power engineering services; provide the engineering credibility that supportsDLB’sgo-to-market positioning.
Serve as primary client relationship manager for key Power Solutions accounts in the utility, renewable energy, and data center markets once engagements are established.
Activate and expandDLB’sexisting client relationships within the Power Solutions scope, identifying engineering service opportunities within accounts the firm already serves.
Support Accenture,Galtra, 2AI-DC, and other ecosystem partners by providing technical input, scoping support, and engineering authority for joint pursuits and shared client opportunities.
Represent DLB at industry conferences, utility meetings, interconnection forums, and technical events as the recognized expert for the Power Solutions practice.
Provide market intelligence to executive leadership on client needs, competitive dynamics, and emerging service opportunities within the utility-scale power engineering space.
Technical Oversight & Project Delivery (25%)
Provide technical oversight and EOR review for power engineering projects across the team, ensuring quality, compliance, and liability management
Review and approve major engineering deliverables, study reports, and stamped documents produced by the team
Manage resource allocation, scheduling, and workload distribution across the power engineering team
Oversee resource forecasting, staffing plans, workload balancing, and utilization across the practice to support sustainable growth
Identify and resolve technical, contractual, and client issues escalated from the project team
Ensure compliance with NESC, NEC, NFPA, ANSI, IEEE, and applicable utility standards across all project deliverables
Support project financial performance including fee management, scope control, and practice profitability
Represent DLB in negotiations and technical discussions with utilities, developers, and AHJs
Reporting (10%)
Report weekly to the Executive Directorsand President on practiceKPIs, revenue pipeline, headcount status, and financial performance against growth targets; maintain a standing executive dashboard for the Power Engineering practice.
OwnpracticeP&Lreporting and budget management; track and communicate variances, utilization rates, and margin performance on a regular cadence.
Maintain and report on the business development pipeline for the Power Engineering practice; provide regular pipeline updates to executive leadership including qualified opportunities, proposal activity, and win/loss trends.
Own the practice hiring roadmap; report regularly on recruiting progress, open requisitions, offer activity, and team capacity relative to project demand.
Monitor and communicate engineering quality, delivery performance, and client satisfaction metrics across the practice portfolio; escalate risks and issues to executive leadership with recommended corrective actions.
Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency
Identify opportunities and leverage technology, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency through workflow automation, reduced manual effort, and improved accuracy in forecasting, documentation, reporting, and quality processes.
Support adoption of emerging technologies -- including advanced analytics, data visualization tools, and digital construction management platforms -- to strengthen readiness, quality assurance, and project controls.
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure technology solutions align with DLB standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity.
Support a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology to optimize performance and scalability.
Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget
Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned
Position Requirements (Advanced level for all the following)
Knowledge of organizational objectives and how they relate to company policies
Demonstrated ability to lead organizational initiatives, develop engineering standards, and influence strategic business decisions
Experience leading practice growth through hiring, mentoring, client development, and operational planning
Deep knowledge of utility-scale power engineering including substation design (AIS/GIS), BESS/IBR interconnection, protection & control, and grid integration across medium- and high-voltage systems
Demonstrated experience managing engineering teams and leading multi-disciplinary power systems projects from concept through commissioning
Strong business development skills including client relationship management, proposal leadership, and engineering services market development
Strong working knowledge of NESC, NEC, NFPA, ANSI, IEEE (1547, 2800, 80, 1584, 519), and utility interconnection standards
Knowledge of power systems analysis tools (ETAP,SKM, ASPEN) and working familiarity with EMT/transient simulation methodologies
Proven track record managing engineering practiceP&L, team performance, and multi-project portfolios
Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet tight deadlines under pressure
Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and serve as a client-facing point of contact
Physical Demands
The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonableaccommodationsmay be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is
Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
Frequently moving throughoffice, facility and other environments
On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds
Travel / Relocation Requirements
Up to20%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees,meetingfor business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.
Education / Experience
Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering
Professional Engineer (PE) license in Electrical Engineering.
PLUS
15+ years of progressive power engineering experience with demonstrated leadership of substation, BESS, or grid integration projects.
Minimum 5 years inan engineeringmanagement, practice leadership, or department director role.
Proven track record as engineer of record on medium- to high-voltage utility electrical projects (substation, generation interconnection, or equivalent).
Experience leading, managing, and growing engineering teams of 5 or more engineers.
Preferred / Strong Plus
Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering or Business Administration (MBA).
Existing relationships with utility-scale developers, utilities, data center owners, or hyperscale clients in the power systems space
Direct experience establishing or formalizing a new engineering service line, including defining scope, building technical standards, and staffing from near-zero.
Direct, hands-on project experience withsubstation,BESS, microgrid, or inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnection from interconnection application through protection design and commissioning.
Benefits
DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include
Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
Flex spending accounts (FSA)
Dental and vision plans
Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
Paid parental leave after one year of employment
CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.
DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.
Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​
​NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:
DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.title: Director of Operations Technology & Automation
jobs.text:
About Homeaglow
Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes. We delight customers and empower cleaning professionals by building the leading platform for home services. Today, we are the world’s largest marketplace for home cleanings. Tomorrow, we’ll be the world’s leading platform for all home services.
We are transforming the home services industry by making high-quality home cleanings more accessible, affordable, and transparent for everyone. We connect customers with independent, background-checked cleaning professionals through a modern technology platform that simplifies booking, pricing, and communication.
Why Join Homeaglow?
A True Startup Environment
Join a high-growth, entrepreneurial company where speed, ownership, and impact define the culture.
Sustained, Profitable Growth
Double-digit year-over-year growth at a nine-figure revenue scale, while serving less than 0.5% of U.S. households — with significant runway ahead.
Strong Unit Economics
Disciplined focus on LTV/CAC and long-term value creation drives sustainable expansion.
Bootstrapped & Focused
No liquidation preferences. No distracting investor pressure. Just stable priorities and long-term thinking.
Real Economic Impact
Over 100,000 cleaning professionals have earned $250M+ through our platform. Average earnings are ~50% higher than traditional hotel housekeeping roles.
Vertical Expansion Strategy
Significant opportunity to expand into adjacent services and deepen customer relationships.
Building a World-Class Team
Be part of a professional, high-caliber team scaling a category-defining platform.
About the Role
We are hiring a Director of Operations Technology & Automation, reporting directly to our Chief Operating Officer, to own the automation, technology, and AI integration into our customer facing teams. This is a pivotal role to chart the automation and AI integration course of a rapidly scaling $100 million+ marketplace, focused on improving quality of our customer experience, while directly driving revenue and increasing efficiency within our 1,000+ customer-facing agent population.
This role will own the roadmap on which automation and AI integration to prioritize, having autonomy to choose third parties, prioritize experiments, and leveraging our dedicated Operations engineers. Success is measured in incremental revenue, cost-to-serve, improved customer experience, and faster response and handle times — not in features shipped.
What You’ll Own
Roadmap & Prioritization
Build and maintain a rolling 12-month roadmap for Operations tooling, automation, and AI features, prioritized by risk-adjusted ROI - working closely with our fast-paced engineering team (including dedicated Ops engineers), as well as the broader Operations Org, and Strategy team.
Specs & Delivery
Write the product specs: problem statement, current state, target state, user flows, requirements, edge cases, success metrics, and rollout plan.
Act as the owner for each initiative end-to-end — from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurement - within a rigorous fast-paced AB testing environment.
AI Integration and Tooling
Be the leader integrating AI into the company, including making the buy vs. build decisions, and managing relationships and pilots with key vendors.
Leverage the relationships with Hubspot, Aircall, and smaller third parties to evaluate and integrate AI solutions - or decide to build in-house with our engineering team.
Translate operational pain points and revenue opportunities into a prioritized backlog for tooling improvements with clear hypotheses and success metrics.
Measurement & Operating Rhythm
Weekly reporting on KPIs - which you will define based on specific project focus areas, e.g., sales automation might prioritize conversion rate on leads or touch to connect ratio, care AI integration would show costs saved / improved handling time / increased customer satisfaction.
Maintain a tight feedback loop with frontline reps and managers — shadow shifts, sit in on calls, ship, iterate.
Roadmap review every six months (frequent enough to adjust course, not so frequent that all we’re doing is roadmapping - we’re a growth phase company, nobody cares about slides).
What You’ll Bring
7+ years in product management, operations strategy, business systems, or RevOps roles, with at least 3 years owning a roadmap end-to-end.
Track record of shipping automation and AI/ML features that produced measurable productivity, conversion, or customer satisfaction gains. Be ready to talk numbers.
Direct experience building or owning internal tools for customer care, support, or sales — not just consuming them.
Strong product craft: you can write a crisp PRD, run a discovery interview, prioritize ruthlessly, and partner well with engineers.
Fluency with the modern stack: CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, or equivalent), helpdesk (Zendesk, Intercom, Kustomer, or equivalent), telephony, conversation intelligence, and LLM-powered assist tools.
Data literacy: comfortable defining metrics, reading dashboards, and using SQL or a BI tool to validate hypotheses on your own.
Travel Requirements
4 - 6 weeks travel per year, including:
1-2 trips to Manila (Philippines) for the Operations Offsite and Kick-off Party
2 company / team offsites
Perks and Benefits
Health insurance fully covered by the company.
Parental leave.
Flexible / unlimited PTO policy.
Cleaning membership perk – Free Homeaglow membership with complimentary cleanings. Enjoy up to 2x cleanings a month, capped at $200 USD per cleaning.
Equal Opportunity Employer
Homeaglow is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.
Accommodations
We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our hiring process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.
Pay Transparency
Compensation ranges are available upon request. Final offers are based on experience, skills, and location in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Well, hello there 👋
Castify (Creators of Screencastify) is a leading technology company dedicated to improving communication and learning outcomes with video. We have established ourselves as a leader in the K-12 education sector in the United States and we are critical in helping scale a teacher and improve student outcomes. We are also actively expanding into new and exciting markets outside of K-12 including bringing our tested solution into companies and organizations. Castify is used by over 15M people today and is seeking a VP of Engineering to join our Squad!
About this role
What started as the simplest and most reliable screen recorder in the world, with millions of users, is now a multi-product, AI-first platform. Our near future is full of ambitious new goals, features, and products that will enable us to further improve how we provide service to our users and accelerate growth. ​
We prioritize fast iteration without compromising quality while maintaining attention to detail that creates the kind of seamless, high-quality experiences we’re known for. We’re looking for an experienced, strategic VP of Engineering to lead and scale our engineering organization as we continue building innovative products that impact millions of users worldwide.
This role will partner with Product and GTM teams to define and execute our technical vision, strengthen engineering operations, and help shape the future of video communication and AI-powered learning experiences.
What you'll do:
Lead a high-performing Engineering organization across multiple product areas and platforms.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and workflows to accelerate team velocity and output quality.
Partner with Product leadership to define technical strategy, roadmap priorities, and execution plans.
Drive engineering excellence by establishing scalable systems, development standards, and operational best practices.
Oversee the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and reliability of our products and infrastructure.
Shape and evolve our AI-first product strategy by enabling experimentation, rapid iteration, and scalable implementation.
Guide technical decision-making across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and platform initiatives.
Ensure strong execution across teams by removing blockers, clarifying priorities, and aligning engineering efforts to business outcomes.
Foster a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Global Payouts
jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
THE WORK:
We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Ripple's cross-border payment offering that enables global institutions to bridge stablecoins and fiat instantly.
This person will lead the roadmap driving the next phase of growth for our flagship payouts products. They will use the power of digital assets and blockchain to bridge traditional financial infrastructure. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Sales and Account Management, Risk/Fraud, Finance, Compliance, and Legal to build payment experiences that are customer-first, resilient, and built to scale.
The ideal candidate has deep payments expertise and a strong curiosity about digital assets. You're a problem solver; you work best when you're driving early stage solutions to achieve next-level scale. You'll excel working in a fast-past environment, and you are adept at and handling cross-functional initiatives across geographies.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Product Strategy and Vision: Define and communicate a product vision, strategy and roadmap for our Global Payouts product.
Product Quality and Delivery: Partner with engineering to ensure clear requirements, strong acceptance criteria, and high-quality launches..
Payments Experience: Lead the end-to-end payments experience across Ripple payouts, crafting capabilities that balance customer experience, conversion, and regulatory controls.
Cross-functional Leadership: Lead high-impact initiatives and align collaborators across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk/Fraud, and Operations; remove blockers and drive decisions.
Collaborator Management and Influence: Deliver concise, committed communication to ensure alignment and drive outcomes.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
12-15 years of total professional experience in financial services, fintech, or the crypto industry, with at least 5-10 years in a core product management role.
A passion for payments and a deep curiosity about digital assets and blockchain.
Demonstrated track record of scaling and evangelizing successful products
Ability to translate complex topics into clear, concise language for different audiences.
Strong technical competence and understanding.
A knack for establishing relationships and driving alignment across teams with different priorities.
For positions that will be based in CA, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.
CA Annual Base Salary Range
$248,000—$300,000 USD
WHO WE ARE:
Do Your Best Work
The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!
Take Control of Your Finances
Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
Employee giving match
Mobile phone stipend
Take Care of Yourself
R&R days so you can rest and recharge
Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events
Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.
