jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.text:
About Abridge
Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.
Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.
We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.
The Role
As the Director of Data Science at Abridge you will be responsible for building a world-class data team, implementing a comprehensive data strategy that can help democratize data in the age of AI and use data to drive actionable insights. We’re looking for a leader who has high-agency, strong taste, and wants to make a high impact while growing our U.S. based team.
This role is crucial to our company as the data science team will serve as a central resource to provide insight and clarity while speeding up decision making. Your key cross-functional partners will include our Product, Engineering and Science teams, as well as our commercial and finance teams to ultimately help guide our decision making.
What You’ll Do
As the leader of our data science function, you’ll be responsible for:
Build and manage a world-class team of data scientists, providing guidance, mentorship and high standards while growing the team
Foster a high impact and collaborative team culture, focused on having agency, providing clarity of thinking to the organization and pride in authorship
Drive product strategy through data-driven insights across our growing product portfolio, including user behavior analysis, deep-dives into product performance metrics, causal inference experimentation
Partner with our product, strategy, and research teams to develop sophisticated ROI frameworks for our customers, ingesting real-time data and demonstrating impact
Collaborate with our world-class research team on models and model evaluation, including shaping our model evaluation frameworks, production performance monitoring, and defining quality metrics that matter clinically
Effectively communicate our data strategy, complex analyses and key insights to cross-functional partners including the executive team
Structure the company’s data strategy, working closely with our Data Engineering team to identify gaps in data sources, ingest internal & external data, and structure that data for optimal use across the company
Make critical technical infrastructure decisions for the data organization, including tooling choices, build vs buy tradeoffs for analytics platforms, and setting technical standards that enable the team to move fast without creating technical debt
Build the data science org of the future, incorporating the current and soon-to-come best practices in order to utilize AI to speed up data ingestion and insight generation
What You’ll Bring
MS or PhD in quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, computer science, physics, or related)
12+ years in data-science or analytics, especially in product-facing roles where you had to drive impact by using data to shape product strategy, goal setting and execution
Depth of experience using Python, R, SQL for large-scale analytics
Comfort building data capabilities from the earliest stages through rapid growth, including interfacing closely with data engineering and machine learning
Experience with data visualization tools, both BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, Sigma) and code-based tools (e.g. Seaborn, ggplot2)
Excellent communicator capable of effectively delivering quantitative findings to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and compelling fashion.
A strong leader who is able to help build great teams, drive urgency in execution while ensuring we prioritize appropriately in a rapid growth environment
Bonus Points
Knowledge of healthcare settings, electronic health records (EHR), and healthcare billing
Experience diving into / shaping Analytics Engineering (recruiting & supporting)
We value people who are eager to learn new things and recognize that great team members might not perfectly match a job description. If you’re interested in the role but aren’t sure whether or not you’re a good fit, we’d still like to hear from you.
Why Work at Abridge?
At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.
Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.
Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.
We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.
If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.
How we take care of Abridgers:
Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees
Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.
Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.
Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.
Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.
401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.
Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.
Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.
Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.
Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.
Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.
Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.
... and much more!
Equal Opportunity Employer
Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.
Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud
We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

jobs.title: VP, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.text:
Role Summary
Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. As VP, Infrastructure Engineering, you'll shape the platforms that make that mission possible by enabling every engineering team to build, deploy, and operate software at scale.
You'll lead an Infrastructure Engineering organization responsible for the cloud platforms, developer experience, data infrastructure, reliability, observability, and engineering productivity capabilities that power HubSpot's products. Reporting to senior engineering leadership, you'll be responsible for defining how infrastructure engineering evolves in an AI-first software company. This is a transformational leadership opportunity to influence HubSpot's technical strategy, accelerate engineering velocity, and help hundreds of engineers deliver remarkable experiences for millions of customers worldwide.
Team Overview
The Infrastructure Engineering organization provides the shared platforms, services, and tooling that every HubSpot product team depends on. From cloud infrastructure and developer platforms to data infrastructure, reliability engineering, observability, and AI-enabled engineering productivity, the team enables product engineers to move faster while delivering secure, reliable, and scalable customer experiences.
What You'll Do
Define and execute the long-term vision for Infrastructure Engineering, ensuring HubSpot's platforms continue to scale with our customers, products, and engineering organization.
Lead and develop a high-performing organization of engineers, building leadership depth and succession across the organization.
Drive the evolution of HubSpot's engineering platforms, including cloud infrastructure, platform as a service, data infrastructure, observability, and reliability engineering.
Lead the transformation of Infrastructure Engineering for an AI-first future by identifying opportunities where AI fundamentally changes how software is built, operated, and supported.
Accelerate global infrastructure expansion while ensuring platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and executive leadership to align infrastructure investments with company strategy and product priorities.
Champion modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, operational excellence, and continuous improvements to platform reliability and developer experience.
Drive adoption of scalable platform capabilities that improve engineering velocity while reducing operational complexity.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, inclusion, and customer focus across the Infrastructure Engineering organization.
Build strategic relationships with key technology partners, including hyperscale cloud providers, to maximize long-term platform capabilities and business value.
What You'll Bring
Required Qualifications
Significant executive engineering leadership experience leading large, multi-layer engineering organizations.
Proven success building and scaling Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, Developer Platforms, or Cloud Platform organizations within modern cloud-native SaaS businesses.
Experience operating highly available, globally distributed systems serving millions of users or customers at internet scale.
Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, developer platforms, reliability engineering, observability, infrastructure automation, and modern software delivery.
Demonstrated ability to define long-term technical strategy while delivering measurable business outcomes.
Experience partnering with executive leadership to shape organizational strategy and technology investment decisions.
Strong track record developing engineering leaders, building inclusive organizations, and creating high-performing teams.
Excellent executive communication, organizational leadership, and cross-functional influencing skills.
Passion for leveraging AI to transform engineering, infrastructure, operations, and the entire software lifecycle.
Nice-to-Have Qualifications
Experience operationalizing modern database technologies and large-scale data platforms.
Experience building or evolving internal developer platforms that significantly improve engineering productivity.
Experience partnering strategically with AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
Track record improving cloud efficiency and operational cost optimization at enterprise scale.
Active participation in the broader engineering community through technical writing, speaking, or open-source contributions.
Pay & Benefits
The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.
This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.
Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.
At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.
Annual Cash Compensation Range:
$401,895—$643,005 USD
We know theconfidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.
If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.
At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.
If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements
Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
Germany Applicants: (m/f/d) - link to HubSpot's Career Diversity page here.
India Applicants: link to HubSpot India's equal opportunity policy here.
About HubSpot
HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.
At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.
We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.
Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.
Explore more:
HubSpot Careers
Life at HubSpot on Instagram
HubSpot may use AI to help screen or assess candidates, but all hiring decisions are always human. More information can be found here. By submitting your application, you agree that HubSpot may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. We may use CLEAR ID Verification during the hiring process to confirm your identity and help maintain a safe, secure, and trusted experience for all candidates. Refer to HubSpot's Recruiting Privacy Notice for details on data processing and your rights.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Data and Analytics
jobs.text:
Overview
To drive innovation and operational excellence through technology that enables teams to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences. The Business Systems department delivers software to drive business process optimization through automation, intuitive workflows, and data governance. Our goal is to serve our internal customers (operators & support departments) with solutions that empower them to maximize their performance and enhance the customer journey.
Position Summary
The Senior Director, Data & Analytics leads the strategic direction, delivery, and operational maturity of RPM Living's Data & Analytics organization within Product & Engineering. This role partners directly with the SVP, Data & Analytics, to build and scale internal data engineering, analytics, and governance capabilities, reducing reliance on third-party contractors while establishing RPM Living as a data-driven, insight-led organization.
Responsibilities
• Serve as the senior operating leader for the Data & Analytics team, translating the SVP's vision into staffing plans, delivery roadmaps, and quarterly priorities.• Own end-to-end delivery of the Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold/semantic layers) in partnership with the Data Engineering Lead and Lead Data Architect.• Directly manage and develop a team spanning data engineering, analytics/BI, data governance, and QA, including performance management, career development, and org design.• Partner with business stakeholders across property operations, finance, and technology to prioritize analytics and reporting initiatives, including cross-platform data integrations and business processes.• Establish data governance, quality, and security standards across 30+ source integrations (Yardi, RealPage, UKG, Salesforce, and others).• Evaluate and drive adoption of AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude, CodeRabbit) to accelerate engineering velocity and analytics delivery.• Present roadmap progress, risks, and organizational health to senior executive leadership.• Manage vendor and contractor relationships, budgets, and resourcing decisions for the Data & Analytics function.• Define and enforce architectural and coding standards, working closely with the Lead Data Architect to ensure long-term platform scalability.
Education and Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field. Experience may substitute for education.• Ten years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence, including Five+ years in a people-leadership role.• Five years’ experience with modern cloud data platforms (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse/SQL, or equivalent) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).• Experience in multifamily, real estate, or another property-operations-driven industry is a plus but not required.
• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical strategy for non-technical senior leadership.• Knowledge of data architecture patterns (medallion/lakehouse), data governance frameworks, and modern BI/semantic modeling practices.• Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing technical teams in a rebuild/turnaround environment.• Strong vendor management and contract negotiation skills, particularly related to managed services and staff augmentation.• Comfort operating with ambiguity and evolving scope typical of a growing, newly-formed department.• Working knowledge of AI-assisted development and analytics tooling and its application to team productivity.
Qualifications
Physical Requirements:• May be required to sit for extended periods of time • May occasionally be required to lift or carry items such as files or office supplies weighing up to 15 pounds • Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment • Must be able to read documents, computer screens, and data • Must be able to hear and understand verbal communications in person and over the phone or computer
Work Environment:• This is a remote role. The associate must have a dedicated workspace that is free from distraction and has reliable internet.• Overnight travel may be required quarterly for various business reasons.
Company Information
Join RPM Living and experience exceptional benefits designed to enhance your life.
Weekly pay for all associates working onsite at an apartment community
Comprehensive healthcare coverage available for all full-time, regular associates
Employer-paid employee assistance, mental health, and wellness programs
Ancillary benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance
401(k) with robust company match
Opportunities for professional development, career growth, and role-based learning plans
Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) and multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERG)
Paid time off plus floating holidays and volunteer days
Discounted Perks (Costco membership, movie tickets, health & wellness, entertainment & travel discounts)
Employment with RPM Living is contingent upon successful completion of a background check as local and federal state requires. A valid driver’s license is preferred; candidates without a license will be provided a liability waiver.
RPM Living participates in E-Verify. For more information, see the E-Verify Participation Poster and the Right to Work Poster.
RPM Living is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Serve as the senior operating leader for the Data & Analytics team, translating the SVP's vision into staffing plans, delivery roadmaps, and quarterly priorities.• Own end-to-end delivery of the Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold/semantic layers) in partnership with the Data Engineering Lead and Lead Data Architect.• Directly manage and develop a team spanning data engineering, analytics/BI, data governance, and QA, including performance management, career development, and org design.• Partner with business stakeholders across property operations, finance, and technology to prioritize analytics and reporting initiatives, including cross-platform data integrations and business processes.• Establish data governance, quality, and security standards across 30+ source integrations (Yardi, RealPage, UKG, Salesforce, and others).• Evaluate and drive adoption of AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude, CodeRabbit) to accelerate engineering velocity and analytics delivery.• Present roadmap progress, risks, and organizational health to senior executive leadership.• Manage vendor and contractor relationships, budgets, and resourcing decisions for the Data & Analytics function.• Define and enforce architectural and coding standards, working closely with the Lead Data Architect to ensure long-term platform scalability.
Education and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field. Experience may substitute for education.• Ten years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence, including Five+ years in a people-leadership role.• Five years’ experience with modern cloud data platforms (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse/SQL, or equivalent) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).• Experience in multifamily, real estate, or another property-operations-driven industry is a plus but not required.

• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical strategy for non-technical senior leadership.• Knowledge of data architecture patterns (medallion/lakehouse), data governance frameworks, and modern BI/semantic modeling practices.• Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing technical teams in a rebuild/turnaround environment.• Strong vendor management and contract negotiation skills, particularly related to managed services and staff augmentation.• Comfort operating with ambiguity and evolving scope typical of a growing, newly-formed department.• Working knowledge of AI-assisted development and analytics tooling and its application to team productivity.
Qualifications

Physical Requirements:• May be required to sit for extended periods of time • May occasionally be required to lift or carry items such as files or office supplies weighing up to 15 pounds • Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment • Must be able to read documents, computer screens, and data • Must be able to hear and understand verbal communications in person and over the phone or computer

Work Environment:• This is a remote role. The associate must have a dedicated workspace that is free from distraction and has reliable internet.• Overnight travel may be required quarterly for various business reasons.
Company Information
Join RPM Living and experience exceptional benefits designed to enhance your life.

Opportunities for professional development, career growth, and role-based learning plans

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
If you are a candidate, we're very keen to tell you more about this position. Please continue reading! If you are an agency, headhunter or similar 3rd party, please scroll all the way down so you won’t miss our most important message to you.
Job title: Head of Engineering
This is a senior leadership role. You will set engineering standards, direction, and priorities. You will be accountable for fleet availability, drive a continuous programme of service modifications and upgrades, and act as the organisation's senior technical authority. You will have a strong engineering grounding, enough to challenge and guide your teams.
Your headline accountability: Fleet availability is the primary measure of success in this role. You own the engineering decisions and processes that keep turbines producing safely and reliably, and you are accountable for meeting the availability commitments we make to our clients.
· Own fleet-wide availability as your primary KPI: Accountable for the engineering strategy, standards, and decisions that protect and improve it across the multi-brand fleet.
· Turn availability data into engineering priorities: Identify the bad actors, recurring failure modes, and systemic issues dragging the fleet down, and direct your teams’ effort where it moves the number most.
· Safeguard contractual performance: Ensure engineering activity supports availability guarantees and warranty positions, and flag risks early.
· Report on availability: Communicate trends, root causes, and the engineering actions taken to leadership and, where relevant, to clients.
Engineering leadership & oversight:
· Lead the engineering teams: Set their direction, standards, and priorities, develop their capability, and hold them accountable for resolution quality and speed.
· Ensure rigorous root-cause analysis: You are accountable that complex and recurring faults are investigated to a consistent standard and resolved at the true mechanism, not that you perform the analysis yourself.
· Review and approve high-stakes conclusions: Challenge weak analysis and sign off findings on fleet-threatening, safety-critical, or warranty-related failures.
· Act as the senior technical authority: The top of the escalation path for strategic or cross-fleet issues, sitting above the escalation teams rather than as first-line support.
· Own the engineering knowledge base: Ensure lessons learned, failure history, and standard repair methods are captured and reused across the fleet.
Service modifications & continuous improvement:
· Continuously seek upgrade opportunities: Proactively identify ways to improve turbine reliability, performance, and lifecycle cost through service modifications, retrofits, and upgrades across the multi-brand fleet.
· Build the case for modifications: Assess technical merit alongside cost, downtime, and availability/return impact, and present it in terms owners and the commercial team can act on.
· Drive approved campaigns to completion: Own the engineering side of modification rollouts from design through field implementation and close-out.
· Maintain an improvement pipeline: Keep a prioritised backlog of initiatives ranked by their effect on availability, safety, and cost.
Stakeholder & supplier management:
· Manage OEM, supplier, and consultancy relationships: Evaluate external engineering studies critically and integrate sound findings into fleet strategy.
· Support the commercial function: Provide technical input to proposals, warranty disputes, and end-of-warranty inspections, and help frame engineering value commercially.
What you bring:
· Proven engineering judgement on complex, multi-brand failures — enough depth in drivetrain, power conversion, and control systems to challenge a root-cause analysis, even though you will not be hands-on.
· Track record of leading or managing technical teams.
· Commercial literacy, able to frame engineering decisions, especially modifications, in terms of availability, cost, and return, and to navigate client and internal stakeholders.
· Comfortable working with SCADA, condition-monitoring, fault logs, and supplier documentation.
· Willingness to travel.
What’s in it for you?
At Full Circle, we don’t just offer a competitive pay and benefits package (though you’ll get that too—including pension contributions, health and life insurance, an electric car scheme, holiday purchase options, gym discounts, and access to our employee support program). More importantly, you’ll have the chance to shape your career in a way that works for you. Whether that means learning new technologies on our wind farm sites, stepping into a remote support role, or growing into a leadership position, we’ll support you in finding the path that fits your skills and ambitions.
If you’re ready to join us in harnessing the power of the wind and driving forward the future of clean energy, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today, and let’s keep the world turning—one turbine at a time! 🌎💨
About Full Circle
At Full Circle, we've been in the wind turbine game for over two decades, and now, we're ready to spread our wings and soar as an independent entity, supporting various wind turbine brands. Our journey into independence began in 2021, and every day, our team is fuelled by the excitement of growth and autonomy.
Our Mission: Offering Top-Notch Support, No Exceptions!
We're here to dish out top-tier maintenance support to everyone in need, regardless of the turbine brand or whether you've got one or a hundred turbines in your backyard. Expect us to swoop in with agile, honest, and lightning-fast support. From routine maintenance to blade inspections, repairs, 24/7 remote monitoring, and even those must-do statutory inspections – we've got your back! Basically, everything to keep those turbines dancing in the wind.
Our Secret Sauce: Expertise, Resources, and a Personal Touch! We're renowned for our wizard-like expertise, abundant resources, and a friendly, personalised approach that ensures you squeeze every last whirl out of those turbines.
Our HQ: Where Magic Happens! Our headquarters are nestled in the lively city of Amersfoort, Netherlands. But hey, our squad is scattered all across Europe, maintaining wind turbines across the globe.
Meet Our Funky, Spirited Team. We're not just a team; we're a bubbling cauldron of enthusiasm and youthfulness, growing alongside our company. That makes our work environment an absolute blast—overflowing with energy and collaboration! We're open, direct, and as honest as a clear blue sky, reflecting the diverse world we live in!
Hey, You! Still Here? Join the Fun!
If you're still hanging in there and thinking, "This sounds like my kind of jam," hit that apply button. We're itching to meet folks who match our vibe and skills. Let's make some wind turbine magic together! Join us at Full Circle. If you're keen on renewable energy and thrive in a dynamic environment, we want you on our team!
Apply Now and Let's Rock the Wind Turbine World Together!
NOTE TO 3RD PARTIES:
Here at Full Circle, we are very lucky to be very successful recruiting all our new employees ourselves. Something we are very proud of. Despite our kind requests to all of you not to reach out for support in this area, our HR team, hiring managers and our front office are overwhelmed with contact requests, telephone calls, email requests and other attempts to get in touch. We know you guys are out there; we understand that this cold acquisition is part of your job, but we strongly request that you respect our time and not reach out. We want to use all the time we have to make the world a greener place! If we ever need support, we'll work with our preferred suppliers (and no, we are not looking for new ones;-)) We appreciate your understanding on this, and we wish you the best of luck on finding your next client.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management (Platform & Growth)
jobs.text:
Death is our only foe.
Immortals was founded by Bryan Johnson, who has the world’s best comprehensive biomarkers. He is quantitatively the healthiest person on the planet.
Immortals is methodically built on science. Bryan freely shares his protocol, learnings and data with everyone to use. Immortals has also developed a family of nutritional products to make the benefits of the Blueprint protocol affordable and available to all.
We’re a small, tight-knit team working to clean up the global food supply, provide healthy food to everyone, and build Don’t Die into the most influential ideology in the world. We move quickly, work efficiently, and enjoy an environment defined by competence.
We are seeking a rare, hands-on leader who can operate at the intersection of high-scale systems and high-velocity commercial growth. As the VP of Product, you will lead the product and design vision for Immortals’ digital experiences, ensuring our technical foundation is modular and scalable while driving user acquisition and monetization.
A core mission for this role is creating a new, unified AI interaction experience that seamlessly ties together our commerce (supplements and meds), biomarker data, and our passionate community. This experience is designed to help deliver the best personalized solutions and recommendations to improve our users’ longevity and health. You aren't just a people manager; you are a "player-coach" who remains deeply hands-on in the product management process, leveraging AI assistance to drive 10x productivity and execution.
Requirements
Position Responsibilities:
1. Commercial Growth, E-commerce & Community
Full-Solution E-commerce: Optimize the purchase and renewal experience for our total health solutions, including supplements, prescription medicines, and biomarker testing.
Community Ecosystem: Foster and build the digital infrastructure for our community of users who care for each other’s health as much as their own.
Revenue Alignment: Partner with Sales and Marketing to optimize the "Product-Led Growth" (PLG) funnel and expansion.
Retention Economics: Use behavioral data and community loops to build "sticky" products that increase Lifetime Value (LTV).
2. The Unified AI Experience & Platform
Next-Gen AI Interaction: Lead the design and delivery of an AI-driven interface that synthesizes biomarker results, product recommendations, and community insights into a single, intuitive user experience.
System Scalability: Work with Engineering to ensure our data and AI layers support rapid third-party integrations and global scale.
Technical Debt Management: Make high-judgment calls on when to refactor for stability versus when to sprint for market impact.
3. Hands-on Execution & Leadership
Player-Coach Mentality: Run the product management process end-to-end—from discovery to shipping—while building and leading a high-performing team.
AI-Assisted Workflow: Champion the use of AI tools within the product organization to accelerate research, documentation, and design.
Strategic Conviction: Pivot quickly based on new information while having the data-backed conviction to protect the core product path.
Basic Qualifications:
10+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a VP or senior leadership role.
Hands-on Expert: Demonstrated ability to remain "in the weeds" of product execution while managing an organization.
B2C Scale: Proven track record scaling products from 0 to 1 and managing millions of users.
AI Fluent: Experience leveraging AI tools (LLMs, agents, coding assistants) in your personal and professional workflow.
Proven track record leading both product management and design teams simultaneously.
Preferred Skills:
Health E-commerce: Experience in B2C companies selling complex physical/digital health solutions (supplements, pharmaceuticals, or lab testing).
Community Building: Experience building or managing digital communities focused on shared goals or identity.
AI UX Innovator: Experience creating novel, non-traditional user interfaces driven by AI and data synthesis.
Experience in health tech, wellness, or personalization-driven digital products.
Passion for longevity, health optimization, or the Immortals mission.
Benefits
Salary Range: $220-265k + equity + benefits

jobs.title: Founding Engineer (Potential CTO)
jobs.text:
About the Role
A well-funded, early-stage healthtech startup is looking for a Founding Engineer (with CTO potential) to be the second technical voice at the company. This is a rare opportunity to own the full technical direction of a clinically grounded AI mobile product that uses biofeedback and biosignal data to help people repair their autonomic nervous system and manage chronic symptoms.
You'll ship the first end-to-end AI coaching experience, design the underlying model and feedback loop, define the engineering culture, and make foundational stack decisions that will shape how the company builds for years to come. This role is on-site in Montreal, San Francisco, or New York City — candidates must be willing and able to work in person.
Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
What You'll Do
Serve as the Founding Engineer and potential CTO, owning technical direction and hands-on execution.
Ship the first AI coaching experience end-to-end — from the React Native mobile app to frontier-model-backed inference and wearable integrations.
Architect and build the AI nervous system training coach, including model design, prompt engineering, tool use, and evaluation frameworks.
Translate biosignals (HRV, breath, motion, PPG) into a real-time, personalized coaching layer.
Build and maintain AI-powered QA and testing pipelines to enable safe, continuous shipping.
Own full-stack decisions across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI-native layers.
Integrate iOS/HealthKit and wearable platforms (e.g., Apple Watch, Oura, Whoop, EEG headbands).
Collaborate closely with the founding team in person to move fast and make hard tradeoffs.
What We're Looking For
Dealbreakers (must-haves):
Proven, hands-on experience shipping and operating Claude or other frontier models in production — including prompts, tool use, and evals.
Willingness and ability to work on-site in Montreal, San Francisco, or New York City.
3+ years of mobile/full-stack engineering experience, with at least one 0→1 consumer mobile app shipped and operated with real users.
Required:
Experience with AI-native infrastructure where AI capabilities are integrated across layers (not bolted on).
Backend development in Node.js or Python with PostgreSQL and modern infra (e.g., Vercel, Fly, Render).
Ability to move fluidly across the stack — frontend, backend, infra, and AI — with minimal handholding.
Deep fluency in React Native and full ownership of the mobile lifecycle (build, release, debug, monitor, iterate).
Experience with HealthKit, wearable APIs, or real-time biosignal data (HRV, PPG, motion).
Nice to Have:
Experience building AI-powered testing or evaluation pipelines.
Prior experience as the first or only engineer at a startup.
Background or strong interest in nervous system science, somatics, neuroscience, or trauma research.
Compensation & Benefits
Base salary: $170,000 USD
Equity: Meaningful equity package offered (ranging up to significant founder-level upside based on performance and trajectory)
Direct path to CTO for the right candidate
Location
This is an on-site role. The primary location is Montreal, Canada, with the option to be based in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY. Regular in-person collaboration with the founding team is expected. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Direct path to CTO for the right candidate

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Emphasys PHA
jobs.text:
Who we are
Aquila, a group within Constellation Software Inc., one of North America’s largest and most respected software companies, invests in category-defining B2B and B2G software businesses globally, providing long-term support and strategic guidance. Emphasys Software has been part of Aquila since 2008.
Operating across five specialized divisions, Emphasys provides mission-critical software that modernizes and streamlines complex processes for housing authorities, lenders, and government agencies in nearly every state. Through both products and services, Emphasys helps house roughly half of the families most in need in the country.
At Emphasys PHA, a division of Emphasys, we develop and support industry-leading software designed specifically for Public Housing Authorities across the United States. As a trusted provider in the affordable housing sector, our solutions help PHAs efficiently manage operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and deliver critical housing services to families and individuals in need. From applicant intake to rent calculations and unit inspections, our platform supports the full lifecycle of public housing programs—empowering agencies to focus on their mission of providing safe, stable, and affordable housing.
Who we need
Reporting to the CEO, we are hiring a Director of Product Management to lead and strengthen our Product function. As our new Director of Product Management, you will bring greater structure, discipline, and strategic direction to how we define, prioritize, and deliver our product roadmap. Leading a team of three Product Owners, you will establish stronger product management practices, coach and develop the team, and partner closely with Development, Sales, Marketing, and industry leadership to connect customer needs and market opportunities with business priorities. You will balance strategy with hands-on leadership as we evolve our product offering, including the continued transition from a legacy desktop application toward a more modern, web-based platform.
This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States.
What’s in it for you
The opportunity to shape the Product function. You will step into a team with deep industry knowledge and an opportunity to introduce the product management structure, practices, and operating rhythm that will help it evolve. You will have the autonomy to strengthen roadmapping, prioritization, and agile ways of working while coaching a team that is ready to build its product management capabilities. Your experience will directly influence how the function operates and how product decisions are made.
A meaningful product transformation. You will help guide the evolution of an established software product as we continue moving from a legacy desktop application toward a more modern, web-based platform. You will have the opportunity to balance customer needs and commitments with innovation and technical investment, helping determine what we build, why it matters, and where we focus next.
Evolve how Product works with AI. You will help the Product team adopt and mature AI-enabled ways of working, including the emerging AI Delivery Life Cycle (AI-DLC) methodology. As these practices continue to evolve across the organization, you will help the team explore where AI can strengthen product discovery, decision-making, development, and delivery, encouraging thoughtful experimentation while establishing practical approaches that can scale.
Influence and visibility. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will have a voice in decisions that connect product direction with customer needs, market opportunities, and business growth. You will work closely with Development, Sales, Marketing, and industry leadership and engage directly with customers, giving you broad exposure and the opportunity to influence both product strategy and how that strategy comes to life.
How you will make an impact:
Set the product direction. You will define and communicate a clear product vision and strategy, connecting customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities. You will translate that direction into a longer-term roadmap that gives teams greater clarity on where we are going, why it matters, and what comes next.
Bring structure to product management. You will establish stronger product management practices, operating rhythms, and agile ways of working. You will bring greater discipline to prioritization, backlog management, planning, and decision-making, helping the team move from reactive delivery toward a more consistent and strategic approach.
Lead the evolution of the product. You will help guide the continued transition from a legacy desktop application toward a more modern, web-based product. Partnering closely with Development, you will balance innovation, technical investment, customer commitments, and business priorities to support predictable, high-quality delivery.
Develop and empower the team. You will lead, coach, and develop a team of three Product Owners, building their product management capabilities and creating greater clarity around ownership and accountability. Initially operating as a player-coach, you will provide hands-on guidance while helping the team become increasingly strategic and effective.
Bring the customer into product decisions. You will engage directly with customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and priorities and bring those insights back into product strategy and planning. You will confidently present product direction, listen to feedback, and ensure customer needs are considered alongside broader market and business opportunities.
Connect Product across the business. You will partner with Development, Sales, Marketing, and industry leadership to create stronger alignment around product priorities and opportunities. You will contribute product insight to positioning, packaging, pricing, strategic accounts, and growth discussions, helping connect product decisions to customer value and business outcomes.
Here’s what you bring:
The product leadership experience. You have led a product team and know how to build the structure, practices, and accountability that enable people to do their best work. You have experience coaching and developing Product Owners or Product Managers while remaining close enough to the work to provide practical, hands-on guidance when needed.
The strategic and operational mindset. You can translate customer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives into a clear product strategy and actionable roadmap. You know how to prioritize competing needs, make thoughtful trade-offs, and bring greater discipline and predictability to how product decisions are made and executed.
The product management discipline. You have worked within strong product management environments and understand agile principles, backlog management, roadmapping, prioritization, and product lifecycle practices. You can assess what is working, identify where greater structure is needed, and introduce processes that help a team become more strategic and effective without adding unnecessary complexity.
The customer focus. You are comfortable engaging directly with customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and priorities and using those insights to inform product decisions. You can present product direction with confidence, navigate differing perspectives, and build credibility with customers and industry stakeholders.
The cross-functional leadership. You can build trusted relationships across Development, Sales, Marketing, and leadership teams, bringing different perspectives together around shared priorities. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences and can challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and push back constructively when needed.
The adaptability. You are comfortable joining an established business and product at an important point in its evolution. You bring curiosity and sound judgment to learning a specialized market and are open to exploring how emerging technologies, including AI-assisted development, can support better products and more effective ways of working.
The AI-forward mindset. You are curious about how AI is changing the product discipline and are motivated to explore how it can improve the way products are discovered, developed, and delivered. You may already have experience incorporating AI-enabled tools or methodologies into product practices, or you bring the curiosity and willingness to learn, experiment, and help a team adopt new ways of working as technologies and approaches continue to evolve.
Why join?
Aquila is a division of Constellation Software Inc., one of the largest and most successful software companies in Canada and the most successful technology stock in Canada over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].
Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.
We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.
If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fiber, you will thrive at Aquila.
Apply now.
Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.
What you can expect from our interview process:
A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
An interview with the CEO focused on your product leadership experience and your approach to building product management discipline, developing a team, and strengthening how product strategy and execution come together.
A final interview with members of the leadership team focused on your leadership approach, cross-functional collaboration, and how you would work across the organization to help evolve the Product function.
Aquila welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology Operations
jobs.text:
Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@, @, or @) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.
About the Role
We are looking for a seasoned technology operations leader with direct experience with data, data operations, hosting infrastructure, both public and private cloud, development operations as well as cyber-security; to work with a top-notch team in an exciting, innovative and dynamic environment.
Your Area of Focus
Lead adoption and usage of advanced AI technologies across the operations organization to improve overall internal efficiency, getting more done to accelerate product and business outcomes
Stay on top of leading technology operational trends and AI advancements, identifying the best, creative solutions to incorporate to drive efficiency and greater throughput
Provide leadership, vision and strategy driving automation, stability, and availability of our technology infrastructure leveraging cloud and on-premise technologies to support business agility and maximize efficiencies
Drive innovation across security, data privacy, data and development operations and infrastructure
Define the technology operations strategy and roadmap to support current and future business needs for scalability, growth capacity, and quality of service (performance, reliability, and business continuity)
Define requirements for new technology implementations and clearly communicate them to key business stakeholders
Partner with senior leaders across the business to realize measurable outcomes aligned with business expectations
Drive the execution of security, data, infrastructure and technology operations initiatives and projects to achieve the expected scalability, performance, and availability targets
Assess and communicate risks associated with technology-related investments and purchases
Support business growth initiatives by aligning the technology operations vision with the business strategy
Develop business case justifications and cost/benefit analyses for technology operations spending and initiatives
Develop and implement the people, process and technologies, necessary for meeting current and future customer demands
Define, maintain, and present metrics to the executive and leadership team on a regular basis such as overall security, data, and infrastructure health, any risk areas, productivity stats, and overall health of technology operations
Define, measure, and improve technology standards across the organization to establish a technology-enabled competitive edge
Provide reliable due diligence and technical assessments of potential acquisitions
Your Professional Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or higher in the field of computer science, information systems, or engineering
15 years of experience managing technology operations in the fields of development operations, data, infrastructure, and cybersecurity
Extensive knowledge and direct experience with AI tools and methodologies on how to apply them to improve operational efficiency
Strong technical background in an environment with a heterogeneous mix of on-premise, hosted, and cloud hardware and software
Experience with leading operational technologies for deployment, maintenance, and monitoring of large scale SaaS platforms
Experience with hosting operations and leading cloud migrations with AWS, Azure, and GCP
Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts bringing the best solutions to Tebra while optimizing expense costs
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical details and strategy to non-technical leadership
Demonstrated success leading modernization and transformation initiatives across data and infrastructure environments
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity methodologies and practices to stay ahead of growing security threats
Demonstrated success in leading large, diverse global teams
Effective people leader who attracts and retains strong talent
Expert knowledge of technology environments, including networks, operating systems, databases, application and web servers
Technical experience with systems networking, databases, infrastructure, and user support
Experience defining standardized operating procedures and services across various operational disciplines
Experience in strategic technology planning, execution, and policy development
Experience with business processes, management, and budgeting
Strong understanding of project management principles
Proven experience in planning, organization, and development
Demonstrated ability to apply technology solutions to business problems
Experience with acquisition due diligence and integrations
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions.
Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this:

Zone 3: High-Cost Regions
Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions
Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen.
Zone 1 (National Average)
$282,000—$322,000 USD
About Tebra
Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at .
Our Values
Start with the Customer
We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.
Keep It Simple
Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.
Stay Entrepreneurial
We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.
Better Together
We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together.
Celebrate Success
Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success.
Perks & Benefits
United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering | US -Remote
jobs.text:
Vice President of Engineering
Company: Neuron7.ai
Location: US -Remote
About Neuron7.ai
Neuron7.ai is a leading Service Resolution Intelligence platform leveraging AI and GenAI to transform enterprise service operations. We help global enterprises improve resolution speed, reduce operational costs, and enhance customer experience through intelligent automation and AI-driven insights.
Role Overview
We are looking for a seasoned VP of Engineering to lead and scale our global engineering organization. This leader will be responsible for driving the technology vision, building high-performing teams, and delivering scalable, enterprise-grade AI products. The role requires deep expertise in AI/GenAI systems, distributed architecture, and enterprise SaaS platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Define and execute the engineering strategy and technology roadmap aligned with business goals
Build, lead, and scale high-performing global engineering teams
Drive architecture and delivery of AI/GenAI platforms (LLMs, RAG, NLP, agentic systems)
Ensure scalability, reliability, and performance of enterprise SaaS products
Partner closely with Product, Sales, and Customer teams to deliver customer-centric solutions
Establish best practices in software development, DevOps, and quality engineering
Lead hiring, mentoring, and leadership development across engineering teams
Drive innovation in AI, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
Manage budgets, planning, and execution for engineering initiatives
Required Qualifications
15+ years of experience in software engineering, with 5+ years in senior leadership roles
Proven experience leading engineering teams in high-growth SaaS or AI companies
Strong expertise in distributed systems, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and microservices
Experience building and scaling AI/GenAI systems (LLMs, RAG, NLP, search platforms)
Track record of delivering enterprise-grade products at scale
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Field Service, Customer Service, or enterprise operations domain
Familiarity with Salesforce, ServiceNow, or enterprise system integrations
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, and AI evaluation frameworks
Background in data engineering, analytics, or search systems
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
Neuron7.ai is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We ensure equal employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
If you’re excited about using data to drive service intelligence and want to be part of a forward-thinking team, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: VP, Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
Why We Stand Out
Seeking a career-defining opportunity where your leadership, strategic vision, and client expertise are recognized and rewarded? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you.
As one of the top accounting firms in the country, our foundation is “people first.” In the words of James Kaufman, “we prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day.”
Kaufman Rossin is a privately owned, independent public accounting firm, which means we are not beholden to outside investors or private equity influence. This independence allows us to prioritize long-term client relationships, maintain objectivity in our advisory approach, and make strategic decisions that benefit our people and clients, not external stakeholders. Our structure fosters agility, entrepreneurial thinking, and a collaborative culture where leadership is accessible, and innovation is encouraged.
Celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida over a dozen times, Kaufman Rossin has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area, including sister entities Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
Think you have what it takes?
How You’ll Contribute
Kaufman Rossin is seeking a VP of Platform Engineering to join our growing Information Technology team. In this role, you will lead the strategy, delivery, and governance of KR’s Platform Engineering function, including AI application development, Salesforce CRM, Azure and AWS cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365, automation and application integration, M Files document management, and our global delivery team in Bengaluru.
Platform Engineering Leadership & Strategy
Define the technical roadmap for cloud platforms, DevOps, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and AI assisted engineering tools
Build, develop, and retain a high performing global engineering team across South Florida and Bengaluru
Manage the Platform Engineering budget, including headcount, cloud costs, tools, and vendor contracts
Lead transformational initiatives while fostering professional development, accountability, and strong performance AI Applications (Internal & Client-Facing)
AI Applications
Establish the AI use case roadmap, model selection strategy, and governance framework
Oversee the development of Azure based AI applications, including retrieval augmented generation, document intelligence, conversational agents, and client solutions
Ensure responsible AI practices through content filtering, data isolation, audit logging, and appropriate governance controls
Salesforce CRM
Provide strategic oversight of Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud
Partner with Marketing leadership to support campaign management, client engagement, and relationship strategies
Ensure Salesforce solutions align with business objectives, integration standards, and user needs
Azure and AWS Cloud Infrastructure
Lead cloud infrastructure strategy across Azure and AWS, including architecture, governance, security, and cost management
Oversee the migration from AWS to Azure and the transition from Citrix to Azure Virtual Desktop
Provide leadership across the Microsoft technology ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, Entra ID, Purview, and Sentinel
Automation and Application Integration
Lead KR’s automation capabilities across Automation Anywhere, UiPath, Power Automate, Workato, and MuleSoft
Define build, buy, and platform strategies that improve efficiency, scalability, and return on investment
Establish standards for application integration, automation governance, and solution delivery
M Files Document Management
Lead the technical implementation and ongoing development of M Files, including architecture, configuration, and integration with Salesforce and Azure
Ensure the platform supports the document management, audit, security, and compliance requirements of a CPA firm
Vendor and Stakeholder Management
Manage strategic relationships with Microsoft, Salesforce, AI providers, automation platforms, and other technology partners
Lead vendor evaluations, requests for proposals, proof of concept assessments, and technology recommendations
Collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Security, Data Insights, PMO, Operations, and business leaders
Communicate complex technical strategies clearly to executive, client, business, and technical audiences

jobs.title: Director, Procurement (Technology & Product)
jobs.text:
At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.
The Crown Is Yours
As Director of Procurement, you'll lead a team responsible for procurement strategy supporting Technology & Product. You will partner with senior leaders to develop commercial strategies that support product innovation, platform scalability, operational resilience, and responsible technology investment. By connecting technology roadmaps, consumption insights, and market intelligence, you'll help teams move quickly while delivering measurable value and improving business outcomes.
What You'll Do
Lead and develop a team of Procurement professionals supporting Technology & Product, setting clear priorities, building category expertise, and fostering a high-performance culture.
Own the procurement strategy, supplier ecosystem, and sourcing roadmap across enterprise software, SaaS, cloud and infrastructure, hardware, telecom, data, AI, developer tools, cybersecurity, and technology services.
Partner with executive and senior leaders across Technology, Product, Engineering, Data, Information Security, IT, Finance, and Legal to align procurement strategies with product roadmaps, architecture decisions, investment priorities, and growth plans.
Lead complex sourcing initiatives and negotiations, including strategic software renewals, cloud and consumption commitments, enterprise licensing, AI and data arrangements, and global technology services.
Develop commercial structures that improve scalability, flexibility, accountability, and value, including licensing models, consumption commitments, unit-based pricing, ramp schedules, price protections, service levels, and performance measures.
Apply spend, demand, utilization, benchmark, and supplier-market analyses to identify consolidation, competitive sourcing, license optimization, demand-management, and supplier-rationalization opportunities across the portfolio.
Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Information Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Technology stakeholders to address contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and third-party risks without compromising speed or business continuity.
Represent Procurement as a strategic advisor to Technology & Product leadership while advancing enterprise-wide procurement standards, tools, and ways of working.
What You'll Bring
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, category management, procurement, vendor management, or a related commercial function, including significant responsibility for technology or product categories.
Demonstrated experience leading teams and developing Procurement professionals in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Deep knowledge of technology commercial models, including SaaS and enterprise licensing, cloud and consumption-based pricing, data, AI, infrastructure, hardware, telecom, cybersecurity, and professional services.
Proven success leading high-value, complex negotiations and building category strategies for business-critical technology suppliers.
Strong financial and analytical acumen, including experience with total cost of ownership, demand and utilization data, benchmarking, and unit economics.
Ability to translate technology roadmaps, architecture considerations, and business requirements into practical sourcing and supplier strategies.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and build credibility with Vice President, Senior Vice President, and C-suite stakeholders.
Experience leveraging analytics, AI, automation, and procurement technology to improve sourcing outcomes, controls, and stakeholder experience.
Experience in sports betting, iGaming, fantasy sports, technology, financial services, or another regulated industry is a plus.
Join Our Team
We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role.
If this job posting does not include compensation information, this is due to a technical error that our team is working to resolve! We will repost this position with compensation information as soon as it is resolved. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Join our team as a VP of Engineering and help virtualize biological experiments to accelerate discovery!
About Turbine
Turbine is building Virtual Assays - AI-powered predictive models that can run biological experiments in silico. We're combining deep learning with a systematic approach to biology to enable faster, cheaper, more extensive testing. Our team is small, focused, and composed of researchers and engineers who care deeply about getting biology right.
About This Role
We're looking for a VP of Engineering to own technical leadership across Turbine's engineering organization.
You'll build and lead the teams developing our Virtual Lab platform -the infrastructure and systems that power our Virtual Assay capabilities - while ensuring alignment, operational excellence, and scalability across the entire engineering function.
This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll drive technical strategy, maintain system reliability, establish infrastructure discipline, and partner closely with Product and AI to translate our scientific vision into robust, compliant, scalable systems.
You are a Turbiner if these personality traits apply to you:
You have self-awareness and strong intention on personal growth
You seek out feedback and learn from mistakes and apply what you learned
You take responsibility and focus on the outcomes over tasks
You focus on shared success and are open to challenging others respectfully to get the best possible outcome
You are in it for the long haul and have passion for our mission
Key Responsibilities
Build and lead engineering teams working on the Virtual Lab platform; ensure they are healthy, motivated, and staffed appropriately to deliver current products and anticipate future technical needs
Ensure Virtual Lab remains stable, performant, and operational at all times—owning reliability, incident response, and continuous improvement
Establish and maintain engineering standards, best practices, and technical alignment across the entire company to prevent silos and technical debt
Partner with Product to collect, analyze, and interpret system and user analytics; provide data-driven insights that inform product decisions and prioritization
Own scalability of architecture, ensuring our systems can grow with our data and user needs without accumulating technical debt
Lead compliance and security initiatives—understanding regulatory requirements and ensuring engineering practices and security posture remain current and robust
Build systems and processes to prevent infrastructure debris—manage unused resources, derelict deployments, and abandoned services to maintain cost efficiency and operational clarity
Mentor and develop engineering talent; create a culture of learning, ownership, and high standards
