jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About LeafLink
LeafLink is the largest unified B2B cannabis platform, providing licensed cannabis businesses a suite of tools to manage their business more effectively, sell or order from their favorite brands and accelerate growth. We are one platform, one solution and we’re defining the way thousands of cannabis brands, distributors, and retailers streamline their operations. With thousands of brands and retailers across 30+ markets in North America, we are setting the industry standard for how cannabis businesses grow together. LeafLink processes more than $5 billion in wholesale cannabis orders annually.
Our team, backed by funding from leading VC's, including Founders Fund, Thrive Capital, Nosara Capital, and Lerer Hippeau is poised to define the cannabis supply chain through technology. LeafLink was named one of Inc. 5000’s ‘Top 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies’; one of Fast Company's 'Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Enterprise for 2020', joining the ranks of Amazon, Slack, and VMWare; one of Built In NYC's 'Best Places to Work in 2021'; 2024 Fast Company’s Best WorkPlaces for Innovators for Banking, Finance, and Fintech category; 2024 Green Market Report Award for Best Fintech in cannabis - and we're just getting started!
The Role
LeafLink is seeking a Head of Engineering to lead our entire engineering organization. This role owns the technical vision, architecture, and health of every engineering function and is accountable for how well our teams turn strategy into shipped, reliable software. You'll report directly into executive leadership, partner closely with Product, and represent engineering at the leadership table.
As Head of Engineering, you are the senior-most technical leader responsible for building the org itself: hiring and developing engineering managers, setting standards for how we plan and execute, and making the calls on architecture, tooling, and headcount that determine whether we can keep moving fast without breaking things. You'll work with modern technologies and concepts such as containerized and serverless design patterns, Python, Kubernetes, AWS-managed and self-hosted services, third-party integrations, and event-driven and distributed architectures. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just a roadmap, but the operating model of an engineering org at a pivotal size, big enough to need real structure, small enough that one leader can still touch everything that matters.
Ideal candidates possess a strategic mind for solving unique challenges with fitting solutions, and a track record of building high-performing teams and the managers who run them. They should be personable, decisive, flexible, and communicative, with a strong desire to implement change, grow the org thoughtfully, and bring a genuine passion for their craft. This role comes with the opportunity to define engineering leadership at a fast-paced, dynamic, and quickly growing company.
What You'll Be Doing
Translate company, product, and technology objectives and goals into a 1 - 3-year engineering plan, operating model, organizational structure, and execution roadmap. Lead rebuild versus refactor decisions related to platform enhancement and integration across all of our platforms
Create the right engineering organizational structure and lead the engineering team. Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent and set the bar for how the engineering team operates day to day
Set engineering-wide standards for planning, estimation, and delivery, and hold teams accountable to them without turning process into bureaucracy
Establish engineering metrics, operating rhythms, and governance that provide executive visibility into execution. Own and manage the technical architecture, infrastructure, security and technical debt speed and long-term stability.
Improve engineering velocity while reducing technical debt and operational risk.
Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate customer requirements into engineering priorities, ensuring engineering capacity, sequencing, and constraints are represented in roadmap decisions and the team delivers features that have measurable customer impact and move adoption., ensuring
Manage the engineering budget: headcount planning, vendor and tooling spend, and cloud cost, with a clear view of TCO
Establish company-wide engineering practices for code quality, testing, CI/CD, and on-call/incident response as the team scales past the size where informal norms hold
Own SOC 2 and broader security/compliance posture across engineering, partnering with IT and any external auditors
Create long-term sustainable mechanisms such as feedback loops, retros, postmortems, and eng-wide metrics for continuous improvement across performance, scale, delivery and org health.
Build and protect engineering culture as headcount grows: the norms around ownership, blameless problem-solving, and technical excellence that are easy to lose past 80 people
Champion agentic AI, LLM-powered code generation, and multi-agent orchestration to reimagine how services are built and operated at scale, compressing delivery timelines and raising engineering velocity.

blocks.text: About LeafLink

LeafLink is the largest unified B2B cannabis platform, providing licensed cannabis businesses a suite of tools to manage their business more effectively, sell or order from their favorite brands and accelerate growth. We are one platform, one solution and we’re defining the way thousands of cannabis brands, distributors, and retailers streamline their operations. With thousands of brands and retailers across 30+ markets in North America, we are setting the industry standard for how cannabis businesses grow together. LeafLink processes more than $5 billion in wholesale cannabis orders annually.

Our team, backed by funding from leading VC's, including Founders Fund, Thrive Capital, Nosara Capital, and Lerer Hippeau is poised to define the cannabis supply chain through technology. LeafLink was named one of Inc. 5000’s ‘Top 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies’; one of Fast Company's 'Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Enterprise for 2020', joining the ranks of Amazon, Slack, and VMWare; one of Built In NYC's 'Best Places to Work in 2021'; 2024 Fast Company’s Best WorkPlaces for Innovators for Banking, Finance, and Fintech category; 2024 Green Market Report Award for Best Fintech in cannabis - and we're just getting started!
The Role

LeafLink is seeking a Head of Engineering to lead our entire engineering organization. This role owns the technical vision, architecture, and health of every engineering function and is accountable for how well our teams turn strategy into shipped, reliable software. You'll report directly into executive leadership, partner closely with Product, and represent engineering at the leadership table.

As Head of Engineering, you are the senior-most technical leader responsible for building the org itself: hiring and developing engineering managers, setting standards for how we plan and execute, and making the calls on architecture, tooling, and headcount that determine whether we can keep moving fast without breaking things. You'll work with modern technologies and concepts such as containerized and serverless design patterns, Python, Kubernetes, AWS-managed and self-hosted services, third-party integrations, and event-driven and distributed architectures. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just a roadmap, but the operating model of an engineering org at a pivotal size, big enough to need real structure, small enough that one leader can still touch everything that matters.

Ideal candidates possess a strategic mind for solving unique challenges with fitting solutions, and a track record of building high-performing teams and the managers who run them. They should be personable, decisive, flexible, and communicative, with a strong desire to implement change, grow the org thoughtfully, and bring a genuine passion for their craft. This role comes with the opportunity to define engineering leadership at a fast-paced, dynamic, and quickly growing company.

items: Translate company, product, and technology objectives and goals into a 1 - 3-year engineering plan, operating model, organizational structure, and execution roadmap. Lead rebuild versus refactor decisions related to platform enhancement and integration across all of our platforms

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.text:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.
Dragos is looking for an experienced Director of Engineering to lead a multi-team engineering organization building and sustaining our OT cybersecurity products, most notably the Dragos Platform. This role reports to the VP of Engineering, leads a minimum of four engineering managers, and is accountable for an overall organization of 35 to 50 people.
You will own a set of discipline-based engineering communities, such as frontend, backend, data, AI, etc. each led by a manager with a team of engineers in that discipline. Engineers from these communities staff cross-functional product teams that are led day to day by a tech lead and a product manager, with your managers serving in an advisory and coaching capacity. Success in this role means your managers and engineers raise the technical bar everywhere they are deployed, and that you drive department-wide improvements alongside your engineering and product director peers.
Responsibilities:
Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineering managers, each accountable for a discipline-based engineering community. Own their performance, growth, and effectiveness as people leaders.
Provide substantive technical guidance to your managers and their teams on software design and architecture, code quality practices, testing strategy, and review discipline. Stay close enough to the work to add real value in a design or code review.
Set the standard for AI-assisted engineering. Evaluate and roll out AI development tooling, define practices for its effective and responsible use, and coach your managers on where it accelerates delivery and where human judgment and review remain essential.
Own and drive key initiatives across the engineering department, working alongside your director peers on engineering standards, delivery practices, tooling, onboarding, and reduction of technical debt.
Partner closely with product directors to staff and support cross-functional product teams, balancing engineering capacity against roadmap commitments and resolving competing priorities at the lowest possible level.
Coach the tech leads and engineers in your organization so that product teams they support consistently deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable software.
Be accountable for the long-term health of the services and codebases your organization owns, including operational readiness and support for deployed product.
Build influential working relationships across engineering, product, and the wider business. Resolve the majority of disagreements yourself, and escalate the remainder promptly with clear context.
Own technical hiring for your organization: shape roles, run interview panels, and raise the bar on selection and onboarding.
Requirements:
8+ years leading software engineering teams, including 3+ years managing managers
Experience leading an engineering organization of 20 or more people across multiple teams
Strong technical background as a practicing software engineer and working fluency across technical architectures, including frontend, data, networking, backend, etc.
Demonstrated fluency with AI development tooling, including coding assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted review and test generation, plus a clear point of view on how to adopt it across a team
Cybersecurity experience at a product company shipping commercial software to external customers
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the range to move between executive updates, peer negotiation, and detailed technical review
Experience supporting agile, cross-functional teams that pair engineering with product management
Experience with performance evaluation, promotion recommendations, and performance improvement processes
Nice to have:
Experience with OT or ICS environments, threat detection, or asset visibility products
Experience integrating engineering teams following an acquisition
Compensation:
Salary: $260,000
Competitive Equity Package
Comprehensive Benefits Plan

All new hires must pass a background check as a condition of employment.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run 30,000 programs, welcomed 1.2 million applicants, and facilitated the distribution of more than $10 billion in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.
We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change.
About the Role
Submittable is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to own our engineering vision, architecture, and execution as we continue to scale. This is a pivotal leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, responsible for building and leading a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization spanning India and the US. The CTO will partner closely with Product, Sales, and the broader Executive Leadership Team to translate strategic vision into technical execution including platform stability, scalable architecture, and cross-border effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Strategy & Architecture
Define and own the multi-year technology roadmap and architecture strategy in alignment with business goals
Evaluate and evolve the technology stack to support scalability, security, and reliability
Champion product stability and platform resilience as a top engineering priority
Own build-vs-buy and vendor/technology partnership decisions
Maintenance of legacy platforms and potential for migration strategies, profit optimization
Engineering Leadership
Lead a distributed engineering organization across US and India
Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent; build a strong leadership bench
Establish engineering best practices: code quality, testing, CI/CD, incident response, and security posture
Drive cross-border collaboration and communication practices to close gaps between distributed teams
Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with Product on roadmap prioritization and technical feasibility
Work with Sales and Customer Success to address technical escalations and enterprise requirements
Represent engineering in ELT strategic planning, budgeting, and board-level initiatives
Operational Excellence
Own engineering KPIs (i.e. uptime/reliability, velocity, technical debt reduction, defect reporting, AI utilization/leverage, etc.)
Oversee security and compliance team inclusive of SOC II audits, pen testing, privacy compliance, etc.
Manage engineering budget, Saas platform margin, headcount planning, and vendor contracts
Ensure compliance with data security, privacy, and industry regulations relevant to SaaS
Qualifications
12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in senior technology leadership (CTO or equivalent) at a SaaS company
Proven experience leading distributed/global engineering teams, ideally including India-based teams
Track record of scaling engineering organizations through growth stages (startup to mid-market SaaS)
Demonstrated experience building or scaling AI/ML-powered product features and driving AI adoption within an engineering organization"
Strong technical foundation in modern web architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), APIs, and data security
Experience partnering with executive leadership on business strategy, not just technical execution
Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and the board
Experience with M&A technical due diligence, platform migrations, or major re-architecture projects is a plus
Success Metrics (First 12 Months)
Established technical roadmap aligned to ELT strategic priorities
Measurable improvement in platform stability and uptime
Strengthened US/India engineering collaboration model
Key senior engineering leadership hires and retention milestones met
We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States; however, we cannot accommodate scholastic or employment visas at this time. In addition, we are not able to consider applicants who reside in the following states: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maine, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, West Virginia, and Wyoming.
Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Submittable will NEVER request bank details, payment, or personal information during the hiring process, nor extend offers without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official email addresses. If you receive suspicious outreach, please report it to . (Please do not submit applications, resumes, cover letters, or other candidacy materials to this email address. Emails of this nature will not be reviewed or considered.)
Why Submittable?
Joining Submittable means becoming part of a forward-thinking, mission-driven company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. We empower organizations working for social good with technology that accelerates their work, amplifies their impact, and drives meaningful change.
At Submittable, you’ll find a supportive, dynamic work environment where your contributions directly influence our success. If you thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and are excited to be part of a company dedicated to social impact, we invite you to apply!
Benefits: We are proud to offer highly competitive benefits to our full-time employees, including:
Comprehensive health and life insurance with optional HSA, FSA, and DCA accounts
401(k) plan with employer match starting day one
Equity stock options to share in our success
Flexible hours, remote work options, and generous vacation and sick leave
Paid parental leave for mothers, fathers, and adoptive parents
Professional development stipends to support your career growth
Opportunities to participate in community outreach and volunteer programs
Monthly company-sponsored happy hours and gatherings to connect and unwind
Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging
At Submittable, we believe technology is a force for good, driving social impact and enabling corporate social responsibility on a global scale. To achieve this, we are committed to fostering a workplace that values inclusion and belonging as central pillars of our culture.
We embrace the strength of our diverse community by creating a safe space where employees feel empowered to share ideas, celebrate unique experiences, and learn from one another. By prioritizing inclusion, we aim to build an environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and make innovative contributions that enable our customers to tackle complex challenges and spread more good.
As a globally used platform, we are dedicated to hiring and supporting employees who represent a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. This includes diversity in ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, religion, ability, culture, and socioeconomic background.
About Our Process
Our goal is a fair, efficient, and thorough evaluation process that benefits you and our team and respects your time. As you can imagine, we have received a high volume of applications. Your willingness to participate in I.D. Verification and answer a few questions early allows us to move through the process more quickly.
Let's Talk About AI:
Guidelines for using AI in our Hiring Process: At Submittable, we believe that Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be a powerful tool for good. We are committed to leveraging AI technologies responsibly, ensuring their use is equitable, fair and safe. To ensure fairness and accurate skill assessment, we do not allow the use of AI tools (including note takers, transcription tools, or recordings) during take home tests or interviews. If you have questions or need accommodations, please let us know.
For additional information and guidance on using AI to prepare an interview at Submittable, please clickhere.
We believe our approach streamlines the hiring process and respects your time by ensuring that every conversation is substantive and focused on your unique qualifications. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to learning more about you.

jobs.title: Design Director
jobs.text:
About the role
We’re hiring a Design Director to lead Product Design across our Spending, Savings, and Investing experiences. You’ll shape how millions of members interact with their money every day—from the experiences they rely on most often to the ones that help them build toward what’s next.
This role calls for a leader who pairs exceptional visual craft with strong product thinking. You’ll set a high bar for how our products look, feel, and work; build a clear design vision across a connected portfolio; and lead a talented team of designers in turning complex financial experiences into products that feel simple, intuitive, and distinctly Chime. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, and Brand to make that vision real.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $242,000 and up to $335,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Set the design vision and quality bar across our Spending, Savings, and Investing experiences, creating products that feel cohesive, intuitive, and unmistakably Chime.
Lead, coach, and develop a team of product designers, helping them strengthen their craft, expand their impact, and do the best work of their careers.
Bring a strong point of view on visual and interaction design, using your craft expertise to push the work from good to exceptional while empowering designers to own the solutions.
Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and translate ambitious ideas into compelling member experiences.
Think across individual features and journeys to create a connected product experience, balancing immediate member needs with a longer-term design vision.
Use research, customer insights, data, and experimentation to understand what matters to our members and guide design decisions.
Champion design excellence across Chime, contributing to the evolution of our product language, design systems, critique culture, and broader design practice.
To thrive in this role, you have
Experience leading and developing high-performing product design teams responsible for complex, consumer-facing digital products.
A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates exceptional visual and interaction design craft, alongside the ability to translate that standard into the work of a broader team.
A track record of creating and delivering compelling design visions across multiple products, journeys, or interconnected experiences.
Deep product design expertise and the judgment to move comfortably between high-level strategy and the details that make an experience exceptional.
Experience partnering with senior Product and Engineering leaders to influence product strategy and deliver meaningful customer and business outcomes.
Experience building strong design teams through coaching, feedback, critique, and talent development.
The ability to communicate a clear design point of view, bring people along with your thinking, and create clarity in complex or ambiguous spaces.
#LI-TP1 #LI-Onsite
A little about us
At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.
We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.
We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.
We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.
Because if we don't—who will?
*Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.
What we offer for our full-time, regular employees
🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress
We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.
Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: accommodations@chime.com.
To learn more about how Chime collects and uses your personal information during the application process, please see the Chime Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.
At Klaviyo, we empower creators to own their destiny. Our SaaS platform provides businesses of all sizes with powerful, easy-to-use marketing automation tools, making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We are a team of ambitious, bold peers who are insatiably curious and meticulous in our craft. As we scale globally, we are seeking a foundational leader to build and lead our Site Reliability functions from our new strategic hub in Dublin.
About the Team
The SRE team is the bedrock of trust for the 200,000+ businesses that rely on Klaviyo to power their growth. This team is responsible for the secure reliability, scalability, and performance of our entire platform: from our core data processing pipelines to our cutting-edge AI services. As a foundational leader in our new Dublin office, you will build this team from the ground up, establishing a center of excellence for platform integrity and playing a pivotal role in Klaviyo’s European expansion. You will be the ultimate custodian of the trust our customers place in us every day.
How You'll Make a Difference
Architect and Lead: Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a unified SRE organization. You will build and mentor a world-class, multi-disciplinary team of engineers in Dublin, fostering a culture of operational excellence, proactive problem-solving, and blameless learning.
Champion Reliability: Drive a "reliable by design" philosophy across all of engineering. Partner with product and platform teams to embed reliability principles into the entire software development lifecycle, from initial design to production deployment.
Own Platform Integrity: Take ownership of the availability, latency, performance efficiency, change management, monitoring, emergency response, and capacity planning for Klaviyo’s global platform.
Drive Automation: Build the "paved road" for Klaviyo engineers by developing automated, self-service tooling and infrastructure that enables teams to "move fast, no shortcuts".
Lead Through Incidents: Command reliability incidents, guiding teams to rapid resolution while fostering a culture of blameless post-mortems that drive meaningful, systemic improvements.
Who You Are
You are a proven engineering leader with a track record of building and scaling high-performing, geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced SaaS environment.
You are intellectually curious and a continuous learner, with a deep understanding of modern reliability principles.
You are a "Driver" who is biased toward action. You don’t wait for problems to find you; you proactively identify risks and rally teams to solve them.
You are a cross-functional influencer and an exceptional communicator, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, from engineers to executives to enterprise customers.
You are a player-coach who can dive deep into technical details with your team while also developing and articulating a long-term strategic vision.
You are passionate about building a strong, inclusive team culture and have experience integrating new teams with existing ones across different time zones and cultures.
You thrive in an environment of high ambiguity and rapid change, embodying a "1% done" mindset and seeing opportunity in every challenge.
What You'll Need
12+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role managing SRE teams.
Proven experience building and scaling engineering teams, ideally with experience establishing a new team or office.
Deep, hands-on experience with cloud-native production systems at scale (AWS preferred).
Strong technical background in distributed systems, observability, container orchestration (Kubernetes), infrastructure as code (Terraform), and CI/CD principles.
Experience managing geographically distributed teams and fostering a strong, unified culture across multiple time zones.
You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.
Our salary range reflects the cost of labour in the country where the job post is advertised. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.
In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.
Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
Base Pay Range in Local Currency:
€160.000—€240.000 EUR
This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.
Get to Know Klaviyo
We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.
AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human-in-the-loop). We provide accommodations as needed.
By participating in Klaviyo’s interview process, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and will adhere to our Guidelines for using AI in the Klaviyo interview Process. For more information about how we process your personal data, see our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.
Klaviyo is committed to a policy of equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, citizenship, national origin, color, religion or religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, veteran or active military status, marital status, criminal record, genetics, retaliation, sexual harassment or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
IMPORTANT NOTICE: Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses (@klaviyo.com), instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.
By clicking "Submit Application" you consent to Klaviyo processing your Personal Data in accordance with our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. If you do not wish for Klaviyo to process your Personal Data, please do not submit an application. You can find our Job Applicant Privacy Notice here and here (FR).

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role
We are an early-stage wearable sensing startup building a body-worn sensing platform at the frontier of hardware engineering. This is a pivotal moment for the company, and we're looking for a technically deep, hands-on Head of Engineering to own technical execution from architecture through shipping — while leading a distributed team across India and San Francisco.
You'll be based full-time in India and travel to San Francisco approximately one week per month. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of systems thinking, embedded hardware, and team leadership — and who has a proven track record of shipping real products into real users' hands.
Note: This role is open to US citizens and US visa holders only. Visa sponsorship is not available.
What You'll Do
Own end-to-end technical execution of a body-worn sensing platform — from system architecture through production shipment.
Lead and coordinate a distributed team of hardware, firmware, and mechanical specialists across India and San Francisco.
Make weekly design and integration decisions across power systems, sensor synchronization, firmware/embedded Linux, and mechanical structure.
Define and maintain the complete hardware system architecture, ensuring all subsystems integrate coherently into a wearable product.
Translate product requirements into clear, precise engineering briefs for the distributed team to execute against.
Review and critique mechanical designs with engineering justification, focusing on wearability, durability, and real-world deployment constraints.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
AmeriSave Mortgage Corp. has set the standard in online mortgage lending, with over $130 billion in funded loan volume. As one of the top rated, largest privately owned online mortgage lenders in the nation, our mission is to deliver beneficial, responsible home lending solutions with unwavering integrity, dedication and excellence. We leverage cutting edge technology and data driven strategies to provide exceptional service to our customers.
Our employees are the driving force behind our success. We believe in the power of a dynamic and talented workforce and creating an environment where your contributions are not just recognized, they're celebrated. Your success is our success, and we are seeking skilled professionals who are ready to bring their A-game, exceed benchmarks, and enhance the overall excellence of AmeriSave, while also growing and advancing their careers.
At AmeriSave, we're one team with one shared dream: to be the best. Let's redefine excellence together!
What We’re Looking For:
AmeriSave is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to lead our Enterprise Technology & AI organization, software engineering, infrastructure, and security function responsible for our proprietary technology stack, including our Digital Mortgage platform and the systems that run our loan origination business end to end.
This is an executive role for a hands-on technology leader who has run large engineering organizations at scale, ideally within the mortgage industry or at a well-known lender, and who is equally credible discussing Azure architecture with a principal engineer, disaster recovery posture with an auditor, and technology strategy with the Board. You will own the reliability, security, scalability, and roadmap of the systems that power the company, while building and developing the engineering talent that maintains them.Seeking candidates with expertise and hands-on experience with Aloha software.
What You'll Do:
Engineering Organization Leadership:Lead a software engineering organization that designs, builds, and maintains AmeriSave's proprietary technology platforms, setting engineering standards, architecture direction, and delivery cadence across multiple product and platform teams.
Cloud & Database Infrastructure:Own the Azure cloud infrastructure and SQL Server database environments that run the company's proprietary systems, including architecture, cost management, performance tuning, and long-term platform strategy.
Reliability & Uptime:Hold accountability for system uptime and reliability in the high 99.99% range across production systems; drive the monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and engineering discipline required to sustain that bar at scale.
Information Security:Own the organization's information security posture and security infrastructure, partnering with Compliance and Risk to ensure systems, data, and customer information are protected against evolving threats, and that the company meets regulatory and investor security requirements.
AI Strategy:Set direction for the company's AI strategy and investment, overseeing in-house AI initiatives (including proprietary AI-powered platform capabilities, automation, and applied AI/ML use cases) and evaluating where AI can responsibly improve efficiency, customer experience, and decisioning.
Networking Infrastructure:Own enterprise networking architecture, including data center, cloud, and remote/hybrid workforce connectivity, ensuring performance, security, and scalability of the network as the business grows.
Disaster Recovery:Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning for all critical systems, including recovery time/point objectives, failover testing, and readiness, ensuring the business can withstand and recover from major disruptions.
Capacity Planning:Lead capacity planning across infrastructure and applications, forecasting growth and ensuring systems scale ahead of business demand without over-provisioning cost.
Development Resource Management:Build, develop, and retain engineering talent and leadership; manage development resourcing and prioritization across competing business and technology initiatives; establish career paths and a strong engineering culture.
Executive Partnership & Communication:Partner with the CEO, CIO/CISO, and executive leadership team to translate business strategy into a technology roadmap; represent Technology in Board and investor conversations, and communicate complex technical topics in terms executives and non-technical stakeholders can act on.
Budget Ownership:Manage the technology budget, including infrastructure spend, tooling, and headcount, balancing innovation investment against operating efficiency.
What You’ll Need:
Deep Industry Experience:15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including 5+ years in a senior executive technology role (CTO, VP Engineering, or similar), preferably within the mortgage industry, and preferably with a well-known mortgage lender or financial services company.
Scale of Engineering Leadership:Demonstrated experience leading a software engineering organization that builds and maintains proprietary systems, not a primarily vendor/SaaS-managed environment.
Cloud & Database Expertise:Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure cloud infrastructure and SQL Server environments at production scale, including architecture, performance, security, and cost management.
Reliability Track Record:Proven track record of sustaining system uptime in the high 99.99% range for business-critical, customer-facing systems.
Security Expertise:Strong background in information security management and security infrastructure, including familiarity with financial services regulatory and audit expectations.
AI Experience:Experience directing applied AI/ML initiatives within a production engineering organization, translating AI capability into real business and customer outcomes.
Networking Expertise:Solid grounding in enterprise networking infrastructure, including cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, and network security.
Disaster Recovery Expertise:Experience owning disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including failover testing and recovery objectives, for mission-critical systems.
Capacity Planning Expertise:Demonstrated skill in infrastructure and application capacity planning, forecasting scale needs ahead of business growth.
Talent & Resource Management:Strong people leadership skills, with experience building, developing, and retaining engineering talent and managing development resourcing across a large, multi-team organization.
Executive Communication:Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; comfortable presenting technology strategy, risk, and performance directly to the CEO, Board, and investors.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred.
High-speed internet required for remote work, Cable or Fiber ONLY with the ability to connect via Ethernet. Minimum speeds: 70/30 Mbps (basic), 200-300/35-70 Mbps (shared), 500-1,000/100+ Mbps (heavy use).
**Please note that the compensation and benefit information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position only and is provided pursuant to applicable state and local laws on pay transparency. It is estimated based on what a successful applicant in the relevant state might be paid. **
Compensation:
The annual compensation for this position generally ranges from between $275,000-$350,000 based on experience and qualifications, plus executive bonus and long-term incentive eligibility.
Benefits:
401(k)
Dental insurance
Disability insurance
Employee discounts
Health insurance
Life insurance
Paid time off
12 paid holidays per year
Paid training
Referral program
Vision insurance
Supplemental pay types:
Referral bonuses
Executive bonus and long-term incentive program

jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.text:
Linah Group is seeking a Head of Technology to define and drive the company's technology strategy, lead digital transformation across all business sectors under the Group while enabling each business unit to innovate within its own market and manage a cross-functional IT organization spanning helpdesk support, software development, and enterprise systems (ERP).
This role will oversee Linah Group portfolio spanning Head office, agriculture sector, manufacturing sector, retail, and hospitality (the 5-star Sultan Gardens Resort in Sharm El Sheikh) and other subsidiaries.
Group-Wide Technology Leadership
Define and drive the overarching technology strategy and roadmap for Linah Group, ensuring alignment with business objectives across all sectors
Provide technology leadership and governance across Manufacturing, Head Office, Agriculture, and Hospitality, ensuring consistency in standards, security, and infrastructure while respecting each sector's specific needs
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing technology organization, including sector-level technology leads for each business unit
Oversee IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, data governance, and enterprise systems across all four sectors
Manage the Group-wide technology budget, ensuring optimal allocation of resources and timely reinvestment in upgrades across sectors
Establish technology policies, standards, and best practices to ensure consistency, security, and scalability across the Group
Act as a key advisor to the executive leadership team and Board on technology strategy, risk, and investment decisions
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all technology functions within the Group
Manufacturing
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of production systems, ERP, and plant automation
Identify and implement technologies that improve manufacturing efficiency, quality, and safety
Head Office
Oversee core corporate IT systems, networks, and enterprise software supporting all business functions
Ensure Head Office systems remain current, secure, and integrated with sector-level platforms
Agriculture
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of farming operations, including smart farming and agri-tech solutions
Evaluate and implement emerging agri-technology (IoT sensors, precision farming, automation) to improve yield and efficiency
Hospitality (5-Star Hotel)
Ensure continuous technological upkeep and upgrade of guest-facing and back-of-house systems, including property management systems and service platforms
Drive technology initiatives that enhance guest experience and operational efficiency in line with 5-star service standards

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Viseven Group is a leading global B2B MarTech service provider, empowering Pharma and LifeScience companies since 2009. Our mission is to drive digital transformation and excellence, offering comprehensive end-to-end software and digital marketing services tailored to the pharmaceutical industry. The company's solutions, products, and services are actively used by the top 100 Pharma and Life Science companies.
At Viseven, our rapidly growing team boasts over 700 highly skilled professionals, including experts in development, design, business analysis, project management, delivery, sales, marketing, and customer success.
With a global footprint in more than 30 countries across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC, and physical offices in Ukraine, Poland, Estonia, India, and the US, we are well-positioned to serve our diverse clientele.
Join us and become part of a pioneering team dedicated to shaping the future of digital transformation in Pharma and Life Sciences across more than 50 countries around the globe.
Role description: Viseven is looking for a Head of Product to own and drive the success of the entire products and services portfolio, create synergies across solutions, and increase overall portfolio value and profitability.
Responsibilities:
Define and lead product portfolio vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with company goals and a coherent value proposition.
Decide portfolio composition (invest/grow/maintain/change/sunset) to maximize market opportunity and business impact, ensuring products synergy and competitive advantage.
Continuously analyze market trends, competition, customer needs, stakeholder insights and synthesize it into product decisions and choices.
Identify and validate new product and business opportunities, including building business cases and managing new products before they are transferred to separate business lines.
Oversee product lifecycle (development, launch, evolution), balancing innovation and improvement.
Monitor and manage product performance (revenue, profitability, adoption, retention) and optimize accordingly.
Set cross-product priorities and allocate resources based on impact, ROI, and strategic fit, including the balance between building core and customer desired functionality.
Build and lead the product management function, including capabilities, standards, and best practices organization-wide, owning and building company-wide expertise related to products knowledge and product application.
Align and active cooperate with cross-functional stakeholders to drive go-to-market, customer acquisition and retention, adoption, and overall portfolio growth.
Hard skills required:
5+ years in product management with leadership of multi-product SaaS portfolios; MarTech/Pharma or regulated domain experience preferred.
Proven ownership of portfolio strategy and P&L, including product launches and scaling in international markets.
Strong strategic and analytical skills: portfolio decisions (invest/grow/sunset), business cases, pricing, ROI, SaaS metrics.
Deep product management expertise (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization, experimentation) across full product lifecycle.
Experience balancing innovation vs. optimization and core vs. customer-driven development.
Ability to build and scale product organizations, define standards, and develop product managers.
Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder alignment in a multinational environment.
Clear communication and data-driven, customer-centric, outcome-oriented mindset.
Soft skills required:
Both in-depth and agile mindset.
Strong leadership, planning, effective management of self and the team.
Advanced communication and presentation skills.
Great team player – optimistic, organized, flexible, helpful.
Wholistic, creative and critical thinking – ability to develop and create new ideas, systems, and relationships for the success of the company, analyze root causes and provide solutions.
What we provide:
We know our team members are key to achieving our goals, so we value and empower them to share their vision. We reward this passion with exceptional benefits, including:
Competitive Compensation: Regular performance-based salary and career development reviews.
Experienced Team: Join a passionate, experienced team in a friendly atmosphere.
Career Growth: Opportunities for professional and career advancement.
Paid Time Off: 18 business days per year (20 business days after 2 years of service).
Sick Leave:
Non-documented: 4 business days per year.
Documented: 20 business days per year.
Family Leave: 3 paid business days for marriage, childbirth, or bereavement.
Medical Insurance: Comprehensive coverage.
English Courses: Learning opportunities to improve your language skills.
Professional Development: Participation in forums and conferences.
Corporate Events: Regular team-building activities and events.
Work Environment: Enjoy a comfortable, fully equipped office and the possibility to work from home.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering, Applications
jobs.text:
About A1
There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.
Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.
Role
Turn intelligence into a real product. You are responsible for the engineering systems, teams, and execution that turn ML capability into reliable, fast, and intuitive user experiences across backend, mobile, and desktop platforms.
This role is a senior engineering leader who stays close to the product, makes hard technical decisions, and holds a high bar for quality and delivery.
What You'll be Doing
Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.
Lead and grow a small, senior applications team, including backend, mobile, and desktop engineers.
Set the architectural direction for AI-powered product workflows, APIs, and client integrations.
Ensure AI capabilities are integrated into the product with clear abstractions, predictable behavior, and graceful failure modes.
Partner closely with Machine Learning leadership to translate model capability into shippable product features.
Make high-impact decisions across latency, cost, reliability, security, and user experience.
Establish clear ownership boundaries across backend, mobile, and desktop to prevent architectural drift.
Ensure production readiness: observability, monitoring, retries, fallbacks, privacy, and cost controls.
Balance speed and discipline – shipping quickly without compromising long-term system quality.
What You Will Need
Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.
Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.
Experience delivering AI-powered products, with a deep understanding of model integration trade-offs.
Excellent system design skills across services, APIs, clients, and data flows.
Comfort operating across platforms (backend, mobile, desktop), even if your depth is in one.
Proven ability to make high-impact technical decisions under ambiguity.
A strong bias toward shipping, iteration, and learning from real-world usage.
Low ego, strong judgment, and the ability to raise the technical bar for the entire applications organization.
Outcomes
Reliable, low-latency AI user experiences across backend, mobile, and desktop
Clear architectural boundaries that allow teams to move fast without constant rewrites.
Measurable improvements in system performance, stability, and production reliability.
Strong observability and operational discipline across all application systems.
A small, senior team that ships frequently, owns what they build, and raises the technical bar.
Team members are empowered, growing in their roles, and able to make high-impact contributions.
How We Work
The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product
Interview process
If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.
Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.
We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
About Eridan
At Eridan we believe in the power of collaboration and communication to achieve our mission: connect the planet to empower a sustainable, shared future. That mission is possible with our patented transmitter which decreases the cost and power required to roll out 5G by 10x when deployed globally. This is all facilitated through our offices: our Sunnyvale headquarters has big windows (even in the lab!), is walking distance to downtown and the Caltrain, and fits the entire team in the cafeteria for our frequent company parties. Learn more about our mission here.
Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering
About this Job
The Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering is a senior technical leadership role that owns the systems engineering function across Eridan’s radio product lines. The role sits at the intersection of systems architecture, hardware integration, and cross-functional execution, and is responsible for ensuring that engineering outputs hold together as coherent, specification-compliant systems — not just collections of subsystems.
This role serves as the internal owner of system-level specifications and integration integrity. Requirements arrive from Solutions Engineering and Deployments; this role translates them into rigorous engineering deliverables and drives alignment across hardware, firmware, and software. The Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering is the person who is accountable when a system does — or does not — perform as intended.
The role will initially focus on Eridan’s compact and high power radio unit product lines, with scope expected to expand as additional platforms come online. Leading an RF hardware systems engineering team is a core part of the mandate from the outset.
As a Director of RF Hardware Systems Engineering, You Will
Systems Engineering Ownership
Own end-to-end systems hardware engineering across active radio product lines: requirements definition, architecture, integration, and verification
Maintain and enforce system-level specifications, ensuring fidelity from requirements intake through product qualification
Drive resolution of cross-subsystem technical issues and represent systems integrity in design reviews and milestone gate decisions
Establish systems engineering processes and documentation standards appropriate for a scaling hardware startup
Oversee board-level integration and PCB development, ensuring robust RF/high-speed layout practices and design-for-manufacturability standards
Requirements Intake and Specification Ownership
Serve as the primary engineering interface for requirements arriving from Solutions Engineering and Deployments — translating operational needs into precise, actionable system specifications
Ensure that engineering priorities and trade-off decisions are grounded in validated requirements
Partner with the VP of Engineering as well as Product and Operations leadership to align specification work with program milestones and planning commitments
Team Building and Leadership
Manage and develop a team of hardware engineers aligned to active product lines
Structure the team for growth as additional product lines come online, in partnership with the VP of Engineering
Mentor developing engineers and help build the systems engineering discipline across the organization
Cross-Functional Execution
Work closely with hardware, software, and test engineering teams to align integration milestones and system-level validation plans
Coordinate with Test and Operations on qualification activities and readiness criteria
Contribute to engineering program planning and resource discussions with cross-functional leadership
Qualities of a Successful Candidate
8+ years of experience in RF hardware systems engineering or a closely related technical discipline, with at least 3 years in a people management role
B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field
Deep expertise in RF, wireless, or telecommunications hardware systems — experience at the radio unit, subsystem, or component level in any generation (4G, 5G, satellite, defense RF, or similar)
Demonstrated ability to own system-level specifications and drive integration in complex hardware/software co-development environments
Proven track record of translating operational or customer requirements into rigorous engineering deliverables
Strong communication and influencing skills across technical and cross-functional audiences
Experience transitioning technology from R&D to high volume production
Nice to Have
Experience with 5G radio hardware (O-RAN, small cell, macro radio)
Familiarity with all levels of radio unit design, including power distribution, digital motherboards, RF circuitry, mechanical design, and manufacturing considerations
Experience scaling a systems engineering function at a startup or growth-stage hardware company
Perks of working at Eridan
Work on new technology that will make a significant impact on global infrastructure
Ability to learn, develop, and advance within a flexible environment
Collaborate with smart, passionate, and helpful co-workers
Celebrate progress company-wide
Pre-IPO equity
401K with automatic match
Health, Vision and Dental insurance
Salary Range
Given our anticipated growth, we are open to hiring individuals with varying levels of experience to fill this role. Salary will be commensurate with job-related skills, experience and other relevant factors. The base salary range for the primary location of this role is between $180,000 and $210,000 plus stock options and benefits.
Eridan is an equal opportunity employer. We value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.text:
The CVO Tribe
CVO owns two of HelloFresh's largest economic levers: benefit optimization and pricing. The tribe uses machine learning, personalization, and lifetime-value prediction to replace manual, rules-based decisioning with data-driven systems.
The engineering org is globally distributed across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, and includes Frontend, Backend, Data, and ML Engineering, working closely with embedded Data Scientists. The work spans a genuinely mixed engineering profile: ML-heavy systems for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, alongside backend and distributed-systems work powering pricing infrastructure and subscription products at scale.
As Senior Director, based in Berlin, you'll lead this full spectrum, setting technical strategy across ML, backend, and data disciplines and across time zones, without relying on daily co-location.
What you'll do
Lead an organization of 25-30 engineers, data scientists, and ML practitioners across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, through a layer of Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers reporting into you.
Own ML strategy for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, as well as backend and distributed-systems strategy for pricing and subscription infrastructure.
Drive the transformation of ways of working toward fully GenAI-native, cross-functional product teams, building on teams that already ship the majority of their code with AI assistance.
Own reliability and operational excellence across both ML and backend systems: observability from model output through to customer-facing delivery, SLOs/SLIs, incident management, and MLOps practices such as retraining, rollback, and experiment tracking.
Partner with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, and adjacent engineering teams to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage and develop Engineering Managers and Data Science Leads across disciplines and geographies, holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
What you'll bring
Range across ML and backend engineering. You don't need to be hands-on expert in both, but you need credibility in each: enough ML depth to set direction on production ML systems and partner effectively with Data Science, enough distributed-systems depth to be a trusted partner on pricing infrastructure and subscription products.
Proven leadership of globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, without daily co-location. Comfortable with regular travel and bridging US and European hours.
Deep ML engineering expertise, including feature engineering, training/serving infrastructure, experimentation, and MLOps. Causal inference or uplift modeling experience is a plus.
Distributed systems and backend depth, including scaling backend services and data pipelines in revenue-sensitive, high-throughput environments. Subscription or billing experience is a plus.
AI-native leadership, with a track record of building or scaling AI-native engineering practices, not just adopting AI tools.
Commercial and pricing domain fluency, or strong aptitude to build it quickly, including benefit optimization, lifetime-value forecasting, and pricing elasticity.
Proven leadership at scale: 12+ years in software/ML engineering, with 5+ years managing Engineering Managers across more than one technical discipline and geography.
Operational excellence mindset, with strong grounding in SRE and MLOps practices for systems with direct financial impact.
Strong cross-functional communication, translating ML, data, and backend concepts into business terms and vice versa.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.
What we offer
Global collaboration across HelloTech's hubs in Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto.
High-leverage, technically diverse work spanning ML, backend, data, and product engineering, with a direct line to business outcomes.
A genuinely AI-native environment with a mandate to scale that approach further.
Technical and engineering leadership in an autonomous, product-led setup, with end-to-end ownership from problem definition to production.
Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.
Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).
Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.
Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.
Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).
Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.
Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).
Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.
Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences, so even if you don't tick every box but think you'd thrive in this role, we'd really like to hear from you.

Director of UX, Growth
Location: Toronto or New York
Team: UX, Growth Mega-Alliance
Level: Director (people leadership). For the right person there's a clear path to Senior Director as the alliance scales.
Reports to: Global VP of UX
About HelloFresh
Our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. We're the world's leading meal-kit provider and a global digital-native FMCG company, reaching more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of brands, from HelloFresh and Factor to Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, YouFoodz, Good Chop, and The Pets Table. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.
About the role
We're looking for a Director of UX to lead the Growth experience end to end, across the brands in our portfolio, with HelloFresh and Factor the biggest. This is the team that owns how people discover our brands, sign up, get to their first great box, and keep coming back. Most funnels are something people endure. We want ours to be something they remember. Your job is to turn each step into a moment worth having, so the journey feels effortless, true to each brand, and sticky enough that people want to stay, and to grow the business while you do it.
You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and lead a team of 6 UX designers and collaborate closely with content design and research strategy. You set the quality bar for the alliance and work shoulder to shoulder with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering across web and app, and across 16 markets. You care about the numbers and the experience, and you know the best growth work improves both at once.
This is a hands-on leadership role, and a build-and-scale one rather than a maintenance one. You are exceptional at craft and stay close enough to the work to lead with credibility. You're also a visionary: you bring our brands to life and express them clearly across every touchpoint, and you have a strong feel for content and how words shape an experience. You're happy in ambiguity, and you'd rather write the playbook than follow one.
What you'll own
A funnel worth remembering. You lead the experience across the full customer journey: acquisition and activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation of lapsed customers. You do more than reduce drop-off and smooth out onboarding. You make each step sticky and memorable, so people feel something at sign-up, come back because they want to, and tell a friend. You give lapsed customers a real reason to return.
Experimentation and evidence. You run a team that tests its way to the answer. You treat behavioral data as a primary design input, not just something to validate a decision after the fact. You set clear hypotheses, design experiments and A/B tests with statistical rigor alongside data science, read the results honestly, and balance quick wins with the changes that compound over time.
Strategy before screens. You decide which problems are worth solving and why, and you tie design choices to the business outcomes this role is measured on, like conversion, activation rate, and retention [confirm the exact KPIs for this role]. You set direction before design work begins.
Craft and quality. You define what excellent looks like for Growth and hold the bar. You set a high standard for craft yourself and raise it in others, and you build and evolve the systems and patterns that let the team ship consistent, high-quality work at speed across web and app.
Brand expression. You bring our portfolio of brands to life, from HelloFresh and Factor to the rest, and give each a clear, distinct voice and look in the experience. You know how to hold what makes a brand itself while keeping the funnel coherent across all of them. You have a strong understanding of content and how design and words work together to express who each brand is.
Make us AI-native. You lead a team that treats AI as an active part of how the work gets done, from insight synthesis to rapid prototyping to the path from design to code. You define the quality bar AI-assisted work has to meet, and you help rewrite how growth experiences get built in the AI era. You are a driving force in this transformation, not a passenger, and you help your team see the shift as opportunity rather than threat.
A team of generalists. You lead a team of UX Designers with a generalist profile that move across design, content, research and code. You attract, develop, and retain strong talent, coach through feedback and influence rather than authority, and build a place where people do the best work of their careers.
What you bring
10+ years in product design, including experience leading and growing teams in a consumer (B2C) or product-led environment with a track record of moving metrics like activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
Exceptional craft. You are a top-tier designer who sets and holds a high bar, and you stay hands-on enough to lead with credibility and a visionary eye for the brand. You can bring distinct brands to life and express them clearly and consistently across an experience.
High agency. You push for the right solution over the convenient one and make things happen without waiting for permission.
AI-native practice. You already use AI across the design workflow, for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design to code, and you have a clear point of view on scaling it responsibly at a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma and Claude is expected, and you can show your team what excellent AI-assisted work looks like.
Strong data fluency. You read behavioral data and experiment results well, know what they are and aren't telling you, and use them to sharpen design, not just defend it. You're comfortable partnering with data science on experimentation quality.
Command of experimentation: hypothesis design, A/B testing, and funnel analysis as a connected system rather than isolated moments.
A partnership mindset with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering. You navigate constraints with engineers and shape research and synthesis with researchers.
People leadership experience: building teams, coaching designers, and setting a quality bar others rally around.
Nice to have
Experience shaping cross-channel communication strategy across app, email, push, and web, so the message a customer gets is consistent and well-timed wherever they meet us.
Experience with pricing, packaging, or monetization design.
A track record building 0-to-1 growth systems, or fixing broken acquisition and retention loops.
What success looks like
Your team consistently ships high-quality growth work at speed, and the metrics move.
You've hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and judgment.
Experience quality across the funnel is visibly higher, and customers feel it.
Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.
AI-native ways of working in your domain make the whole team faster without giving up craft.
Each brand feels distinctly itself in the experience, while the funnel stays coherent across all of them.
What we offer
Scale and impact. Shape experiences for millions of customers across our brands and 16 markets.
A craft-and-AI-first culture, championed from the top of the organization.
Real ownership of your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.
A defined leadership track and the chance to grow your scope as the alliance scales.
Global collaboration with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing
Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.
Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.
Access wellness resources including fitness discounts and mental health support.
Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings.
Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.
Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.
How we work
We're moving UX to work AI-native, and we expect our leaders to help drive that shift. You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders in the region.
Equal opportunity
We believe that sharing a meal brings people of all identities, backgrounds, and cultures together, and we're committed to celebrating every dimension of diversity in the workplace. We're an equal-opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. We provide reasonable accommodations to candidates at any stage of the process. If you need one, please let us know.
Please note that for this position employees are eligible to equity on top of the base pay.
Toronto, ON Pay Range
$143,850—$153,850 CAD
