jobs.title: SVP, Engineering
jobs.text:
What We Are Looking For
We are seeking a visionary, inspirational Senior Vice President of Engineering to lead and scale our global engineering function. They will be responsible for defining our multi-year technical strategy, leading the organization at an executive level, and ensuring the quality, performance, and resilience of our Java open-source based in-memory Real-Time Data Platform.
This role requires an executive leader who is a strategic business partner to the C-suite, a champion of engineering excellence, and a driver of enterprise-wide innovation who can balance long-term technical vision with predictable, world-class execution.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
I. Executive Technical Strategy & Product Delivery
Executive Technical Vision: Define and champion a multi-year technology strategy and architectural vision that anticipates market trends and directly aligns with the company’s long-term business objectives and revenue growth.
Product Strategy & Roadmap Co-Ownership: Collaborate at the executive level with Product Management to define, prioritize, and drive the technical direction of the product roadmap, ensuring engineering input enhances technical execution, architectural quality, commercial value, differentiated packaging, and timely delivery.
Strategic Execution & Delivery: Drive, own, and manage end-to-end engineering delivery against the product roadmap, utilizing agile methodologies to ensure rapid, predictable, and high-quality releases at an enterprise scale.
Quality & Resilience: Maintain and continuously elevate world-class standards for system quality, performance, security, and resilience across the entire platform, ensuring enterprise-grade reliability for our largest customers.
Innovation & Future-Proofing: Provide executive oversight for core technical domains (distributed systems, high-performance Java, concurrency, streaming, data structures) while aggressively evaluating and integrating emerging technologies to maintain a competitive market edge.
Resource & Investment Optimisation: Manage the engineering budget, drive ROI on technology investments, and optimize resource allocation to ensure maximum business impact and operational efficiency.
II. Open Source Software Leadership
Open Source Stewardship: Steward Hazelcast’s open-source core with a strong commitment to transparency, stability, and long-term compatibility, ensuring community trust while advancing enterprise capabilities.
Open Source/Commercial Balance: Balance the needs of commercial customers with the expectations of a global, user-led open-source community, making principled, strategic decisions about feature placement, deprecations, and roadmap visibility.
Industry Thought Leadership: Serve as a prominent voice and advocate for the company within the broader open-source and real-time data ecosystems, influencing industry standards and building strategic technological partnerships.
Community Feedback: Convert high-volume user feedback from diverse production environments into clear engineering priorities, ensuring the OSS platform remains robust, predictable, and widely adoptable.
Ecosystem: Maintain disciplined reliability across Hazelcast’s multi-language client ecosystem and seamless upgrades for all users.
Superior Developer and Operator Experience: Champion exceptional developer and operator experience, driving documentation quality, release clarity, and community engagement to strengthen Hazelcast’s ecosystem.
III. Organisational Development & Leadership
Global Executive Leadership: Lead, motivate, and manage a highly distributed, global engineering team, fostering a people-centric managerial approach and an aggressive, collaborative engineering culture. The majority of our Engineers are based in the UK with smaller teams across EMEA.
Culture & Ethos: Instill a strong product-led, innovation-led ethos within the department, guiding engineering teams to build and develop the product as a customer acquisition and value-delivery tool
Organizational Design & Scaling: Evolve and optimize the organisational structure for maximum performance, resilience, scalability, and ownership to support the company's next phase of growth.
Talent Acquisition & Leadership Development: Lead global headcount planning to ensure a right-sized, highly skilled, and diverse engineering organisation. Build a robust leadership bench and succession plan for critical technical and managerial roles.
Managerial Development: Identify, coach, mentor, and develop engineering directors and managers within the organisation, creating clear career paths for both technical and managerial career tracks.
Performance Management: Ensure teams are empowered and aligned with company goals, providing frequent, actionable, and constructive feedback to support personal development and measure team outcomes.
IV. Go-To-Market and External Partnership
Executive Collaboration: Partner closely with the CEO, and other C-level executives to report on engineering performance, technological risks, and strategic opportunities.
Executive Client Sponsorship: Serve as an executive sponsor for key enterprise accounts. Partner with Sales to engage in high-stakes C-level prospect meetings, acting as the ultimate technical authority for the company.
Developer Relations: Inspire and engage advanced developers globally, encouraging contributions to our open-source projects and fostering a vibrant technical community.
WHAT YOU HAVE
Executive Leadership: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in software engineering, with at least 7+ years operating at the VP, SVP, or CTO level, preferably in a B2B enterprise software or platform company. Demonstrated experience fostering a product-led culture and driving commercial results through engineering excellence.
Business & Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to manage large departmental budgets, optimize engineering spend, and translate complex technical decisions into clear business value for executive-level stakeholders.
Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of complex architectures, concurrent, distributed systems, high-performance compute, and real-time data architectures.
Open Source Software Expertise: Excel at balancing open-source community expectations with enterprise requirements, maintaining rigorous public API discipline, documentation standards, and governance practices. Experience nurturing a global developer and operator community—across polyglot clients, cloud-native deployments, and hybrid environments.
Global Team Management: Proven track record of successfully scaling and leading a geographically distributed, international engineering organisation of significant size.
Technical Depth: A strong foundation in the core technologies relevant to the Hazelcast platform including Java, concurrency, networking, data streaming, SQL, distributed data stores, data grids. Ability to engage deeply with Principal Engineers and Architects on complex technical designs.
Agile and Delivery: Expertise in modern agile methodologies and continuous delivery pipelines, focused on delivering product capabilities rapidly, reliably, and at scale.
Customer-Centric/Team Aligner: Comfortable working backward from the customer and working in an “open-kitchen,” GTM aligned environment.
Desired Characteristics
Strategic Visionary & Entrepreneurial Spirit: The ability to look ahead to anticipate technological shifts, while approaching the engineering function with the agility of a startup to constantly innovate and improve.
Executive Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, capable of communicating complex technical strategy to both internal teams (engineering, product) and external stakeholders (C-level customers, analysts, board).
Influence: Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries, driving alignment between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at the highest levels.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (Master’s or equivalent advanced degree preferred).
BENEFITS
25 days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays + Quarterly Wellbeing Days
Group Company Pension Plan
Private Medical Insurance
Private Dental Insurance
Life Insurance
EAP (Employee Assistance Program)

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Our mission
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...
How you'll help us achieve it
We're looking for a CTO who wants to own engineering end to end: the systems, the people, and the standards for a company whose work changes lives.
Keep us fast as we get bigger: We deliberately favor fewer processes, simple designs, and deeply understood tools, because that's what lets a small team operate a system this important. Your job is to protect that as the headcount grows and ensure more ownership per engineer, and a clear view of where complexity is genuinely worth it.
Own reliability: Wave is the financial system for millions of people who have no alternative. You'll set the standards for uptime, incident response, and how carefully we change things that move money and you'll be accountable when we fall short.
Build and lead the leadership layer: You'll inherit 5 direct reports and an engineering organization of ~132 people including security, data and infrastructure. The CISO will also be reporting to you. You will be responsible for hiring, developing, and where necessary replacing engineering managers and directors. You'll be personally involved in senior hiring.
Set our vision on AI. We're already shipping AI in production as autonomous voice and digital agents handle over 10 million customer interactions a month across West Africa and we're building tooling so engineers can use coding agents safely inside a large Python monolith. You’ll help us be truly AI forward, not just a pragmatic adopter.
Support expansion. Wave is growing fast, and each new market brings new challenges and constraints. You’ll help us plan the right architecture and organisational structure to help us grow smoothly and consistently.
Represent engineering to the company. Wave is unusually transparent: everyone sees monthly update from our CEO. You'll write clearly about what engineering is doing and why, to an audience that includes engineers, non-engineers, our leadership team, and, when needed, our regulators.
Key details
Reports to: Drew Durbin, CEO.
Team: Around ~132 engineers across 5 teams (Payment, User-facing products, Internal, non-product teams and platform) plus 5 leaders. Engineering teams are co-led by a product manager and an engineering manager. Data science and analytics sits in the engineering organization; corporate IT does not for now.
Stack: Python 3 with mypy on the backend, GraphQL API layer, Postgres and Redis, Kotlin/Jetpack on Android (our main client), Swift/SwiftUI on iOS, TypeScript and React on the web. Infrastructure on GCP, managed with Kubernetes and Terraform. Most backend work happens in a large Python monolith, deployed across multi-country architecture. Current in-flight work includes agentic developer tooling, a large scale migration of our databases, and some refactoring of our monolith.
Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (Spain, UK, East Coast of USA, Canada, Kenya, Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso. Expect to travel to our markets a minimum of twice per year to stay close to local realities, products, teams and of course our users. Wave covers all costs.
Compensation: Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary of up to $356,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.
Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
Major benefits:
Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.
$10,000 annual charitable donation matching.
Process: The process runs up to 5 conversations, including 2 technical discussions. We want this to be a 2-way assessment: as much a chance for you to evaluate us as for us to get to know you. Along the way you'll meet our CEO, Head of People, Head of Product, both Engineering Directors, and a senior leader from one of our markets.
Requirements
You've managed an engineering organization of at least~100 people, including managers who manage others. You can describe how your own job changed as the org grew.
You have a software engineering background and are good at it. You can still read code and follow a technical argument to the end.
You've been accountable for a system where failure was expensive: money, safety, or regulated data.
You've hired senior engineering leaders, and you've moved someone out of a role that wasn't working. You can talk about both honestly.
You write well. Clear, short, and persuasive, for readers who aren't engineers.
You have an actual point of view on AI in engineering: something you've tried, changed, or abandoned, not a plan to look into it.
You believe in what we're building and can say why without being prompted.
You might be a good fit if you
Would rather run a great team than be the smartest engineer in the room, and don't feel a loss in that trade.
Are comfortable being the person who says the unwelcome thing in a meeting, and can do it without making it personal.
Change your mind in public when the evidence changes.
Prefer the simplest system that works to the most interesting one.
Care about what our users actually experience: how long a transfer takes on a bad network, what happens to a shop owner when a deposit fails and bring that up unprompted when discussing infrastructure.
Take responsibility for outcomes rather than processes, including when the outcome is bad.
Are drawn to a company that publishes its numbers internally every month, expects direct feedback in both directions, and would rather be embarrassingly honest than comfortable.
Our team
We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.
How to apply
Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.
We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.
Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Director, Product Strategy
jobs.text:
Real Voices. Superior Advertising. Thriving Media.
CivicScience is seeking a Director, Product Strategy to establish a clear and disciplined product approach, improve prioritization and roadmap alignment, and strengthen our competitive positioning through market-informed decisions. This role is ideal for an experienced product professional who has established clear and disciplined product strategy while creating organizational clarity around product portfolio and future direction. Our preferred candidate will help us proactively anticipate customer and market needs (rather than reacting to them) and align our teams around what we build, why it matters, and who we're building for.
Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Portfolio
Develop and drive CivicScience product strategy and long-term product roadmap
Define and evolve our product portfolio, establishing criteria for what defines products vs. services vs. customized solutions
Create frameworks to evaluate and prioritize new product opportunities
Ensure product investments align with customer demand, market trends, and business priorities
Market & Competitive Intelligence
Evaluate the competitive landscape and conduct ongoing market benchmarking
Identify industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving customer expectations
Make strategic recommendations on where the market is headed
Position CivicScience products for future growth
Assess opportunities to leverage AI and other emerging technologies that impact offerings
Strategic Business Partnership
Collaborate across business units to identify new market opportunities, eliminate product gaps, and address recurring customer needs
Support customer and partner conversations by clearly articulating product vision and long-term direction
Product Planning
Bring structure and discipline to product planning, prioritization, and roadmap development
Identify necessary cross-functional teammates to collaborate on strategic product initiatives and special projects
Lead the product planning process from concept through execution
Customer Experience & Product Definition
Translate complex business and customer needs into clear, concise product requirements and user workflows that enable intuitive customer experiences
Develop clear product positioning and messaging that strengthens market presence
Communication & Leadership
Communicate product strategy clearly an concisely to executives and cross-functional teams
Influence decision-making across departments through data-driven insights and thoughtful recommendations
Foster a disciplined product culture, focused on long-term value creation
Qualifications
10+ years of experience in product strategy, product management, management consulting, or related strategic leadership role(s)
Demonstrated success developing product strategy and bringing new products and/or portfolios to market
Strong understanding of data, advertising, competitive analysis, and product positioning
Experience creating strategic product roadmaps and investment frameworks
Knowledge of commercial application of AI and other emerging technologies
Exceptional analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Established industry network
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct managerial authority
Bachelor's degree (required); MBA (preferred)
Benefits & Expectations
Join a company that values innovation and creativity, works with cutting-edge technology to influence major business decisions, and makes a real-world impact. Benefits include:
Company paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your legal dependents
Company paid life insurance plus short- & long-term disability coverage
Flexible spending accounts for medical and dependent care
Employee assistance programs
Unlimited PTO
401(k)
Travel and educational opportunities
This is a remote (work from home) role with preference for candidates in the Eastern Time Zone.
Working at CivicScience
CivicScience has a vibrant, high-energy work culture with ambitious, innovative, and forward-thinking team members. Our specialized business units collaborate to fuel CivicScience's goals and objectives.
We've been recognized for our work in the Inc. 5000, Pittsburgh Top Workplaces 2022, Pittsburgh Business Times Fast 50, GRIT Top 50 Innovative Supplier, Pittsburgh Technology Council's Tech 50 (winner), and Mental Health America’s Bell Seal program (Platinum winner, 2026; Gold winner, 2025 & 2024).
More about CivicScience
CivicScience is a consumer analytics and advertising platform. Our proprietary, always on, data collection engine captures over 1M survey responses daily, creating the most dynamic, real-time understanding of consumer wants, needs, and intentions in a constantly changing world. Powered by our premium media partnerships, our attitudinal database helps brands and media companies retain and grow existing customers while reaching and acquiring new ones.
Our clients use CivicScience's unique dataset to inform advertising, communications, product, and financial strategies that drive superior business outcomes. Join the conversation.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data
jobs.text:
Who is Boulevard?
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.
Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.
We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.
Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.
Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.
We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Data to build and lead the technical foundation that powers Boulevard's data ecosystem and products. This role is responsible for our data infrastructure, data governance, ML capabilities and the underlying systems that enable data-driven products and decision-making across the company.
Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll play a critical leadership role in establishing Boulevard's data platform as a strategic competitive advantage. Your work will shape how data is collected, processed, and leveraged across the company - driving insights, powering product innovation, and ensuring operational excellence. You will ensure that data is reliable, secure, performant, and accessible to support our growing customer base and internal teams. You'll lead a high-impact team of data engineers, with a mandate to grow and scale the organization. This is a foundational role where you'll architect and build systems that will support Boulevard's growth for years to come.
Domains of Ownership
Data Infrastructure & Platform Engineering - Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and infrastructure
Data Products - Partner with the insights team, product management and product engineering to power reporting dashboards, analytics features, and data-driven customer experiences
Data Governance & Quality - Establish frameworks for data integrity, lineage, and compliance
Data Security & Privacy - Ensure data protection, access controls, and regulatory compliance (including HIPAA)
ML/AI Platform Operations - Provide the foundation and standards for machine learning and AI capabilities
Real-time & Batch Processing - Design and optimize data processing systems for various use cases
Data Integration & APIs - Enable seamless data flow between systems and external partners
Key Projects & Initiatives
Modern Data Infrastructure: Continue building out scalable data infrastructure using tools like dbt, Airflow, and real-time streaming platforms
Customer Data Products: Collaborate with Product Management and Product Engineering to deliver customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features
Data Platform for Insights: Build robust data pipelines that enable the Data Insights team to deliver external benchmarking and internal business intelligence
Data Governance Framework: Establish comprehensive data quality monitoring, lineage tracking, and governance policies
Platform Self-Service: Build tools and frameworks that enable other teams to safely and efficiently work with data
Security & Compliance: Strengthen data protection, access controls, and ensure HIPAA compliance across all data systems
Performance Optimization: Continuously improve cost, speed, and reliability of data processing systems
ML/AI Infrastructure: Provide robust foundation for training, deployment, and monitoring of machine learning models and LLMs
What You'll Do Here
Technical Leadership: Define and execute the long-term technical strategy for Boulevard's data platform, ensuring scalability and reliability as we grow
Team Building: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data platform engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of excellence
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, and the Data Insights team to understand requirements and deliver platform capabilities that enable customer-facing data products and internal insights
Architecture & Design: Drive architectural decisions for data systems, balancing current needs with future flexibility and scalability
Operational Excellence: Establish monitoring, alerting, and operational practices that ensure high availability and performance of data systems
Standards & Governance: Define and implement data governance policies, security standards, and quality frameworks across the organization
Strategic Planning: Work with leadership to align data platform roadmap with business objectives and technical strategy
What You'll Need to Thrive
10+ years of experience in data platform engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure engineering, with deep expertise in building scalable data processing systems
5+ years of people management experience, including managing senior engineers and technical leads
Proven track record of building data platforms and ML systems that support both internal analytics and customer-facing data products
Experience delivering customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features in collaboration with Product teams
Strong experience with modern data stack technologies (dbt, Airflow, Snowflake, Kafka, etc.)
Deep understanding of data governance, quality frameworks, and security best practices
A strategic mindset with the ability to translate business goals into technical roadmaps, balancing short-term execution with long-term vision.
How We'll Take Care of You
At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $220,000 - $270,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.
In addition to the wonderful people you'll get to work with and challenging projects that'll push you:
✨ We've got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance
🏝 Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy
🖥 Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You'll receive a work from home stipend every month
💚 Family planning resources and specialized support programs

jobs.title: Director of ML Engineering, Conversation Product Area
jobs.text:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack.
We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company.
You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.
What You'll Do
Own engineering execution and technical direction for the Conversation Product Area, including the Agent Engine, the evaluation infrastructure, the Search platform, the AI Voice platform (Speak), and some consumer agentic features built on top of the Agent Engine. This spans production systems at massive scale, applied ML research, and infrastructure that other product areas depend on.
Co-lead the Product Area in a paired product/engineering model. You own engineering and deeply partner with a product counterpart that owns product strategy. You’ll operate as a single leadership unit for planning, prioritization, and external representation. This partnership is core to the success of the role.
You’ll manage a team of ~70 engineers, with a small team of Senior Engineering Managers and Staff/Principal engineers directly reporting to you. You’ll develop and hold accountable the EM layer running the PA's roughly 9 teams. Your leverage comes through your SEMs and Staff engineers, but you’re ultimately accountable for delivery across the entire product area.
Drive the migration of the company’s existing agentic infrastructure onto the shared Agent Engine, in close partnership product teams across the company, balancing migration speed against product teams’ existing roadmap work.
Own the technical strategy for Spotify's first-party voice investment: what Speak builds versus buys, how the team organizes and delivers against a market that's commoditizing fast, and how the character/brand voice decisions for agent experiences get made and shipped on their own aggressive timelines.
Define and hold the technical bar on evaluation. Build the discipline around building feature-specific judges and datasets and product decisions based on those eval sets.
Set and enforce engineering quality standards appropriate to an AI-assisted development era including code review discipline and test coverage especially designed for teams that are increasingly writing code with AI assistance.
Participate as a full member of the broader leadership group, co-developing with your peers and executives the operating model for the whole studio across capacity management, project prioritization, studio communication principles, and building a healthy engineering culture in a highly changeable environment.
Represent the Conversation PA's engineering point of view in high visibility, company-wide architecture and steerco conversations with senior leaders.
Who You Are
You are deeply technical, not tech-adjacent. This PA's defining work (a new shared agent runtime and harness, a scaled evaluation system, a voice/speech stack) requires a Director who can evaluate architecture proposals, hold their own in a room with senior ICs, contribute technically in meaningful ways, and make tough tiebreaking and tradeoff calls.
You have run large engineering orgs through platform consolidations, migrations, or evolutions, and you’ve had to earn trust by building highly scaled and functional platform technology.
You have experience with at least two of: LLM-based agent systems and orchestration, evaluation/eval-infrastructure design (including automated judges and regression suites), large-scale retrieval or search systems, or speech/voice ML systems and production voice infrastructure.
You've managed managers, not just individual contributors. You know how to build a management structure that scales.
You have a track record of building strong but nimble teams, with experience restructuring, shifting team resourcing, adjusting to fast changing priorities or shifting needs without losing delivery momentum.
Where You'll Be
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas or EMEA region as long as we have a work location.
This team operates primarily within the Eastern North America and Central European time zones for collaboration, so we ask that you be located within a time zone that enables regular overlap with the team.
The United States base range for this position is $281,196 – $401,709 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. blocks.text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company.

You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.
What You'll Do

items: Own engineering execution and technical direction for the Conversation Product Area, including the Agent Engine, the evaluation infrastructure, the Search platform, the AI Voice platform (Speak), and some consumer agentic features built on top of the Agent Engine. This spans production systems at massive scale, applied ML research, and infrastructure that other product areas depend on.

Co-lead the Product Area in a paired product/engineering model. You own engineering and deeply partner with a product counterpart that owns product strategy. You’ll operate as a single leadership unit for planning, prioritization, and external representation. This partnership is core to the success of the role.

You’ll manage a team of ~70 engineers, with a small team of Senior Engineering Managers and Staff/Principal engineers directly reporting to you. You’ll develop and hold accountable the EM layer running the PA's roughly 9 teams. Your leverage comes through your SEMs and Staff engineers, but you’re ultimately accountable for delivery across the entire product area.

Drive the migration of the company’s existing agentic infrastructure onto the shared Agent Engine, in close partnership product teams across the company, balancing migration speed against product teams’ existing roadmap work.

Own the technical strategy for Spotify's first-party voice investment: what Speak builds versus buys, how the team organizes and delivers against a market that's commoditizing fast, and how the character/brand voice decisions for agent experiences get made and shipped on their own aggressive timelines.
Define and hold the technical bar on evaluation. Build the discipline around building feature-specific judges and datasets and product decisions based on those eval sets.

Set and enforce engineering quality standards appropriate to an AI-assisted development era including code review discipline and test coverage especially designed for teams that are increasingly writing code with AI assistance.

Participate as a full member of the broader leadership group, co-developing with your peers and executives the operating model for the whole studio across capacity management, project prioritization, studio communication principles, and building a healthy engineering culture in a highly changeable environment.
Represent the Conversation PA's engineering point of view in high visibility, company-wide architecture and steerco conversations with senior leaders.

blocks.text: Who You Are

items: You are deeply technical, not tech-adjacent. This PA's defining work (a new shared agent runtime and harness, a scaled evaluation system, a voice/speech stack) requires a Director who can evaluate architecture proposals, hold their own in a room with senior ICs, contribute technically in meaningful ways, and make tough tiebreaking and tradeoff calls.
You have run large engineering orgs through platform consolidations, migrations, or evolutions, and you’ve had to earn trust by building highly scaled and functional platform technology.

You have experience with at least two of: LLM-based agent systems and orchestration, evaluation/eval-infrastructure design (including automated judges and regression suites), large-scale retrieval or search systems, or speech/voice ML systems and production voice infrastructure.
You've managed managers, not just individual contributors. You know how to build a management structure that scales.

You have a track record of building strong but nimble teams, with experience restructuring, shifting team resourcing, adjusting to fast changing priorities or shifting needs without losing delivery momentum.

items: We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas or EMEA region as long as we have a work location.

This team operates primarily within the Eastern North America and Central European time zones for collaboration, so we ask that you be located within a time zone that enables regular overlap with the team.

jobs.text:
VP Product Management
POSITION OVERVIEW
Speedcastis accelerating its expansion into high-growth markets, and the SIGMA platform sits at the center of that strategy. As Vice President of Product Management for SIGMA, you will serve as the de facto general manager of this business unit — owning full P&L accountability, defining the multi-year product roadmap, and driving end-to-end Go-To-Market execution across existing and emerging verticals.
This is a rare opportunity for a deeply technical, commercially minded leader to shape the future of a mission-critical platform deployed at the network edge. You will combine strong product instincts with edge computeexpertiseto evolve SIGMA from a managed connectivity layer into an intelligent, programmable edge ecosystem — unlocking new revenue streams forSpeedcastacross enterprise, energy, maritime, rail, and emerging markets including India and the Middle East.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
P&L Ownership & Business Leadership
Own the full P&L for the SIGMA platform, including revenue targets, margin performance, investment prioritization, and budget management
Serve as the internal executive champion for SIGMA,establishingaccountability frameworks and operating rhythms across product, engineering, sales, and delivery
Define and track KPIs that measure platform adoption, customer retention, revenue growth, and margin improvement
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Lead the development of a multi-year SIGMA product roadmap grounded in market requirements, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, andSpeedcast’sstrategic objectives
Drive the integration of edge compute capabilities into SIGMA’s architecture, enabling compute-at-the-edge use cases such as local data processing, AI inferencing, IoT aggregation, and application hosting in bandwidth-constrained or remote environments
Define and own the SIGMA portal strategy, ensuring a best-in-class operator and end-user experience for provisioning, monitoring, and managing edge services
Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to translate product vision into delivery roadmaps, managing trade-offs between speed, scope, and technical debt
Go-To-Market Execution
Architect and lead Go-To-Market strategies for each SIGMA vertical, from value proposition definition through sales enablement, pricing, and launch execution
Collaborate closely with the Head of Sales, Business Development, and vertical leads to drive pipeline generation and close high-value enterprise deals
Develop compelling commercial narratives and competitive differentiation frameworks that equip sales teams to win against both legacy connectivity providers and pure-play edge compute vendors
Represent SIGMA at executive briefings, industry events, and strategic customer engagements
Partnerships & Ecosystem Development
Identify, structure, and manage strategic partnerships with resellers, co-sell partners, white-label operators, and technology integrators acrossSpeedcast’sportfolio (LEO/Starlink, GEO, LTE, SIGMA, and applications)
Lead commercial negotiations and partnership agreement structuring in close collaboration with legal, finance, and product teams
Manage and growSpeedcast’sstrategic relationships with key ecosystem partners including Sify and HCL Tech, andidentifynew partnerships to accelerate SIGMA adoption
Build an ecosystem strategy that extends SIGMA’s addressable market through third-party application integrations, ISV relationships, and platform APIs
Cross-Functional Leadership
Operate as a senior cross-functional leader, aligning product, sales, engineering, innovation, and finance around a coherent SIGMA growth strategy
Present strategy, roadmap, pipeline performance, and investment cases to the CPO and Board-level audiences, with clarity and commercial rigor
Mentor and develop product managers within the SIGMA organization, building a high-performance team culture
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required
15+ years of experience in technology product management, product strategy, or a closely related discipline, with a minimum of 5 years of focused experience in edge compute, distributed systems, or network-edge platforms
Demonstrated success owning P&L accountability for a software platform or technology product line, including revenue growth, margin management, and investment decision-making
Deep technical fluency in edge compute architectures — including containerized workloads, edge orchestration, IoT data pipelines, and low-latency application delivery — with the ability to engage credibly with engineering leadership and customer CTOs
Proventrack recorddesigning and executing Go-To-Market strategies across enterprise, industrial, or connectivity verticals, from strategy through sales enablement and commercial launch
Experience building and closing complex strategic partnerships with ICTs, system integrators, and IT consulting organizations
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, withdemonstratedability to present complex strategy, business cases, and risk assessments to CPO and Board-level audiences
Strong commercial acumen, including experience structuring pricing, packaging, and partnership commercial terms
Ability to manage andallocatebudgets effectively and advocate for investment prioritization in a resource-constrained environment
Preferred
Experience inIT, or network-as-a-service environments
Prior experience scaling a product inexisting andemerging markets such as India or the Middle East
Background in SaaS platform business models, particularly those with usage-based or managed service components
MBA or equivalent advanced business education
Working at Speedcast:
At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure. Who are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity and thinking outside the box. Who relish the idea of working in an industry undergoing massive transformation. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you’re in the right place.
We're always pushing forward, never standing still. When people rely on you and your team to stay connected, it brings everyone closer together. We’re united by the adrenaline of high-stakes projects and our love of getting the job done right. You will experiment, learn and grow here, right alongside us, every single day.
Find great opportunities to make an impact. We have a "one team, one dream" mentality. We work together to make great things happen. Working at Speedcast isn't just a job, it's a career that you can take to new levels.
Top reasons why people love working at Speedcast:
Our global presence– you get to work with clients and colleagues all over the world, in every continent
Talented teammates– your co-workers are the best and brightest in the industry
Industry leadership– be part of the latest advancements shaping the future of communications
Ability to develop skills– work across departments to gain new skills and valuable experience
Choose your environment– we have an environment to fit your temperament. Choose between a traditional desk job or work in the field.
Grow your career- Guide your career in the direction you want. Gain new titles and responsibilities through our internal promotion system.
Work on diverse projects– every day is different with our customers from a range of industries around the world

We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. jobs.text:
The Senior Director, Development requires strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills, ability to self-direct, strong background in data center design, engineering, controls, and operational requirements, with an emphasis on project/construction management. In this role, you will function as QTS’ point of contact for new client builds and implementations and liaise between the QTS Sales Team (Account Exec and Sales Engineer), the QTS Operations Team, the QTS Property Development Team, and the Customer. The PSCM will work closely with existing Development Construction Project Managers to ensure the customers’ needs are carried out to high levels of expectation.
The position will report into the QTS Property Development department and work closely with the CHO and CRO, depending on the origin of the project.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES, other duties may be assigned.
Manage the customer deployment project delivery for each sold deal within each QTS location
Coordinate with the QTS Property Development team, and supporting specialty consultants, to support customer’s design needs, pricing, customer approvals, & implementation of specific deployment scopes
Manage the delivery of these projects, this position aligns clients’ objectives, business processes, vendor management strategies, and cross-group collaboration efforts across the QTS organization
Drive effective client relationship management and efficient cost management, with the ultimate goal of delivering the project on time and on budget
Serve as a single contact for Federal sales support on potential secured deals
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s Degree and/or professional licenses in Construction Management or Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or Architecture
Ten or more years of progressive responsibility in development of Mission Critical Facilities
Five or more years of responsibility of data center project construction with large-scale data centers or DC lease providers
Be able to travel up to 50% of the time
US Citizenship for this position is required by law due to federal customer contracts
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience managing multiple large, multi-faceted projects
Experience with Construction Health & Safety Knowledge
Experience with Customer Deployment Technologies and Equipment, RCDD a plus.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
Strong Verbal and Written Communication Skills
Ability to independently manage deadlines and support staff
Ability to influence cross-discipline teams
Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing situations at a high growth company
TOTAL REWARDS
This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.

The platform model centers on one governed connection per data domain — exposed as an MCP server, API, direct SQL connection, or event stream — with two backend lanes behind every connection: a read lane serving curated, AI- and analytics-ready data products, and an operational lane serving approved enterprise actions and event-driven integration back into source systems. The Director owns both lanes, the connection layer that unifies them, the access model that determines what any caller — person, application, AI agent, or integration pipeline — is permitted to do, and the event streaming infrastructure that powers domain-event-driven consumers such as Hatch.
This is a hands-on architectural and operational leadership role. The Director will be the senior-most technical authority on Snowflake, data governance, platform access and authorization, FinOps, ingestion, medallion architecture, data product publishing, and event
High-Level Responsibilities
The Director owns seven core pillars of the Data Platform Team, plus the event streaming and messaging infrastructure that is essential for integration-pipeline and event-driven consumers:
1. Snowflake Ownership
Own the target-state Snowflake architecture: data organization, storage patterns, warehouse and workload segmentation, performance optimization, and lifecycle management.
Set platform-wide standards for environments, security model, scalability, and operational resilience.
Serve as the senior-most technical authority on Snowflake within the enterprise, with deep hands-on credibility.
2. Data Governance
Own the enterprise data governance vision, operating model, and leadership cadence — embedded into platform delivery and operations, not run as a disconnected compliance function.
Lead the governance agenda across ownership, stewardship, quality, metadata, lineage, cataloging, retention, classification, and policy enforcement.
Hire and lead a Data Governance leader reporting into this role, while retaining accountability for enterprise data policy, standards, and outcomes.
Design governance controls that support AI and agent-based consumption: policy-aware access, auditability of actions, appropriate use of sensitive data, and traceability of context.
3. Data Platform Auth, Use Cases, and Access
Own the access-rights model that governs every domain connection: who can read, who can write, who can subscribe to event streams, and under what scope — by role, by application, and by AI agent.
Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards at the connection layer, ensuring every call is identified, scoped, and audited regardless of which backend lane serves it.
Own the catalog of domain connections and the self-service model that lets consumers discover what they can access and request what they cannot.
Partner with Security to ensure access governance, policy enforcement, and use-case approval processes scale with the number of domain connections and consumers.
4. FinOps
Own platform cost governance for Snowflake and the surrounding data estate: budgeting, spend visibility, showback/chargeback policy, and optimization guardrails.
Establish unit economics and cost-per-workload visibility so platform investment decisions are made with full cost transparency.
Drive continuous cost optimization without compromising performance, reliability, or governance standards.
5. Ingestion
Own the standards and patterns for data ingestion into the platform: batch, CDC, streaming, and event-driven sources.
Define source onboarding standards, schema change handling, and replay/backfill patterns.
Ensure ingestion patterns scale cleanly as new domains and source systems are added to the platform.
6. Medallion Architecture
Own the Bronze → Silver → Gold processing model: raw retention, cleansing and conformance, and product-ready modeling.
Set transformation standards, testing practices, and reconciliation processes across all medallion layers.
Ensure the medallion architecture is the consistent foundation underneath every domain connection’s read lane, regardless of who contributed the underlying product.
7. Data Product Publishing and Documentation
Own the end-to-end lifecycle for data products: intake, build, review, publication, change control, and retirement.
Establish documentation standards so every published product has a clear owner, contract, SLA, classification, and lineage.
Build and run the federated contribution model: approved domain teams can build and submit read-side data products; the core team reviews, scales, and promotes them into the shared catalog while retaining final editorial control over what gets published.
Drive platform-wide discoverability and self-service consumption so published products are easy to find, understand, and adopt.
8. Event Streaming and Messaging Infrastructure
In addition to the seven pillars above, the Director owns the event streaming and messaging layer that powers integration-pipeline and event-driven consumers:
Own the domain event streaming infrastructure — the platform through which consumers subscribe to governed domain events rather than polling source systems directly. Current infrastructure includes MuleSoft
Establish event contracts as a first-class element of every domain connection: schemas, topic naming, retention policies, ordering guarantees, and access rights are governed at the connection level
Ensure event streams feed the read lane’s ingestion pipelines as a governed push-based delivery mechanism into the medallion stack
Partner with integration platform owners and application teams to migrate from point-to-point event wiring toward governed, domain-aligned event contracts under this team’s stewardship.
Additional Duties and Leadership Scope
Build the Data Platform Team : recruit, structure, and lead a high-performing organization spanning platform engineering, data governance, data product delivery, and event infrastructure.
Define and own the architecture for unified domain connections — one governed connection per data domain, exposing curated reads, operational reads, governed write actions, and event stream subscriptions through a single contract consumers integrate to.
Design the platform to support both analytical and operational use cases, enabling trusted historical insight while supporting the real-time, entity-specific access patterns required for AI agents, automated workflows, and event-driven integration pipelines.
Architect governed write-back patterns and event emission patterns that allow downstream systems, workflows, or AI agents to act safely on platform data, with full auditability and scoped access rights.
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Product, and Security to ensure the platform is resilient, trusted, extensible, and aligned to enterprise priorities.
Build a platform operating model that balances central ownership with federated, domain-aligned contribution — enabling teams to move quickly without compromising governance or architectural integrity.
Establish platform engineering standards for performance, resilience, monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery, and service-level expectations across all connection modes: direct SQL, API, MCP, and event stream.
Own the platform roadmap across foundational build-out, Snowflake optimization, governance maturity, event streaming infrastructure, and future-facing capabilities that support AI-driven workflows.
Provide strong cross-functional leadership and executive communication, translating platform decisions into business impact, delivery tradeoffs, and investment priorities.
Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
12 or more years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, data architecture, or related technology roles.
At least 5 years in a leadership role with responsibility for platform strategy, architecture, and engineering team leadership — including building a team or function from the ground up.
Demonstrated experience architecting and operating modern enterprise data platforms in cloud environments.
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, including platform design, performance optimization, security, workload management, and FinOps/cost governance.
Experience designing and running data governance programs: ownership, stewardship, quality, metadata, lineage, cataloging, classification, and policy enforcement.
Experience designing access and authorization models for data platforms, including role-based, application-based, and AI-agent access patterns.
Experience designing data ingestion patterns across batch, CDC, and streaming sources, and medallion-style (Bronze/Silver/Gold) processing architectures.
Experience with event streaming and messaging infrastructure — e.g. Kafka, MuleSoft, or equivalent — including event schema governance, topic design, retention policy, and integration with data platform ingestion pipelines.
Experience building data product publishing programs, including documentation standards, catalog design, and self-service consumption models.
Experience building or enabling platforms that support AI, intelligent automation, or agent-based workflows.
Experience designing governed write-back or operational integration patterns that allow downstream systems, workflows, or agents to act safely on platform data.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical architecture decisions to business value.

jobs.title: VP of Product, Commerce
jobs.text:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
Stord has built one of the world’s leading delivery networks with fulfillment centers across North America, UK, and EU delivering to nearly one in four US households and running a vertically integrated tech stack that allows for unprecedented automation and efficiency. Over the past ~9mo, Stord has expanded these capabilities into the front-end commerce journey and consumer experience, building and launching ~8 new products in the pre- and post-purchase ecommerce space. This product portfolio has quickly scaled in breadth and shown high-adoption and revenue growth. This has created a high-impact opportunity for a capable, experienced, and strategic leader to continue its exponential growth trajectory – both in product capability and compound product platform and in adoption and growth.
The Vice President of Product, Commerce will own the product and revenue outcomes of the Commerce suite of products across Stord including, as of today, 8 different products that operate across the pre- and post-purchase consumer experience to drive increased add-to-cart and checkout conversion, AOV, margin per order, LTV, and subscriber retention. This individual will be expected to build, manage, and scale a world-class product team of high-ownership, fast-paced, product managers. They will be responsible for the short and long-term product roadmap and strategy to deliver market-leading value and outcomes for customers, achieve Stord’s revenue and strategy goals, and deliver products that compound in capability and competitive position over time. As part of this leadership role, they will be expected to ensure commercial success – spending time with customers; partnering with Sales, Marketing, CX, Implementations, Solutions, and other cross-functional teams; iterating on pricing and packaging; establishing clear market positioning; and removing barriers to maximum product adoption and growth. The VP of Product, Commerce will be responsible for scaling and launching new products and expanding the product portfolio into additional high-growth products, new markets, and new business lines.
What You'll Own
Product strategy and roadmap across the full Commerce suite of products covering the end-to-end pre- and post-purchase consumer experience. This includes products like Estimated Delivery Dates and Dynamic Ship Options, Post-Purchase Tracking, Unbox, Subscriptions Management, Shipment Protection, and more.
Team leadership - build and lead a team of world-class product managers within the Commerce product organization. You will be expected to hire exceptional product talent, develop product managers who understand this domain as deeply as you do, and create the kind of team that compounds over time. The calibre of this team is what determines whether we win.
Commercial alignment - work directly with sales, solutions, and client success on competitive positioning, client retention, and new logo requirements. You understand what it takes to win a deal and what keeps a client for life. Revenue outcomes are not someone else's problem.
Operational Excellence - define and own the operating cadences, metrics, and rituals that keep the Commerce product organization running at a fast pace. You set the bar for how products are spec'd, shipped, measured, and iterated. You own the portfolio prioritization framework that ensures the team is always working on the highest-value work. You drive adoption and attach rates.
Delivering Value - own the revenue outcomes of the Commerce suite. You are accountable for software cARR growth across the portfolio: from pricing and packaging decisions to attach rate optimization to identifying and launching net-new products. You measure your team's success not by features shipped but by revenue generated, customer outcomes improved, and competitive position strengthened.
What We're Looking For
You have deep domain knowledge in Ecommerce and Commerce. You've operated an Ecommerce business or scaled products servicing Ecommerce brands/merchants. You understand the metrics Ecommerce founders, Marketing leaders, CX leaders, Operations leaders, and Finance leaders care about and recognize the throughlines of growth goals, retention targets, and margin and cash targets between them all.
You've led a product organization at scale in a complex environment. Think high-growth venture-backed unicorns, software companies that have gone public, or a comparable scaled logistics technology platform. You've managed a multi-product portfolio to successful outcomes and built the organization required to drive that success. You’ve hired world-class PMs and coached into a product organization that others copy and want to poach.
You can go both wide and deep. You are not a pure strategist who can't get into the weeds, and you are not someone who goes so deep on one product area that everything else falls behind. This role spans a number of independent and interrelated products, with more planned. You manage the portfolio of products with discipline and can zoom in and out when it counts.
You understand Ecommerce economics. The same metrics an Ecommerce founder, marketer, operator, or leader thinks about for their business are the lens through which you evaluate every product decision. You can sit across from a brand's CFO, CMO, or CEO and speak their language. And you deliver product outcomes that materially move the unit economics and conversion metrics for brands.
You have a point of view on best-in-class consumer experiences in a fast-changing landscape. The best post-purchase experiences today won't be the best in 6 months. You track how leading brands, adjacent industries, AI, technology trends, cultural trends, and new startups are changing the pre-purchase, checkout, and post-purchase journey. You have conviction about the future of consumer experiences and can translate that conviction into a product roadmap that stays ahead of the market.
Success Profile
A successful VP of Product will be able to:
Set a compelling product vision and translate it into an executable roadmap.
Balance strategic thinking with hands-on product judgment.
Go deep enough to understand product, customer, technical, and operational details.
Make disciplined tradeoffs across competing priorities.
Lead through influence across Engineering, GTM, Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders.
Build strong product teams and raise the quality of product decision-making.
Use customer insight, data, and business context to guide product direction.
Drive adoption and measurable outcomes, not just feature delivery.
Operate effectively in ambiguity and complexity.
Represent the product internally and externally with credibility.
What We Are Not Looking For
A pure strategist who cannot engage deeply in product details, customer problems, or execution tradeoffs.
A single-product specialist who has not demonstrated the ability to manage broader portfolio complexity.
A product leader who relies on roadmap process without clear business impact.
A leader who treats commercial outcomes, customer adoption, or implementation success as someone else’s responsibility.
A product manager who has not managed or developed other product managers.
A leader who cannot communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.
A candidate who speaks in broad product language but cannot provide specific examples of shipped products, tradeoffs, metrics, and outcomes.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Global Technology Service Management
jobs.text:
Job Title: Executive Director, Global Technology Service Management
Job Location: Remote (US), United States of America
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer. The Executive Director, Global Technology Service Management executes BeOne’s enterprise service management strategy and leads the governance and operational performance needed to improve service reliability, employee productivity, business continuity, and technology-enabled business outcomes. This role oversees the ServiceNow platform, global service desk operations, executive support, ITSM processes, service governance, automation, experience management, and performance accountability as an integrated service management ecosystem designed to deliver consistent, scalable, and high-quality technology services worldwide. In partnership with regional delivery, workplace technology, infrastructure, enterprise platform, and business leaders, the Executive Director standardizes services, strengthens operational excellence, and improves employee experience through data-driven, AI-enabled service delivery. Essential Functions of the Role: Enterprise Service Management & Governance Define and execute the enterprise service management framework, including standards, governance, service ownership, support models, escalation paths, and lifecycle practices. Maintain service catalog governance, service taxonomy, service data quality, and consistent onboarding practices for technology services. Extend enterprise service management practices beyond IT where appropriate to enable consistent, controlled, and measurable business services. jobs.title: TECH000: Head of Technology/CIO
jobs.text:
About JerseySTEM
JerseySTEM is a mission-driven network of professionals dedicated to closing the gender gap in STEM by expanding access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.
Role Details & Commitment:
Type: Pro-bono (unpaid volunteer)
Time Commitment: ~6 flexible hours per week for a minimum of 6 months
Member Deposit: Requires a $100 refundable deposit (fully returned after 6 months of active service). Exemptions apply for K–12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students.
Overview
JerseySTEM is seeking an experienced Head of Technology / Chief Information Officer (CIO) to provide leadership, strategic oversight, and team management for our technology department. Taking the reins from our Interim CIO, you will lead a team of 6–8 technical leads (and their respective associates) who maintain our core operational platforms, including Google Workspace, Salesforce, and Jira.
Note: This is fundamentally a people leadership and operational management role rather than a hands-on technical coding position.
Responsibilities
Culture & Collaboration: Cultivate an open, feedback-driven environment focused on mission impact over ego to ensure all technology decisions directly serve the youth we empower.
Executive Leadership: Serve on the Executive Committee as the primary liaison and advocate for the Tech team.
Team Operations: Facilitate weekly Tech meetings to align goals, resolve roadblocks, and advance both technical capabilities and organizational mission objectives.
Performance Management: Establish and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across the organization to deliver responsive, high-quality technical support.
Knowledge Management & Succession: Champion best practices in technical documentation and build a sustainable succession pipeline for key technical roles.
Qualifications
Service Mindset: View internal teams and stakeholders as primary clients, prioritizing responsive, high-quality technical support.
Team Leadership & Strategy: Proven ability to articulate technology strategy, gain team buy-in, and foster collaboration among technical leads and associates.
Non-Profit Experience & Adaptability: Prior experience working with non-profits or community organizations, with a demonstrated ability to thrive and innovate within resource-constrained operating environments.
Strong Communication: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to convey strategy clearly and build alignment across teams.
Drive & Initiative: A strong sense of urgency focused on decisive execution and timely problem-solving.
Team Advocacy: Serve as an enthusiastic champion and advocate for the Tech team and its contributions.
Technical Familiarity: General exposure to or familiarity with core platforms, including Google Workspace, Salesforce, and Jira.
Documentation Focus: Strong commitment to clear, thorough documentation to ensure operational continuity and seamless succession.
Availability & Commitment: Ability to dedicate 8–10 hours per week for a 12+ month commitment.
