jobs.text:
Head of AI Engineering – Bilingual English C1
Full-Time | Remote | Colombia
About the Company
We are an AI strategy and integration firm that builds production AI systems for B2B companies in private equity, wholesale lending, real estate, and SaaS.
We work with high-growth businesses globally, helping them move revenue, compress costs, and automate the work that used to take entire teams — through AI systems that are built to last and designed to perform.
About the Role
We are seeking a Head of AI Engineering to own all engineering delivery at our Colombia engineering hub.
This is the senior-most technical leadership role in the organization. You will lead a high-performing team of AI, ML, MLOps, and Data Engineers while setting the technical bar personally. You'll translate ambitious client goals into scalable, production-ready AI systems — and build the processes, platforms, and culture needed to operate at scale.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of deploying AI systems that moved real business KPIs, is comfortable being client-facing, and knows what it means to own the whole problem — not just manage a piece of it.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering Delivery & Leadership
Own all engineering deliverables — quality, scalability, and on-time execution
Lead and manage the full engineering organization: AI Engineers, ML Engineers, MLOps, and Data Engineers
Establish and run Agile/Scrum processes: sprints, backlog grooming, ticketing, and release planning
Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement
AI/ML Strategy & Architecture
Define and standardize best practices across the full AI/ML lifecycle — from experimentation through deployment and monitoring
Architect and oversee a full ML platform: infrastructure, scalability, reliability, and rapid iteration
Design and build scalable, end-to-end ML solutions for predictions, recommendations, search, and growth systems
Evaluate experiments, document findings, select winning approaches, and roll them out team-wide
Technical Execution
Contribute directly to system architecture and key technical decisions
Oversee model training, optimization, deployment, and performance monitoring
Drive data excellence: clean pipelines, strong governance, and actionable insights
Establish frameworks that integrate generative AI into engineering workflows
Client Engagement
Join client calls as a senior technical voice, shaping solutions and building stakeholder trust
Partner with product managers and business leaders to translate business objectives into technical roadmaps
Present trade-offs clearly so clients understand what's being built and why it will move their business
Team Development
Hire, coach, and mentor top-tier AI-first engineers and engineering leaders
Establish clear career paths, feedback loops, and performance standards
Scale the AI function across MLE, MLOps, and Data Engineering as the company grows
Requirements
10+ years of engineering experience with significant and proven leadership responsibility
Track record managing large engineering teams in fast-moving, high-accountability environments
Deep expertise in AI/ML systems — generative AI, model training, and production deployment
Strong command of Agile/Scrum and the operational discipline to run a high-output engineering org
Experience architecting and scaling ML platforms and data infrastructure
Comfortable being client-facing and translating complex technical concepts into business value
English proficiency at C1 level or above
Nice to Have
Former founder or early engineering leader who has operated with full ownership of a technical function
Experience in consulting, professional services, or client-facing technical leadership
Track record of deploying AI systems that moved a business KPI — revenue gained, cost saved, or time eliminated
Active in the AI community — writing, speaking, or building in public
Skills
Machine Learning, Generative AI, and model optimization
MLOps, CI/CD, and ML lifecycle management
Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Data engineering, pipelines, and analytics
Scalable system design and architecture
Exceptional communication across engineering, client, and executive audiences
At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they are born in.

jobs.title: Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development
jobs.text:
Firmus Technologies
Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.
Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.
At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.
Firmus AI Cloud
Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.
It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.
Roles & Responsibilities
As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development at Firmus, you will lead the electrical engineering discipline across every site where Firmus is building and scaling an AI Factory. This is a principal-engineer-equivalent management role within the Build group, accountable for the consistent, high-quality implementation of Firmus's reference electrical design across our global site portfolio.
The role sits within AI Factory Development (Build) and reports to the Head/Director of AI Factory Engineering. You will lead a distributed team of site-based electrical engineers across Indonesia, Australia, and any future geography where Firmus is active. Your remit is delivery, governance, and technical assurance of the electrical design in construction, commissioning, and handover — not ownership of the reference design itself, though you will be a primary and continuous input into the reference design's evolution.
This is a central leadership role. You are the single accountable owner for electrical engineering execution across the Firmus AI Factory estate, the escalation point for electrical technical issues in the field, and the guardian of design intent from tender through energisation. You will work in tight partnership with the reference design owners, the Mechanical and Thermal, Controls, and Physical Networking Heads, and with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations to ensure every site is electrically built, tested, and handed over to standard.
What you will do
As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development, you will own the electrical engineering function within the AI Factory Development group. You will define how the reference electrical design is interpreted, adapted for local codes and site conditions, procured, constructed, and commissioned across every Firmus site. You will set the technical bar for MV/LV distribution, UPS and standby generation, protection and coordination, earthing and bonding, power quality, and the electrical interfaces to liquid-cooled AI compute halls.
You will act as the engineering authority for electrical execution across the AI Factory portfolio — accountable for design governance in the field, deviation management, factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning readiness, and safe, reliable energisation. You will operate the change-control and design-review disciplines that keep every site aligned to the Firmus reference design, and you will be the escalation point when local realities require considered deviation or when the reference design itself needs to evolve.
You will not own the development of the reference electrical design, but you will be one of its most important customers and contributors. You will feed operational learnings, site constraints, vendor performance data, and commissioning findings back into the reference design owners, and you will co-develop the electrical standards, templates, and Basis of Design updates that keep Firmus's design ahead of the industry.
You will build, lead, and scale a geographically distributed electrical engineering team – site-based engineers embedded in Indonesia, Australia, and any additional geography where Firmus operates. You will set the operating rhythm across time zones, establish consistent engineering practice and quality standards across sites, develop the next generation of senior electrical engineers within Firmus, and represent electrical engineering in cross-functional Build, Commissioning, and Operations forums.
Skills & Experiences
You are, first and foremost, an accomplished electrical engineer for mission-critical, high-density digital infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in medium- and low-voltage distribution, UPS systems, standby and prime-power generation, static and rotary switching, protection and relay coordination, arc-flash and safety-in-design, earthing and bonding, and the specific electrical demands of dense GPU compute halls and liquid-cooled AI infrastructure. You understand power system modelling — load flow, short-circuit, motor starting, transient stability — and you have used it to make consequential design and operational decisions.
Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading tender design reviews, consultant and contractor governance, factory acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, level-1 through level-5 commissioning, and handover to operations. You have authored or materially shaped Basis of Design documents, engineering templates, global minimum standards, and change-control processes at a hyperscale operator or equivalent. You are comfortable engaging utilities, regulators, and major equipment vendors, and you know how to drive value engineering, DfMA, and sustainability outcomes without compromising reliability.
Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under construction and commissioning pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of site engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI infrastructure that works reliably from day one.
The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in electrical power engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (power systems preferred) recognised in at least one of Firmus's operating jurisdictions, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience across hyperscale or mission-critical data centre developments, industrial power systems, or comparable high-availability infrastructure. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as an electrical subject-matter expert and design manager on multi-site programmes, and a proven track record leading design governance, quality assurance, and commissioning readiness across a portfolio of concurrent projects.
This experience should include leading distributed, site-based engineering teams across multiple countries, managing external consultants and EPC contractors to global standards, and working effectively across the build-to-run interface with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations. Experience authoring or contributing materially to global electrical Basis of Design, minimum standards, or reference architecture at a hyperscale, cloud, or specialist AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia and Australia — under diverse regulatory, grid, and utility conditions.
Location & Reporting
Australia, or Singapore (with regular travel across the AI Factory portfolio)
Reporting to the Head/Director of AI Factory Engineering

jobs.title: AVP, Product Management
jobs.text:
Axos Bank
Target Range:
$120,000.00 /Yr. - $145,000.00 /Yr.
Actual starting pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, skills, specialty, and education.
Eligible for an Annual Discretionary Cash Bonus Target: 15%Eligible for an Annual Discretionary Restricted Stock Units Bonus Target: 15%
These discretionary target bonuses may be awarded semi-annually based upon your achievement of performance goals and targets.
About This Job
Axos was born digital, providing consumer banking services without any brick-and-mortar locations and has continued evolving since. The Axos consumer product team drives the vision and roadmap for this evolution and is adding an AVP, Product Management - Proxy Account Opening (Deposits, Brokerage, Credit Card, etc.) to the team.
This individual will be responsible for contributing to and driving the Proxy Account Opening roadmap. This individual will work closely with delivery teams across the enterprise to own the delivery of critical projects and release best-in-class experiences to our clients. This role will report to the FVP of Account Opening and will lead product owner(s) in day-to-day SDLC activities.
Responsibilities:
Product Roadmap: Understanding the strategic vision for your area of responsibility and defining a roadmap to achieve the vision
Problem Solving: Working with product leaders and business stakeholders to understand market trends, business objectives, and key customer segments to define product solutions
Definition: Defining workflows, process maps, and data flows to document product requirements
Feature Prioritization: Prioritizing feature releases to optimize business outcomes
Leadership: Leading product owners, designers, and solution architects to define product requirements
Supporting operational readiness activities (documentation, training, and staffing)
Analysis: Analyzing business metrics and customer feedback to improve product performance
Testing: Performing User acceptance testing
Collecting customer feedback / pain points
Presenting to leadership on project status, roadmaps, features, kpi, etc.
To be successful in this role, you will:
Be expected to think both strategically and tactically.
Possess a strong understanding of product discovery, product lifecycle, and SDLC processes.
Effectively communicate with subject matter experts across business, technology, analytics, risk, and operations to define solutions to complex challenges.
Passionately drive initiatives to meet key milestone dates.
Work well autonomously and collaboratively within cross‑functional teams.
Build consensus when there are differing opinions and priorities.
Work with autonomy to meet aggressive timelines in a dynamic environment.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree
5+ years building/managing technical products
Knowledge of the Product Development Lifecycle and SDLC
Experience working in an agile / scrum environment
Experience with issue and development tracking software such as Microsoft DevOps or Jira
Experience with KYC, KYB, and other Identity verification and fraud prevention solutions
Axos Employee Benefits May Include:
Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
Paid Sick Leave, 3 weeks’ Vacation, and Holidays (about 11 a year)
HSA or FSA account and other voluntary benefits
401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with Employer Match Program and 529 Savings Plan
Employee Mortgage Loan Program and free access to an Axos Bank Account with Self-Directed Trading
About Axos
Born digital-first, Axos delivers financial tools and services that allow individuals, small businesses, and companies to access and manage their money how, when, and where they want. We’re a diverse team of dynamic, insightful, and independent innovators who are excited to provide technology-driven solutions that offer unbeatable value to our customers.
Axos Financial is our holding company and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "AX" (NYSE: AX).
Learn more about working at Axos
Pre-Employment Background Check and Drug Test:
All offers are contingent upon the candidate successfully passing a credit check, criminal background check, and pre-employment drug screening, which includes screening for marijuana. Axos Bank is a federally regulated banking institution. At the federal level, marijuana is an illegal schedule 1 drug; therefore, we will not employ any person who tests positive for marijuana, regardless of state legalization.
Equal Employment Opportunity:
Axos is an Equal Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, sex (including pregnancy, breast feeding and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military and veteran status, marital status, age, protected medical condition, genetic information, physical disability, mental disability, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.
Job Functions and Work Environment:
While performing the duties of this position, the employee is required to sit for extended periods of time. Manual dexterity and coordination are required while operating standard office equipment such as computer keyboard and mouse, calculator, telephone, copiers, etc.
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.
E-Verify and Right to Work Notices
Axos participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States. The E-Verify program is an internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services.

jobs.title: Head of Platform Product
jobs.text:
About Us
Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Leader to join our technology leadership team, reporting directly to the CTO. This role will manage and grow the Platform Product organization and extend product ownership across the CTO-line platform product portfolio, including infrastructure-facing product lines such as AI platform, compliance infrastructure, financial cloud, and developer tooling.
This is a rare opportunity to shape the product strategy of a global crypto exchange at a pivotal inflection point — transitioning from a high-growth crypto-native platform to a regulated, AI-native financial institution.
What You'll Own
1. Platform Product Organization Leadership
Directly manage and develop the Platform Product Group — a 15+ person team spanning compliance site building, payments & assets, CRM, user/security/reach, personalization, and AI product lines
Drive team health, OKR quality, and delivery rigor across 10+ sub-teams and 200+ active requirements
Build a high-performance product culture: elevate product thinking from requirement-taking to systems-level ownership; enforce outcome-based OKRs over go-live checklists
Recruit, develop, and retain senior product talent; proactively manage succession and capability gaps
2. CTO-Line Platform Product Strategy
Own the product vision and roadmap for CTO-line platform product lines, including:
AI Platform (OpenClaw, AI Gateway, AI Sub-Account, Skills Marketplace, AI Coding infrastructure)
Financial Cloud / Compliance Infrastructure (self-service compliance platform, multi-jurisdiction site building, regulatory data export)
Developer Experience & Internal Tooling (BDOT, CI/CD product layer, AI-native R&D workflow)
Data & Intelligence Platform (knowledge distillation, MCP integration, personalization engine)
Translate CTO-level technical strategy into concrete product roadmaps with measurable business outcomes
3. AI-Native Product Transformation
Lead the platform product team's transition to AI-native product development — 100% AI documentation coverage, AI-assisted requirement analysis, and measurable AI efficiency gains
Define and drive the killing feature strategy for the AI agent platform: identify the user acquisition hook that converts infrastructure investment into real user growth
Own the product strategy for intelligent customer service evolution — from reactive article-linking to proactive, fully automated resolution (>80% resolution rate target)
What We're Looking For
Must Have
10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a senior product leadership role managing multi-team product organizations (20+ PMs)
Proven track record building and shipping platform/infrastructure products — not just consumer-facing features; experience with developer platforms, internal tooling, or B2B SaaS is highly valued
Strong systems thinking: ability to define product architecture, module catalogs, and API contracts — not just user stories
Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment (fintech, banking, crypto, or equivalent); understanding of how regulatory requirements translate into product constraints and opportunities
Demonstrated ability to drive OKR quality — moving teams from go-live metrics to outcome-based measurement
Fluency in Chinese (Mandarin) — required for internal communication with engineering teams and business stakeholders
Strongly Preferred
Experience with AI product strategy — agent platforms, LLM-powered products, or AI infrastructure products
Background in financial services technology or crypto/Web3
Experience managing product teams through organizational restructuring or rapid scaling
Familiarity with multi-jurisdiction compliance product challenges (KYC/KYB, AML, regulatory data reporting, multi-site architecture)
Track record of defining and launching platform "killing features" — not just maintaining existing product lines
Leadership Profile
End-to-end ownership mindset: bridges customer pain points, product design, system architecture, data governance, compliance, and business outcomes — not a handoff-oriented PM
Prioritization discipline: can narrow scope to the top 5 problems and communicate a clear, credible plan rather than attempting to map everything simultaneously
Honest communicator: acknowledges unknowns directly; gives specific, actionable feedback to senior engineers and PMs
Builder, not coordinator: avoids absorbing accountability for all cross-team AI products without authority; focuses on creating genuine new product value
Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.text:
Are you a data-driven leader who thrives at the intersection of business and technology? As Head of Data at Digital Forms, you will be responsible for translating business goals into measurable outcomes. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their challenges, design actionable KPIs, and implement the data flows and dashboards needed to drive decision-making. This role combines strategic thinking, hands-on data expertise, and outstanding communication skills. You’ll be a key player in delivering high-impact digital transformation solutions for our international clients.
Requirements
Responsibilities
Lead the company’s data strategy in alignment with business objectives and client goals.
Work closely with clients to understand their business context, define success metrics, and design clear, actionable KPIs.
Design and implement efficient data flows, pipelines, and architectures for business intelligence and reporting.
Build and manage dashboards that support executive-level decision-making and operational optimization.
Translate complex data insights into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including tech, marketing, and sales, to deliver data-driven solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve data processes, reporting, and automation internally and for clients.
Requirements
Hard Skills:
Proven experience in designing and implementing dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, or similar.
Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and modern data stacks.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and SQL proficiency.
Ability to design scalable data architectures and optimize performance across systems.
Demonstrated ability to set up data tracking and analytics for digital transformation use cases.
Soft Skills:
Excellent spoken and written English; able to work closely with international clients.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business goals and turn them into data solutions.
Comfortable leading discovery sessions, presenting insights, and defining success metrics with clients.
Clear, structured communicator who can explain data concepts to non-technical audiences.
Organized and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
Highlights
Lead the data strategy behind impactful digital transformation projects, translating business goals into measurable outcomes through smart KPIs, clear dashboards, and scalable data architecture.

jobs.text:
About Nebius:
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
About Nebius
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The role
Nebius builds the infrastructure serious AI teams run on - GPU clusters, inference runtimes, agent development environments, data pipelines - all of it purpose-built for the most demanding AI workloads. What we are now building is the ecosystem function that ensures the world's best AI companies are successful on Nebius.
As Director of Forward Deployed Engineering, you will build and scale the organization that makes those companies successful on our platform. You will recruit exceptional FDEs, establish the operating model, ensure technical excellence, and turn partner engagements into product improvements and reusable platform assets.
This is not a Sales Engineering leader, Professional Services manager, or traditional Engineering manager role. It sits at the intersection of engineering leadership, AI platform architecture, ecosystem partnerships, and product strategy.
You're welcome to work remotely in the United States.
Your responsibilities will include
Organization Building & Talent
Build, hire, and develop a world-class Forward Deployed Engineering organization across AI applications, inference, infrastructure, and data.
Define the talent bar, team structure, career paths, and leadership expectations for the function.
Coach engineers and managers toward greater independence while maintaining a consistently high technical standard.
Build an organization and leadership system that scales without depending on individual heroics.
Operating Model & Technical Excellence
Establish scalable operating models for partner engagement, technical scoping, architecture reviews, escalation, and delivery health.
Set the technical bar for integrations, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and partner assessments produced by the team.
Review architectures across AI applications, managed inference, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms, bringing in deeper experts where needed.
Balance speed with engineering quality and ensure the team builds production-quality work rather than disposable demonstrations.
Executive & Ecosystem Leadership
Engage credibly with founders, CTOs, senior engineering leaders, and enterprise technical executives as Nebius's senior FDE leader.
Build trusted relationships across AI platforms, cloud providers, ISVs, open source communities, and strategic technology partners.
Represent Forward Deployed Engineering in platform planning, ecosystem strategy, and executive investment decisions.
Create a strong external technical presence through workshops, reference architectures, open source work, events, and developer advocacy.
Field-to-Product & Reusable Leverage
Treat partner engagements as a continuous product discovery engine and convert field learning into roadmap priorities and shipped platform improvements.
Ensure every engagement creates reusable value through platform capabilities, reference architectures, tooling, benchmarks, documentation, or automation.
Prevent the function from becoming one-off consulting work by setting clear boundaries and rewarding reusable outcomes.
Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to close the loop on recurring friction and improve the experience for customers beyond the original engagement.
We expect you to have
12-18+ years of experience across engineering, solutions architecture, customer engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed engineering.
3-7+ years leading technical field organizations, including experience building a new function or materially scaling an existing team.
A strong record of hiring, coaching, and scaling Customer Engineering, FDE, Solutions Architecture, or Field CTO teams.
Earlier hands-on engineering experience in cloud, infrastructure, AI, or developer platforms.
Technical judgment to review and elevate architectures across AI applications, inference, infrastructure, and data platforms.
A proven track record of converting customer and partner feedback into shipped platform improvements.
Executive presence and credibility as a trusted advisor to founders, CTOs, and enterprise technical executives.
Experience leading across cloud providers, AI platforms, ISVs, open source communities, and strategic technology partners.
The ability to hire experts, evaluate their work, and set a high technical standard without needing to be the deepest specialist in every domain.
It will be an added bonus if you have
Strong relationships across the AI and cloud ecosystem.
Public technical leadership through talks, workshops, reference architectures, open source projects, or developer advocacy.
Built a Forward Deployed Engineering, Customer Engineering, or Field Engineering organization from zero to one.
Scaled a technical field organization across regions or ecosystem domains without lowering the hiring or engineering bar.
Experience as a founder, VP Engineering, Field CTO, Head of Customer Engineering, or early FDE leader.
Led production architecture and execution for demanding AI application, training, inference, or platform workloads.
Key Employee Benefits
Health Insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
401(k) Plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
Remote Work Reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
Disability & Life Insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term, and life insurance coverage.
Pay Transparency
We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.
Base Compensation Range: $270,800 - $310,000 USD

Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: VP B2B Product Innovation
jobs.text:
Title: VP, B2B Product Innovation
Desired Location: US Remote
The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.
Meet Nuvei, Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.
At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!
The Vice President, B2B Product Innovation is responsible for driving the vision, development, and commercialization of innovative B2B payment solutions that accelerate growth across embedded payments, ERP integrations, and partner ecosystems. This leader will champion customer-centric product innovation, identify emerging market opportunities, and bring differentiated payment capabilities to market that enhance customer value, increase adoption, and drive revenue growth. The role serves as the bridge between customer needs, market trends, technology capabilities, and commercial outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
· Define and lead Nuvei's B2B product innovation agenda across embedded payments, ERP platforms, and indirect channel ecosystems.
· Identify emerging market trends, customer pain points, and technology opportunities to create next-generation payment solutions.
· Drive ideation, validation, and commercialization of new B2B products, features, and platform capabilities.
· Build and manage an innovation pipeline that delivers differentiated products and sustainable competitive advantage.
· Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Partners to accelerate innovation from concept through launch.
· Develop innovative payment experiences that improve customer adoption, retention, and lifetime value.
· Champion customer-centric product design through direct engagement with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.
· Lead innovation efforts around embedded finance, automation, AI-enabled payments, ERP workflows, and emerging commerce technologies.
· Evaluate build, buy, and partnership opportunities to accelerate product innovation and market expansion.
· Drive product adoption through commercialization strategies, solution packaging, and enablement initiatives.
· Establish innovation KPIs, product success metrics, and portfolio performance reporting.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering Identity Platform
jobs.text:
Location Details: USA Remote
At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.
This position may be a hybrid or fully remote position, as decided by your manager. If designated as hybrid, you’ll divide your time between working remotely from your home and an office location, so you should live within commuting distance. If designated as remote, you’ll be working remotely from your home and may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. Your hiring manager can share more about this role’s hybrid or remote designation.
This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.
GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.
Join our Team
GoDaddy's Identity Platform powers authentication, authorization, and core identity infrastructure, which sits at the heart of how millions of small businesses securely access, manage, and grow their online presence, across our products.
We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this critical platform into its next chapter — driving company-wide adoption of OAuth/OpenID Connect (OIDC) and OpenFGA, strengthening the reliability and security of core identity services, and crafting customer experiences that are flawless, scalable, and trusted.
In this role, you’ll set the technical vision and the execution rhythm for a 50+ person engineering organization. This organization spans the US and India. You will lead through multiple Senior Managers while staying close to the technology. This is a hands-on leadership role — we expect you to code, prototype, run technical experiments, and to lead by example in using AI-assisted development tools.
What you’ll get to do
Own and set the engineering strategy and lead execution for the platforms that power authentication, authorization, and customer profile management across GoDaddy
Lead, mentor, and scale a distributed engineering organization of 50+ engineers across the US and India, including multiple Senior Managers
Stay close to the technology. You’ll contribute hands-on, from prototyping and code review to architecture and design discussions — using your technical depth to build credibility and make sharp technical calls
Champion the effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Copilot, Cursor, in your own work and driving adoption across the organization, or similar, helping your teams increase efficiency while applying good judgment in security-critical environments
Drive company-wide adoption of modern identity and authorization standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect and OpenFGA, partnering across teams to develop migration strategy and influence engineering standards beyond your own organization
Raise the operational bar for critical systems, improving incident response, on-call health, and monitoring for services used across every GoDaddy product
Champion identity experiences (password less, streamlined authorization) that protect customers; balancing strong security with ease of use
Your experience should include…
10+ years' demonstrated ability in software engineering, with recent experience in identity, security, or platform engineering within a global technology environment. Hands on experience driving large-scale technical migrations, platform modernization, or engineering standards adoption across a sophisticated engineering organization
8+ years' proven experience as a people leader, with a track record of leading and scaling engineering organizations of 20+ engineers through multiple layers of management across distributed teams and geographies. An ownership mentality, strong customer advocacy in technical decision-making, and the ability to lead teams optimally through ambiguity
Strong hands-on technical depth across security, identity, access control, or adjacent platform systems, with the ability to deep dive into identity and authorization concepts, write code, prototype, and lead architecture and design reviews
Proficiency in a modern backend language such as Java or Python, with solid understanding of broader modern engineering stacks including React, GraphQL, and AWS; direct experience with OAuth, OIDC, or fine-grained authorization models such as OpenFGA is highly desirable
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools, including a proven track record in driving adoption across engineering teams and apply good judgment around safe use in security-critical contexts

Join our Team

GoDaddy's Identity Platform powers authentication, authorization, and core identity infrastructure, which sits at the heart of how millions of small businesses securely access, manage, and grow their online presence, across our products.

We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this critical platform into its next chapter — driving company-wide adoption of OAuth/OpenID Connect (OIDC) and OpenFGA, strengthening the reliability and security of core identity services, and crafting customer experiences that are flawless, scalable, and trusted.

In this role, you’ll set the technical vision and the execution rhythm for a 50+ person engineering organization. This organization spans the US and India. You will lead through multiple Senior Managers while staying close to the technology. This is a hands-on leadership role — we expect you to code, prototype, run technical experiments, and to lead by example in using AI-assisted development tools.

items: Own and set the engineering strategy and lead execution for the platforms that power authentication, authorization, and customer profile management across GoDaddy
Lead, mentor, and scale a distributed engineering organization of 50+ engineers across the US and India, including multiple Senior Managers

Stay close to the technology. You’ll contribute hands-on, from prototyping and code review to architecture and design discussions — using your technical depth to build credibility and make sharp technical calls

Champion the effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Copilot, Cursor, in your own work and driving adoption across the organization, or similar, helping your teams increase efficiency while applying good judgment in security-critical environments

Drive company-wide adoption of modern identity and authorization standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect and OpenFGA, partnering across teams to develop migration strategy and influence engineering standards beyond your own organization
Raise the operational bar for critical systems, improving incident response, on-call health, and monitoring for services used across every GoDaddy product
Champion identity experiences (password less, streamlined authorization) that protect customers; balancing strong security with ease of use

8+ years' proven experience as a people leader, with a track record of leading and scaling engineering organizations of 20+ engineers through multiple layers of management across distributed teams and geographies. An ownership mentality, strong customer advocacy in technical decision-making, and the ability to lead teams optimally through ambiguity

Strong hands-on technical depth across security, identity, access control, or adjacent platform systems, with the ability to deep dive into identity and authorization concepts, write code, prototype, and lead architecture and design reviews

Proficiency in a modern backend language such as Java or Python, with solid understanding of broader modern engineering stacks including React, GraphQL, and AWS; direct experience with OAuth, OIDC, or fine-grained authorization models such as OpenFGA is highly desirable

Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools, including a proven track record in driving adoption across engineering teams and apply good judgment around safe use in security-critical contexts

Experience leading US/India distributed teams

jobs.title: Senior Director, Revenue Analytics
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Senior Director, Revenue Analytics, you'll lead a high-performing team of analytics professionals and own the strategic vision and execution for sales and customer experience data and analytics across GitLab. You'll serve as a key business partner to executive leadership, using data to shape GitLab's go-to-market strategy, customer experience, and revenue growth throughout the customer lifecycle.
This role combines strategic thinking with operational excellence. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy, Customer Success, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Finance, and Enterprise Data & Analytics to deliver insights that drive business outcomes.
What you’ll do
Lead and develop the Revenue Analytics team, setting analytics standards and building scalable capabilities to support GitLab's growth.
Support AI self-serve initiatives within the Field through certified data sets, coordination with Ent Data on semantic layers and metric definitions.
Lead a team building insights via AI tooling and solutions along with legacy BI solutions.
Own the analytics roadmap across sales, customer success, and professional services to improve sales productivity, retention, services utilization, and revenue performance.
Develop and support forecasting, pipeline, capacity, and predictive models to improve forecast accuracy, conversion, velocity, resource allocation, and revenue planning.
Build customer lifecycle analytics for onboarding, product adoption, engagement, churn risk, expansion, NRR, and GRR to improve customer outcomes.
Provide strategic leadership on the metrics, insights, and data necessary to help the GTM functions migrate to a consumption-based business model.
Create executive artifacts to be used on recurring basis, integrated reporting, attribution models, and strategic analyses that connect acquisition, post-sale, and services performance.
Partner with executive leaders and teams across Revenue Operations, Marketing, Finance, Product, Professional Services, and Enterprise Data & Analytics to turn business questions into clear recommendations.
Establish data governance and reporting frameworks that improve data quality and provide reliable insights for executive, board, and external reporting.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading analytics teams and developing team members in sales, customer, revenue operations, business intelligence, or consulting environments.
Knowledge of business-to-business software-as-a-service business models, sales processes, and revenue metrics across the customer lifecycle.
Experience with consumption-based metrics and business models.
Ability to develop strategic analytics roadmaps, translate complex data into clear insights, and influence executive-level decisions.
Experience with customer success analytics, including health scoring, churn prediction, NRR and GRR analysis, segmentation, and expansion analytics.
Experience with sales and professional services analytics, including forecasting, revenue planning, utilization, project profitability, and services-led growth metrics.
Ability to work with large, complex datasets to develop analytical frameworks that inform resource allocation, capacity planning, and customer outcomes.
Advanced proficiency with AI tools (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), Business Intelligence tools (Tableau, Hex, Omni), Structured Query Language (SQL), data modeling, statistical analysis, and predictive modeling for customer analytics.
Familiarity with customer data platforms, product analytics tools such as Gainsight or Pendo, services management systems, and other business intelligence platforms is a plus.
About the team
The Revenue Analytics team are full-stack analytics business partners who work with stakeholders to turn data into clear insights that help leaders make informed decisions. Members of this team are able to take questions and needs from leadership and create solutions based on analytic engineering, understanding data structure best practices, business intelligence and data visualization work, ad hoc analytics, project management, and AI implementation. They work to define the best solutions by providing the right data in the right format at the right time in a platform agnostic manner. In this role, you'll shape how we operate, develop our capabilities, and ensure our work supports measurable business outcomes.
The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.
United States Salary Range
$203,200—$345,600 USD
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: 4448 -Associate Director- Implementation Engineering
jobs.text:
Engineering at Innovaccer
With every line of code, we accelerate our customers' success, turning complex challenges into innovative solutions. Collaboratively, we transform each data point we gather into valuable insights for our customers. Join us and be part of a team that's turning dreams of better healthcare into reality, one line of code at a time. Together, we’re shaping the future and making a meaningful impact on the world.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly experienced Associate Director, Data Engineering & Analytics - Customer Success to lead our implementation and delivery organization for large health systems, payers, and provider groups. This leader will oversee a 40+ member multi-disciplinary team responsible for onboarding customers onto the Innovaccer platform and ensuring successful deployments with measurable outcomes.
The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of deep healthcare delivery expertise, strong technical grounding in healthcare data standards, proven large-scale delivery leadership, and exceptional operational and financial discipline. You will own end-to-end implementation outcomes, including delivery quality, timelines, data readiness, customer satisfaction, and the financial performance (margins) of the delivery organization.
A Day in the Life
You will lead and execute the enterprise data vision by aligning data strategy with business objectives, architecting scalable cloud-based data platforms, and building high-performing Data Engineering and Analytics teams. You will ensure strong governance, reliability, and cost efficiency while enabling trusted self-service analytics. In close partnership with executive stakeholders, you will translate strategic priorities into impactful data initiatives and support advanced analytics and AI/ML capabilities that drive enterprise-wide decision-making and growth.
Data Strategy & Architecture
Define and execute the company’s data engineering strategy
Design scalable data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, streaming systems)
Oversee cloud data infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Team Leadership
Lead and grow data engineering teams
Hire senior engineers and managers
Establish engineering standards and best practices
Platform & Infrastructure
Oversee ETL/ELT pipelines
Manage real-time and batch processing systems
Ensure reliability, scalability, and security
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Product, and Engineering
Align data architecture with business goals
Support AI/ML and analytics initiatives
Governance & Compliance
Data quality frameworks
Data governance policies
Regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.)
What You Need
12–18 years of experience in healthcare delivery, health IT, population health, or payer/provider operations.
Deep expertise in healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, C-CDA, X12/EDI, Claims, Quality Measures).
Proven success leading large delivery or implementation organizations (30 - 40 people).
Strong financial acumen and experience owning delivery P&L and margin performance.
Experience implementing complex healthcare data platforms, analytics solutions, or clinical systems at enterprise scale.
Executive presence with ability to influence and communicate with customer CXOs.
Demonstrated operational discipline, problem-solving, and accountability mindset.
Experience in high-growth SaaS or healthtech environments.
Familiarity with modern cloud data platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Strong understanding of value-based care, care management, risk adjustment, and quality programs.
Certifications in program management, technical architecture, or healthcare informatics.

jobs.title: Director of ML Engineering - Conversation Product Area
jobs.text:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack.
We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company.
You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.

Job Title: Director of Infrastructure Engineering
Job Type: Full-time
Location: Remote
The Role
We're looking for a Director of Infrastructure Engineering to build and scale the platform that powers production AI systems. You'll own the strategy and execution behind our cloud infrastructure, developer platform, and reliability practices, ensuring our systems remain secure, observable, and resilient as we grow.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys operating at every level—from defining long-term infrastructure strategy to solving production incidents and mentoring high-performing engineers.
What You'll Do
Own the architecture and evolution of our multi-cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP, optimizing for scalability, reliability, security, and cost.
Lead and grow a high-performing Infrastructure/Platform Engineering team while establishing a strong engineering culture centered on ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Build infrastructure as code using Terraform (or equivalent), ensuring reproducible, version-controlled, and auditable environments.
Design and improve CI/CD systems that enable fast, reliable, and secure software delivery.
Build world-class observability across metrics, logs, traces, and alerting to proactively detect and resolve production issues.
Define and drive reliability practices, including incident response, on-call operations, SLOs, error budgets, disaster recovery, and blameless postmortems.
Partner closely with Security and Engineering leadership to embed security by default and maintain compliance with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and CMMC.
Continuously improve the developer experience by reducing operational friction through automation and platform tooling.
What We're Looking For
8+ years building and operating production infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or SRE systems.
3+ years leading engineering teams in high-growth environments.
Deep expertise with AWS, GCP, or multi-cloud production environments.
Strong experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, containers, and modern CI/CD platforms.
Proven experience building highly available, observable, and resilient production systems.
Strong understanding of infrastructure security, compliance, and operational risk management.
Experience scaling engineering organizations and infrastructure in fast-moving startup environments.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical strategy across engineering and executive stakeholders.
Preferred
Experience supporting AI/ML infrastructure or large-scale data platforms.
Familiarity with model training, inference, evaluation, or data pipeline infrastructure.
Experience operating regulated cloud environments such as FedRAMP, GovCloud, or CMMC Level 2.

jobs.title: Lead Manager/Associate Director, Strategy & Analytics (Bangkok-based, Relocation Provided)
jobs.text:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get To Know Our Team:
Strategy & Analytics is a fast-growing and dynamic team within the Strategic Partnerships department of Agoda. Strategic Partnerships is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s non-accommodation partners and promote Agoda’s top and bottom-line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. The Strategy & Analytics team’s scope includes profitability optimization, target setting, KPI management, data analytics, and business strategy.
The Opportunity:
As Lead Manager / Associate Director – Strategy & Analytics, you will lead the data strategy and governance of one of Booking Holdings' most critical initiatives, defining how Agoda, Booking.com, and Priceline collectively measure, interpret, and act on business performance.
Within Booking Holdings, an enhanced and more connected B2B business is being built consolidating the businesses of Booking.com, Priceline and Agoda into a single global division (“New B2B Business”)
You will own a high-visibility, cross-brand program that goes far beyond data management. This initiative shapes how the company defines growth, evaluates profitability, and allocates resources across its portfolio of businesses, with the work you deliver directly informing decisions at the highest levels of the organization.
If you are energized by impact and ready to build something that truly matters, this role is for you.
What You’ll Do:
Lead the design and implementation of a unified data strategy and measurement framework across Agoda, Booking.com, and Priceline, establishing a single source of truth for how the New B2B Business defines, tracks, and acts on performance
Own the data harmonization roadmap from scoping through phased delivery, ensuring alignment on definitions, metrics, and data logic across three distinct brand organizations with differing systems and conventions
Analyze and translate complex data into actionable insights that drive business strategy and enable strategic decision-making
Build and develop a high-performing global team of analysts by setting strategic direction, establishing quality standards, and creating an environment where the team operates with clarity, accountability, and ambition
Collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional global teams across Analytics, Product, Tech, Finance, Legal, etc., to execute on strategic initiatives
Keep leadership informed and aligned by providing rigorous reporting and analysis on strategic initiatives, communicating progress, risks, and recommendations in a clear and structured manner to support data-driven decision-making at the Executive level
Required Qualifications:
7+ years of total professional experience in an analytically rigorous environment; prior experience at a top-tier management consulting firm with demonstrated progression and impact is strongly preferred
Proven experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder projects, owning timelines, deliverables, and executive reporting
A track record of independently structuring and solving complex, ambiguous problems
Strong data literacy and business numeracy, genuinely comfortable interrogating business metrics, evaluating data logic, and translating numbers into meaningful business insights
Prior experience managing and developing a team, with the ability to lead across geographies and functions
Exceptional Executive communication and presentation skills, able to distill complex, nuanced topics into clear, compelling, and actionable narratives
A high-ownership mindset, comfortable with ambiguity, energized by fast-moving environments, and fully accountable for outcomes
Preferred Qualifications:
Proficiency in SQL or data querying tools
Proficiency in Tableau or equivalent BI and visualization platforms
A degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline; an MBA or advanced degree from a top-tier institution is a meaningful plus
Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. jobs.title: Senior Director, Core Infrastructure Engineering - OCI Virtual Networking
jobs.text:
Are you passionate about building cloud infrastructure that powers millions of customers? Do you enjoy leading high-performing engineering organizations that design and operate mission-critical distributed systems at massive scale? Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is looking for an experienced engineering leader to drive the strategy, development, and operations of our Tier-0 Virtual Networking and Identity services.
In this role, you will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for core virtual networking Infrastructure services including, authentication and authorization. These highly available, low-latency services are foundational to the OCI control plane and require exceptional reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
As a Senior Director, you will define the long-term technical vision, influence product strategy, and lead the execution of cloud-scale distributed systems that support Oracle's rapidly growing cloud business. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Security, Networking, and other OCI engineering organizations to deliver innovative capabilities while maintaining the highest standards for availability, security, and customer experience.
Responsibilities
Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for Tier-0 authentication, authorization, and virtual networking services.
Define the technical strategy and roadmap for critical OCI infrastructure services in partnership with Product Management.
Drive the architecture, development, and operation of highly available, secure, and scalable distributed systems.
Establish engineering best practices that improve service reliability, operational excellence, security, and performance.
Collaborate across OCI organizations to deliver integrated cloud networking and security solutions.
Recruit, mentor, and develop engineering managers and senior engineers while building a high-performing engineering culture.
Influence technical direction and strategic decisions across the broader OCI Networking organization.
Represent your organization in executive-level planning, architecture reviews, and customer engagements.

Hello there. We’re Zopa.
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. jobs.title: Vice President – Data Governance
jobs.text:
We are seeking a seasoned leader to drive our enterprise-wide Data Governance strategy and implementation. This role will establish robust governance frameworks, ensure data quality and compliance, and foster a data-driven culture across the organization.
Responsibilities
Lead adoption of the Data Governance Framework, policies, and standards.
Drive initiatives to improve data quality, consistency, security, and compliance.
Facilitate Data Governance Committee meetings and provide oversight to senior leadership.
Define enterprise-wide data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models.
Oversee metadata management, business glossary, data lineage, and lifecycle management.
Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Technology, and business teams to embed governance controls.
Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and internal standards.
Champion governance awareness, training, and onboarding programs.
Monitor KPIs and report governance performance to senior management.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Management, or related field (Master's preferred).
10+ years in Data Governance/Data Management, with 5+ years in leadership.
Strong knowledge of governance frameworks, metadata, lineage, and master data management.
Experience with tools such as Collibra, Informatica, Microsoft Purview, or Alation.
Background in banking/financial services regulations is highly desirable.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills.
Certifications such as CDMP, DAMA, DCAM, or COBIT.
Experience in digital transformation or enterprise data modernization.
Knowledge of data privacy and risk governance in financial services.
