Job Description
Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Patient-Centered Research (PCR) group helps sponsors to integrate the patient voice in all relevant healthcare decisions, from development over regulatory to reimbursement and product launch. For that, PCR uses a unique combination of scientific fields, including health sciences, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, health economics and others. Our work has helped identify and clarify unmet clinical needs, assess burden of illness and evaluate patient outcomes, preference and/or adherence, while supporting promotional and labeling claims on a global scale.
The Senior Director of Qualitative Data Collection and Analysis (QDA) is primarily responsible for the collection, organization and analysis of qualitative data on PCR projects, including: moderation of interviews and focus groups, management of vendors for dedicated qualitative research services, oversight of qualitative research technologies (incl., AI-enabled solutions), and qualitative data analysis. As part of this remit the Senior Director will be responsible for leading the development, improvement and implementation of quality and compliance assurance processes. The aim of this exciting role is to build a best-in-class qualitative research center of excellence that supports our scientific solution teams with its methodological expertise.
This role is critical for our mission to provide a full suite of services and offerings to achieve patient focused drug development.
What You’ll Do:
Develop and implement annual QDA business plans, including identifying and implementing a best-in-class qualitative delivery model.
Monitor industry developments to ensure the team has access to best-in-class capabilities.
Collaborate with all PCR solution teams (i.e., clinical outcomes assessment, in-trial research, patient preferences, real-world experience and insights) to ensure the successful design and delivery of projects.
Manage staff, including interviewing and selection, job description preparation, professional development, goal setting, performance management and any other tasks associated with staff functions and management
Drive thought leadership to ensure continuous scientific improvement
Support opportunity management to optimize win rates, including leading the development of qualitative research strategies to meet client needs, and ensuring these are appropriately represented in proposals
Oversee the delivery of qualitative components of PCR studies, including qualitative data collection (incl., moderation), data management, and data analysis
Collaborate with external and internal vendors that support PCR with dedicated qualitative research services
Manage qualitative research technologies for data collection and analysis (incl., AI enablement)
Work with relevant internal stakeholders to develop, manage, improve and implement qualitative research standards and processes
Education and Experience:
PhD, Master’s or Bachelor’s (PhD preferred)
At least 12 years of qualitative research leadership in a relevant field with a track record of scientific outputs
Knowledge, Skills,and Abilities:
Deep and demonstrated understanding of patient centered research, including a demonstrated knowledge of GCP and awareness of working in a regulatory environment.
Ability to develop business strategies and plans.
Understanding of budgeting and forecasting with the ability to interpret data with attention to detail
Proven ability to lead a team to deliver high quality scientific deliverables
Demonstrated ability to delegate effectively
Strong interpersonal, organizational, communication and staff management skills and experience required
Ability to work in a cross functional team
Ability to communicate complex information and ideas so that others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences
Tact and sensitivity in matters relating to confidential material.
Fluency in written and oral English
Why Join Us?
When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.
Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthrough.

jobs.title: Head of Product - Central Europe
jobs.text:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best-in-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.
Ready to take your career global?
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Head of Product, Central Europe to join our ever evolving SMB Product team within Global Payments and help shape the future of global commerce.
This senior leadership role is accountable for defining and delivering the Central Europe SMB solutions strategy across Joint Venture partnerships. You will work through influence across a complex partner ecosystem, aligning Global Payments, JV partners, EU market leadership, and global product and technology teams around clear priorities, funded roadmaps, and sustainable commercial outcomes.
What you’ll own
Define and lead the Central Europe SMB solutions strategy across Joint Venture partnerships, translating customer needs, market insights, competitive trends, and platform opportunities into a clear 3 to 5-year product vision that supports sustainable growth across the region.
Establish and drive strong governance frameworks across Global Payments and JV partners, ensuring alignment on product priorities, investment decisions, roadmap execution, funding models, and expected business outcomes.
Own the product roadmap and prioritisation process, balancing strategic objectives, commercial impact, customer value, technology capacity, and partner-specific requirements to maximise overall portfolio performance.
Build alignment across product, technology, commercial, and executive stakeholders, proactively managing dependencies, resolving competing priorities, and influencing decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
Ensure product initiatives deliver measurable business impact by connecting delivery outcomes to revenue growth, market expansion, customer success, operational efficiency, and long-term value creation for both Global Payments and JV partners.
What you’ll bring
15+ years of product leadership experience delivering end-to-end product strategy, development, and lifecycle management within payments, fintech, banking, software platforms, commerce technology, or similarly complex industries, with a strong track record of translating market opportunities into scalable product solutions.
Proven ability to lead through influence in complex, matrixed, and multi-entity environments, aligning product, technology, commercial, and executive stakeholders around shared objectives and driving outcomes without direct authority.
Extensive experience in product governance, roadmap prioritisation, and portfolio management, including balancing strategic objectives, managing cross-functional dependencies, navigating investment trade-offs, and ensuring successful execution across multiple businesses, markets, or partners.
Strong commercial acumen and partnership leadership, with experience developing business cases, connecting product investments to revenue outcomes, managing portfolio performance, and successfully collaborating with Joint Ventures, strategic partners, or other complex stakeholder ecosystems.
Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, combined with a people-first, high-accountability mindset, enabling the development of trusted relationships, effective decision-making, and successful collaboration across countries, cultures, and organisational boundaries.
It’s a bonus if you have
Experience working within Joint Ventures, strategic partnerships, or other multi-entity environments, with an understanding of complex governance structures, funding models, and stakeholder management requirements.
Strong knowledge of payment ecosystems, fintech, banking, commerce technology, or SMB-focused solutions, with the ability to connect market opportunities to product strategy and execution.
Experience operating across multiple countries and markets, balancing local customer and partner requirements with broader regional or global product objectives.
Familiarity with API-first platforms, target architecture models, platform modernisation initiatives, and scalable product delivery approaches that support long-term business growth.
Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a proven ability to align diverse executive stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and drive outcomes without direct authority.
About the team
Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
What makes a Globalpayer?
Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Real World Data (RWD)
jobs.text:
About this opportunity:
As the Senior Director of Real World Data (RWD), you will be accountable for defining, developing, and implementing our RWD strategy, platform, and data pipeline to transform diverse real-world datasets into regulatory-grade, research-ready assets that drive our clinical development, evidence generation, digital health products and product offerings. You will play a key role informing regulatory decisions, improving clinical trial efficiency, evaluating and implementing AI/agentic workflows to strengthen our RWD platform and help bridge the gap between clinical research and medical practice to improve patient outcomes and advance our vision of a world without disease.
The Senior Director will lead all informatics aspects of developing and maintaining a “regulatory-grade” RWD pipeline. Specifically, the Senior Director will lead the RWD Informatics team in turning electronic health records (EHR), claims, imaging, and other RWD sources into research-ready datasets accessible by our biostatisticians,computational scientists and other end users while ensuring data quality, operational efficiency, and scalability.
These efforts will contribute to developing and commercializing a portfolio of early cancer detection products — based on both clinical and multiomics data — and digital health solutions that will enable payers, providers, and patients to catch cancers early when curative intervention is most achievable.
The role reports to the Chief Product Officer. This role will be a Remote role.
What you’ll do:
Lead the operations and continuous improvement of our RWD curation pipeline, managing internal and external resources as needed. Evaluate and integrate agentic workflows and AI to ensure accuracy, augment the interpretability and quality, and drive efficiencies across our RWD efforts. This includes:
Designing and implementing processes, analytical methods, and AI tools to integrate a variety of RWD sources.
Preparing data for analysis, including data cleaning and mapping.
Ensuring “regulatory-grade” data quality where required.
Developing a scalable unstructured data curation operation, leveraging automation as much as possible and only transiently leveraging manual techniques with a roadmap towards eliminating these steps as appropriate.
Create a comprehensive, multi-year strategy for the acquisition, management, curation, and use of RWD to support regulatory submissions, clinical evidence generation, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), and commercial efforts such as patient identification and care navigation.
Architect, build, and maintain a robust, efficient, and scalable RWD platform and pipeline capable of ingesting, linking, harmonizing, and curating large, complex, and disparate real-world datasets such as Electronic Health Records (EHRs), claims data, imaging, and registries of structured and unstructured data.
Lead clinical data analyses to support product strategy, development and commercialization to improve Freenome’s access to RWD and enhance future product offerings for HCOs.
Serve as the RWD expert, proactively collaborating with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Engineering, Science and Product and Commercial teams to ensure the RWD pipeline meets diverse end-user needs, clinical, scientific and commercial objectives.
Contribute to defining the strategic direction of Freenome's data initiatives, in partnership with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Support data acquisition by conducting technical due diligence, facilitating data acquisition agreements and defining data delivery specifications and lead data product implementation efforts into Freenome’s platforms with strategic partners and customers.
Oversee the translation of raw RWD datasets into research-ready, regulatory-grade datasets, following OMOP or other industry-standard models, suitable for rigorous statistical analysis and real-world evidence (RWE) generation.
Foster a quality mindset through data quality checks, governance policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure the integrity, privacy, security, and traceability of all RWD assets to meet regulatory requirements.
Develop the team, building technical and leadership capabilities and coaching for high-performance proficiency.
Directly lead a team of clinical informaticists and data analysts through clear direction and priorities and hands-on management to enable focused execution in alignment with company objectives.
Manage the RWD department budget, ensuring efficient resource utilization and allocation of expenditures.
Build and maintain a culture of collaboration and inclusivity both within RWD and cross-functionally across Freenome.
Must haves:
Master’s or Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Health Informatics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
At least 12 years of progressive experience in clinical informatics, including experience with:
EHR, claims, other structured and unstructured RWD, and molecular data.
Applying RWD to device, therapeutic and/or software product development.
RWD across multiple disease areas, including oncology.
At least 10 years of experience building and leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary teams.
Demonstrated success operating within a matrixed organization and proactively collaborating with teams of internal and external partners to guide product delivery from concept to completion.
Passion for getting in the trenches, leading by example, and scaling technical platforms and teams.
Excellent written and verbal communicator with strong stakeholder management capabilities and problem-solving skills.
Experience leading data modeling, terminology normalization, data curation and/or unstructured data abstraction via natural language processing (NLP).
Deep knowledge of ontologies commonly used by health systems and payers (ICD-10, HCPCS, CPT, LOINC, RxNorm).
Experience with Python, R, and/or SQL.
Nice to haves:
Experience supporting real-world evidence FDA submissions or payer/guideline dossiers.
Clinical background (MD, NP, RN, or similar) and/or degree in health informatics.
Experience with cloud-based data storage and processing environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP).
Experience working directly with health systems or data vendors on data licensing and ingestion projects.
Benefits and additional information:
The US target range of our base salary rate for new hires is $236,300 - $335,475. You will also be eligible to receive equity, cash bonuses, and a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits depending on the position offered. Please note that individual total compensation for this position will be determined at the Company’s sole discretion and may vary based on several factors, including but not limited to, location, skill level, years and depth of relevant experience, and education. We invite you to check out our career page @ for additional company information.
Freenome is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, and we value diversity. Freenome does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Technology (m/f/x)
jobs.text:
Cara Care is a leading German digital therapeutics company and part of Bayer, combining the agility of a growth-stage health tech company with the backing, scale, and credibility of a global healthcare leader. We build DiGA-listed products that deliver measurable clinical outcomes for patients and integrate deeply into the German healthcare system. Our ambition is to become a category leader in digital care by bringing together evidence-based medicine, outstanding user engagement, and scalable, compliant technology - while shaping how digital therapeutics connect to national health infrastructure and care delivery.
We are looking for a Head of Product & Technology (m/f/x) to support us in our mission with immediate effect. In this role, you will be a key member of the Cara Care leadership team and report directly to the Managing Director of Cara Care. You will own the combined product and technology agenda across our DiGA products for IBS and GERD as well as our R&D portfolio. Your mission is to build a clinically effective, user-centric, compliant, and scalable digital therapeutics platform that strengthens Cara Care’s position as a category leader in digital care.
You combine product leadership, technical depth, and regulated healthcare expertise. You set direction, create focus, build strong teams, and ensure that product discovery, engineering delivery, data/AI capabilities, and compliance requirements work together effectively.

jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.text:
Sobre a Clicksign
Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.
Como trabalhamos:
Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.
Descrição da vaga
Estamos em busca de um(a)Diretor(a) de Tecnologia, que fará parte da liderança executiva da empresa, atuando em parceria com Produto e demais áreas do Negócio, para acelerar a execução da estratégia da companhia, no âmbito da Tecnologia e Inteligência Artificial. Procuramos uma liderança capaz de construir uma organização de Tecnologia de alta performance; desenvolver pessoas, incluindo lideranças; e preparar o time para escalar de forma sustentável. Seu dia a dia contará com:
Definir e executar a estratégia de Tecnologia, garantindo uma plataforma moderna, escalável, resiliente e preparada para o crescimento da empresa.
Desenvolver e potencializar as lideranças de Tecnologia, formando sucessores e construindo uma organização capaz de escalar de forma sustentável.
Atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, fortalecendo uma cultura de alta performance, autonomia, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo.
Liderar a evolução da empresa para uma organização AI-First, incorporando Inteligência Artificial aos produtos, processos e ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.
Garantir o alinhamento entre Tecnologia, Produto e Negócio, transformando estratégia em execução consistente e geração de valor para clientes e empresa.
Promover excelência técnica por meio de práticas modernas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento de software, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, SRE, Observabilidade e Continuous Delivery.
Gerenciar Tecnologia como um portfólio de investimentos, equilibrando inovação, evolução da plataforma, dívida técnica, segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência operacional.
Gerenciar orçamento, infraestrutura e decisões estratégicas de investimento, buscando o melhor equilíbrio entre custo, inovação e crescimento.
Experiência
Experiência consolidada em posições executivas de Tecnologia.
Histórico na construção e escalabilidade de organizações de Tecnologia de alta performance.
Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de líderes, formação de sucessores e evolução organizacional.
Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, liderando plataformas de alta escala e produtos digitais.
Experiência atuando em parceria com Produto e áreas de negócio na definição e execução de estratégias corporativas.
Qualificações técnicas
Sólido conhecimento em arquitetura de software, sistemas distribuídos e cloud computing.
Sólida experiência com Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, SRE, Observabilidade e Continuous Delivery.
Conhecimento em métricas de engenharia, como DORA, SPACE e Flow Metrics.
Experiência na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial para ganho de produtividade, automação e inovação.
Vivência em gestão financeira de Tecnologia, orçamento e alocação estratégica de investimentos.
Competências
Capacidade comprovada de desenvolver líderes e construir organizações de alta performance.
Visão estratégica e forte orientação para resultados.
Excelente comunicação e influência junto à liderança executiva.
Pensamento sistêmico para equilibrar inovação, velocidade, qualidade e eficiência.
Perfil colaborativo, com foco em desenvolvimento organizacional e cultura.
Diferenciais
Experiência em empresas SaaS, B2B ou B2B2C de alto crescimento.
Vivência em transformação organizacional e modernização tecnológica.
Experiência na implementação de estratégias AI-First.
Conhecimento em Engineering Economics e gestão de portfólio de investimentos.
Informações adicionais
O que você pode esperar da gente?
Trabalho 100% remoto.
Cultura de confiança, focada em resultados e com muito desafio e aprendizado.
Autonomia e protagonismo, em um ambiente cheio de colaboração e empatia.
Cultura de feedback e 1:1 com uma liderança humana e sem microgerenciamento.
Benefícios completos como: vale refeição/alimentação, auxílios creche, home office, saúde, educação e cultura, gympass, day-off de aniversário, descontos em terapia e cursos de inglês, entre outras parcerias.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
We are building a Digital Concierge Platform for 2–4 star hotels that transforms every hotel room into a digital sales channel for local services. Guests discover and book experiences, wellness, dining, and more via a simple QR code—while hotels unlock new revenue streams without additional operational effort.
The founding team consists of two experienced and successful entrepreneurs with a strong track record in building and scaling companies.
Our next step: build the MVP → launch pilot hotels and partners → raise seed funding.
Your Role
As CTO, you are a technical co-founder responsible for building the entire platform—from architecture to launch.
You will work directly with the founders and have full ownership of the product and tech vision.
Tasks
Your Mission (0–6 months)
Phase 1: MVP (0–3 months)
Define and build the technical architecture
Develop a mobile-first web or app MVP
Implement core features:
QR-based entry experience
Location-based content delivery
Booking and payment flows (via APIs)
Rapid iteration with real pilot customers
Phase 2: Validation & Fundraising
Stabilize and scale the platform
Integrate initial partners (via APIs or manual onboarding)
Support technical due diligence with investors
Requirements
Strong full-stack engineering background (e.g., React / Next.js / Node / Python or
similar)
Proven experience building MVPs and scalable platforms
Product mindset—you think in solutions, not just features
Ideally experience with:
Marketplace models
Booking and payment integrations
Location-based services
Hands-on builder mentality with the ability to scale into a leadership role
Startup mindset: speed over perfection
Benefits
What We Offer
Equity-based co-founder role
Opportunity to build a globally scalable product from scratch
Close collaboration with experienced serial entrepreneurs
Clear vision with a strong, revenue-driven business model
Compensation
No salary for the first 3–4 months
Focus: build MVP & secure funding
Salary and team expansion after successful fundraising
Why This Is Exciting
Large, clearly defined global market (hotels worldwide)
Immediate monetization potential (commission-based model)
Not a “nice-to-have,” but a revenue engine for hotels
Strong go-to-market strategy (QR + co-branding + local partnerships)

jobs.title: Director of Product, EQA
jobs.text:
Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) is seeking a Director of Product to lead and scale a high-performing product organization responsible for both defining the future of our portfolio growth investments and delivering strong in-market performance today.
In this role, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle of hardware and software products in the healthcare equipment quality assurance market. You will lead a team of Product Managers and Product Planners to ensure clear decisions on what to build, when to build it, and how to win in-market.
You will operate at both the strategic and business operations level, balancing long-term growth strategy with near-term results and influencing key stakeholders across the organization. Success in this role requires the ability to drive transformation, scale teams and processes, and consistently deliver measurable business outcomes.
Who You Are
Product leader with a demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels across a complex portfolio
Strong decision-maker who drives clarity on investment priorities, portfolio tradeoffs, and resource allocation
Builder of high-performing and engaged teams
results oriented leader, focused on driving growth, profitability, and competitive advantage
Influential communicator who can align senior stakeholders on a path for action
Key Responsibilities Portfolio Leadership & Business Performance
Own the end-to-end performance of the product portfolio, including revenue, margin, growth, and competitive positioning
Drive strategic alignment between maximizing new product introductions and sustaining investments across product lines.
Establish accountability for delivering business outcomes across the organization
Ensure data-driven and financially grounded roadmap decisions through innovation funnel stage gate processes
Product Strategy & Innovation Oversight
Lead front-end innovation and product planning, ensuring focus on high-impact opportunities
Drive use of market insights, Voice of Customer, and competitive intelligence in decisions
Oversee product strategies, business cases, and portfolio roadmaps
Drive enterprise-level prioritization and tradeoff decisions
Portfolio Execution & Lifecycle Management
Ensure successful execution of price changes, launching new products, and end-of-life transitions
Ensure timely investment required to sustain mature product lines
Ensure responsiveness to market and competitive dynamics
Team Leadership & Organizational Development
Lead, coach, and develop Product Managers and Product Planners
Evolve product organization structure to support scale and growth for hardware and software products
Establish clear expectations, metrics, and development pathways for your team
Build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Cross-Functional Leadership & Operating Cadence
Partner with Sales, Marketing, R&D, Operations, and Quality to achieve business outcomes
Drive consistent operating cadence across teams including portfolio management and operations reviews
Align priorities, tradeoffs, and execution plans
Represent product leadership in executive forums
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of product management or portfolio leadership experience
Proven track record of delivering results through a team in a matrix org structure
Experience across strategy, product development, and business operations processes
Ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders
Growth mindset and adaptability
Preferred
MBA or equivalent strategic leadership experience
Experience in biomedical, healthcare, or technical product markets
Experience with continuous improvement tools and methodologies
Key Skills & Attributes
Strong portfolio leadership and business ownership mindset
Ability to integrate strategy and execution
Strong decision-making under ambiguity
Organizational leadership and team-building skills
Results-oriented with focus on business outcomes
What Success Looks Like
Lead and develop a high-performing product organization
Strong revenue growth, margin, and competitiveness in the marketplace
Robust pipeline of innovation opportunities
Aligned and well-executed product strategies that incorporate hardware and software
Effective product launches and product lifecycle management
Fortive Corporation Overview
Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.
We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.
We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.
At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.
At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.
At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.
Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.
About Fluke Health Solutions
Comprised of four industry leaders—Fluke Biomedical, LANDAUER, RaySafe, and Victoreen — Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) leads the biomedical and radiation detection markets with innovative products and services that help keep customers, patients, and clients safe.Fluke Biomedical leads the world in manufacturing biomedical test equipment like defibrillator analyzers and digital pressure meters. LANDAUER measures radiation exposure with dosimeter and radiation monitoring badges. RaySafe is the worldwide leader of X-ray test equipment, real-time staff dosimetry, and radiation survey meters. And Victoreen instruments are the trusted source for radiation monitoring systems and quality assurance for nuclear power professionals.At FHS, we believe in your potential — your ability to learn, grow and contribute in meaningful ways. And we believe in giving you the opportunity, accountability, and visibility to do just that.
We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Fortive and all Fortive Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at .
Bonus or Equity
This position is also eligible for bonus as part of the total compensation package.
Pay Range
The salary range for this position (in local currency) is 133,600.00 - 248,500.00

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
About TMGM
TMGM is a leading global CFD trading provider with a strong international presence across three continents. As the Official Regional Online Forex and Trading Partner of Chelsea FC in Asia Pacific, we are committed to strengthening our global brand through strategic partnerships, innovation, and exceptional client experiences.
We are looking for a bilingual Product Director to lead our Sales and Client Portals across APAC. You will drive product strategy, cross-functional delivery and data-led growth while exploring AI opportunities to improve client and internal user experiences. Experience in financial services or trading is highly valued.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Strategy and Delivery
• Own the product roadmaps for the Sales Portal and Client Portal, prioritising initiatives to maintain alignment with business objectives and evolving user needs.
• Develop a strong understanding of data flows and functional integrations across the Sales Portal, Client Portal, CRM, middleware and data platforms; identify experience gaps and optimisation opportunities.
• Translate growth objectives and user insights into clear product specifications and executable delivery plans.
2. Requirements Definition and Product Delivery
• Conduct in-depth research into the needs of retail trading clients and internal teams, including Sales, Customer Service, Operations and Marketing, and produce high-quality PRDs and functional specifications.
• Partner closely with Design, Engineering, QA and Data teams to manage the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery to launch, ensuring delivery quality and momentum.
• Lead backlog management and prioritisation decisions, and coordinate sprint planning, iteration reviews and releases across teams.
3. Data-Driven Product Growth
• Establish core metrics across product modules and regularly review user behaviour, conversion funnels, retention and lifetime value.
• Lead A/B testing and product experimentation, using data to continuously optimise features and user experience.
• Advance data-product capabilities supporting BI reporting, user segmentation, personalisation and recommendation use cases.
4. AI and Emerging Technology
• Identify and validate AI and machine-learning opportunities in trading products, such as intelligent notifications, risk-support tools, customer-service automation and personalised market information.
• Collaborate with technology teams to understand the boundaries of web, mobile and data platforms, ensuring product designs are feasible, scalable and maintainable.
5. Cross-Functional Leadership and Communication
• Act as the key product representative across Business, Compliance, Technology and Marketing, establishing clear communication mechanisms and aligning cross-functional goals.
• Understand how regulatory requirements, including ASIC, MAS and FSA obligations, affect product design and delivery.
• Communicate effectively in English and Chinese and support product collaboration across APAC markets and cultures.

jobs.title: Director of AI & Data Platform
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
The Position
OPSWAT is building the internal AI & Data platform that will power every non-engineering function at the company — Finance, HR, Legal, Sales Ops, Marketing, CX, IT, Security, and Supply Chain. We are not buying our way out of this problem with off-the-shelf SaaS; we are building it ourselves, with AI-accelerated development, and we need a leader to own the foundation.
As Director of AI Platform & Data, you will own the AI Platform pillar end-to-end and be accountable to executive leadership for its outcomes. You will run the connective tissue that makes company-wide AI enablement real: the MCP servers and gateway, the agent runtime and orchestration layer, the AI-native data platform that feeds them, the analytics layer that surfaces insight through conversation rather than dashboards, and the governance framework that keeps it all safe. You will lead a multi-team organization, make the platform decisions, set the technical and product direction, and represent this pillar to the CEO, COO, and senior leadership. This role is for someone who thinks like a founder, builds like an engineer, and leads like an operator — someone ready to run an org, not assist in running one.
What You Will Be Doing
Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the AI Platform & Data pillar end-to-end: MCP servers, agent runtime and orchestration framework, AI-native data platform, analytics products, and governance.
Scale and lead a multi-team organization spanning Orchestration, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Governance; recruit, mentor, and develop engineering managers and technical leads — and raise the bar on the leaders you inherit.
Build the AI-native data platform — a foundation with CDC pipelines, a semantic layer designed for LLM consumption, lineage, freshness SLAs, and a quality framework that makes agent outputs trustworthy by default.
Reinvent the analytics function. Move the company from static dashboards to agent-driven insights: natural-language analytics, autonomous deep-dives, anomaly detection, and proactive surfacing of business signals to the teams that need them.
Define and enforce the architectural patterns that let product teams across Finance, HR, Legal, CX, Supply Chain, and GTM Systems ship AI-powered internal workflows on the shared platform — without rebuilding plumbing every time.
Own OPSWAT’s private LLM strategy and operating model, including model selection, fine-tuning and post-training, secure deployment, inference infrastructure, evaluation, observability, and lifecycle management. Build private models that can power internal agents, AI-assisted SDLC, and sensitive-data workflows where public or externally hosted models are not appropriate.
Establish the architecture and decision framework for routing workloads between OPSWAT-hosted models and approved external foundation models based on data classification, security requirements, latency, quality, and cost.
Build and govern the training and evaluation data pipelines required to improve OPSWAT’s private models, including dataset curation, anonymization, access controls, versioning, benchmarking, red-team testing, and protection against data leakage.
Partner with Security, Engineering, Legal, and Product teams to define private-model use cases across secure coding, internal knowledge retrieval, cybersecurity analysis, operational agents, and regulated or customer-sensitive workflows.
Eliminate shadow IT by making the platform the obvious choice: design MCP servers, data connectors, and agent primitives that are faster, safer, and easier than DIY alternatives.
Establish the governance framework — model access, data classification, audit, evaluation, cost controls — that lets the company adopt AI broadly without compromising security or compliance.
Drive a development culture that runs ahead of the industry curve on agentic coding, AI-assisted SDLC, and internal tooling velocity — the platform team should be the most productive engineering team in the company.
Represent the pillar to executive leadership, business function heads, and external partners; own the narrative, the roadmap, and the results.
What We Need From You
10+ years in software, data, or platform engineering, with 6+ years leading engineering teams and at least 2 years managing managers.
Demonstrated track record building and shipping platform products at scale — internal developer platforms, AI/ML infrastructure, modern data platforms, or equivalent.
Deep hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack: LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), MCP, prompt engineering, and evaluation/observability.
Hands-on understanding of private LLM deployment and optimization, including open-weight models, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, quantization, inference serving, GPU infrastructure, model evaluation, and secure model operations.
Experience designing hybrid AI architectures that intelligently route requests between private models and commercial foundation models while maintaining security, quality, latency, and cost controls.
Strong data engineering and analytics foundation: lakehouse architectures (Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake), CDC, streaming, dbt-style transformation, semantic layers, and analytics-grade data quality. You have built data platforms that serve both humans and machines.
Security and governance mindset — you have built systems that needed to pass audit, not just demos.
Proven ability to partner with non-technical business functions and translate ambiguous requirements into platform capabilities.
An innovator’s instinct paired with an operator’s discipline: you bring ideas to the table proactively, then ship them with rigor.
Excellent written and verbal communication; you can hold the room with the CEO and pair-program with an IC in the same week.
It Would Be Nice If You Had
Background in cybersecurity, critical infrastructure, or another regulated industry.
Experience fine-tuning or post-training open-weight models for enterprise, cybersecurity, software engineering, or domain-specific use cases.
Familiarity with private inference platforms and tooling such as vLLM, SGLang, Hugging Face, NVIDIA NIM, Kubernetes-based GPU serving, or equivalent technologies.
Experience automating revenue operations, finance, HR, or legal workflows through AI.
Familiarity with SugarCRM, Salesforce, or comparable enterprise system metadata and integration patterns.
Experience standing up MCP servers, agent infrastructure, or AI gateways in production.
A point of view on how AI is changing the way internal engineering teams ship software, and how to bring that perspective to a 700+ person company.

All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management
jobs.text:
About Us
CipherHealth is an award winning software company committed to enhancing care coordination and outcomes across the continuum. Since 2009, CipherHealth’s automated, scalable platform has empowered healthcare organizations to engage patients and care teams at every touchpoint, streamlining workflows and improving experiences. With tailored communication solutions powered by AI and deep integrations, CipherHealth drives better clinical results, operational efficiency, and financial sustainability, transforming healthcare one interaction at a time.
About the Role
We're looking for a Vice President of Product Management to lead our product organization and set the strategy, vision, and roadmap for our portfolio. You will own product outcomes end to end, from discovery and definition through delivery and iteration, while partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to bring products to market that customers love and that drive measurable business results.
What makes this role different is how we do product management? You will build, operate, and coach a product organization where AI agents handle much of the analytical and synthesis heavy-lifting, freeing our team to focus on customer empathy, strategic judgment, and cross-functional alignment. The ideal candidate pairs deep, traditional product management craft with an agentic mindset: someone who thinks about product management as a system of humans and agents working in a loop, and who is as comfortable running a quarterly roadmap review as designing an agent workflow.
Core Product Management Responsibilities
Set product vision and strategy. Define a compelling, differentiated product vision and translate it into a clear, prioritized multi-quarter strategy aligned to company goals.
Own the roadmap. Build and maintain roadmaps grounded in customer needs, market opportunity, and business value; communicate them clearly to stakeholders and executives.
Drive discovery and validation. Champion continuous customer discovery, user research, and data-informed decision-making to identify the right problems to solve.
Define requirements. Author and oversee crisp PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria; ensure a well-groomed, prioritized backlog.
Lead go-to-market. Partner with Marketing, Sales, and CS on positioning, pricing, packaging, launch, and adoption.
Measure and iterate. Define success metrics and OKRs, instrument products, and use quantitative and qualitative signals to guide the roadmap.
Manage the product lifecycle. Balance new bets, growth initiatives, technical investment, and maintenance across the portfolio.
Build and lead the team. Hire, mentor, and grow product managers; establish a healthy, high-performing product culture and craft.
What You'll Own
1. Build and Operate the Agentic PM Loop
You will stand up and continuously improve a fleet of product-analyst agents that augment the entire product team. These agents should be able to:
Summarize support tickets into digestible themes and severity signals
Cluster feature requests across channels to surface demand patterns
Watch competitors and flag meaningful moves, launches, and positioning shifts
Analyze churn to explain why customers leave, not just how many
Identify customer pain themes from unstructured feedback across sources
Summarize sales calls and Gong calls into structured insights and objections
Monitor usage analytics to detect adoption, friction, and drop-off signals
Generate weekly opportunity reports that synthesize the above into prioritized bets
Draft first-pass PRDs so humans start from a strong draft rather than a blank page
You own the quality, reliability, and evolution of this "Product Analyst" agent layer. You treat it as a product in its own right, defining requirements, measuring accuracy and adoption, and iterating on the leverage it creates for the team. The agentic loop doesn't replace product craft; it accelerates discovery, sharpens prioritization, and gives your PMs more time for strategy and customers.
2. Run the Product Council System
Product decisions at our company happen through Product Councils, and you are the steward of this operating model.
Each product has a recurring Product Council that runs Epic and Sprint planning for its area.
Each council produces a roadmap for its area, grounded in customer discovery, business value, and the outputs of the agentic PM loop.
You ensure councils are well-run, cross-functional, decisions are evidence-based, and priorities ladder up to company strategy.
3. Chair the Strategic Product Council
You lead the Strategic Product Council, the body that sits above the individual councils and sets company-level product direction.
Approves the roadmaps produced by each Product Council.
Allocates resources across our various Threads (strategic investment areas), making the hard trade-offs about where the company invests for maximum return.
The Team
You will lead a lean, high-leverage product organization:
VP, Product (you) — sets the product vision and strategy, runs the Strategic Product Council, and is accountable for the overall product portfolio and its outcomes.
You manage the agentic PM loop across all products, owning the agents, their outputs, and how they plug into the council system.
You coach the team on our process and on product craft—teaching PMs how to run discovery, write great PRDs, prioritize ruthlessly, work effectively alongside agents, run councils, and produce roadmaps that survive strategic review.
What Success Looks Like
A clear, trusted product vision and strategy that the company rallies behind.
Roadmaps that are evidence-based, customer-driven, and clearly tied to resourced Threads.
Products that ship on a healthy cadence and move the metrics that matter (adoption, retention, revenue).
The agentic PM loop reliably shortens the path from signal to decision.
Product Councils run crisply, with genuine cross-functional engagement from Sales and CS.
A strong, growing product team that excels at both classic PM craft and our agent-augmented process.
What We're Looking For
Proven product leadership. 10+ years in product management with several years leading and scaling product teams; a track record of shipping products customers love.
Product craft. Deep fluency in discovery, prioritization frameworks, roadmapping, PRD writing, metrics/OKRs, and the full product lifecycle.
Strategic judgment. You make and defend hard resource-allocation and trade-off decisions across competing priorities.
Agentic mindset. You believe AI agents change how product work gets done, and you have hands-on instincts for designing agent workflows—defining requirements, evaluating outputs, and iterating on quality.
Cross-functional leadership. You bring Sales, CS, Engineering, Design, and Marketing together and hold them to a high bar.
Customer and data obsession. You ground decisions in customer insight and data, not opinion.
Coach and multiplier. You grow the people and the process around you.
How We Invest In You
Healthcare that begins on your first day:
Generous company-funding of our health, vision, and dental plans
HSA/FSA plans
Short and Long-Term Disability
Life and Personal Accident Insurance
$40 monthly wellness stipend you can use towards any wellness, fitness, and wellbeing purchases
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Adoption Assistance
Retirement: 401(k) at three months of employment — with a match upon enrollment!
Time away:
Discretionary PTO + 13 paid holidays
Parenthood: Competitive paid parental leave and flexible return to work policy
Recognition:
Generous Employee Referral Program - earn cash for each employee referral that is hired
Yearly Cipher-versary stipend
Ci-Phives - receive public kudos and gift cards from peers and managers
Culture:
CARE2 Values
Monthly All Teams Meetings
Employee Resource Groups such as Rainbow Room and BIPOC Group
Internal Webinars and robust onboarding / training programs
Remote-first team: $50 per month reimbursement in your check for WFH expenses
You’ll receive a new Macbook laptop, other hardware, and company swag upon hire

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
Description
MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.
We are seeking a VP of Product to lead our entire product & engineering organisation. This is one of the most expansive and demanding product leadership roles you will find in the market: the person in this role will own PM, Engineering, Design, Data, and PMM under a single umbrella — a scope typically reserved for C-suite executives at much larger companies.
The organisation you will lead includes 1 Director of Product, 8 PMs, 1 Director of UX & Design, 3 Designers, 1 Director of Data & Analytics, 6 data analysts, 1 data engineer, 1 Lead PMM, 1 VP of Engineering, and 30+ Engineers & QAs across two product tracks- Core Track and AI Clinic Track.
We have already shipped multiple AI initiatives:
AI Scribe that helps clinicians save time on writing progress notes
Chart Review AI that highlights deviations from clinical protocols
Agentic AI Receptionist that owns internal support processes
The role reports directly to the CEO.
We expect the person in this role to bring rare, genuine depth across product strategy, behavioural design, applied AI, data-driven decision making, and people leadership - and to operate effectively at both the executive and hands-on levels simultaneously.
Responsibilities
Define, refine, and execute the long-term AI-first product vision and strategy for MEDvidi
Lead, coach, and manage the full product & engineering organisation across both product tracks
Set and maintain a high bar for product quality and execution speed across all teams
Facilitate quarterly strategy and OKR planning at the executive level
Resolve cross-functional blockers and identify opportunities through direct day-to-day engagement with teams
Continuously improve product & engineering culture and processes
Collaborate with other department heads and the CEO on company-level initiatives
Requirements
10+ years of experience in product management, with at least 3-5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing multiple product teams
Experience leading cross-functional organisations that include design, data, and/or engineering - not just PM
Strong product sense: proven track record of both growing existing products and building new ones from 0 to 1
Hands-on experience building AI-first products, including practical knowledge of RAG systems, Agentic AI, and AI Evals
Ability to build an AI product prototype independently, without involving engineering
Experience with behavioural design - building product experiences that drive user behaviour, not just ship features
Executive-level communication skills: ability to bring clarity to complex, uncertain situations
Experience driving company-level strategy and quarterly OKR planning
Data-driven mindset: ability to diagnose issues with data using a segment → root cause → fix approach
Structured problem solving using issue trees, hypothesis trees, or equivalent frameworks
Culture fit: ownership, focus, radical transparency, evidence-based decisions
Advanced English (C1+) and fluent Russian
What we offer
High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
Time off: 22 paid vacation days annually, 5 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.
Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.
MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Physical AI
jobs.text:
Director of Engineering, Physical AI
Role Overview
The Director of Engineering will report to the General Manager of Physical AI, and will be responsible for leading a multi-disciplinary engineering organization. In this senior leadership role, you will own the execution of the Physical AI Data Engine — the platform powering the next generation of Physical AI/Embodied AI. You will collaborate closely with Operations and GTM to guide product direction and help solve the data bottleneck that stands between today's robotics research and real-world deployment.
This role requires significant ownership in a fast-paced environment and you will motivate internal teams to set the pace for business growth. Travel will come into play.
Key Responsibilities:
Set and drive the technical vision across data collection infrastructure, teleoperation systems, ML training pipelines, model evaluation frameworks, annotation tooling, and research
Lead a multidisciplinary engineering organization—spanning engineering managers, software engineers, ML engineers, and ML research scientists—while designing the organizational structure, talent strategy, and culture required to scale rapidly without compromising on quality or strategic alignment
Maintain exceptional technical and operational excellence by deeply understanding team deliverables, asking incisive questions, identifying slipping standards early, and knowing precisely when to step in
Drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Operations, and GTM on platform architecture, release processes, and shared priorities
Collaborate with researchers and clients to architect and deliver scalable, production-grade data infrastructure tailored for complex robotics workloads
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related technical field
8+ years of engineering experience in fast-paced environments, including 4+ years direct people management demonstrated history of recruiting, mentoring, and developing high-performing technical teams through rapid growth and change
Experience leading technical execution for complex hardware-software systems, with deep domain knowledge in Robotics, Autonomous Vehicles, Computer Vision, and/or Machine Learning strongly preferred
Deep fluency in the ML development lifecycle — training pipelines, data flywheels, and evaluation frameworks as systems you've built and owned
Comfortable leading teams across Python, C++, and TypeScript/Node stacks, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes), and workflow orchestration (Temporal, Airflow)
Proven ability to independently navigate, execute effectively amidst ambiguity, and strong attention to detail
Strong operator and communicator to create tight feedback loops between teams, surface problems early, and drive decisions with clarity across technical and executive audiences
Nice to Have
MS or PhD is a plus, though strong practical experience is equally valued.
Hands-on experience with teleoperation systems (ALOHA, UMI, hand tracking), robotic hardware platforms, or imitation learning
Background in sensor fusion, SLAM, or 3D data processing
Experience scaling data collection systems globally
Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend.
The base salary range for this full-time position in the location of San Francisco is:
$302,400—$378,000 USD
PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.
About Us:
At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.
We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status.
We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information.
We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.
PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data Products
jobs.text:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.
We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our Data Products pillar, serving as the technical engine for Counterpart Health's (CPH) clinical-data foundation. You will own the technical strategy and execution for the Data Products roadmap—encompassing clinical data ingestion, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability—while building scalable, reusable data capabilities that serve as a foundational platform for driving clinical insight generation. You will own the technical strategy for our Data Products platform—ensuring our clinical data foundations (using standards like FHIR, LOINC, and RxNorm) effectively drive business outcomes. You will serve as a critical leader and partner to the VP of Engineering and cross-functional leaders in Product, Data Science, and Design.
As a Director of Engineering, Data Products, you will:
Own the Data Products technical roadmap, canonical data modeling, and ingestion scalability.
Manage and optimize the clinical data ingestion pipeline.
Oversee the scaling of customer data onboarding processes and the continuous improvement of data hygiene, canonical storage standards, and observability and monitoring of the data pipelines.
Enable shared funnel visibility across the organization and support the development of a robust enterprise reporting framework.
Drive the adoption of an AI-powered Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), leveraging AI tools to accelerate coding, testing, and deployment processes while maintaining stringent code quality and security standards.
Success in this role looks like:
Successfully achieving improved clinical data coverage and freshness targets across all patient populations.
Predictable and repeatable multi-customer scaling with standardized playbooks for rapid data readiness.
Broad adoption of the Data Products platform and its capabilities
Data infrastructure is robust, stable, and serves as a reliable source of truth during rapid organizational growth and customer expansion.
You should get in touch if:
You possess 10+ years of engineering experience with a deep focus on building high-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR, CCDA).
Proven track record in managing and scaling engineering teams that handle data-heavy workloads and complex clinical data pipelines.
Proven experience leading cross-functional teams of engineers to deliver complex software in regulated environments.
Experience implementing and scaling AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., AI code assistants, automated testing, or AI-driven SDLC) to improve engineering productivity.
Demonstrated experience building and managing engineering systems in highly regulated healthcare environments, with a strong operational understanding of HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance requirements.
Passionate about the healthcare sector and committed to utilizing technical expertise to drive meaningful improvements in patient outcomes.
Deeply familiar with the inherent complexities and lack of standardization in clinical datasets, with a proactive focus on enhancing data integrity.
Motivated by intricate technical challenges and dedicated to architecting pragmatic, high-quality engineering solutions through continuous intellectual exploration.
Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments, demonstrating the ability to navigate ambiguity and align technical priorities with overarching strategic objectives.
Action-oriented leader who assumes full ownership of system sustainability, willing to address operational gaps to ensure the team achieves its delivery milestones.
Engineering Leadership Skills:
Proven track record of directly hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering managers, Tech Leads (TLs), and Principal Engineers (PELs).
Demonstrated ability to cultivate a high-performance engineering culture focused on velocity, quality, and psychological safety.
Experience leading organizational change, including structural re-orgs and process evolution.
Strong proficiency in strategic resource allocation, capacity planning, and managing technical debt in a fast-paced product environment.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear, actionable business strategies (e.g., impact on HEDIS/RADV outcomes) for non-technical leadership.
Benefits Overview:
Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.
Additional Perks:
Reimbursement for office setup expenses
Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
Paid parental leave for all new parents
And much more!
About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.
Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.
With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.
Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company.
Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.
A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is:
$223,100—$290,000 USD

jobs.text:
At DUAL North America, our core values dictate how we live and work. We are a group with independence and people at its heart and we are a home for talent with a unique culture: the biggest small company in the world.
The focus on being a People First business has always been at the very heart of the Group; Our vision was to create an independent business with a unique culture and one that would survive and thrive as a business controlled by the people working for it. And finding the most talented and entrepreneurial people to join the Group has been and will continue to be key.
DUAL North America, Inc. is seeking a
AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management
AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management
Location: Remote
Classification: Exempt
Reports to: SVP Service Strategy
Travel: 10-15%
Salary range: $160,000-$180,000
Role overview
DUAL North America is seeking an AVP Technology Delivery & Release Management to lead enterprise technology delivery, release governance, and strategic project execution across the organization. This role requires a strong leader who can drive the successful planning, coordination, communication, and delivery of technology initiatives while ensuring alignment with business objectives.
The AVP will oversee a team of product owners, analysts and project professionals, manage complex cross-functional technology programs, establish release management best practices, and partner closely with business and technology leaders to deliver scalable solutions that support operational excellence and business growth.
Role responsibilities
Leadership and Strategy
Lead, mentor, and develop a team responsible for requirements management, release management, and project execution.
Partner with senior business and technology leaders to prioritize initiatives, manage delivery portfolios, and align technology investments with business outcomes.
Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and execution excellence.
Release Management and Governance
Own and mature the enterprise release management function, including release planning, scheduling, governance, risk management, and deployment readiness.
Establish standardized release management processes, controls, and reporting to improve delivery predictability and quality.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of technology releases across applications, infrastructure, and business systems.
Drive release readiness reviews, dependency management, risk mitigation planning, and post-release assessments.
Ensure releases are delivered in accordance with organizational standards, compliance requirements, and business expectations.
Release Communications and Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders by translating technical concepts into business-relevant information.
Develop and execute comprehensive release communication plans for business and technology stakeholders.
Provide timely updates regarding release schedules, impacts, milestones, risks, and deployment activities.
Present program status, release outcomes, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
Technical Requirements Management
Lead the gathering, prioritization, and validation of technical and functional requirements for strategic technology initiatives.
Collaborate with architects, engineers and business stakeholders to ensure requirements are clearly defined and actionable.
Establish best practices for requirements management to improve solution quality, reduce rework, and accelerate delivery.
Ensure technical requirements align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and business objectives.
Project and Program Management
Lead complex technology projects and programs from initiation through implementation and operational transition.
Ensure delivery teams maintain alignment with scope, timelines, quality expectations, and business goals.
Drive cross-functional coordination to remove obstacles, resolve issues, and maintain project momentum.
Utilize SAFe Agile 6.0, and traditional project delivery methodologies as appropriate to maximize successful outcomes.
Data-Driven Delivery Excellence
Leverage reporting and analytics to monitor progress, identify risks, and support executive decision-making.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on performance trends and lessons learned.
Change Leadership and Organizational Readiness
Support organizational readiness activities that support successful adoption of new technology solutions and capabilities.
Partner with business stakeholders to ensure alignment between project delivery objectives and operational execution.
Promote best practices that improve delivery efficiency, team effectiveness, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Key requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology delivery, project/program management, release management, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership position.
PMP, SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), Release Train Engineer (RTE), or equivalent certifications preferred.
Experience implementing enterprise release management frameworks and governance models preferred.
Extensive experience leading large-scale technology programs, enterprise initiatives, and cross-functional delivery teams.
Demonstrated expertise in Release Management, Project Management, and Technical Requirements Management within complex enterprise environments.
Strong knowledge of Agile SAFe 6, and traditional project management methodologies.
Proven success managing technology portfolios, release governance processes, and organizational transformation initiatives.
Experience working closely with architecture, engineering, infrastructure and business teams to deliver enterprise technology solutions.
Strong understanding of IT operations, software delivery lifecycles, governance frameworks, and technology strategy.
Demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, and competing priorities across multiple initiatives.
Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with a focus on delivering measurable business value through technology.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing strategic planning with operational execution.
What we offer:
A career that you define. Yes, we offer all the usual rewards and benefits - including medical, dental, vision, a wide variety of wellbeing offers, competitive salary, unlimited PTO, 401k with company match, paid volunteer days and more.
We provide an environment where new ideas are encouraged and celebrated, where people who want to have a real hand in our success thrive. We want people who want to make a difference - not just in the workplace, but in the industry and in the wider community.

We consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness, and respect.
