jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
🌍 Global SaaS | $28M Series B Investment
📍 Remote in Europe
The Mission
As the Director of Product, you will lead the product organization to move with conviction, speed, and evidence. You are responsible for leading a team of Product Managers, Designers and Product Operations to ensure we are solving high-impact problems and building the leanest, most impactful solutions for our customers and the business.
You will act as the primary strategic force for the executive team, front-running strategy and managing stakeholder expectations, owning the tactical translation of strategy into a coherent, high-velocity roadmap, so that the roadmap remains proactive, data-driven, and aligned with our commercial goals. Your goal is to be a "Player-Coach" who deep-dives into the domain with PMs to ensure excellent execution habits. You are the final gatekeeper who resolves blockers and scope disputes before they ever reach the CEO or CPTO, which will provide you and the teams with a level of autonomy in which to thrive.
You drive efficiency through an AI-First approach, while embracing SVPG style experimentation and pragmatic execution, and inject these principles into your teams. This allows you to closely align with the Director of Engineering and make Dual Track Agile a standard across the organization.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Elevating Product Discovery & Conviction
Advancing Empowered Squads: You will work to continually increase the level of empowerment within our squads. Moving beyond execution, you coach PMs to take deeper ownership of business outcomes, ensuring they are positioned to solve complex problems rather than just deliver features.
Continuous Discovery: You own the standard for modern discovery. You ensure squads are in constant contact with users to (in)validate hypotheses before significant engineering resources are committed.
Bias to Action with Knowledge: You move with high urgency but high conviction. Decisions must be rooted in user insights and market data, ensuring we are always "building the right thing."
2. The Product-Engineering Partnership (Dual-Track Agile)
Strategic Duo: You work in a tight, peer-level partnership with the Director of Engineering to lead the "R&D engine." Together, you are responsible for the total health, culture, and output of the R&D organization.
Discovery vs. Delivery Alignment: While you own the Discovery Track (validating value and usability), you collaborate daily with the Director of Engineering, who owns the Delivery Track (feasibility, scalability, and execution). You ensure these two tracks are synchronized and never siloed.
Resource & Trade-off Management: You partner with Engineering leadership to manage capacity. You lead the difficult conversations regarding trade-offs between new feature discovery, technical debt, and maintenance, ensuring the business is always focused on the highest ROI activities.
3. Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management
The "Final Answer": You are the primary gatekeeper for the product roadmap. You provide clear, definitive "Yes/No" decisions to executive stakeholders underpinned with knowledge of our customers and the necessary trade-offs.
Vacuum Prevention: You identify misalignments early and resolve them across all swimlanes of the business.
Commercial Realism: You translate high-level business goals (Retention, Revenue, Strategic Growth) into actionable priorities while aligning with the company’s core Key Results and Business Objectives.
4. Operational Excellence & People Leadership
Product Operations Mastery: You view Product Ops as a strategic lever. You standardize discovery documentation and research databases across the organization to create a transparent, low-friction environment.
Outcome Accountability: You manage the Product Scorecard and Rolling Roadmap. These must be high-integrity, automated "Sources of Truth" providing executive-level visibility.
Radical Candor: You practice direct challenge combined with personal care. You are responsible for raising the "Product IQ" of your team—coaching PMs to think like owners and act with strategic independence.
5. Product Advocacy & Representation
Product Voice to the Company: Serve as the primary representative of the Product organization in company-wide meetings (All Hands, Town Halls). You must be able to translate complex technical roadmaps into compelling narratives that inspire and align the entire business.
Evangelizing the Vision: Actively advocate for the "Why" behind our product strategy. You ensure that Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success clearly understand our product direction, value propositions, and upcoming releases.
Presentation Excellence: You possess elite presentation skills, utilizing the Pyramid Principle to deliver high-impact, succinct, and visually clear updates to both internal and external audiences.
6. Aggressive Scope Management & Lean Execution
The "Slicer": You coach PMs to avoid "heavyweight" features. You have a relentless focus on building the leanest possible MVP, MSP, CMF, ILS solutions based on the need or pain. If a solution is over-scoped, you are the one who cuts it back to the core value.
Pushback & Scrappiness: You teach PMs to find their “appetite” for investment into a solution and how to find "cheaper" ways to validate hypotheses. You empower them to push back on high-effort requests by proposing creative, lower-cost alternatives.
Deep-Dive Problem Solving: You don’t stay at the surface. You sit with PMs to help them deeply understand core user problems to avoid building "to cover all bases" and relentlessly focus on solving the actual customer pain.
The Ideal Profile:
The High-Agency Leader: You don't wait for permission; you identify gaps and fill them. You have a natural "bias to action" but are always grounded in data.
The SVPG & Cagan Practitioner: You live and breathe modern product principles and know how to coach others to do the same.
The Elite Communicator: You are a master of the Pyramid Principle. You can command a room, whether it’s a 3rd-person Exec meeting or a 200-person All Hands.
The Systems Thinker: You look at the "R&D Engine" as a whole and work with your Engineering counterpart to optimize for both speed and quality.
Operational Source of Truth: The Scorecard and Roadmap are automated and accurate, serving as the definitive guide for the executive team and the business.
The B2B SaaS Operator: You have built and led product in a B2B SaaS environment — ideally with a sales-assisted and PLG motion and an ARR-driven commercial model.
Success Metrics (First 90 Days):
R&D Sync: Established a seamless rhythm with the Director of Engineering; joint ownership of delivery velocity and discovery outcomes.
Strategic Visibility: The "Rolling Roadmap" and "Scorecard" are live, automated, and being used by the Executive team without manual intervention.
Empowerment Baseline: Documented "Discovery to Delivery" workflows for all 6 squads with clear KPIs for hypothesis validation.
Stakeholder Trust: A measurable reduction in "Roadmap bypass" incidents; stakeholders rely on your "Final Answer."
About CloudTalk:
CloudTalk is THE global AI-powered business calling platform, trusted by 30,000+ professionals at companies like Nokia, Revolut, Glovo, and Uber.
We’re building the world’s most capable AI business calling software available in 160+ countries — helping businesses have more and better calls every day. Backed by $35.3M in funding from leading investors, including KPN Ventures, Point Nine, and HenQ, we're investing in making AI native to every conversation.
We're a ~200-person team that values growth, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and human connection. We move fast, build for the future, and care deeply about creating products — and a culture — that people genuinely love.
Why you’ll love being a CloudTalker
Unlimited PTO that people actually take. Fully remote with four European hubs. A coach you can book, a career path in writing, and equity when you deliver. Here's the full package.
Get better, faster
💬 A coach you can actually book. Recurring 1-on-1 sessions with our resident coach. A real conversation about your career, on company time.
🪜 Promotions without guesswork. Our job-leveling framework is transparent: every level and its expectations, in writing. You'll always know what the next step requires and where you stand.
Work the way you work best
🌴 Unlimited PTO, and we mean it. Taking 30 days a year is normal here. Deliver beyond expectations, and you've bought yourself room for more.
🌍 The right setup for your role. Depending on the team, you’ll either work from one of our hubs four days a week or have the option to work fully remotely. Our offices are fully equipped and centrally located.
⏰ Flexible hours, built around your team. No clocking in, no clocking out. Be there for your team, clients, and the meetings that matter. The rest is yours.
💻 Gear that doesn't fight you. A MacBook for work, plus a home-office allowance for remote roles to build a setup you like sitting at.
Rest like you mean it
🔋 Recharge Fridays: 4 extra all-company days off a year. Once a quarter, everyone is off at the same time. You come back to zero pings, not a doubled backlog. That's the point.
🏃 Fitness allowance. Gym, climbing, yoga, whatever keeps you moving. You choose, we pay.
People worth staying for
💸 Up to €5,000 per referral. You know great people. When we hire one of them, you get paid for it.
✈️ Two offsites a year worth packing a bag for. The all-company offsite (last year: Tuscany 🇮🇹) plus a dedicated function-specific offsite, both somewhere remote enough that people actually talk.
👕 Fresh CloudTalk swag every year!
Apply now and be part of our journey to $100M ARR!
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Cloudtalk will process your personal data based on Cloudtalk’s legitimate interest in finding the most suitable candidate and a pre-contractual relationship with you. For more information on how Cloudtalk processes your personal data, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: SVP of Data Management
jobs.text:
At DUAL North America, our core values dictate how we live and work. We are a group with independence and people at its heart and we are a home for talent with a unique culture: the biggest small company in the world.
The focus on being a People First business has always been at the very heart of the Group; Our vision was to create an independent business with a unique culture and one that would survive and thrive as a business controlled by the people working for it. And finding the most talented and entrepreneurial people to join the Group has been and will continue to be key.
DUAL North America, Inc. is seeking a
SVP of Data Management
Classification: Exempt/Full-time
Reports to: CFO
Travel: %10
Location: Remote/Hybrid
Salary: $200,000- $240,000.00
Role overview
The SVP of Data Managements role is to design, plan, monitor, and improve the organization’s Data Management functions. The central objective of this role is to ensure that the organization’s Data Management disciplines are running effectively and meeting the business’s needs regarding data. With the growing push for data and information being used as corporate assets, serving as integral platforms for generating revenue and competitive advantages, you must be able to understand both the technical points of Data Management, as well as the business drivers and needs regarding data. This individual must be able to understand the “bits and the bytes” related to the organization’s Data Management and develop a strategic plan for the technical space considering the business’s perspective and needs.
Role responsibilities
Set data strategy, governance, and operating model
Align data initiatives to business needs and value
Identify growth, efficiency, and cost-saving opportunities
Define org structure, goals, and KPIs
Ensure regulatory, security, and compliance alignment
Drive enterprise data and analytics capabilities
Oversee full data lifecycle and governance
Ensure data security, privacy, and compliance
Establish KPIs, SLAs, and delivery accountability frameworks
Support SAFe 6.0 and ITIL process execution
If you do not meet all the qualifications for this role, we still encourage you to apply, as we are always looking for diverse talent to join our growing team
Key requirements
15+ years experience managing and/or directing a Data Management operation or team
Proven experience leading strategic planning and initiative designs
Demonstrated success delivering complex, multi-platform initiatives across all integration patterns (EAI, ETL/ELT, Streaming)
Proven experience leading high-growth, fast-paced teams
Knowledge and experience of DAMA DMBOK and the different disciplines of Data Management
What we offer:
A career that you define. Yes, we offer all the usual rewards and benefits - including medical, dental, vision, a wide variety of wellbeing offers, competitive salary, unlimited PTO, 401k with company match, paid volunteer days and more.
We provide an environment where new ideas are encouraged and celebrated, where people who want to have a real hand in our success thrive. We want people who want to make a difference - not just in the workplace, but in the industry and in the wider community.

, remotePosition: Health Information Technology (HIT) Manager/DirectorCompany Overview:Absolute Elder Care is a leading provider of in-home care services for seniors in Ocala, FL and surrounding areas. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for our clients by providing compassionate and personalized care in the comfort of their own homes.Position Overview:We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Health Information Technology (HIT) Manager/Director to oversee our HIT department. The HIT Manager/Director will be responsible for managing and maintaining our electronic health records system, ensuring compliance with HIPAA regulations, and implementing new technologies to improve efficiency and quality of care.Key Responsibilities:- Manage and maintain the electronic health records system, ensuring accuracy, security, and compliance with HIPAA regulations- Develop and implement HIT policies and procedures to ensure efficient and effective use of technology- Train and support staff on the use of HIT systems and troubleshoot any issues that arise- Collaborate with other departments to identify and implement new technologies to improve processes and enhance patient care- Monitor and analyze HIT data to identify areas for improvement and make recommendations for enhancements- Ensure all HIT systems are up to date and in compliance with industry standards- Stay current on industry trends and advancements in HIT to make strategic recommendations for the company- Develop and manage the HIT budget, including forecasting and cost analysis- Oversee the selection and implementation of new HIT systems and software- Ensure all staff are trained on new HIT systems and provide ongoing support and training as neededQualifications:- Bachelor's degree in Health Information Management, Information Technology, or a related field- Minimum of 5 years of experience in HIT management or a similar role- Strong knowledge of HIT systems and electronic health records- Experience with HIPAA regulations and compliance- Excellent communication and leadership skills- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills- Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively- Experience with budget management and cost analysis- Proven track record of implementing and managing HIT systems in a healthcare settingLocation:This is a part-time, remote position. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your qualifications and why you are interested in joining our team at Absolute Elder Care.

jobs.title: Data Policy, Manager/Snr Manager/Assistant Director, Data Governance, GDD, SNDG
jobs.company: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI)
jobs.text:
The Smart Nation Group – Digital Government (SNDG), under the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI), is at the forefront of the Singapore Government’s digital transformation. We shape and implement strategies and policies to achieve our vision of a Digital Government that is Digital to the core, and serves with heart. This includes building long-term digital capabilities for the public sector, driving innovation across Government agencies, and ensuring digital services are user-centric, secure and resilient.
The Government Data Division (GDD) within SNDG plays a central policymaking role in advancing data governance excellence across the public sector. Its responsibilities include:
(a) formulating and implementing whole-of-government (WOG) data policies that guide the strategic management, sharing, and utilisation of data as a national asset;
(b) identifying and driving new initiatives to improve the exchange of data within Government agencies, and sharing of Government data with commercial partners and the public; and
(c) strengthening data governance by developing policies relating to responsible use of data, as well as driving the development of capabilities, institutionalizing structures and standardising tools for WOG.
We want a change maker who has experience in policymaking, and is collaborative in stakeholder management. Experience in data management, governance or related domains will also be helpful.
You must be ready to roll up your sleeves and rally different teams across Government agencies to achieve SNG’s vision of a public sector that is ‘data driven to the core’. This includes enabling Government agencies to use data to create solutions that benefit citizens and businesses, while ensuring the responsible use of data.
You will be part of a team at the forefront of transforming Government data and driving the next bound of the whole-of-Government data ecosystem, through policy formulation and development of key systems and structures. Your work will involve one or more of the following areas:
Policy Development and Implementation. Formulate and implement key data policies across whole-of-Government, that cover data governance, data sharing policies, data classification frameworks, treatment and protection of personal data, as well as the accompanying legislative frameworks.
Stakeholder Engagement. Work closely with agencies to understand their use cases and governance context, and drive implementation. Provide advice on policies and measures, including arbitrating between competing needs where necessary.
Ecosystem Development. Design and implement the next bound of the Government data ecosystem, to supercharge data sharing and usage across whole-of-Government to enable agencies’ use cases in policy, operations and service delivery, while ensuring good data governance. This entails the following work:
Conceptualising a whole value chain perspective of the data ecosystem, including how the pieces should come together to best facilitate the sharing and usage of data underpinned by proper governance frameworks.
Developing the system-level roles and responsibilities that agencies need to play, as part of the broader data value chain perspective.
Capability building for effective implementation (e.g. establish centres of excellence to drive though leadership, establish funding principles and resource allocation).
Integrating the Policy-Tech “handshake” with Government Technology Agency colleagues to ensure the ecosystem architecture and data products support policy objectives.
This role offers a unique opportunity to shape policy and drive change implementation across the public sector, with significant impact on how Government agencies access and use data effectively and responsibly for policy analysis, service delivery and operations.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) - Octopus by RTG
jobs.text:
We are looking for an experienced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the technical vision, architecture, and technology strategy for a next-generation digital wealth management platform. The platform includes native iOS and Android applications, a web-based administration portal, and an AI-powered investment and advisory engine.
As CTO, you will be responsible for defining the platform's long-term technology direction, architecture, security, and governance while partnering closely with the Engineering Director, AI Engineering team, Product, and business stakeholders. This is a strategic leadership position focused on technology vision, technical governance, and business alignment rather than day-to-day software development.
Key Responsibilities
Technology Strategy & Architecture
Define and own the end-to-end architecture for mobile applications, web platforms, AI services, backend systems, and cloud infrastructure.
Establish technology standards, architectural principles, and engineering best practices.
Lead architectural decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and real-time data platforms.
Drive technology roadmaps, architecture evolution, scalability, and technical debt management.
Define non-functional requirements including scalability, performance, availability, resilience, and security.
AI & Innovation
Define the organization's AI strategy and oversee the integration of AI-powered capabilities.
Guide the development of LLM-powered services, conversational AI, and intelligent automation.
Establish AI governance frameworks covering model quality, explainability, monitoring, bias mitigation, auditability, and regulatory compliance.
Ensure AI solutions meet business objectives while operating within regulated financial environments.
Security & Compliance
Own the platform's security architecture, including authentication, authorization, encryption, API security, and identity management.
Ensure compliance with financial regulations, data privacy laws, and security standards across all markets.
Oversee disaster recovery, business continuity, and platform resilience strategies.
Establish governance for audit trails, compliance reporting, and regulatory readiness.
Engineering Leadership
Provide technical leadership across engineering teams and resolve complex architectural challenges.
Lead architecture reviews, technical governance, and engineering decision-making.
Define engineering standards, technical hiring criteria, and technology best practices.
Identify technical risks and ensure mitigation strategies are implemented throughout the product lifecycle.
Executive Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary technology advisor to executive leadership, clients, investors, and strategic partners.
Translate complex technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Project Management teams to align technology delivery with business goals.
Support client engagements, pre-sales activities, RFP responses, and investor presentations.

jobs.title: Medical Director, Clinical Product
jobs.text:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare by building technology that clinicians actually love to use. Our flagship platform, Counterpart Assistant, is a cloud-based, value-based care enablement AI platform designed to empower primary care providers to detect, manage, and prevent chronic diseases earlier. We believe that better technology supporting PCPs at the point of care leads to better clinician experiences and better patient outcomes.
We are seeking a Medical Director of Clinical Product to serve as a clinical voice and provider advocate within our product organization.
In this role, you won't just be advising from the sidelines; you will be a key partner and guiding force for cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, and Design. Drawing on deep, real-world primary care experience, you will help shape how our software integrates into the daily rhythms of busy practice environments. You will ensure our technology solves real clinical pain points for primary care providers, driving clinical care outcomes that enhance the patient-provider relationship.
As a Medical Director, Clinical Product, you will:
Lead Clinical Product Development: Serve as a key clinical voice across cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics), ensuring every feature built reflects the reality of everyday practice and drives clinical utility.
Translate Clinical Reality to Product Design: Bridge the gap between clinical practice and software development. Translate complex care workflows, documentation needs, and value-based care levers into clear, actionable clinical requirements.
Be the Voice of our Clinician Users: Work alongside user research and analytics to synthesize provider feedback, champion the end-user experience, and hold product teams accountable to high standards of clinical usability and safety.
Drive Quality & Pre-Launch Standards: Establish pre-launch clinical QA standards and validation processes to guarantee that new platform tools are intuitive, safe, and efficient before they reach clinicians.
Monitor Industry Trends: Stay ahead of emerging technologies and evolving practices in primary care and value-based care to identify unmet user needs and future product opportunities.
Success in this role looks like:
Uncompromising Clinical Voice: Cross-functional teams actively look to you for clear clinical direction, trusted clinical insight, and clear prioritization of provider needs.
Adding to a Seamless Cross-Functional Alignment: A collaborative, high-execution environment where clinical, product, and engineering teams operate with shared clarity and mutual accountability.
You should get in touch if:
Clinical Degree: Active MD or DO with board certification in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Geriatrics, or a related primary care field.

Health Tech Integration: Proven track record (3+ years) participating in health technology product, integration, EHR optimization, or clinical informatics within a practice setting.
Clinical Leadership: Demonstrated capability to command respect, lead cross-functional discussions, and guide non-clinical teams toward sound clinical decisions.

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
Role & Responsibilities
Creative Leadership & Vision
Set and elevate the creative standard across the APAC Hub, championing exceptional craft and contemporary visual thinking.
Partner with Creative Directors and cross-functional teams to shape creative direction across multiple clients and workstreams.
Develop compelling visual systems, creative territories, and design languages that scale across channels, markets, and platforms.
Present creative vision and design rationale confidently to clients and senior stakeholders.
Design Excellence
Create and oversee distinctive, beautifully crafted design systems that balance aesthetics, usability, and scalability.
Be comfortable working across the full spectrum of design, from branding and identity systems to websites, digital products, campaigns, social content, and presentations.
Maintain an exceptional eye for typography, composition, motion, storytelling, and contemporary visual culture.
Provide hands-on creative direction and design leadership on key projects when required.
Team Leadership
Mentor, coach, and inspire designers, Art Directors, and Senior Art Directors, helping them grow both creatively and professionally.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing creative culture built around curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning.
Champion constructive feedback, strong creative reviews, and a culture of raising the standard together.
Craft, Systems & Innovation
Drive consistency across design systems, templates, frameworks, and creative processes.
Identify opportunities to improve creative workflows through automation, scalable systems, and operational efficiencies.
Champion technology-enabled creativity by integrating AI-powered tools and automation throughout the creative process, helping teams work smarter while maintaining exceptional creative quality.
Continuously explore emerging creative technologies and evolve best practices across the team.
Requirements
10+ years of experience across branding, design, digital, campaigns, and integrated creative environments.
Exceptional portfolio demonstrating creative leadership, world-class visual craft, and strategic design thinking.
Proven experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams across multiple clients or brands.
High proficiency across Figma, Google Slides, and the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
Deep understanding of brand systems, digital experiences, content ecosystems, social-first thinking, and integrated campaigns.
Experience designing across branding, websites, digital products, campaigns, social content, and presentations.
Strong understanding of scalable design systems and operational workflows.
Demonstrated experience integrating AI-powered creative tools and automation into design workflows to improve quality, speed, and efficiency.
Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent English proficiency.
Nice to Have
Experience working across APAC markets.
Motion design, creative technology, or digital product experience.
Experience building and leading distributed creative teams.
What We Value
Leaders who inspire exceptional creative work through both vision and action.
Designers with impeccable taste and an obsession for craft.
Curiosity, experimentation, and a commitment to continuous evolution.
A systems mindset that balances creativity with scalability.
Technology-enabled creativity, where AI and automation are embraced as part of the modern creative process.
People who build strong teams, champion collaboration, and elevate those around them.

About Monks
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long-term impact.
Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025), runner-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024). Additionally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

jobs.title: AI & Data - Vice President
jobs.text:
About AlixPartners
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters, creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve.
By understanding, respecting and supporting the needs of our employees, clients and communities, AlixPartners fosters an inclusive environment where authenticity, growth and collaboration thrive. We believe diversity strengthens our perspectives, improves our decisions and ultimately delivers better outcomes for our clients.
About our Paris Office
Paris is one of AlixPartners' leading European offices, advising CEOs, Boards, executive teams and private equity investors across France and the wider EMEA region.
Our consultants support clients through their most critical business challenges across industries including Aerospace & Defence, Consumer Products, Retail, Healthcare, Industrial Goods, Technology, Financial Services and Private Equity.
While our office has grown significantly, we have deliberately preserved the entrepreneurial culture of a boutique firm.
Our teams remain lean. Responsibility comes early. Collaboration is genuine. Ideas matter more than hierarchy.
From day one, our consultants work alongside Partners and senior client executives to solve complex business problems and deliver measurable results.
Today, we are investing in the next chapter of our growth by building our AI Transformation practice in France.
AI Transformation
Artificial Intelligence is creating one of the largest business transformations of our generation. While many organisations are experimenting with AI, relatively few have succeeded in turning it into measurable business value.
At AlixPartners, we help clients move beyond experimentation.
We combine strategy, transformation and execution to help organisations identify high-impact AI opportunities, redesign operating models, prototype solutions, deploy AI at scale and create sustainable business outcomes.
Our AI Transformation team brings together experienced consultants, AI specialists and industry experts to help organisations rethink how they operate, make decisions and create value. Working closely with colleagues across our global network, we support clients across functions including operations, finance, procurement, supply chain, commercial excellence and corporate strategy.
Our ambition is to build a team of consultants who combine outstanding business judgement with modern AI capabilities.
This is a unique opportunity to join at an early stage, help shape our AI Transformation practice in France and influence how AI consulting evolves within AlixPartners.
What We Offer
Impactful, hands-on and pragmatic—at AlixPartners, your career is driven by performance, initiative and the value you create.
Working in small, highly experienced teams, you will collaborate directly with CEOs, executive committees, Boards and private equity investors on some of their most strategic and time-critical challenges.
Our consultants do more than develop recommendations. They work alongside clients to design solutions, prototype rapidly, deploy at scale and measure the impact created.
One week you may be helping a CEO define an enterprise AI strategy. The next, you may be building an AI-enabled solution to automate a critical business process, improve decision-making or transform the way an organisation operates.
This unique combination of strategy, execution and technology is what differentiates AlixPartners.
Through our One-Firm approach, you will collaborate with experts across industries, functions and geographies while benefiting from exceptional learning opportunities, international exposure and accelerated career development.
Your Role
As part of our AI Transformation team, you will help organisations unlock the full potential of Artificial Intelligence across strategy, operations and enterprise transformation.
Depending on your experience, your responsibilities may include:
AI Strategy & Transformation
Define AI transformation strategies and implementation roadmaps.
Identify high-value AI use cases across business functions.
Design AI-enabled operating models.
Advise executive teams on AI investments, governance and adoption.
Support organisational change and AI transformation programmes.
Build & Prototype
Develop Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs).
Design and prototype AI-enabled business solutions.
Experiment with Generative AI, Agentic AI and emerging technologies.
Design intelligent workflows and automation solutions.
Translate business challenges into practical AI use cases.
Deliver Business Impact
Deploy AI solutions alongside client teams.
Support enterprise-wide adoption.
Measure business outcomes and value creation.
Bridge business priorities with technical implementation.
Ensure solutions remain pragmatic, scalable and focused on measurable client impact.
Build the Practice
As our AI Transformation practice continues to grow, you will also contribute to:
developing new client offerings;
creating reusable methodologies and intellectual property;
supporting business development activities;
mentoring colleagues;
strengthening AlixPartners' market leadership in AI Transformation.
This description is not intended to provide an exhaustive list of responsibilities.
Your Profile
We are looking for consultants who combine business acumen, technical curiosity and an execution mindset.
Depending on seniority, we welcome candidates ranging from exceptional early-career talent to experienced transformation leaders.
Successful candidates may come from leading consulting firms, specialised AI organisations, technology consulting practices or corporate transformation teams.
Successful candidates will typically demonstrate:
outstanding structured problem-solving skills;
strong business judgement and consulting capabilities;
a pragmatic, hands-on approach to solving complex challenges;
an entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership;
excellent communication and stakeholder management skills;
the ability to bridge business priorities and technology;
intellectual curiosity and a passion for continuous learning.
Technical Experience
We value hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including:
Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector databases
Agentic AI
AI orchestration and workflow automation
AI governance, responsible AI and security
Hands-on experience building prototypes, experimenting with AI technologies and deploying AI-enabled solutions is particularly valued.
We care far more about what you have built, deployed and the measurable value you have created than the number of technologies you have used.
The AlixPartners Mindset
Technical expertise is only part of the equation.
Our best consultants share a common mindset.
They are intellectually curious.
They simplify complexity.
They are comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situations.
They take ownership.
They enjoy building.
They test ideas.
They continuously improve.
They focus relentlessly on outcomes.
At AlixPartners, titles matter less than contribution.
Hierarchy matters less than ideas.
Execution matters more than PowerPoint.
We believe AI is not an end in itself. It is a lever to solve real business problems, create measurable value and deliver lasting transformation.
We are not looking for people who simply understand AI.
We are looking for consultants who will help organisations create measurable value through AI.
If that resonates with you, we'd love to meet you.

blocks.text: About AlixPartners

At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters, creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve.

By understanding, respecting and supporting the needs of our employees, clients and communities, AlixPartners fosters an inclusive environment where authenticity, growth and collaboration thrive. We believe diversity strengthens our perspectives, improves our decisions and ultimately delivers better outcomes for our clients.
About our Paris Office
Paris is one of AlixPartners' leading European offices, advising CEOs, Boards, executive teams and private equity investors across France and the wider EMEA region.

Our consultants support clients through their most critical business challenges across industries including Aerospace & Defence, Consumer Products, Retail, Healthcare, Industrial Goods, Technology, Financial Services and Private Equity.
While our office has grown significantly, we have deliberately preserved the entrepreneurial culture of a boutique firm.
Our teams remain lean. Responsibility comes early. Collaboration is genuine. Ideas matter more than hierarchy.
From day one, our consultants work alongside Partners and senior client executives to solve complex business problems and deliver measurable results.
Today, we are investing in the next chapter of our growth by building our AI Transformation practice in France.
AI Transformation

Artificial Intelligence is creating one of the largest business transformations of our generation. While many organisations are experimenting with AI, relatively few have succeeded in turning it into measurable business value.
At AlixPartners, we help clients move beyond experimentation.

We combine strategy, transformation and execution to help organisations identify high-impact AI opportunities, redesign operating models, prototype solutions, deploy AI at scale and create sustainable business outcomes.

Our AI Transformation team brings together experienced consultants, AI specialists and industry experts to help organisations rethink how they operate, make decisions and create value. Working closely with colleagues across our global network, we support clients across functions including operations, finance, procurement, supply chain, commercial excellence and corporate strategy.
Our ambition is to build a team of consultants who combine outstanding business judgement with modern AI capabilities.
This is a unique opportunity to join at an early stage, help shape our AI Transformation practice in France and influence how AI consulting evolves within AlixPartners.
What We Offer
Impactful, hands-on and pragmatic—at AlixPartners, your career is driven by performance, initiative and the value you create.

Working in small, highly experienced teams, you will collaborate directly with CEOs, executive committees, Boards and private equity investors on some of their most strategic and time-critical challenges.
Our consultants do more than develop recommendations. They work alongside clients to design solutions, prototype rapidly, deploy at scale and measure the impact created.

One week you may be helping a CEO define an enterprise AI strategy. The next, you may be building an AI-enabled solution to automate a critical business process, improve decision-making or transform the way an organisation operates.
This unique combination of strategy, execution and technology is what differentiates AlixPartners.

Through our One-Firm approach, you will collaborate with experts across industries, functions and geographies while benefiting from exceptional learning opportunities, international exposure and accelerated career development.
Your Role
As part of our AI Transformation team, you will help organisations unlock the full potential of Artificial Intelligence across strategy, operations and enterprise transformation.
Depending on your experience, your responsibilities may include:
AI Strategy & Transformation

items: Define AI transformation strategies and implementation roadmaps.
Identify high-value AI use cases across business functions.
Design AI-enabled operating models.
Advise executive teams on AI investments, governance and adoption.
Support organisational change and AI transformation programmes.

blocks.text: Build & Prototype

items: Develop Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs).
Design and prototype AI-enabled business solutions.
Experiment with Generative AI, Agentic AI and emerging technologies.
Design intelligent workflows and automation solutions.
Translate business challenges into practical AI use cases.

blocks.text: Deliver Business Impact

items: Deploy AI solutions alongside client teams.
Support enterprise-wide adoption.
Measure business outcomes and value creation.
Bridge business priorities with technical implementation.
Ensure solutions remain pragmatic, scalable and focused on measurable client impact.

blocks.text: Build the Practice
As our AI Transformation practice continues to grow, you will also contribute to:

items: developing new client offerings;
creating reusable methodologies and intellectual property;
supporting business development activities;
mentoring colleagues;
strengthening AlixPartners' market leadership in AI Transformation.

blocks.text: This description is not intended to provide an exhaustive list of responsibilities.
Your Profile
We are looking for consultants who combine business acumen, technical curiosity and an execution mindset.
Depending on seniority, we welcome candidates ranging from exceptional early-career talent to experienced transformation leaders.
Successful candidates may come from leading consulting firms, specialised AI organisations, technology consulting practices or corporate transformation teams.
Successful candidates will typically demonstrate:

items: outstanding structured problem-solving skills;
strong business judgement and consulting capabilities;
a pragmatic, hands-on approach to solving complex challenges;
an entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership;
excellent communication and stakeholder management skills;
the ability to bridge business priorities and technology;
intellectual curiosity and a passion for continuous learning.

blocks.text: Technical Experience
We value hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including:

items: Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector databases
Agentic AI
AI orchestration and workflow automation
AI governance, responsible AI and security

blocks.text: Hands-on experience building prototypes, experimenting with AI technologies and deploying AI-enabled solutions is particularly valued.
We care far more about what you have built, deployed and the measurable value you have created than the number of technologies you have used.
The AlixPartners Mindset
Technical expertise is only part of the equation.
Our best consultants share a common mindset.
They are intellectually curious.
They simplify complexity.
They are comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situations.
They take ownership.
They enjoy building.
They test ideas.
They continuously improve.
They focus relentlessly on outcomes.
At AlixPartners, titles matter less than contribution.
Hierarchy matters less than ideas.
Execution matters more than PowerPoint.
We believe AI is not an end in itself. It is a lever to solve real business problems, create measurable value and deliver lasting transformation.
We are not looking for people who simply understand AI.
We are looking for consultants who will help organisations create measurable value through AI.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Event Contracts
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
Event Contracts are one of the fastest-growing financial innovation categories globally over the past two years, showing significant potential across crypto, politics, sports, and macro events. We are building our own Event Contract product line from the ground up. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who understands both financial products design, trading systems and market microstructure to take the business line to the next growth phase.
What You’ll Be Doing
Own the full lifecycle of this business line — from mechanism design and liquidity build-out to user growth and experience optimization — driving the end-to-end planning and execution of the Event Contract product line.
Product Mechanism Design: Own the overall design of Event Contract products, including but not limited to product specs for Up-Down, Between (range), and Hit; strike price generation logic; settlement mechanism design; and the specs of contracts on crypto, equities, and other underlyings.
Market Depth & Liquidity Framework: Design and drive the Market Maker incentive and obligation framework (spread, depth, uptime, and other obligation metrics); continuously monitor order book quality (spread / depth / uptime) to keep the product competitive on key liquidity metrics.
Business Growth: Own user experience, user growth, and business scaling for this category — including defining and executing user growth campaigns, acquisition/retention/activation strategies, and coordinating channel and operations resources; accountable for core business metrics such as trading volume and user count.
Competitive Research, Data-Driven Decisions & Cross-Team Collaboration: Continuously track the product mechanisms, fee structures, volume composition, and growth strategies of leading domestic and international competitors, translating industry best practices into product iteration plans for our platform; conduct in-depth analysis of internal trading data to produce actionable product and growth recommendations; work closely with Trading Engine, Frontend, Risk/Settlement, Liquidity/Market Making, and Operations teams to drive execution and iteration.
New Business Exploration: Explore opportunities to combine event contracts with other product formats (e.g., structured products, social/community mechanics, copy trading, broker distribution partnerships) to open up new growth curves for the platform.
What We Look For In You
Experience building complex backend systems from 0 to 1 (e.g. trading systems, ad systems, e-commerce systems, or payment systems). Candidates with internet product growth experience, having led acquisition/retention/activation campaigns and owned business outcomes and metrics, have a strong advantage.
Exceptional learning ability, logical reasoning, and quantitative skills. Strong ability to abstract and translate real-world business scenarios into elegant data structures and business logic.
Deep understanding of financial derivatives principles, and experience owning the 0-to-1 design or large-scale overhaul of futures/options trading systems is preferred. Alternatively, strong learning ability and transferable methodology from building similar complex systems are welcome.
Strong drive and leadership. Excellent data analytical skills.
Strong insight and judgment, and able to identify hot topics and market opportunities amid constant change. Sustained interest in and understanding of event contracts underlying such as crypto, macro events, sports, and politics.
Ability to systematically produce AI tools to improve personal work output and efficiency (AI leverage) — e.g. using AI to support data analysis, documentation, and code/query writing in day-to-day work.
Experience investing or trading in equities, FX, crypto spot/derivatives, or quantitative trading is preferred.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience in options product design or trading, or hands-on trading/research/industry experience with similar event contracts platforms is a plus.
Experience designing Market Maker strategies or liquidity incentive mechanisms is a plus.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director - Digital Engineering
jobs.text:
The Director – Digital Engineering will provide technical leadership across Qiddiya’s core digital product streams, ensuring that all platforms, services, and digital capabilities are designed and delivered to the highest engineering standards. The role is accountable for ensuring that digital products are built with a reusable, scalable, resilient, reliable, observable, and extensible architecture that can be leveraged across multiple Qiddiya assets. This includes setting the technical direction, challenging low-level engineering decisions, governing solution quality, and ensuring that all delivery outcomes meet the standards defined by Qiddiya Investment Company. The Director – Digital Engineering will work in a multi-vendor delivery environment and will play a critical role in ensuring that vendors, engineering teams, and embedded technical leaders are aligned to Qiddiya’s technology strategy, architecture principles, and operating model.
Key Responsibilities:
Technical Leadership & Engineering Governance
• Lead the technical oversight of Qiddiya’s core digital product streams, ensuring that all solutions are designed and delivered in line with Qiddiya’s target architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technology vision.
• Define and enforce engineering principles around reusability, scalability, resiliency, reliability, observability, maintainability, security, and performance across all digital products and platforms.
• Ensure that all technical decisions are properly reviewed, challenged, and validated by Qiddiya, with clear ownership and governance over architecture and engineering direction.
• Act as a senior technical authority capable of engaging at low-level design, architecture, code, integration, infrastructure, and operational decision-making levels.
• Challenge vendor proposals, solution designs, implementation approaches, and technical trade offs to ensure that Qiddiya retains control over critical engineering decisions.
Product Architecture & Reusability
• Ensure that digital products are built as reusable capabilities that can be extended and adopted across multiple Qiddiya assets, rather than being designed as isolated one-off implementations.
• Drive the creation of reusable patterns, components, services, APIs, integration approaches, and engineering guidelines that support product scalability across the Qiddiya ecosystem.
• Partner closely with architecture, product, delivery, DevSecOps, cloud, and security teams to ensure that product delivery aligns with the overall digital target state.
Leadership of Staff Engineers
• Lead and manage Staff Software Engineers who will be embedded within product streams and work closely with vendor teams.
• Set clear expectations for Staff Engineers around technical governance, architecture review, engineering excellence, code quality, observability, resiliency, and vendor challenge.
• Ensure that Staff Engineers are actively influencing product delivery, reviewing technical decisions, and protecting Qiddiya’s long-term technology interests.
• Build a strong internal engineering capability that reduces dependency on vendors for critical technical decisions and strengthens Qiddiya’s ownership of its digital platforms.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management - Evidence Platform
jobs.text:
Director of Product Management - Evidence Platform
Truveta is the world’s first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta’ s ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.
Truveta was born in the Pacific Northwest, but we have employees who live across the country. Our team enjoys the flexibility of a hybrid model and working from anywhere. In person attendance is required at least once per year for an onsite meeting.
For overall team productivity, we optimize meeting hours in the pacific time zone. We avoid scheduling recurring meetings that start after 3pm PT, however, ad hoc meetings occur between 8am-6pm Pacific time. #LI-remote
Who We Need
Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. Beyond core capabilities, we are seeking problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.
This Opportunity
“Build the platform that powers the next generation of AI-native clinical research.”
Evidence is one of Truveta’s three core product pillars, alongside Data and Intelligence. Reporting to the Head of Evidence, you will lead the Product Management organization within Evidence and partner to shape the strategy, roadmap, and customer experience of the Evidence Platform.
The Evidence Platform enables researchers, healthcare organizations, and life science companies to transform one of the world’s largest collections of healthcare data into trusted real-world evidence (RWE). It provides the reusable platform capabilities that power clinical research, regulatory evidence generation, healthcare analytics, AI-powered research, and future healthcare applications.
You will join a small, highly collaborative team and lead a growing Product Management organization. This role combines organizational leadership with hands-on product management. In addition to leading the Product Management organization, you will personally own strategic product areas, partner closely with customers and engineering teams, and drive products from discovery through launch and continuous improvement, helping define the platform that enables the next generation of AI-native clinical research.
A successful Director of Product Management at Truveta is someone who:
Thinks in platforms rather than point solutions, building reusable capabilities that support multiple products, workflows, and customer segments.
Leads by example, balancing organizational leadership with hands-on ownership of strategic product areas and close partnership with customers and Engineering.
Is deeply curious about researchers, healthcare organizations, and life science customers, meeting them where they work rather than forcing them into predefined workflows.
Uses customer insights, experimentation, and product data to continuously improve products and prioritization.
Builds high-performing Product Management teams while creating clarity and alignment across Engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.
Responsibilities
Product leadership
Lead, coach, and grow the Product Management organization for the Evidence Platform.
Personally own one or more strategic product domains, driving product discovery, customer validation, feature definition, prioritization, launch, and continuous improvement.
Partner with the Head of Evidence to translate long-term product vision into strategy, roadmaps, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Build a high-performing product organization with clear ownership, accountability, and execution.
Platform strategy and customer value
Develop a deep understanding of researchers, healthcare organizations, pharmaceutical companies, and life science customers, translating their needs into reusable platform capabilities.
Define and evolve the platform strategy, balancing customer value, scientific rigor, engineering investment, extensibility, scalability, and long-term platform evolution.
Stay close to customer workflows, product behavior, and technical tradeoffs while simplifying research workflows and enabling future AI-powered experiences.
Data-driven product management
Establish a culture of data-driven product management using customer insights, product metrics, experimentation, and business outcomes.
Define product success metrics, evaluate customer behavior and outcomes, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product portfolio.
Cross-functional leadership
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Intelligence, Catalysts, Evidence Services, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Sales, and executive leadership.
Drive alignment across organizations while balancing customer-facing innovation with platform scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Statistics, Public Health, Healthcare, or a related quantitative field.
10+ years of Product Management experience, including significant experience leading Product Managers or product teams.
Demonstrated success building enterprise SaaS, platform products, data platforms, analytics platforms, research platforms, AI-enabled products, or other complex data-intensive software.
Strong understanding of clinical research, real-world evidence (RWE), real-world data (RWD), healthcare analytics, clinical informatics, biomedical informatics, or life sciences.
Proven ability to translate long-term product strategy into measurable execution.
Demonstrated experience owning strategic product areas end-to-end while leading and developing Product Managers.
Systems thinking with the ability to identify reusable platform capabilities that support multiple products, workflows, and customer segments rather than isolated solutions.
Strong product judgment balancing customer needs, scientific rigor, technical constraints, extensibility, and long-term platform evolution.
Strong analytical mindset with experience using customer behavior, experimentation, and product metrics to guide product decisions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across engineering, clinical, commercial, and executive leadership.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building products for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, medical device, CRO, academic research, or research-intensive software organizations.
Experience supporting observational research, clinical trials, regulatory submissions, or regulatory-grade evidence generation.
Experience working with healthcare data including EHR, claims, genomics, imaging, registries, or other real-world data sources.
Experience building extensible platform products, shared platform capabilities, or data products supporting multiple solution areas.
Experience designing products that integrate naturally into researcher workflows rather than requiring customers to adopt entirely new ways of working.
Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for roadmap planning, backlog management, portfolio management, and cross-team coordination.
Experience building AI-enabled products, analytics platforms, or research software.
Advanced degree such as an MS, PhD, MD, MPH, or MBA.
What Success Looks Like
Within your first 12 months you will have:
Strengthened and evolved the Product Management organization with clear ownership, accountability, and execution.
Established a repeatable product operating model that improves planning, prioritization, roadmap management, and delivery.
Delivered measurable improvements in researcher productivity, customer satisfaction, and the quality, reproducibility, and impact of research performed on the platform.
Established a culture of data-driven product management where investment decisions are informed by customer behavior and measurable outcomes.
Strengthened partnerships across Engineering, Data, Intelligence, Design, Catalysts, and customer-facing organizations.
Expanded the Evidence Platform through reusable platform capabilities that enable new research and healthcare solutions while maintaining a coherent long-term strategy.
Why Truveta?
Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together.
We Offer:
Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage
Great benefits package
Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans
401K plan
Professional development & training opportunities for continuous learning
Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off
Generous parental leave
Regular team activities (virtual and in-person)
The base pay for this position is $253,000 to $280,000. The pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target. Pay is based on several factors including location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles are eligible for additional compensation such as incentive pay and stock options.
If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.
Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude Black and Indigenous people, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people. We strongly encourage individuals with these identities to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements.
Please note that all applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer as we are unable to sponsor work visas or permits (e.g. F-1 OPT, H1-B) at this time. We appreciate your interest in the position and encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

jobs.title: (Senior) Director, Product Quality
jobs.text:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​
For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.
Position Summary
Join ASM's journey to enable the next era of semiconductor innovation. As Product Quality Director/Sr. Director, you will lead quality and reliability for cutting-edge equipment platforms supporting advanced process technologies. Reporting to the VP, Global Quality, you will work at the intersection of engineering innovation and customer success, driving quality excellence from new technology development through global deployment. This role provides a unique opportunity to influence the development and commercialization of breakthrough semiconductor technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and ensure the robust performance of products that enable the world's most advanced AI, logic, memory, and high-performance computing applications.
Key Responsibilities
Product Line Quality Ownership
Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for all product quality matters for assigned product lines
Coach and mentor teams for root cause investigations on issues leveraging failure analysis and best practices, e.g. 5 Why's, fishbone diagram etc.
Develop and execute product quality strategies aligned with business objectives in alignment with business units.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
Monitor and report product quality performance through established KPIs and scorecards.
New Product Introduction (NPI) Quality Leadership
Lead Quality engagement throughout the NPI lifecycle.
Define, communicate, and execute Quality Roles & Responsibilities (R&R) within product development programs.
Ensure Design for Quality and Reliability principles are incorporated into new product development.
Support design reviews, qualification activities, and product release readiness assessments.
Establish product quality requirements and acceptance criteria during development.
Product Lifecycle Quality Management
Serve as the Quality Owner within the Product Lifecycle Control (PLC) process.
Own and maintain critical quality deliverables including:
Product and System FMEA
Critical Parts Identification and Control
Reliability Plans and Assessments
Product Risk Registers
Quality Plans
Ensure lifecycle quality requirements are met from concept through end-of-life.
Product Reliability Engineering
Define product reliability requirements and objectives.
Develop reliability verification and validation strategies.
Establish reliability measurement methodologies, performance metrics, and qualification criteria.
Lead reliability growth and improvement activities.
Develop and maintain reliability apportionment models to support system reliability targets.
Analyze field reliability data and drive corrective actions to improve product robustness.
Customer Quality and Escalation Management
Own Top-X customer quality issues and Tier 1 escalations for assigned product lines.
Act as the primary quality interface for strategic customers
Lead cross-functional teams in containment, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and closure activities.
Provide executive-level communication and status updates for critical customer issues.
Drive customer satisfaction and quality improvement initiatives.
Risk Management and Continuous Improvement
Apply risk-based methodologies to identify and mitigate product quality risks.
Facilitate structured problem-solving activities using methodologies such as:
8D
DMAIC
FMEA
Fault Tree Analysis
Root Cause Analysis
Drive systemic corrective and preventive actions.
Champion quality culture and operational excellence initiatives.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Reliability, or related technical discipline.
Master's degree preferred.
Experience
15+ years of experience in Quality, Reliability, Engineering, or Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing.
Proven experience in New Product Introduction (NPI) and Product Lifecycle Management.
Experience leading customer quality escalations and complex cross-functional problem-solving efforts.
Strong understanding of semiconductor equipment systems and reliability engineering principles.
Technical Skills
Product Quality Management
Reliability Engineering
FMEA Facilitation
Statistical Analysis and SPC
Root Cause Analysis
Product Qualification and Validation
Reliability Modeling and Apportionment
Customer Quality Management
Risk Assessment and Mitigation
Quality Management Systems (QMS)
Leadership Competencies
Strong cross-functional leadership and influencing skills.
Excellent executive communication and presentation capabilities.
Ability to drive alignment across engineering, operations, and business organizations.
Customer-focused mindset with a bias toward action and issue resolution.
Strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
This role requires approximately 40% travel internationally.
Apply today to be part of what’s next.
We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.
To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
